dbe skrun gsal bshad/'dzam gling yang steng du chags pa'i rang re'i bod mi rigs 'di nyid la lo rgyus ring zhing mi rigs kyi thun min gyi khyad chos ldan pa'i rig gnas gzhan dring mi 'jog pa zhig yod gshis/ deng sang 'dzam gling du bod rig pa zhes bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i bod spyi tshogs kyi khyab khongs so sor zhib 'jug bgyi ba'i rig lam gsar ba 'di gsar dang byung ste/ rgyal khab dang sa khul mang po zhig gis zhib la jug las khungs ched btsugs kyis do snang chen po byas dang byed bzhin yod pa spyi dang / sgos su rang rgyal du nye ba'i lo 'ga' nas bod rig pa'i zhib 'jug gi las ka dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas pa'i dgos mkho'i ched dang / lhag par rgyal nang du spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi dpal yon gsum 'dzugs spel gyi rba rlabs 'phyur bzhin yod pa'ang mi'i shes rig la rag las stabs/ mi rigs so so'i rtsa ba'i rig gnas phul byung rnams nyams nga/ sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel gtong ba'i dgos mkho bcas la dmigs te/ 'di ga dpe skrun khang gis rgyal khab rim pa'i tshan rig zhib 'jug thi rnam grangs gtso gras su tshud pa'i bod yig gi 〈bka' 'gyur 〉 dang 〈bstan 'gyur nyi dpe bsdur ma par skrun 'grem spel byas dang byed mur yod pa ma zad/ da dung bod kyi mkhas dbang snga rabs pa dag gis mdzad pa'i gsung 'bum thams cad legs sgrig bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi ltar/ bod yig gi gna' dpe'i dpe dkon dpe tshogs du ma par du bskrun dang skrun bzhin yod la/ da lam rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan ras dgyes pa'i dga' ston du 'bul bya ni 〈rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum 〉〉 zhes pa ste/ 'di ni dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i skabs su byon pa'i tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i gsung chos rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs (pod 1428yod pa )pa yin la/ yongs grags su rgyal dbang /lnga pa zhes pa khong ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng thams cad las brtsams chos ches mang zhing / bod kyi chos srid rig gnas thad la mdzad pa ta cang rgya chen po gnang yod pa'i thun min skyes mchog cig yin/

bgrang bya gnyis kyi sngon du 'di ga dpe skrun khang nas ser gtsug dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang dang zhib gros byas mthar srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang / bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈gangs can khyad nor 〉〉zhes pa'i dpe tshogs chen po mnyam 'brel gyis par skrun zhu rgyu'i gros mthun byung ba las/ gsung 'bum 'di nyid par du bskrun pa ni mnyam las kyi grub 'bras thog ma yin zhing / mu mthud las gzhi rgya bskyed yong ba'i rmang gzhi yang tshugs pa yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi bsdu rub dang / glog klad du 'jug pa/ zhu dag bcas ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas mdzad cing / sgrig rim dang dpe sgrigazhu dag skabs kyi gsal bshad zhu dgos pa rnams bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du bkod yod pa ltar lags pas bskyar zlos gsal bshad byas med/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi nang du/ lo rgyus rnam thar skor dang / gsan yig 'don chog sgrub thabs/ dbu phar 'dul mdzod sogs kyi 'grel bshad/ rten bzhugs dkar chag rtsis dkar nagagasol mchod/ chab shog bca' yig rdzogs chen khrid skor/ snyan ngag gi 'grel pa sogs nang don sna mang phun sum tshogs pa yod pas/ skabs de'i bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dang / mdo sngags rig gnas kyi skor la slob gnyer dang zhib 'jug byed mkhan rnams la rin thang gzhal du med pa'i dpyad gzhi'i nor sgrom zhig red/ 'di ltar dpe sgrig gi las ga'i brgyud rim cha tshang ba byas te par du bton mod/ nga tsho'i shes yon gyi chu tshad zhan pa dang mi sna nyung zhing las ka mang drag pas zhu dag dang dpe sgrig thad la chad lhag nor 'phyug yod nges pas mkhyen ldan rnams kyis legs spel nyes 'gog gi dgongs 'char thad dar stsol gnang mkhyen zhu rgyu dang / rting mar gsung 'bum 'di bzhin legs sgrig byed pa'i bya ba la phyogs gang thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gzhud sger kun la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu'o//spung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla 8par/2

gleng gzhi/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs su bskor zhing 'dzam gling go la chen po'i spyi gtsug tu chags pa'i mtho sgang bod ces grags pa'i sa yi thig ler/ pha sprel rgan dang / ma brag srin gnyis nas mched pa'i bod mi'i thog ma byung ba nas bzung / skye bo kun gyis rang rang gi rnam dpyod 'dra min gyi rtsal la brten nas rig pa'i gnas ci rigs gsar gtod dang / 'phel rgyas btang zhing gtong mus mchis/ lhag par dus rabs bdun pa'i skabs su sa gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa yongs su khyab pa'i chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po zhes bya ba'i skyes mchog gang gi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i byed las nyag gcig gi mthu las/ bod kyi sa chen po'i khyon kun la khyab par nus shing / 'jig rten dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs mtha' dag ji bzhin ston par nus pa/ ches ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i bod kyi yi ge 'di bzhin thog mar srol gtod mdzad la/ skye rgu'i phan bde'i gzhi rtsa nang chos bod du bsgyur mgo brtsams pa dang / dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan gyis bsam yas su sad mi bdun gyis thog drangs rab byung gi sde dang / sgra bsgyur slob grwa thog mar btsugs nas blo rig bkra ba'i lo tsā ba du ma gso skyong gnang ste/ nye 'brel rgyal khab khag nas nang rig pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs gzhung snying bcud sna tshogs ljongs 'dir dar spel mdzad de/ shes rig mdzod brgya'i sgo 'phar yangs por phyes pa nas bzung / dus rabs rim pa'i nang yul khams 'dir 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum la mnga' brnyes pa'i mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi skyes chen dam pa ji snyed byon pa rnams kyis snga phyir bod yig tu bsgyur cing gtan la phab pa dang / gsar rtsom mdzad pa'i bstan bcos thams cad 'u cag lta bus tshe gang ngal ba bsten nas bgrangs kyang bgrang bar dka' bas/ bod yul gyi gsung rab glegs bam thams cad gzhi gcig tu brtsigs na ri rgyal lhun po'i dpangs la'ang skyengs pa ster nus so zhes smras kyang 'ud du mi che/ de lta bu'i rtsa che'i rigs gzhung

rmongs pa'i nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman mchog bdud rtsi lta bu de dag gi ro bcud gangs can pa'i lus sems su shog bu snum tshos bzhin du sims pa nas bzung / skye bo phal pa dag gi blang dor 'byed pa'i shes rab kyi tshad kyang ches mthon por son te sgo gsum dge bcu'i las la brtson pa dang / byams dang snying rjes rgyud dul zhing / ya rabs dang gshis bzang gi mdzes sdug rang chas su ldan pa'i mi rigs khyad 'phags can zhig tu yar rgyas byung ba'i 'bras bur/ deng gi dus su'ang 'dzam gling yongs su gnas pa'i srid 'byor rig gsum spyi dang / yang sgos tshan rig rtser son gyi yul gru dag gi mi sna grags can rnams kyang yul 'di dang 'di nyid kyi rig gnas la blo kha phyogs sa dang / zhib 'jug bya yul zhig tu gyur don yang de'i phyir lags/'on kyang sems can spyi mthun gyi bsod nams nyams dmas su song ba'i nyer len las/ lo bcu'i god chags kyi khrod du stong gsum nor gyis bkang ste yon du phul na yang blu thabs bral ba'i gangs ljongs kyi khyad noX te/ gsung rab par shing dang bcas pa phal mo che me lha dang chu lha'i zhal du phul zin das ni bskyar gso bya rgyu'i nus mthu rang cag su la'ang med la/ dus ngan de lta bu'i khrod nas stes dbang gis da lta sa steng du lhag lus gsung rab dag kyang phal che ba dpe rgyun dkon rigs sha stag tu gyur stabs deng skabs rig gnas dngos rdzas kyi lam lugs gzhir bzung bdag srung byed dgos rkyen/ rigs gzhung don gnyer ba'i spyan lam du bstar ma thub pas gsung rab kyi dgos pa ji bzhin ma grub cing / de bas nyen tshabs che ba ni 'byung bzhi sogs kyi gnod pas sa steng du rtsa brlag mi gtong ba'i nges pa med gshis/ 'di kun bdag srung gnad 'khel bya rgyu de gzhan la 'gel thabs med pa'i rang cag kho na'i 'gan 'khri nyid du nges so/ /der brten se ra theg chen gling dang lha ldan gtsug lag khang mnyam 'brel gyis ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang zhes pa'i tshan pa zhig ched du btsugs nas da bar bgrang bya gsum lhag tsam gyi ring la phyogs gnyis nas thun mong du ma thebs sgor sa ya gsum lhag 2

tsam btang ste dpe dkon myur skyob dang / deng skabs slob gnyer ba'i nyer mkho'i ched du gangs can khyad nor zhes pa'i dpe tshogs gsar du bsgrigs te da phan pod phreng nyis brgyar nye ba par skrun zin pa dang / dgon sde dang / spyi tshogs kyi dpe mdzod khang brgya la nye bar cha tshang gnyis re rin med 'bul lam zhus pa phud/ de byings ma gnas tsam gyi thog nas spus 'tshong zhus te/ rgyal bstan la sri zhu dang ris med ser skya thos bsam can rnams kyi thugs 'dun skong thabs zhu mus su mchis/'das pa'i lo zla'i nang nga tsho'i las gzhi la gong rim 'brel yod tshan pa khag gi dbu khrid nas gzigs skyong bla na med pa gnang ba dang / mkhyen dpyod mkha' ltar yangs shing / lhag bsam dung ltar dkar ba'i skyes chen du mas nga tsho'i las kur gdeng 'jog tshad med dang / ma nor lam ston/ ma dpe mkho 'don gnang ba sogs kyis mtshon/ nga tshor phyar ba gru 'degs kyis lhad med rgyab skyor rogs ram gnang bar rjes su yi rangs dang / snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes zhu ba dang chabs ciga'abyung 'gyur yang ser gtsug nas dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso bor gyur pa'i ris med gsung rab dpe rgyun dkon rigs dang / zhib 'jug tshan pa khag dang / slob grwa khag la nye bar mkho ba'i rig gzhung dag kyang rim pas par skrun zhu rgyu'i 'dun pa snying bcangs su yod pa lags na/ lhag bsam rnam dpyod can gyi ris med ser skya kun nas ma dpe mkho 'don dang / nga tsho'i las gar rtsa che'i lam ston bka' slob mu mthud lhug stsol yod pa mkhyen zhes zhu'o/ /ser ra khrig nang bstan dbe rnying 'tshor bas phyogs ga khang nas/spyi lo 2009lo'i zla ba 6pa'i tshes 7la/

bsdo/sgrig gsal sand/7gong sa lnga pa chen po mchog ni spyir sku tshe hril po chos srid gnyis kyis mtshon sku gsung thugs kyi gsang gsum mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dus 'da' bar mdzad pa dang/ yang sgos mdzad pa'i mchog gsung gi mdzad pa ste/ dam pa gang gis rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du bzhag pa'i yid bzhin nor bu las kyang lhag pa'i rtsa chen gsung 'bum dag ni/gang nyid sku 'tsho bzhugs skabs nas lha rtse dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du cha tshang par shing du brkos yod rung / rig gnas gsar brje'i skabs rtsa thor du song nas da lta gsung 'bum cha tshang gcig kyang btsal rnyed dka' bar gyur stabs/ snga phyir don gnyer lhag bsam can gyi tshogs pa dang mi sger mi nyung ba zhig la/ phyogs bsgrigs dang dpe skrun zhu 'dun yod kyang / ma dpe btsal 'tshol dang mi sna'i cha rkyen sogs rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas/ da bar sus kyang dpe skrun ma thub par rim 'gyangs su lus 'dug par brten/'di ga ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang nas spyi lo 2005nas bzung snga phyir 'bras spungs dgon dang /pho brang po tā la/bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang sogs rig dngos tshan pa khag dang /de bzhin mi sger sogs nas ma dpe g.yar po zhus pa bzhin 'brel yod khag nas gang ci'i mthun 'gyur gang legs stsal ba brgyud dge lugs gsung 'bum gtso gnad du byas pa'i ris med kyi gsung 'bum pod stong phrag brgal ba zer bris su dpar ba dang / gzhan yang dpe dkon dang nyer mkho'i rigs dpe deb nyis brgyar nye ba nang khul par skrun byas zin pa dang /de'i khongs nas rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung 'bum pod nyer lnga dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum bcas khyon pod nyer brgyad bzhugs pa/gangs can khyad nor dpe tshogs kyi pod 'phreng 171nas 198bar bsgrigs te rgya che'i gzigs pa 4

po'i spyan lam du phul ba yin/gsung 'bum 'di nyid kyi ma phyi ni pho brang po tā lar bzhugs pa'i rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung 'bum rmang gzhir bzung thog yi ge mi gsal ba dang dogs gnas can rnams se ra theg chen gling gi rgyal ba'i gzims chung bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i gsung 'bum dang / lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa' gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma/ de bzhin dwags po mnga' ris grwa tshang gi gsung 'bum 'phrul par ma sogs ma dpe khag bzhi tsam la zhib bsdur zhus pa yin/glegs bam dang chos tshan gyi go rim ni/ deb 1nas 4bar pod rtags (ka) (kha) rtoganakhong ) ste rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig 'gaṅgā 'a chu rgyun pod bzhi dang / deb ldanas 7bar pod rtags 6) (cha) (ja) ste thun mong phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam pod gsum/ deb 8nas 10bar sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang gi 'phros pod gsum ste pod rtags la (jam (ja3) (ja4)bkod yod/ deb 11pa la pod rtags 6) ste rgyal dbang sku 'phreng gsum pa dang bzhi pa/ dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ mgon po bsod nams mchag ldan/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ byang pa rig 'dzin chen po'i rnam thar bcas chos tshan bdun/ deb 12pa la pod rtags rta)ste zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ nyang ston khra tshang pa/ tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyi rnam thar bcas chos tshan lnga/ deb 13pa la pod rtags (tha)ste bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga zung 'jug sgrub pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan drug cu re gsum/ deb 14pa la pod rtags9)ste dam can chos srung rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs mchod 'bul bskang bshags bstod tshogs sogs chos tshan bcu bdun/ deb 15pa la pod rtags rton)ste lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung sogs chos tshan bcu/ deb 16pa la pod rtags (pa)ste phar phyin blo bzang dgongs rgyan gdong lnga'i dbang po'i sgra dbyangs/ deb 17pa la pod rtags (pha)ste 'dul ba'i

snyelas chog rnam rgyal gser mdog dang / chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 18pa la pod rtags (ba)sde bstod tshogs dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs chos tshan bcu gcig deb 19nas 21bar pod rtags (pa) (she (chen ste sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhedas rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang pod gsum/ deb 22pa la pod rtags (dza)ste rgyal rabs deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs sogs chos chan bzhi/ deb 23pa la pod rtags (wa)ste snyan 'grel dbyangs can dgyes glu sogs chos tshan gsum/ deb 24pa la pod rtags (zha)ste smon lam shis brjod brtan bzhugs sogs kyi chigs su bcad pa rab dkar dge ba'i chu klung glegs bam gnyis/deb 25pa gsung nang ma (ka)ste bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las byang khrag 'thung gad rgyangs sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 26pa gsung nang ma (ba)ste tshe bdag gi yig char rnam par dpyad pa'i yi ge ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig sogs chos tshan zhe gsum/ deb 27pa gsung nang ma rtog)ste rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung sogs chos tshan nyer drug deb 28pa gsung nang ma khong)sde le'u bdun pa'i brgyud 'debs sogs chos tshan nga lnga bcas te pho brang po tā la'i gsung 'bum dkar chag gi go rim ltar bsgrigs pa yin/dmigs bsal zhu bya zhig la khong gi gsung las gsang ba rgya can bris ma pod gnyis bzhugs pa ha cang bka' gnyan pa dang / gsang ba khyab bsgrags mi rung ba'i bka' srol ltar 'dir yang par skrun zhus med pa thugs nges zhu rgyu ma zad/ ma dpe'i nang du mchod brjod sogs kyi skabs su la bhā 65nga tsam byung yang da lta slog klad du lañdza 'a yi ge med pas 'jog thub med pa bcas kyang thugs la nges par 'tshal zhu/lhag par du rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis slad phyin ma phyir dpe sdur ba dang / 'tshol bde ba'i ched ma dpe'i shog grangs dang nyin srib kyi bsdus rtags (2na) (2ba ) 'di'i nang bkod yod/()

zhu dag byed skabs/ thog ma'i zhu dag dang / bskyar zhus/ yang zhus/ zhus chen bcas zhu dag gi rim pa bzhi lhag brgyud cing / tshig phrad dang / lhag bcas/ rgyan sdud gsum gyi phrad dang yig nor mngon gsal can re zung dag bcos byas pa phud/ skabs de'i yi ge'i 'bri srol/ deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba dper na/'bri la 'dri dang / tsong kha pa la btsong kha pa/ mtshams la 'tshams/ mthun la 'thun/mtsho la 'tsho/ med la smad/ byung la 'byung / rang rkya la rang skya/ grwa la ga klong la slong / rig 'dzin la rigs 'dzin/ rig gnas la rigs gnas/ rigs pa la rig pa/ gcod la spyod/ rdzong brda la rdzong sta/ rdzong bda' sogs kyang ma dpe sor bzhag byas yod/spyir na tshig don gnyis thad nas zhus dag pher nges su rloms kyang / nged rnams rtsom sgrig gi bya bar las dang po ba yin pa dang / shes rig nor gyis dbul bas phyogs gang thad nas mi ldeng ba'i cha sogs skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig 'byung nges pas rgya che'i mkhyen ldan rnam pas thad gar ram/yig thog zhal par bcas gang rung gi thog nas nyes 'gog legs spel gyi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang rogs zhes dran skul zhu rgyu ma zad/ lhag par nged tsho'i las don thad lhag bsam rnam dag gis rgyab skyor gnang mkhan dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i rig dngos do dam khang gis gtsos tshan pa khag dang / mi sger bcas nas gang ci'i thad slob ston dang mthun rkyen gyi rgyab skyor tshad med gnang bar snying dbus nas thugs rje che zhes snyel na brgyar zhu'o/ /ser tha khug nang brten dpe rnying 'tshos bsdu phyogs ga khang nas/bod sa glang lo'i sa ga zla ba'i tshes 15la/7

mdzad pa po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/ji skad du/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dus mthar 'jig rten nyams pa na/ /sdom brtson rgyal po'i tshul gyis ni/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba the tshom med/ /dper na ma khol zhes bya dang / /me tog ces byar rnam par grags/ /zhes dang / gzhan yang bka' gdams glegs bam/ rat+na'i spyi lung / rdo rje gling pa'i gter lung / bka' thang sde lnga sogs bka' gter mang po nas 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul par lan cig min par gsungs pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po mtshan yongs rdzogs la thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde'am/byis pa'i mtshan bdud 'dul rdo rje dang / snyan ngag gi mtshan tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje/ gsang mtshan sngags spyon zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal dang / za hor gyi sngags mkhan che mchog 'dus pa rtsal/rnal 'byor pa gang shar rang grol/ de bzhin 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam za hor gyi ban+de zhes yongs su grags pa ste/ gang gi sprul gzhi 'phags mchog spyan ngas gzigs kyi che ba'i yon tan dang / sprul brgyud na rim gyi rnam par byon tshul sogs ni sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i du kū la'i gos bzang glegs bam gsum pa'i 'phros bzhi pa sogs chos 'byung lo rgyus deb ther khag las shes par bya zhing / rigs ni dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho dang / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha sku 'byungs pa'i rgyud za hong gyi rigs las chad pa/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i blon po'i gdung rgyud du yab bdud 'dul rab brtan dang / yum kun dga' lha mdzes gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i me sprul te spyi lo 1617lor lho kha 'phyongs rgyas 'phying dbar stag rtser sku 'khrungs shing / sku na chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i rang mdangs lhag par gsal zheng byis pa phal pa'i spyod tshul las 'das pa'i khyad yon mnga'/ dgung lo gsum thog dpon slob paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang /gling smad zhabs drung khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gnyis nas rwa sgreng gi jo bo 'jam dpal rdo rje 8

dang / lha sa'i jo bo shākya mu ne'i sku drung du zan ril brtag pa mdzad pa dang / chos skyong khag gi bka' lung rnams gcig mthun byung ba ltar paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan dang / chos rje sbyin pa dar rgyas sogs nas gtsang pa rgyal por snyan zhus bka' 'khrol bzhin rgyal ba sku 'phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i yang srid du ngos 'dzin zhus te mi ring bar dga' ldan pho brang du gdan drangs/ dgung lo dgu par paṇa chen rin po ches mkhan po dang / khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob mdzad de dge tshul gyi bslab sdom bzhes te ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde zhes mtshan gsol ba dang / de nas rim bzhin khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ zur chen chos dbyings rang grol/ zha lu mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub/ nyang ston khra tshang pa chen po blo mchog rgya mtsho/ smon 'gro 'jam dbyangs dbang rgyal rdo rje sogs la bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten nas gzhung chen bka' pod lnga dang / gsang sngags gsar rnying gi chos skor/ sgra snyan sman rtsis dang bcas pa rig gnas skor yongs su rdzogs pa la gsan bsam mthar phyin pa mdzad/ de nas dgung lo nyer gnyis pa sa pho stag gi lor lha ldan jo shāka yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du dpon slob paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan gyis mkhan po dang gsang ston/ khri chen dkon mchog chos 'phel gyis las slob/ byes pa rtsed thang pa byams pa smon lam gyis grib tshod pa mdzad de dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/ dgung lo nyer drug par dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang yongs rdzogs bzhes te thog ma'i sde srid du phyag mdzod bsod nams chos 'phel bsko gzhag mdzad/dgung lo nyer dgu par pho brang po tā la'i pho brang rnying pa rgya bskyed thog pho brang dkar po gsar bzhengs mdzad cing / pho brang dkar po grub rjes dga' ldan pho brang gi chos srid kyi byed sgo gal chen khag der spel ba gnang / dgung lo so gsum pa la gso rig 'gro phan gling gsar du btsugs/ dgung lo so drug thog gong ma shun tsis gdan zhus ltar pe cin du phebs/ dgung lo nga bzhi'i thog ra sa dang bsam 9

yas kyi gtsug lag khang bcas la nyams gso gnang ba/ gzhan yang rje 'dis dgon sde gsar 'debs mdzad pa dang / dgon sde khag tu lha khang dang rten mchod gsar bzhedas/ chos gzhis mchod rgyun sbyor 'jags mdzad pa/ ris med gsung rab pod khrir nye bar dkar chag gsar bsgrigs/bsgrub bya khri phrag mang por dge tshul slong gi sdom pa bstsal ba dang / de bzhin dpe rgyun dkon rigasapar 'debs byed rgyu khyab brdal gtong ched/ 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brang gi par khang dang / pho brang po tā la'i ltag sgo'i rgyab kyi par khang bcas gsar du 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa sogs chos srid kyi mdzad pa spyi dang / lhag par rgyal dbang mchog gi don gyi rnam thar gsan yig gaṅgā'i chu rgyun/ phyi'i rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang gis gtsos pa'i rnam thar/ gzhung chen khag gi 'grel pa dbu ma la theg chen rgya mtshor la jug pa'i gru rdzings dang / mdzod la chos mngon rin chen 'dren pa'i shing rta/ 'dul bar las chog rnam rgyal gser mdog rgyal rabs la deb ther rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i dga' ston dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ smin byed kyi 'khrid yig rnam gnyis te lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung dang / rdzogs chen 'khrid yig rig 'dzin zhal lung / de bzhin rtsis skar nag tshe bdag dris lan/dkar chag zhal gdams/ snyan mgur/ snyan dar zhal yig chab shog brtan bzhugs/ lam yigabasko 'ja'/ grwa tshang 'don cha/ dam can chos srung gi sgrub skor/ bsnyen yig sogs pod nyer lnga dang /gsang ba'i gras rtsa gsum lha dang mngon sum mjal zhing bgros pa la sogs pa'i rgya can nyer bzhi'i bu yig bka' rtsom gras bod gnyis bcas/ legs par bshad pa pod nyi shu rtsa bdun brtsams par gnang ste bstan 'gro'i phan bde rgya cher spel gnang mdzad nas mthar dgung grangs re drug ste rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu khyi ste 1682lor dgongs pa gzhan don du gshegs pa bcas dam pa gang gi rnam par thar pa mdor mtshon tsam du bkod pa las zhib phra rang rnam du kū la'i gos bzang sogs mdzad rnam gzhan mang du bzhugs pa las mkhyen par zhus/ /ser gtsug nang brten dpe rnying 'tshos bas phyog sgrig khang nas/0

dkar chagasku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang gi glegs bam gnyis pa/ (1)/༷) tshor /bye/la tho zu mi /rte/ 1)/ ge snakhyertse/ri la snarab byung bcu ga ga pa' chu lar mdzad pa' sku gsung thugs na dang na pa mchad rdzas sogs gsar bzhengs kyi dkar chag dang smon lam sogs/ (1)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu glang lor mdzad pa'i lha sa smon lam go mo'i tshogs khro gsar blug gi kha byang dang / rin go rgyan cha'i deb ther gyi 'go brjod sogs/ 〈10)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing stag lor mdzad pa'i ser 'bras sogs kyi rten mchod rnams kyi deb ther 'go brjod sogs/ 〈69)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing yos lor mdzad pa'i rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par spyi sgos kyi rim gro'i gtong deb kyi 'go brjod dang / bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang la phu dud rgya cher spel ba'i dkar chag sogs/ (76)rab byung bcu gcig me 'brug lor deb ther du bkod pa'i dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du dri med bshags rgyud dpar du bskrun pa'i smon tshig dang / rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur sogs rten mchod gsar bzhengs kyi dkar chag sogs/ (143)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me sbrul lor deb ther du bkod pa'i rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i dngos spyad kyi deb ther dpag bsam 'dod 'jo dang / che'i rig byed mtha' dag gi snying po bsdus pa'i glegs bam gyi che brjod smon lam gyi rim pa sogs/ 〈182)

rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa rta lor deb ther du bkod pa'i mtsho smad bsam grub khang gsar dang smon grong gnyis kyi gzhis dzi'i khang tho dang chos rgyal gter bdag gling pas o rgyan smin grol gling du sku gsung thugs rten legs bskrun gyi dkar chag sogs/ (256)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa lug lor deb ther du bkod pa'i sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur gsar du bzhengs pa'i dkar chag smon lam dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho khri 'don skabs rten gtso khag la tham phud phul ba'i kha byang sogs/ 〈357)

ra༅༅/ /sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag dang tham phud deb khrims yig 'go rgyangs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar phye ba'i skal bzang gi glegs bam gnyis pa bzhugs/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu byi lor mdzad pa'i sku gsung thugs rten dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas sogs gsar bzhengs kyi dkar chag dang smon lam sogs/༄tsho/ /(sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i brit+ta las me tog 'phreng can/〉〈khyan sti tri kalbe di ga rtse pha〉dharak+ṣa tra pā kyu dwa lharnatrekaḥ yings med bskal gsum bsags pa'i tsho gis gnyis 'bras/ /'og min zhing gtsor smin lasadu ma'i gar/ /(2na)e ka pa rlasko mā shuḥskṛ hā tsan+t+raXshu yo bā ra nirmā ma yo pad+ma ya: skyil krung gcig gis mya ngan med ljon la/ /rgyab brten mchog gi sprul pa'i sgyu ma mkhan/ /lha rnams bsngags pa'i me tog 'thor ba'i yul/ /(2ba tha skal bzang 'di la chad med stong phrag 'phreng / /rim byon bde gshegs bzhi pa don kun grub/ /rgyal gzhan las lhag snying stobs khyad zhugs dpa'/ /mtha' klas nyi ma gzi brjed las 'phags sku/ /mtshan dpe rab bkra mthong bas rnam grol ba/ /dran pas srid zhi'i gdung sel mdza' na mo/ /yid dbang bstan pa 'phrog pa kun+da'i dpyid/ /mkhyen pa'i gzhal byar bros pa'i lkog gyur chos/ /nam mkha'i pha mtha' btsal kyang ma rnyed par/ /slar yang thugs kyi man shel dri bral ngos/ /byed pos—1—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)pir gyis bris pa tshon ris bzhin/ /skyon gyi rnyog ma'i rdul cha phra mos kyang / /ma gos yon to dngas bsil lhung lhung sgra/ /rdzogs pa khyod nyid gcig pu'i ngang tshul tsam/ /ma yin bde bar gshegs kun spyi lugs srol/ /'gro khams sgrib gnyis nad kyis mnar de srid/ /'phrin las: sman ljon pa 'jug pa'i mtha'/ /zad min de phyir tshangs pa thal sbyar nas/ /chos 'khor bskor bar gsol la rtag tu 'brel/ /sku dang thugs yon 'phrin las ma la ya'i/ /bser bus 'gro kun nyes brgya tsha ba'i gdung / /bcil yang dpal gyi mgul nas tshangs pa'i gsung / /'di ko mdzad pa rnams kyi yang rtser son/ /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za grul bum sogs/ /mtha' klas yid can skad dang dbang po sa /gsung gcig gdangs las so so legasang ba/ /stong phrag rdzing bur shar ba'i zla gzugs bzhin/ /dbus 'gyur shar lho nub kyi ljongs wo por/ /dar ba'i gsung rab zad med bang mdzod las/ /lo paṇa brtson pa'i shing rtas bod yul 'dir/ /mkha' tshes glegs bam rin cen phung por drangs/ /rgyal bstan nyi ltar (3na skos la bzhed lhag bsam gyis/ /mchod gnas sdoganyis dbu yi thod khur nas/ /bshad sgrub srog gi zungs su sngon byung gi /rgyal blon rim par byon las su zhig gshung / /yid srubs phyogs kyi dmod pas lung rtogs zla/ /ma shas 'phel 'grib dngos po'i gshis yin kyang / /phyi dar bstan pa'i nyi dkyil rtag gang ba/ /'gro 'di'i bsod nams dpyid du rgyas pa bzhin/ /dge sdig srang la bteg pas las dkar gyi/ /phung po lcid du che 'dod blang dor la/ /lta ba'i mig yangs nang sodagos dgos kyis/ /brtson pas brgya phrag glegs bam deng 'dir bsgrubs/ /rgyu sbyor bris mkhan zhus chen las byed kun/'dir 'bad bsam sbyor dzasbu ljon pa'i 'bras/ /legs byas rgya mtshor lhung las srid dang zhi'i/ /gser gyi snye ma yongs su smin par shog /bde bar gshegs pas gang mkhyen chos rnams la/ /ma rga sum zhabrul med gzhal nus btso me kha pa'i/ /bstan pa'i ba dan phyogs ༄ ra rab tshugs shing / /de 'dzin skyes bu 'dus tshogs dar bar shog /thos bsam sgom pa 'brel ba'i gru bo ches/ /'gro mang nor bu'i gling du 'dren bzod pa/ /za hor rigs las 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes/ khrag gi 'tsho ba don —2

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mdang ldan gyur cig/gom pa'i ri mo rgyal phran bye ba'i mgor//'god pa'i blo dang bzang po'i las lo'i mthu//stobs ldan sa spyod tshe dang dbang thang gis//dus kyi byed po'i ngang tshul 'dzin par shog/srin po byin sha 'dar pa'i dpa' rtul gyis//dgra dpung srid sdo lkog mar snying 'bros mkhan//bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal pos gnam dang sa'i//dbang phyug dam pa'i ngang tshul 'dzin par shog/lha ldan gtsug lag bya 'dabs kyis bskyangs pa/ /sde3ba 'dir 'dzam gling yongs kyi bdog pa'i nga bya/ /kun tshang tshong 'dus dar ba rnam thos bu'i//gan mdzod mngon sum 'phos pa'i rjes 'gror shog/'byor pa nor bus 'grangs rgyas ltar gyur kyang //rgyags pa'i khengs bral khang khyim shag skor ldan//mgon med zasasbyin la 'bu'i mi brgyud dang / /mnga' thang bla nas blar yang 'phel bar shog /dkon cog thugs rje'i gzi byin nor bu'i sgron//ches cher 'jig rten yongs kyi phan dang bde'i//snang ba chad pa med sgyur 'dis mtshon pa'i//dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tsho gos mtha' dag bsngo/zhes 'grangs rgyas shag pa nang so dgos dgos kyi lhag bsam gyis yid drangs te rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog glegs bam du bzhengs pa'i tshe dkar chag smon lam dang bcas pa zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang pos bgyis pa dza / /sdos sbyor mnya pa'i brit+ta la tshe tonang tso/rā ga bi rgya lha bā lha kyi sha ཾ su khyarā swā da yag:prurba bud+dhir+sha lha//namabe+e shādzin rlo dza'i mya rting piñtsa spi ti pra ta pi tsa kya kaḥchags rdul srid la mi gnas ni bde'i ro//zhen med 'gro don lagazholas ngas rgyas spyi'i//lugs las khyad 'phags rgyal g.yin gyis dor ba'i//lnga bdo'i skye rgu'i 'dren pa shākya'i tog/'dzul zhal pad+ma'i 'dab rgya yongs grol las//legs gsung sbrang rtsi'i 4nakhub 'jog pa'i rgyun//rigs can gsum gyi bung ba sa byas deng //bar med las lhan mtha' dag gcig tu tshim/khyu des mtho ris dga' tshal lta zhog gi/thar pa'i yul sa kun kyang phan pa'i glu//dar dir sgrogs la brel bas gtams pa 'di//mgon khyod drin las gzhan du gang gis byas//log pa'i slob dpon gyis 'drid mu stegs byed//lha gcig phyogs las phyir gyur skal ngan can//byang bstan

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogephug par nyi 'od mi 'char ba'i//rang bzhin de la su yis bcos su yod/sgyu yang yid mi byed pa'i rnyog pa yis//thub bstan chu klung sbags pa ka ma las//drungs kyang phyag rgya'i khrus gang der smon pa//ljongs 'dir skye rgu'i las ga ldog pa dka'//'on te sdosnod gsum dang rgyud sdebazhi'i//rlabs 'phreng yol ba med pa'i rgya mtsho'i 'jing / /sa lam gdengs ka g.yo ba'i gtsug tor rtser/ /sku bzhi nor bu'i cod pan 'od 'bar spro//de tshul 'grub byed rgyu rkyen la rag pas//sgrib gnyis nad gso'i sman pa nyi ma'i gnyen//dpal gyi gur las gsungs pa dam pa'i chos//thos bsam sgom la mkhas rnams gcig tu gzhol//bod skyong rgyal po'i bkas bcad lnga phyir 'gyur//phyi dar 'jig rten mig gcig mtha' klas pa'i//gsar zhus sngar byung bcos sogs rgyal ba'i bka'//brgya phrag glegs bam bsod nams brgya mtsho'i zhing //'dri klog 'chad nyan sri zhur byed pa kun//sngon goms skye bo'i spyi gtsug sha rmen las//brdol ba'i 'khor 'das phun tshogasang la nu'i//dbang thang gser gyi 'khor lo mkha' la 'phags//'di dang gtan gyi mdun ma ma lus pa//'grub la gor ma chags pa blo gros kyi//mig gis ma rga sum mthong bzhin 4ba yal 'dor ba//de 'dra gzhan 'phrul bdag pos brlams par zad//skye rga na 'chi'i chu srin 'byung gnas las//sgrol nus dal 'byor gru bo che yi mthus//spangs rtogs rin cen 'dren 'dod dpyod ldan rnams//dge tshogs ded dpon ngang tshul la brten rigs//de yang dkar nag gi las kyi 'bras bu 'chol bar mi 'byung ba 'o skol gyi ston pas lan gcig ma yin par bka' stsal zhing de la yid brtan du byas pa mi bslu ba/lung phran tshegs las/zla ba skar ma'i tsho gis bcasas la lhung yang srid//sa 'di ri dang nags bcas mkha' la 'gro yang srid//rgya mtsho chen po'i chu ni bskams par 'gyur srid kyi//drang srong chen po rdzun gsung 'gyur ba srid pa min/zhes sangs rgyas kyis mi bden pa gsung ba ni nam yang med cing dge ba'i tshogs rnams kyi nang nas kyang dkon cog gsum dngos dang de'i rten la ri mor bya ba ni mchog tu bsngags pas/lung gzhi las//mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dad pas//sangs rgyas mchod /na la ni gom 'dor na//dzam+bha chu bo'i gser gyi srang

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mtshad ni/ /stong khrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min/ /zhes dang bdag sngon spos 'tsho nge gyur ba las/ /rnam par gzigs kyi gsung rab kyi/ /dge slong dge 'dun spyan drangs nas/ khyed cag ji snyed ba ched pa yi/ /bsnyun sman bdag gis dbul bgyis te/ 5/na pa rtsa ba 'bras bu'i sman/ /dge 'dun bdag gisatshim par gyis/ /dge 'dun dbyar gyi spyan drangs nas/ /bdag la dge slong gcig cig gis/ /a ru ra gcig ma gtogos bar/ /de na 'ga' yang slong ba med/ /bskal pa dgu cu rtsa gcig tu/ /bdag ni log par lhung ma gyur/ /sman sbyin pa yi rnam smin ni/ /mthu chen 'di (5na)ni blta bar gyis/ /dge ba chung ngu byas pas ni/ /bde ba mang po nyams su myong / /a ru ra ni gcig byin pas/ /yun ring mtho ris rnams su dga'/ /zhes sangs rgyas kyi mchod rten la gus par byas pa dang dge 'dun la bsod snyoms dang sman phul ba sogs kyis mtshon pa'i bsod nams kyi 'bras bu bla na med na'ang de'i nang nas kyang gsung rab nyid mchog tu gyur pas/ brgyad stong pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis glegs bam chen po la yi ge gsal zhid rab tu gsal ba legs par bris te me tog dang bdug pa dang dri dang 'phreng ba dang byug pa dang phye ma dang na bza' dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang dril bu dang ba dan dang kho ra khor yug tu mar me'i 'phreng ba dang mchod pa rnam pa mang pos bkur stir bya bla mar bya/ rjed par bya mchod par bya ri mor bya bsnyen bkur bya ste kun dga' bo 'di ni nga'i rjes su bstan pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shesayongs su rdzogs par gyur ro/ /zhes khrung ba sher phyogs su ma zad thub pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag la phyogs mtshungs shing / /rgyud rnams ni phan yon lhag par che bas/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ bzlas pa'i gsang ba nges sbas pa/ /gsang ba 'di ni rnam pa drug /rig 'dzin rnams kyi snying po dang / /rnal 'byor rgyud ni bsdus pa dang / don yod shin tu rmad thong ba/ /gsang ba las kyang mchog gsang bshad/ /bzlas brjod tsam gyi sbyor ba yis/ /lta ba'i ri bo 'joms par 'gyur/ /zhes bzlas brjod tsam gyi 3 yon 'di ltar gsungs shing / spyi rgyud du/ /dkyil 'khor (5ba 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag thad par 'gyur yin —3—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)na/ /zhes dkyil 'khor mthong ba tsam gyis kyang sdig pa'i tshogs rnams byang bar gsungs pa'i shugs bstan la/ rgyud sde bzhi'i glegs bam 'dri zhing klog pa dang ri mor byed pa sogs phan yon mtha' klas pas 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus lo paṇa rnams kyis mdo 'dul sher phyogs mang du bsgyur cing / rigs kyi dbon gsang ba'i bdag po mnga' bdag khri ral pa can gyis skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la 'bebs su bcug /gsang sngags rnying ma'i rgyud rnams ni bka' shin tu gnyan pas gsang chos lta bur sbas pa'i tshul du gyur nas bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal ba dus kyi 'phel 'grib sna tshogs byung na'ang dpal mar me mdzad dang bsod snyoms pa chen po shākya shrī sogs lo paṇa mkhas grub mang pos bstan pa'i me ro ches cher bsos shing khyad par bka' 'gyur ro cog la dbus pa blo gsal dang bcom ldan ral gri/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che/ tshal pa si tu dge ba'i blo gros rnams kyis dkar chag bsgrigs shing dag ther mdzad nas 'phel rgyas su gyur cing khyad par bstan pa'i rgyun la dgongs nas bshes gnyen gro lung pa chen po dang / chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches mdo mangs kyi lung rgyun 'bad pa chen pos btsal ba ni/brgyad stong pa las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mnyan par bya gzung bar bya bcang bar bya bklag par bya kun chub par bya/ rab tu gdon par bya/ bstan par bya nye bar bstan par bya lung dbog par bya kha tan bya bri bar bya/ zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs pa bla na ma mchis pa (6na tshe yin cing / bar skabs su rim gyis cha phra bar gyur pa bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' rnam rgyal dpal bzang pos shing rta'i srol slar yang btod cing deng sang gi dus chos par rlom pa phal cher khyim gyi bdag po'i bsam sbyor lhur blangs te gal chung chos la byed pa'i dus ngan 'dir/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag gnas gsar pa mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bstan pa rin po che'i srog 'thud pa'i rnam par thar pa la gzur gnas skye rgu rnams lag pa'i sor mo snying gar zum pa'i gnas su snang zhing slar yang thub ba'i bstan pa la bya ba yang dag par —6

sku gsung thugasarten gsar bzhengasadang rin po che'i mchod rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar chag (memadzad pa ngesapa don gyi bstan 'dzin mang zhing 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi mthus rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i bar du 'byon par sems so/ /skabs don pa ri dha ra zhes pa yongs 'dzin du 'bod pa chu pho byi ba'i lo sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis khur bzhes nas do dam nyug pa don grub rdo rje dang 'bri lung dbang rgyal gnyis kyis byasadapon yig pa o chos lung dkar mo nas mkhas bsdus kyis hor rgyal po'i dus bod khri skor bcu gsum du phye ba'i ya gyal lho khri skor gyi rdzong gi lte ba shal dkar du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog rgyal rtse them spangs ma sor bzhag la rnying ma rgyud 'bum gtso bsdusagasum bsnan te bzhengs pa yin no/ /rgya hor bod yul tshangasapa'i lte ba mā /zhwa ser bstan srid gser sgong yongs spungasapa/ /bsod namasabyasapa'i drod kyis cher smin 'bras/ /thub pa'i bstan la nam yang 'dzad med shog /'di'i ched byed por gtogasapa'i mchog dman 'gros/ /nyer mtshon rgyud lnga'i skye rgu ma (6ba)lus pa/ /gnas skabs sum rtsen dpal la spyod bzhin du/ /ring min byang chub mchog de rnyed par shob/ shaṃs brjod me tog dkar mdzes mchod pa'i sprin/ /rgyal gsung sri zhur dbul ba'i 'chi med rnams/ /lha lam ngos su dga' ba'i gar sgyur cing / /rab rnyan glu dbyangs rtag tu len gyur cig /ces bka' 'gyur gsar bzhengs kyi dkar chag smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni za hor gyi ban+de sdom brtson sde snod gsum pas sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang pos bgyis pa shrī yasamabar+shatanan+dabahalhasanodayalhawan+tu/chu byi pho brang chen po po ta la'i mchod khang dmar po'i li ma lha khang du bzhugasapa'i brisathang sna tshogasasnod sgam chosabacasadebather du stsokhopa'i 'gobarjodango ma'i sgyu lasagar mal/ rnam 'dren srasadang slob ma'i snang brtan gyi/ /sprul bsgyur chu zla ji bzhin gdul bya'i ngor/ /shar ba'i pha mtha' mes pos ma rnyed nas/ /zag bcas gnyid la bskal pa'i bar du g.yur/ /'on te tshur mthong 'gro blor nyer 'tsham pa'i/ /sna tshogasabakod pa kā shi gtsang ma'i ngos/ /gtsug lag gnyisapa shesapa'i sor mo'i gar/ /legs bsgyur sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul —7—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)gzigs mor mtshar//grangs snyed rtogs par sla ba'i ngos 'dzin gyi//dkar chag a 'dus ka 'phreng yi ge'i gzugs//deb ther 'khrul pa med pa'i ā dar+shar//gsal 'dis mi bskyud mthong bas don kun grub//ces shis par brjod nas//chu byi sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis ra sa 'phrul snang gi maṇ+ḍal ra ba'i lcags khra gsar brjes kyi nub phyogs su ra ma lug gi gas gos rgyas par spel༅ la yig mar sprin yod med sul phe phyag rgya/dzasbu'i ljon pas mtshan 7na ) pa'i gling gi rgyan//lha bcas skye rgu'i bsod nams rgya mtsho'i yul//mthong thos dran pa'i nges legs sar sbyor ba/'i kya'i tog gyur rnam 'dren nyi ma'i gnyen//mgon de'i brten pa zhing khams zhing gi gtso/slong btsan ye shes sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar//lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po//sa la gnas pa'i 'og min sdug po bkod//rgya gar rgya nag hor dang bal yul li//ya tshe bod kyi che rgyas thog drangs pa'i//mchog dman bar pa'i 'gro bas yongs spel ba//mchod sprin 'dzad pa med pa nam mkha' mdzod//gang der mi bsrun chom pos ma byin len//srung byed lcags kyi dra ba'i 'khor yug gi/nub ngos dngul tshags ru bzhi ra ma lug/med byung bkod pas ri mor tshar dngar ba//sa skyong blo bzang mas stobasakyis spel ba'i//do dam bar ta cho ge mdzad a tar sogs//tshags pa rin cen gyis gtsos bzo bo'i rigs//dgos byed sprod mkhan byang gling rgyal pos bgyis//dge tshogs ma dros las 'ongs gaṅgā'i klung //byang chub mchog gi rgya mtshor rtag babs nas//'bras bu rgyud lnga'i yid can ma lus pa//'dren pa'i ded dpon r+ṣa por 'gyur bar shog/sems ldan tso gyi snying las cog gi/ma smad sa sa rje zhugs pa'i gzi byin 'od//'bar ba'i ba po shis snang ba'i dga' ston gyis//yangs pa'i nor 'dzin ma lus gsal bar shog/chos nyid zad sar 'byol ba'i rags pa'i lus//'ja' tshon 'od skur grol mthus 'khor 'das la/dbang sgyur brtul zhugs mthar phyin rig sngags 'chang //pad+ma thod 'phreng 'gro kun rjes su bzung //thabs shes mkha' 7ba tha mkha' sbyor zung 'jug pas//bhu tir rlung sems bcings las 'khor lo'i mdud/ /rnam grol bde stong byingaX zhugs pad+ma las/ /legs par 'byung ba'i gnas

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag tre'igacig khyod kho na//phyag dar khrod pa'i bur smig gos 'chang zhing //yon tan kun rdzogos pad+ma sam bha wa//lnga rig mkhyen yangs spyan gyis ma gzhal ba'i//ji lta ji snyed gnas tshul da ga re//gcig tu gsal ba'i blo gros nyi 'od kyis//rmongs chen smag sum pha mthar byas pa'i bzhul/shes bya'i gzugs kun mthong ba'i skal pa dang //ldan khyod mchog gi nye lam la sred btson//skye med pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur skye ba'i tshul//chags med rgyal sras rgyud lngar chags pa yis//zhen med khams gsum sdud por zhen pa can//nges med 'gro kun mnga' 'bangs ris ltar skyong //brgya phrag nyi ma'i dpal la 'gran pa'i 'od//thugs rje'i zer 'phreng spro ba med po che//gdul byar snang ba brtse ba'i mchog sbyin mkhan//rnal 'byor spyod pas sa lam rtogs pa rdzogs//dkar min rang sems 'khrul ba'i sgyu ma'i grong //yid srubs ba glang spyon pa'i srog pa rtser/shwakya'i mtshan dpe seng ge'i mche ba yis//nyer gcod thub chen g.yin na dmigs su med//lta ngan mu stegs sde bcas ri dgas tshogos//lkog mar don snying 'thon pa'i sngon 'gro'i sgor//rna bar 'jigs pa med pa seng ge'i sgra//sgrogs pa'i rdo rje'i khro bo gar gyis rol//'chol pa'i khro bo gtum chen stang stabs kyis//phur pa'i dbyug rtser dgra bgegs phyer btags pas//sde brgyad kun gyi lag cha stabs gcig tu//'tshor byed rdo rje srin po gro bo lod//mgon khyod mdzad 8na ) pas mkha' khyab de snyed tshad//rnam mkhyen las gzhan gzhal nus srid min kyang //'dzam bu'i gling na mtsho skyes rnam rol gar//che long zhing bkod ngo mtshar stims su klas/dge tshogs ṛ ti'i 'od kyis gang khyab chu//srid zhi'i zug rngu'i dug bral phan dang bde'i//yan lag brgyad du bsgyur ba skye rgya'i bdag/mtho ris sman pa chen po deng 'grub shog/ces pa 'di yang sne'u sdong rtse'i bdag mo bsod nams dbang 'dus rgyal mos dpal oṃ ḍi rdza na'i slob dpon chen po mtshan brgyad gra tshar si rgyu rgya mtsho'i zhing bkod dang bcas bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun /gas dbang po'o//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)rab byung bcu gcig pa'i chu glang lor mdzad pa'i lha sa smon lam chen mo'i tshogs khro gsar blug gi kha byang dang / rin chen rgyan cha'i deb ther gyi 'go brjod sogs/chu glang sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis khur bzhes nas blug pa'i lha sa smon lam chen mo'i tshogs khro 'dzam gling 'dod la tso kha byang ho med mu smigs ra pa'i waṃ shing / rgya hor mdo stod mdo smad bal bod sogs/ /'dzam gling skye rgyas legs byas spel ba'i ched/ /ljon pa'i phur ma bcud du 'khyil ba'i ja/ /ro brgya'i dpal ldan tsha ba'i za ma tog /'di nang srid zhi'i longs spyod ma lus pa/ /dbyar mtsho lta bur gyen nas gyen phyur ba'i/ khro 'di shong ba'i snod du tshangs pa yis/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin dpal mo'i mngal chen bskrun/ /bsod nams zad med shes pa'i mu tig char/ /rgyun du 'bab pa 'khri shing gzhen nu ma'i/ /ngang tshul ji bzhin rtag tu sangs rgyas sras/ /mchod la rab dga'i bag chags sad gyur pa'i/ /'dir 'bad skye rgu'i mtshon pa'i mkha' mnyam gyi/ /ma rgan 'gro ba'i rgyud kyi sgrib gnyis nad/ /sel ba'i sman pa sangs rgyas zhes bya'i (sha bsgo tshan/ /grags pa'i go 'phang myur du 'thob par shog /grangs med brtsegs mar bsgos pa sdig pa'i 'bras/ /yongs smin sdug bsngal dri ma kun bkru ba/ /mi byed 'dus pa'i thugs rje mtho ris chab/ /rab sgrengs phan bde'i zhabs su bsil bar 3|ga /khro khar rgya'i khal phyed bzhi brgya/ khams bsha' khal bdun cu don lnga/ stod bsha' khal bco lnga/ zhal 'debs su dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis gser zho phyed gsum phul ba'i lha sa smon lam chen mo'i tshogs khro 'dzam gling 'dod 'jo 'di ni sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis khur bzhes mdzad/ do dam 'bog gong mkhar ltag pa phun tshogs grags pas chu shur zha gab pa tshe dbang / lo ro ba dbu mdzad sangs rgyas don grub/ dga' ba rdo rje can mi grangs bcu gnyis kyis chu glang hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bcu la blugs pa maṅga le/—/snyo

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mchu glang sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis khur bzhes nas blugs pa'i lha sa smon lam ོ mo tshogs khro 'dod 'tsho re skong gi kha byang zas sbyin gnyis pa'i rjes 'gro dbugs skung snyan pa'i lha bu ra/phyogs bcu'i rgyal bas ches cher bsngags pa'i yul//snying stobs mchog gis dpa' ba don kun grub/shwakya seng go stone pa drug sde'i tshogs//mtho risathar pa'i lam du nyer drangs pa//mkha yod mar pa'i dus kyi dga' ston la//phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun 'dus pa'i srid zhu'i snod//ma smad phun tsho gos 'dod pa'i re stong khro//yid can bsod nams rgya tsho'i zhing gi phul//mtha' bzhi'i mkho dgu longs spyod ma lus pa//gangs can lto bar byed pos drangasapa bzhi//lar med zong rnams das cog mar pa'i rdzas//rab song rgyu sbyor byas pa don 9na skon shog/'di sgrub kun dang bgrang yas sems can rgyud//bde bar gshegs pa brgyad kyi thugs rje'i mthu//nyer zhugs mngon mtho'i them skas la brten nas//byang chub mchoge gi khang par 'jug par shog/yang srid kun tu sangs rgyas thos la//rtag tu brnyes bkur rlabs wo tsho gos sgrub par//mgon med zas sbyin rnam thar bzhi spyod pa'i//dge tsho gis 'gro kun byang chub 'thob byed bsngo/khro khar rgya'i khal phyed bzhi brgya/khams bsha' khal bdun cu don lnga/stod bsha' khal bco lnga/zhal 'debs su dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to gyis gser zho phyed gsum phul ba'i lha sa smon lam wo mo'i tshogs khro 'dod 'jo'i re skong 'di ni sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis khur bzhes mdzad do dam 'bog gong mkhar ltag pa phun tshogs grags pa/chu shur zha gab pa tshe dbang /lo ro ba dbu mdzad sangs rgyas don grub/dga' ba rdo rje can mi grangs bcu gnyis kyis chu glang hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bcu la blugs pa ma sgo lo/sman rgyas gsung rab dpal ldan rgyud bzhi yi//ma lag bco brgyad sgo nas gsal byed pa//rje btsun g.yu thog legs bshad yongs 'du'i ljon//ris med kun dga'i 'dod pa cig tu 'jo//dar mo sman rams blo bzang chos grags kyis//snga phyir par du brko bar nyer bskul zhing //deng sang drang srong rgan po'i glegs bam mdzod//gangs can lha rje rnams kyi spyi yi nor//nad du gyur ro cog kun drung 'byin pa//sman pa che mchog shākya seng ge yi//rnam thar las 'dir 'bad pa byed kun gyis//zin pa'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (sheskal ba bzang por myur spyod shog/ces pa'ang za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lkog pa phun tshogs 9ba ji bang po'o//kun dga' zhes pa shing stag lo'i dkar nag rtsis kyi lo tho 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tsho gis dbang pos bzos pa'i 'go brjod blang dor tshigs sa gsal phe wo byed/bhā wakā khyaka we di gargyo dam gre rba5྅sa dharma shu ka lhag ma//gre ya bha driḥpha lā/ras swā thu dwa niḥg rā āt+nadzā yas gas dan//grangs med bskal par goms pa'i tsho gos gnyis kyi//sabon dar drag chos gzugs yongs 'du'i ljon//dge legs sa bzang ro bda' 'gro kun la//sbyin mdzad zas gtsang sras po rgyal gyur cig/stong nyid rdo rje bas mo'i e gsang du//waṃ yig bde wo zung 'jug me long ngos//mtshan dpe'i gar mkhan kā la tsakrazhes//dpal ldan sgyu skar dkyil 'khor gtso de bsngags/khams gsum brtan pa kun 'phrog rig byed ma//'chi med tshe ster rje btsun 'phagasama'i zhabs//mi mdzad 10na thib gi mchod sbyin mtsho byung lha//snying dbus pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur rtag tu bzhugs//lo brgyar gsang chen nā tha'i dbyangs snyan po//sgrogs pa'i snang ba rdo rje'i ljags brkyangasanas//cha bsags 'gro kun dang po'i sangs rgyas sar//'khrid mdzad chos rgyal rigs ldan tshogasal bdud//'phags bod bka' drin zla bral lo paṇa tshogs//gsung rab rgya mtsho'i mthar son bu ston rje//sangs rgyas kun gyi yab gcig btsong kha pa//gzur gnas yongs kyi lag pad zum bya'i yul//nges par thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi grags//gnas lnga rig pa'i lo chen stag tshang pa//gangs khrod dus 'khor zhabs pa nor bu bzang //rnam gsum lam 'dir zhakhrul med bstan pa'i srog mang rta ོ po lhun grub rgya mtsho'i gter//rnam dpyod zla bral dpal mgon 'phrin las rje//gsang rnying phug pa'i man ngag lugs 'dzin pa'i//mkhas mang rin cen 'phreng ba phyag gi gnas/khyad par bdag blo rtsisakyi snang ba la//gcig tu dkar par mdzad pa'i 'jig rten mig/'dar lo ngag dbang phun tsho gos lhun grub kyi//bka' drin dran tshe snying nas gus pas 'dud//sna bo'i lag len log pa'i chu skyar gyis//'gro mang nya srog phral dang mtshudas min pa'i//'khrul med phug pa'i man ngag lugs ba ched srol//le'u tho

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag 9'iyid bzhin dbang rgyal deng 'dir spel/ /lha rnams snyan pa'i glu las sngags brjod yul/ /bskal bzang 'di la rnam 'dren stong 'byon pa'i/ /dbus na snying stobs mchogo gis cher dpa' ba/ /don kun lhun gyis grub pa'i zas gtsang sras/ /drag po lcags sprel sa ga'i tshes bdun la/ /bltams nas rig byed yon tan mtshams (10ba)mig 'das/ /rgyal ba zhes pa nam mthongs zla ba'i tshes/ /bdud rtsi brnyesanas mkha' stong dus mig grangs/ thu kya seng shes 'bras spungs mchod rten cher/ /zla bzang sogs la dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud/ /lcags 'brug nag nyar gsungs nas chu gter mda'/ /dbang po mtshe ma sngon du byung pa'i lo/ /phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba srong btsan rjes/ /lha ldan gtsug lag bskrun nas rtse lag phyogs/ /gangs can rje 'bangs 'dren par thod 'phreng rtsal/ khri srong mthus drangs zla lag klu 'das tshe/ /stod 'grel ā nan+da ra 'bod kun dga'i lo/ /mang bkur rgyal po'i khab tu dar ljang gos/ /phang phung mdzes par klubs pa shing pho stag /'byung ba sum ldan kha yan span pa'i klung / /pho brang gling dbus bdud kyi me long 'char/ /zhakhrul med grub pa'i mtha' la lo yi bdag /bdud rtsi'i 'od can dkyil 'khor nya gang rgyas/ /stong dang drug brgya nyi shu'i yul gru na/ khyu skar mdzes ma mdza' bo'i lha mos dbang / /byed pa'i lo bdag drang srong snyan ngag mkhan/ /sa bdag dkar po 'phrul blon ri bong 'dzin/ /de rnams shar ba dwangs ma'i mtsho nang du/ /dge dang me dge'i rol rtsed 'dus pa'i gar/ /bsgyur ba phyi nang rgyud dang khungs ldan gyi/ /dus rtag bstan bcos las byung 'di na gsal/ /bar 'dir mdo sde gsang ba sogs las byung ba'i lo bshad tshigs bcad lhug gang yod chu babs su bkod/mdzes mdzes snyan po'i ta'i ra bsgyur nas/ /dgyes dgyes thos 'dzin bu ram dngar byas kyang / /zom zom phub ma g.yogs pa'i chu dong bzhin/ /gsal gsal rdzun gyi phug de rdib kyi dogs/ /ngan ngan dkar min las kyi gos mang yang / /bsags bsags legs byas phung po cher spungs na/ /skyid skyid phun tshogs(11na kho la 'jig rten kun/ /lhod lhod yongs su spyod las gzhan du min/ /de phyir tshad ldan sgrub mchod sreg zor mdos/ /bde gshegs bdun mdo 'gyur ro cog gi bka'/ /rten dang dge —13—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (she'adun bkur sti sbyin gtong sogs//mchog dman mtha' dag tsho gis gsog mdzad par rigs//dge legs ti se'i gtsug tor las babs chu//spyi dang khyad par gang can nyes brgya'i dri//rab bkrus phan bde'i rgya mtshor nges legs rgyun//lhung lhung dal gyis babs te ro gcig shog/rnam kun mchog ldan stong gzugs phyag rgya che//lo dang phyogs gsum dag la mngon byas nas//'og min gzhan du mi 'tshol dus 'khor lo'i//rgyud 'grel skye bar thos bsam sgom byed shog/legs ldan gtsug na zla ba'i dbyangs 'char la//rab sbyangs phas rgol dgra sde nyer bcom zhing //rang srid rnam par rgyal ba'i rnga bo che//brdungs pas skad gsang 'dzam gling kun khyab shog/dga' ba'i dpal ldan pho brang sdebazhi'i mdzod//lugs gnyis khrims shing 'gro ba'i gnyar bkal te//dus kyi bdag po'i che ba mi 'gog pa'i/mas pa'i mas ma bzang pos dpal 'bar shog/rig ldan blon po yang ba'i sa dpyad ri//phying bar stag rtse'i khab kyi bya 'dabs nas//gtsug lag 'di la yangs pa'i blo mig can//lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po zhes byas bkod//ring sbyangs rgan po'i yus dang rnam dpyod rtsal//che phra bdag 'dras 'khrul med rtogs dka' yang //mkhas mang rim par brgyud pa'i slob dpon gyi//phyag bzhesaji ltar bris pas nongs med snyam//de phyir skar nag dgongs pa gcig bsdebs nas//blang dor tshul 11ba ) ba'i na bstan tshe dge ba'i 'bras//nam yang bslu med 'byung bas le'u tho 'di//nor bu dbang gi rgyal por da gdod nges//'chi med tshogs rnams rgyud mangs las drangs pa'i//rab snyan bden pa brjod tshig glur len cing //lhan gcig man+da ra yi char babs te//'jig rten kun tu khyab pa'i bkra shis shog/sngon byon sa rnams bsgol la ba lko srol mang //deng rtsis phal〉 'ol rdzo mu sto smra//mchu zla nyis brtsegs phug pa phag lugs//dbo zla bskol ba rnam dpyod rtsal gyis thon//sho lo kodang po sdos sbyor rma ga pha pa sbul gyi ming wo/ pra dza a la la na shom su bos de2gro po dol ka su sti bī ṇaḥg ṣi sdod ā pā lha zhung zhi ṣi shi ti/ /bigatata ra ma snyika pu rtsug thi tā binā yas ha graha su ka we btaḥsu dra yoḥrat+na brje tsā be sha yoḥ//lha rnams mgrin btegs su sti'i /da mangs glur blangs bsngags brjod me tog tshig

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ho shākamada'i lam kun dog por bkang ste 'bebs pa'i yul//grags r+ṣa don ldan bskal bzang 'di la skye rgu'i bsod nams srad bur brgyus nas rim byon rnam 'dren stong gi rin cen phreng //2na dzi ta mu kuṭa nā tha te pā laḥ.ā snyib byi n+ta yaḥrat+na pā rgyas ne badz+ra rat+na ka nirmāṇa kā ye ma hā thubar dza na tamog mā no ba lo yas te gas ṅge i ༅ lha re ban+ta te kā ta zhi rbata zhwa/de dag rnams las snying stobs 'a pos khyad par yongs gyur dam pa tog dkar dbus tsā ra 44 'dir mchog gi sprul pa'i skur//'tshang rgya'i sngon 'gro rin cen cod pan gang gi thod du bcings te dbang bskur rgyal sgo mi pham mgon des 'gro 'di skyongs//blo kaganyis pa sdeb sbyor ra babs gsum pa rgya mtsho/ 2ba ) pa ri ta tang2te kā sha dwam:lku sgyu tabastur dwaḥk+ṣan+ti shi la dra shaḥṅgā na tsa pradzha bīḥs ka'atshal bha tamaṇ+ḍaḍa so khyu pa8pā ra2sna daswā kri snro gro tsā zhwa tsa ā roḥsu wak+ṣi zhi kho/bgrang ring brgyud mar sbyin tshul bzod brtson bsam gto shes rab pha rol phyin la lan gcig min par goms byas kyang //tso mthong byis pa'i blo mig wo ngur lo drug dka' spyad ngal spangs mtha' snyed ku sha'i tso chas bto ba'i steng //3na a na shi tsal badz+re ka pa rlabasku tā tsagaṅgār dza:khya wastu lu mā me ni ka dwa lu gi di shidza ya dunābhi kaṇi nu su nut+ta ro ma bu sna༄tha' mi dzi du kho tha0//mi gzhig rdo rje'i skyil krung gcig bcas g.yo ba med dang gaṅgā'i klung rdul grangs mnyam bdud sde dus gcig tu//bcom pa'i rgyal rnga phyogs bral rnam 'god skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo legs bsgyur byams mgon khyod kyis bdag rjes zungs//3ba spro slo0nyis pa go sbyor rang bshasha spyi sgo rgya mtsho/ga a nas ma a nu rā ge ṇa so tso dan bru hākho bṛn+tagiṅka tsā stu ya daṇ+ḍaḥpa ṇi dhi a btar tsit+ta pā dor then na5so ma na sba t+ma〉lhas mādzāk+ṣa kwa sha/tshangs pa rgan pos mkha' mtha'i zhags pa brkyang yang ma rnyed 'gro la mnyam par rjes chags kyis//legs bskul smon 'jug sems bskyed shing rtas drangs pa'i tshogs gnyis 'dzad med yid bawo nor bu'i dpya//4na dza ta hi ta su khan tha pañtsa ti bi sba uṅgā ṭa na swā ra ākā sha ko lha ma so skya/ /blam ma ma na rat+napra

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shetidzñā:ṇa ta shu ta sma du hārī ka dwa na ka〉la /chos gzugs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo phye ma 'dris kun la phan bde'i mchod sbyin stsol mdzad pa/ /mi pham mgon pos nye bar dam bcas gzungs kyi phan yon thos pa'i mod la bdag yid phrogs/ /ring por mi thogs dzasbu'i ljon pas yongs su mtshan pa'i gling mchog 'dir/ /mgon khyod mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan 'bar ba nyi ma'i dngos po brgya yi lus/ /rnam par grol lam snang ba'i dga' ston longs su spyod par nyer spro phyir/ /ma smad dge tshogs sa bon 'debs la brtson pa'i spobs pa gzengs su mtho/ /cher snyigs 'gro ba 'dren la rgyal ba rnams/ /mi lusazol 'dzin bshes gnyen 'ga' zhig dang / /srid lam dub pa'i gdung skyob sman gyi bla/ /mched kun mgron thabs bkod legs tshar du dngar/ /sangs rgyas sems dpa' sems ma khro bo rnams/ /gcig 'dus lha (14ba tha zhi bka' gdams ba ched pa'i srol/ khregs pa'i sde dpon rdo rje grags ldan mir/ /rab brlams log 'dren gshed du mngon sum bzhin/ /thar pa'i grong khyer sa thag mi ring rgyu/ /rgya hor bzang gos dbang gzhu'i tshon ris can/ /brgya phrag du mar spel legs gzigs mo sa /tshar dngar ye shes sems dpa' gcig tu 'khyil/ /'bad pa 'di snang phyi ma'i srid bde tsam/ /gnyer dang g.yin 'dring snyan grags lhur blangs te/ /'khor ba'i 'khor lo bskor la chung ngu'i blo/ /ma song gzhan phan lhag bsam gyis drangs bzhengs/ /snang mun bskal pa'i khyad par de bzhin gshegs/ /'jig rten khamasasu byon la bltos pa'i phyir/ /ma rgan yin no cog gi bde ba'i gzhi/ /thub pa rnams kyi ring lugs kho nar rag /bsod nams byas pa'i sa bon yongs 'phel rtsa/ /rgya cher bskyed bsrings sdong po dar drag pa/ 'i kya'i lung rtogs yongs 'du sa brtol dbang / /bskal brgyar phan bde'i 'bras dud kun tshim shog /thub bstan 'dab rgyas ba tu bsil pa'i 'og /'jig rten gsum gyi skye rgu ma lus pa/ /sim pa'i tshor ba chad med ngal stegs la/ /'tsho ba'i re ba don dang ldan par shog /rgyal kun mkhyen rab phung po'i za ma tog /'jam mgon blo bzang grags pa'i ring lugs mchog /bla nas blar 'degs chos srid nyi zla'i 'od/ /'jig rten gsum po rtag tu gsal byed shog /dga' ba brgya pa'i gnam gyi she mong lung / / 16

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag 6)btsan po'i khrims kyis rdzogs ldan dga' ston la/ /legs spyod pho brang chen po'i bka' 'og tu/ /bod dang bod chen ma lus 'du bar shog /'di'i ched chu thigs tsam sa mtha' (15na)brten nas/ /phan pa bsgrubs so cog gi yid can rnams/ /byams mgon bstan pa 'dzam bu'i gling shar tshe/ /'dus pa dang po'i 'khor du skye bar shog /srid bder sbyar ba'i dge ba nyi tshebs/ /gos bu 'dzad mi shes pa gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /'gro kun rgyud la byang chen chu bo'i gter/ /tshes cher yongs 'phel ro gcig rgyu ru bsngo/ /ma byon sangs rgyas lnga pa rgyal tshab mi pham mgon po ma ga dha rdo rje'i spo la mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i rol gar bstan pa'i tshe gang gi rjes su 'dzin pa dang dam bcas pa'i gzungs kyi phan yon mthong bas yid phrogs te mgon po 'di nyid kyi snang brnyan mgron thabs kyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa rgya hor bzang gosasna tshogs kyi rgyu las bskrun pa swā la'i ljongs 'dir che tshad du gtogs pa zhig bzheng ba'i 'dun pa lhag bsam gyis drangs pa bzhin 'phags pa'i yul du pra ma ti zhes pa phyogs 'dir bag yod du 'bod cing 'jam dbyangs rgyal po'i khab tu gu'i tshe'u zhes chu mo glang gi lo rgyal ba shākya seng shes dpal ldan gos spungs kyi mchod rten chen po dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi rtsa rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyis pa bka' stsal ba'i zla ba'i yar tshes bcu gsum pa pa sangs dbo'i 'phrod dge bar dbu btsugs pa'i phyag mdzod mi rje blo bzang mthu stobs kyis khur blangs do dam tre bo dar khan dka' bcu/ lha khang pa rdo rje nor bu/ bkras rab pa dkon cog /ri mo'i dbu mdzad do dam tshe dbang rig 'dzin/ dbu chung ragasakha 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ dbu 'og rong tshangs pa/ lha sab legs pa rgyal mtshan/ dkon cog /mkhar rtse dge bsnyen/ gos bzo ba dbu mdzad rgyal rtse ri nang phun tshogs/ lha sar rtse shag pa skyon/ pa rnam brtan pa/ nor khyung tshe (15ba tha rtan/ 'phrang 'go tshangs ldan/ dbu chung gong dkar phun tshogs/rgyal rtse pad+ma tshe ring / gzhis rtse dar rgyas bkra shis/ dbu 'og rgyal rtse bstan 'dzin rdo rje/ chos dbang /dpal ldan/ dpal 'byor/ ngag dbang dpal ldan/ gra phyi nor skyong / gong dkar lnga yags/ pa rnam sum legs/ tshe dbang dgos slebs/ 'grangs skyes/ nor bu/ dkyus ma byams gling mkhas mchog /—17

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (ge'agro 'dren dam bcas thugs bskyed sa bon tshogs gnyis drod gsher kyis smin pas/ /chos sku'i rtsa ba ches cher rab brtan nges pa lnga ldan sdong po can/ /sna tshogs sprul pa'i yal 'dab nyer rgyas sku bzhi'i 'bras bus yongs dud pa/ /rgyal ba'i tog (16ba〉spyar dpag bsam ljon pa shākya seng ges dge legs stsol/ /thub pa'i rnam sprul gaṅgā'i klung rdul snyed/ /mkhyen pa'i phung po dngos gang 'jam pa'i dbyangs/yid can srid lam dub pa'i gdung skyob tu/ /mi lus zol brten blo bzang grags pas stongs/ /dzasbu'i gser zhun 'khyil ba'i 'od 'bar ba/ /zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs che/ /rab 'dzin dge 'dun dkon cog yin no cog /byang chub bar du rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs/ /rnam bkra ri mo g.yas 'khyil dpal gyi mgur/ /mthor bteg yan lag drug cu tshangs pa'i skur/ /chos phung rgya mtsho'i tshig don nyer blangs pa/ /skye rgu'i legs byas mngon sum snang ba bzhin/ /drang nges gsung rab lha yi chu bo'i rgyun/ /cig car 'thung ba'i mi brjed gzungs thob can/ /bka' rnams sdud pa'i drang srong zhal sgo las/ /thub bstan lam gsum srog tu chad med 'bab/ zhang rta che so gos 'phags yul paṇa grub kyis/ /lan brgyar dpyad brdar bsregs pa'i dam chos gser/ /rnam bshad phra tshom bkod pa'i gdub skor gyis/ /dpyod ldan g.yon mig ma yi rgyan du mdzes/ /mdo 'dul sher phyogs nges gsang theg pa'i rgyud/ /rim 'gyur chos rgyal mes dbon lo pan gyi/ /zla med bka' drin gangs can skye rgu yis/ /bskal par gzhal kyang 'khor bar nus pa phra/ /'chad nyan bsam dang sgom pas thub pa'i gsung / /dar ba sngon byung lo rgyus gzhan 'dring tsam/ /ma yin dam pa du ma'i rnam par thar/ /'khrul med mthong la blo ldan su zhig bston/ /bsod nams bsod namasamin pa phyogs bzung gis/ /rgyal bstan zla ba 'phel 'grib mi sems bzhin/ /bde skyid kun+da ra yid gtod gnyis skyes la/ zhes(17na skon khrel ba'i 'dab ma dgod cing 'dar/ /bka' gdams bshes gnyen blo gros 'byung gnas dang / khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i zhabs/ /du mas lung khungs 'tshol dang dkar chag gi /dpyad pa gsum gyis gtan la legs par phab/ /tshal pa si tu dge ba'i blo gros dang / /nges par thams cad mkhyen pa bu —/(3

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheston sogs/ /mkhas mang mdzad pa drang srong chu lha'i bus/ /ma dag dug dbyung nad sel chu bor bsgyur/ /kṛ kri'i rmi ltas ji bzhin mdo rgyud bka'i/ /rgyun bzang pad dkar srad bu'i srog gi zungs/ /thos bsam rdo rje'i lug rgyud kyis gdams pa'i/ /sngon med sman pa kun dga' rnam par rgyal/ /phal chen srid pa'i mal du bag yangs gnyid/ /stug po las slong lhag bsam skya rengs kyis/ /'chad nyan nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dren mdzad pa/ kho bo'i yongs 'dzin rdze btsun bka' 'gyur ba/ /de tsam dam pa'i spyod tshul char sprin la/ /gcig tu spro bas yar blta'i mig gtod cing / /gzur gnas spu sdug bkra ba'i rma bya'i gar/ /blo gros 'dab shog zlum por byas te bsgyur/ /tshul de klog dang bsam gtan mkhan kun gyis/ /gzhol bar bya las khyim gyi bdag po rnams/ /yi ger 'dri dang srid zhun byas pa'i 'bras/ /gzugs su snang na srid gsum snod du chungs/ /e dbyibs chos lung dkar ba'i 'dzin ma na/ /tshangasarigs grub pa'i lugs gnyis rnam dpyod can/ /dkon cog bla mar bzung bas stobs lhor kun/ /dar wo rgyas pa'i zhang blon dra ma gang / /'dzol med blang dor kha dpangs mthon po can/ /srid skyong gsar gom rim pas dkyus thog gcod/ /gtong phod rin cen (17bsko srab brgyan spras pa'i/ /rta mchog gzhon nas ci bder slebs mthong tshe/ /grags skam 'grin pa bzang po'i gnya' steng na/ /tshul min spyod pa'i ze ba tsam bzung ste/ /'jungs pa'i thang la brgyugs nas rtse mo'i dar/ /len rnams chu 'dod smig rgyur snyeg pa bzhin/ /beḍūr zhun ma 'khyil 'dra mthing shog ngos/ /gser dngul spel ma'i yig gzugs sdeb legs can/ /glegs bam nya phyis khog pa yangs po mra /rnam smin dkar po'i mu tig phyur bur spungs/ /'gro kun pha mar gyur nas phan btags pa'i/ /yon du dge tshogs 'bras bu gtong phod zhan/ /rang gi 'di phyi tsam bde'i phub ma tsa/ /'bras dkar lo legs shugs lasang nga gis 'byung / /mchog dman gdul bya'i blor 'tsham sna tshogs mdo/ /bag yod bgrang byar bzhengs pas thog drangs te/ /gangs ljongs rgyal srung tshom bu'i do shal che/ /brtson pa'i srad bur snying stobs sor mos brgyu/ /ched du bsod nams sa bon 'di btab par/ /thub bstan a mra'i sdong po dar drag rtser/ /bde skyid —2()

sku gsung thugasarten gsar 4khosadang rin po che'i mchod rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar chag (mes ha ka ra smin pa'i ro/ /margan semasacan rnamasakyisamyong bar shog /sangasargyasakun gyisagang mkhyen shesabya'i gnas/ /macan sumagazigasapa 'jamamagon btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugasabod yulahor dang rgya nag po'i/ /rgyal khams kun tu khyab cing dar bar shog /rnam mkhyen thob min de srid rgyu sbyor gyi/ /legs byas lha gos lasagrub stan bzang po/ /skye ba'i gom pa gang bkod 'bad med du/ /'ding ba gro bzhin skyesakyi spun zlar shog /dkon cog thugasarjesasmin pa'i gang bu mā /tshe 'byor rigasabargyud dbang thang dar ba'i til/ /bgrang du med 'phel rgyasapa nam mkha' mdzod/ /ji bzhin nam lang mi 'dzad gter (18naskod shog /'dri dang brda tshig don la zhus chen mkhan/ /g.yos mal snag shog gis mtshon yo byad kun/ /lus ngag yid kyis 'bad rnams srid dang zhi'i/ /sim pa'i tshor ba rtag tu myong bar shog /gangasacan yul gru gtsor gyur 'dzam gling 'dir/ /sdig 'bras gshongs su rtsod pa'i klung chen rgyun/ /drag 'bab rdzogasaldan chu lon gyisabakag ste/ /dga' spro'i skam la rtse dga' dgod par shog /lasanyon gdon zhugasaskye rga na 'chi'i ro'i/ /gtsug tu dgoba'i rigasasngagasaphur pa'i dbal/ /btab pasa'ajig rten gsum gyi skye rgu'i tshogs/ /myang 'dasagrong khyer chen por dbugasadabyung shog /chu yi bum pa gang yang zad pa'i mthar/ /nam mkha'i ngo bo ngang gisalhun grub ltar/ /'gro sems sangs rgyasabag la zha byed sgrib/ /nyer sangasa'og min gzhan nasami 'tshol shog /dusakyi chad pa'i sprin nag mang po'i mgo tathug po dkar min mkha' la yongs gdengs pa/ /rnam 'dren rgyasasras nyan rang bden tshig rlung / /drag posaskad cig tsam la mthar byed shog /chos nyid chosacan blo mig brang gi steng / /bsrubs lasa'akhor 'dasalegasatshogasargod ma kha/ /kun dga'i mdza' ba ster ba'i gzi byin gyis/ /bkra shis snang ba'i dpal gyis khyab gyur cig /ces yul lho brgyud e rig pa'i 'byung gnas kyi sa'i cha nas rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa la gus pa lhur len pa'i ri sgo gzims shag lho pa gsol dpon rab brtan zhes dpa' mdzangs rtul phod pa gang gi rigs las lugs gnyis spyod pa'i blo mig yangs pa nang so dkon cog dar rgyas—2/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)kyis mnyam med zas gtsang sras po'i gsung rab las (18ba)ri kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir 'khor lo dang po'i lung sde bzhi/ /gnyis pa'i sher phyogs/ /gsum pa'i dkon brtsegs dang phal chen/ theg pa sna tshogs bsdus pa'i mdo sde/ rgyud 'bum gsar ma rnams 'gyur ro cog dang / gsang sngagasarnying ma'i rgyud gtso bsdus dang bcas bzheng bar mngon du phyogs pa'i sta gon gyi tshe dkar chag che brjod smon lam rgyas pa zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi ban+ḍis chu glang hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu drug la pho brang dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang pos bgyis ba sar+bha di ke dza yan+tu/zla ltar dkar yang thor tshugasasnum zhing nag /sprosadang bralayang gosabazang rin cen rgyan/ /'gro la brtseyang yid srubs phye mar 'thag /blo grosargan yang gzhon nu'i ngang tshul can/ /mtshan dpe'i sku ni mthong ba don dang ldan/ /tshangs pa'i gsung gi shes bya'i gnas kun rtogs/ /thugs rjes srid zhi'i 'jigasasgrol 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /dusagasum sangs rgyasarnamasakyi yab gcig pu/ /snang brnyan mdo khams tre bo'i yul gru nas/ /legasasbyar rtsisadang thu mi'i gtsug lag sogs/ /rig gnasadu mar blo mig rab yangs pa/ /ngag dbang nam mkhar 'bod de'i gsol gdab rten/ /yang yang snying nas mi phyed dad pa yis/ /lhang lhang thugs rje bskul bar gsol 'debasan/ /gsal gsal mgon khyod bdag yid la zhugs nas/ /bzang bzang 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i spobs pa stsol/ /'jam zhing dbyangs snyan zla ltar dkar ba'i zhal/ /zhal 'dzum lhug par bstan nas 'gro ba kun/ /kun gzigs mgon po'i go 'phang ma 'thob bar/ /bar chad (19nagoyul las rgyal bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes tre bo spos 'dzin rig byed smra ba ngag dbang nam mkhas 'jam dkar gyi sku thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi ban+des sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /bag yod kyi lo rgyas btab ra mo che'i kun dga' ra bar skyes rabasaso bzhi pa'i zhing bkod bris pa'i tshe le'u so so'i zhal byang mdzad ༅ snying po tshig par du spelabasnyo lasargya mtsho/ bskal mang gomasapa'i snying rje chen po'i chu/ /lhag bsam —22—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang ran po che' mchod rdzas khang bzang ga dkar chag (mari gzar las babs gzhan rkyen gyis//ldog min stag mo'i srog ched rang gi lus//gtong la lha klu gnod sbyin rjes yi rangs/1/brgya byin bram ze mig bral nyam thag par//nyer sprul chod myul byed la zhum pa'i blo//rab spangs tsham tshom med par rang gi spyan//ster mdzad shi pi la yi rgyal po mtshar/2/gla yis 'tsho ba'i dbus por gyur na yang //bsod nams zhing la gzan changs byin pa'i 'bras//ko sal yi sa spyod dbang po sa/gyur pa'i snyan grags phyogs kyi rna bar 'jebs/3/sdig rta'i 'phrul gyi bzod dka'i dmyal me la//'jigs med brtul zhugs chen pos rang sangs rgyas//rnyed bkur phul la dpa' ba'i spyod tshul gyis//me tog mda' can mya ngan khang bur brgyal/4/bdog pa dgun gyi chu bran bzhin bskams tshe//gtong sems dbyar gyi mtsho ltar cher 'phel ba//'a lcangs pa'i zil gyisami non tshong dpon gyi//mdzad pas brgya byin yid dbang ci yang phrogs/5/gdag gtsos pa'i tsher marang snying la//zug pas ma bzod zhugs kya phung po sa/mchod par som nyi med pa ri bong gi/grags pa 'chi med 'dun sar gcig tu che/6/srid bde 9bsdug bsngal yin par yongs rig nas//rab byung dben par spong ba lhur len kyang //rang nyid chog shes gzhan la sbyin brtson pa//gnyis skyes mchog la lha dbang dad pa 'phel//brlang por spyod pa'i gnod sbyin btud pa'i ched//ris med 'gro kun skyong ba'i snying rje che//rtsa chen las gtar dngas ma'i khrag gi rgyun//stsol mjad byams pa'i stobasakhyod skye rgu'i gnyen/8/don med 'khor ba'i dngos po gang la yang //ma chags sdug bsngal dang du len nus pa//thams cad sgrol gyi ngang tshul 'di mthong tshe//grags chen sangs rgyas de yang mi ring nye//'chi ba chos smra'i tshig gis yid drangs nas//phyugs kyi mchod sbyin sdig pa'i lam po che//bkag nasaphongs rnams 'dod pa'i re bskang ste//mngon mtho nges legs sa mkhan khyod gcig pu/1/rang nyid g.yul ngor pham pa yal dor nas//mkha' lding srog gcod sdom chen shing rta'i kha//sgyur tshe sbyin skyesadapung rnams 'thor rlung gis//gtor ba'i spren bzhin byer bas rgyal rnga brdungs/ 1/slob bu'i ngang tshul brtag phyir slob dpon gyi//rku ba chos su bshad tshe bram ze che//yid dam brtan po'i brtul zhugs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)lhur blangasapa'i//ngo mtshar ston zla nya gang bzhin du dkar/12/myosabyed mig gi zur mda' 'phangasapa'i mod//rgyal po'i brtan pa phrogasakyang log g.yem gyi//mnyen posango tsha shesal blon po sogs//'bangs rnams rangs pa'i bstod bsngags dbyangs su len/ 3/glong mkhar bru chen chud nas tshong pa rnams//nyi bu'i mche ba'i phrag par nyer 'gro tshe//rdzun bral bden tshig brjod pasa'ajigasapa las//thar mdzad legasapa'i pha rol phyin de mtshar/14/dkar min 20na7sa kyi 'bras bu'i mtsho bskamasate//nya rnamasasrog song bzhin du nyam thag par//dag pa'i tshul gnas mthu yisachar 'bebasapa//gser mig rgyal po'i rnam thar yid la 'babs/15/tshang snang zhugasakyisabasregasapa'i melcol//cher skrag bshog rtsal rdzogs kun byer na yang //sreg pa'i phrug gu'i tshogasarnamasa'atshig nye tshe//skad cig bzlog pa'i bden pa brjod de btsan/16/mdza' bo'i sasbyod log pa'i bshes gnyen gyis//dbyen bcos chang gis cher myos ra ro nas//'di phyi'i mdun ma nyams tshe thabs mkhasamathus//bag yod gnasal sbyor ba pha du byung /17/rmugasa'adzin longasaspyod rjesa'agro dpal 'byor la//rgyagasapa'i bsnyems pa mi ldan 'khor ba'i chos//chu shing ltar gzigs khyim spangs bas mtha' mā/zhi ba'i ro brgya myong de mchog gi blo/18/pha ma dang bral rkyen gyis mched po drug/'bangs bcas nags su pang rtsasanyer 'tsho ba'i//rang skal 'ad la mi gdung 'dod chung bar//mchod sbyin brgya pasasnyan pa'i bstod bsngags brjod/19/rna dbang nyams pas brjod pa don log sgras//rab tu byung zhes gragasapas nyer bskul nas//mi rje gnyen grogs rnamasakyisam ldog par//srid las byung ba'i bag yod brtul zhugs blangs/20/gnyis skyes 'khor bar yid phyung 'byog dgon par//bgrod pa'i phyi bzhin rgyu ba'i mchosabrang pa//'chi bar bzod pa'i char gyisas bdag rgyud//gdung ba'i nyon mongasame chen rab tu bsad/2 /nayomakha'i rgyalapo'i go du baṣ+ka bzang srog/'dor nusaya 4satshulalarngon pa yang //mtshang 'dzan rgyal khab mgrin rnga gzengasamatho'i sgras//rje 'bangs legs pa'i lam bkod dge ba'i bshes/22/gtsug lag ngan pa'i gtam gyisayid drangasanas//mi bdag log 20bapa'i lam du 4

sku gsung thugasarten gsar 4khosadang rin po che'i mchod rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar chag yonamangon phyogs pa//lung dang rig pasatshar bcad yang dag sar//sbyor ba'i kun tu rgyu khyod byang chub che/3/gcong rong lhungasalasanyer brtan srog bskyabs mi//drin lan log par gzhal la rjesabartse'i me//chesacher 'bar bsanagasaklung stug po las//sgrol mdzad 'phagasachen spre'u'i ngang tshul bzung /4/rgyal po ri dwagasarngon phyir cang shesarta//brgyugs pa'i mod la gting zab g.yang lhungasapar//mi 'jigasasbyin pasadabugasadabyung sha ra bha'i//bzod pa'i snying stobasago cha mchog tu btsan/25/shugasadrag nusakhyer bzung lan log 'jal mis//sna drangs sa skyong dmag dpung nyer lhagasakyang //byang chub semasakyisam rung rab btul ba'i//ri dgasaru ru'i mdzad pa 'di med byung /26/sahā ka ra'i ror sreg mi rje yi//brlang spyod dpung gisa'ajig tu 'cha' ba'i tshe//grangasamed sprel tshogasa'ajigasapa lasabaskyabasapa'i//bdag gzhan mnyam par brje ba'i tshul 'di bsngags/27/rang rgyud nyon mongasargyasadape gzhan bkab nas//sadabang mtshon gyisadrang srong lus gtubasapar/khong khro'i bud shing bzod pa'i mesabasregasal//mthong chos myong ba'i dmyal me 'gran bzhin 'bar/28/log lta'i rdul gyis yan lag sbyin semasachu//rnog pa'i ngan 'gro'i g.yang la gom khyer ba//tshangs rigasagrub pa'i thabs mkhas ke ta gas//bgrungs pas phan bde'i gzugs brnyan gcig tu gsal/29/mya ngam dgon par brgya phrag bdun gyi mi//mnar ba'i sdug bsngal skyab phyir rang gi lus//yal bar 'dor la spro ba'i gnyisa'athung dbang //gom stabasalhod posatshogasaganyisasachen brgal/30/zla ltar dkar ba'i lhag bsam 'od po ches//su dwa sabu'i rtsub semasasmag rum dpung //rgyal po'i rigasasogasa'agro mang bde ba'i lam//legs 2nangagod thugasarje'i rnam 'dren yol med mtshar/3 /lcagasakhyim sna tshogaganor bu'i phrasamadzesasogs//ma smad 'byor pa dug chu ltar spangasanas//dben pa'i gnas su zhi ba'i lam po che//zhugs te byang chub mchog de mi ring nye/32/brag ri 'bigs nus rno ngar rwa gdengs kyang /nyam chung spre'us 'tsho bar bzod pa'i go/btsan po'i khyu mchog ngang tshul gnod sbyin gyis//mthong tshe legs so'i tshig gi me tog 'thor/33/dregs myos seng ge mgrin pa rus

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)'dzer gyis//bzod dka'i zug ngur gyur tshe kha nang du//phyin te nang drung 'byin pa'i 'dab brgya pa//sngon med sman pa chen po dpag bsam ljon/34/sdos sbyor mnya pa'iXt+ta las rnyigs ma par rtson pa/bo ṅgā nut+ta ra yoḥtsa ro/tsar ma hā rgyus pra tidzñā ma ni tsit+ta swā ra ni dziṣ+ṭhatsas ka la yo phebat+pa re tsi lha thoḥmā lu:char tha susarba gam no mo khyon ga re ba be+e nā yi)ti thi sidha shākya ka ru ṇa ni tāk+ṣipe lo ka rta//rgyu dang mi rgyu'i yid can mtha' dag bla med byang chub chen po sa/'god pa'i dam bca' thugs kyi dpal be'u gsal ba'i ri mo nam du yang //zubs min brtson 'grus shing rta'i shugs kyis thar pa'i grong du 'gro ba kun//'dren pa'i ded dpon shākya seng ges thugs sdeb sbyor dpyad kyi thig le//21ba ) bī gaṇ+ḍaXkhyug ṇa ga lha ma hāXti yodharma dzña sarba pa ri aṇ+ḍa su ba r+ṇa pā kaḥdebargya paṇ+ḍi nga tsa si d+dha ma te shuXrnyo bha dra su kirti tsa dzā la go mi te stu tra/rje'i spyan ras yengs med gzigs//tshogs gnyis mngal gyi drod po cher sgrums pas//chos kun mkhyen pa'i gser sgong yongs 'dzin pa//blo gros paṇa grub lha gzhan las rgan pa'i//mkhas btsun bzang po'i grags pa 'bar khyod bsngags//rang rigs sna bor zhen pa'i rtul po'i blos//bstod min gtan gyi skabs gnas btsong kha par//nges kyang ris med grub mthar smod pa'i mtshon//mi 'phen shes rab mig dkyus ring po'i drin//kri kri'i rmi ltas khron pas 'bod ltar ding //rang 'dod dwangs khar 'tshangs pa'i rmongs chen gyis//sna tshogs ri mos byis pa'i blo brid kyang //thub bstan zhugs kun dad pa'i cha shas phra//ci'i phyir mdzes sdug rma bya'i gar steng na//tshul 'tshos gdong drug phyogs lhung 'dam bu'i tshal//bag yengs rgyu la gzhan sdom gnyis pa//'khrul chos mche ba phyungs par dgod la brel//22na tha stan 'dir mtshan dpe'i ngo mtshar bkra ba'i lus//grib ma gnyis pa las gzhan grogs med pa/thu kya seng ge'i mdzad pa 'dri ba la//kla klo mu stegs ma yin su mi dad//'di snang 'gro 'dug nyal 'chag mthun 'jug la//rnam par thar zhes gleng min bskal mang du//thugs bskyed chang gis myas pa 'a byang sems kyi//rlabs chen spyod pa'i rgyang glu blangs de mtshar//tshogs gnyis bsags 'bras chos dbyings zhi ba'i mal//mnal yang

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag khoma'og min zhing khams zhing gi gtsor/ /nges pa lnga ldan las sprul 'dzam gling 'dir/ /mtha' klas mdzad pas 'gro mang phan bder sbyor/ /spangs dang mngon du mdzad la thub pa rnams/ /mnyam yang ches cher gdul dka' 'dul ba'i mgon/ /zas gtsang sras khyod chen po'i drin gyi mtha'/ /nam mkha'i ska rags des kyang ga la chings/ /snying stobs lhag par rgyas pa sngon byung gi /rlabs chen spyod pa'i grangs tshad tshangs pa yis/ /bskal par gzhal kyang rtogs par nus min na/ /bus pa'i blo gros rnams kyis ci zhig rnyed/ /'on te ka lan+ta gas chu gter las/ /skom pa'i gdung ba sel nus 'thungs pa bzhin/ /'phags bod pa9grub du mas mdo 'dul nas/ /gang dpogs bkod pa'i glegs bam tshad ma'i dbang / /rgyal bas dpal gyi 'gur nas 'byung 'gyur lung / /nyer bstan dpa' bos snyan ngag tasbu ra'i/ khyud 'a las drangs pa' skyes rabs sa /so bzhi grangs su byed pa'i glu 'di snyan/ /'khor mtshor sgrol ba'i ma ma stong 'khrun khar/ /'chi med lus phra'i dpal 'dzin kong co yi/ /ngo mtshar sprul pa'i ga rjo la'i rtsig ngos/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho'i snang brnyan 'byams su klas/ /mkhyen brtse'i lang (22ba)tsho rgyas pa'i pir thogs mkhan/ /bzhed srol 'dzin mkhas dbu mdzad gzhon nu sogs/ /gtsug lag gnyis pa shes pa'i dpyod ldan 'gas/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyi khengs pa bag la zha/ /log rtog dris sbags ding 'gro khyab 'jug rkang / /dag byed rnam thar mtho ri bak+ṣa ma lha'i chab/ /sbrengs pa'i legs byas yan lag brgyad ldan rgyun/ /byang chen zla ba'i ma ma 'phel byed shog /zhwa ser cod pan 'chang bstan lha dang mis/ /yon gnas dam par bla nas blar bkur zhing / /su la'i tshal 'dir gnas pa'i skye rgu kun/ /rdzogs ldan gzhen nu'i rtse dga' dgod par shog /tshul min bag tshe'i smag nas ma 'thibs par/ /yang dag khrims shing bod chen gnya' ba ru /rab lci dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang che'i/ /mnga' thang mchod sbyin brgya pa'i dpal 'dzin shog /mchog gsum thugs rje'i ga bur gzigs ma'i rdul/ /lhungs pa'i mod la bde skyid kun+da'i 'dab/ /grol byed bkra shis zla ba dkar po'i cha/ /gang ba'i dpal gyis dus kun khyab par shog /ces gangs can phan bde'i rtsa lag rgyas btab ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang dus babs kyis nyams —27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shechag byung bar phyag mdzod blo bzang mthu stobs kyis khur bzhes nas zhig gsos mdzad pa'i las dpon 'phan yul lha khang pa dge logs a dar/ shing bzo dbu chen gra sa pa/ lha sal ma rnyed/ dbu chung gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs/ gra phyi dgos dgos rtse gdong phun tshogs/ bye mda' lha bu/ chu shur tsher gseb pa/ smon drug gling pa/ rtse kha chos skyong / rdo bzo dbu chen dpal bzang tshe ring / dol pa dgosaskyes/ dbu chung spel nag tshe ring rgyal po/ mal dro jo jo bkra shis/ 'phan yul spang lkog mgon po/(23na po gur rta bsod nams lhun grub/ 'bri gung bsam grub tshe brtan/ gser rtag gi zangasabardungs do dam 'dar gzhon ngag dbang 'phrin las dang gra pa dpon/ gser gtong ba'i do dam star stong pa nang so blo bzang tshe brtan/ shangs brgya tsho nas/ nyang pa mdo chung nas/ 'grangs rgyas shag pa nang so dgos dgos/ zangs mgar ba'i dbu mdzad rnam sras lhas byin/ dngos grub/ bal po a ma ra sidha / /dha na shrī sogs kyis byas shing / mchod 'bul gyi rgyun tshugs nas ring por ma lon pa bag yod kyi lo kun dga' ra bar 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med zas gtsang sras pos slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su byang sems kyi spyod pa rlabs
