po che'i mdzad pa las snyan ngag mkhan dpa' bos btus pa'i skyes rabs so bzhi pa'i nyid bkod nag pa zla ba'i che'i/bzhi la dbu btsugs/ khrums stod kyis nya ba'i nang du legs par grub pa'i do dam sde pa 'dar gzhen ngag dbang 'phrin las/ kong po gur bzang pa bsod nams dar rgyas/ ri mo ba'i dbu chen chos mdzad gar+sha zhe nu/ gong dkar sa spungs slob dpon pa ngag dbang 'phrin las/ dbu 'bring sbus khyim ngang grol/ zho ra rgyal po/ gsang mkhar tshe 'phel/rnam rgyal tshing bkras/ dbu chung spus khyim nor dbang / byings sdebs dzam bha la/ byams pa rgyal mtshan/bsod nams nor bu/ zho ra dbang phyug /nor bu don ldan/ o rgyan dar rgyas/ sangs rgyas don ldan/bsod nams mgon po/ gra phyi nor bu/ bkra shis dpal 'byor/ mon mkhar blo bzang / 'jam dbyangs rin cen/ 'brug stod 'jam dbyangs/ grags pa dbang phyug /blo bzang bsam gtan/ bsod namasa'ajam dbyangs/ ngag dbang mdo sde/ mon mkhar (23ba)pad+ma/ zho ra ngag dbang / kun dga' rab —28

sku gsung thugasarten gsar bzhengasadang rin po che'i mchod rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar chag (me'aphel/ nor bu bkra shis/ byams pa mthar phyin/ sangs rgyas 'phrin las/ gsang sngags bstan 'dzin/ rin chen rnam rgyal/ ngag dbang ye shes bzod pa rgya mtsho/ byams gling mkhas mchog /kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ skal bzang / 'dzom drug /thosabasam rnam rgyal/ bkra shisatshe ring / sbusakhyim lhasabyin/ sangs rgyasa'aphel/ rtse lung don grub mkhan chen/ byang chub ye shes bzang po/ dgra 'dul/blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ lha bsrung / sangs rgyasakun dga'/ bkra shis/ rta mgrin/ nor bu 'phrin las/blo bzang rdo rje/ tsher steng rab brtan/ ja ma nam langs rnams/ lcags phag mchod khang steng ma gnyis kyi 'bur sku rnams dang 'di lo sgo khyams kyi rgyal chen bzhengs pa'i do dam phod dkar ba bsod namasarnam rgyal/ rgyal sman bkra shisakha pa/ bstan 'dzin rab brtan/ dbu chen bag dro/ dbu chung chosa'aphel/byingasasdebasa'adzom drug /smin drug /a bar dpal 'dzin/ btsun chung / blo bzang bstan skyong / o rgyan mgon po/ lnga 'dzom/ blo bzang bstan 'phel/ 'dzom drug gachen pa/ a bar dar rgyas/ o rgyan/g.yu 'brug /bstan 'dzin bsam grub/ nor bu tshe ring / bsod namasatshe ring / rgya bod kyi yig risapa nyang stod 'jam dbyangs dbang po/ phogs sogasa'aphral dgos sprod mi byang gling bsam grub rgyal po rnams kyis bgyis pa'i tshe zhing bkod kyi che brjod smon lam dang bcas pa 'di ni za hor gyi rigs las sdom brtson klog pa mkhan ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes bag yod ces pa chu glang hor zla drug pa'i dmar cha'i dga' ba dang po la gtsug lag lugasabargya'i 'dun sapho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang pos bgyis pa sar+bha dwa gre ya sirnyi rastu/(sdeb sbyor mash+ka pa'i bṛt+ta lasosprinarnam par sgrog pa/)(24nakhridhiḥloshiste:shuratsanatsaromadh+ya.ādarashasate.upyadīrnyaslarbe.anuragadayashidhabisbapratini/ parārūpatārganidzagugatayoḥsarbarūpasmama3.atikakhrimasgogatidaya.adhishādrugadhadanairka/ /'jig rten gsum na rgyu dang mi rgyu'i semasakyi nor bu'i me long ngos/ /bsnyen sring med par kun la rjesachags thugasarje'i gzugasabarnyan nyer 'phos pa'i/ /dam pa'i rang bzhin —29—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)nam yang mi gtong bde gshegs spyi yi tshul lugs kyang / /cher snyigs 'gror brtse'i khyad par de yis zas gtsang sras por gcig tu dad/ /mgon khyod bya dka' yal dor bskal mang por/ /bsags pa'i tshogs 'bras sems can kho na'i ched/ /yin phyir byang chub brnyed nas gzhan don du/ /yol med 'phrin las mtshar ci dngos po'i gshis/ /ma rgan nyam thag ma bzod slob lam tshe/ /ri gzar chu ltar ldog min brtson 'grus go /gyon na bzhed pa'i rnam mkhyen thob 'a nas dang / /gdul dka' mi 'dul btang snyoms gang gi skyon/ /'on te ma rig stug po'i smag gi rum/ /sgrib pa'i mal du nyal la mtshan (24ba)dpe'i sku/ /bstan kyang byang phug nyi bzhin ma mthong nyes/ /mgon khyod la bkal le lan brda ru med/ /gzhan skyon dpyad kyis dbyung tshul yon tan sman/ /'debs min bden pa bstan pas gdul bya rnams/ /grol phyir tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis gsungs pa'i bka'/ /phan bde'i srog 'thud thengs gsos bdud rtsi'i dpyid/ /mi brjed gzungs thob rnams kyis nyer bsdus nas/ /yi ge'i 'phreng bar spel ba'i glegs bam tshogs/ /yid can kun gyi 'dod pa'i re skong ba/ /sngon med bsam 'phel yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /dbus 'gyung 'chang dang gangs can bod yul 'dir/ /'chad nyan zhus chen 'gyur bcos kyis spel ba'i/ /lo paṇa rgyal blon 'phags chen rnam thar gyis/ /yid dbang phyogs pas lag pad snying dar zum/ /thub gsung drang nges dka' ba'i gnad kyi mdud/ /rnam dpyod sor mos 'grol la zla med pa/ /blo bzang grags pa'i dpal khyod rigs gsum gyi/ /sgyu 'phrul gar las gzhan min gtsug na bsten/ /rgyal dang de sras sprul pas skye rgu rnams/ /rjes su bzung la nges rnyed mos rlud gis/ /thugasarje'i mkha' glang bsgul las bde skyid char/ /nor 'dzin khyab pa'i bkra shis dge legs stsol/ /zhes chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i dad pa'i sgo nas yul khyad par can la ched du brjod pa sngon du 'gro ba'i bkra shis pa'i glu dbyangs kyis sngun bsus te/ mtha' klas pa'i bskal pa mang por sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la brtson pa chen pos goms 'dris su mdzad de tshogs rlabs po che bde blag tu bsags nas 'og min gyi zhing du nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur mngon par rdzogs par sangs —30

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag 6yirgyas kyang mi mjed kyi zhing 'di'i (25na〉na dul bya nyon mongs pa'i stobs lhag par rgyas te 'dul bar dka' ba rnams kyi don du ma ga dha rdo rje'i gdan gyi spo la mchog gi sprul pa'i skur mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan nas bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i mtshan snyan shākya seng ge zhes 'o skol gyi ston pa bla na med pa 'di nyid kyis drang nges kyi theg pa las brtsams pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya cher bskor ba mdzad pa'i pha mtha' srid pa tha ma pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang tshad bzung bar mi nus na so so skye bo rnams kyi blos spobs pa'i yul min na'ang mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob pa'i 'phags pa dgra bcom pa rnams kyis bka' bsdu bar mdzad nas glegs bam du bkod de dgongs don rtogs par dka' ba dag shing rta chen po gnyis sogs paṇa grub rnams kyis legs par bkral nas rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du bstan pa rin po che nyin mo ltar gsal ba yin la/ de yang bram ze'i rgyal po rgyal shes kyis dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba me la bsregs te glegs bam rnams zhugs su sbyangs pas bstan pa la 'phel 'grib cher byung ba na lung sde bzhi'i glegs bam gzhan rnams rnyed kyang gzhung bla ma kha che'i dge slong zhig gi blor yod pa las yi ger bris pas ma tshang pa dang ma dag pa yod pa'i rgyun 'phel zhing sngar gsung rab mer bsregs pa'i thal khrod nas rnyed par grags pa'i gzhung bla ma yul dbus kyi dge slong zhig gi blor yod pa sde snod 'dzin pa du mas grong khyer bcom brlag tu bsdus pa'i zhu ba ma rdzogs pa 'di dag pa yin la/ de'ang dkar chag phang thang ma sogs kyi rjes su 'brangs te tshal ba bka' 'gyur du dang por lung gzhi/ gnyis par so thar gyi mdo dang rnam 'byed/ gsum par phran (25ba/sgo nas bzhi par zhu ba 'dzad la/ thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches dang por pha'i so thar/ de nas ma'i so thar dang rnam 'byed/ de nas don 'grel ba lung gzhi/kha skong phran tshegs/ gtan la 'bebs pa gzhung bla ma rnams yod pas gang gi rjes su 'brangs kyang mi 'thad pa med la/ yum rgyas pa'i byams zhus sogs le'u bzhi klu'i yul nas gdan ma 'drongs par nyi khri dang brgyad stong pa nas de rnams kha bskong ba rgya nag nas 'gos chos grub kyi 'gyur yod pa dngos —3/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebastan la 'khrul gzhi bya bar mi rigs shing / brgyad stong pa la 'phreng can/ bzo sbyangs/ sde can zhesaming gsum du grags pa 'gyur gyi tshig sna ring thung cung zad las don la khyad par med pa'i rgyu mtshan 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu zha lu lo chen rin cen chos skyong bzang pos gsungs/ mdo mang gi nang nasagatso bor gyur pa 'phags pa dkon cog brtsegs par rnam pa bcu drug gis chos bstan pa de rnams 'od srungs kyis zhus pa 'phags pa sdom pa gsum bstan par tshig don mdor bsdus nas de'i rgyas bshad sgo mtha' yas pa sogs le'u lhag ma rnams kyis bstan pas rtsa 'grel lta bu yin ces thams cad mkhyen pa ye bzang rtse pa'i zhal snga nas gsung ba legs par bshad pa chen por snang / shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i sde snod sangs rgyas phal po cher mtshan gyi rnam grangs mang du byung ba'i mkhan chen pad+ma bzang pos smad chad ces pa ma smad pa'i don dang / spyan snga zhwa dmar pa bzhi pa chos kyi grags pas ma rig pa'i smag rum med pa'i smag chad du sgra bshad pa gnyis ka mkhas pa'i gsung la khungs yod pa gzhir bcas kyang dbus pa blo gsal gyis rmag chad ces pa yang dag pa'i brda rnying du gsung pa (26na thags par mngon zhing 'di la snyan gyi gong rgyan dang pad+ma'i rgyan sogs mtshan gyi rnam grangs su thub bstan yongs su rdzogs pa'i bshes gnyen chen po 'gos lo ye bzang rtse pa bzhed/ mdo sna tshogs pa phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa rnams ni 'khor lo gsum po so so nas byung ba'i theg pa'i mtho dma'/ drang nges/ sgra ji bzhin pa yin min/ dgongs pa can dang ldem dgongs sogs rnam grangasaches shin tu mang yang / ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ 'jig rten khams ni stong dag tu/ /ngas ni mdo sdogang bshad pa/ /tshig 'bru tha dad don gcig ste/ /thams cad brjod par nus ma yin/ /ces pa ltar de dag thams cad gdul bya'i blo brid lugs tsam las don thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam ston thabs su ma go bar 'ga' zhig bzang po dang 'ga' zhig ngan par bzung na rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen pos/ mang du thos kyang chos kyis 'phongs pa ni/ /gsung rab gdams par shar ba med pas nongs/ /zhes gsung ba thog tu 'bab pa'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ gang gis 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir ni/ /—32

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shāmimachode rten thams cad bshig byed pas/ /gang gis mdo sde spong byed pa'i/ /sdig pa de ni ches khyad 'phags/ /gang gis gaṅgā'i bye snyed kyi/ /dgra bcom bsad par gyur pa bas/ /gang gis mdo sde spong byed pa'i/ /sdig pa 'di ni ches khyad 'phags/ /zhes bka' stsal pa ltar chos spong gis sgrib pa la 'dzem pa ni gnad du che zhing mdo sna tshogs pa'i bzhugs tshul la tshal pa bka' 'gyur dang them spangs ma gnyis mi mthun pa gang gi rjes su gongs kyang chog par mngon/ gsang sngags phyi 'gyur gyi rgyud 'bum la/ sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang (26bskosang 'dus rtsa rgyud tsam ma gtogs bla med phal cher bstan pa snga dar gyi dus ma 'gyur ba shas che shing rgya pho ba lung pas brtsams pa'i gsang 'dus gnyis med rnam rgyal dang / bde mchog ra li nyer gcig mgon po gsang ba dngos grub kun 'byung sogs rgyud brdzus ma mang du byung ba mtha' dag rgyal ba gnyis pa bu ston rin po ches dag ther mdzad nas dbyung bar brten gsang rgyud tshal pa bka' 'gyur las them spangs ma khungs btsun zhing lo chen tshad thub mang po'i 'gyur dpyad bzod pa dang / khyad par dus kyi ltor lo shong ston rdo rje rgyal mas gyi 4ra sngon med ngo ma' gyi gnas r+ṣa po yin pas thog mtha'i 'gyur gsar rnying rnams dor nas 'di nyid gtso bor gzung na legs par mngon/ gsang sngags snga 'gyur gyi rgyud ni dkar chag phang thang ma dang ldan dkar mar gsang sngags phyi'i rgyud rnams zhib mor bkod pa'i rjes su gsang sngags nang gi rgyud rnams ni ches gnyan pas re zhig 'dir ma bkod ces rgyal blon gyi dus su be ro tsa na rma gnyags gnubs gsum sogs lo tsā ba rnams kyis gsang ba'i tshul du yo ga rnam gsum bsgyur bas dkar chag phyi ma rnams su yang mi bzhugs shing bstan pa nyams pa'i bar skabs su la lar lhad cung zad zhugs par bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas zhus dag cig mdzad bzhed nas re zhig dkar chag tu ma bkod pa'i skyon gyis ding sang bar du rgyun 'byams la/ rnying rgyud tsho ha cang mangs pas tshang ma 'dri bar ma nus pa rnams phyogs rer mi 'gyur pa'i slad tu/ si tu thams cad mkhyen pa dge ba'i blo gros kyis snga 'gyur gyi rgyud gtso bsdus po ti gsum rgyud 'bum du bkod pas tshal pa bka' 'gyur rnam dpyod (27na ji —33

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)bar grags/ de yang lha mo dri ma med pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro/ zhes bka' stsal pa ltar byang phyogs gangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir mnga' bdag khri ral yan gyi rgyal po rnams rigs gsum gyi mgon po sogs 'phags chen du ma'i rnam thar sprul pa nyag gcig tu byon pa'i thog mar rgyal po gnya' khri btsan pos bod spyi la dbang bsgyur ba nas gdung rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun pa'i mthar/ lha tho tho ris pho brang yom bu gla snang du bzhugs pa'i yang thog tu gser gyi shog bu la be+e ḍūrlas bris pa'i dbang skong phyag brgya pa dang / mdo sde za ma tog babs pas bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga na 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ /lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ /gangs can ri yi nang gnas pa'i/ /rgyal po mi yi lha zhes pa/ /li tsa bī rnams rigs su 'byung / /de yang sngags kyi don grub ste/ /longs spyod tshe dang ldan par gyur/ /rig pa longs spyod ldan ces bya/ /mi yi bdag po de yang grub/ /lo ni brgyad cur rgyal srid bya/ /zhes dang / 'jig rten sgrol ma zhes grags dang / /lha mo gos dkar mo dang ni/ dkar mo chen mo gzhan phan brtson/ ces lung bstan pa ltar/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus thu mi sa sto ṭas sher phyin 'bum pa/ rin po che tog gi gzungs/ thugs rje chen po'i mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig bsgyur bas bstan pa'i srol btod/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos/ nga ste gdung rabs lnga na nga'i dbon sras (27ba)rgyal po lde zhes bya ba'i ring la dam pa'i chos 'byung ba zangs kyi byang bu la bris pa'i lung bstan bzhin/ btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyis mkhan chen bo dhi sa twa/ slon dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ bi mā la mi tra/ sha ni nga gar+bha/ pad+ma'i ngang tshul/ be+e ro tsa na/ sad mi mi bdun sogs lo paṇa mang po bla'i mchod gnas su bskur te 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab nas dar rgyas su mdzad/ 'di'i dus rlangs khams pa go chas 'bum thugs la bzung nas bsgyur bas rlangs kyi thugs 'gyur mar grags/ sbas ma lha dang nyang in+d+ra gnyis kyis blangs pa'i rgya dpe'i steng nas yo byad rnams 'bangs la khral bsdus nas bsgyur pas dpya 'bum du grags/ rgyal po'i dbu skra dang rams bsres pa'i reg zig —34

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (masngon po dum bu bzhi pa la lcags thur brgyus pas lcags thur can du btags pa sngar bsam yas su bzhugs zhing / sku mtshal bsres pa'i reg zig dmar po lha sa gong gi so phag mchod rten gyi nang du bzhugs par gleng zhing / glegs bam 'di dag zin bris lta bur song bas be+e ro tsa nas zhug chen mdzad pa'i dum bu drug par glegs shing la brten nas par bkab can dang gsung rab kyi khrod du pha wang gis tshang bcas pas pha wang can du grags/ 'brom bza' byang chub sman gyis rab byung rnams la bsnyen bkur pa'i gdugs tshod thon pa'i tshe tshar re sgrog par 'gyed bde ba'i ched du bam po re la shog dril re byas pa 'jug snod la brten nas sha sgro can du grags/ lha sras sad na legs kyi dus phang thang ka med kyi gtsug lag khang gi gsung rab rnams ban+de dpal brtsegs sogs kyis thems byang (28na)bkod pa bka' 'gyur phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i thog ma yin cing / de rjes stong thang ldan dkar gyi gsung rab rnams ban+de dpal brtsegs dang 'khon klu'i dbang po srung sogs kyis bsgrig par mdzad/ snying rje pad dkar chen po las/ kun dga' bo nga 'das nas byang phyogs kyi rgyud na grong khyer rdo 'jog ces bya ba phyogs dang phyogs mtshams su sgra grags pa yod par 'gyur te/ de na khyim bdag ral pa can ces bya ba phyug pa nor che ba/ longs spyod che ba/ bsod nams dang ldan pa/ shes rab dang ldan pa/ gzugs bzang ba mdzes pa/ lta na sdug pa/ kha dog dbang po rgyas pa mchog dang ldan pa/ dad pa can dang ba can cig 'byung ste/ des nga'i lus dang nyan thos rnams la bsti stang du byed pa dang / bla mar byed pa dang / rim gror byed pa dang / mchod pa dang rjed pa dang bstab par 'gyur te/ zhes lung bstan pa ltar/ mnga' bdag khri lde srong lde btsan gyi lung gis 'on ljang rdo'i lha khang du ā tsarla dzon mi tra sogs lo paṇa mang pos brda sprod dang chos kyi gzhung dang mi mthun pa rnams legs par dpyad nas skad gsar bcad che 'bring chung gsum gyis gtan la phab/ 'phan yul gyi smad ka ba na mo cher 'gyur bcos kyi zhus chen la brten 'bum dum pa bcu drug tu bzhengs pas ding sang gi bar du dum pa bcu drug dar so che/ de'ang bod sbyi'i bsod nams kyi mthu dman pas glang dar ma rgyal sar 'khod de —35

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa bsnubs te bod mun pa'i smag rum lta bur gyur na'ang / dkon cog gi thugasarje shugs drag pa'i dbang (28ba〉shes slar yang bstan pa phyi dar du grags pa byung ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta 'e ti/jo bo chen po a ti sha/ paṇa chen ga ya skor/ ā tsarla dmar po/ kha che paṇa chen/ nags kyi rin cen sogs paṇ+ḍita du ma dang / lo chen rin cen bzang po/ 'phrog mi mar mal rwa gnyan sa rngog shong dbang sogs skad gnyis smra ba mtha' klas pas bka' bstan bcos mang du bsgyur/ khyad par yum chen mo sngon rje ma gtogs 'bangs kyis bzheng mi nus pa las phyis su 'bangs kyis bzhengs pa'i 'bum pu ti tshar bcu dgu tsam byung ba nas 'phel ba'i rgyun las yar klungs jo pos bzhengs pa'i blo ka chig 'bum chig stong yod pa zhig dang rngog los bal yul pham mthing gi gtsug lag khang nas ting nge 'dzin gsum gsar du rnyed pa sogs bam po sum brgya dang le'u don gnyis byung ba'i rngog 'gyur legs par grags shing yum bsdus pa jo bo a ti sha dang lo chen rin bzang gis 'gyur bcos shing skyid shod snye thang ra mo cher jo 'brom yab sras kyis brgyad stong pa gsungs pa'i tshe gtan la phab cing rngog los kha che dang yul dbus kyi rgya dpe du ma bsags nas zhus chen mdzad pas grags shin tu che/ rgya nag nasa'ajam dgag pa shis cha rkyen bskur ba la brten nas dbus pa blo gsal sogs kyis sngon mchims kyis bzhengs pa'i 'dul ba lung dang mdo sde'i skor chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i thugs dam lha mi'i rgyan mchog /zha lu gser bkang / gtsang gser bkang / gtsang chu mig ring mo/ spun gsum gtsug lag khang du bzhugs pa dang mchims kyi gser gzhung ma/ gru spangs rtsa'i 'dzam gling rgyan sogs mdo sna tshogs gung bsgrigs/ sher phyogs rgyud 'bum rnams (29na8pal snar thang gi gtsug lag khang du bzhengs shing bcom ldan ral gris dkar chag nyi ma'i 'od zer mdzad cing si tu thams cad mkhyen pas bzhengs pa'i tshal pa bka' 'gyur gyi phyi mo 'di nyid la brten/ shes bya thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston zhabs kyi chos 'byung gi rjes su 'brangs nas bzhengs pa zha lur bzhugs pa nas rim gyis mched pas thems spangs mar grags/ rtsa bar gyur pa rgyal ba'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel rnams la brten —36

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mnas bshad sgrub shin tu dar zhing lhag par mdo sngags kyi gnad shin tu rtogs par dka' ba'i ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa'i the tshom gyi mdud pa mtha' dag /snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis legs par bkrol te/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba dam pa'i chos 'dul ba nas bzung theg pa'i yang rtser dpal ldan 'dus pa'i bar gyi thub pa'i ring lugs rma med pas stod dzā ti'i me tog rnam par bkra ba'i dri bsung 'thul ba nas/ smad za 'og thags su 'thag pa'i sa chen po'i bar kun tu khyab pa'i bka' drin zla med pa yin la/ bye brag mdo las/ dam pa'i chosakyi tshul 'di nyid gzung bar bya/ gcang bar bya/ lung dbog par bya/ lung nod par bya/ zhes bka' stsal pa ltar sngon gyi mkhas grub du mas 'dul ba lung / sher phyogs/ dkon brtsegs/ phal chen/ rgyud 'bum rnams kyi lung rgya cher spel na'ang mdo sna tshogs pa 'di nyid nyag phra bar byung bas/ bshes gnyen gro lung pa chen pos steng pa lo tsā ba lung rgyun 'tshol ba dang rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam (29ba 〉 r+sā shing bsgyur bar rgya gar du brdzangs pas/ paṇ+ḍita shrī rnam gnyis la mdo sde rnams legs par gsan rtogs brjod rin po che ni thugs blor ma shong bsad lta'i bar du shong gi 'gyur gcig ma 'di ga las med/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po ches stag ston shes rab 'od zer la mdo mang gi lung khungs tshol zhig par bka' gnang bar brten blo chen sangs rgyas sras dang srad phag khur ba gnyis la gsan cing spel bas bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshugs pa lta bur song zhing / de'i rgyun bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan la kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa thu btsun kun dga' rnam rgyal gyis gsan nas rgya cher spel ba'ang rim gyis pad+ma'i skud pa ltar byung ba'i tshe/ kho bo'i 'dren mchog rdo rje 'kho gnas gsar ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rgyud dang 'dul ba lung gnyis ngor dang gong dkar du gsan zin na'ang sher phyogs dang mdo'i skor gyi lung 'tshol bar mkhas grub sman lung pa chen po blo mchog rig pa'i rdo rjer cha rkyen gya nom pa dang bcas bskul ma gnang bar brten bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab kyi lung 'bogs nod kyi gra je bzang du —37—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gegyur pa'i bka' drin 'di ni gangs can pa rnams kyis gzhal bar dka' zhing rang nyid kyi ched du chos brgyad lhur len pa'i cher rlom rnams kyi ngang tshul la dpags kyang 'phags chen dam pa'i rnam thar zla med pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i yul lo/ /skabs don mdo nyi ma'i snying po las/ sgyu 'dra ba yi las byasapa/ /de 'dra ba yi gos bu thob/ /dge ba yin na bzang po ste/ /sdig pa byed pa'ang sdig lta'o/ /zhes pa dang / rin cen (30na tshe phreng ba las/ /mi dge ba las sdug bsngal kun/ /de bzhin ngan 'gro thamasacad do/ /dge las bde 'gro thams cad dang / /skye ba kun tu bde ba dag /ces pa ltar dkar po'i las bsags pa'i 'bras bu bde ba dang nag po'i las kyi 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'thob par gsungs pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ zla ba skar mar bcas pa gnas lhung zhing / /ri dang grong du bcas pa'i sa zhig la / /nam mkha'i khams ni rnam pa gzhan gyur kyang / khyod ni mi bden pa yi tshig migasung / /zhes sangs rgyas kyis rdzun gsung ba nam yang mi srid pas rang nyid legs par 'dod pa rnams kyis rnam smin dkar por 'dzag pa'i tshul la 'jug dgos shing / 'jug tshul yang / 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyi stobs bskyed pa cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul ba bstan pa las/ gang dag de bzhin gshegs pa la mngon sum du me tog dang / spos dang / dri dang / 'phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / na bza' dang / rgyan rnams kyi mchod pas mchod pa lta smos kyang ci dgos/ lha'i bu dag gang sems can la las sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das mya ngan las 'das nas lo brgya stong ngam bskal pa bye ba lon yang sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo zhes mtshan nas lan bdun brjod nas nam mkha' la me tog gtor na de dag thams cad sdug bsngal mthar byed par 'gyur ro/ /me tog nam mkha' la gtor ba lta theg gi /gang dag dad pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rjes su slob pa la la zhig gis de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims bslab pa gcig tsam 'dzin tam/ nyin (30ba tshe ka cig gam/ mtshan gcig gam/ yud tsam zhig de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa yid la byed par brtson na de sdug bsngal mthar byas nas rim gyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par —38

sku gsung thugs rten gsar ba tshe ngas dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mardzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brjod pa dang yud tsam zhig mchod pa yid la byed par brtson pa dag kyang sdug bsngal las thar pa dang rdzogs byang 'thob par gsungs na sangs rgyas la mi phyed pa'i dad pas kun nas bslangs te sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhed ba dang ri mor byed pa la phan yon rgya chen 'byung zhing / de gsum gyi nang nas kyang mchog tu gyur pa ni gsung gi mdzad pa yin pas/ gser 'od las/ bcon ldan 'das yul gyi bdag po de dag gis gdon mi 'tshal bar mdo sde'i rgyal po dam pa 'di mnyan nas yongs su bzung bar bgyi zhing mdo sde 'di klog pa dang / 'don pa dar/ len pa dang / 'dzin pa dag la'ang bsnyen bkur ba dang / rim gro dang mchod par bgyid na bdag cag dus tshad ma mchis pa'i lha'i 'khor g.yin rnams chos nyan pa'i dge bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mthus bla na ma mchis pa'i bdud rtsi'i chos kyi ro myong bar 'gyur bas/ zhes gser 'od dam pa 'di nyid nyan pa'i phan yon dngos su bstan pa'i shugs la bka' gzhan rnams la'ang don gyis thob cing / shes rab khri pa las/ rab 'byor de bzhin no/ /ji skad smras pa de bzhin te/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de tshes brgyad dang / tshes bcu bzhi dang / tshes bco lnga la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha rtan du byed pa dang / 'chad par byed pa na bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med/ (31na)grangs med/ tshad med/ bsam gyis mi khyab/ gzhal du med pa mang po dag bskyed par 'gyur zhing de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha rtan du byed pa dang 'chad par byed pa na lha'i 'khor mdun du gnas par 'gyur ro/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rin po che yin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de la rin po che ni 'di yin te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba las yongs su thar bar byed pa dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / mi dbul po dang / gnod sbyin dbul po dang /klu dbul po las yongs su thar bar byed pa yin no/ /zhes sher phyin gyis mtsho ni te/ bde bar gshegasapa'i gsung rab la kha ton du byed pa sogs ri mor byed pa'i mthu la brten nas gnas ngan len dang —39

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)bde 'gro'i sdug bsngal gyi 'jig pa las thar par 'gyur pa gsungs par ma zad gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi don thams cad 'grub pa'i rgyu mtshan kyang gong gi 'phros las/ gzhan yang rgyal rigs shing su la chen pa lta bu rnams su 'byin par byed pa dang / de bzhin du bram ze'i rigs shing swā la chen po lta bu rnams dang / khyim bdag gi rigs shing su la chen po lta bu rnams dang / tshong dpon gyi rigs shing swā la chen po lta bu rnams 'byin par byed pa dang de bzhin du rgyal chen ris kyi lha rnams kyi nang du skye ba 'byin par byed pa dang / de bzhin du sbyar te 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched kyi lha rnams kyi nang du skye ba 'byin par byed pa dang / de bzhin du rgyun du zhugs pa'i 'bras bu 'byin par byed pa (31ba)dang / de bzhin du lan gcig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang / dgra bcom pa nyid dang / rang byang chub dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'byin par byed pa yin no/ /zhes pa'i phan yon tshul bzhin 'byung ba la yang de bzhin gshegs pa lta bu'ang drang don du las kyi rnam par smin pa bcu la spyod na bdag lta bus lta smos kyang ci dgos snyam pa bcos min gyi sgo nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'dri ba dang kha 'a dang bkur sti rim gro byas pa'i kun tu spyod pa'i stobs la brten nas 'gyod sdom drag pos bshags pa byas na/ sdig lhung rnams byang nas sa lam gyi yon tan kun 'phel bar 'gyur gyi stobs bzhi dang mi ldan pa'i thabs g.yin gyis 'grub pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo las/ de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcasapa 'di gsungs so/ /gang du gnas kyang las rnams mi 'byung ba/ /de lta bu yi sa phyogs yongs med de/ /bar snang ma yin rgya mtsho'i dbus ma yin/ /ri yi phrag tu bzhugs kyang ma yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de nas mi bzhi bcu po de dag 'di snyam du gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi rje la'ang rnam par smin par 'gyur na bdag cag lta bu ci'i phyir rnam par smin par mi 'gyur snyam nas de nas de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis gdon mi 'tshal par srog bcad par bgyis te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar nongs pa bshags so zhes nyes pa bshags pa dang ci 40

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag khomanas kyang skyes bu bzhi bcu po de dag ye shes rtogs par 'gyur ba dang / srog chags sum khri nyis stong rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba'i chos la chos kyi mig rnam par dag par (32na〉gyur ba dang / las zad par bya ba'i phyir las brtsams nas de ltar de bzhi gshegs pas chos bshad do/ /rgyu de dang rkyen de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs la seng ldeng gi tshal pa zug ste/ de yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i thabs mkhas pa yin gyi las kyi sgrib pa ma yin no zhes rgya cher gsungs pa nyid kyis shes shing tshul de dag nyams su myong ba yang dad pa la rag lus pas/ phal chen las/ su zhig sangs rgyas yul la dad sems pa/ /de ni chags med thub pa kun gyis dbang yang bskur zhes dang / dkon cog ta la'i gzungs las/ dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste/ /yon tan thams cad bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed/ /dogs pa sel zhing chu bo rnams las grol/ dad pa bde legs grong khyer mtshon byed yin/ /dad pa rnyog pa med cing sems dang byed/ /nga rgyal spong zhing gus pa'i rtsab yin/ /dad pa nor dang gter dang rkang pa'i mchog /lag pa bzhin du dge sdud rtsa ba yin/ khres gsungs pa ltar yin la/ khyad par gsung rab glegs bam du bris nas mchod par byed pa'i bsod nams kyi mthu bla na med pa ni sdud pa las/ bde bar gshegs kyi yum 'di glegs bam la bris te/ /'chang zhing me tog byug pas bsti stang byed gyur na/ /mchod rten byas mchode bsod nams des ni char mi phod/ zhes dang / 'phags pa brgyad stong pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis glegs bam chen po la yi ge gsal zhing rab tu gsal ba legs par bris te me tog dang bdug pa dang dri dang 'phreng ba dang byug pa dang phye ma dngan bza' dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang dril bu dang ba dan khor ra khor yug tu mar me'i 'phreng ba (32brkong mchod pa rnam pa mang pos/ bkur stir bya bla mar bya brjod par bya mchod par bya ri mor bya bsnyen bskur bya ste/ kun dga' bo 'di ni ngas rjes su bstan pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang /pad dkar chen po las/ kun dga' bo/ gang dag kha cig sangs rgyas la dmigs nas tha na me rtag nga /

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gegacig nam mkha' la 'thor na kun dga' bo dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyi 'bras bu mya ngan las 'das pa yin te/ zhes thar pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang la mngon du sbyor ba'i phyir na tshe 'di dang 'jig rten phyi ma tsam gyi bde skyid du 'byung ba gor ma chag mod/ 'on kyang spyod 'jug las/ji ltar mtshan mo mun nag sprin rum na/ /glog 'gyu skad cig bar snang ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas mthu yis brgya lam na/ /'jig rten bsod nams blo gros thangs 'ga' 'byung / /zhes sangasargyas kyi bstan pa dang phrad pa'ang shin tu dkon zhing da lam dal 'byor don ldan du byar yod pa'i tshul la 'phyong rgyas sger bu ba bsod nams dar rgyas yid ches kyi nges pa rnyed de rang gi tshe rabs sngon nas da lta'i bar du bsags pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba'i las rnams sbyong ba dang 'di phyi'i phan bde'i legs tshogs spel ba'i lhag bsam gyis kun nas drangs te nyang stod 'brong rtse'i gzhis gar 'phags pa'i yul du pra ma dhi zhes pa phyogs 'dir bag yod du 'bod cing / rgya nag po'i rgyal khams su gu'i tshe'u zhes pa ljongs 'dir dbang thang dang bstun te chu mo glang gi lor 'dul mdo sher phyogs ljongs 'dir 'gyur ro cog dang gsang sngags phyi 'gyur gyi rgyud 'bum dang bcas pa'i bde bar gshegs (33na)pa'i gsung rab pu sta daḥbargya phrag gi 'phreng bar spel pa'i snag 3|ga glegs shing glegs chab zhal khebs gdong dar sogs rgyu phun sum tshogs pa dang yig gzugs brda dag gi gtsug lag la blo mig yangs pa'i dbon yig rnams kyis 'bad pas bris shing mkho dgu'i longs spyod kyis tshim par byas nas shegs med du grub pa yin no/ /mkha' mnyam sems can yongs la nyer bsngos pa'i/ legs byasarang rgya'i bum par shong ba'i chu/ /kun mkhyen ye shes rgya mtshor ro gcig nas/ nam yang mdzad pa med pa'i gter rnyed shog /thub bstan skye rgu'i sim mtshor srog zungs su/ /rab dkar dge ba'i rtsi sman 'di song bas/ /ma pham mgon de dbus 'gyur 'byon min par/ /don grub 'phrin las grib tu 'gro bder shog /zhwa ser cod pan thod du nyer bcings te/ blo gsal skal bzang 'dus pa'i grags pa'i sgras/ dza lha'i ljon pas mtshan pa'i lus can rnar/ /mdzes byed snyed pa'i rin cen 'od 'bar shog /bag —42

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag khomatsha'i gnas la ngo sor khyer min pa//ya rabs khrims kyis gangs can dpal mo'i mngal/yongs lci khur dud dga' ldan pho brang gi/lugs zung mnga' thang bla nas blar 'phel shog/thub gsung glegs bam brgya phrag bzheng ba'i rgyu//sbyor byed sgrom bu bsod nams dar rgyas kyi//tshe dpal rigs brgyud dbang thang rnam thos bu'i//bzang po'i bskal pa de dang mnyam par shog/'di sgrub ched du lus ngag yid gsum gyis/'bad par gtogos so cog rnams srid dang zhi'i//bde legs kun la rtsol ba'i ngal med du//dbang 'byor 'dod 'jo'i ba mo rnyed par shog/bkra shis skye ba lnga pa'i dung dkar po/ngo mtshar ri mo g.yas 'khyil skad gsang gis//tshangs pa'i 33ba〉sril sa'i bar du yongs khyab nas/phun sum tshogs pa'i dga' ston rgyas par shog/ces bag yod ces pa chu glang gi lo 'phyong rgyas sgrom bu ba bsod nams dar rgyas kyis rnam 'dren shākya seng ge'i gsung rab ljongs 'dir 'gyur ba phal mo che'i glegs bam bzhengs pa'i tshe dkar chag dang 'brel ba'i smon lam zhig dgos tshul 'byung ba ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang pos bgyis pa sarba dā bha wa shas nā la ya su shri ya wadhe stu/lha sa smon lam chen mo'i dus kyi bol ba bla bres gdan cha sogs kyi 'go brjod gnam sa'i khyad par mdzes sa/sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i brit+ta las rdzogasang /bhā be+e r+sha rtok+ṣi shrī da nā khod na tres dharmā de/an+ta dzñān+ta lha hastu ku ༷ ni re bsku/so kheḥsrid zhi'i gtsug tor rtse mor zhabs sen zla//tshes pa'i mod la dam chos snang ba yis//mun bskal mthar byed bu ram shing pa'i phyag/ring khyongs spyi bor bzhag ste 'gro dbugs phyungs//lus can 34nakun rjes 'dzin par ba ched pa'i khur//rab tu lci yang mgur gyi bum bzang nas//rnam gsum 'khor lo'i zil dngar 'dzad med rgyun//'dul zhing rna ba'i bcud du 'bab 'di mtshar//'on te bskal mang bsod nams bsags pa'i 'bras//rab tu smin pa'i lang tsho dar drag pas//ro bda' chu lha'i bu yi bzhin ro mes pa'i//dus kyi cho ga rdzogos pa'i snod du gyur//lta spyod ga pa'i lung rig gis drangs nas//gna' bo'i srol la zhen pa'i ston pa drug/sdebaXs bcom pa'i mnyan yod mchod pa yi//dus ston

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)mngon sum ljongasa'adir 'phosapa bzhi//tshuladesamathasaklasaskal bzang yid ga rnams//thar pa'i grong du 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan che/khamasagasum chosakyi rgyal po btsong kha pa//lasagazhan byed po tshad masadamigasasu med//bya dka'i spyod pa rlabs chen phung po'i tshogs//nyer bsagasasngon gyi rtogasabarjod la brten nas//'gro rgyud sangasargyasaded spel dge ba'i rlung //ldangs pasa'akhor ba'i tsha gdung rab tu bcil//de phyir chosasmra ba la bsti stang du//bgyid pa'i gnam sabar rgyan stan la sogs//phyi nang nyer mkho'i dpyad dngosayi ge sa/spel ba'i deb ther 'dzad med mdzod 'di'o/zhesabasngags brjod gyi 'phreng ba tshigs su bcad de 'o skol gyi rnam 'dren bu ram shing pas rdzogs byed sogs phyi rol pa'i ston par khas 'che ba'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal can rnams btul ba'i mgo pa'i dus ston bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan 'phrul snang sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du khams gsum chosakyi rgyal po 34bgor btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis phyag dar te 'dzugs pa gnang ba'i smon lam chen mo'i dus kyi yol ba bla bre gdan cha sogs phyi nang nyer mkho'i yo byad rnams sngon chad par bkab cig mi 'dug pa nye char sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis zhal bkod mdzad nas bag yod ces pa chu glang hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer lnga rgyal dang phur bu 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor gyi thog deb ther du bkod pa la/rin cen rgyan tha deb ther gya 'go brjod lo med ma gyi mgo po/sdebasbyor mash+ka pa'i bṛt+ta lasazlum po/madh+yanasharādzagadzinasalwapakirtisrurladaḥkhālu/ /8tatsitre/lamāyanārtalham〉〉kho3:taphyadeb/ 'phags yul rgyal rigs swa la par grags nyi ma'i gnyen gyi brgyud du 'khrungs//rigs gsum sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar las gangs can spyi bo gnam bstad lha//35na〉yosakāsanatwasasriman+t+rakakaṇ+ḍasnyizhitesadishasum̐skramāgahikyisukhyadzībakapraḍokhā+esukalgaganya' khri btsan nas ral pa can bar yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor ma lus par//dbang phyug dam pa'i skyem bu rim byon phan bde'i srog 'tsho'i rtsisman ljon//snab med pa gnam gyi sgo 'phar nas//dusagyi bdag 44

sku gsung thugasarten gsar 4khosadang rin po ༅ mgo dzosakhang bzang gi dkar ga (mepo'i she mong dpung pa can/ /'jam dbyangasargyal po'i lung lasabaka' rtags kyis/ /ngesapar chen por bkur rnamasabasngagasabya'i gnas/ /chasakyi mdzesabarjid bsgrigs kyi nye bar dpa'/ /mdzangs mkhasabazang spyodasgrin dkar phung po la/ /mig ltosagazur gnas rma bya rnam dpyod kyi/ /sgrogashog zlum por bsgyur ba sngon mang byung / /ya rabasachasakyi yiṇ+ḍa wā ra'i rdul/ /phun tshogs 'byor pa'i gur kum dang 'dresading / /gangasacan kā shi mdzesadaga'i 'gram (35ba)pa la/ shar 'disaskal bzang bung ba rtsed 'jor brel/ /ngo mtshar rin cen sna tshogasaphra tshom dang / /ring po'i do shal phan tshun 'thab pa'i 'od/ /'bar bsanyin dang mtshan mo'i khyad par ni/ /'byed la sgam bu phywa de 'phyang mo nyug /e ma srid pa'i dpal 'byor yod do cog /byang phyogasanor 'dzin dpal mo'i mngal khur du/ sbrum tshe ljid kyisam bzod rngul ba'i chu/ /chad med ri klungasakun nasa'abab pa bzhin/ /rang blo khongasanasamathon por gzengs bstod ba'i/ /'jigasamed bsnyegasapa'i chas gosakyisaklubasapa/ /drung 'khor lha yi spun zla bgrang yasakyis/ /skabasagasum bdag po'i 'dun sabazhin du mdzes/ /gnod sbyin bye ba'i grong khyer chen po yi/ khor sagacig gyur phobrang lcang locan/ /ru bzhiskye rgu'i legasabyasashing rta yis/ /skalabazang mgron du mngon sum drangasasam snyam/ /ne'u le'i mgrin nasa'adzad med nor bu'i rgyun/ /lhug lhug skyugs 'di phun tshogasarin po che/ /rgyan bzang mchor por spel ba rnam thos bus/ /g.yon pa'i sor mos ched du bcir ba bzhin/ /rtsing por spyod pas chud 'dza' chom rkun sogs/ /nyes brgya'i dri ma 'byin byed grangs tshad dbyibs/ /rtogs sla yi ger 'god dang 'jug snod kyi/ /tshar dngar dngas snyigs 'byed pa'i rnam dpyod 'phrul/ /gser ga sog rna sog sgor rna rgyan shal/ /rtse ber gtsug zhus mtshon pa'i nyer dpyad rnams/ /dngas pa'i mtsho la rdul bral zla gzugs bzhin/ /gsal byed deb ther dpyid kyi glu ru len/ /zhesabakra(36nashisapa'i tshig 'phreng tasbu ra'i dbyangasasu blangasate de'ang rjogasaldan gyi bskal pa la 'khor losasgyur ba'i rgyal po rnamasal rgyal srid sna bdun sogasasrid pa'i dpal 'byor thamasacad rtsol pa la ma bltosapar lhun gyisagrub cing rtsod ldan gyi dusa'adir yang rgya 45

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shegar/rgya nag/hor/bal bod kyis mtsho ni pa'i nyi 'og gi rgyal po/rgyal phran/gtso bo/khyim bdag sogs yul gru so so'i srol lugs gyi chas dang rgyan gos phun sum gang tshogs kyi rgyun dar zhing /khyad par ri kha ba can gyis bskor ba'i bod gling dgu'i rgyal khams 'dir mes dbon gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i chos skyong ba'i rgyal po rim par byon pa rnams kyi dus rtse gos dang bla g.yu rna rgyan sogs mas gos kyi spams mtho ba rgya bal dang phyogs mthun pa byung zhing /gnam gyi lha 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i lung gis chol kha gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i 'bangs su phul ba nas bzung skya bo zhwa lngas mtshon pa'i rgya hor gyi srol dar la/sde srid phag mo gru pa'i dus nas dpon chen dpon skya phal cher la rin cen rgyan char grags pa'i gzabs mchor dar ba'i rgyun bar skabs su cung zad nyag phra bar slar yang pho brang chen po po ta lar lo gsar gyi dus ston dang smon lam chen mo'i skya rags sogs kyi ched du sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis ri mo rnying pa gab pa gsar gso'i tshul du bsgrigs pa'i gser ga/sog rna/sog sgor/rna rgyangs/shal dkar dmar/rtse ber/gtsug zhwa/skya rags dus kyi gsar chas kyis thog drangs nyer 36bsgo'o rnams deb ther du bag yod ces pa chu glang hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer lnga rgyal dang phur bu 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor gyi thog bkod pa la/dmu nga las sto sgrung pa la wo mtsho yo byad gyi de spu kyi 'go brjod rig 'dzin rol pa'i dga' ri/steng sbyor mnyam pa' brit+ta la me tog 'phreng ༅/sdeb spyor mnyam pa'iXt+ta las me rtag 'phreng can/zwadhi bā sirnyi ba dhe kya4rtasurwadzes bha bshu swā rot+ta rāXbadz+ra sa twa pra storwa du ke ni kyil:rma hāXta lhams bhaḥmachog thun dngos grub bsam 'phel yid bzhin gyi//dbang gi rgyal po dngos brgyud bla ma rnams/khyab bdag rdo rje sems pa'i bdag nyid du//nges r+sā byang r+sā bar du gtsug na mdzes//chos sku wo zhi'i 4 du ro r+sāg kyang //chu nang zla bzhin sna tsho gos du ma'i gar//rab bsgyur zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yi//phul byung thugasarje'i mthu yis bdag byin rlobs//bdud dpung srog dang 'bral la ches rings pa'i/khrag33)lasbyod pa'i gtul drag gar sgyur yang //dam ldan skyoX ༷ dgyel zhal lhug pa sa/ston mdzad chos skyong

sku gsung thugs rten gsar spu gos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (masrung mas 'phrin las sgrubs//nges gsang lam gyis 'di phyi gtan gyi mdun//spel thabs dbang bskur byin rlabs rjes gnang dang //rig gtad rab gnas bsad mnan sreg 'phang sogs//gang 'tsham 'phrin las sgrub la nyer mkho'i chas//de tshul gsar rnying rigs 'dzin chos kyi spyan//dkyusarings rgyud sde rgya mtshor nyer gzigs kun//bzhed pa'i srol rjesangs las snang shas kyi/khungasabral 'phrul khyad kyis bzod do zla min//sngags gzhung chu gter gting mtha' gzhal dka' yang //thos brtson ri bo bsgril las nyer thon pa'i//mkhas grub phyag bzhes bdud rtsi phan bde'i srog/ring por lo ba'i zungs su gyur 'di spro//de phyir rigs 'dzin rnal 'byor spyod pa por//nyer mgo yo byad mang zhig 'du bgyis rnams//brjed byang deb ther ā dar+sha yi ngos//tshig don brjod bde yi ger shar 'di'o//zhes mchod par brjod pa sogs sngon 'gro gleng bslang bar 'os pa'i tshigs su bcad pa nye bar brjod nas/ston pa thugs rje'i bdag nyid can des zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos tshul mthas klas pa zhig bka' stsal pa'i nang nas bla nas blar mtho pa'i gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi tshul thosabasam sgom pas gtan la 'bebs par byed pa la nye bar mkho ba'i sngags gsar rnying gi dkyil thang /dbang chas/rab gnas/sbyin sreg/srung bzlog bsad mnan sogs kyi yo byad 37bsgoms sa bya mchod dpon rgyal dar gong pa ngag dbang shes rab la rtsis sprod byas pa bzhin chu glang hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer lnga rgyal dang phur bu 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor gyi thog deb ther du bkod pa la/phur sgrub mdo gtor sogs dus rim spyi bye brag gi dgos cha de btu 'khod pa'i 'go brjod phun tsho gos 'dod 'jo/sdeb sbyor mnyam pa' mit+ta las me tog phreng can/em:pa tu phor ta shā khyuta bro lha tatwa ta bha bā : ཿmu dra hi/pā shum tregaṇikrodha daṅgā:lha rtsi kyi blo n+t+ra byudza pā rma sheñtsa sga pa ta/e ma 'jam dpal dpa' bo dus kyi dgrar//rab bzhengs srid gsum phyag rgya zil gnon pa//mthong ba'i mod la khro tsho gos dregs pa kun//brgyal dngangs lag cha ma lus stabs gcig 'chor/ /lha khyod dkyil ༷khor gtsor bzhengs bka' rtags kyi/ /cod pan

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shethod 'ching 'dod khams dbang phyug sogs//bstan srung dam can mngag gzhug tshogs rnams kyis//ba po shis lha rgyal mgrin mthor bteg nas 'then//ma dang dpa 'tsha'i dga' ston yar gyi tshes//38nakhrag 'thung rol pa dmar cha'i dus chen la//skong bshags tshogos mchode mdos gtor sna tsho gos las//sgrub pa sngags 'chang tshad ldan spyi yi lugs//don des sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin gyis//kun bzang mchod sbrin nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo//'byed kyang spyan gzigs sna tshogs mthun pa'i rdzas//rtsa gsum thugs dam skong la gces pa'i nor//gnam ston sal 'khyil 'dra'i rdzing bu la/ngang pa mgrin rnga sgrog cing 'dub ltar/khyud dang man ngag las byung rdzas tshogs par//dam can srung ma mi 'du dmigasasu med//de phyir zhwa phod rus pa sbrul chun dang //mi rkang stag shun mgo lag dbang po lnga/khyu ma'i dra bar brgyus sogs dpal gyi chas//srin po'i grong gi bkod pa'i spun zlar dogs//lha rdzas rab bkra rgyal mtshan ba dan 'phan/khrab rmog gzhol btags bir phub mda' mdung gri//me sgrogs dmag chen ru mtshon sna tshogs mtsho ni//'chi med dbang po g.yul ngor chas pa bzhin//sor mo'i 'dab stong 'dar ba'i sbubs nang du//bkod pa'i khyad par bung ba glu blangs pas//don ldan ze'u 'bru'i snying po myangasapa'i 'bras//ngo mtshar mang raba'i sbrang chang las la brel//de 'dra ming don brda ru nyer sprad nas//'phrul med lag tu dar la dka' ba'i 'phrang /sgrol byed bde bar 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan des//brjod pa rnam dag gter gyi sgo 'di dbye//zhes ba po shis pa'i tshig sngon du 'gro ba'i dngos po nges par bstan nas//phur sgrub/gtor bzlog/srid gsum bdag mo mchod pa sogs lo gsar dus rim gtso bor byas te gzhan yang 'bro rol/mdos skang 38ba〉〈gas dgos pa skabs don gang 'tsham la nye bar mkho ba'i snyan dar gong ba ci par/drag chas kyi lda ldi/sngags chas/rus rgyan/rgyal mtshan/'phan/ru mtshon/rgya hor bod kyi go mtshon sogs spyan gzigs kyi rim pa rnams sa bya mchod dpon rgyal dar gong pa ngag dbang shes rab la rtsis sprod byas pa bzhin bag yod ces pa chu glang hor zla brgyad pa'i nyer lnga rgyal dang phur bu 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor gyi /ga deb ther du bkod pa la/

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khog dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga 9yigazims sa mgon khang du lcang lo tso du dgram rgyu'i nag thang gra tshar gyi rgyang yig dngos grub gter mdzod/sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i brit+ta la rigs gnas/〉tsit+ta stod r+sha mu kha tri mu mya dePROBPROBPROBrjedo〉spro ti bi sbad rba sha ye gar mā yi:tam trasadre sha ཾ li khā ṅga〉sidhika kor ṭi to ni dhaḥrang sems me long ngos su rtsa gsum lha'i//bskyed rim gzugs bas 'char byed zhi dang khro'i//rnam 'gyur sgyu ma'i gar mkhan gzigs mo sa/legs ston bris sku dngos grub bye ba'i gter//gang bsams39na sgo choge dang thun mong 'phrin las kun//lag rtser 'bad med rtsol nus yad bzhin gyi//nor bu dbang gi rgyal po'i 'phreng ba 'di//bkod legs srad bur dkyus ring gcig tu brgyus//bsod nams sprin dkar lang long 'khrigs pa las//lha sngags ye shes 'dzad med char wo pos//rang rgyud zhing sa gsher bas bskyed rdzogs kyi//sa bon sbrums pa'i snye ma g.yur za shog/ces rab byung brgya gag pa chu pho byi ba'i lo nas dbu btsugs chu glang legasapar grub pa'i sngags gsar rnying gi rtsa ba gsum gyi nag thang gzims chung mgon khang du dgram bya gras phangs bco lnga phyag mdzod blo bzang mthu stobs kyis khur bzhes do dam thon bya sgo ba blo bzang dbang phyug/ri mo ba dbumadzad dpal mgon/dbu 'bring pho brang phun tsho gos dang srad pa bsod nams/dbu chung stag lung bkra shis dang sngags gra bsod nams/byings gras dgos bsam/'phrang sgo dkon cog rgyal po/māṃ mdangs pa snye mo rkarma/tshe dbang nor bu/lha sa rta mgrin/'jam dbyangs don grub/dpon cog/grags pa phun tshogs/a lkugs/sgor ngag dbang dar rgyas/rin spungs lnga 'dzom/tshe bdag/bsod nams rgyal po/ram pa brag logs pa/'phan po dge bsnyen rgyal po/dpal gnasargyal po/bstan 'phel/gzhis rtse rdo rje tshe brtan/rdo rje rab brtan/pad dkar/rtse gdong bsod nams tshe ring /bstan 'dzin/lcang srung khang rin cen rdo rje/'phyong rgyas 'jam dbyangs/'dod yon/sdings chen mi 'gyur/ 39brgyab yig 'dri mi nyang stod pa ngag dbang phun tsho gos dang sdings chen mi 'gyur/phogs sogs dgos cha sprod mi byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos byas pa shri ya ra stu/dus rim r+pā mor dgram rgyu'i sngags thang gra tshar gyi rgyabaX ngo mtshar rgya mtsho/sdes sbyor mnyam pa'i brit+ta las me tog phreng

sku gsung thugs rten gsar sa khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga (matsā kro yak+ṣa ri rnye yastu/phun tsho gos dpal dang 'byor pas khor yug kun//gcig gyur lcang lo can gyi pho brang nas//rnam mang thos pa'i sras gyur rgyal po che//'khor tshogs gnod sbyin rgya mtshos shis par mdzod//legs byas 'byams su klas pa'i thang yangs por//cang shes 'khrul gyi gsar gom bang 'gros kyis/rnam dpyod kyus thog gcod lagazigs mos/mtshar che'i dga' ri pa ya sa sa spyi yi srol//sprul pa'i bzo rig gnyis pa shes pa'i mig/41na〉ngas pa'i 'phrul gyis gser dngul bkrol tshagasasga//gong rmed srab 'khor sna tsho gis rgyan gyi gzhin//snang srid gzugs kun ma cane sum shar ba bzhin//spu len ze long kheb sogs za 'og gi/tshon mdangs spel legs bkrag chen 'ja' ris kyi//rjes 'gro cang shes gzabs mchor lha dbang gi/rta mchog dpung gi khengs pa bag la zha//de phyir bkra shis rin cen sna bdun gyi//ya rgyal shugs ldan mdzes par byed pa'i chas//'khrul med dkar 'jam shog bu'i deb yangs por//brjod pa rnam dag yi ge'i gzugs su shar//zhes bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas skabs don gyi snying po bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir sngon gyi che gzha phal cher la yongs su grags pa'i skya rags che chung dang khyad par rin cen rgyan sprod kyi skya rags la med du mi rung ba'i gsar chas gzabs mchor gyi rim pa rnams dang zhan byung /bde mas la brten pa'i mtshar du che ba'i rigs kyang de snga phan kha 'thor ba'i tshul las phyogs gcig pa zhig mi snang ba nye char sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis blo dang brtson pa'i byed pos bsgrigs tshoms tshar du dngar ba adhi dang gnyis sogs go rim kun rtogs sla ba'i ched du bag yod ces pa chu mo glang gi lo dbyu gu zla ba'i yar tshes dge bar dkar chag tu bkod pa la/rgyas bto ra mo che' rten mchod kyi deb ther brjed ngas chu las sgrol ba'i gru rdzings/4ba sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i brit+ta las tshe tog phreng mā/ shu d+dha sa sdir+sha ṅgā tu dza ya dra/8 shrī la hi ma tra to de shakwa ti ta bā/ bishāXyi r+sha rī ra rgya swā ka lha sureshaprabha grwa ha tārā yi bān+taXbhaḥdag pa don dam dbyings su rgyal kun gyi//snang tshul so so'i tshad ma'i yul 'das kyang //sna tsho gos gzugs sku'i bkod pa dngas pa'i mtshor//gsal ba'i gza' skar bzhin du

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)mtha' rnyed bral/ /'og min zhing gtso'i mgon po longs spyod rdzogs/ /dam pa rta go dkar rnam par 'phrul pa'i gdangs/ /sgyu ma'i bu mo lha las mdzes pa'i mngal/ shar la don kun grub snyan mtshan du btags/ /rab rmongs mun smag mthon por brtsegs pa'i khrod/ /sgron me'i nang nas bzang po'i bskal pa 'dir/ /stong phrag rnam 'dren g.yin las snying stobs kyi/ khyad par byas pa bzhi pa'i thub pa mchog /lha gcig mtshan gyi dbyangs snyan rna ba sa /thos pas srid las thar ba mang byung na/ /mthong (42na thas 'khor 'das mtha' las rnam grol te/ /byang chub chen po'i sa de mi ring nye/ /gling 'dir ba po shes bgrang bya lon pa'i sku/ /tshad slebs rang las gzhan min zhal 'tshes pa/ /mi bskyod rdo rje 'gro kun bsod nams zhing / gyur kyang gangs can skye rgur gcig tu brtse/ /sems ldan 'khor mtsho'i mtha' las sgrol ba'i ma/ /tong khun sa yi tshangs pa'i sras mo yi/ /thugs dmar mo cher grags drig mo khang / /dpon cog rten gyi ga 'kha yas zhing gi phul/ /e ma ye shes sgyu ma'i pho brang la/ /theg gsum skye 'phags ngo mtshar 'byamasaklas par/ /nam mkha'i mdzod kyi sgo phye mchod pa'i sprin/ /byed pos rmugs 'dzin 'byor pa drangs pa bzhin/ /rten mchod bdog pa chom pos gzhan 'khyar dang / /glen lkugs rtsing po'i spyod pas chud gson sogs/ /brgya phrag nyes sel brjed ngas chu bo las/ /sgrol ba'i deb ther gru rdzings 'di na skyong/ /ces snyan pa'i lam nas ched du brjod pa sngon du btang ste 'o skol lnga brgya pa rnams kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam par gyur pa rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya seng ge zhes snyan pa'i gdugs dkar po gcig gis yangs pa'i sa chen po kun tu khyab pa gang de'i bstan pa rin po che rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas rim bzhin byang phyogs su dar bar lung bstan pa ltar/ ri kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir ches cher rmongs pa'i 'gro ba rnams thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas yang dag pa'i lam la bkri ba'i slad du sangs rgyas byang sems nyag cig gi sprul pa chos rgyal mes dbon rim par byon pa rnams kyi nang nas mi rje srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mor (42bskor rgyal po thang tha'i sun gyi sras mo rgya mo bza' kong co zhes 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rnam 'phrul de nyid byon nas rgyas btab ra mo che'i gtsug —52

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag yonalag khang legs par bskrun pa'i rten gyi gtso bor gser gyi lha shākya mu ba bzhugs pa bar skabs su rgya bod kyi g.yul 'khrug la brten go sa 'phos te rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad bal mo bza' khri btsun gyis gdan drangs pa jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje deng sang lus can kun gyi mig shes kyi spyod yul du mngon sum du bzhugs pa 'di nyid kyi gtsug lag khang khyams dang bcas par zhig gsos nang gi bzhugs khang / phyi'i gser tog ldebs bris sogs gsar du bskrun pa dkar chag tu gsal ba ltar yin cing dngos don rten mchod rnams chud mi 'dza' zhing zegs 'khyar mi yong ba'i ched du bag yod ces pa chu glang gi lo dbyug pa zla ba'i yar tshes dge bar deb ther du bkod pa la/ sa yi tshangs pa 'jam dbyangs gong ma che/ /nor rgyun ma dngos rgyal mo tha'i kho dang / /ri khi ching wang la sogasadabyig 'dzin gyi/ /dbang phyug dam pa'i drin gyis bskyangs pa'i mthus/ bstan la yongs rdzogs blo bzang sbyin pa yis/ /mang bkur rgyal khab pho brang pi cing du/ /gser sbyangs las grub stong phrag brgya pa dang / /dkon cog gsum gyi gas la bzhengs pas/ /mtshon te dus gsum bsags pa'i legasabyas gos/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'phel/ /gnam bskos rgyal po'i sku tshe mnga' thang rgyas/ /sbyin pa'i bdag po'i chos srid dar bar shog /(43na༄sa pa 'di ni dge slong blo bzang sbyin pas 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i rgyal khab tu gser las grub pa'i 'bum/ gzims khang ser po'i byang phyogs su gtsug lag khang rten brten pa bzhengs pa'i che brjod smon lam rdo rings la sbyor rgyu zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi brte ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar pa'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /mthong bas spro bskyed thos pas rnam grol ba'i/ /ngo mtshar bde ldan zhing gi bkod pa 'di/ /mtshon byed dmigs rten yid ngor sgyu dra'i gar/ /mang por goms shing smon lam sa bon rnams/ /dar ba'i legasabyas pa da dkar ze'u 'bru'i dbus/ /'di snang 'gags tsherang sems rdzus skyes te/ /'od dpag med mgon sras kyi thu bo zung / /'khor tshogs rgya mtsho mngon sum mthong bar shog /tshangs pa'i dbyangs las theg —53

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shechen chos kyi sgra/ /thos bsam sgom pas smin cing yongs grol nas/ /srid par 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba ma lus ba/ /sgrol ba'i ded dpon chen por bdag gyur shog /ces dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pasanyal sgom gyi dmigs rten bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bkras rab pa phun dbang ngo / /mgon khyod legs bsnyen sgrub cing mchod pa yis/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sras dang slob mar bcas/ /dkon cog yongs la bskur ba'i bsod nams 'bras/ /sbyin mdzad gsang 'dus gas 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs/ /mtha' klas zhi dang khro (43bsta'i yi dam lha/ /dkyil 'khor gcig tu kun tshang sgrub sdo brgyad/ mchog thun dngos grub 'dod dgu'i char chen gyis/ /'di phyi gtan mdun snye ma g.yur du za/ /de phyir nga rgyal brtan dang phra rags kyi/ /gsal snang 'don nus sgrub mchod dmigs pa'i gzhi/ /rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor shel tshon bzhin/ /rab bkras sgyu ma'i khengs pa bag la zha/ /'dis mtsho ni dge bas las bzhi grub pa brgyad/ /thun mong don kun thogs pa med grub cing / /rang rig dpal wo che mchog thod 'phrong rtsal/ /rang ngo 'phrod nas tshe 'dir grol bar shog /rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la gzhol khrims ldan gling / /thub bstan gnas pa de srid rab 'phel bar/ /srid gsum dbang mo la sogs lha tshogs kyis/ /g.yel ba med par 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ /ces pa 'di ni dge slong phun tsho gos rgya mtsho/ dge slong yon tan dpal bzang / 'jam dbyangs rgyal mtshan gsum gyis rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i dkon gnyer byed skabs zhal thang bco lnga'i tsan+dan gyi tog dang gong gsham zhig gsos/ mdzo sna a lung dang bcas pa/ ka pā li gnyis kyi nang sha dang kha gcod la dngul srang bco brgyad/ gtor slang gcig /lcags sder gsum/ ting chung gsum/ pad sder gnyis/ 'jon dmar gyi yas mgu mas mgu/ dkar rtsi/ dmar rtsi/ nag rtsi so so re bzhu ba'i zangasasnod kha gcod dang bcas pa/ kro le ma nyi shu la bzos pa'i me glang gcig /zangs gyi sgron skyogs bzhi/sgron skam gsum/ zangs rkyan gcig /li dang (44na skogs kyi me long legs pa gnyis/ rnga gdan —54

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mabacu/ zangs kyi phud phor stegs bcas/ gu gu shel gyi phud phor nang sha /lcags kong drug /rnam rgyal 'joms kyi bum gdan/ rnam rgyal ma'i stegs bu dang mdun cog gsum/ dung chen gyi shubs cha gcig dang rgya gling gi shubs cha gnyis bcas cha 'grig khros mdong cha/ spos gzhe dza gcig /sgo lcags dgu/rgyun rnga rnams kyi pags pa gsar brjes/ sgam dril tshas ja lung sogs nyer mkho mang du bzos shing rnying pa'i zhig gsos kyis mtsho ni pa'i 'jog las sna ba gzhan las dbangs mtho ba byas skabs bla ma gsang 'dus dang bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi dkyil thang bzhengs tshe rgyab yig gi smon lam dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun dbang ngo / /e ma 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po sto /zas gtsang sras su nyer bltams don kun grub/ /g.yasa'akhyil mgrin pa'i ri mo rnam grol las/ /tshangs dbyangs 'gro ba'i gsos sman bla na med/ /de'i nang gangs can 'gyur ba'i seng ge'i rgyud/ /mtha' klas 'gro la zab rgyas rtsi sman ljon/ /myangs pa tsam gyisasrid zhi'i nyes kun nad/ khrung byinas 'an 'di skal bzang yongs kyi dpyid/ /de phyir thub gsung glegasabam brgya phrag rnams/ /yig gzugs 'phags bod brda dag med byung ba/ /pusta gaḥ'aphreng nor bu'i do shal cher/ /sgo gsum 'bad dang 'dog pa gtong byed mkhan/ shar phyogs dang po brag phyi'i grong khyer nas/ /skye ba'i ming 'dzin ngag dbang bkra shis zhes/ /rab (4grub〉ums5des zhi gnas slob dbon tshe/ /nyang stod sum rtsen yul gru'i sa char bzhengs/ /rang don gnyer min rgyal sras slob mar bcas/ /bzhed skong bskal brgyar mi 'da'i gsol 'debs dang / /bstan 'gro'i bde skyid tshe bde'i pha mas mtsho ni/ /lus can kun don lhag pa'i bsams pas drangs/ /byed po nyid kyi sems bskyed ji bzhin 'bras/ /dus las yol med smin pa'i smon lam mtha'/ /btsan po lhun gyis grub par sangs rgyas dang / /byang sems nyan rang bcas pas deng byin rlobs/ /glegs bam 'di ko gang du bzhugs pa' sar/ /thub bstan spyi dang mnyam med btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs 'phel zhing rtsod pa'i gdung ba kun/ /rab zhi rdzogs ldan dga' ston rgyas par shog /gzhung lugs mang por brgyal brtag smra ba'i ngag /dbang phyug —55

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)grub blo rnam bkra'i sbyin pa'i bdag/skye bar lha mi'i rten gyi shis pa'i lam//rim brgyud myur du stobasabs rtsal rgyas shog/rnam 'dren gsang gsum yon to mthong ba'i mod//rnam dag dang bas sri zhung bgyid pa'i dngos//rnam mang nam mkha' mdzod 'byed mos blo'i mthus//rnam mkhyen mchod sbyin 'gro kun la gtong shog/ces nyang kha brag phyi sku skye rab stims smra ba ngag dbang bkra shis nyang stod dpal 'khor bde chen gyi zhi gnas slon dpon gyi khur len skabs rnying ma rgyud 'bum gtso bsdus po ti gsum dang phyis 'gyur rgyud 'bum yongs rdzogs dang /de phyin gangs can 'gyur ro cog gi bka' 'gyur bzhengasapa'i smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas lkog pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/sdob sbyor mnya pa' brit+ta las metog phreng can/ya thog lha t+palā bh+yadhe bā ni tu swa〉rga4yuk+ta miXde te rtepa do/nimiti lha dra tsakra su ha mā du rma hā sto gyi lhunu kā sha ཾ kus 45na skong la bsod nams byas 'bras mngon mtho dang /nges legs sar sbyor nyi ma'i gnyen khyod zhabs//mtshan bzang 'khor lo'i ri mos bdag sogs 'gro'i//byang chen bar du gtsug na rjes gsal mdzod//sangs rgyas dngos kyi zhal skyin jo bo shākya mu ni'i bzhugs khang rgyab yol dang bcas pa sman bla bla brgyud lha tshogs/rgya phibs gdan khri gser dngul zangs las grub pa phra rgyan bcas par zhal 'debs pa the ba'i gser zho nyis stong dgu brgya so gnyis se ba brgya bdun/dngul srang bdun stong lhas brgya lnga bcu nga dgu zho do skar byed drug/dngul chu srang chig stong bzhi brgya don bdun/zangs bzo ma mkhar rgya'i 'degs khal tshig brgya dang nyi shu rtsa dgu lhag lnga spor do/ bsha' dkar nyag lnga/ti tsha 'degs khal bzhi nyag bcu gcig /45ba〉sdur ram 'degs khal gcig/spos dkar 'degs khal nyi shu tham pa nyag gang /dza ti ra tshon pa/gser pad che 'bring chung gsum bco lnga/g.yu pad chung ba bcu gcig gser ga gsum/gser spyi g.yu phra yod pa gcig/yum bdag med ma'i dbu g.yus gtsos gtsug g.yu sna tshogs bcu gsum/g.yu rdog che ba bdun/'bring gra bcu gcig/chung ba nyer gcig/g.yu ljang gcig/g.yu phra rta sonas 'dra gzugs

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang ren po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag slonabasdoms pa tshig brgya re bdun/ byu ru che chung sna tsho gos chig stong nyis brgya bco lnga/ spos shel gyi rdo rje 'cha gtso 'khor gsum/ kha che spos shel che nges drug /rdog kham rlon nas sran ma'i bar yod pa nga gcig /rkos yod med sna tshogasang gsum/ spos shel gyi phor pa bzhi/ hor shel rkos yod med che chung bdun/ tha na mu tig che chung bcu drug /rgya mu tig bya sgong dang mtheb mgo tsam gyis gtsos pa'i che chung bsdoms pa chig stong lnga brgya dgu bcu go lnga/ mu tig a ma che chung phyed bcu bzhi/ ma na ho dang g.yang ṭi'u bsdoms pa'i phu gu sna tsho gis nyis brgya lnga bcu nga bdun/ hril mo che chung bsdoms pa bdun brgya nga bdun/ a lung bco lnga/ g.yang ṭi'i 'phan mgo gser gyi nyag thag ma gcig /mu men bcu gsum/mchod hril che chung gya gnyis/ glang mche gzugs gcig /nar mo bdun/ be+eḍūrla ser po gsum/ pad rā ga /su ga rnyi/ nal/ ke ke sa bzhu shel/ bskyur shel sogs sna tshogs bsdoms pa tshig stong nyis brgya gya dgu/ shel hril che chung nyis brgya nyer bdun/ rdo ljang gnyis/ gser ljang brdungs kyi ga'u dra hril/'phan ma go /phu gu/ bab gzugs/ skra rgyan/ me tog /lce le rnams kyi thog rin po che sna tsho gis kyi phra rgyan (46na〉pa chig brgya nyer gnyis/ mu tig chung bsgrigs kyi dra hril gcig /gser gyi a lung brgyad/ga'u g.yu phra ma gcig rnams kyis spras pa legs par grub pa'i khur bzhes sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis mdzad/ 'go lung la stag lung phyag mdzod dbu ma blo bzang ngag dbang / ngag dbang dpal 'bror/ ka brgyad nor bu/ lha sbug pa blo bzang shes rab/ shing bzo'i do dam pa sge logs a dar/ bris pa lhun po/ bal po'i dbu mdzad sirnyi/ a mar sidhi/ bkra shis mgon po/ dha na shrī/ zangs bzo dbu mdzad rnam sras/ dngos grub/ shing bzo dbu mdzad gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs dang rtse kha chos skyong /bal po dha na mu ni/ dha na/ su tsa/ dharma de ba/ la ṇa tsan+d+ra/ da na mu ni/ ḍā gi ta/ dza shrī di ba/ su tra ka la/ dha na da ba/ d+dha na shrī/ da na mu ni/ la ṇa de ba/ dha na de ba/ pad+ma nos/ shākya mu ni/ la ṇa de ba/ ma hā mu ni/yis shrī/ dze sa tsaṇ+ḍa/ la ṇa tsaṇ+ḍa shākya mu ni dze sa tsaṇ+ḍa/ bha lo/ glang bu de ba/ dze sa dha na/ sarba kre/ bkra shis nor bu/ dha na pa ni/ ma ni la/ dha na shrī/ ga na pa ti/ nor bu tshe ring/ sto de ba/ gu ṇa tsan+da/ mu ni/—57

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)la na mu ni/ la gri/ shākya mu ni/ de ba dza ti/ tsaṇ+ḍa la/ tshe ring / sa ma tra ba ḍa/ mgon po dha na/ mu ni/ dze sa de ba/ la ṇa/ zangs bzo pa gu sa nor bu/ tshe ring dpal rgyas/ dpal 'byor/ tshe dbang / rdo rje/ngag dbang / nor bu/ dar rgyas/ mgon po/ sha lung dar rgyas/ bon skyabs/ dar rgyas/ tog gzungs/sman bla'i 'dra dpe 'dri mi gzhig/shar a gur/ ngag dbang 'phrin las/ 'phrin las rnam rgyal/ rgya bod kyi yig ris pa rgyal rtse 'jam dbyangs dbang po dang ngag dbang phun tshogs (46ba'i gos cha sprod mi bsam grub rgyal po rnams kyis bgyis te bag yod ces pa chu glang hor zla dang po'i tshes bco brgyad la dbu btsugs zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyer lda la grub pa dza ( / /lhag bsam me long ngos su legs byas gzugs/ /yongs shar yang srid rim brgyud mi gnas pa'i/ /myang 'das thob par phan bde'i ltad mo la/ /yengs pa'i ngo mtshar snying la sim par shog /yid srubs 'dab ldan snying zhugs dbang zhu'i rjes/ /nyer btang bsod nams rdul brtsegs lhun po'i ngos/ /bstan 'gro'i bde skyid nyi zla dkon cog mthus/ /zung 'brel rtag la4 'dod pa'i don 'grub shog /mthas klas dge gos 'bad rtsol bral ba'i stan/ /rang nyid tsam min mkha' mnyam ma rgan gyis/ bting nas sim pa'i tshor ba rtag myong ba'i/ /gro bzhi skyes kyi rnam thar 'dzin par shog /ces za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /su sti pra dza saḥ thugs rje chen po rang byon lnga ldan gyi dbu thog tu gser zangs las grub pa'i bla bre/ dbus su rgyal po bka' 'bum lugs/ g.yas su 'gro ba kun sgrol/ g.yon du 'khor ba dbyingasasgrol gyi dkyil 'khor phul brdungs su bzhedas pa'i sku rgyu la gser zho bdun brgya/ zangs bzo ma 'degasakhal drug bstonyag gsum/ bsha' dkar nyag gsum/ ti tsha kha' sna gcig nyag gsum/ spos dkar khal bcu/ bu ram nyag bcu/ zangs tshal dngul srang gsum dang zho lnga/ 'then 'dzin lcags thag/ lcagasagazer/ lcags shan bcas par kro le ma drug rnams las legs par grub (47na)pa khur bzhes do dam bzo rigs thams cad jo bo rin po che'i bzhugs khang dang gcig cing dkyil 'khor kyi rim zur —58

sku gsung thugasarten gsar 4khosadang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga (megyi sngags 'chang gzhis ka shar a gur gyi bgyis pa la ghiḥ/khyod zhal mes sngon nag phyogs bskrad bzhin ding //glagasabalta sdebacasaming tsam rjesashul du//byasate thub bstan nyi ma 'od po ches//gangs can bde skyid snang ba rtag 'bar shog/blo /rga goltor 4〉kha' brat+ta 477 4nga ༅/ tsisnagot+tadapasaupukadrigāṇadumagyodayanarbikalhadaphuhimahāXpa)philam̐gasatshwayashitedzagāshāmar+sālika/thugs bskyed sa bon yongs su smin pa las//tshogs gnyis sdong po dar drag dpag bsam rgyur bsngos pas//cher 'phel thub gsung ri mo gang gis bsrub//de phyir rab snyigs skal ga gser can srog/48natat+thakalpaphyadudh+wakarābabaṇak+ṣarmyuspyobyutsukhibhadaphile/shāwasaraskusanatshurbasa3nogagargyupraljardogatu/dgoba'i migasngon sder mosaphralaba'i 'bras//brgya pa'i tshe yun rdzogs ldan rtse dga' la//mkha' mnyam skye rgu kun gyis spyod par shog/'gro rnams sangs rgyas blta zhing chos wa pa'i//legs byas zad pa med pa 48bgwamanābud+dhapashutātīdharmagagrotataspudhakar+sā'iyāmuk+kikaḥlātakābarabastakrametānubitswayuban+tabatat+pabyanāpash+yatu/mu thi li'i//'khri shing mar mtshungs sgrib gos rim srab nas//rnam mkhyen lang tsho'i lus de rjen mthong shog/su sti sirnyi/bag yod ces pa chu glang zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyer lnga la las 'go btsugs kun dga' zhes pa shing stag zla ba drug pa'i nang du legs par grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal zhing khams rgya mtsho lha mo'i 'dod yon g.yas 'khyil gang 'di'i sku rgyu la gser btso ma zho drug brgya dang gsum se ba bcu bzhi/dngul srang sum stong brgyad brgya gya gnyis zho gang skar brgyad/dngul chu srang bzhi brgya gya gsum zho dgu skar lnga/zangs smar 'degs khal chig brgya bcu gsum nyag bcu bdun spor do/zha nye 'degs 9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)khal gcig /phra rgyan la dngul tsha gser gyi phu gu nga/zod dbyebs sa tshogs che chung 'dres pa nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang zangs tsha gser (49na tshe phu gu gnyis/ su gan+ti rdeg gcig /rgya nag pad rwag rdog che chung drug cu re bzhi/ dza ta ru pa rdog gnyis/ in+d+ra nī la rgya sran las 'u nga tsam gnyis/ bzhu shel tshos kha sna tsho gis rdog che chung bdun brgya dang dgu /bshags pa gsum/ bum gzugs gsum/ g.yu ljang brag gzugs dpangs sor phyed gsum gser gar blugs kyi ljon shing rgya bzo ba nyis la smyor gceg /gtsug g.yu che chung drug /g.yu che chung 'dres pa'i phra rgyan drug brgya dang zhe gcig /mu tig che chung bsdoms pa brgyad brgya so brgyad/ be+eḍūr+ya rdog gcig /byu ru che chung bsdoms pa bzhi brgya dang bcu gnyis/ byu ru nar mo ring thung bzo dbyibs sna tshogs nyi shu rtsa bdun dang rgyal lag che chung bzhi/ mu men ril mo gnyisadang nas 'dra so gsum/ spos shel nar mo ring thung bcu drug /zur gsum gcig /spos shel che co 'dres pa tshig brgya go bdun/ nas rdog po che chung 'dres pa brgya dang gsum/ che tsam nar gzugs sa cig mchong dmar nas 'dra gzugs gnyis/ gzi hril bzhi/ ma na ho mgron gzugs gcig zhal hril re chung bsdoms pa rdo gso drug khyed pa gsum/ mgron gzugs gcig /nar mo brgyad bshogs gcig /ra shel shing 'bras gzugs gcig /mching bu pu shel kham tshig tsam gsum/ 2la tsha li rngos gcig skyur shel kham tshig tsam bzhi brgya dang bstodagu /dngul gyi a lung nang bab le sum sgrom gnyis/ shel sgo'i mthong bcu gnyis rnams legs par grub pa sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis thugs khur bzhes te 'go lung pa stag lung phyag mdzod blo bzang ngag (49brko bang / 'dar gzhon ngag dbang 'phrin las/'jam dbyangs dpal 'byor/ bka' brgyad nor bu/ lha sbugs pa blo bzang shes rab/ ri mo ba gting skyes tshe dbang lhun po/ bal po dbu mdzad a mar sidha/ bkra shis mgon po/ bha na shrī zangs bzo ba dbu mdzad rnam sras lhas byin/ dngos grub/ byings gras bal po dha na shrī/ dha rma de ba/ dha na mu ni/ dha na/dzñā na 5ni/ na kyi ta/ lan de ba/ su ta kur/ dza shing de ba/ mahā 5ni/ su tsa shrī/ de ba tsaṇ+ḍa/ e du shrī/dze sa tsaṇ+ḍa/ shākya mu ni/ pra ma na rgya/ shākya mu ni/ dzñā na mu ni/ dha na de ba/ la na de ba/ la na tsan+d+ra/ dha lo/—60

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag 9'ilo bu dha la/dze dha na/kyi na de ba/sarba dharma/bkra shis nor bu/dha na pa ṇi/ma ṇi tsha/dha na shrī/ga na pa ti/nor bu tshe ring /dharma de ba/gu na tsan+d+ra/mu ni/la na mu ni/de ba la tre/shākya mu ni/de ba dza ti/tsa spro la/tshe ring /saṃ gha bha dra/mu ni/mgon po dha na/dze de ba/la na tsan+d+ra/zangs bzo pa byings gras gu mānor bu bzang po/tshe ring dpal rgyas/dar rgyas tshe ring /sha lung tshe ring dar rgyas/tshe dbang dar rgyas/ngag dbang dpal lor/bsod nams dpal 'byor/rdo rje drag po/bon skyabs tshe ring /dar rgyas tshe ring /nor bu tshe brtan/mgon po tog gzungs/shing bzo ba'i do dam lha khang sgo log dar/dbu mdzad lam rnyed/gnas gsar 'jam dbyangs/shing bzo pa byings gras ser gnyis dga'/tsher gseb dbang phyug sogs dang /rgya bod kyi yig ris pa rgyal rtse 'jam dbyangs dbang po/phogs sogs dgosacha sprod mi byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos bgyis pa dza ga su bha ban+tu//50na blo ka gnyis sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i brit+ta las zlum po/nom la su tsit+ta kā sngas yab yab di ta sgo rī ra bikrabod su hi ta nut+ta ra kya bodhikā di tā ma ge khu pru ti lo tsan bha ba bla bā sa no ba ro tsartsi mā ra tsākra ha tri ge btsakra tsā ga nirluni ji pā da nā kha myurta shobha/dri bral thugs kyi man shel dngas par ji lta ji snyed shes bya'i gzugs//rjen par 'char ba'i bla med byang lho gzod ma nyid nas 'og min du//mngon du gyur kyang rdo rje'i gdan steng bdud bzhi'i dpung tsho gos bcom tshul gyis//rim gsum 'khor los mchog dman 'gro 'dren thub dbang zhabs sen gtsug na mdzes//50ba / lha nu dzā ra dzā ya pā ra ṣ+ṭha ni rnadis grwa pa ka rda ma tra na sti hi na tan46ge ta kā:bat+ta kār//o ṣa dhe nas lta1gi sum kirti tsā na la sbul su pa r+ṣa meghanā n+da tsā k+ṣa pāk+ṣi kerma ba lha ka dzña btsuko ma yur/cher snyigs rdul gyis rgyal gzhan byin rlabs chu klung nyer stogs tshe//ma smad thugs rje ke ta ka yis lhag par bsrungasamadzad pa/sman bla mched bdun snyan pa'i grags 'bar sdug po'i char sprin la//dga' spro'i mig gtod sgro gshog mi bsgyur shes ldan rma bya su//ldan 'di na blo na bzhi sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i:ta laXste togo 'phreng can/༄dra biṅgā di rta rbu lus lu:rkaX: ye'

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shen+ta kā mā ni rjes pru ta no sgyu yabs du gas rnyi ba:r+shar tsun pa rnyi lcatā/'bad brtson rta ljang shugs kyis grangs med bskal//gsum yun mkha' mtha' 'jal la zhus sa sems cha//rab phra nyi ma'i gnyen rjes 'gro blo'i mdog/ston zla lta bus bsod nams byas pa yis//5ba ) ār+sha sirnya su ni mā ga mi ho'i de te khri tiṣ+ṭha su tsakra su lha ki rtetaḥdharma bha ba nyudzā te bo ya ti〉mahā|:garnya'ide sgo da ya/don kun grub pa'i ring lugs yin no cog/khyad par bstan pa'i 'khor lo btsong kha pa'i//chos srid dzā ti'i dri bsung 'thul ba nas//za 'og 'thag pa'i yul bar dar bar shog/52na sgo aṅgā ma tso dhe kā sa twasno tu la bha:be+e deb36kaḥsan+ta tos lta sī sa rta gu ṇi stor ta lha ma tobhag bha dre bha ba//3 gzung dang bral ma rgan lus can kun//nges legs ma thob de srid lha mi'i rten//rgyud mar mtho ris bdun gyi yon to la//spyod pa'i dpal ldan skal pa bzang por shog/52bsgo nu)tā bha ba/ku dzā snobatsan pi ji pad+ma ma da lnga ta tha ya pha lus kā2ma hā bodhi nodiḥlha tā tsa tar+sātānā pa kāḥgayin phan gyur na rang nyid dmyal me mā/bsregs kyang ji mi snyam pa'i lhag bsam gyis/dge 'bras skye rgu mtha' dag byang wo du/ring por mi 'thogs 'gyur ba de rgyur bsngo//zhes gdan sa53na ye ri po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal pa'i gling du dgram rgyur 'gro ba'i bla ma shākya seng ge la rgyal ba btsong kha pa/'jam dbyangs dkon cog chos 'phel/sman bla bder gshegs bdun/klu dbang gi rgyal po/tshe dpag med/sgrol dkar/las gshin/gang la rnams kyis bskor ba'i gos sku bzhengasapar zhal 'debs bstan 'dzin da la'i rgyal pos gos yug ser po gcig/klu 'bum chos rjes gos yug ljang gu gcig dang kha thi gcig byung zhing khur bzhes phyag mdzod sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobos kyisamadzad/do dmo tre bo dar kha dka ༅/bkras sgo pa das tso/lcang shar ba lha dbang /ri mo ba dbu mdzad pho brang phun tshogs/byings gras legs pa rgyal mtshan/dge bsnyen/blo bzang /gos bzo ba dbu mdzad pa rnam brtan pa/ra phyi shag skyon/nor khyung tshe brtan/gong 'go sgos ldan/dbu wo rgyal rtse pad+ma tsha ring /gzhis rtse dar rgyas ba po shis/ang dang gras chos dbang /bstan 'dzin/dpal

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (ma'abyor/dpal brtan/tshe dgos sum legs/nor skyong /byings gras dge bsnyen sogs mi grangs nyi shu rtsa brgyad/rgya bod kyi yig ris pa rgyal rtse 'jam dbyangs dbang po/phogs dang ja mar sprod mi byang gling bsam grub rgyal po dang tshogs rgyal gling pa tshe 'dzin rnams kyis byas te 'phags yul du ā nan+da zhes pa phyogs 'dir kun dgar grags shing rgya nag tu gyi lin zhes pa ljongs 'dir shing stag tu 'bod pa'i dbyar gyi dus ston la babs tshe legs par grub kyi bsngo smon gyi tshigs bcad 'dir yang za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong 53brgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang pos bgyisapa sarba dza yan+tu//'chi med zil dngar dwangs ma'i bcud rnams kun//skye 'gro snying gi dpal ber 'dren mdzad pa//bde ba ro zhing mgon po gar gyi dbang//dkyus ring spyan gyis rtag tu btsa' bar mdzod//'chor ba'i khro bo gnam lcags 'bar ba'i dpal//lhungs pa'i mod la rgyal bgo dmo rdzi so gos//'byung po'i brag ri phyer btags dkar po'i phyogs//rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon bsgreng de bsngags//don yod he ruka dpalamagru stobs rtsal//dar nag ber chen khros pa laṅka'i bdag/bdud bzhi'i gnyen por rkarma gu ru'i gar//yang gsang drag por gyur des log 'dren choms/na tu zhi ba'i 'jam dbyangs kun tu bzang /khregasapa'i dpung 'joms byed la rnam par 'phrul//gtus drag gshin rje'i gshed pos dag bgegs kyi//snying dron khrag gi rgya mtsho hub kyis drongs//pad+mā kā ra lo chen snang mdzad kyis//thugs bcud shel gyi brag la rgyas btab pa//chos rgyal gter bdag gling pas gdan drangs pa'i//dus babs las bzhi'i rten 'brel lhun grub shog/ces rgya chen kyi tshe dpag med/rdo rje gro bo lod//yang gsang drag po dang gter gsar gshin rje 'joms byed bzhi'i mngon par rtogs pa dang mthun par gter ston rigs 'dzin chen pos zhal bkod gnang zhing dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang blo bzang rig rgyam spun 54na ) gyis yon sbyar te chog gra so so'i sgrub brten du zhal thang so sor snyan dar lnga re/tsaka li nyer lnga/bum ba'i mgul chings/gtor gdugs daX bcas pa cha 'grig phul ba'i tshe rgyab yig dgos

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge ba ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o//sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis khur bzhes mdzad nas lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i bzo bkod rgya cher bsgrun pa'i bdog pa'i de bzer rgyugs yon bang mdzod//ris med kun la dus drug gzigs pa'i spyan//nam yang mi bsnyel rnam 'dren nyi ma'i gnyen//legs gsungs lung rtogs bstan dang de 'dzin sde//slu med rin cen gsum gyis shis par mdzod//'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i brtan g.yo'i dngos//ma lus bsdus nas phun tsho gos 'dod dgu'i char//kun bzod yangs pa'i khyon labs mdzad pa//rmugs 'dzin dbang po'i longs spyod gcig tu 'khyil//rten gsum gtsug lag khang bzang rgya phibs dang //rin cen dar zab la sogs bzo yi rigs//mchod sbyin sgo phye bdog pa rim song ba'i//gsal byed yi ge'i 'phreng ba 'di na spel//zhes brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas 'phrul snang dang ra mo che gnyis kyis gtsos gtsug lag khang du mar zhig gsos gser tog/g.yin yang sku gsung thugs rten rin po dang gos dar las grub pa'i bzo'i rigs/dge 'dun mchod cing skye bor sbyin gtong sogs rim song la54bsdeb sbyor mnya pa' brit+ta las me rta ge phreng ༅/ ga ma ni ā nyis rbe khu sgo so stuto mi thob rje tri lon ka'adi pa kaḥte pād tsakra su ge stsa༅lhun bi khro pa rlud yi rta lha shekus 'gro ba kun lam 'dris mdza' ba'i gnyen//'jig rten gsum gyi sgron me gcig pu pa/shwakya seng ge khyod zhabs 'khor lo yi/ri mo gtsug mtshor yongasashar deng shis mdzod//brling zab bka' 'grel shing rta che gnyis sogs//'phags yul paṇa grub gsung rab chu shel dbang //ljongs 'di'i mkhar 'dren 'jig rten mig gcig rlung //phan bde'i kun+da ba 'ad pa'i cho ga mkhan//bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog grags glegs bam 'phreng //dkar chag srad bur rgyu ba chos kyi spyan//rab gsal gnas lnga rig pa bu ston rje//nges par thams cad mkhyen la som nyi bral//de phyir thub gsung rnam 'brel pu sta ga:rdzogs par 'dri ba'i lhag bsam mtho risachab/snying stobs hub 55na kyis 'dren nus dzaḥ//rang min gnyis pa'i grogs mang sngon byung gtam//rgyal kun spyi gzugs rje btsun dben sa pa'i//da// rigs phun tshogs rab tu brtan pa zhes//dge

sku gsung thugs rten gsar ban pa ma dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mtshogs rgya cher bskrun pa'i rnam dpyod la//changs pas bsgrun min cha yig zol gyis brdzu//ston zla ltar dkar shog bu'i ā dar+shaḥ/stang zil yig gzugs rnam sgyur g.yo ba'i gar//brda dag rgyan gyis spud la shes ldan rnams//mtshar 'dzin gzigs mo'i tshad lagacig tu che//gangs dkar rtse nas 'phrog byed sder chags kun//zil gyis gnon pa'i nga ro'i skad gsang yang /ga snyi ka yis nags su lhod yangasapor/khyu ba'i glang chen sa srungs de ༅ byung //dbang sngon kha dog dwangs par rjes 'gro'i 'bangs//rang skad snyan pos rna bar rtsub pa'i tsher//sgrib ṭas rang bzhin bzang po'i sa le sbram//'od mdangs mtshan mthar 'byol ding skya rengs 'dren//byang chen rgyur bsngo'i rtsi yis legs byas lcags//nam yang 'dzad mi nus pa'i gser sbyangs su//bsgyur ba'i ngang tshul de 'a mtha' gcig tu//blo gros mig dkyus ring rnams 'bad pas 'jug kho de 'di snang bde ba slob/ gi 'od//phyi mar 'khor los sgyur yang chu shing 'dra//'khor mtshor 'gro kun sgrol nus rnam mkhyen gzings//gzhan du gtan mdun yang rtser dmigs su med//lung dang rig pa'i drang srong ā ga sduḥrdul bral sems kyi mkha' la shar ba'i tshe//chos brgyad dug rnams phyung ba'i sman gyi chu//srid zhi'i nad brgya'i zug rngu dus gcig gzhil//de don rtogs pas55ba〉rgyud bskul dge 'dis mtsho ni//sngon nas bsags so cog gi bsod nams 'bras//nam mkha'i pha mtha' rnyed min ma rgan don//bsngo bar sems kyi 'char sgo ches cher spro//thub bstan snying po kun mkhyen btsong kha pa'i//ma smad bstan pa gser gyi sgong nga'i dbyibs//'dzam gling skye rgu'i dad gdung drod gsher gyis//yongs smin mes po'i mched zla gnyis par shos/bkra shis lha tshogs bdun gyi bang rim can//thos bsam rdul brtsegs lhun po 'dus pa'i sde//gling bzhi'i mun pa nyi zla'i 'od zer gyis//gsal ba de srid dar zhing rgyas par shog/bgrang yas blo gros ldan pa'i gdul bya'i mgon//mkhas btsun bzang por ye nas lhun grub pas//'gro khams shes pa'i ma smad sgyu dra'i gar//g.yung drung lta bur na mo yang g.yo med shog/dam pa'i rim gro sgrub la kun dga' bo//gnyis pa'i grib mar bltos pa min pa'i grogs//phun tsho gos rab tu brtan pa'i ༷di dang phyi'i//gtan gyi mdun ma lhun rgyas grub par

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geshog /'gro rgyud nyon mongs shes bya'i dri ma kun/ /'khrud nus dge tshogs gaṅgā bsgrengs pa'i rtser/ /byang chub mchog rgyur bsngo ba'i khyab 'jug rkang / /tog gis 'jig rten gsum po mdzes gyur cig /ces phyag mdzod phun tshogs rab brtan gyis khur blangs te chos sde chen po bkra shis lhun por bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gsar du bzhengs pa'i tshe che brjod smon lam gyi tshigs su bcad pa zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi rigs las sdom brtson sde snod gsum pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ (56na〉sre1nga rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang pos bgyis pas sa spru dwa shri ya bha bstu/ /phyag mdzod phun tsho gos rab brtan gyis bkra shis lhun por sangs rgyas stong sku bzhengs pa'i deb kyi 'go brjod rnam 'dren 'phreng mdzes/ 'chi med rnams kyis bzang po'i bskal pa bzhes/ /bsngags ltar rnam 'dren stong gi mu tig 'phreng / /lus can bsod nams srad bur legs brgyus pa/ /'di ko grags pa don dang ldan pa'i gtam/ /rdo rjes mtshani pa'i mi 'gyur stan bzang por/ mi shigs skyil krung gcig gis yid srubs sde/ /rab bcoms mchog gi sprul sku mthong thos dang / /dran 'di sngon bsags chos dkar bye bas myos/ /de phyir stong phrag bde bar gshegs pa'i sku/ /'jon dmar dzasbu'i gser chus legs byugs pa'i/ /snang brnyan tshar du dngar ba'i ga smyo la'i/ /deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu 'di len/ /ces shis pa brjod pa sngon du btang ste/ brgya phrag thub gsum glegs bam rin cen dpya/ /rnam dpyod shing rtas su la'i sman ljongs su/ /'dren mdzad rgyal blon lo paṇa drin 'jal nor/ /snod du tshangs pas 'jig rten khams bskrun chungs/ /'bri bklag kun chub rim gro lung nod zla/ /cha gad bsod nams dkyil 'khor rang gi mched/ /ra ri'i dri ma las gzhan rnyed min pa'i/ /skal bzang dpyid kyi lang tsho ngom de mtshar/ /'jam dbyangs thu mi'i bzhed gzhud brda dag gzugs/ /'khrul med gtsug lag blo yangs sor mo'i gar/ khog bu'i dor ra sgyur tsha (56ba〉sgyu ma mkhan/
