/bsnyems pa'i ngal ba btang nas bag la zha/ /'gro rgyud mig sngon bgrod pa'i dri bkru bar/ /rgyal gsung mtho ris chu gos lhab lhub rtser/ /phan bde'i —66

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha 6mitog gis sbud pas yid grubs sems//zhi dang lhan cig dkar phyogs lha rnams bsngags//legs byas 'dzad pa med pa'i stan bzang bor//mkha' mnyam lus can rtag tu longs spyod rgyur//bsngo ba'i 'bras bu gro bzhin skyes kyi tshul//'dzin pa'i smon pa yid bzhin 'grub par shog zhes pa'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di ni 'brog bsam sdings sprul skus bka' 'gyur bzhengs pa'i tshe che brjod smon lam dgos tshul gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyis bsdos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o//dus kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus//mig sman brtsegs pa'i lhun po ltar brjid sku//mthong ba'i mod la khro tsho gis stabs gcig tu//lag cha mchor mdzad gshin rje gshed khyod bsngags//chos dbyings bde ba che las g.yo med par//log 'dren 'dul phyir gtum chen srin po'i gzugs//legs ldan nag po rten 'dir nyer spyon la//thub pa'i bstan pa yun du bsrung bar mdzod//ces pa 'di'ang rta ra mdo pa ngag dbang lhun grub kyis thang rka'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar/〉spur mi skaba'i chu las ye kho phreng tso/gtamā so khyaka lhag ṇi so:hā tha lha tārti bla ṅgā ni dha ro:t+na rī gu bo bā spyik+tam n+ma thal bak+ta kya ni tshus mā na da yi r+sha kya sidhañdza lda/ 57na〉'gro byed grangs med bskal par tshogs bsags dbang //lus phyed nor 'dzin las thon sa'i lha mos//gsong por brjod tshe yid srubs gdong smad pa//mnyam par brtse ldan zas gtsang sras po rgyal//'jigs med stong chen seng ge'i rgyud kyi sgras//rtag chad ri dwags sngangs byed zab mo'i gtam//phyogs sgyur brgyad brgya'i grangs can gle ka/'khor lo bar pa'i yang snying bsdus pa'i bka'//sngo bsangs sgeg mo'i bzhin mdangs phyungs pa'i ngos/gser zhun yi ge rnam bkra'i mig gi dkyus//srid pa'i pha rol brgal nas myang 'das grong //mtha' rnyed gzigs phyir ring por brkyangs pa 'dra//phyi dar bstan pa'i 'byung khungs zha lu zhes//nyang smad 'dzin mar gser gyi me tog gis//yongs bkang ltar 57ba ) mdzes sde snod gsum pa'i 'phreng //chad med blo gsal bgrang yas 'du ba'i gling /khyad par shes bya'i khyon la srid do cog/gzags pas

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shethams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rje/khyod las mkhas pa dbus 'gyur 'chang nas kyang //rnyed par dka' na phyogs 'dir 'gran nus su//zhabs rdul 'jigs med khrir lhung gdan sa'i 'phreng //nyer gcig grangs su rang bstan 'byul med pa//'dzin las yid bzhin nor bu rin cen ltar//skal ldan gdul bya'i bsod nams mchog tu grub//rab 'byams rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i thar son mkhas//nyes lhung phra mos ma gos bag yod btsun//bdag gzhan mnyam par rje ba'i sems kyi bzang //bshes gnyen dam pa'i mtshan nyid kun tshang snyam//de phyir dkyil 'khor bye ba'i rigs kyi gtso/khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo mā/gdengs tshad nges pa rnyed nas mi 'phrog pa'i//mos gus lam zab rnal 'byor mchog la spro//chos brgyad gdon snying zhugs pa'i bun long gis//srid par kun 'khor dge dang mtshungs min pa//thugs bskyed ga bur gzegs mas mkha' mnyam 'gro'i//sdug bsngal tsha gdung sel ba'i cho ga mkhan//thub pa'i ring lugs de 'dzin bshes dang sde//yongs dar ma la ya klung gisakhyab pa'i//'jig rten gsum gyi lus can stong dum kun//phan bde'i tsas ljon par gnas 'gyur shog/ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa rin cen grub/khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po tshar pa rje'i/zab cho sem dros mtsho chen g.yas 'khyil las//bshad sgrub rnam bzhi'i chu bo rtag 5ni〉yab shog/mi bdag tsho gos kyang rang dbang mnga' ris kyis//chog shes yib rtsod dang bral 'bangs rnams kun//ring po'i tshe dang 'byor pa rjogs ldan gyi//bskal bzang lnga brgya'i dus 'dir ma' sum shog khyad par 'dren pa mchog 'di 'chi med tsher//dbang phyug lhun gyis grub pas rin chen khrir//chos 'khor bskor phyir nges pa lnga ldan ltar//nam yang g.yo ba med par rab brtan shog/glegs bam ched du ngal ba bsten pa rnams//'di phyir lha mi'i bde 'bras la spyod cing //ring min theg pa chen por sems bskyed nas//bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa brnyed shog/bsams pa'i don kun kun nas 'bad med du//lhun grub dge legs legs tshogs ches mang ra bas//dus rnams bkra shis shis pa'i man+da ras/khams gsum ma lus lus pa med 6༷ba shog/ces dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' ngur

sku gsung thugasarten gsar 4khosadang rin po che'i mchod rdza khang bzang gi dkar sa khu'ismig gar gyi rnam par rol ba zhwa lu mkhan po rin cen bsod nams mchog grub bam tshe dbang lhun grub rab brtan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos 'o skol gyi ston pa 'jig rten gsum gyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes rnam 'dren zas gtsang gi sras po'i gsung rab kun gyi phul du gyur pa 'phags pa shes rab gyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa'i glegasabam gser gyisabazheng ba gnang skabs dkar chag dang 'brel ba'i smon lam zhig rtsoms zhes bkas bskul bar brten za hor gyi ban+des sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkrasarab pa phun tshogasadabang pos bgyis pa dza yan+tu/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing stag lor mdzad pa'i ser 'bras sogs kyi rten mchod rnams kyi deb ther 'go brjod sogs/dpalaldan wasaspungasakyirten mararnamasakyidebather 'go brjod sna tshogasametog sapo/58bsdosasbyor mnyamapa'i bṛt+ta la mertagagayo ba'i mu shing /skobārākwa biṣaṇagagategomahwamudrarkachabartadzñotsakreparisudaya.eṅgātubishāsurwatsa/samyeyogwader+sāgatamulirkanadagwamostotshi69r+sāgasgokasurutsiram̐lha'isekikaraḥrnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje phyag rgya che//waṃ yig kā la tsa dar yongs shar a dbyings sna tshogasalha mo dang //mnyam sbyor dang po'i sangasargyasartsargyud nā da'iglur 'bab mardzorten gyis//rab mdzesadapal ldan 'bras spungasaganyisapa bod yul bstan pa'i khungs gcig pu/shwakya seng ge'i mgrin pa'i rgyud kyi sgra//chos kyi nga ros log smra'i ri dwags snying //lkog mar 'byin gsung de'i 'brel mkhan po'i gzhung /khur pos dbul 'gyur nor 'dzin ches cher lci//bka' dang rnam bshad glegs bus gtams pa'i mdzod//dkon cog rin cen rten gyigarnyo la//skye dgu'i legs byas snye ma dud pa'i zhing //gangs can dpal mo'i rgyan gyur chos grwa che/ /rin cen za 'og la sogs sna tshogs rgyur/ /theg gsum skye 69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)'phags sku brnyan sgyu ma'i 'phrul/ /ye shes (59na〉sems dpa' yongs su 'khyil ba'i gzi/ /mun bskal pha mthar byed la 'bar ba bzhin/ /lo paṇa drin las 'gyur ro cog gi bka'/ /bstan bcosashing gis ma ma'i khong yangs por/ /brda gzugs bkod pa'i khyad par lta ba la/ /'chi med bdag pos mig stong bskrun min nam/ /rga dang rgud bral gzhom med rdo rje'i lus/ /byis blo 'drid la sku gdung cha brgyad du/ /nyer bgos ring bsrel snying po'i mchod rten brgyad/ zhal ri ston zla'i khu bas byugs pa 'dra/ /'phags bod li bal rgya dang stod smad hor/ /mtha' klas skye rgu'i bdog pa mchod pa'i sprin/ /phung por spungs pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo/ /phye 'dis rmugs 'dzin 'byor pa'i rjes su 'gro/ /blang dor mi shes chud 'dza' dud 'gro'i spun/ /rang nor min sems rtsing sbyod rdo phal mdog /chom rkun bsrung ba'i mel tsher gtan tshigs kyis/ /tshul bzhin bsgrub pa rnam par dpyod pa'i rtsal/ /mdzub rtsis yid dam brtan pa'i grangs 'dzin mkhan/ /bya rog sprin tshad gzhal sbas blo rtse gtod/ /lho mon mtha' 'khob kla klo'i ngang tshul dag /sen dha pa ltar 'byul ba'i 'khor lo bskor/ /mkha' me'i grangs can 'phags yul yi ge'i tshogs/ /rang skad sbyor bder nyer mkho legs bsdus pa'i/ /gtsug lag thu mi'i ri mo srid pa'i mthar/ /mi bskyud rig pa'i rnam 'gyur 'phrul po che/ /de phyir dngos don 'phyug pa med pa'i ming / tshig sbyor me rta ge ma snyigs yi ge'i gzugs/ /rab spel chun po deb ther legs bris thod/ /bcings pa'i kha dog ma 'dres so sor ltos/ /zhes snyan pa'i tshig gi 'phreng ba sngon du spel nas skabs kyi don ri kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir 'gran pa'i zla kun dang bral ba'i chos grwa chen po dpal ldan 'bras (59ba)spungs phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde'i gtsug lag khang gi rten mchod kyi rim pa'i tho rnying pa kha 'thor ba rnams dang gsar du bskrun pa'i skor kun dga' zhes pa shing stag khrums stod zla ba'i gral tshes dge bar deb ther du bkod pa la/dpal ldan 'bras spungs rten mchod deb skur a ma'i skyed tshal/ (sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i phrit+ta las me rtag 'phreng can/)dharmadh+wato rbatse sherba dha maṇ+ḍal snyad co bus mā swā rdza lhas tu taḥsu chu:6 di ka shrīdha ni rgya dzin pa su pa de khrin pā smre na taḥ chos —70

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha yonadabyings gsung gi dbang phyug dkyil 'khor gtso/ /spro dang bsdu ba'i mchod sdong thugs rten gyis/ /legs brgyan shrī dha n+ya ka ṭa gaḥganyis pa kha ba'i ljongs kyi 'dus pa'i sde'i//bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog gi tshal//rten dang brten par bcas pa'i gtsug lag khang //rnam thos bu yi 'byor pa la 'khu ba//'jig rten mes pos ched du bskrun pa bzhin//sku gsung thugs rten mchod rdzas a mra'i shing //gzegs 'khyar nyes60na ) pa srung byed deb zer 'phreng //spyig ma'i tshal gyi ra bas yongasabaskor ba'i//tshul la blo gros ldan rnams yid rab gtod//ces sogs gong 'dra/se ra theg wo gling gi rten mchod kyi des ther mtho ris chu rgyun/sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i brit+ta la me rtag 'phreng can/e ma be+e du snyitā gam nākān+ta shu)yan stir+ya te na hrī ba chu kaḥm3〉〉nu mā re kar dzñā na ni tra pra kā sha su go stur so dhi ya shaḥ.e ma shes bya'i gnas lugs nam mkha'i mthas//gzhal nus min de khyod mkhyen gyis rtogs tshe//'jam da byangs gzhone nur byed pa'i ye shes spyan//rab gsal 'gro ba'i bla ma btsong kha pa//mgon nyid chos sdings gnas su bzhugs pa'i dus/zhar phyin ngo mtshar gtam gyi bkod pa'i gzugs//skal bzang yid mkhar 'gog med shar pa'i gdangs//nor 'dzin dzam+bha'i gser gyis byugs pa 'dra//rten cing 'brel 'byung bslu ba med 'bras ding /zhang rta che gnyis bzhed pa'i gzhung 60ba ) lugs la//thos bsam yang rtser son pa'i chos kyi gra//ser theg chen gling zhes grags pa dkar//rgyal srasaslob mar bcas pa'i sku rten dang //gsung rten bka' dang bstan bcos 'gyur ro cog/bde bar gshegs pa thugs rten rnam brgyad kyi//phyur bur kun nas gtams pa'i dri gtsang khang //ta ming gong ma la sogs che rgu yis//yongs spel mchod rdzas deng bar ho med du//stug po'i char sprin bzhin du bla nas blar//mtho bar brtsegs pa'i khur 'di ljid du lci//tshe rabs gzhan du bsags pa'i bsod nams kyi//'bras bu chud mi ja bar mngon sum du//myong ba mu tig 'khri shing rtogs brjod kyi//blo gros ldan rnams yid dbang cis mi 'phrog/phra rgyas kun nas dkrigs pa'i dra ba dag/thub rnams shes rab mtshon gyis bcad pa'i phyir//ste'u gzas sdang tsan+dan byug la chags//mnyam par lta ba dam pa spyi yi

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)lugs/ /'on te mchog gsum yul la bsngosapa'i rdzas/ /gzhan spyod ngan du 'gro ba'i sgo phye nas/ /me 'bar lcags gong za ba'i sdug bsngal gang / /bsams tshe rmi lam na yang su yi bzod/ /de phyir dkon cog bla mar yongs bzung ste/ /sri zhur legs byas sgyu ma'i zang zing nor/ /snying por blangasapa'i dngos kun srid mtha' bar/ /mi 'dzad phyag rgyas 'ching ba mkhas pa'i lugs/ /med par sgro btags nyes med ar la gtad/ /yod la zom lusanyesayod ci bder 'jog /zhabrul pa'i rang mtshang nying zhabrul lta bu la/ /tshul bzhin brtags dpyad ngang tshul de spong rigs/ khyu mtshan shes nas shog bu'i lam gsum par/ /don gyi rlabs 'phreng nam yang mi yol ba/ /(61nakhya ge'i 'phreng ba mtho ris chu bo'i rgyun/ /deb ther zla ba'i ma mar ro gcig 'khyil/ /zhes shisapa brjod pa sngon du btang ste gangs can bstan pa'i sgron me sa gsum na 'gran pa'i zla thamasacad dang bral ba/ se ra theg chen gling gi garnyo la'i rten gsum mchod rdzas sngon nas da lta'i bar du rim byung kun dga' zhes pa shing stag hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes dge bar deb ther du bkod pa la/'og min zhing gtsor bzhengs kyang lnga bdo'i 'gro/ /'dren ched sgyu 'phrul las bltams nyi ma'i gnyen/ /theg gsum zab rgyasargyud mngasachosakyi glur/ /blangasanasasdug kun nad sel sman gyi ljon/ /yid gnyisatsam gyisa'akhor ba hrul po sa /byed nusarten cing 'brel 'gyung sgra bo che/ /rab sgrogasastong phrag brgyad pa'i pū sta gaḥ /ro gzugasazla ba'i grangs ldan tshar dngar ba/ /skal bzang gra tog gser gzungs thar pa che/ /mdzangasablun mtshan 'bum thar chen klu 'bum dkar/ /bka' gdamasaglegs bam chos 'byung lam rim skor / /dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i gsung rab par ma dang / /isgru ni la'i mdangs 'dzin shog bu la/ /gser sbyangs khu bas legs brisasman gyi mdo/ /brgyad brgya'i grangs su byugs ris sh+lau ka /legs byas bye bar spel ba'i phul byung zhing / /glegs shing gdong dar sku rags la sogs pas/ /gsung rab 'grel par bcasal sri zhu sra /bskrun pa'i dge tshogasabyang chub phyir bsngosapa'i/ /'bras bu nam mkha'i mthas kyang gzhal nus ci/ /byed po sems can kun 'dren stobs bcu po/ /—72—

sku gsung thugasarten gsar 4khosadang ri po lo marna rdzasakhang 4nga gi dkar ga shā'iyongs mnga'i rtsal 6brdzogasangesapa lnga ldan du//lhun grub sna tshogasasprul pa gaṅgā'i klung //rdul snyed grangs bzhin zlos gar legs bsgyur shog/'di don phan tshig brjod dang lus ngal bsten//bdog pa spel sogasamathun rkyen bsgrubasaso cog/lha mi'i srid pa rim par brgyud brgyud nas//ring por mi thogs rdzogs 'tshang rgya bar shog/thub bstan spyod dang zhwa ser 'chang ba'i sde//de 'dzin 'dus par bcasadar 'dab stong dbus//'jig rten gsum gyi phan bde'i ze'u 'brur//myangasapa'i rgyang glu 'gro rnams rtag len shog/'disamatshon chosadakar sngon nasad lta'i bar//bsagasapa'i 'brasabu rgya shug tshi gu yis//drang bar nusamin ma rgan skye rgu'i tshogs//kun mkhyen ye shesathob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo//zhes pa 'di yang rme ru bla ma rin cen rgya mtshogagasung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i glegs bam brgya dang sum cu skor par du bawa cing sman bla'i mdo chog gi tshe nye bar mkho ba sman mdo brgyad brgya pa'i gser chos bzhengasapa'i dus bsngo smon gyi tshigs bcad dgos tshul bskul ba ltar za hor gyi ban+des sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o//dī munalegacug/paṃ kā ra'i ye shesasgyuma'i 'phrul//bstodrug thig ler rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs//yongasashar skal ba mchog gi spyod yul la//byang chen bar du 'bral ba med par shogakhrid 'ag rten dbang phyug/pa'i rgya mtsho che las 'gro ba kun/sgrol pa'i 'phags mchog snying rje'i gter chen gru//'jig rten dbang phyug khyod zhal byang chub bar//62nayig gi bdud rtsir lta ba'i skal bzang stsol/zhi bltabs/dang khro bo'i bde bar gshegasasocog/kun bdusadapalachen la sogasagrub sdebargyad//rten dang brten par bcasapa'i mchog thun gyis//med byung mthu rtsal byin chen dbab tu gsol//'jig tshe dpag med lo bdag bdud 'joms/rten gsum la dbang ba'i 'chi bdag bdud//ma lus 'joms par nusapa'i bcom ldan 'das//tshe dang ye shesadapag tu med pa yis//snying gi dpal be'u bdud rtsisagatamasapar mdzod//dbyarastamayodamasgogloganon/gyi char sprin lta bu'i snyigasadusa'adir//lang long 'khrigs pa'i dam sri'i snying ga sa/dpal chen rta mgrin zhabasakyi bro brdungasanas//gdug rtsu

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (peb tshaba'i dpal kun:la gyis gnon//zag bla ma bde dbang phyug/med bde ba chen po'i ros myos pas//mchog thun dngos grub kun la dbang phyug pa//rigs bdag bla ma pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis//byang chen ma thob par du rjes zungs shig/'chi rigs rdzo 4stod mchokhe tshe/med tshe yi dga' ston mchog sbyin par//rigs lnga so so'i rang gzugs 'ja' tshon ltar//ma 'dres rab spras srog gi ka ba la//gzhom med rdo rje'i phyag rgyas dam du chings/ /'phrin yang gsang lto drag po/las rigs 'dzin kurma drag po rtsal/ /tshes cher rab tu khros pa gtum po che//yang gsang dpa' bo'i mtshon gyis bdud sde dang //'phung byed 'dre srin 'byung po rdul du rlogs//sde rtsa khor dregs2la/brgyad dregs pa 'dul ba'i 62bsko nyen po sa/sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang 'dzin rdo rje che//phyogs bcur gdengs nas yid srubs dpung bcas rnams//ming gi lhag ma tsam du tshar chod cig/gdengs nag raka/can tshogs dang sa bdag gnyan gyi dug/'joms nus 'jam dpal srin po rigs lnga yi//byin rlabs rnam par rgyal ba'i sman mchog gis//sgo gsum phan dang bde ba'i lam la sbyor//mi rdo rje gro lod/bsrun bdud dang dam sri gnyis 'thung mgo/cher 'thag mthu stobs gdong lnga 'bar ba'i gzi//chol pa'i khro rgyal rdo rje gro bo lod//srid gsum zil gnon gar gyis logs 'dren sgrol//phun tshe dpag med dngas ma bas 'dren/tshogs brtan g.yo'i tshe dang dngas ma'i bcud//srog gi zungs su 'dren pa'i 'chi med lha//ston mtshan zla ba'i bkrag dang gzi byin gyis//nyi ma'i bu yi smag rum pha mthar skyod//rta rta 'as sa gsu'i la gnon/skad bsgrags pa tsam gyis khams gsum rnams//zil gnon dbang chen dbu dgu bco brgyad phyag/zhabs brgyad dor stabs gar dgu'i rol pa yis//lus med dpung bcas don snying lkog mar phyungs//nyon mongs sman bla/dug lnga'i rtsa ba drung phyung ba'i//zhan la bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kyi tshogs//mthar byed sman gyi bla ma be+e ḍūrlaḥ /'od kyi rgyal po'i thugs rje'i lcags kyus zungs/ khes lha mo/ rab rdo rje dbyings kyi 'udabang phyug ma//dri za'i bu mor sprul pa dbyangs can lha//srid gsum bdag mo 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i ltas//bsam pa'i re ba yongs su skong bar 0 7 /4/

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga (763na sti ngo bkod rgyab yig/sa spra te rtarma bharnya ba:sedi bhan+ta su bī kas mānā ti:rgyu pa tsa/āka she bha r+ṣa me sto yathuṣabyu pa he tu phi'oXs lha bha ba bhā be+e bkaḥkun rtse0sbyor ma lnga yo'i shāt+ta las tshe togang mā/rdzob chos rnams 'khrul pa'i snang ba la//nying zhakhrul rmi lam lta bur ches rdzun kyang //mkha' la char sprin ji bzhin tha snyad du/khyu 'bras 'chol bar mi 'byung dngos po'i gshis//rig pa rang byung rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zhing //tshad bzung mtha' bral ngo mtshar cho 'phrul kun//snang dang shes pa'i nyams su 'gog med par//'char ba'i ngang tshul de la gang gis bston//de phyir bgrang yas lha yi rol gar dang //sna tsho gos zhing gi bkod pa sgyu ma'i spun//brgya phrag tshon dang phrad pa'i man shel bzhin//ras dkar gtsang ma'i ngos la bshar 'di mtshar//gang de mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis//yon sbyar zur rigs tshon las rnam rgyal sogs//gtsug lag lta ba'i 63ba ) mig yangs mkhas rnams kyis//sgo gsum 'bad pas bskrun pa'i mthu las po//dge tshogs byang chub bar du rab 'phel 'bras//srid zhi'i yon tan phung po legs phyur te//'gro 'dren ༅ gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa//ring min ma' du 'gyur ba'i dge legs stsol//zhes rgya can gyi lha tshogs dang zhing bkod bsdoms pa'i zhal thang gra tshar sum cu rtsa lnga ri bo chos gling pa mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za tor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o//zhing khams rgya mtshor gsang gsum sgyu ma'i gar//mtha' klas 'gro ba'i snang ngor yongs shar yang //zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya las gzhan du//rnyed min bder gshegs kun 'dus thugs rje yis//lnga pa'i lam gyur rdo rje sgrol ma gang //phyi ltar laṅka'i rgyal khab dpal gyi ri//nang ltar 'og min stug po bkod pa'i gnas//gsang ba chos nyid zad pa'i slong 'khrid shog/dkar nag ci byas bto pa'i sa bon bzhin//ma 'dres so sor 'char phyir dge 'di'i mthus//tshe 'das kyis ma lus can ji snyed pa//rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob gyur cig/sngags ban ngag dbang 'phrin las kyis bu mo'i don du zhi khro'i sku bas bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /chos dbyings mkha' la spro zhing nyer (64na)sdud pa/ /grangs med rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor chu shel dbang / /sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar mkhan/ /'dren byedagazigs mor rab bkra'i chog rdzogs/ /gru 'dzin laṅka'i khab sogs ngo mtshar ba'i/ /bkod pa rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed zhing khams su/ /bzhugs kyang tshon brgyar nye ba'i shel ltar du/ /'di rnams ma 'dres dbang po'i gzhu bzhin gsal/ /tshangs pa rgan po'i blo yis ma byas shing / /'phrog byed 'jug bcu'i rnam 'phrul ma yin par/ /bgrang bya lta la 'byam klas mi ngal bas/ /gzhan du sgyu ma'i grong khyer dmigs su med/ /sman thang bzo rigs gtsug lag deng 'dzin mig /gnyis pa yangs pa'i rtsal ldan mkhas bsgrugs kyis/ /ri mor 'dri ba'i rkyen rnams mi yi bdag /blo bzang mas stobs mkhyen brtson byed pos bskrun/ /dge ba'i kha rdul mang brtsegasagangs ri las/ /legs tshogs nyal 'gros nyes brgya'i dri ma kun/ /yongs bkrus 'di phyi'i zhing sa gshin po la/ /phan bde'i snye ma g.yur du za bar shog /ces rgya can gyi zhing bkod gra tshar sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis bzheng bar mdzad pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul gsung gis bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bkras rab pa phun tshogs dbang po'o/ /rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing yos lor mdzad pa'i rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling par spyi sgos kyi rim gro'i gtong deb kyi 'go brjod dang / bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang la phu dud rgya cher spel ba'i dkar chag sogs/dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags kyis nged rang gi 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i smon lam dpag bsam re stong / bsod nams nyer bsags grangs med skye ba'i mtshor/ /mgon khyod thugs rje zla gzugs rtag shar tshe/ /—76

sku gsung thugs rten gsar ba tshe ngas dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (7byang chub bar du 'bral med rjes 'dzin pa/ /smon pa'i re ba ji bzhin 'grub gyur cig /(64ba)(sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i brit+ta las me rta go 'phreng ༅/〉ske ba kho birnyubi bras sgo dharma kā ya pra spo(na bā lha yi stogarkaḥ kā dra ṇa pā ta be+e ru ji rnani rma kā ya su bi du gi sha shu sti bha dra kaḥ ngo bo mkha' khyab spros bral chos sku'i ngang / /rang bzhin ye shes 'ja' ris longs spyod rdzogs/ /thugs rje kun 'jug 'gag med sprul pa'i sku/ /rang rig gdod ma'i dpal ldan kun tu bzang / /slo bur dri bcas sems kyi 'ching rgya las/ /yongs grol pha rol don gyi pad+ma 'byung / /sa lam yon tan ye nas lhun rdzogs pa/ /gzhan du bslu med gtan gyi skyabs de su/ /chos nyid zad sar 'byol ba chos kyi sku/ /'og min zhing gtso nges pa lnga ldan gar/ /rnga yab dpal gyi ri bor thod 'phreng rtsal/ /mtha' dag chu zla lta bur rig gdangs tsam/ /lnga brgya'i 'gro ngor mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes/ /'dzam gling che ba'i sngags 'chang gcig pu las/ /du mar bsgyur ba'i mtshan brgyad rnam 'phrul gyis/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyi bsnyems pa (65na)bag la zha/ /rgyal kun 'dus pa bla ma rdo rje 'chang / /ngo mtshar snang bas bsod nams bye ba'i zhing / /bskrun pa'i snying stobs ljid kyis sa srungs kyi/ /'gram par rngul chu'i 'phreng bas brgyan pa bzhin/ /he ru rkaḥdapal gangs can pad+ma'i stor/ /gos dkar rig sngags 'chang ba so zur gnubs/ /snyan grags lha yi rnga gsang srid pa'i rtser/ /ldir ba'i ngang tshul de la su zhig bston/ /sems phyogs mdo rgyu'i bstan pa bla nas blar/ /yongs 'degs zur rigs muk+ta ka yi 'phreng / /chad med las 'ongs gzhis ka shar pa zhes/ /rgyu sbyor legs byas 'gugs pa'i cho ga mkhan/ /grangs med sems can rnams la dge ba'i 'bras/ /dngos zhan 'di'i ched mthun rkyen bsgrubs so cog /gnas skabs lha yi tshe dpal la 'gran cing / /ring min kun mkhyen ye shes 'thob par shog /sbyin pa'i bdag po tshe 'dir grol ba'i lam/ /mgon khyod thugs rjes rnyed na smos ci 'tshal /gal te skal zhan yang srid phyi ma tshe/ /pad+ma 'od kyi zhing du skye bar shog /gsol 'debs bsam pa lhun gyis grub pa sa /zhal 'ches rdo ba'i ri mo mi 'gyur phyir/ /'di phyi bar gyi mdun ma gru bzhi par/ /'byer bar byin rlobs rje btsun thod 'phreng rtsal/ /mkha' la rtsa gsum thugs rje'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs/ /—77

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebar du theg mchog chos kyi 'brug stong ldir/ /sa la phan bde'i lo tog rab tu smin/ /dus kun bkra shis dpal gyis khyab par shog /ces zur gyis (65ba)sngags 'chang gzhis ka shar pa spun rigs kyi bu dang bcas pas mtshan brgyad kyi sku brnyan dang mchis brang rgyal mos byams pa'i gser thang bzhengs pa rnams kyi smon lam dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi ban+des sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs gragasapa'o/ /nyan rang zhi bde'i lam nasanyer bslang ba'i/ /thugasabaskyed skya rengasakyisadrangasasalam mkhar/ /chos gzugs dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i bde bar gshegs/ /rabs bdun nyin mor byed pas rtag tu skyongs/ /g.yin phan rgyal srasaspyod zhon rang gi don/ /grub nas ngal ba med par 'gro rgyud kyi/ /sgrib gnyis bag chags sbyong ba'i thabasamakhasakhur/ khyer ba la gzhan mdzad pa ci zhig mchis/ /de phyir bdag sogs snyigasam lnga bdo'i 'gro/ /bor te btang snyoms zhi bde'i dbyings gzhol na/ /sangs rgyas mtshan de snyan yang nyan rang las/ khyad zhugasayon tan de ko ming tsam gyur/ /sngon gomasabadag gi mi dge byasapa'i 'bras/ /smin pa 'dren pa rnamasal yus kyi gtam/ /gsol ba 'os su mi che rang nyesakyang / /bu yis ma min gzhan dag su la re/ /'gro rnamasathugs rje'i phyag gisaganas skabs dang / /mthar thug sdug bsngal kun las yongs bsgral te/ /deng nas stobasabacu mnga' ba ma thob bar/ /bde skyed dpal la sbyor zhig 'phagasamachog kye/ /rnam 'dren sku gzugasargyu sbyor yon bdag dang / /bzo rig bran 'khor lasabyed ji snyed pa/ /me zhal tshe 'byor mtshungasapar rtag spyod (༅nastang / /ring min mgon khyod spang rtogs rjes 'gror shog /kha ba'i ljongs 'di sum rtsen ltar bde zhing / /thub pa'i bstan 'phel de 'dzin yun du gnas/ /bsamasadon yid bzhin 'grub pa'i dge legasakyis/ /phyogs dus kun tu bkra shis rgya mtsho stsol/ /ces lha sa byang gling bsam grub rgyal pos sangs rgyas rabs bdun gyi gser thang bzhengs pa'i rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi ban+des sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs gragasapa'o/ /rgyal kun thugs rje'i snang ba cher 'bar bas/ /sgrib gnyis —78

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag yonade gos nyas brgya'i mun sangs te/ /'di phyi gtan gyi phan bde yongs gsal ba'i/ /dga' ston la sbyor rtsa gsum lha tsho gos kyi/ /zhes shing yos rtses dang dpal grong rab 'byams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis lha sa smon lam chen mor gra skor bgyi skabs rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling du dngul srang nyi shu rtsa gsum las grub pa'i kong bu phul ba'i kha byang du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /e ma shes bya'i yul la srid do cog /mtha' slas gnas lugs rtogs byed rigs pa'i 'phrul/ /grangs kyi khyad par ji snyed 'phags bod kyi/ /lo paṇa mkhas pa'i gsung las rlung bzhin grags/ /'on te snying po ma pham zhal gyi sgor/ /cher bsngags nyi zla ltar gsal rig pa lnga'i/ /nang tshan rjes 'dzin bzo gzugs dpyod ldan gyi/ /yid ngo'i me long gtsang mar ci yang 'char/ /lus ngag sems kyi rnam (slob)par bcos pa'i gar/ /mngon rjes tshad ma'i do rar yongs bsgyur ba'i/ /pha mtha' 'tshol la mes pos gdong pa bzhi/ /sprul kyang ma rnyed zag bcas gnyid la g.yur/ /de nang lus gyi sgyu rtsal mchog dman bar/ /kun rtog pir gyis dris pa'i rol pa las/ /rgyal dang de sras slob ma'i tshogasarnams kyi/ /snang brnyan bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing gi phul/ /rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ma rgyud sdom 'byung dang / khyud 'grel dri ma med pa'i 'od sogs las/ /'ongs pa'i cha tshad dbye ba 'chi med lam/ /rgyu skar 'phreng ba ji bzhin tshar du dngar/ /sngon rabs gtsug lag gnyis pa shes pa'i mig /dkyus ring mang rjes ba po shis rgyal po'i mtshan/ /rab snyan ma dros mtsho las legs babs pa/ /sman mkhyen gaṅgā'i la klung chen 'phel/ /blo gros srad bur brgyus pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi/ /mu tig 'phreng 'dren ri mo mkhan mang ding / /lto phyir gang dran srin bu'i sug rjes can/ /ngo tsha'i gos bral ljid kyis gser ldan khyod/ /lha yi bzo bo gnyis pa sman thang pa/ /don kun grub dang rjes 'jug ring mkhar ba/ /dri za'i bu mos mngon sum zhal bstan pa'i/ /legs bshad 'di ko mngon med yang dag lam/ /ding sang bris 'bur sku dang thugs kyi rten/ /bzheng la cha tshad dgos nges snyan po'i gtam/ /gab pa'i ri mo ji bzhin —79

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)nyer sbas pa/ /gsal bar byed la shes ldan su mi spro/ /de phyir lha rigs bya nag gdung 'dzin cing / /snga rig don rtogs rnam gling dkon cog dang / /sa 'bur bzor (67na〉khas gting skyes lhun po yis/ /cho me sbyin 'dzad med par du bskrun la bskul/ /phyogs lhung:na la mig gtos go po'i mngal /'dzin pa'i rma bya mang mod drang po'i blos/ /mkhyen brtse'i rnam dpyod mtshor shar tshad kyi zla/ /slad mar nya rgyas lta bur spel bar spro/ /gna' bor zhen pa'i dbang rtul dad chu'i sna/ /rmonges pa'i sal gar khrid ma yin par/ /mkhas pa'i bstan bcos lus phras phrogs pa'i yid/ /kun slong ngan pa'i rgan rjes ga la rgyug /sos dus khu byug lang tsho rgyas pa'i skad/ /thos 'dzan yul du lhang lhang ches snyan yang / /nagasakhrod khā da'i tshigs kyi ca co'i sgra/ /sgrogs la su zhig rna ba ga la gtad/ /skye mangs bag chag bzang po sgo nga'i sbubs/ /phul byung shes rab rtsal sgro nyer rdzogs nas/ /yid la kun dga' ster pa'i glu dbyangasamakhan/ /'dab chags kal piṅka'i tshul la rangs/ /bsod nams byas 'dis yang srid thams cad du/ /sras bcas rgyal ba'i sku gzugs byed pa por/ /yongs brgyud dri med rgyal po'i rnam par thar/ /'dzin pa'i skal ba bzang por 'gyur bar shog /nyer 'bad par gyi chu 'dzin stug po las/ /mi 'dzad glegasabu'i char gyi rgyun chen pos/ /zhabrul med cha tshad snye ma yongs dud pas/ /dge 'bras ro bda'i skya de rgyal bar shog /dkon cog thugs rje brgya phyin gtsug tor rtse/ /reg pa'i mod la duḥkhas mnar ba'i gzugs/ /bde ldan lha lus ltar gyur mkha' mnyam 'gror/ /skyid pa'i nyi ma dgung nas 'char par shog /ces gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir sman mkhyen gnyis zhes nyi zla lta bur grags pa'i nang tshan sman bla don grub kyis mdzad (67ba)pa'i cha tshad bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs kyi rab tu byed pa yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / sgra dbyangs lha mos rjes su bzung ba 'phrang kha ba dpal ldan blo gros bzang pos mdzad pa'i cha tshad kyi yi ge gnyis par du brko ba'i bdun pa yod pa'i steng / bya rigs gnas lnga smra ba rnam gling dkon cog chos grags dang bris 'bur gyi tshul la blo mig yangs pa gting skyes pa tshe dbang lhun po gnyis kyis mtshams sbyar pa'i rkyen gyis rab byung bcu gcig pa'i srin po zhes pa shing —80

sku gsung thugasarten gsar 4khosadang rin po che'i mardzo rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar ga shākayos dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du brkos pa'i par byang 'di ni za sto gyi ban+de tshas sras bawa pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa dza yan+tu/rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs༅da gling par spyi sgosakyi rim 'a༅gakho deb kyi 'go brjod sasa'adzin bang mdzod kha chad/goltorogayophobṛt+talagazag4nga༅/bī'otsā40k+tot+palasanapā'ibisnospo69narmo/zhi79phyatsistekhrizhubeshasāmaphyabe+e)rlurwaskreyarkayatsātu/rgyud kyisabakug pa'i ut+pal dmar po'i gzhu//'dab ldan zung 'jug me tog kha 'busamadzes//brtan g.yo'i snying kha phug tshe srid pa gsum//dbang sdud rig byed lha mos shis pa stsol//mtha' phyag gnyis kyi sor 68namos ne'u le'i mgrin//btsir las longs spyod mi zad 'dod dgu'i dpya/ /skyug mdzad gas pa rdo rje dzam bha la/ /pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs 'dzin khyod kyis skyongs//bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro mgo lcam dang //chos skyong srung ma'i dgyes skong mthun pa'i rdzas//rtsing spyod mtho dma'i skyon bral mu thi la//srad bur brgyusa'adra'i brjed byang deb ther dgod//de yang rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs lad gling du zla rer gakho ba'i dus gtor/tshesachug lo gsar dang nag zla'i lha zhal gnyis kyi mar gtor go mo/sprel zla'i tshes bcu/mdos wang /khrorol/lo'ajug dusapho/4 tha/ngesamed kyi pho grogosagator dang mtshamasakhag/gzimasachung mgon khang zur rgyas gsang sngags pho brang steng shod/gsang sngags dge tshal sogasagyi gar+ṣa gzhi spo bsamago/bstan pa spyi sgosakyi rim gro gar+ṣa dgosakyi brjed lo shog ril sna rgas chad lhag mtho dma' che zhing mi mthun pa mang ba'i yid brtan khel dka' ba zhig 'dug par tshig ro phud cing zhus dag bakha ba'i ngos/'phar chag ci dgos zhib mor dpyad nasalha bsangs dang bstan gsol gyi phye mar ma gtogs 'degs gshor mkha' ru zhe gcig tu byas te phyag mdzod dang gnyer tshang so so nas gtong dgosakyi rim pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i srin po zhes pa shing yos hor zla bzhi par gtan 'bebs kyi deb thor bkod pa la/e ma srid zhi'i gdung ba skyob pa la//mkhyen brtse nusapa'i lo 'dab phang phung gis//bsil ba'i 8

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shegrib mar 'gro rnamasang la gso ba//rdzogs sangs64rgyas kun shis lugs rmad po che//'on te cher bdo'i snyigs ma lnga yi mun//sdug bsngal mal du gnyid g.yur lus can tshogs//bde skyid tsha gser 'dren pa'i rta ljang rtsal/khyad zhugs bde bar gshegs pa bdun du grags//nam yang drang por gsungs pas tshad ma'i dpang //nyi ma'i gnyen ljags yangs shing ring brkyang las//sman mdo brgyad brgya par stsal phan yon la//rdzun zhes rgol bar byed pa'i klan ka su//lha sras khri srong lde btsan bzhed skong slad//mkhan chen bo dhi satwa sa cho ga'i gzhung //byin rlabs sa bon gangs ldan dpal mo'i stor//sbrums pa'i phan bde'i mngal khur gcig tu lci//sngon rabs tshad mar gyur pa'i mkhas rnams kyis//mdo sngags ma 'dres dgongs don legs bkral kyang //'chal ba'i shes rab can 'gas mtshal snag gnyis//bsres ltar ma dag yig chas rnyog mar byas//phyogs re'i mig ldan ma yin shes bya'i khyon/ /yongs gzigs gnas lnga kun rig stag tshang pa'i/ /legs bshad zhi 'tsho'i dgongs rgyan la brten nas//mdo chog bstan pa'i me ro ches cher gsos//sum rtsen yul la 'gran pa nyang stod char//pho brang gnam gyi ka ba rgyal mkhar rtse'i//bya 'dabs 'khod pa'i bal po pi la phu/mgon med zasasbyin sa 'dir 'phos pa bzhin//skye ba du mar ma ro zhe mtho'i rten bzang lam//rim brgyud thar pa'i khang par 'jug 'dod pas//mdo chog lha tshogs gser zangs rgyu spel te//bzhengs pa'i bsod nams phung po srid rtser snyeg/rgyal dbang pad+ma'i zhal lung mngar po'i ror//ma pham mgon 69na ) gyi sprul par lung zin pa//rab brtan kun bzang 'phags kyis mdzad pa'i phul//dpal 'khor bde chen chos sde'i grags pa snyan//thub pa'i rjes su 'jug rlom grub pa'i mtha'//mang yang lta ba bkar btags phyag rgya bzhi//tshul ldan sa dge bu ston ring lugs pa//skye rgu'i chos dkar myu gu bskyed pa'i zhing //rgya mtsho mkha' stong mes bsgyur 'dus tshogs kyis//bde gshegs bdun mchod pho brang bzhugasapa'i sku//ston zla dang mtshungs lhag bsam rgyas phul ba'i//bsod rtan mas mug char gyi 'khri shing bzhin//rten dang sbyin pa'i bdag po bal por bcas//dbuX4 ra sman ljongs 'degs pa'i zla grogs mkhan//

sku gsung thugasarten gsar bzheng dang rin po che'i mar rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar chag (mergyang ro grwa tshang slob dbon yon to bzang / /legs bshad bgo bsha' byed la shin tu rings/ /chu lbur mig yul mgyur rgyu mtshan du/ /byasategosadum bcug pa tsam min par/ /chos sku'i ring bsrel gtsor byas phyag len ltar/ /phul 'dir srasabacasargyal ba dgyesasam snyam/ /dam tshig 'dab stong ba'ad pa'i ze'u 'bru'i dris/ /ye shesasemasadapa'i bung ba yongasabakug par/ /dbang bskur rgyasabatab spyan dbye brtan bzhugasadang / /mchod sbyin bstod sogasarab gnas tshul bzhin bsgrubs/ /'di'i slad 'bad pa lta ci dge tshogasal/ /rjesasu yi rang bgyid pa'i mtha' rten rnams/ /srid pa kun tu dpal 'byor dbang thang tshe/ /gnod sbyin lus༅ po yi spun zlar shog /ring min shar nasashar bgrod dag pa'i gnas/ /bde gshegasabadun gyi zhing du pad+ma las/ /rdzusate skyesanasazhal (69ba)mthong dam pa'i chos/ /rab thob nges par legs pa'i lam rnyed shog /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par ru bzhi'i yul/ /dkar min 'brasabu'i ming yang ma gragasapar/ /rdzogasaldan skye rgu'i bde skyid nyamasamyong ba'i/ /bzang po'i skalab mngon sum mthong par shog /bsod namasastobasakyi 'khor lo mnga' thang mkhar/ /'phagasapas bar med gnam sa'i khyon kun la/ /dbang sgyur khrimasakyi gnya' shing 'dzin pa'i ri/ /rgya hor bod kyi phrag par rab lci shog /mdo rgyud klog dang spong ba bgyid pa'i grwa/ /sa bon gser ldan yongasakhyab mnyam bkram pas/ /lung rtogasasnyem dar drag thar pa'i srog /zungasagyur byang chub bar du 'dzad med shog /'du ba nyer 'khrugs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad/ /drung 'byin rnam par rgyal ba a ru ra/ /'dzin mdzad sngon med sman ba skye rgu'i gawo/ /mngon gyur sgrib gnyisand rnamasabacilabar shog /bsgrubasadang slong byed gsog bzhin dge ba'i 'bras/ /rang ched khonar mdamigasa'agroba'i sems/ /spang rtogasayon tan pha mthar yongasaphyin pa/ /kun mkhyen ye shesaganasasu 'gyur bar bsngo/ /chu glang gi lo sman bla'i mdo chog che mor mtha' dpyod zhus dag par byas nas par du brkosate dbusagatsang gi chos sde mang por spel ba'i tshe nyang stod dpal 'khor bde ba chen por rgyal rtse chosargyal chen po nasad lta'i bar gra bzang bar 'dug pa'i pho brang la 'god rgyu'i sman bla'i lha tshogs nga gsum gyi —83—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)gser sku bal po bi la dzus mi phyed pa'i dad bas kun nas blangs te rgyu sbyor byas pa'i skabs che (70na tharjod smon lam gyi tshigs bcad cig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /'og min zhing gtso'i nges pa lnga ldan gzugs/ /smin legs sgyu phrul mang la yangs me long ngos/ /yongs shar mchog sprul zlos gar ma ga dhar/ /ston mdzad srid zhi'i don kun grub pa'i lha/ /ri mo g.yas 'khyil mgrin las chos kyi dung / /ris med skye rgu'i rna bar snyan pa'i sgra/ /'khor 'das gdung sel yan lag bcu gnyis gsung / /stims su klas des lus can mtha' 'tshol bzhin/ /ches phra lkog tu gyur kyang mngon sum du/ /chags thogs med par gzigs pa'i ye shes spyan/ /dkyus ring dgu tshigs ska rags zhags pa yis/ /ma bcings chos kyi mkha' de gang nas rnyed/ khyod bstan ji srid tshangs spyod tshul bstan zla/ /'phel 'grib dang bral 'gro 'dren dam bca'i khur/ /lhag bsam khyogasal nyer bteg dgra bcom pa/ /bsto drug grangs kyi mtshan snyan gnas brtan che/ /bla med ye shes mchogo gi lang tsho'i gzi/ /'bar yang ma dag skye rgu'i las snang ngor/ /rtog dman gzhen nu'i lus kyi nyan thos pa/ /rma byar smo pa'i gdong drug sngon med lha/ /bag yod dkyil 'khor shar ba'i 'od zer gyis/ /phra rags lhung ba'i phyogs rnams yongs bcil te/ /dag tshul yan lag brgyad ldan ar+gha yis/ /thub bstan zhabs su bsil byed chu lha'i bu/ /rnga yab ga dengs pas mchode pa'i sprin spro zhing / /nyon mongs(70ba)des bskyed lus sems sdug bsngal grol/ /spos phor dri dang khrims gtsang gdung ba'i nad/ /gzhil mdzad mthong bas rnam grol yan lag 'byung / /mnyam gzhag phyag gis mthong thos reg pa kun/ khu mig 'phel dpal ldan snyan dang grags pa 'bar/ /brgya phrag ting 'dzin mchog la mnga' dbang bas/ /nyes dgras ma pham rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ /sa chu me rlung klu sogs khrung po'i gdon/ /bsdigasapa'i mdzum mos rab btul 'bangs su khol/ /sgrib gnyis tsha dang bsil byed rnga yab kyis/ /bden gnyis ma' sum ston mdzad nags na gnas/ /rin cen rna kor mthong dang reg tsam gyis/ /spang rtogs—84

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhongs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mayongs rdzogs byang sems nyan rang sogs//mtha' yas yon tan mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa'i//grangasamed 'khor tsho gis sdud pa'i dus ldan pa//sdigs mdzub bstad pas dkar nag 'brel 'jog kun//rnam mkhyen sar 'god sman sbags rnga yab kyis//ye shes dbang phyug lus yon ji snyid pas//byang chen la sbyor rdo rje mo yi bu//chos 'chad phyag rgyas myang 'das gnas lugs rtogs//bsam dgu 'grub cing thabs shes zung du 'jug/mnyam gzhag bsam gtan 'phrul gyis nyon mongs bzlog/rgol ngan tshar gcod rjes 'dzin bzang po'i zhabs//rin cen zhags pas chos kun nyer thos pa//dran pas mi brjed gzungs thob spobs mthor son//ji lta ji snyed rnam par 'byed pa yi//rgya wo shes rab la bkri gser gyi bes/gang gi mnyam gzhag phyag rgya bcas pa'i mdo//ngan 'gro las thar dga' bde shin tu 71na los//ye shes mthu yi rnam dkar yon tan kun//'phel mdzad bha ra dh+wa dza gser can mchog/ne'u les 'dod don phun tshogs phyin drug rdzogs//bdag med gnas lugs mtshon gyisam rig gcod//byams dang snying rje'i chu yis rang rgyud zhing //rab brlan 'bras bu bskyed mdzad ba ku la//si byu brog zhu cod pan la bcings pa//mthong rnams dgra tsho gos nyer bas tshig don rtogs//sras bcas rgyal bas sgo gsum byin rlabs par//yongs su sbyor ba'i mthu ldan sgra gcan 'dzin//mnyam gzhag phyag rgya mdzad pas dug gsum dang //mnar sems mi shes sdug bsngal sems rgyud 'khrugs//log lta'i me zhi dbang po rab dul zhing /rkyen ༅ gdon las skyob pa'i lam phran bstan//nyes byasagadungs la glegs bam bstan reg gis//duḥkha kun sel ldog phyogs yon tan 'phel//mnyam bzhag shes rab slong snod srid dang zhi'i//'byor spel bha ra dh+wa dza bsod snyoms len//glegs bam mthong reg spobs pa blo gros rgyas//sgrib 'bras dang bral dal rten theg chen spyod//chos 'chad phyag rgyas blo 'phel lta ga bzlog/dkon cog mthong thos la sbyor lam bstan pa//bum bzang bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyisalas sgrib dri//rab bkrug gsil byed sgra yis nad la sogs//sdug bsngal de rgyu'i tsho gos rnamasayongs zhi zhing / /mtha' klas yon tan 'phel ma/da klu yi sde/ /glegs bam reg mthong 'chang kun

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)gnas lnga rig/nyon mongs dag cing chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur/shes rab cher rgyas de bzhin 71bgashegs pa yi//sras kyi thu bor bsgyur nus sped byed pa//byang byu mchod rten mthong bas don grub cing //bslab gsum mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis phra rgyas gzhil//rtag tu phun sum tshogs shing mi dge ba'i//phung po ma lus sbyong mdzad mi phyed pa//gcan gzan 'jigs sel dkon cog bar+sā bkur bar//'gro ba kun sbyor don gyi gnas brtan che//dge bsnyen tshul 'dzin rgyal sras spyod pa ldan//rdul phyag chu sbreng dharma tā la che//lag na pad dkar 'chang ba mi'i gzugs can//gnam sa'i dbang phyug thang gi legs byas shing //'phags pa'i gnas brtan tsi na'i rgyal khams su//'dren pa'i pho nya hwa shang rdzu'aphrul bdag/thub dbang spyan sngar bla gos phrag pa sa/bzar nas thal sbyar yid srubs dpung 'joms shing //dkar phyogs skyong bar g.yar dam zhal 'tshes pa//mthu stobs dbang phyug rgyal chen sdebazhi po//gas la dang ri brag ljon shing sogs//ngo mtshar bkod pa'i bzhugs gnas mtha' klas pa//dbus 'gyur 'chad dang rgya nag zhing gi phul//mngon sum ltar spel bi shwa ga me'i spun//gdod ma nyid nas spang rtogs mthar phyin kyang //'od mtshon stong 'bar sras kyi thu bo yi//tshul gzung gru 'dzin la dgyes pa da dkar can//'gro rnams 'dren pa'i dam bcas gcig tu dpa'//sngon goms 'jungs pa'i dri ma yongs bkrus pas//srid pa'i dpal 'byor phung po cher spungs pa//e ren+da ra gzigs kun la sbyin pa'i phyag/ring por rkyong ba 'jig rten dbang phyug zhabs//gzhan 72na skong 'phrul byed bdag po snying gi dbus//zhugs pa skyes bus 'phangs pa'i mda' bo che//bden pa'i tshig gis bzlog nus ya mu'i gling //sa la spyod ba'i mnga' bdag lha'i rgyal po//'phags chen dam pa'i byin rlabs sgyu ma'i 'phrul//nor 'dzin bdag por shar ba'i zhabs 'a zla//bod yongs thor tshugs rtser tshes phan bde'i sgo//brgya phrag 'byed mdzad gnya' khri btsan po zhes//byang phyogs mun pa'i gling du dam chos kyi//nyi ma thog mar 'char ba'i rten 'brel du//gsang ba gnyen por grags pa'i mchod pa'i rten//bda' babs kun bzang rnam sprul tho tho ri//la// rgyal khab gshegs nas ku sha na//chun bcas

sku gsung thugs rten gsar tshongs dang rin po tsho ma rdzo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha 6)drang bar bskul ba bdud mo yi//'phung sbyor rang gshed phab pa'i blo stobs kyi//rtsal ldan bhang ga la rje dad pa brtan//zag med bde wo bskyed pa'i mdza' na mo//gsang ba ye shes skyon yul nas drangs//dri med mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje'i zhal//lung bstan dbugs dbyung nyer thob dkon cog 'bangs//rgya bal sa dbang sras mo khab bzhes pa'i//'phrul gyis sangs rgyas dngos 'dra'i jo shāka zung //spyan drangs rten dang brten pa kha ba'i ljongs/khyab mdzad srong btsan sgam po chos kyi rgyal//brgya phrag lo paṇa la brten lung rtogs kyi//bshad sgrub bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan rab tu btsugs//thod 'phreng rtsal gyi rjes bzung che mchog grub/ /ting 'dzin g.yo med khri srong lde'u btsan rje/ /bka' dang dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos rnams//72bskos ra bcad skad kyis gtan phab rab thong tshogs//bsnyen bkur lha yi bla mar gzengs bstod pa'i//mi yi dbang phyug khri lde srong btsan zhabs//ljon shing swā la ltar mtho rgyal po'i rigs//bka' btsan 'bangs kun yang dag lam la sbyor //dkon cog bla mar 'dzin pa mi yi dbang //dge ba dpal zhes snyan pa'i grags pa che//lag na rdo rje 'bar ba'i mthu stobasakyis//gnod sbyin 'khor / rgyal ngal gsos bu//bran khol kha che'i yul gyi grub pa'i dbang//rnal 'byor mchog la brtson pa dgon pa ba//phyi dar bstan pa ma dag rnyog ma'i dri//bgrungs byed di paṃ ka ra spyan drangs nas//lha chos bdun ldan bka' gdams ring lugs kyi/mang rta chen po 'byom ston chos kyi rje//rigs kun bdag po dgyes mdzad he ru ga khyud sde rgya mtsho'i smin grol spel pa'i ne//'khon ra 'jam dbyangs dpa' bo'i tshul 'dzin pa//sa skya'i bla wo 'gro lab tshe ba'i gto//rnam drug rtsa ba'i bla mas rjes bzung ste//zab don chos kyi bdud rtsis thugs rgyud gtams//gnasalugs ga khug ma'i rang zhal legs gzigs ba//g.yu brag 'gro ba'i mgon po brtson 'grus grags//lung bstan ji bzhin soganyis gter kha bton//mkhan wo bza' yi dom sgro ngos su gto//gsang sngags rnying ma'i bstan 'dzin kun gyi gtsug/mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal po nyang ral rje//gangs can skye rgur bu gcig ma ltar brtse//gsodapyad bdud /sa 'gro mang srog rtsa 'thud//lha ldan 'jig ba'i chu

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shepo phyir 73na〉zlog pa'i//rdzu snyul mnga' brnyes lha rje dge ba 'bum//ne pā la yul grong khyer chen por 'khrungs//gnas lnga rig pa'i gtsug lag du mar sbyangs//lha sngags ye shes mthu yi mchog thun gyi//dngos grub mnga' brnyes pad+ma badz+ra che//nang rig mdo dang rgyud sde'i gnad kun gzigs//tha snyad shes byar mkhyen pa'i spyan ras yangs//grags pa don dang ldan pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta//dge 'dun grub pa bka' gdams bstan pa'i mes//mgrin par dbyangs can lha mo rab zhugs pas//'chad rtsod rtsom la spobs pa dge ba'i dbang //chos kun nges par thams cad mkhyen pa la//som nyi'i yul bral dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal//hor bod cha dgu yongs kyi ral pa'i rtser//zhabs sen zla ba tshes pa rtag shar bas//zhwa ser 'chang ba'i bstan pa'i ku mu da//'byed mdzad rje btsun bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde//tshe ring gnam gyi she mong dpung pa yis//mang bkur jing gir hor gyi rigs bltams pa//ma 'dris lus can kun gyi mgon po mchog/bde chen chos kyi rgyal po'i mtshan de snyan//sgrib gnyis 'ching ba'i rgya yis nyer bcings kyang //dam pa rnams dang las 'brel thogs pa tsam//sgro btags 'gro ba 'dren pa'i gzugs brnyan can//za hor rigs skyes zil gnon bshad pa rtsal//lo paṇa rab byung sngagasa'achang chos rgyal sogs//'gro ba'i dbang por 'tsham pa'i sgyu dra'i gar//legs ston dpal ldan bla ma dam pa yis//mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char 73bdu phob//mtha' klas spang rtogs rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun//mnyam gyur yon tan khyad zhugs srad min kyang //ches cher snyigs ma'i 'gro la thugs rje'i mthu//'gran gyi zla med pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal//rgya bal bod kyi mkhas grub bgrang yas rnams//mtshungs par lta ba'i rmongs dad can mang yang //'ja' lus snang srid dbang du bsdus pa'i tshe//tha mal gdan la tshul bstan gos kyis sgrib//de phyir mi 'gyur chos sku 'od dpag med//longs spyod rdzogs sku khro bo'i gar gyis bzhengs//mtsho skyes dus gsum sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku//au ṇ+ḍi ya na'i slob dpon khyod nyid tsam//mkha' spyod gtso mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma//g.yu lo bkod par 'phags ma sgrol ma yang //lha lcam yid 'dzin jo mo 'tsho rgya/ sdus//logs su 'tshol rnams byis pa'i nying ga gil

sku gsung thug rten gsar ba tshe pas dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag khomatsam//e dbyings stong pa'i rang gdangs man+da rar//bde byu waṃ yig zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin//pad+ma 'byung gnas zhi dang khro bo yi//dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i gtso bor lhun gyis grub//nyon mongs ri gzar rtse nas 'bab pa'i chu//bag yod rags kyis gyen ldog sdom brtson can//sna tsho gos yon tan bsil ba'i tshal du brnyes//pad+ma sam bha ngur sgrig 'chang ba'i gtso//lkog gyur gnas la ma rmonges dngosagrub kun//rā ga rak+ta'i yul du nyer thob pa'i//snyan pa'i grags pa 'bar ba'i thams cad mkhyen//dran pas gdung sel blo ldan mchog sred zhabs//brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos rnams ma lus pa//'dar nus khams gsum thams cad dbang 74na)da pa'i//dngos grub dga' ba tshal gyi gnas su brnyes//srid gsum zil gnon pad+ma rgyal po che//brlang sems lcags khams nyer dul gser khams su//bsgyur nus gdul dka'i 'gro ba ma lus pa//rab btul dngos grub ko sa gling thob pas//phan bde smi mor byed pa'i 'od zer ༅/shar phyogs za hor yul gyi rgyal khams su//nag po bdud kyi sdo yi dpung tsho gos rnams//'dul ba'i dngos grub rab brnyes 'jigs med rgyud//nga ro dbyangs su len pa'i shākya seng //dbus 'gyur 'chang ba'i dur khrod chen po sa/gnam lcags 'bar ba'i thog gi mu stegs kun//thal bar rlog pa'i dngos grub rab thob pa//seng ge'i rtsal du rdzogos pa'i sgra chen sgrog/stag tshang seng ge bsam grub phug pa mā/dregs pa tshar gcod las la rab bskul ba'i//dngos grub mthu ldan mu stegs steng na 'gying //'chol ba'i khro rgyal rdo rje gro bo lod //ri brag pho brang gtsug lag khang la sogs//'byon bzhud gnas rten brten pa ngo mtshar can//chu lhar mig la bdud rtsi ster mkhas pa//e dbyings chos lung dkar po'i phyogs nas longs//legs byas phung por spungs pa'i byed pa po//ra sahrūl snang bya 'dab nyer 'khod pa'i//byang gling bsam grub rgyal po khyo kyi shugs sa//dad dang gtong phod snying stobs mthu las so//dge gos 'di dang phyi ma'i yang srid kun//lha mi'i bde bar longs su spyod pa'i rang //myur du 'gro rnams sgrol phyir 'og min gyi//zhing du longs spyod rdzogasaskur 'tshang rgya shog/spyi dang khyad par mnyam med ༷tsong kha pa'i//bstan pa dar zhing de 'dzin zhabs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ rtogepad brtan/kha ba'i ljongs 'dir rdzogs ldan ji bzhin du//bde skyid dga' ston dpal la spyod par shog/gsung jig dbang dang grol lam mtho 74ba ji sa chu//blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtshor 'bebasamakhas pa//rdo rjes rab mas seng shes bteg pa'i khrir//bskal brgyar g.yo med chos 'khor bskor bar shog/dkar por 'dzag pa rnam par smin pa'i las/khyud lnga'i 'gro ched bsngo bas rgyas bto mthus//mkha' khyab skye rgu byang chen 'thob min bar//dge ba'i tshimatha' de snyed mi 'dzad shog/lha sabyang gling bsam 'grub rgyal po khyo shugs rnams kyis e nas sprul sku bag gro can mkhas bsgrugasabakug pa'i gong gsal gyi rten rnams ring 'tsho'i rten khrung sogs rang gas gyi don rgya byu po sgrub pa'i ched du bzhengs pa'i tshe dkar chag che brjod brtan bzhugs dang bcas pa zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar za hor gyi ban+de 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o//ldeng sbyor mkho pa' mit+ta las sa gas g.yo rgya mtsho/pa ris ka la hikalpa gu bo shu ṇa liḥdzā ge kadro pāḥtātāde wa po dog mā hormi/༅ ka'i9yag kho pas su ka nā/hi dwa sha su:sī ka pañtsa su sprul du mā lnga drum/mtha' klasabaskal sngon mkha' khyab 'gro la snying rje'i chus brlan thugs bskyed thog mar sa bon dar drag pa//rlabs ོ bya dka'i tshogs gnyis drod kyis yongs su smin pa'i sa bcu'i lam gyi rtsa stong yal ga can//pon ji skar hi tsa snyan bhā gas phal sgyu bha rī ka smokarmā ri shu pa:sus ka tsadha gam lha shiṣāpa(mya lha bra46zhu ba shākya sidhe na bā tre du:ya tsā tu/chos gzugs zung du 'jug pa'i 'bras bu'i khur gyisadud pa'i ho med tshon las phang phung 'dab ma'i grib//3 gzung dang bral rgyud lnga'i skye rgu bde bar ngal gso shākya seng ges deng 'dir dge legs stsole//bkra shis ri mo g.yas su 'khyil ba dpal gyi mgur nas tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi legs gsungs kun//klog pa thos bsam spong ba bsam gtan rab bstar grub dbang brgyad cu rgyan drug mchog gnyis tshogs//lung rtogs yon to rgya mtshor dbang phyug grub mtha' rnam bzhi smra ba'i nyi zla 'od po che/90/ma ga dha sogs rgya bal yul gyi rmongs mun yongs

sku gsung thug rten gsar stongs dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga shā'ibacil bshad sgrub snang byed dam par dad//rigs gsum thugs rje'i shing rtas legs drangs phan dang bde ba'i yid 'badze zhin nor//gnya' khri btsan nas byang chub 'od bar rim par byon pa'i rgyal blon dang //snga phyir dar ba'i bstan pa'i srog 'thud lo paṇa tsho gos kyi bka' drin lan//gzhal bar dka' ba'i don la dpyad tshe tshangs pa oṃ yig zol gyis brdzu//snang ba mtha' yas sgyu 'phrul rol gar a ti sha/lag na bad dkar dge bsnyen tshul 'dzin 'brom ston sogs//lha chos bdun gyi brgyud pa 3 med bka' gdams zhes//rnam thar gtsang ma'i bshes gnyen tsho gos rnams phyag gi yul//tshul khrims dag pa'i bzhin ras ches dkar ngos//bdag g.yin brje ba'i brtse spyan dkyus ring pos//mnyam sbyor e waṃ zung 'jug thub bstan rnams//'gal med gdams par shar ba'i btsong kha pa/kha phor gtsang ma'i rmongs dad tsam//ma yin rgyu mtshan gtan tshigasakyis/shes nas bsngags bya'i yul kun la//yan lag mchog gis 'dud par spro//'og min la sogs dag dang ma dag gnas kyi khyad par du//longasaspyod rdzogs dang sprul pa'i zlos gar du ma r+sā pa'i skus//dbang por la'i pa'i gsung gis 'gro rgyud wo mongs sel ba'i dus//mtha' klas chos kyis 'khor rnams yongs smin phun tsho gos lnga ldan mtshar//e ma chos kyi phung po'i tshad de 'di zhes tshur mthong byis pa'i blos//gzung bar byed pa zla ba'i ma ma a ma'i tshig gus gzhal ba yis//drag po'i dka' thub 'bad pas bsten kyang bskal brgya'i mal du ngal dub las//ma rga sum nyams su myong bar 'dod de dbang po'i gzhu la sbar 'dzin bzhi//'on te dpag tshad lnga bcu'i tshad kyi 7na ) khyod ldan chu shel dbang po'i dkyil 'khor gzugs//chung ngu'i rdzing bur 'gog med 'tsho ltar mchog dman gdul bya'i blo dang nyer la tshigasung //mi ba rje dgazungasathob dgra bcom rnams kyis zhakhrul med yi ger bkod pa'i glegs bam tshogs//ri bo dngos su skrungasapa lta bu'i zas las ji tsam 'os pa longs spyod bzhin//rgya bal yul du chos phung rgya mtsho 'khyil ba las//'jig rten mig gcig rnam dpyod skyogs kyis rab bcus pa//swā la'i sman ljongs skal bzang skye rgu'i skom sel chu/snga phyir 'gyur ro cog gi thub gsung ༷di med byung //srong btsan thugs rje'i 'phrul gyis

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)sam bho ṭas//bod mun sel sgron bteg rjes khri srong dus//legs bsgyur bka' 'grel khri lde gtsug brtan mthus//gsar bcad skad kyis gtan la ci yang phab//phyi dar rin 'brog mar mal rwa gnyan chag/sa rngog bus mtsho ni lo chen mtha' klas pas//'gyur zin bcos dang gsar du bsgyur ba sogs//bstan pa'i byi dor mdzad la gcig tu rangs/khyad par don la mi rmongs brda sprod gzhung //legasaspel shong dbang rim brgyud chos skyong bzang //rjes gong mang mthar paṇa chen smon 'gro ba//bsams kyin don gyi rgyal bstan nges par 'dzin//gsung rab lung nod kha rta zhe las 'dri sogs//sri zhu bgyisapa'i phan yon gzugs can du//grub na shong ba'i snod du 'jig rten 'di//chungs pas mes po gsar du bskrun la ngal//chad med bklag lung 'tshol bzhed gro lung pa//chos rgyal 'phags pa bag ston gzhen tshul sogs//7bsngon byon mang pos chos phyir dka' spyad la//bsams na rtag tu ngu la mos pa bskyung //phyi dus mtshudas med shākya rgyal mtshan dang //thu stone 'jigs med dpa' bo gong dkar bas//dgun chu dbyar gyi nyal 'gro ltar spel ba'i//yang dag mdzad par gzur gnas su mi dad//'jig rten chos ltar bcos nas mchogo dman mgo/bskor te stong 'ur gtsor 'dzin ma yin par//thub bstan srog gi ka ba bka' 'gyur ba'i//rnam thar dran tshe yid kyis gdung ba sel//bsod nams phung por spungs pa'i tshogs gsog ding //sgrub pa bzang po'i skal bzang 'di lta bu//sngon rabs dam pa'i drin du mi bsam par//'byog spyod lce gnyis skyong mang gad mo'i rgyu//skye gzhan bsags pa'i drang srong dmod pa'i mthus//blo ngan bzang brdzu'i lcags kyi gtun bu bdun//bstan sel log pa'i smra brjod dar rgyas mkhan//de 'dra bya gyur goms pa'i khyab 'jug bzhin//tshul 'chos rab bkra'i sgro gshog zlum por bsgyur//grags skam dbyar rngas 'dod dgu'i mngal khur 'dzin//phyogs lhungs sprin dkar dbus su mig gtod pa'i//'dren rlom rma bya mthong na mchi ma bku//tsan+dan tshang ching 'khrigs pa'i ma la yar//phal shing tsha sel dri ldan bsgyur ba ltar//deng dus khyim gyi bdag po gtong phod par//gyen nas gyen du blta bar cis mi rangs//bdud rtsis nyer ngo mes lha min sgra gcan ske//tshangs pa'i 'khor 9

sku gsung thugasarten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar chag yonalo dam bca' bzhi ldan gyis/ /bcad kyang srog gi 'tsho ba mi gtong phyir/ /(77na)zil dngar 'di ko 'bad pasabasgrub bya'iganas/ /'od gsal lha rigasasaskyong rgya ri ba'i/ /shad blon dra ma rimabyung brgyud pa las/ /dpa' mdzangs brtul phod dkon cog dar rgyas zhes/ /lugs gnyis blang dor blta la mig dkyusayangs/ /don med chudazar ma song bsagasapa'i nor/ /snying med snying por bsgyur nusarnam dkar las/ /bskrun pa'i lhag bsam nor gyi chu shel dbang / /skyengasanasabyang gling gola'i bshuladu bros/ /dpyad mi bzod pa'i gnyisamed rnam rgyal sogs/ /'ga' zhig ma gtogs sgrigs rtsom khungs btsun pa/ /tshal pa gitu dge ba'i blo grosakyi/ /dkar chag 'di ko sngon med legs pa'i lam/ /mdo 'dul sher phyogs phyi 'gyur gsang sngagasasteng/ /rdzogs chen dgongs 'dus sgyu 'phrul sgrub sde brgyad/ /gtsor bsdusanyer bsnan bcu gsum gyisalhag pa'i/ /brgya phrag glegs bam 'phreng ba tshar du dngar/ /mthing shog nam mkha' zhun 'dra'i ngosayangasapor/ /dbu khang lha bkod yig gzugs 'bur dod can/ /de phyir gser dngul khu ba gang 'drongasakyis/ /yi ge dbyibasalegasastengs kyisarnam par dag /phyi nang bzang gos zhal khebs gdong dar brtsegs/ /brkos pa'i glegs shing gser shog tshon rtsi mchor/ /glegasachab ra ma lugasasogasargyu tshogasakun/ /zol sbyor ma yin gtong phod gtsor brtan bsgrubs/ /gtsug lag mang por sbyangasapa'i yon tan can/ /'byung gnas e dbyibs chos lung dkar po nas/ /dbon (77ba)yig mkhasa'adus sor mo'i 'du byed kyis/ /sgyu ma mkhan gyi khengasapa bag la zha/ /thub pas 'gro ched tshogasaganyis bsagasapa'i dbang / /lha mo bstan mas lusaphyed sar thon ltar/ /bsod namasa'adi 'bras mi slu'i gtan tshigagasu/ /gsung rab mang por zhal 'ches rdo'i ri mo/ /rang blo mal du mi gnasa'abyog po'i 'gros/ /nyin 'da' mtshan mo'i mtha' rgyug blun po'i gshis/ /ma yin gang byasachud mi za ba'i gdengs/ /thob pa'i ngang tshul 'di las lhag par spro/ /de phyir gaṅgā'i yab gcig gtsug tor 'od/ /zhus nusalegasabyasaphung por spungs pa'i zlas/ /yangasapa'i 'jig rten ku mu da yi tshal/ /bayid pa'i 'dab ma kun nas 'dzum par shog khyu dang mi rgyu'i skye rgu bde ba'i gzhi/ /—93—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shergyal bstan nor 'dzin log rtog rgya mtsho sa /mi bying zhur ba'i bshes gnyen 'dus pa'i sde'i/ /'phrin las rus sbal stobs kyis 'degs par shog /spang rtogs mtho dma' sangs rgyas kun mnyam yang / /kha ba ri par bka' drin zla med pa/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po btsong kha pa'i/ /bshad sgrub ring lugs dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel shog /dzā rta'i rkang 'thung 'khrig pa'i sdum ra nas/ /dar zab thags su 'thag pa'i rgyal khams tshul/ /zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan srid kyi/ /khyab pas nor 'dzin bu mo mngal sbrum shog /bar mtshams med par gnam sa'i khyon kun la/ /mnga' sgyur dga' ba ldan pa'i pho brang che'i/ /bka' khrims gser shing 'gro rnams gnya' ba sa /yongs lci drang (78na)thig rngul chu 'bab par shog /sdig pa ri dwags 'phrul gyis mi brid par/ /tshe 'byor stobs kyi sī ta lang tsho mar/ /dgyes dgur spyod pa'i dga' byed mched po sa /rgyu sbyor der gtogs ma lus 'gyur bar shog /deng nas skye ba kun tu bde skyid gyi/ /mu tig mdzad pa med pa'i 'khri shing char/ /gsung rab 'di bskrun byed po yin no cog /yongs la 'bab pa'i skal bzang thob par shog /mi 'a sungs rin cen rgyur grub pu sta da /bzhengs pas yang srid kun bde'i lus mdangs gser/ /mdzes pa'i rna rgyan 'gram par legs 'phyang ba/ /gro bzhin skyes kyi ngang tshul 'dzin nus shog /'di skyid phyi ma mngon mtho'i bde tsam la/ /sred pa'i lha min gdon chen snying dbus su/ /ma zhugs mkha' mnyam 'gro la bsngos pa'i dge'i/ /gaṅgā byang chen rgya mtshor rtag 'bab shog /gos bu sangs rgyas de rgyu lung rtogs chos/ /tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i sems dpa' slob mar bcas/ /mchog gsum bkra shis lus can thams cad la/ khyab pa'i ngo mtshar g.yang du chags par shog khres lho brgyud e chos lung dkar po nas rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i bstan pa rin po che la sri zhur bskrun par mgon med zas sbyin dang chos mtshungs pa'i gzims shag lho pa dkon cog dar rgyas kyi tshal pa bka' 'gyur sor bzhag gi gsung rab rin po che ra ma lug tu dngos gtsang bar bzhengs pa'i tshe dkar chag che brjod smon lam dang bcas pa zhig dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi ban+de 'jam (74)dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen du 'bod pas srin po 94

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga (mazhes pa shing yos hor zla drug pa'i nyer drug gi nyin 'phral du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa sa spru di klu le shā da ya bha ( //sdeb sbyor mas ye ji t+ta las me 7 phreng ༅/82mu hika〈li khi rgya su mi rgyu ka kā te:po bishwaka mā ya:ta/zhes r+ṣa byu)r+sār khrug rgya hi bā la na rmā na kai gros smos yaḥnying 'byul kun rtog pir gyi rdzun shog ngos/ /dbang gzhu ltar bkra sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul gar//'dren byed bslu brid bkod pa rgya mtsho'i zhing //mthong snyam gyis yid rgan por 'khrid nus gang //bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i theg mchog rtser//phan bde'i legs byas 'bras bur bshad sgrub gling //lha sngags ye shes rol pa 'dus sde yi//zab lam rnal 'byor skyong ba'i dad rten du//nyer 'dzin blo bzang sbyin pas khur blangs te//bzhedas79 80nal yi rangs bgyis pa'i mtha' rten kun//gnas skabs sum rtsen bdag po'i bde skyid dang //gtan mdun zung 'jug lam der nyer bgrod shog/rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling gi rigasa'adzin 'dus sde'i tshogs kyi lam zab sgrub pa'i dad rten du rgya can gyi zhing bkod yang srid dang sprul pa sna tshogs kyi sku rten gtso bor byas pa 'di ni srin po zhes pa shing yos nag pa zla ba'i tshes brgyad gyi 'grub sbyor thog las 'go btsugs te khrums zla'i yar tshes dge bar grub pa'i rgyur/cog ras yug drug/spang 'bru/mthing 'bru gnyis mkhar bre re/spang shun/mthing shun/spang skya/sngo skya/li khri rnams phul bzhi re/mtshal/de'i shun pa/dmar skya/ba bla bzhi phul lnga re/rgya tshos dang zhun bre lnga re/spyin bre bzhi/dkar dreg bre bdun/gser ris la brtul ma zho nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang se ba bdun/gong gsham la gos thon thi gzhi sngon sa gzhi mdzod khyon kha dgu bcu go gsum/nang 'jar jus ser po kha nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang /dmar po kha nyi shu byed rtsa gcig/zhal khebs la byang dar dmar po kha nyis brgya dang gnyis/sman rnying ser khra kha brgya dang zhe drug/rgyab shar ling lu had kha sum brgya re brgyad/rlung mnon lce ler ling sngon kha dgu bcu go dgu/'dogs thag men sngon kha so bzhi/skud rtar gos dmar kha phyed bcu/gos dkar kha lnga/zur rgyan pa trar ༷ga sbug lnga/tog mdzod sna dang gzung gdan bcas

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)par lcags kro le ma bcu gnyis/ tshags la gser btso ma zho bzhi bcu zhe gsum dang se (79 80ba)ba lnga/ a lung la dngul srang brgyad zho gsum rnams song ba'i dngos gzhi'i khur len gnyer pa 'phyong rgyas blo bzang sbyin pa/ do dam 'go lung pa sngags rams pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ri mo ba dbu mdzad pho brang phun tshogs/ dbu chung gzhis rtse bkra shis dang rags kha a par/ byings gras 'phyong rgyasa'ajam dbyangs/ sdings po che mi 'gyur/ tshe brtan/ sha yon pa/ rtse gdong bstan 'dzin/ pa rnam mgon po/ rong pa tshangs pa/ bsod nams rgyal po/ tshe bdag /lnga 'dzom/ snye mo dme/ 'phrang 'go dkon cog /'phan yul mkhar rtse ba dge bsnyen rgyal po/ dpal gnas rgyal po/ a khu bsam grub/jog po dge bsnyen/ lha sa a lkug /lags rta mgrin/ dkon cog /dgos bsam/ 'jam dbyangs don grub/ lcang srung khang pa rin cen rdo rje/ bsam grub tshe ring / yar klungs pa 'dod yon/ rab brtan/gos bzo pa dbu mdzad tshangs ldan/ /dgos pa/ sngo bzo pa dbu mdzad gu sa dbu mdzad a bar don grub/ btsan skyabs/ a khug /phag skyag /blo bzang / sum dga'/ pad+ma/ rdo rje/ tshags pa dbu mdzad rtse chen pa/ pho brang pa bde chen lhun grub/ gnam pa rgyal po/ tshar sna rgyal po/ rtse chen brtan pa/ nyang ser a mdog /lcags bzo pa dbu mdzad dge rgyas pa rnams kyis byas nas legs par grub pa dza ya skyo/dri med thugs mtshor gsal ba'i snang ba kun/ /dag pa ngo mtshar mi zad rgyan 'khor gzugs/ /'char dang nub pa spangs pa'i 'dren pa mchog khru 'dzin zhing la dgyes pa'i pad dkar 'chang / /tshig rkang snga ma gsum bldabs te/ ya mun na yi sa spyod lha'i rgyal po/ /(81na'i ri rangs bgyis pa'i mtha' rten kun/ gnas skabs sum rtsen bdag po'i bde skyid dang / gtan bdun zung 'jug lam der nyer bgrod shog /rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling gi rigs 'dzin 'dus sde'i chogs kyi lam zab sgrub pa'i dad rten du rgya can zhing bkod yang srid dang sprul pa sna tshogs kyi sku rten gtso bor byas pa 'di ni srin po zhes pa shing yos nag pa zla ba'i tshes brgyad kyi 'grub sbyor thog las 'go btsugs te khrums zla'i yar tshes dge bar grub pa'i rgyur/ cog ras yug drug /spang 'bru/ mthing 'bru —96

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag tre'iganyis mkhar bre re/ spang shun/ mthin shun/ sdang skya/ sngo skya/ li khri rnams phul bzhi re/ mtshal/ de'i shan pa/ dmar skya/ ba bla bzhi phul lnga re/ rgya chos dang zhun ze lnga re/ sbyin bre bzhi/ dkar dreg bre bdun/gser ris la brtul ma zho nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang se ba bdun/ gong gsham la gos thon thi gzhi sngon sagazhi mdzod khyon kha dgu bcu go gsum/ nang 'jar jas ser po kha nyi shu rtsa gnyis dang dmar ba kha nyi shu phyed rtsa gcig /zhal khebs la byang dar dmar po kha nyis brgyad dang gnyis/ sman rnying ser khra kha brgya dang zhe drug /rgyab shar ling lu hang kha sum brgya re brgyad/ rlung gnon lce ler long sngon kha dgu bcu go dgu/ 'dogs thag min sngon kha so bzhi/ skud rtar gos dmar kha phyed bcu/ gos dkar kha lnga/zur rgyan pa trar sag sbug lnga/ rtag mdzo sna dang gzung gdan bcas par lcags krol ma bcu gnyis/tshags la gser btso ma zho bzhi bcu zhi gsum dang se (80bsgo lnga/ a lung la dngul srang brgyad dang zho gsum rnams song ba'i dngas gzhi'i khur len gnyer pa 'phrong rgyas blo bzang sbyin pa/ do dam 'go lung pa sngags rams pa bsod nams rgyal ma zhan/ ri mo ba dbu mdzad pho brang phun tshogs/ dbu chung gzhis rtse bkra shis dang rags kha a bar/ byings gras 'phyod rgyas 'jam dbyangs/ sdings po che mi 'gyur/ tshe brtan/ sho yon pa/ rtse gdong bstan 'dzin/ pa rnam mgon po/ rong pa tshangs pa bsod nams rgyal po/ tshe bdag /lnga 'dzom/ snye mo dme/ 'phrang 'go dkon chog /'phan yul mkhar rtse ba dge bsnyen rgyal po/ dpal gnas rgyal po/ a khu bsam grub/ jog bo dge bsnyen/ lha sa pha spru lkug /lags rta mgrin/ dkon cog /dgos bsam/ 'jam dbyangs don grub/ lcang srung kha pa rin cen rdo rje/ bsam grub tshe ring / yar klungs pa 'dod yon/ rab brtan/ gos bzo ba dbu mdzad tshangs ldan/dgos pa/ sngo bzo ba dbu mdzad gu sa dbu mdzad a bar don grub/ btsan skyabs/ a khug /phag skyag /blo bzang / sum dga'/ pad+ma/ rdo rje/ tshags pa dbu mdzad rtse chen pa/ pho brang ba bde chen lhun grub/ gnam pa rgyal po/ char sna rgyal po/ rtse chen brtan pa/ nyang ser a mdog /lcags bzo pa dbu mdzad dge rgyas pa rnams kyis byas nas legs par grub pa dza yan+tu/ /dri med thugs mtsho me gsal ba'i —97—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shesnang ba tso//dag pa ngo mtshar mi zad rgyan 'khor gzugs//'tshar dab ya spangs pa'i 'dren pa mchog/gru 'dzin zhing la dgyes pa'i pad dkar 'chang //tshig rkang snga ma gsum bldabs te/ya mun na yi saspyod lha'i rgyal po/81na skongs can bstan pa'i dbu brnyes tho tho ri//au ṇ+ḍi ya na'i dpa' bo dkon cog 'bangs//thub bstan dar mdzad tshangs pa lha'i me tog/'phags yul nor 'dzin skyong ba dge ba dpal//lha chos bdun gyi srol 'byed 'brom ston rje//zab mo'i lam gyi grub brnyengs g.yu brag pa//ra sar chu bo'i 'jigs sel dge ba 'bum//gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇa chen dge 'dun grub//mthu stobs mnga' bdag bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde//sbyin pa'i pha rol son pa 'jig rten dbang //bod yul thog ma'i rgyal po gnya' khri btsan//bdud mo'i ltas ga g.yang lon dad pa brtan//thub bstan srol brta srong bawo sgam po rje//yab mes bstan srog 'dzin pa'i khri ral pa//lag na rdo rjes rjes bzung dgon pa ba//rigs kun bdag po rtse wo snying po'i zhabs//snga 'gyur chos kyi sgron me mnga' bdag myang //pad+ma badz+ra ba la yul paṇ+ḍita//dbyangs can bzhad pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dpal//gnam gyi brgyud las yon tan rgya mtsho'i gter//sdeb sbyor sgrog phreng /koli snye(sbomaṇ+ḍa spu shān+ta kre lha lde bā pa tsā sproḥpru kā shā lha lā sha shrī:mā hāshrī so pā re te ru kyaḥ.a nu lus kyi dkyil 'khor du//zhi khro'i lha tsho gos chu zla ltar//rab gsal rigs rnams kun gyi gtso//dpal ldan che mchog he ru gaḥ/81bsgom rtog blo yi me long du//gcig pu nyid las du ma'i gar//nying 'byul brdzun bris ri mo de//bstad med zog po'i rang mtsha tsam//'on te rdo ba'i ring bsrel bzhin//snying nas mos ngor dngos grub rnams//'grub pa snang ba'i chos rnams kun//ka dag dbyingasasu sgyur nus mtshar/mang yos rnam par rgyal ba'i 'dus pa'i tshogs kyi zab lam rnal 'byor gyi rten du gnyer pa blo bzang sbyin pas khur blangs nas rgya can gyi lha tshogs rnams bzhengs pa'i rgyu song sogs zhib cha mtha' dag zhing bkod gtso thang gi rgyab yig tu gsal lo//phyag rgya gcig gi thog mtha' yis/'khor 'das nus stobs brag gi ri//'thag bye/ /la gnon tshe yi bdag/'jam dpal gshin rje

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (7dus dgra /mthong ba tsam gyi lha srin kun/ /dngangs mdzad 'phrol ba'i khro rgyal che/ /rdo rje'i bla ma gro bo lod/ /he ru ka dpal gar du bzhedas/ /mi srun dregs pa'i snying ga sa /brkyang bskum zhabs kyi stang stabs can/ /lag na 'bar ba rdo rje'i mtshon/ /gdengs pas sde brgyad kun 'dul bsngags/ /nyi ma'i bu yi dpung tsho gos rnams/ /ming mthar gtong ba'i dpa' bo che/ /'chi med rig pa 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /pad+ma tshe dbang rtsal der dad/ /sgrib gnyis nyes brgya ma lus pa/ /phyungs pas de gos zug rngu'i dbyings phyug mas/ /gzhan min dpal ldan re ma ti/ /rdo rje 'bar ba gdengs tsam gyis/ /dam sri lha srin mo dngangs dang / /lhan cig nus stobs mngal lhungs pa'i/ /zil gnon rta mgrin drag rtsal che/ /dgra snying khrag dron lha 'phreng gi /tshems dkar g.yogs kyang ma tshim par/ /sbar mos nang 'brol 'drad byed pa'i/ /beg tse lcam dral gnod sbyin gtso/ /tshe mtha' yasapa'i waṃ yig gzugs/ /gos dkar e dbyings mnyam sbyar bas/ /srog gi gzugs gyur dwangs ma kun/ /rab drongs 'chi bdag g.yul las rgyal/ /mar me mdzad dpal ye shes kyi/ /dngas pa'i chu mtshor rgyud sdebazhi'i/ /lha tsho gos gzugs brnyan sku gsung thugs rten gsar ba tshe ngas dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (makyis/ /don la gos pa min kyang rmi lam ltar/ /med bzhin kun rdzob ngang du mthol zhing bshags/ /mtha' 'jig rten 'di'i phyi phyogs rme tshams sogs/ /brjod dka' rdul snyed zhing gis sangasargyas dang / /gu ru pad+ma zung 'brel mdo sngags cho me/ /'khor lo gdul bya dang 'tsham bskor bar bskul/ /mya ga mtsho ni dus gsum gyi/ /bsod nams byas so cog 'bras gangs ljongs 'dir/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje'i 'phrin las yongs khyab pas/ /'gro rnams bde skyid dpal la spyod par bsngo/ /par 'di'i ched du sgo gsum 'bad pa dang / /bklags shing 'chang kun yang srid thams cad du/ /dgra gdon bgegs kyi g.yul las rab rgyal zhing / /tshe 'byor dbang thang rnam thos bur 'gran shog /nyem mongasades bskyed sgrib gos rim srab nas/ /skye bar pad 'byung zhal mthong gsung thos te/ /ring min rnga yab dpal rir rigs 'dzin gyi/ /gral zhugs bskyed rdzogs rdzogs chen gyis grol shog /bsod nams yongs 'du gsar pa'i 'khri shing gi /phang phung lo 'dab rgyas pa'i grib bsil du/ /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par bod yul 'gros/ /bde zhing brtan pa'i 'bras bu myong bar shog /su sti pra dzā ༷ ཿyi sgrar drangs pa'i/ /phun tshogs dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i (85ba'i dbyangs kyis/ /dga' skyid dbyar gyi lang tsho nyer bkug ste/ /thog mtha' bar dge'i shis pas khyab gyur cig /ces dpal sangs rgyas gnyisapa yo ṇ+ḍi ya na'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rnam par thar pa gter kha gong 'og pa khal smug po sogs gter byon mang por rgyas bsdus dang / gdul bya'i blo dang bstun pa'i rigs mi gcig pa sna tsho gis snang zhing pad+ma rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sherje phyon gling pas bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtshos thog drangs chos bka' mtha' klas pa brtan pas gter ston du grags shing pad+ma bka'i thang yig 'di nyid chu 'brug zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad gza' zla ba dang skar ma dbo 'dzom pa'i nyin yar klungs shel gyi brag rdzong pad+ma brtsegs pa'i ngos pad+ma shel phug gi sgo srung khyab 'jug chen po'i thugs ka nas gu ru phyon gling pas las ldan gyi grogs gzhu kun ra ba hor pa sgom shāka dang bcas gter nas spyan drangs pa la yi ger lhad zhugs pa'i dpe sna tshogs shig 'dug pa lo chen be+e ro'i rnam 'phrul gter ston shes rab 'od zer gyi dgongs pa skong slad/ /bod yul 'dir gnam gyis bskos pa'i rgyal po dpal phag mo gru pa'i mdun na 'don rgya gar gyi rgyal rigs swā la pa chen po 'phyong rgyas dpal ri'i bar zhes tshad thub tu byed na'ang 'phrin las ha cang ches pa'i yig 'bru 'thor pa dang mi gsal ba kha yar 'dug pa lho brag sprul sku'i chos 'byung dang sog bzlog pa blo gros rgyal mtshan zhes rnam dpyod dang ldan pa des brtsams pa'i skyon chen po'i rnam thar ltar gter ston rdo rje gro lod kyi lung bstan dpe rnying pa lcags smyug ma nas rnyed pa mchog sprul legs ldan rdo rje'i dus rtags sogs gsal por snang bas gsar du bcug pa tsam las bcos med 'di dpal skyon chen po'i zab gter nas lung gis zin pa grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtshos par gsar pa zhig bskos na zhes bskul bas rkyen byas/ rang nyid kyang mi phyed ba'i dad pas yid drangs te kha ba ri pa rnams la gcig tu phan pa'i chos sbyin mi zad pa'i bar za hor gyi rigs las sngags pa rgan po che mchog 'dus pa rtsal pad+mas ming btags rdo rje thogs med rtsal du 'bod pas par byang dang bcas te 'du gyis nas shing yos dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du brko rgyur bsrings pa par zhus dang do dam pa yar 'brog pa dge slong blo gros brtan pa/ rtse skor ba dge slong blo gsal mkhas pa/ bkras gling dge slong smra ba'i dbang phyug gsum dang / yig mkhan blo bzang dam chos/ blo bzang nyi ma/ dga' —104

dang brten la sri zhu mā/bskrun pa'i ngo mtshar cho ga brjod la spro//zhes tshigs su bcad pas sdun bsus nas gleng bar bya ba ni//lus can mtha' dag 87bgi mgon dang skyabs dang gling dang dpung gnyen rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shemadzad pa gsum gyi phyi ma mnga' bdag chos skyong ba'i rgyal po lha sras khri srong lde'u btsan gyis mkhan slob rnam pa gnyis kyis thog drangs mkhas grub lo paṇa rnams dbu'i thod du bkur te bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad pa'i dang por/ dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyis lha srin rnams dam la btags shing sa gzhi btul te nye( tan+ta pā ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe byas nas bzhengs pa bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang zhes lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhing mchog dam pa 'di nyid la sa skyong dga' ldan pa rdo rje rnam rgyal mched gnyis kyis sa mo bya lo phan sri zhur mdzad pa'i dkar chag sngon du bkod zin na'ang lcags khyi nasabazung me 'brug bar gyi mdzad pa ni/ khams gsum me tog sgrol du gser zangs las grub pa'i gañdzi ra dpangs rgyug mtho bcu gsum pa/ dbu tshal gser khang gling / 'jam dpal gling / ārla pa lo'i gling /dga' ldan byams pa gling / byang chub sems bskyed gling / pe dar lcog ste drug la rgyug mtho bcu yod do/ /dge rgyasang du rgyug mtho brgyad yod/ mchims phu skyon gsang phug tu rgyug mtho bcu yod pa rnams gsar du bskrun no/ /byung gyur rnam 'dren gas la yi rtser/ /mdzod ldan 'od 'bar nus pa bsod nams 'di/ /bsags(88na)'bras skye bar smin pa glang po che/ /gser sbyangs zhun ma'i snye ma g.yur za shog /dkar chag sngon mar gsal ba'i khro kong rnams/ /sbug skyon byung ba bskyar sdugs kyi zhabs ra kha yig can/ yang gsar bzos khro kong zla drug 'khyongs pa nyer gsum dang zla gsum ldang ba brgyad rnams kyi nang du zangs dmar gyi kong g.yel mo lcags kyi rkang gsum dang bcas pa bzhi bcu/ ga kong g.yu rtsi ma gsum bcas mchode khang che phra so sor bgos nas phul bar bgegs mi 'jug pa dang rten rnying rnams la yang rab gnas skyong ba phan yon shin tu che ba nas/ zhad sna nam pa rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi ye shes sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i zlos gar rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku mchog grwa bcas sum cu rtsa gnyis thub bstan rdo rje brag dang lag na pad+mas byin gyis brlabs par grags pa rgyal ba'i sras po shes rab 'phel ba'i sprul pa'i sku grwa bcas nyer bzhi rnams rim par spyan drangs te zhag bdun gyi —106

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mobar bsnyen bkur nas rab tu gnas shing me tog 'thor ba mdzad/ zhig gsos kho nar dbu rtse'i mda' yab sogs gtsug lag khang gi ched du shing bzo ba dgus zla ba lnga dang zhag nyer gsum song ngo / /rgyu skar bsnyems 'phrog snang gsal bzhu snod dang / /rten gsar lnga phrag zla lhag rkang 'thung bzo/ /legasaspel dam tshig dngas mtshor ye shes kyi/ /bkod pa'i ri mo 'char 'dis bdag byin rlobs/ /sngon chad dkar me khang dang snod sogs par bkab med pa gsar du spel ched (88ba)'degs khal nyi shu rtsa grangs las grub pa'i zangs chen nang du ban chen tshad bzhi bcu rtsa gcig re 'gro ba gsum/ mar khu bsing ba dang sdugs snod 'degs khal nyer brgyad las grub pa'i zangs gzhed lcags kha ma a lung dang bcas pa cha/ zangs kyi mar skyogs kha lcags la yig ge ma gcig dang / de mtshudas kha lcagasamed pa dgu/ zangs tshags che chung gnyis/ pang rgyan g.yu rtsi ma lnga bcu thams pa dang phan rtsi ma brgya nyi shu/ mar thur/ shing gzheng sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams tshang 'grig tu bskrun nas de dag 'jog pa dang las byed kyi gnas khang bya lugs gnam lha byang chub dang gnod sbyin chen po gnyis la ji ltar 'gab gsol lan du dbu rtse rigs gsum nas brtsis pa'i byang shar mtshams sdug 'dre'i gzhal yasakhang 'di dang nye ba'i sa yul 'di ru bkod pa byas nas/ gnas khang gegs med du 'grub cing gnasaskabs dang slad kyi 'gro ba rnams la yang phan pa rgya chen po yod tshul lung bstan pa ltar khang pa ka ba brgyad cu skor nas dkyil du ka drug steng mar shing rtsi tshon khra gser shog can shod dang bar gsum gyi sgo sge khung thams cad tshal rtsi lcags shan ma/ de'i g.yas g.yon du ka gzhi steng shod bar gsum/dkar me bzhu thab ka drug nyis thog gi rtsis/ mdo khyams nub sgo sdus h+phu da kyi mkhris ka gnyis nyisathog dkar phibs dang bcas pa/ gzhan ma nas khang sogs steng shod kha shas yod pa grub 'tshams/chos skyong chen po nas gnas (pon〉nga 'dir mar me'i rgyun ji srid bar 'phel ba'i rten 'brel du/rigs gsum mgon po dang rnam sras 'khor bcas bzhed dgos pa'i lung bstan ltar/ spyan rasagazigs/ 'jam dbyangs/ phyag rdor/ ngal bsos po bzhi mi tshad lhag tsam/ 'khor rta bdag brgyad —107

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)sku'i phyed cha'i tshad rnams la grang gser sbyib byugs can gzi 'od dang ldan pa legs par grub par longs su spyod rgyu'i tshogs kyang sngon nas ru khag nyer drug btsugs pa'i rtsi bcud kyis gtsug lag khang tshang mar/ mar me nyin mtshan 'byongs pa'i rgyun bzang na'ang gor nad sogs glo bur ba'i 'phel 'grib kyi rtag mi thub pa dang / lha khang grangs mang ba'i snang gsal gyi mchod rgyun nyag phra ba mi 'byung ba'i ched du bsam yas gzhung rgyug gi bogs steng nas sa ngan hred gyong che ba phran bu ma gtogs deb tu sel len nges kyi 'bru bogs khal sum stong lhag bcas mchod pa dang gsol ga'i stong sgo/ tshong pa mi khal gyi chas lag g.yog sogs dgos cha che phra'i thebs su gzhis ka bkra shis gling la gtogs pa'i mi gra bsdad grong dud che chung sum cu skor gyi yong 'bab bogs shas lag 'debs dang bcas par 'bru khal chig stong brgya bcas thon pa sbyar bar dkar me rang la gang dgos min pa phyi khral gyi rigs rtsa chag /deb dang 'byed khra'i don bzhin gan gtsang du sbyar ro/ /skye mang goms pa'i ma rig mun sel sgron/ nyi zla skyengs byed snang gzi bla nas blar/ /chad med srid rtser snyeg nus rigs gsum mgon/ /rnam (yob)thos sras kyis 'phrin las rtag 'jug shog /dkar mer brten pa'i khang pa sa zhing ru ba sogs phyi nang gi dkor nor mtha' dag phyi 'khyar mi yong zhing dkar me'i rgyun bstan pa ji srid gnas kyi bar mi chad pa'i gnyer gtad kyi 'phrin las zhu rtsis yin tshul chos skyong chen po rnam gnyis la zhus pa'i tshe gnyis ga'ang shin tu dgyes shing gtum la rngams pa'i drag po'i sgo nas sngon chad nyams gsos bgyis pa rnams kyang sdug 'dre'i yid dang mthun pa'i legs pa byung / slad nas kyang byed dgos khyad par mar me'i gnas khang gi phyi nang bar gsum gyi nor rdzas/ dkar mo'i 'bru drug gi yong sgo sa gzhis mi gra so gos sbyar ba 'di dag kyang legs/ sdug 'dre ni gu ru pad+ma'i bka' bzhin byed pa legs nyes kyi bstang 'dzin/ dam tshig gi rjes gcod pa'i 'dre zhig yin pas gnyer btad drag po bzhin khas len gyi gnyer kha drag po byed par gtod lugs phyi nang gsang gsum yod pas phyi'i gnyer kha tsam yin nam ji ltar yin gnang byung bar phyi nang gsang gsum ga'i 'bul ba yin zhus lan/ de ltar —108

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag slo'iyin na mar me'i gnas khang 'dir yang sdug 'dre'i drag po'i gzhal yas khang rten rdzas tshang ba'i mdos gzhi sogs gu ru pad+ma'i zab gter las byung ba'i bca' gzhi yongs rdzogs shig gi bkod pa bsgrigs dang bkod pa de byung tshe sdug 'dre yang dus dbang gis gnas der yong spro zhing srung stob byed gsung don bzhin rnam sras lha khang gi g.yas lcog ka bzhi'i shing rtsi logs bris sogs rgyas pa grub cing / de (90na)yang lho nub kyi lcog gsar bla ma lha khang du sngar byang chub gling sku skyes btsugs pa'i mdos kyi mtshan nyid cha tsam yang ma tshang ba'i zag thog de rigs la ma song ba zhig bstar ba la skye brgyud rigs rus sbyang stobs sogs kyis bsnyems pa'i gsang sngags rnying ma'i bstan 'dzin nam
