mkha'i skar tshogs ltar mang yang rgyud 'grel bla ma'i man ngag sogs la nang byan chud pa nyi zla bzhin grogs gzhan gnyis pa med par rten yang bskyar chos skyong chen po'i bka' phebs bzhin rdo rje brag nas chos rgyal byang pa rigs 'dzin chen po'i mchog gi sprul sku spyan drangs/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sku'i sprul pa bla ma mnga' bdag chen po myang ral pa can gyi zab gter las byung ba'i pe skar gyi rgyud sgrub thabs man ngag skor dang / mnga' bdag thugs kyi sprul pa mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che pad+ma dbang rgyal rdo rje dang gcung zhang sna nam pa'i yang srid rigs 'dzin chen po legs ldan rdo rje thun mong las byung ba'i zab gter rigs 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi cha lag gnod sbyin dmag dpon gyi rgyud man ngag skor rnams la rgyal dbang pad+ma ka ra nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du byin rlabs brgyud pa mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs kyi drod ma nyams/ mkha' la dam tshig rdo rje'i rwa gur ma bral/ bar du sman rag gi rgya mtsho ma bskams shing gtor ma'i ri bo ma nyil/ 'og tu dkyil 'khor bri thig gi bkrag ma yal/ dam sel 'dre khyer mi dbar khyi zhugs kyis bslad pa med pa'i khungs (90ba)ldan gyi phyag bzhes man ngag ltar thun rdzas rnams nyer bsdogs dgos pa'i zhal ta sa skyong sbyin pa'i bdag por gsol nas 'du bgyis te bkod pa'i rim pa yang / spyir rgyud sde rin po che mtha' dag dgongs pa mthun par dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad gtso bo'i ye shes kyi gzung byar bshad cing bskyed pa ma ha yo ga'i lugs la kun —109

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)rdzob tu snang srid kyi dregasapa rnamasadon dam par zhi khro dam pa rigasabargya'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa'i phyir/mnga' ris pad+ma dbang chen rin po ches//rigs lnga'i rang rtsal rgyal chen sku lnga dang //spyan ma la sogs rang gdangasayum lnga dang //semasadapal sems ma yul drug ngo bo nyid//nang blon sha grol kyi grol phyi blon tshogs//zhes gsal bar gsungasashing lung a nu yo ga ba ro rkyang dbu gsum dregasab rgyud gsum gyi ngo bor mdzad pa saskya tshad kyi rna bar ma grags pa'i snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan kha'u pa yab sras kyi bzhed pa dang phyogs mthun/rdzogs pa a ti yo gar khri srong rnam sprul chos kyi rgyalapo dpalabakrashisastobasargyal gyis/snang stong dbyer med dregasargyud pho mo'i tshogs//gnyisamed dbyingasalasalasabazhi'i thugs dam bskul//zhes snang stong zung 'jug tu thag chod pa ste bdag chen rdo rje 'chang yan chad kyi gdung brgyud rim par byung pa'i chig brgyud kyi dgongs pa dang mthun pas na/thamasacad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis/snang srid chosakun rgyud gsum dregasapa'i 91nadangos//de yang rang semasagasal stong zung 'jug tu//ngo 'phrod saskya'i bla chen thugasakyi bcud//cesapa'i don laganasapa'i phyir bdag chen kun rin pas/mgon chen dang chosargyal/pu tra dang gnod sbyin rgyud gcig pa kho na'i shesabya mtha' bkag de 'dra dgosapar mi semasamod/bye brag shel 'phreng dkar po'i rgyud las/rdo rje khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul//srog bdag gser gyi shang shang can//zhesadang /srog bdag khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul//chibagasu seng ge dkar po chibs//lag na me dar 'bar ba 'phyar//gnod sbyin kun gyi dmag dpon mdzad/khesathugasadang 'phrin lasakyi rgyal bo khyung chen klu 'brug 'dul dang don gcig cing de dang gnod sbyin go po tha mi dad pa'i gcig pu nyid las du ma'i rnam par 'phrul pa yin kyang gnasaskabs su rgyud man ngag gi dgongs don ltar gtso bo las mkhan gyi rnam par snang ba'i lugs bzhin 'drisamed so sor mdzad pa'i rnam grangs la dbus su sku lnga'i gzhal yasakhang blosaslong gi rtser so sor tsakra gser shog can zlum po phyi nang gsang ba'i rten dang mchod rdzas sna tshogs dang bcasapa'i g.yon du chos rgyal sku lnga'i mdos ri rab bang rim can gyi rtser 0

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ho shākagadugs/khyung gtsang nam mkha' sogs stong skud sna tsho gos las grub cing /rgyang bu/mda' 'phang /pho gdong mo mdong /phyi nang gi mthun pa'i dam rdzas dngos dang ri mor bkod pas mar thams cad tshang ba 9ba ) dngul phor du sku lnga'i rtag gtor/gtor sgam rtsi ma lcags shan ma kha btags mthing kha'i khebs bcas rnams/g.yas phyogs su gnod sbyin dmag dpon kun khyab rdo rje drag po rtsal gyi sku bas bse'i khrab glog dar ru co /rgyal ma' tog ldan gos dmar gyi thod/gos dmar gser ma'i khrab gdan/gos dmar gyi zhabs chings rgyan can/gos lham mi mgos spras pa/gos bzang bsgrigs kyi dpung gdan nyis brtsegs la gser dngul gyi me long dang nyi zlas spud pa/gos dar sna tsho gis kyi snyan shal sogs khog zhugs kyi cha lugs ji lta ba/sgrub kor nas phyi gsol kha la brten nas dam can sprin ltar 'du ba/nang sba lcag la brten nas dam can khyi ltar 'brang ba/gsang ba mkhar dang bla rdo srog 'khor la brten nas dam can khru ltar chags pa/de kho na nyid bdud zhags dmar po la brten nas dgra bgegs cham la 'bebs pa'i rten rdzas/bse phor gru gsum nang du gnod sbyin chen po'i rtag gtor gdugs dar dmar mda' bcas khebs gos nag can/gzhan yang rtsa ba gsum gyi mchod gtor sogs bkod pas mdzes pa/dbus su bla bre gos sngo skya gser 'brug ma/mtha' nyis tsho me/sham bu ma rtse ha sna byas pa che legs/de'i g.yas su si'u ma'i bla bre/mtha' gos dmar/sham bu ma ha zhes byasapa/g.yon du bla bre/'brug ma 'ja' bzhi gshibs/sham bu ma ha zhes byas pa/gos sna tsho gos kyi lce le yod pa'i 'phan lag gsum ma gcig/gos gser 92na ) ma'i 'phan chung lce le ma lag gsum yod pa cha 'dra nyi shu tham pa/snam sbyar chung ngu gcig dang 'khar gsil chung ba gcig/gos mchin gyi g.yang gzhi mi lngags gzugs gcig/lda ldir dar sna tsho gos spel ba/ka ba bzhin khrab sram rgyan ma bzhi dang sha gsham ma brgyad so sor rmog bcas dar ru wo sogs cha sgo /tha'i jir rang gi gri shel rdo gser tshags ma gcig dang /mgo bo ba sos byas pa'i ring ba gcig/sngo shubs kha gsar lag longs gcig/sbu la ha ri'i sag thag kha gsar bzhi/dgra sta gnyis/me mda' bzhi sogs spyan gzigs sna tshogs/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gemachod lcog steng mar hor ting che ba dpus legs bdun tshar/ li ting 'bring lnga tshar dang chung ba bdun tshar/ khro'i sman rag ka pā la stegs bcas/ zhal dkar chag med stegs ldan/ rgya rag gi mchod kong gcig dang zla drug 'byongs pa'i khro zangs kyi kong lcags kyi rkang gsum dang bcas pa/ nyin mtshan thub pa'i sdong rkang re/ mar thur 'jab bcas zangs sder bzhi/ rag sder gcig /lcags kyi lding spos gcig /rgya sbub legs pa gcig /gser rnga gsar bzos cha/ zangs dmar gyi gtor gcig /zangasarkyan gcig grum tse gcig /ras gdan kha gang ma gcig /bar skas gyi sgo phibs la gzig dred rgya gnyis dang bcas pa'i lding gsob/ thog steng dbus su gser zangs kyi gañdzi ra/ mdun dbus nas za 'og gi rgyal mtshan/ seng ge'i rgyal mtshan sha ru dang thugs dmar sbrags pa/ srin por spre'u'i (92ba)rgyal mtshan/ rlung du dom gyi rgyal mtshan/ byang du spyang zhi'i rgyal mtshan/ dbang gi rgyal mtshan/ dred kyi rgyal mtshan/ dbang ldan du stag gi rgyal mtshan/ mer rma bya'i rgyal mtshan/ lhor bya rgod kyi rgyal mtshan rnams/ khang pa'i phyi rol tu sa 'phan che ba brgyad/ gsol kha ba mi gcig gis nyin star thor gsol gyi 'phrin las gyer bar gtor chas dang tsho gis chas sogs cha tshang / srod gsol gyi dgos gong bzhin dang zla ba ngo re bzhin gyi tshes brgyad/ bco lnga/ nyer gnyis te gsum la lcog pa ba brgyad kyi 'phrin las don bcu ma gtong chas mchod gtor tshogs 'khor bsnyen bkur dang yon sogs rgyu song gtong deb tu gsal lo/ /rang snang dag pa'i rigs brgya dregs pa'i ngor/ /yongs shar gnam sngon mtsho la ngang mo bzhin/ /'du ba'i gnad shes rig sngags 'chang ba dang / khyu sbyor zung 'jug gis bcol las kun sgrubs/ /de yang rgyal ba'i sras po gter chen rdo rje gling pas gnam lcags brag nasagadan drangs pa'i le'u brgya dang gcig yod pa'i thang yig las/ mtha' dmag dbus rdib 'bri dang phag pa 'thab/ /dbus gtsang sil bu phag khyu tshal par 'gro /stag tshang zab lung sbas ba'i gter kha 'di/ /mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags de bstan nas 'byung / /gter ston rdo rje gro lod ces bya 'byung / /zhes dus rtags dang gter gnas 'on phu stag tshang shin du 'grig cing gter ston gyi mtshan yang paṇa 112

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shā'ichen sku mched thun mong gi zab gter rigs 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi lung byang las/ /'di nas nyi ma nub phyogs su/ /yang (93na〉sil pra dun rtse yi lho/ /ge sar klu yi kha gnon byang / /ri rgyal glang chen 'gying 'dra'i 'dabs/ /chu chen drag po 'bab pa'i 'gram/ /glo bo ma thang zhes bya'i phur/ /rje rigasasngags long rnal 'byor pa/ /pha ma rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi bu/ /kun bzang dgongs pa'i klong nas bskrun/ /bi mā 'tsho rgyal sprul pa'i sras/ /spun bdun tshigs sam mtha' ru 'byung / /lhum nas hūṃ hrīḥ'i sgra sgrog cing / /skyes pa'i lo nas bde skyid ldan/ /yul khams bde zhing bsam don 'grub/ /chu khams lug gam sprel lo ba/ /bdag gis byin brlabs pad+ma rgyal/ /'tsho rgyal byin brlabs 'od zer ming / /chos rgyal byin brlabs gro bo lod/ /nam snying rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ /bdud 'joms byin brlabasardo rje'i ming / /be+e ros byin brlabs gter bdag gling / /zhes byung ba'i rigs rus yab yum yul sogs ni sku mched du song ba'i so sor dbye ma dgos/ spun bdun gyi tshigs te bar ma dang glang ngam lug gi lo pa ni mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che dang / tha ma dang spri'u lo pa ni legs ldan zhabs yin pa gdon mi za zhing mtshan gyi rnam grangs kyang gcen la pad+ma dbang rgyal rdo rje thogs med rtsal/ gter bdag gling pa/ yon to 'od zer dang gas la rdo rje gro lod/ bdud 'joms rdo rje zhes byung bas gro bo lod dang 'grig pa yin cing / sgos gter 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi lo rgyus rin cen 'phreng ba las/bdag gi smon lam mthu btsan pas/ rdo rje bdud 'joms skye ba'i mthar/ byang sems spre'u'i lo pa (93bshig /las ldan thog babs tshul du 'byung / de yis 'di 'byin 'gro 'dren 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i bsam yas bar khang byang chub chen po'i thugs ka nas gdan drangs pa'i thugs rje chen po 'khor ba dbyings sgrol gyi skor bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i nyams len shin tu zab pa skal ldan tshe 'dir grol ba'i nye lam khyad par can yin pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang las/ de ltar skal mchog lam 'dir zhugs pa yis/ /rang g.yin don gnyis grub par gdon mi za/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs bcud 'dus pa ste/ /mtsho skyes rdo rje gus pa'i yid kyis gzung / /srid mtsho mi zad skems pa'i nyi ma yin/ /—113—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)sdug bsngal chu bo sgrol ba'i gru chen yin/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs pa'i yang zhun te/ /sdogasum rim dgu bcud kyi dngas ma 'di/ /mkha' khyab 'gro ba sgrol byed dpal du shog /ces bshad cing / thun mong las tshogos myong grol las kyang / phyi ru nad gdon ma lus zhi/ /nang du dug lnga rang sar grol/ /sdig can mtshams med spyod pa yang / /'di nyid stor song ngan song khegs/ /mchog thun dngos grub nges par 'thob/ /de phyir yon tan brjod las 'das/ /zhes lce brgyas bskal par brjod du med pa'i yon tan mtha' klas shing / /rang gter tshe sgrub bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i lo rgyus las/ kye ho sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /tshe sgrub bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i skor/ /ma bur bcas pa mi spel te/ /rin cen snying po'i brag logs la/ /'chi med lha tshogs (94na'ang byon yod/ /de yi g.yon zur tshe chu'i steng / /rin cen 'dra ba'i brag 'og tu/ /tshe chur bcas te gter du sped/ /ces sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi lha ri rin cen snying po'i brag ngos la rgyas btab pa'i tshe dpag med bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i skor spyan 'dren pa po ni de nyid las/ de'i dus bdag gi thugs rje dang / khyed kyi smon lam mthu btsan pas/ /bdud 'joms skye ba nyi zla'i ming / /drag spyod hur 'grogs brtul zhugs can/ /dug lnga rags la yun thung ba/ /pad+ma'i gnas chen sgo 'byed byed/ /de dus zab gter 'di dang phrad/ /de yis bod khams lo skor bde/ /gnyan nad de yi thugs rjes zhi/ /de dang yon mchod 'dzom pa na/ /nyer lnga'i bar du bod khams bde/ /zhes byung ba'i zab chos 'di nyid kyis mchog thun gyi dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos bcud len tsam gyi phan yon yang / /bcud len 'chi med ye shes las/ 'di la dus kun sus spyad gang zag de'i/ /tshe ni nyi zla bkrag mdangs me tog 'dra/ /gzhen tshul byis pa seng glang stobs dang ldan/ /mdangs ni rma bya yang rtsal mkha' lding khyung / /mgyogs 'gros rta dang blo gros 'jam dbyangs 'dra/ /'chi ba drug bzlog rigs 'dzin rnam bzhi 'thob/ /mkha' 'gro dbang 'dus sde brgyad bran du 'khol/ /rdo rje'i lus thob tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs ldan/ /sems nyid bde stong zung 'jug gzung 'dzin zhig /phyag rgya chen po'i sal lhun rgyas grub/ /bcud len tsam la'ang yon tan de dag 'byung / /(94ba〉skrub spyad sgrub —1/4

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengasadang rin po che'i mchod rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar chag (mebyed yon tan smosaci dgos/ /phra mo'i yon tan brjod pa ga la nus/ /pad+ma bdag gis spyad pas 'chi med grub/ /chen po'i yon tan ma lusalhun gyisagrub/ /ces mchog gi dngosagrub kho nar ma zad 'chi med tshe'i rigasa'adzin gyi mtshon yon tan mtha' yas pa gsungs pa sogs gter chos 'di dag yi ge 'ga' zhig tu bzang bar bstan pa cig shos su ngan par chad pa'i zhabs rdol rdzun dris mkhan gyi rnyog dri tsam yang med pa'i dpyad gsum rnam dag gis yid drangs te bod 'bangs kyi bde thabs tshe dpag med dang / thugasarje chen po'i lha tshogasatshang ba zhig dpal bsam yasakyi gnasasu bzhugasan legs so zhes sa skyong rdo rje rnam rgyal la ched du mol ba ltar/ sman 'dam las grub pa'i tshe dpag med bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i lha tshogasabacu gsum/ thugasarje chen po 'khor ba dbyingasasgrol gyi zhi khro'i lha tshogasabaco lnga/ gter ston mnga' risapa chen po legs ldan bdud 'joms rdo rje'i sku brnyan dang bcasapa'i sku mdog na bza'i kha dog sgrub thabasadang las byang nas byung ba bzhin la g.yu mu tig byu ru shel pur len sogs rin po che'i phra sna tshogs kyis mdzes shing phyag mtshan phal cher yang rin po che las grub pa bzhengasate lha khang dbusamar bzhugasapar/ dar zab snyan shal gtso bo rnams la kha dog drug so sor 'brel ma/ 'khor rnams la grangs de mtshungs kha re mar smon lam gyi yi ge gser dngul gyis bris pa/ gosadamar bum gdan dpusalegasakyi bla bre gung khebs/ shar nub gnyis(95na)la gos bzang bsgrigasakyi bla bre sham bu dang bcasapa che chung drug /lhor stod rasapar ma'i gnam rgyan/ gosabazang bsgrigasalasabyasapa'i phye phur thog tshad cha gnyis/ dril gdang / mchod stegs rtsi ma'i steng li ting che ba bdun tshar gsum/ li ting rnying pa nyi shu tham pa/ 'gag gzugasam chung ba bdun tshar/ li'i maṇ+ḍal gsum/ rag gi me dam cha/ rdza'i me dam g.yu rtsi ma cha/ sil snyan cha/ zangasargyan gcig /khro kong g.yel mo zla drug 'khyongasapar mar me'i rgyun chad med/ lcags kong 'gag gzugs ma g.yel me gcig /zhal zasabacu re nyin star 'bul ba'i rgyu gtong deb tu bkod/ dkar me khang gi lha tshogasasnga phyir bzhengasapa rnams kyi bzo dbyibs kyi zhal bkod mtha' dag rdo rje brag nas rigs 'dzin sprul —115—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shepa'i skus mdzad cing de nyid dang gra bcas sum cu skor gyis zhag nyer lngar gzungs 'bul/ sgrub pa/rab gnas rnams dang / rab byung pa bla ma gra bcas bdun cu skor gyis nyin gnyis ma'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pa rgyas par bsgrubs so/ /'khrul med zab gter las byung tshe mtha' yas/ /'jig rten dbang phyug lha tsho gos gsar bskrun sogs/ /snang gsal khang bzang bcas la ye shes pa/ /bcug 'bras byang chen bar du 'bral med shog /rten gyi gtso bo mthong thos dran cing reg pas rnam par grol ba jo bo byang chub chen po'i gser chab brtsegs mang ba dang mi mkhas pa 'dras 'byug nyes pa'i skyon gyis gas grums ches (95ba)pa 'khyar ba dman pa'i sar song na yul der rnam par gnag pa'i 'bras bu bskyed pa'i nyes pa dang / gnas skabs su gser gsol byed dka' ba sogs la brten mi'i jo bo rdo rje rnam rgyal dang chos skyong chen po mi la brlams yul sku khog dang gnyis las mi mang lag mang gis skyon dang bral bas gdan zhus te zhal gser rnams kyi g.ya' dang sa rdul phyung nas cung zad tsam yang ma 'khyar bar sa skyong nyid kyis phyag dar nas spron pa'i steng du gser btul ma zho bcu tham pa legs par bstan nas mig gi bdud rtsi/ dngul srang brgya dang brgyad las grub pa'i lhung bzed cig gsol lhung rnying pa chag grums can gyi tshab tu phul/ de zhor gling bzhi gling phran jo mo'i gling sogs lha khang tshang ma'i rten brten par gser btul ma zho brgya tham pa'i gser chab kyi sri zhus be+e ḍūrla ser po'i ri bo nyi mas 'khyud pa lta bu'i gzi byin spros/ dbu rtse'i 'og khang gi zhal ba rnams ha cang snyigs chesapa'i rmig med lta bur song ba'i snum dreg chags nas 'bur stong mangs pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad bsgrig dka' zhing gnas mjal ba rnams kyang 'gyel bub mi 'byung ba'i ched du gsar du bzos pa rnyog bral gyi mtsho la byad bzhin ltar gzugs brnyan kun 'char bar nus pa'i dngos gtsang ba/ bha ta hor gyi yul nas gdan drangs pa'i g.yu'i thub pa dang bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho'i dbu thod gnas mjal ba byings kyis mjal dka' bar shing khri gsar bzos byas pa'i gser 'bum 'og tu 'dzul (96na)chog pa kun gyi mig lam du gsal po mthong bar bsgrigs/ de /16

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (ma'akhris lho byang mdun gyi rgya khra gsar bskrun rnams la tshon rtsi gser shog rgyas pa/ chos skyong chen pos gnas khang gi rgya khyen dang sku rnams kyi babs dang bstan mchod pa'i yo byad 'di dag kyang de mthun gyi bkod pa che tsam bsgrigs na legs tshul gsungs pa ltar yas mas kyi ka ba'i bar khengs pa'i mchod cog bang rim lnga yod tshon rtsi gser shog gis sprad pa'i steng ting re la gser zho bcu gnyis re song bar chu ban rgyab chad lhag tsam 'gro ba 'bras kyis bkang ba'i bdun tshar/ ting re'i rgyur dngul srang brgya re song ba gros bkang ba'i bdun tshar/ de mtshungs li ting bdun tshar gsum gyi gnyis nas dang gcig dri chab/ bang rim 'og ma'i ting bar du mar gyi zhal zas khru gang gi tshad la mar tshon sna lnga'i me tog gi rgyan sprod mtshar ba cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes gcig dang mtshungs lo star gyi mchod khang che phra tshor gsar du brje ba'i rgyun btsugs/ sku mdun du brgya mchod 'bul ba'i khro kong brgya dang brgyad khri 'gyogs dang bcas pa/ mchod yon 'bul ba'i ting gra mtshungs brgya phrag gnyis/ dbu rtse'i mda' yab steng shod dang sku mdun gyi mda' yab rim gsum dang bcas pa'i g.yu thog rnams gsar brjes/mda' yab 'degs byed seng ge bzhi bcu skor la tshon khra rgyas pa/ steng gi lcags khra'i gsham gyi sgam shag gi phyogs bzhi por mchod pa'i lha mo tshon rdzogs khor yug khyab pa gsar bzhengs/ 'og khang lte ba'i srang kyog nang skor gyi ka ba rnams sa chu'i rul (96ba)skyon 'dug pa dag 'gyogs 'degs 'phrul gyis brtan par bzos/ dge rgyas li ma gling la bye mtshan ches par bye ba shugs nyin bcu'i bar 'u lag drug brgyar thug chang byin/ gtsug lag khang byings dang phyi'i mchod rten rnams la lo star sa rtsi gsol skabs 'u lag rkang rer rtsam mda' zo re/ chang bre re yong ba rgyun 'jags kyi rgyur 'bru khal nyer gsum 'gro ba gnyer tshang gi deb la bkod/ khams gsum zangs khang gling gi 'og khang mdo khyams kyi 'kha ba khol gsos rnams legs par bsgrubs/ de yang rten brten pa rnams zhig gsosagasar bzhengs mchod pa'i tshogs rgya cher spel nus pa 'di yang bu mo zla ba mchog gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ gal te rgyal ba de dag mchod 'dod na/ /sangs rgyas nyad phyir khyod kyis smon lam thob/ zhes—1/7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shetshe rabs mang po rnam par dag pa'i smon lam dri ma med pas mtshams sbyar ba zhig ma gtogs gang zag ci yang rung ba la 'byung ba ma yin cing dri gtsang khang sogs zhig pa gas pa phyag bdar byas pa'i phan yon/ sangs rgyas phal po che las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis phyag bdar byed pa la yon tan lnga yod de/ lnga gang zhe na/ bdag nyid kyi sems dang bar 'gyur ba dang / gzhan gyi sems dang bar 'gyur ba dang / lha rnams kyi yid dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / mdzes par 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gsog par 'gyur ba dang / lus zhig nas bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten gyi lha rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes rgya cher (97na)bsngags shing / pad dkar chen po las/ kun dga' bo nga yongs su mya ngan lasa'adas nas rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo rab tu byung ba'am khyim na gnas pa gang dag kha cig tha na ring bsrel yungs tsā tsam la bsti stang du byid/ bla mar byed/ rim gror byed/ mchod par byed/ kun dga' bo dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyi 'bras bu yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa yin te/ tha ma yongs su mya ngan las 'das par nga smra'o zhes dang / lung gzhi las/ gang zhig rab dad sems kyisasangs rgyas kyi/ /mchod rten me tog sil ma spungs pas 'thor/ /dzasbu'i chu bo'i gser phye bre bo ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min/ /mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dang bas/ /sangs rgyasamachod rten me tog 'phreng bskor ba/ /dzaskru'i chu bo'i gser gyi sgrom dag ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min/ /mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dad pas/ /sangs rgyas ma chad rten mar me 'bul byed na/ /dzaskru'i chu bo'i gser srang bye ba ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min/ /rab dang sems kyis sangs rgyas mchod rten la/ /gdugs dang rgyal mtshan 'phan ni 'dogs byed na/ /gser gyi ri bo lhun po dang mnyam pa/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min/ zhes bde bar bshegasapa'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la ri mor byas pa'i 'bras bu mtha' klas pa de ltar bshad cing / blon (97ba)po bka' thang las kyang / phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyasarnams/ /gling bzhi khyab par mdun du bsam/ /mchod tshogs 'phreng ba brtsegs pa'i tshul/ /ut+pal la —/18

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha shāmisogs me tog dang //a ka ru sogs bdug spos dang //rin cen la sogs snang ba dang //ga pur la sogs dri bzang dang //lha bsgos la sogs bza' ba dang //gdugs dang rgyal mas na bza' dang //ba dan bi wang dzornga sogs//rol mo sna tsho gos pa wo 'bul/zhes dang /a ma son sam rdzo la brtson//rgyal srid chos dang mthun pa yin//gtso po tshe ring longs spyod che//skyon po rnams kyi sgrib pa 'dag/lha dang mi yi skye gnas len//dag par byed pa cho ga'i mchog/bdag gzhan bag chagasadag par 'gyur/zhes bsngags pa de dag kyang rang don yid byed du ma song ba'i kha ba ri pa'i bstan 'gro'i bde skyid kyi ched du sman pas bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur ba'i phyir na/lam sgron las//rdzogs sangs bris sku la sogs dang //ma rdzo rten dam chos mdzo phyogs nas//me tog bdug sposadangos po dag/ci wor pa yi mar pa bya//kun bzang spyod las gsungs pa bzhi//mar pa rnam pa bdun dag kyang //byang chub snying po'i mthar thug bar//mi ldog pa yi sems dag gis//dkon cog gsum la rab dad cing //bus mo'i lha nga sar btsugs nas//thal mo sbyar ba byas nas ni//zhesagasungs la/bye brag bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub 98na ) pa'i gtsug lag khang la phu dud bgyis pa'i sgos kyi phan yon kyang sprul ba'i gter chen skyon gling pas yar klungs shel gyi brag phug nas gdan drangs pa'i pad+ma bka'i thang yig las/khri gdugs 'og na 'gran zla ma mchos pa'i//rgya gar rdo rje gdan mtshungs bsam yas 'di//mig gi mthong 3 ga song skye sgo gcod//gang dag 'di la skor ba sus bskor pa//bshan pa yin kyang mtho ris gnas su skye//zhes dang /gang zhig bsam yas 'di la maṇ+ḍal 'bul//gnas skabs mthar thug 'bras bu mchog kun 'thob//gang zhig bsam yas 'di la me tog 'bul//mi rnams dga' zhing rab tu skyid par 'gyur//bsam yas me tog nyal snyigasasus phyags pa//sbyin gnas mtshudas med sangs rgyas 'thob par 'gyur//gang zhig bsam yas 'di la spos 'bul ba//blta bar 'os shing nor chen ldan par 'gyur//gang zhig bsam yas 'di la mar me 'bul//bye ba khrag khrig lha zhal nges mthong 'gyu///gang zhig bsam yas mar me'i rgyun 'dzugs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)pa/ /chos kyi 'od zer bdag nyid gsal bar 'gyur/ gang zhig bsam yas 'di la dri chab 'bul /yi dwags mi skye longs spyod che bar 'gyur/ gang zhig bsam yas 'di la zhal zas 'bul/ nad mug med cing tshe ring longs spyod 'phel/ /gang zhig bsam yas 'di la sil snyan 'bul/ /zab cing spobasapa phun sum tshogs par 'gyur/ /gang zhig bsam yas 'di la gdugs 'bul ba/ /(98ba)kun mchod bkur sti bya ba'i 'os su 'gyur/ /gang zhig bsam yas 'di la na bza' 'bul/ /myur du bla med byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ /bsam yas phreng ba gdan khri 'bul byed pa/ /bde ba'i yo byad thams cad de la 'byung / zhes dang / /gang zhig bsam yas 'di la zhig gsos byed/ /mya ngan med pa'i bla med byang chub 'thob/ /gang zhig bsam yas 'di la yi rang ba'i/ /dge des sdig byang 'brasabu bla med 'gyur/ /zhes phyogs 'dir sgo gsum gyi ngal ba bsten pa mtha' dag gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu yid du 'ong ba'i tshul bsam gyis mi khyab cing / de yang sngon sba rag gi chagasasdang la brten khor sa rnams bshig pa'i nyams chags che bar byung ba rwa chen lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyisagaso bran mdzad/ bar skabs su bar skor yang grong khang gis bgags pa sogs nyams chags che ba'i tshe bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa' las can nyi shu rtsa gcig lung bstan skabs/ ra ban chos btsun rin cen snying po khyod/ /yongs kyi rtsis 'debs dag tu mnga' gsol cing / /gsang mas rdo rje drag po kun dga' rtsal/ /ma 'ongs dus su las can dbang mchog 'dzin/ /gal te pe gar rgyal pos ma bslusan/ /rnal 'byor smyon pa skyes bu seng ge gdong / /kun gyi ming can rlabs wo spyod pa skyong / /lus la sha mtshan dang mig thig les spras/ /gdung shugs can dag glegs bam 'dzin par gyur/ zhes dang /gter ston pad+ma gling pa'i lung bstan las/ sngags 'chang sna nam rdo rje'i (99na)sprul pa zhig /dga' ba'i ming can shar gyi phyogs nas khrung / /sprul sku'i zhabs 'degs lcang lo can du 'gro/ /zhes byung zhing gter ston gyi dngos slob dka' chen pa kun dga' grags kyis brtul zhugs chen po'i bden pa'i tshig gis skor lam bsrang ba sogs zhabs tog che bas da lta'i bar du dbu rtse dkar po bas 'dzin —120

sku gsung thugasarten gsar bzhengasadang rin po che'i mchod rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar chag yonabazhin pa dang / gzhan yang rdzogasachen pa lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigasamed sogasaris bral gyi sri zhu mdzad pa mang dag byung na'ang phal cher stobasa'abyor gyi nusapa dman la/ bla dbon chen por rloms pa rnams gnas srung gi gnyan cha la 'jigasate btang snyoms su bzhag pa mang bas phyogs rer song ba'i rngo thogasapar ma gyur pa sa skyong rdo rje rnam rgyal mched gnyis dad dang gtong ba blo brtson stobs 'byor sogasamathun pa'i rkyen kun tshang ba'i phan yon gyi rnam par dkar ba'i las rngamasapo che 'di lta bu bsgrubasapa'i tshul la bsamasan ding dusar sa'aphrul snang dang mi 'gyur lhun gyisagrub pa'i gtsug lag khang gis thog drangs chos rgyal mes dbon gyis bzhengs pa'i lha khang bstan 'gro'i bde skyid kyi rtsa lag dam pa rnams spyi rta sgal ral du lus par ma zad de dag las nged kyi gnas dgon che ge mo dag bzang ngo zhesagazhan 'drid kyi zlos gar bsgyur ba ches mang bas kyang phan bde'i 'byung gnasartsi sman gyi ljon pa de dag la bla mar mdzad pa sngon byung da lta bar dang slad nas 'byung 'gyur kun la gzur gnasarnams rjesasu yi rang ba'i (99ba)gnasayin par sems so/ /gzhan zer ri dwagasa'aphrul gyi mi 'khrid par/ /legasabyasamada' yisasgrib gnyis laṅka'i mgrin/ /bcasanasagatan bde'i sī tar rtag rtse ba/ dga' byed gnyisapa'i ngang tshul 'dzin par shog /de'ang mchod rten bzhir rtsi shing sogs sna tshogs skyes pa dang khyad par dmar po'i bum pa la shing skye tshan ches pa'i 'jig tu nye bar 'di cher zhig gsosadus la babs pas byed lugs 'bras spungs dge bshes la dris gsungs 'dug na'ang ngos kyi lta rtog ma bcug par gya tshom du smra ba skabs su ma phye bar ma zad spyan stong rig pa'i bzos lam du 'gro mi 'gro lkog tu gyur tshul de rigs la chos skyong chen po'i snang srid gsal ba'i dpral ba'i spyan gyis gzigs nas lung bstan pa nyid legs tshogs che tshul sa skyong sbyin pa'i bdag por mol ba ltar lcog tu bslab ston zhusapa'i sngon 'gror rtag rtse khul gyi mi ser khyon langs dud res so phag nyer lnga re bsdebs 'dren dgos par so sor nas khal lnga re bsam zung khral 'dzin sum brgya sogasum skor rer khal dgu re/ 'on pa nyisabargya skor la khal lnga re/ 'on bsam spyi phyur khal lnga brgya —121—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)skor rnams chas thebs su rtsis sprad/ phyi rol gyi mchod rten brag sna'i bye 'bum/ sba/ be+e ro tsa na'i yum rten sogs mchod rten lnga po sngon med du 'gro ba lta bur nyams gsos sngar bzo dang mthun pa'i chos 'khor tog bcas sra mdzes legs par bskrun/ phyogs kyi mchod rten bzhi ni/ rgyal po bka' thang las/ /bka' (100na skyogs phyag rgya mchod rten bzhi la ni/ /mchod rten dkar po seng ge brgyad kyis brgyan/ /srung ma gnod sbyin skar mda'i gdong pa can/ /bzhengs pa'i lag len blon r+ṣa shud bu yin/ /mchod rten dmar po pad+ma stong gis brgyan/ /skyong ba'i srung ma gza' bdud mig dmar yin/ /bzhengs pa'i lag len rgya tsha lha snang yin/ /mchod rten nag po mchod rten stong gis brgyan/ /skyong ba'i srung ma mkha' 'gro lcags mchu can/ /bzhengs pa'i lag len rta ra klu gong yin/ mchod rten sngon po lha khang bcu drug brgyan/ /skyong ba'i srung ma rdo rje 'dud 'dul yin/ /bzhengs pa'i lag len rdo rje spre'u chung yin/ /zhesamanga' bdag rgyal pos bzhengs pa'i tshul ni/ mchod rten dkar po byang chub chen po nyan thos kyi lugs seng ge brgyad 'i kyas brgyan pa/ las dpon shud bu dpal seng gis byas nas bzhengs/ srog shing tsan dan dkar po rgyal chen bzhis btsugs/ nang bzhugs la sangs rgyas kyi ring bsril ma ga dha'i bre'i khal gcig /yab mes kyi yi dam gnyan po gsang ba/ mdo sde lnga rnams bzhugs pas byin rlakhas che/srung ma gnod sbyin skar mda' gdong la gto/ mar rten dmar po chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba byang chub sems dpa'i lugs pad+ma stong gis brgyan pa/ las dpon zhang rgya tsha lha snang gis byas nas bzhengs/srung ma gza' mig dmar la gtad/ mchod rten nag po rang sangs rgyas lugs sku gdung gis brgyan pa/ las dpon ngam stag ra klu gong gis byas nas(100ba tha zhengs/ srung ma gnod sbyin lcags mchu can la gtad/ mchod rten sngon po dpal lha las babs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i lugs lha khang bcu drug sa brgyan pa/ las dpon mchims rdo rje spre'u chung gis byas nas bzhengs/ srung ma gnod sbyin nyi ma'i gdong can rdo rje bdud 'dul la gto/ mchod rten 'di rnams bzhengs dus 'dre mo 'od can mas bar chad 'tshe ba mang du byas par/ mkhan slob la zhus pas/ byams pa gling du sa lhag rdo lhag —122

sku gsung thugasarten gsar bzhengasadang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mibasdus nas mchod rten bzhengs te mnan/ rab gnasaganang dus 'od du 'bar bas na mchod rten 'od 'bar du grags/ de dag kyang dus dbang gis shing sdong mes tshig pa lta bu'i mi mdzesapar ma zad srog shing rnams hrul 'khyogs chos 'khor gyi zangs gas grums bug rdol sogs nyams chags che bar brten dpal ldan dmag dpon chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rten bzhi po 'di rgyal khamasaspyi'i bde thabs kho nar dgos gnad che ba dang / yang dgosaskye 'gro gzugs can la gnod pa'i 'byung po sa bdag klu gnyan phyogs bzhi'i dgra bgegs mnan pa sogs rten so so'i 'og tu yod pas 'di rnams nyams nas don pa byung na skye 'gro spyi la legs pa med pas rim bzhin nyams gsosam byas pa'i thabs med pas snga 'phros gdugs chos 'khor 'phral grub gegs med 'byung ba'i ched du rdo rje phur pa'i sgo nas khro bo rol pa'i gtor bzlog cig gnas rdo rje brag rdzong gi dge bshes de yis byas na legs zhes (101na〉sdung bstan pa bzhin thub bstan e waṃ lcog sgar nas rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i sku mchog dpon slob rnams gdan drangs te 'brul med kyi gter ston rgod kyi ldem phru'i zab gter byang lcags mdzod nag po'i chos sde nas byung ba dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i spu gri'i drag po zor gyi 'phrin lasaganam lcags 'bar ba'i mthu rtsal gyis nag phyogs yid srubs kyi tshogs rnams phye mar btags/ rigasa'adzin srog sgrub dang gter gsar rigs 'dzin yongasa'adusanam mkhar chen bza'i sprul par lung gis zin pa dpal ri sprul skus dbu rtse bar khang du zhag bco brgyad kyi ring phur sgrub/ mchod rten bzhi'i chos 'khor rnamasagasar brje byed pa'i sta gon du sngar gyi chos 'khor gyi bzo dbyibs dang dpangs sogs thig rtsa'i 'phyugs med blangs pa'i yod lugs dang gsar du bskrun pa la/ nub byang mchod rten nag po'i chosa'akhor dgu brtsegs steng / pad stegs/ pad+ma/ bum pa/ bre/chos 'khor bdun brtsegs steng du bre/ lcags thag 'dzin byed lba rog khebasabacas la mu tig can/de steng gdugasastegs pad+ma/ gdugasathod sbrags/ dra phyed dang rtse rgyan nyi shu'i steng rdza ma nag po tog bcas kyi stegs pad rkang gi steng tog dang ldan pa/ lcags thag 'dzin byed nas zur bzhir rlung 'dzin —/23—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)lcags thag /srog shing dpangs rgyug mtho soganyis/ rtsab gru bzhi sbom sar mtshon bdun/ rtser mtshon bzhi/ chos 'khor dngos gzhi'i tsho 'dzin srog shing yin na'ang chos 'khor skor rgya rer shing sgroms gru bzhi'i tsho 'dzin (101ba)lcags bsnyad gru bzhi sbom nges rnams 'dug par dpe byas te shing lcags gsar brjes thog chos 'khor snga sor gnas kyi zangs gser gnyis ka sra 'bregs gtsor gton/gdugs kyi dra phyed nang khor mar dril bu brgyad/ lcags thag bzhin dril bu re dang bcas pa'i bcu gnyis la dril lcer rlung bskul zangs leb/ sa khri'i bang rim so phag nas rgyud sdebang rim bzhi brtsegs/bum ldir man gyi shar lho nub bcas dang byang gi rgyud sde gong ma'i rtse man chad kyi khor yug tshang ma so phag nag po zhe mtshungs kyi khol po dang steng gi bre/ byang ngos kyi bum ldir/ pad gdan gyi sa khri dpangasami gang lhag tsam gsar du bzos pa'i thog gis chu mi 'dzin pa'i g.yam gcal legs par bsgrigs shing mtshams tshor bum gter bcug /lho nub kyi mchod rten dmar po'i chos 'khor dgu brtsegs steng bum pa/ pad stegs kha bre 'byar bcas pa'i steng chos 'khor bdun/ de steng sba 'khor/ sba rog /lcags thag 'dzin byed steng mu tig dang gdugs stengs pad+ma/ gdugs thod sbrags/ dra phyed dang rtse rgyan nyi shu/jo ma nag po'i rtser gzhir cha 'grig /zur bzhin rlung 'dzin lcags thag srog 'dzin gru bzhi rtsa bar mtshon bdun/ rtser mtshon bzhi/ dpangs rgyug mtho sum cu tham pa/ shing lcags gser zangs thamasacad sra brten gtsor brtan/ gdugs kyi dra phyed kyi nang khor ma dang lcags thag gi dril bu lce bskul zangs leb bcas gong 'dra/ sa khra'i bang rim so phag nas bzung seng khri (102na)rgyud sde bang rim drug /bum lder man gyi shar lho nub bcas 'khor yug tshang ma so phag dmar pos zhe mtshungs kyi khol gsos/ byang gi sa khri nas seng khri/ rgyud sde'og ma man gyi bre dang bum ldir gyi byang ngos phal cher gsar bskrun/ pad gdan gyi khri mi gang gi sar thog bkal ba chu mi 'dzin phyir g.yam gcal bsgrigs legs kyi steng nas bre man thams cad la rdo rtsi dmar po shin tu 'thug pa rung bar gsol zhing bum gter gong 'dra gzhug /byang shar bkra shis sgo mangs kyi mchod rten sngon po chos 'khor dgu brtsegs steng —124

sku gsung thugs rten gsar ba tshe ngas dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mopad stegs/ pad+ma/ bum pa bre sbrags/ cho ge 'khor bdun brtsegs steng pad stegs/ pad+ma/ bum pa bre sbrags/ de steng chos 'khor lnga brtsegs/ lcags thag 'dzin byed/ lnga rog /mu tig dang gdugs 'degs pad+ma zung 'brel/ gdugs thod sbrags/ dra phyed dang rtse rgyan nyi shu'i rgyan gyi phyogs bzhir rdo rje sems dpa'/ rin can 'byung ldan/ snang ba mtha' yas/ don yod grub pa ste bzhi'i sku brnyan 'bur dod/ de steng dzom na ga po gañdzi ra dang bcas pa/ zur bzhir rlung 'dzin lcags thag khrog shing dpangasargyug mtho bzhi bcu zhe gsum gyi rtsa ba gru bzhir mtshon dgu/ rtse la mtshon lnga shing lcags zangs gser gyis sra mkhregs gtsor brtan/ dra byed kyi nang khor dang lcags thag gi dril bu lce bcas gong 'dra/ sku gzugs mar sngar zhig gsos phran bu byung ba rnams snga dus kyi dpe tshad ldan 'dra bshus byung tshod (102ba spran 'dug pa'i khar nyams chags kyis dbyibs tshad rtogs dka' rung steng shod gnyis ga'i lho phyogs rnams nyams cung zad chung zhing lhag tu lto'i lha khang dkyil ma'i sgo dpung shar dang lho'i zur bcas la dpe len thub pa'i rtse rnying gis 'brel ba ya bral du ma song ba'i yid ches tshad len thub tsam 'dug par bzo dbyibs phyag tshad 'phyugs med blangs pa'i mchod rten chung ngu zhig dper bzos/shar lho'i zur dang sgo dpung g.yon phyogs de gar cha skor ba'i so phag nang ma rnams mi brje ka med byung na ma gtogs nang bzhugs sogs la skyon gtan nas ma song ba byas ngos sa khri nas bre man la bum ldir gyi so phag rnying pa re gnyis byin rlabs che phyir bzhag /bum ldir gyi g.yu rtsi ljang skya dang dmar skya 'dres skyon 'dug pas rtse gsham tshang mar g.yu rtsi rgya lugs su gsol/ so phag gi bar tshor chu mi 'jug pa'i ched du zha nye blug cing zur sne rnams brtan phyir khro chu'i gzer gyis bsdams/ dpangs mi gang tsam pa'i sa khri'i thog dang g.yam gcal gyi mthar chags su gyo ba'i chu khung gral bsgrigs kyi steng la rtsig thung bskum khru gang gi phyi nang thams cad zhal ba/ rtsig thung gi g.yam bad steng chu zheng gab pa'i thod dkar steng shod kyi lha khang bcu drug pa'i sku brtan rnams kyi phyag zhabs sogs la skyon phran bu 'dug pa gsos shing sku mdog ser po rnams la gser/ dkar po dngul/ zhal khyem gser/—/25

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)dbu mthing / cod pan/ na bzar gser (103na slog ga /lha khang rnams la ldebs zhal/ mthing spos zhal/thog dbang bcas par tshon rtsi/ sngar sgo mi 'dug pa ma btsugs tshe dbyar dus char lhags dang dgun dpyid 'thor rlung gis chud zos 'byung nyen sel byed du tshang mar sbus 'byed mtshal rtsi lcags shan sbar bkab/ ri bzhi rnams mthing ga'i steng badz+ra gu ru sogs gzungs sngags lā& gser shog ma/ so sor sgo yol gzham yos/ rten gtso so sor dar sna drug re'i snyan shal wo star shod kyi bcu gnyis po spyir mar me sdong rkang re dang so sor zhal zas re/ zla re'i tshes bco lnga byung res la steng gi bzhi dang shod kyi bcu gcig por dkar me sdong rkang re dang steng gi bzhi la bsgos lnga re'i 'phar ma'i rgyun btsugs/ skor lam la rdo gcal/ khang pa sum thog gi mchod rten bum pa man bsgribs pa 'ga' zhig 'dug pa nyis thog tu phab ste gong bad las spros mi rtsig pa'i bsdam ra/ lho ngosakyi khang pa gnyis rtsa ba gnas spos pa'i mi khyi sogs kyi gnod pa mi 'byung ba'i ched du rtsig pa thog tshad sgo lcags lde bcas rnams/ shar lho'i byang chub mchod rten dkar por chos 'khor bdun brtsegs kyi steng lcags thag 'dzin byed kyi bre/ lnga rog /mu tig dang gdugs 'degs pad+ma zung 'brel/ gdugs thod sbrags/dra phyed dang rtse rgyan bcu dgu'i dzo ma nag po gañdzi ra cha 'grig /rlung 'dzin lcags thag /srog shing gi rtsa ba gru bzhin mtshon bdun/ rtser mtshon bzhi/ dpangs rgyug (103bsgo tho nyer gsum/ shing lcags zangs gser dang bcas pa'i sra brtan gtsor bton/ gdugs kyi dra phyed kyi nang 'khor dang lcags thag gi dril bu lce bcas gong mchungs/ sa khri bang rim bzhi nas seng khri pad bcas khol gsos/ seng khri'i phyogs bzhin ldebs zhal la sangs rgyas stong sku zhig gsos pa zhig gis bzhengs pa'i rjes mngon tsam snang yang bzhengs yul babs 'brel dang mi mtshungs shing dkar chag tu mi gsal ba nas dkyil ldebs bzhir rgyal chen bzhi tshab re dang g.yas g.yon du seng ge che ba re tshon rdzogs/ rgyud sdebang rim gnyis pa 'di sngar gru bzhi'i shul mngon tsam 'dug kyang zhig gsos pa zhig gis gru sne bcas pa gru bzhi sor gnas bton/ rgyud ldebang rim gnyis pa nas bum ldir bre bcas gsar gsos/ rtse dkar —126

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag khu'ibartan byed kyi rtsi sbyor bzos grub na'ang gsol skabs me tshan che ba btang tshe ring bsel phebs pa nyung du song na zhugs kyis gnod pa yin zer ba'i grags pa ga pa byung dogs rdo zho zer ba'i rtsi dkar 'di gsol zhing lo star yong ba'i rgyun rnams legs par btsugs shing gtong deb tu bkod/ mchod rten rnams dam tshig pa la ye shes kyi lha tshogs bzhu blugs su ro gcig par byed pa'i rab tu gnas pa gal che gshis dbu rtse bar khang du dpal ri sprul sku gra bcas nyer lngas zhag bdun phrag gi bar sgrub pa dang 'brel ba/ gnyis pa rta mgrin gling du rdo rje brag dpon slob so gsum gyi zhag bco lnga'i bar lho brag gter byon gyi phur pa lcags khang dang 'brel ba/ gsum pa (104na)rgyal sras sprul sku gra bcasabaco lnga rab tu gnas te ba po shis pa'i me tog gi char chen po phab bo/ /de yang bde bar gshegasapa'i sku dngos sam dam pa'i gzugs brnyan gsar du bzhengs pa dang zhig pa gsos pa'i 'bras bu bla na med pa'i phyir spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ /gang zhig ston pa mi mchog gzugs byed pa/ /rasa'adri rtsig ngos 'dri'am gser las byas/ /de yi chos kyi khyad par gang yin pa/ /de dag ma lus rab tu bstan gyis nye ne/ /de ni lta min longs par zhan mi 'gyur/ khur bo mi 'gyur yan lag mi sdug min/ /de ni gzugs dang ldan cing kha dog ldan/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis mas gyi go char 'gyur/ /lus ni rnam par dag cing khyad par 'thob/ /spobs pa 'thob cing sgra snyan yid du 'ong / shes bzhin ldan cing 'jig rten kun gyi gtso/ /de mthong sems can bde zhing dga' bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs shing rten la yid dang ba'i sgo nas skor ba mchod pa sogs bsnyen bkur ba'i bsod nams kyi mthu ches khyad par 'phags pa yang / mchod rten skor ba byas pa' phan yon las mchod rten skor ba byas pas ni/ /'dzam bu gling gi mnga' bdag rje/ /sa steng mtha' dag dbang byed pa'i/ chos dang ldan pa'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /zhes dang / spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ bcom ldan mchod rten rnams la pus btsugs phyag byasan/ /dpa' zhing stobs dang ldan pa'i 'khor los sgyur bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / me tog 'phreng ba byasanas su/ /mchod (1tre grub)rten dag la su 'bul ba/ de ni nam yang phongs mi 'gyur/ sum ston gsum —/27

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)'gro bar 'gyur/ /zhes dang / bcom ldan mchod rten gos kyis dkris byas na/ /stong gi 'jig rten khams kun zil gnon te/ 'dzam klung gser gyis gser ni zil mnan bzhin/ /skye rgu'i don ni dpag tu med pa byed/ /ces dang / bcom ldan mchod rten ba dan phul byas na/ /dag cing mchog gi lus ni 'thob 'gyur te/ /dper na/ gser ltar shin tu dgar 'gyur zhing / /lha yis bsngags la mchod cing bla mar byed/ /ces dang / /sangs rgyas stobs bcu ded dpon mthong nas ni/ /dga' ba sems kyis gdugs dang ba dan dang / /mar me rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod/ /byang chub spyod mchog 'di ni rtag par spyod/ mi yi 'jig rten bla mar bsnyen bkur byed/ lha nang lha yi dag dang mi yi gtso/yid 'ong spos mdzes lta na sdug pa dang / /nor bu shel 'dra sna tsho gos ldan pa thob/ khres rgya cher gsungasashing / de'ang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni nam yang rdzun mi gsung bar zhal gyis 'ches pa'i bka' mi slu ba'i phyir/ shes rab brgya pa las/ /dam pa rnams ni khas 'che mi smra zhing / /gal te dka' ba'i khas ni blangs gyur na/ /rdo la ri mo bris pa ji bzhin du/ l+le yang gzhan du byed par mi 'gyur ro/ /zhes 'byung la/ las dkar nag gi 'bras bu mi 'chol ba ste/ mdo nyi ma'i snying po las/ ci 'dra ba yi las byas pa/ /de 'dra ba yi gos bu (1tson)'thob/ /dge ba yin na bzang po ste/ /zhes pa'i don la yid ches kyi nges pa rnyed pa kho na'o/ /thub pa'i rten la bkur ba'i bsod nams 'bras/ /tshe 'dir dud pa'i dza lha'i ljon pa las/ /nyer lhungs skye mang spyod pa'i gser sbyangs kyi/ /snye ma byang chen bar du dngar gyur cig /de yang chos 'khor bsam yas legs par bzhengs nas gnas kyi dkor srung ni/thang yig las gdung rabs brgya dang bcu lhag song tsa na/ /hor yul gnam the'u dkar po'i rgyal po 'ong / /bod 'bangs thams cad hor gyi mnga' 'og 'jug /hor gyi pho lha gnam lha byang chub yin/ /rgyal po shing bya can ni spyan drangs nas/ /de la gtad na gtsug lag khang mi 'jig /bha ta hor gyi sgom gra bcoms pa na/ /pe har ka ca'i phyi la 'brang nas 'ong / /nga yi pe gar gling du rten 'phunas gsung / /zhes mkhan slob chos gsum bka' bgros pa'i snying po gnam lha byang chub pa gnyer gtad mdzad pa —128

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shā'iyin zhing gdan drangs tshul mnga' bdag dang zhang rgya tsha lha snang gnyis 'dzam gling sum gnyis dbang du bsdu ba'i bka' bgros mdzad pa'i tshe blon po'i bus sgo bsrungs pa sras 'bring po mu rug btsan pos mtshon bsnun te bkums pas blon po 'gos pad+ma gung btsan gyis zhal lce 'dar gsum dang dga' gsum bcad pa'i dus lha sras byang phyogs kyi dmag la gtong ba'i nyer bsdogs kyi tshe mkhan slob gnyis kyis thog drangs lo paṇa rnams la bar khang du mchod pa dang / snga khang mdor tshogs(105ba)gtor rgya cher bshams/ bdag byang phyogs kyi yul khams khri brtan dang / phyogs thams cad du dmag dpon la gtong na bdag dang dmag sde thams cad kyi tshe srog la bar chad med par phyogs kyi so kha thams cad thul nas yab rgyal po'i dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang / sa phyogs thams cad du bde legs 'byung pa'i thabs dang rten 'brel mdzad dgos zhes zhus shing / yab rgyal po sogs kyis kyang gsol ba btab pa la brten nas slob dpon chen pos rgyal po rnam thos sras rta bdag brgyad gnod sbyin gdug pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams bkug nas rje blon gyi tshogs la dngos su bstan cing lha sras dang lus dang grib ma bzhin mi 'bral bar bka' bsgros pa ltar zhal gyis bzhes/ kun gyi mthong snang dang mthun pa'i phyar dar mtha' mi mgon brtson gyis ri mo bris/ lo paṇa rnams kyis rnam thos sras 'khor bcas mngon sum du bstim pa'i rab tu gnas pa mdzad/ rje mnga' bdag gis pho nya bkye nas dmag dpung rnams khams kyi g.yar mo thang du bsdus/ rgya zam chen po zhig gi sngas su lcags phag gi de'u brtsegs pa'i steng du lha sras bzhugs nas phyar dar bslang / zhang blon chen po lha bzang klu dpal gyisargya zam de la dmag rnams bshar nas rtsis la btab pa'i dus der/ shar bya khra'i rgyal khams nas lus mi la bya khra'i gdong pa can gyi dmag dar re'i shul du khri tsho re 'brangs pa'i tsho pa dgu/ lho grul bum rkang rtse'i rgyal khams nas ro stod mi la rta bong gi rkang sug yod pa'i dmag dar re'i phyi (106na)la khri re 'brangs pa'i tsho pa bcu/ nub phyogs nas mi lus bye ba'i mjug can gcer bu g.yas smyug mdung dang g.yon go phub thogs pa'i dmag da ra re'i phyir khri re 'brangs pa'i tsho pa bcu gnyis/ byang —/29

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)rna bo che bong bu'i rgyal khams nas mi lus bong bu'i rna ba can gyi dmag dar re'i phyi la khri re 'brangs pa'i tsho pa bcu gsum rnams byung / de rnams gzigs pas lha sras ba 'ad par dmag mi rnams kyi g.yul rgyal zhes gleng/ gru gu'i yul dang rgya nag gi rgyal khams thams cad bcoms shing hor gyi sgom gra bar pa btul/ ba so'i lha khang / shing dung dkar po rgyang grags/ cha lang / dri'u rdog la sogs pa'i dkor cha dang / rnam sras kyi 'chams sku/ pe gar gyi sku/ gnod sbyin tshe'u dmar po'i brtse 'bag rnamasagadan drangs pa de'i tshe rgyal po pe har skrag ste bya rgod thang dkar du sprul nas nam mkhar bros pa rgyal chen rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa'i dmag gis ded de gnod sbyin zhig gis mda' bsnun pas bya rgod kyi gshog dbar la phog ste sar lhungs pa rnam thos sras dpung bcas kyis bsam yas su bskyal ba'i bkod pa ri mor bris pa'i sngon gyi phyar dar la ljangs yul ma dang 'di la ljangs 'dra ma'i tha snyad 'dogs shing rnam sras sprin gseb mar bka' gter gnyis su yod pa'i gter ma bya rgod gshongs su slob dpon chen po dang zhang lha bzang gnyis kyis sbas pa gnyal pa nyi ma shes rab kyis spyan drangs pa'i phyar dar yang rim gyis brgyud par skabs su nyang stod spos (106ba)khang tshogs su bzhugs pa' grags pa che/ bka' gter gnyis ga'i rjes gnang dang lung sogs kyang rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje nas brgyud de deng sang gi bar du dar rgyas su mdzad pas khungs dang 'brel/ lha srasakyis dmag rdzas rnams mnga' bdag la phul bas mnyes shing bar der lo bcu song / mtshims phur slob dpon pad+ma'i drung du sdig pa bshags shing rdo rje gzhen nu'i zhal gzigs pa sogs ldan ma rtse mangs yi ge dang sprin gseb ma gnyis kyi lo rgyus su byung zhing lo rgyus gzhan dag na rgya gar bha tho la nas 'khyar ba'i za hor gyi rgyal rigs dharma pā la zer ba zhig hor gyi sgom grar bzhugs par pe gar shin tu 'go bas rgyal po chags pa'i rten du dkor nor rnams dang chabs cig par byon pas mtshon rgyal po gdan drangs pa'i skor la bka' gter gyi lo rgyus mang po snang ba rnams phal cher gung bsgrig thub pa zhig mchis/ spyir 'gro ba mchog dman mang po nag po'i las kyi bag chags dregs pa'i rnam —/30

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (7par shar ba'i las 'bras ma 'chol ba yin na'ang gnas srung chen po mthu stobs dang rdzu 'phrul ha cang ches pa'i snyan grags kyis 'jigs te chen po dang bzang por rlom pa phal cher phyogs 'dir yun du gnas pa'i bya ba byed par sbrul la gla rtsi bzhin byol nas rngo thogs pa dkon mod rigs 'dzin yongs 'dus kyi paṇa chen rin po che lung bstan skabs/ gnon sbyin drag po shing bya can yang de'i bka' nyan par 'gyur ro zhes dang / 'phrang 'go gter ston rgyas spyan (107na)drangs pa'i chos bdag spyi gter lung bstan las kyang / ma 'ongs dus su 'gro ba'i don nyid du/ /zab mo'i gter shog zung du 'brel ba gnyis/ /steng khang snying sgrom dbus su rgya yis bsdams/ phyi ma'ang chos rgyal stobs ldan brtul zhugs can/ /gnod sbyin drag po shing bya can gyis kyang / /de yi bka' las 'da' bar mi sa nus pa'/pad+ma dbang rgyal rol pa rtsal gyis kyang / lo ke shwa ra'i pho brang dang nye ba'i/ /rnam shes mtshone pa'i phug par dag par phab/ /ces mnga' ris gter ston pad+ma rgyal po ye shes rol pa rtsal gyi bka' lasaganod sbyin chen pos nam yang mi 'da' bar bstan cing / gcung legs ldan zhabs ni gnubs chen sangs rgyas ye shes dang mtshungs pa lta bu'i dregs pa can thams cad bran du bkol ba dper brjod tsam las gsang chen rnying ma'i sngags 'chang rnams ni pha khyim du bu 'dug pa lta bu'i tshul ni rab tu mang bas mtha' dag brjod pa'i yul las 'das zhing sngags gsar ma'i phyogs la dpal ldan sa skya pa'i 'khon dkon cog rgyal po yan chad la sngags rnying ma'i grub brnyes sha stag tu byon par ma zad rje btsun gong ma lnga sogs rdo rje 'chang dang zhal gnyis pa de dag gis rdo rje nag po chen po'i gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba'i zab khrid kyi rnal 'byor la brten rgyud gsum dregs pa mtha' dag bran du 'khol ba'i rgyun gyis srid pa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i chos kyi rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan (107ba)bsam yas su yun ring por stan chags shing mkhan chen bho dhi sa tā'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas chos gsungs pa'i tshe chos skyong rnam gnyis mi'i gzugs su sprul nas chos nyan pa sogs bka' tshul bzhin du bsgrubs pa'i lo rgyus mang ba dang gtsug lag khang la sri zhu mdzad pas/ /—/3/—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)dgongasa'adus lung bstan bka' rgya las/ /thugs rjes mkhas mchog bho dhi sa tā yang / /las kyi lus len 'jug sgo mi mnga' yang / /'gro ba'i don phyir smon lam mtha' btsan pas/ /sayi phyogasanasamakhasabatsun 'jam dbyangasasprul/ /bstan pa'i srol 'dzin bsam yas gtsug lag gso/ /ma drangs bdud kyi sprul pa 'dulabyed 'byung / /bsod namasamatshan 'dzin 'gro ba'i kha lo bsgyur/ /dam pa chos kyi garnye sgrog par byed/ /ces gsal bar 'byung / dusaphyis bdag po kun rin pa gdan sa chen por phyi nang gsang ba'i gegs byed mangs pa'i bzhugs dka' ba'i skabs bsam yas su byon te 'phrin bcol gyi gsol 'debs nan tar mdzad par brten rjes su gdan sa skor rnams thugs dbang 'dus ba'i gtang rag lta bur pe rkar lcog la nyams gsos rgya cher mdzad/ slob dpon chen po'i rnam 'phrul du grags pa bdag chen 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang pos yang nas yang du zhabs kyis bcags shing yar klungasabakra shis rtse gnyan ston sprul pa'i zlos gar mkhan chen gzhon nu blo gros kyi drung du thugasagazu bor gnas pas rang gi yab chos rnams gsan pa'i dus bsam yas nas shar mar (108na)phebs/ sa pho khyi'i lo sdig khrab sgrog pa sogasal bstan pa spyi dang ngor rdzong gong dkar ba sogs sa skya tshad kyi zab chos la mkhyen pa'i spyan yangs shing yang sgos yab chos bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi ring lugs thugs gyi dpal be'u 'chang ba'i sngags 'chang bla ma sems dpa' chen po ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po chos skyong rnam gnyis nas spyan drangs pa ltar chibs kyi kha lo sgyur bas mtshon da lta'i bar gdan sa gong nas sger du zhal 'dzin gnang ba dang gtsug lag khang gzhan las gnyan cha che ba nyes 'dom gyis zhig gsos gzhan ma rnamasakyi bsdebs su mdzad ma bde bar lus pa chu byi mdo sde mchod pa'i skabs chos skyong chen po rnam gnyis kyis rdo rje gdan gyis gtsos pa'i gnas khang gzhan tshang ma nyams gsos mtha' dag lha bdag khyod kyis legasapar bsgrubs pa'i dar zhing rgyas dus 'dir sdug 'dre'i gzhal yas khang hrul por lus pa rten 'brel mi legs 'dug pas 'di yang gso ba'i bkod pa e lcogs gsung ba'i phebs —/32

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (malan du lcogs 'di bsam yas mchod khang phral du mi gtogs pa'i rtsis dang khur chung gi ma byas pa min rung bslab ston ma byung ba'i khar 'tshub cha sogs la 'dzems pa'i lus pa yin/ da cha bka' bzhin bsgrub pas bar chad mi 'byung ba'i 'phrin las gnang dgos tshul zhus te lha mi bka' bgros mthun ngos gdan sa gong du de kha'i rgyu mtshan mdzad pa'i lan du pe har lcog 'di la bla ma gong (108ba)ma'i rab tu gnas ba yin pas re zhig nyams gsos dgos pa med pas byas na mi yong tshul zhabs drung rin po che'i dgongs bcad rang gi par bkab med pa'i phyag mdzod ko lcags pa stangs tshugs bzang ba'i bka' bgros kyi dbang du song 'dra ba de bzhin la chos skyong rnam gnyis ma mnyes bzhin du gdan sar 'jog ches pa'i skor cig byed mi dgos pa'i phyogs kyi mdzes lam du bzhag /gnas srung chen pos bdag chen rin po che dbus su phebs dgos pa'i sa skyar bka' shog 'ga' zhig mdzad kyang 'phral phebs stabs ma 'grig pa'i rim 'gyangs su song ba shing stag slo bur du phebs dgos shar ba'ang lcog gi zhig gsos kyi sngon du zhabs kyis 'char dgos pa yod tshad nas dregs pa'i sde dpon nyid kyis 'phrin las tshil po che mdzad par mngon/ de'ang yab rje sngags 'chang sems dpa' chen po'i spyan bltos bzang pos bstan pa'i srog shing dam par gyur pa'i bdag chen rin po che yab sras bsam yas su phebs pa'i dbus gtsang sa khad 'gyangs shing nye skor du mi sde sogs can med pas ar po'i khur bzhes skyid shod rang nas yong ba'i bka' khyab dgos tshul gnam lha byang chub dang dmag dpon chen por 'phrin bcol gnang ba ltar sa skyong rdo rje rnam rgyal la nan tan sgrub dgos pa'i bka' lci bas g.yar dam mdzad/ bdag chen rin po che yab sras kyi gnas khang bshig skabs nged yong dgos mi dgos dri ba gnang bar dge bshes dag nus pa dang ldan pa yin pas me (109na)tog 'thor rgyu zhig gzhag pas 'thus/ slar legs par grub nas rab gnas la shog gsungs par snang /shing yos kyi dbyar smad mkhar las 'dzugs rtsis la dkar mo'i 'bru drug ma bsdus gong du sa rdo dang shing gi sta gon ma gtogs gnas khang bshig pa mi 'gab par lung bstan/ rgya khyon bzo dbyibs —133

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesogasaji ltar bya ba'i zhu len du sngar gyi gnas khang gi rgya khyon sor gnas ngos steng du sdug 'dre'i gsang ba'i bkod pa byed sa'og khang ji lta ba'i bzo dbyibasamadzesacha yod tsam gsar dod/ sgo dmar mdo/ shar khor yug rnamasakyi shing cha sngar lasargyasapa'i gsar brjes/ ldebasabrisasngar lugasabazhin la shing rtsi gang rgyas/ nub chosargyal lha khang phyogasakhor yug kun bzo dbyibasamatho dma' sngar gnas/phan tshun sra mdzes gang che gyis gsung ba gzhir bzhag pa'i ngos phyi sgo dpangs dma' zhing sgo mchor med pa'i ltar snang mi mdzes pa'i khar sku gsob phyir spyan 'dren pa'i tshe chag grum 'byung nyen gyi dog skyon la/ da lam phyi sgo mtho zhing mdzesapa'i sgo mchor sbar bkab lcags shan tshon rtsi sogasasngar med bsgrubasapa'i rgyur 'dir sbang mthing dgosatshul ltar bsringasasteng / tshon gzhan ma phon che ba/ gser shog dngul shog nyi khri lhag bcas thor mi gsal yang ka gdung dral lcam sogs shing phon shin tu che ba rnamasasong 'dug cing sngar gtsang khang nang du bdag po kun rin pas chos skyong rten dzosamados yin khul snod du bcug pa zhig (109ba〉rgod snang ba thog ma nas bla chen spyi'i rnam thar gyi mtshan nyid ltar zalazog can nam rjes su zhig pa ji ltar yang ding sang grul thub yod rigasamin 'dra bas/ sdug 'dre'i rten rdzasamados sogs rgyud man ngag dang mthun pa'i rgyas pa zhig sdug 'dre'i gsang ba'i bkod pa byed sar dge bshes rang gis 'dzugs thub pa e yong / mi yong na gzhan zhig la 'chol dgosa'adug pa gre ba chos skyong dpon blon nas gdan sa gong du mdzad pa'i gnas tshul las lan ma 'khor gong du sde pa tha'i ji skyid shod du byon pas gsal cha mi 'dug cing nyid kyis mdzad dgos rnams me 'brug mdo sde'i sngon chug tu legasapar grub rtsis mol mchid rgyas par byung ngo / /snang srid sde brgyad rba klong 'tshub pa'i gnas/ gshin rje'i bshasakhang lta bu'i rngams zil can/bstan pa'i khor yug mthudang nusapa'i rtsal/ rab 'bar lcagasari'i cho ga sra gyur cig /de ltar lcagasakhyi nas shing yosabar gyi phar song dang tshur byung gi rim pa/ gong du gsal mi gsal mtha' dag khyon gcig tu bsdoms pa ni/ rdo shing bzo bo brgya phrag res zla ba gsum lhag bcas/ zhal mkhan gyisazla —/34—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che' mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga (mab bcu gcig tu nye ba/'bur bzo ba bcu drug gis zla ba phyed gsum/lha bris pa bcus zla ba bdun lhag bcas/bal po bcus zla ba bcu/dngul zangs bzo bo bdun gyis zla ba bdun/lo ro ba gnyis kyis lo gcig dang zla ba lnga/mgar ba lngas zla ba phyed bcu gnyis/gos bzo khra4 rgyun pa bcu gnyisakyis zla ba gnyis gser 10na tshe sul tshags pa gnyis kyis zla ba gsum//rdza mkhan bco brgyad kyis zla ba lnga//g.yur rtsib bzhis lo gcig dang zla ba gsum//do dam pa bcus zla ba phyed bcu gnyis rnams kyi phogs yon/sku 'dra mchod rdzas kyi rgyu/lho byang mi ser la mas thebs/gegs sel rim gro/rab gnas kyi zhabs ga dang yon sogs che phra khyon dril bar sde pa tha'i ji rang gi wa nag gi dbu zhwa mthon thi dmar po'i rtsag pa phyags sogs gyon pa cha 'grig/grang gser btul ma zho nyis brgya nyi shu phyed rtsa brgyad tshagaser zho skyed dgu brgya lhag bcas/gser thig rnag zho brgyad brgyar nye ba/gser shog chig khri nyis stong lnga brgya bdun cu/dngul srang phyed sum brgya/dngul btul ma srang bcu/dngul chu zho drug stong drug brgya/mnyen zangs 'degs khal sum brgya dang go gnyis lhag bcas/ti tsa rgya thur gyi srang bzhi brgya dang bstogasum/bsha' dkar srang nyer gcig/tshal srang gsum zho do/star bu zangasamago'i khal dgu/lcags 'degs khal drug brgya gya gsum//lcags bsnyad 'dom nyis brgya dang brgyad cu//mtshal rgya thur gyi srang sum brgya nyer lnga//li khri srang drug cu re drug/mthing chen srang chig stong nyis brgya so bzhi/spang ma srang bdun brgya gya bzhi/ba bla srang brgya brgyad cu/ rams zangs mgo'i khal gnyis nyag do/rgya tshos kha la gsum bre do/snag tsha srang nyer drug/rgya mu tig che nges bdun dang che tsam bcu drug/'bring rdog lnga stong brgya so brgyad/g.yu drug 10brkokar sor gsum tsam gcig dang g.yu phra che chung bsdormas pa brgya zhe bzhi/byu ru kong rna nyan pa bstoganyis/'bring bzhi brgya nyer bzhi/bur len che chung 'dres pa nga bdun/ hor shel gcig /mu men che chung nyer drug /nal che chung nyer gsum/pad rā ga ming can gcig/mchong sna tshogs nyer gsum/blug shel sna tsho gis sum brgya so drug/dril bu re gcig/gu gu sha'i ting bdun tshar gcig dang phud phor gcig/li ting rgyu legs don bzhi/

rgyal dbang lnga pa ga dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegaser ting bdun tshar/ zangs rkyan gnyis/ kha btags che ba so bzhi/ bkras btags brgya nyi shu/dkyus ma brgya bcu bdun/ mthing khra lnga/ sman rnying yug nga bdun/ byang dar sna tsho gos yug zhe bzhi/gos sna tshogs yug brgyad cu/ sku rgyur gos kha bcu gnyis/ la tha yug drug /chor tse yug /rten khebs che ba gsum/ rgya ras yug bco lnga/ ka ras yug nyi shu/ dril yug gya gnyis/ lho ras yug go drug /'ban khra yug /gzan sna lnga bcu drug /snam bu dkar dmar 'dom nyis brgya/ rgya ja nag po bar khag phyed drug /tā tshang sbag bcu gcig /se hrug sbag sum cu/ ya ju bar khag nga drug sha shan khor drug don bdun/ mar 'degs khal brgyad brgya dang bcu/ rto kha la so bzhi/ phyur ba khal drug brgya/ snum khal brgya lhag bcas/ 'bru khal nyi khri bdun stong dgu brgya nga lnga/ tshil khor brgya dang bzhi/ kham star khal go gcig /bur ltang bcu bzhi/ bye shel khal phyed bzhi /rgun 'brum chi pa kha 'dres (111na tha khal phyed bdun/ 'bras khal phyed drug /spos dkar khal phyed gnyis/ spos reng brgya khres so drug /chag bubs nyis brgya nyer gcig /chung khog chig stong brgyad brgya nga dgu /pho rta dgu /btsag 'degs khal nga bdun/ spyin zangs mgo'i khal brgya phyed so lnga/ sra rtsi khal bcu gcig zhag bu 'degs khal drug /gso ma 'degs khal nyer gsum/ tshag ko so bzhi/ sol ba 'degs khal chig khri sum stong bzhi brgya zhe lnga/ dngul srang brgya'i rin gyi dong tse 'dags khal nyis brgya nga gnyis/ khro chag 'degs khal re brgyad/ zha nye 'degs khal phyed nga lnga/ dngul gyi me long gsum dang zla ba gnyis/ shel gyi nyi zla/ gser zangs kya me long bdun dang nyi ma gnyis/ li'i me long gnyis dang maṇ+ḍal gsum/ /sto ra gcig /zangs sder drug /lcags rdor gcig /dgra sta gnyis/ dbyug to gcig /lcags rdor tshags ma gnyis/rgya gram yu ba g.yang shis byas pa gcig dang rwas byas pa gcig /sna tsho gis rdo rje gcig /gser gyi rdo rje gsum dang rgya gram gcig /gri gug gser tshags can gnyis/ lcags kyu gsum /gser zangs 'khor lo gnyis/ ral gri gser tshags yu ba ba sos byas pa gcig /lcags thag gsum/ zhags pa lcags kyu a lung cha 'grig gsum/ rgya gri sngo shubs ma gcig zhal 'phreng brgya rtsa lnga/ rgya gri gcig /—136

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mashel rdo gsum/ me mda' cha tshang ring thung gnyis/ sbu la ha ri'i sag thag mda' gzhu cha 'grig bzhi/rgya sbug cha gnyis/ sil snyan cha/ gser rnga cha/ mchod rnga ya/ (111bsing dkar gcig /khro'i ka li khebs bcas khog /dkar yol gnyis/ rgya rag gi kong chung gcig /gser zangs kyi me dam cha gnyis/ lcags kyi lding sbos gcig dang mañdzi gsum/ kha btags kyi yol ba gcig /ras yol gnyis/grum tshe gcig /ras gdan gcig /sgo lcags lde bcas nyer bzhi/ g.yu rtsi'i rgyur ze tsha zhu btul byasapa khal phyed re gnyis/ tshal dkar khal bzhi brgya don bzhi/ rgya tsha 'degs nyag bco lnga/ bdud 'dul khal phyed re lnga/ rag rdo 'degs khal phyed re lnga/ rdo dkar zhib phye khal lnga bcu/ spang mthing 'degasakhal lnga bcu dang bcas pa'i gong gsal rnams kyi 'degs gshor mkha' ru zhe mtshungs su yin zhing /lcags gzer mtho re yod pa chig stong lnga brgya nga bzhi/ shing skam 'degs khal lnga stong don lnga/ legasaskyes su 'di ga nas bzo rigs pa bzhi bcu skor la dgu tshan bzang ba gsum/ 'u lag drug brgya skor la mang ja'i thog ja nyag re'i 'gyed/ yang shing stag dpon g.yog 'khor bcas bzo rigs rnams la ston mo'i steng sa skyong ba nyid la dgu tshan lnga dang bzo bo rnams la dgu tshan bzhi/ phan bde legs bshad gling nas dpon g.yog bzo bo bcas par ston mo bzabs rgyas/ tha'i jir mgul dar dang dgu tshan/drung 'khor spyir dgu tshwa/ bzo bo do dam pa spyir dgu wo/ 'u lag bdun brgya skor la ja thug chang /rtsam bre re/ sha rgyar re/ dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis tha'i ji rang la mgul dar dang dgu shaṃ (112na)bzo bo spyir kha btags gsum dang bdun tshan/ rdo rje brag sprul sku rin po ches tha'i jir mgul dar dang dgu tshan bzhi/ bzo rigs par ston mo/ dgu tshan gnyis/ yang bzo rigs do dam bcas par bdun tshan gsum dang dbu mdzad gnyis la lba dar/ 'u lag nyis brgya lnga bcu skor la ja chang gang 'thung /'on mnga' ris gra tshang nas dpon g.yog 'khor bcas dang bzo bo rnams la ja chang / dkar spro bzabs pa/ tha'i ji rang la dgu tshan/ bzo rigs spyir bdun tshan/ 'u lag bdun brgya skor la rtsam bre re dang zas sna re/ dga' ldan chos sdings nas dpon g.yog bzo rigs bcas par ja sbyor sbrel/ 'bras—137—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)thug /chang / dkar spro bzabs pa/ tha'i jir mgul dar rtags brgyad kha btags dang bdun tshan/ sku rten par lnga dar/ shing bzo bkras rabs par lba dar dang sum tshan/ bzo bo do dam byings bcas par dgu tshan/ drung 'khor spyir dgu tshan/ 'u lag bdun brgya skor la ja 'bras chang / rtsam mda' zo re dang zas sna re/ khri smad bsod nams dbang rgyal gyis dpon g.yog bzo rigs bcas par ja chang 'bras thug dkar spro/ tha'i jir dgu tshan/ 'u lag bdun brgya skor la ja thug chang / rtsam mda' zo re dang zasasna re/ lam smad chos mdzad kyis tha'i jir mgul dar/ zi ling spu ja sbag brgyad/ tā tshang gnyis/ rta/drung 'khor spyir sum tshan/ dge slong rgyal mtshan gyis lnga tshan/ dge slong bla ma'i lnga tshan gcig dang sum (112ba)tshan bkra shis sgang pa'i bdun tshan/ tha'i ji rang gi drung 'khor spyis brtan bzhugs dang 'brel ba'i tshogs 'khor bzabs rgyas/ kha btags re drug dang bdun tshan/ dpal ri sprul skus chang ban sum cu/ bzhes spro snod mgo bcu gcig /dgu tshan gnyis/ dbu mdzad rnam grol bkra shis kyisadagu tshan/ gsol dpon gyis bdun tshan/ mkhan tshang pas chang ban bcu bzhi/ bzhes spro snod mgo dgu/ lba dar gnyis/ lcog gi bskang gso ba spyis chang ban gsum dang lnga tshan/ rab byung bla mas chang ban lnga/ bzhes spro snod mgo lnga/ bdun tshan/ spyi pas chang ban dgu/ bzhes spro snod mgo bdun/ lnga tshan/ khang gsar bas chang ban bcu drug /bzhes spro snod mgo nyi shu/ kha btags/ hub ja bar khag /lha khang pas dpon g.yog bzo rigs bcas par ston mo/ mgul dar/ snam dkar phrug gi chu pa/zung mkhar sle sbus pas lnga tshan/ theg gling pas bdun tshan/ rdo zam pas chang ban bco brgyad/ bzhes spro snod mgo bco brgyad/ lnga dar gnyis/ shing bzo ba bkra shis grags pas bdun tshan rnams rgyas par bstar/ grong gong 'og gi khul la sbyar pa phon che ba chos 'khor chen po 'di nyid yun ring du gnas pa'i mthun rkyen du 'gyur ba'i lhag bsam rnam par dag pas yid drangs pa'i smon lam dri ma med pas mtshams sbyar te zhig gsos kyi rgyur dmigs nas 'dzugs par mdzad pa yang rnam dkar gyi rgyun chad pa med pa bu mo mu tig 'khri shing gi rtogs brjod lta bu'o/ /—138

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag 6)de yang chos 'khor dpal gyi bsam (113na/thas bzhengs ba'i dus dga' glu bcu gsum du grags pa blangs pa ni/ /de ltar mi rje lhas mdzad pa/ /chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan des/ /rin cen khri la bzhengs nas ni/ /rgyal po dgyes pa'i glu blangs pa/ /nga yi dbu rtse rigs gsum 'di/ /rin cen sna las grub pa ste/ /brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/ /nga yi lha khang ngo mtshar che/ /mthong ba tsam gyisanyams re dga'/ /de phyir bsams gyin blo re bde/ /lus 'phags gling la dpe blangs nas/ gar gyi lha khang gsum po 'di/ /rin cen sna las grub ba ste/ /brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/ /nga yi lha khang ngo mtshar che/ /mthong ba tsam gyis nyams re dga'/ /de phyir bsams kyin blo re bde/ /dza myu gling la dpe blangs nas/ /lho yi lha khang gsum po'i 'di/ /rin cen sna las grub pa ste/ /brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/ /nga yi lha khang ngo mtshar che/ /mthong ba tsam gyis nyams re dga'/ /de phyir bsams kyin blo re bde/ /ba lang spyod la dpe blangs pa'i/ nub kyi lha khang gsum po 'di/ /rin cen sna las grub pa ste/ /brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/ /nga yi lha khang ngo mtshar che/ /mthong ba tsam gyis nyams re dga'/ /de phyir bsams kyin blo re bde/ /sgra mi snyan la dpe blangs nas/ /byang gi lha khang gsum po 'di/ /rin cen sna las grub pa ste/ /brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra/ /nga yi lha khang ngo mtshar che mthong ba tsam gyis nyams re dga'/ /de phyir bsams kyin blo re bde/ /nga yi yag sha gong 'og 'di/ /mkha' la nyi ma shar (113ba tha 'dra/ /nga yi btsun mo gling gsum 'di/ /g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal bkod pa 'dra/ /nga yi mchod rten dkar po 'di/ /dung dkar g.yas su 'khyil ba 'dra/ /nga yi mchod rten dmar po 'di/ /me lce gnam la snyeg pa 'dra/ /nga yi mchod rten sngon po 'di/ /g.yu yi ka ba btsugs pa 'dra/ /nga yi mchod rten nag po 'di/ /lcags phur sa la btab pa 'dra/ /nga yi mchod rten ngo mtshar che mthong ba tsam gyi nyams re dga'/ /de phyir bsams kyin blo re bde/ zhes byung ba ltar da lam yang zhig gsosayongs su rdzogs pas dga' glu de dag don gyis thob bam snyam mo/ /nam mkha'i pha mtha' rnyed min de srid du/ /'dzad med dge ba'i mtho ris chu bo'i rgyun/ /byang chub —139

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gemachog gi rgya mtshor rtag 'bab pas/ rgyal sras rlabs chen spyod la gus pa lhod/ /gshin po'i gser ldan drod gsher ldan pa'i stor/ /ched du btab pa'i sa bon legs smin pa/ /a mra'i ljon pa dar la bab pa'i 'bras/ /ro bda' rang rigs brgyud mar myong ba'i zas/ /snyan grags dang ra por yongs 'thul dris bkug pa'i/ /dpyod ldan lha mi'i ra yig gnyis pa'i tshogs/ /bsngags brjod glu dbyangs dar dir nyer sgrog par/ /byed pos 'dab brgya'i nags klung sprul lam snyam/ /gangs can phan bde'i char sprin stug po la/ /gzur gnas dag pa'i blo mig gis blta bas/ /rab dga'i sgro gshog gzha' tshon lta bu'i gdugs/ /phub ste rtsed 'khro'i zlos gar cis mi bsgyur/ /mi dge'i ra re dang bral tshogs chen gyis/ /mthon por spungs pa'i kha ba'i rdul (114na)brtsegs la/ /log lta'i skur 'debs na bun yongs 'khrigs pa/ /dngos po'i gshis yin gang gis bcos su yod/ /chos rgyal rim byon gas la gso 'dun/ /gzhan bsgyur dmod 'bras lcags gtun ma skyes par/ /'di phyi'i bde skyid dpal be'u snying ga sa /'khyil ba'i khyab 'jug gnyis pa gzhan du med/ /'phags bal rgya hor bod 'dir dkon cog blar/ /bkur ba'i sa spyod sngon du mang byung ding / khri srong mdzad pa'i ri mo gab gsal nas/ /mngon sum cho gas mya ngan med pa'i sdun/ /bsod na mas tshogos chen phung por spud pa la/ /gzhol ba'i khyim bdag ngang tshul la brtags tshe/ /rang don phugs bcug ngur smig gos 'chang rnams/ /'phyon ma'i gar gyis ga' na sems 'drid la 'dra/ /gnam sngon ji bzhin khor ra khor yug mtha'/ /lta bar mi mngon 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las/ /sgrol byed legs byas gru rdzings 'dir brten nas/ /thar pa'i rin cen gling der cis mi bgrod/ /rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i bstan pa ches snyigs pa'i/ /ngan spyod ba tshwa'i chu gter rlabs zhabrugs dbus/ /phan bde'i srog zungs bdud rtsi za ma tog /'di 'dra blo brtson ri bo bsgril las thon/ /gnam bskos phag mo gru pa'i bka' rtags kyis/ /skyid shod mi bdag dmag gi kha lo bar/ /dbang bskur rigs las rdo rje rnam par rgyal/ /mgon med zas na ljongs 'dir 'phos las ci/ /brgya phrag bskal bar tshangs pa'i gdong bzhi nas/ /brjod kyang pha mtha' rdzogs par nus —140

sku gsung thugs rten gsar ba tshe ngas dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mamin gtam/ /chu gter che las kusha'i rtse mo yis/ /'thor ba'i dka' thub tsam zhig 'di nas bstan/ /(114bsko tshogs tshone gyis bsgyur ba'i man shel bzhin/ /bsags pa'i rnam smin dkar po'i 'dzag rgyun rnams/ /mtha' klas 'gro ched bsngos pa rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /ma thob bar du mdzad pa med par shog /'jig rten gsum gyi sgron me gcig pu pa/ shwakya seng ge'i ring lugs 'od po ches/ /sdug bsngal de rgyu kun 'byung smag gi rum/ /sangs byed nges legs skya rengs 'char bar shog /zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i chos srid bstan/ /'phrin las rin cen rnam bzhi'i bang rim ljid/ /ma bzod nor 'dzin bu mo'i 'gram pa la/ /rngul chu'i 'phreng ba rtag tu 'dzag par shog /khyad par pur rgyal bde skyid 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /lugs gsum mi 'gyur lhun grub gtsug lag khang / /ma pham dbus 'gyur 'chang du sprul pa'i skur/ /bstan min bar du bla nas blar 'phel shog /ga song so sor myong bya'i 'i dug nad/ /dge tsho gis rtsi sman ljon pas yongs bkrus nas/ /mtho ris skye rgu'i sim pa'i tshor ba la/ /mnyam por longs su spyod pa'i skal thob shog /lha mi'i rin cen rten gyi them skas la/ /dge bcu'i bag ldan rkang pas rab 'dzegs te/ /rdzogs ldan dus kyi dga' ston spyod bzhin du/ /ring min myang 'das grong du 'jug par shog /gom gcig 'dor bas mtha' brten sgo gsum po/ /ngal dang gtong ba'i mi dang sems song tshogs/ /yang srid kun tu sum rtsen lha ltar skyid/ /myur du rnam mkhyen ye shes 'thob par shog /khyad par rgyu sbyor mi bdag rigs kyi sras/ /blon 'bangs bcas rnams sngon byon nga las nu/ /'khor sgyur rgyal po'i rtogs brjod ji bzhin du/ /yongs 'phel brgya (115na)byin stan la bgo bshar shog /srid 'byor rdzas gzhan lta theg mgo bo yan lag mig sogs kyang / /gtong bar tshod ma tsam las skrag pa'i ngang tshul mi sems pa'i/ /thub dbang slob pa lam gyi spyod mchog bzod pa'i go cha che/ /bdag sogs yid can kun gyis gyon nas bdud bzhi las rgyal shog /'gro rgyud nyon mongs gaṅgā'i klung rdul grangs dang tshad gzung mi nus pa'/ /gnyen por rgyal bas bstan pa'i dam chos las gsungasasku gsung thugs kyi rten/ /bzhugs gnas dang bcas zhing khams rgya mtshor bzheng gso sri zhur brtson —141—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)pa la/ /spro dga'i lhag bsam bdag g.yin mkha' mnyam skye rgu'i yid la 'jug par shog /4 sa rgyas phal gyis yal yol btang snyoms tsam du bor ba'i ches cher snyigs ma'i lus can la/ khyad par yongs zhugs snying stobs mchog gis gdul dka' 'dul la bla med thugs bskyed nyi ma'i gnyen/ /sras dang slob mar 'bacas pa 'a rgyud la legs par gtams pa'i lung rtogs yon tan nor bu'i gter/ /dkon cog rnam gsum byin rlabs sprin las bkra shis char chen 'jig rten gsum du khyab gyur cig /ces gnam gyis bskos pa'i rgyal po chen po phag mo gru pa'i mdun na 'don skyid shod sa skyong dga' ldan par grags pa chas kyis mdzes shing sgrigs kyis che ba ya rabs dra ma'i ngang tshul can rim par byon pa'i rigs las mi'i dbang phyug rdo rje rnam rgyal gyis phan bde'i rtsa lag chos 'khor dpal gyi bsam yas la phu dud rgya cher spel ba'i nang tshan lcags khyi tshun gyi dkar chag dgos tshul rgyu song gi sa bon (115ba)dang bcas gsung gis bskul ba ltar mang por thos kyang sgrub la g.yel ba'i chos med kyi chos brdzu mkhan sdom brtson sde snod gsum par rloms pa za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes srin po zhes pa shing yos rgyal gyi sa nya ba'i dkar cha'i bzang po dang po tshes la gtsug lag lugs brgya'i 'dun sa rgyal khab chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa sarba dza gwa zhe shri ye bha / /—142

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga larab yi rgyu stog me 'brug lor deb ther du bkod pa'i dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du dri med nyags rgyud dpar du bskrun pa'i smon tshig dang /rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur sogs rten mchod gsar bzhengs kyi dkar chag sogs/go ltor 77pho:sna las sa po phreng wo/mo lto dzñā na mapū d+dha rdzu379zhe ta bh+ra su〉slo rī yi taḥbharmag lci rdzu gdi khyab me yasaḥrgyam rgya bya yi༅tā/bla med ye shes dkyil 'khor gang ba'i zla//tshems phreng 'od dkar 'dzum pa'i zhal sgo las//chos phung gaṅgā'i klung rdul grangs kyis kyang //gzhal min 'gro kun bsam yas 'tsho me ba bzhi//dbang 6na ) por 'tsham gsungs sman gyis sgrib gnyis nad//cha shas tsam mthar byas te gzhil nus rung //bya rog khyu mchog 'gros kyi khyad par ltar//yo ga'i lam gyis sar snyag tu myur//theg dgu'i nang wo rnal 'byor wo po yi//rab 'bog glang tsho tso las phyungs pa//sdig tsho gos dri ma med pa rtsab nas//'byin byed bshags pa'i rgyud rgyal 'di kha byung //'gro khams wo mongs rdul gyis dam ṣ+ka klung //ma dag rnyog mar gyur pa legs bsgrangs pa'i//gsang r+ṣa chos kyi nor bu ke ta daḥ/lus can bsod nams zong gis nyos pa bzhi//'jig rten mig gcig rnams kyis 'khrul med du//'phags yul skad las bod dper rab bsgyur ding //blun rmongasayi ge'i tsho gos kyis som nyi'i tshogs//glegs bam du mar gtugs te zhib mor dpyad//tha snyad rtog shes bslad pas gangs kyi ri//sngor mthong mig can la 'jug rdzas min yang //skal ldan rab rib sel ba'i gser thur gyis//phra rags chos kun gsal ba'i rtsi sman ljon//mi shes nongs pa tshangs pa'i 'khor lo yis/khas blangs dam bca'i mgrin pa /ra bcad kyang //thar pa'i srog rtsa mi ho 'chi med

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)kyi//bdud rtsi'i btung ba 'di las gzhan na gang //chos spong sgrib pa'i khung bur rtag nyal nas//ga spyod dug lce rkyong ba'i mkhas rlome sbrul//snying la brnag dka'i ri dgas lte ba'i dri//gcil la dusagasum rgyal ba sras bcasang la//'on te gsang las ches gsang 'brug gi sgra//thos pa'i mod la gtan bde'i mngal gyi khur//sbrum nus rigs 'dzin rma bya'i 116ba ) bu mo rnams//dga' ba'i sgro gshog zlum por da sgyur cig/bsod nams 'bras bu mtho ris chu bo yis//'gro rgyud sgrib gnyis khyab 'jug rkang pa'i dri//rab bkrus kun bzang go 'phang rgyal mtshan gyi//rtse mor mdzes pa'i tog 'od 'bar bar shog/ye dag rang rig nyi ma'i snying po la//skyon gyis ma gos gdod ma'i sangs rgyas zhal//gzhan nasa'atshol min mngon sum mjal nus pa'i//bkra shis 'jig rten ma lus khyab par shog/dri med bshagasargyud 'di nges gsang theg pa chen po'i lam du zhugs pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs la med du mi rung bar mchis pa yig mkhan sna tshogs pa'i skyon gyis mthun mi mthun ci rigs snang ba glegs bam 'ga' zhig la nye bar gtugs te shin tu dag pa'i lugs su bgyis nas me 'brug dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du brkos pa'i tshe par byang smon lam dang bcas pa za hor gyi sngags smyon gang shar gyi rang grol gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rig pa 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa sarba di klul udayabhawastu/swasti pra dza:ཿ/e ma rig sngags 'chang ba'i tsho gis rnams kyi//spyad byar 'os pa dri med bshagasapa'i rgyud//don gyi ri gnyis go lar 'gro ā+o sa kyang//rjod byed me tog bko tshul mi 'dra i//de phyir mkhas grub rim byon zhal lung las//gcig nas gcig brgyud mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can//chos rgyal byang pa'i bzhed pa bla med pa//ngo mtshar mi zad glegs bam gter sgo phyi//mkha' khyab skye rgu'i rgyud bgos 117na sdig lhung nad/ /bkru ba'i ro nus zhu rjes sngon med sman/ /gtan bde'i srog gi 'tsho ba don yod du//byed pa'i skal pa bzang por bdag 'gyur shog/dri med bshags rgyud 'gyur cung zad mi 'dra tsam chos rgyal byang pa'i phyag dreg4 rdo'i dpe khungs btsun pa dga' ldan phun tshogs

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha yonagling du par du brkos pa'i par byang za hor gyi sngags 'cha che mchog 'dus pa rtsal gyi sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa wadhe bha wa skyo/zhe yor 47la'i shut+ta las sa ge phreng wo/ā sham swā ma sus skya sku thaṅgānā dhi po ko pi rtaXdzin//ān+taridri grwa tsakra phyag rgya brabha gtwa tsin+ta du thā rnyiswā dhi tsho/zhi khro kun 'dus sgrub sde brgyad kyi gtso//che mchog drag por khros pa'i gzi byin gyis/ /bar chad bgegs kyi dpung tshogs rab bcoms nas//bsams pa ji bzhin dngos grub stsol byin rlobs//117ba tshe pos pa 'di ni skyam pa ngag dbang chos 'dzin/sngagasarams pa phun tshogs legs ra/lha sa ba blo bzang rab brtan gsum gyis rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i dkon gnyer byed skabs sku thang snyan dar kha dog sna tshogs pa dgu dang bcas pa 'di nyid kyis thog drangs zangs khal bdun cu don dgu las grub pa'i mchod kong nyis brgya dang gsum/'jug sgam lcags shan ma cha gnyis/dngul srang nyi shu'i che tshad snod khebs bcas/li ting chung ba g.yag mig ma bdun tshar gnyis/gser zho sum cu so gcig gi rgyu byas te sbyar spos tsan dan ma/kha che ma/gtor mar 'debs rgyu/chos skyong so so'i spyan 'dren gyi spos sbyor/gsar ma'i bum rdzas le tshan/skye khug zhe mtshudas tsam bcu gnyis/bum pa'i mgul chings gcig/sku 'dra gnyis la bar chung re/mtshal cog gser shog ma legs pa che chung sna tshogs cha brgyad dang ya gcig/stegs mtshal rtsi ma gcig/dkar po cha gnyis/an gdar che ba/me long gi shubs gcig/khyab 'jug gi mdos gtore bzheng snod bse'i pad ster tshon khrag ser shog ma gcig /tham tho'i dril gdan zhe mtshungasabargya dang zhe bzhi/rnga gdan brgyad kyi phyi g.yog rgya gling gi shubs cha snyag/ljang ser gyi sgron skyogasacha gnyis dang ya gcig/rnga sgroms drug/mchod dung 'jug snod sgam chung gcig/srid pa hu dang dngas ma bcud 'dren gyi gtso tsag rnams kyi spyi 'bul sngon ma rnams las 8na spoms mtho bar byas pa'i dge bas 'di phyi'i don kun bde blag tu 'grub par gyur cig/skyad shod nyang bran grong smad gyi gzhis ka/gzhis la ga khun / zhol/skyi nag/bzang yul phu mda' dang 4sa pa'i yong deb

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)rnams kyi mgo brjod ni'u le'i mgrin nas gas pa'i dpal 'byor/steb sbyor mnyam pa'iXt+ta las metog 'phreng can/ak+ṣa dirgaya te la m+bha bā sa rgya tsa sgyu la bī ṇi tsashā de ṇa hi/bha bsharnya su la klu du sheḥdza bhaṇ+ḍa ra rgya byudu lha yatsā tu/ spyan dkyus ring por brkyang dang lhan cig par//ut+pal rgyud las 'phos ba'i nyag phran gyis//srid zhi'i phun tshogs 'gugs pa'i dbang gi rgyal//rje btsun rigs byed lha mos dge legs stsol//bsod na mas dzasbu'i ljon pa las smon mtshor//longs spyod gser gyi snye ma dar drag pa//'dzad medaḥrmugs 'dzin 'byor pa'i mched zla yis/gnod sbyin sde dpon bsnyems pa ci yang 'phrog/dbus gtsang ru bzhin dbye ba sbus ru'i cha//118ba 'chi med bdag po'i yul gru sar 'phos pas//skyid shod nyang bran grong smad gzhis ka che//mkho dgu'i 'byor pa gcig tu 'phyur ba bzhin//dpyid kyi pho nya'i mgrin las rab snyan glu//len pa'i sngon 'gror btab pa'i sa bon tshogs//drod gsher skyed kyis bsrings pa'i 'bras ldan dus/ /dga' ston cho ga 'grub de su yis 'gog /mes po'i ral klung stug po las babs pa/ /yan lag brgyad ldan chu bo ji bzhin du/bgrang bya'i 'phrong ba rim par chad med dbyig/legs byas rin cen yol gor gcig tu 'khyil//zhes bkra shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pas sngun bsus te grong smad gzhis ga'i yong deb kyi rim pa gsar du bkod pa la//sdeb sbyor mkho pa' phrit+ta las metog phreng can/〉ya lha torka re pra d+dha ta karma bā li dro bha ṣ+ṭi shā rā lu shu lha rjes kaḥzhisha pā bo kyig9su ye na suḥbha gi rgo dha roXsu so kuṇ+ḍa yu/ 19na khims gsum kun gyi byed por btsan po las/khugs drag dbang phyug brgyad ldan gtsug na zla//lha chen ri sras tshogs kyi bdag po yis//legs byas sa 'dzin bla nas blar rtsegs shig/phyag na pad+ma'i thugs rje 'phrul po ches//phan bde'i 'byung khungs gnas su nyer brlabs pa//brgya phrag nyi ma'i gzi can byu ru'i ri/khro chags nyams kyi brtan g.yo sdud pa bzhin//gang bsam 'dod pa'i gter gyi bye ba'i sgo//'bad med 'byed pa'i bsod nams yongs 'du'i ljon//yal 'dab 'bras bus dud pa'i grib bsil du//sim pa'i tshor ba rtag tu myong byed 'dra//gong dkar pho brang bya 'dabs skyi 4/ga ces//grong smad gzhis phran 'bru mang dbyar
