sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (momatsho ltar//gyen nas gyen du 'phyur tshe tshangs ris kyi//yul sar snyeg la rings su chas sam snyam//drang srong chu lha'i bu yis nyal 'gro kun//dug bral sman du bsgyur ba'i dus kyi tshe//myu gu'i lang tsho smin pa'i 'bru khal grangs//mi bsgyud deb ther 'phreng ba 'di na spel//zhes ba po shis pa'i tshigs su bcad pa sngon du 'gro bas gong dkar skyi nag gi deb gsar du bkod pa la//19bsdeb sbyor mnya pa'i mit+ta las me kho phreng ༅/ni tu ta dhe ṇa senā su rba:mātra lha ji sa brnya tsā tardza shākaḥsukhyabistur rten pa twadzñā ta〉de bi/lha dzñā sa dwa pā la khu/nges gsang rgyud sde'i bcud kyi nying khu la/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i srog snying zhal drod rlangs//bde ba rgyas byed ḍā zhir bka' babs lha//dpal ldan 'dod pa'i rgyal mos rtag tu skyongs/khyod zhal dran pa'i mod la rgud pa'i smag/mthar byed stobs 'byor nyi ma skyid pa'i gung //'char bas spangs pa'i snang ba'i 'od po che//nam yang nub pa med de phan bde'i dpyid//mi bzad lcags kyu rnon po gdengs tsam gyis//'khor 'das kun gyi bstan pa yongs log na//lha mi'i 'dod dgu rang gi dbang byed la//'bad med 'grub pa'i sgyu thabs lo po che//mtho ris grong khyer sal rab 'phos pa//120na jid smad nor 'dzin dpal mo'i mngal gyi khur//legasalci sna tshogs 'bru rigs dar drag 'jun//kun bzod bcud kyi snying po'i rjes su 'gro khog dkar dri ma med par yi ge'i gzugs//mngon par bkra ba'i deb ther yol go'i nang //phun tsho gis wor pa'i mkho dgu spungs pa'i gtam//snyan po rna ba'i dpyid du 'di na len//zhes tshigs su bcad pa'i 'phreng ba sbun du btang ste skyid smad 'jun gzhis ka rtse zhol gyi yong deb bkod pa la/sdes sbyor 47 pa'i brit+ta las me tog phreng can/de ba ni skye su kha sgo mi kāswā na yak+ṣa kyasarba su pā lha ha ne be+e shra waḥhrīyaṅgā tā:bha ben te dzā gi gas sheya tom64bhadha rngu pā ta tu/lha rnams rtag tu bde ba'i ngal gso'i stegs//gnod sbyin yongs kyi sde dpon rnam thos sras/khams gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i gzi byin gyis//'dzad med dge ba'i ba po shis char du pheb// 20bsog g.yon sor mos legs bcir ne'u lo yis//mgrin nas skyug pa'i yid bzhi nor bu'i dbya//༷sod nams byas pa'i rab yangs snod li por//

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20) wa waphyur bur spungs pa'i dga' ston e ma mtshar/ /gangs kyi ra bas bskor ba'i khor yug 'dir/ /pho brang lcang lo can gyi 'byor pa'i mdzod/ /'dren pa'i byed po skye mang goms pa yi/ /chos dkar phung po de la gcig tu rangs/ /dge bcu'i dpal 'bar lho rgyud g.yo ru'i cha/ /bzang yul grong gsar bkra shis rgyas pa'i steng / /'bru bcud lang tsho'i bzhin ras dngom pa na/ /skabs gsum lus phra'i khengs pa bag la zha/ /'dzin ma'i yon tan 'bras bu yongs dud pa/ /brjed ngas dri ma 'khrud pa'i nyal 'gro'i rgyun/ /lhung lhung snyan pa'i sgra dang chabs cig par/ /deb ther rdzing bu'i ngogs su babs 'di mtshar/ /zhes phun sum tshogs pa'i tshig gi 'phreng ba sngon du btang ste bzang yul phu mda'i deb gsar du sgrigs pa 95/su sti pra dza saḥ rgyal kun 'dus pa rnga yab gling pa dang / /dbyer med zur chen chos dbyings rang grol rje'i/ /zhabs kyi pad+ma ra gus pas phyag byas te/ /mdo rgyud pu sta ka 'phreng deb ther dgod/ khesakhyab bdag chos dbyings rang grol gyi phyag dpe dkar chag gi mchod brjod/chos lde chen po dpal ldan sa spungs kyi byang chub lam rim lha khang dang sngags khang gi mchod rdzas me 'brug deb bsgrigs kyi (121na 'go brjod kun bzang chos sprin/ (sdeb sbyor mnya pa'i rlut+ta las me sto phreng mā/〉ma lnga ma:rma tat+pa na ta skra myacaskyo twa muk+ta su hrīdī pa tā du bkaḥ nā ya ka su pra nokā dharat+na su sri mi ka lugu rgyas ta sgra kyi gas la ta chung 'bring chen po'i lam gyi rim pa la/ /brten nas thar pa'i gling du lus can rnams/ /'khrid pa'i ded dpon yongs 'dzin rin cen 'phreng / /dpal ldan bla ma'i bzhugs gnas ga rje la/ /'jam dpal drag por khros pa ma he'i zhal/ /spyan ras gzigs sprul myur mdzad ye shes mgon/ /bka' sdod las gshin rje'i dpung tshogs rnams/ khugs drag gar gyis rol pa'i gzhal med khang / /rab bkra sna tsho gis mchode pa'i sprin phung tshogs/ /rab yangs nam mkha' mdzod ltar zad mi shes/ /rab dngas mos pas nyer dbul mkho dgu'i rdzas/ /rab brtan g.yung drung lta bu mi 'gyur chod/ /rgya bal ḍi li a gar sa ca dang / /pu skyo ka ba stod (121bskyod hor dang rgya/ /sna tshogs yul gyi ka ca ma 'dres par/ /rnam par brtags—148—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga (mashing dpyad nas ngos bzung gang /mang gi ma ma'i do ra yangs pa'i nang //sdebs gzugs spel legs yi ge'i zlos gar tshogs//sor mo'i 'phrul gyis bsgyur ba'i rnam dpyod la//'dren byed yangs pa med par ltos shig gu//zhes dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi byang chub lam rim lha khang dang sngags khang gnyis kyi mchod rdzas me 'brug chu stod zla ba'i yar tshes la deb ther du bkod pa ni/ldeb spyor mkho pa'i mit+ta las me mā phreng ༅/margata 〈be+e du r+sharta su char sma ñtsa li stun mi sgon+tabha bā thu staḥ//kār yu ru pe pa bo rte:da ye tse dmu stoṭa ta wa rgya bhu//mar rgad rdul brtsegs brgya phrag nyi ma'i 'od//byugs pas mtshon min srid zhi'i brtan pa kun//'phrog byed 'phags ma'i snang brnyan sa 'dzin du//shar 'di sbur rgyal skye rgu'i bsod nams mthu// 22nags gnyis drang por srong ba khrims kyi thig/mi g.yo'i bka' btsan dgyel che sgam po'i thugs//lag na pad+ma gangs can lha gcig pur//yongasabastan 'khor los mtshan pa'i zhabs bkod pa//sgeg ldem lang tsho'i 'khri shing gzhen nu ma//mdzes sdug 'chi med bu mo'i khengs pa bsnyil//phan bde'i lo 'bras dud pa'i dpag bsam ljon//mong bza' khri lcam thugs dam gas la//nang mtha' 'od zer gtsang byed pad+ma'i sbubs//brtul zhugs grub pa'i gar sgyur srid gsum na//che ba'i sngags 'chang rnga yab gling pa zhes//rgyal ba kun 'dus de yis byin rlabs yul//brtse chen mar mes byang phyogs smag gi rus//sel mdzad kyi sras thu bo khu rngog sogs//pha chos bdun ldan bka' gdams mu tig 'phreng //nor 'dzin dpal mo'i mgul par mdzes pa'i rgyan//snang srid dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kiṅka rang//byed pa'i nus can ku ma rā dza'i zhabs//chosarnams klong chen mkhar grol rab 'byams rje//snga 'gyur bstan pa'i nyi 'od brdal ba'i gzhi/risamed skye rgu'i legs byas gos bu ding //rab smin dga' ldan gsang sngags yang rtse zhes//rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i ring lugs tshogs//ches dar 122bab ser 'chang ba 'dus pa'i gling //kun dga' ra ba'i khor yug dus gsum gyi//bder gshegs sras dang slob mar bcas pa'i sku//ngo mtshar mig gi bdud rtsi nyer bskrun pas//sgyu ma maX/ gyi khengs pa thung ngur byas//'di don sgrub la sgo

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)gsum yongs 'bad dang //chu thigs tsam gyi mtha' brten dngos po yis//phan par byed rnams pol yun bde dang skyid/rang min bla med byang chub 'thob par shog/spyi dang khyad par su la'i sman ljongs 'dir//dus kyi chad pa'i zug rngu ming rjes kyang //mi grag rdzogs ldan la spyod 'gro ba yi//sim pa'i tshor ba lhan cig myong bar shog /khyad par thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa'i/ /phul byung bstan pa yid bzhi nor bu mchog/srid zhi'i rgyal mas rtse mor rab bkod nas//don gnyis 'dod dgu'i char chen bsnyil bar shog/ces yer pa dga' ldan gsang sngags yang rtse'i 'du khang gi ldebs ris bla gnyer grwa ris rnams kyis 'bad pas bsgrubs pa'i tshe dkar chag dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa dza yan+tu//sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i phrit+ta las me tog 'phrong can/ 123na ) āXs nyuni mit+ta pad+ma su pe di shwaka ni rma le rmāXhālhu taḥbā yod da di di be+e du rā da shā shu/khye chus kyan/sku2wa rnakaḥ//spros pa'i mas ma kun dang yongs bral yang //sna tsho gos sprul pa sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar//gaṅgā'i klung gi rdul gyis cha tsam du//bgrang bar nus min nyi ma'i gnyen khyod bsngags//rin cen cod pan ma pham mgon po'i dbur//bcings te zhing 'di'i 'gro ched shākya'i rigs//nyer bltams rdo rje'i gdan steng bdud bzhi'i dpung //rab bcom mchog gi sprul skur ma' 'tshang rgyas//grangs med sdig pa'i mgal dum cher spungs par//thog med nas 'bar dug gsum byin za'i dbal//zhi byed yan lag bcu gnyis nyal 'gro'i rgyun//chosanyid bden pa bstan na gcig tu mtshar//phyogs lhung char gyi sprin la mig lta zhing //123ba ) rig pa'i dbyar rngas sgra tshad mngal 'dzin pa//phyi rol ston par khas 'ches mdong mtha' phal//log sbyor sgro gzhog zlum por bsgyur nas mnar//de phyir bzod dka'i zug rngu chu srin gyi//'byung gnas 'bor ba zla ba'i ma ma che//sgrol ba'i gru chen gnyis med gsung ba las//ston g.yin 'tshol rnams 'khrul pa'i dra bas bcings//'khor lo'i ri mos mtshan zhabs ma bkod pa'i//swā la'i sman gyi ljongs sogs yul mang por//dge sdig 'dor len nyams su bsta/ byed pa//mgon khyod 'phrin las 'asdug pa khor

sku gsung thugasarten gsar bangasadang rin po che'i mchod rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar sa (menar mchis/ /rgyun mtha'i byang semasatshun blo'i ra ba las/ /yongs brgal mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan kun mkhyen pa'i/ /yon tan brjod nus min yang sems can rnams/ /'dren byed gsung gi mdzad pa phul du byung / /chu shel bu mo'i rdul mngasamathor brtsegasari'i/ khor yug yongasabaskor zhing 'dir rgyal ba'i bka'/ /rab 'gyur rgyal blon lo paṇa phyag gi rjes/ /ri mo khyab mjug ngesakyang dbye nus min/ /legasabyasadabu 'phreng dkar 'khrigasa'o ma'i mtshor/ /phan bde'i 'dab gshog rkyong ba 'khor lo'i lag /gtan mdun mgrin pa'i dril chung yongasa'abrol ba/ /snyan po yid kyi ngal gso'i gtam 'di gleng / /zhes tshigs su bcad pasasngun bsus te/ thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa chen pos/res 'ga' rgyal la dmigs pa'i dad pa skye/ /skabs 'gar shing (124nasko chen po'i sku drin dran/ /g.yin tshe mkhasapa'i bshesal gusapa dang / /nyam chung 'gro la snying nasabartse ba dang / /bstan pa rin cen ring du gnasa'adod pa/ 'di dag phan tshun 'gran bzhin 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhesagasungasapa'i bstan pa rin po che ni 'jig rten gsum gyi sgron me gcig pu pa yin la/ /de'ang slob dpon dbyig gnyen gyis/ ston pa'i dam chosarnam gnyisate/ /lung dang rtogasapa'i bdag nyid do/ /zhesalung rtogasaganyis su bshad pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rim rgyud la skye bar byed pa la de ston par byed pa'i lung gi bstan par rag lusashing / de yang / ji skad du/ chosarnamasathams cad bka' dang bstan bcosaganyis su 'du/ /legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongasa'agrel ba/ /de yi dbang gisashākya'i bstan pa ni/ /'jig rten khamasa'adir yun ring gnasapar 'gyur/ /zhesabaka' dang dgongasa'agrel gnyis su byung ba'i rjes 'brangs mkhan po rnams kyis 'grel pa mdzad pa'i bshad gzhi yang thub pa'i bka' yin la/ de yi rga kyang chos mngon par/ spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ /chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs/ /zhes gdul bya nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong la spyod pa'i gnyen por chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungasapa bsdu na gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis/ de bsdu na dgu/ de bsdu na sdesnod gsum du 'du ba rnams (124bshi bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das rjes bka' bsdu rim —151—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shepa gsum gyi sgo nasaglegasabam du bkod pa/ lung las/ mnyan yod gnasabacasatsam pa ka /wa ra ṇa si yangasapa can/ rgyal po'i khab dang drug po ni/ /de dag grong khyer chen por grags/ /zhesayul chen po drug gisamatshon pa'i rgya gar gyi phyogs kun tu 'dri klog 'chad nyan bsnyen bkur ba sogasadar rgyas che la/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ nga yi dus nas lo brgya na/ kha ba can du mtsho bri nas/ /sā la'i nags ni 'byung ba 'gyur/ /zhesabod kyi rgyal khamasamatshos gang ba kong chu lag tu song ste swā la'i nagasachags pa nas ring zhig na thugs rje chen po dang sgrol mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i spre'u dang brag srin mo las mi'i 'gro ba 'phel bar ma sangs spun dgu/ rgyal phran nyer lnga/ bcu gnyis/ sil ma bzhi bcus rim bzhin dbang byas shing / de rjes 'phags pas byin gyis brlabasapa'i rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po nasabazung rgyal rabs nyer brgyad pa dpal kun tu bzang po'i rnam par sprul pa lha tho tho ri'i snyan shal yar klungs kyi sa'i cha pho brang yom bu gla sgang gi rtser bzhugs pa'i tshe dpang skong phyag rgya pa/ snying po yi ge drug pa/ gser gyi mchod sdong / tshin+ta ma ṇi'i rkos phor rnamasababasapar mtshan gnyan bo gsang bar gsol te bstan pa'i dbu brnyengs/ de nasargyal rabs lnga na/ bka' gdamasaglegasabam rin po cher/ 'di nasaskye ba gzhan (125nayo)sam chod par/ /bod khamasamagon med yul du thugasarjesasong / /bod 'di rgyal po dag la tshad mar byed/ /mi dbang mdzod las bod khams bde bar skyongs/ /zhes rje dkon cog 'bangs kyi yang srid chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po ni spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa yin pas las ldan rnamasakyis a mi de wa dngosasu mthong / bod du yi ge'i srol btod/ rgya bal gyi sras mo khab tu bzhes par brten jo shākya gnyis sogs spyan drangs srin mo'i lus dbyibs kyi sa'i me btsa' bcu gnyis la lha khang brtsegs/ ra sadang ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang du jo bo rnam gnyisabazhugasasu gsol zhing rang byon lnga ldan sogs brten pa lha'i tshogs grangs med pa spel te 'gro ba'i bsod namasakyi mchod sdong dam pa mdzad/ rgyal rabs lnga song ba na 'phagasapa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa chosargyal tshangs pa lha'i me tog gis ā tsar+ya bo dhi satwa gdan drangs nasadam pa'i chosadar bar mdzad bzhed —/52—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar sa lkog dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (7pa la thang lhas dmar po rir thog phab/ sham pos phang thang gi pho brang chu la bskur/ bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis mi nad phyugs nad sogs lha ma srin gyi tshogs kyi lhongs che bar byung ba na sngags mkhan pad+ma sam+bha wa spyan drangs te lha 'dre btul zhing sa gzhi brlabs nas zan g.yang lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang brtsegs/ sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ba sogs dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs shing lo paṇa rnams kyis mdo rgyud kyi chos mang du bsgyur/ dbon (125ba)sras gsang ba'i bdag po'i sprul pa khri srong lde btsan gyis 'on cang rdo dpe med bkra shis dge 'phel gyi pho brang du bzhugs nas/ dzi na mi tra sogasapaṇ+ḍita mang po dang ye shes sde sogs lo tsā ba rnams la yab mes kyi dus bsgyur ba'i gsung rab go dka' ba dang chos kyi brda dang mi mthun pa rnams legs par bcos nas skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phob ces pa'i bka' gnang / rgyal po'i dbu skra la dar yug btags pa'i steng du dge 'dun gyi tshogs bzhugs su gsol ba dang rab byung re la mi khyim bdun re 'bul ba sogs bstan pa'i zhabs rtag 'di lta bu rgya gar du'ang ma byung bar grags/ bstan pa phyi dar la dpal mar me mdzad dang paṇa chen gha ya dha ra sogs paṇa grub khungs btsun du ma byon zhing lo chen rin bzang dang 'brog mi gnyis nas bzung thams cad mkhyen pa zha lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po'i bar du byon pa'i 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu rnams kyis bka' bstan bcos bsgyur ba dang bsgyur zin 'chos pas mtshon thub pa'i bstan pa la byi dor med du byung ba mdzad/ mnga' bdag sad na legs kyi dus ska cog rnam gnyisakyis thog drangs pas pho brang phang thang du rgyud sde 'og ma gsum dang mdo 'dul sher phyogs kyi glegs bam rnams phyogs gcig tu mdzad pa bka' 'gyur bsgrig pa'i thog ma yin/ de rjes dkar chag ldan dkar ma/ dbus pa blo gsal sangs rgyas 'bum sogs kyis dpal snar thang du bsgrigs (126na)par bcom ldan ral gyis dkar chag nyi ma'i 'od zer mdzad/ gi tu dge ba'i blo gros kyis dkar chag tu bkod par tshal pa bka' 'gyur zhes dbus phyogs su grags che/ de dang dus mtshudas par nyang smad zha lu gser bkang du snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa bu ston rin po che chos kyi 'byung gnas gsung —153

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)rab rin po che'i mdzod bsgrigs par brten bka' 'gyur them spangasam zhesabyung / de dag las phyi mor byasate 'byor ldan rnams kyis rgya cher spel ba'i phan yon ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa las/ sangasargyasakyi tshul rgyun chad par ma gyur cig /dam pa'i chosanub par ma gyur cig khesadam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas par bya ba dang / tshul dang ma bral bas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la phan gdags pa bsgrub pa byas par 'gyur pa chung ngu na glegs bam du chud bar byas te 'chang ngam bzhag la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa de la me tog dang bdug pa dang dri dang 'phreng ba dang byug pa dang phye ma dang na bza' dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang dril bu dang ba dan dag dang kho ra khor yug tu mar me'i 'phreng ba dag dang mchod pa rnam pa mang po dag gis mchod par byed de bkur stir byed/ bla mar byed/ brjed par byed/ mchod par byed/ ri mor byed/ bsnyen bkur byed na/ ko shi ka bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa de la rin po che sna bdun gyi mchod rten de bzhin gshegs (126ba)pa'i ring bsrel gyi phung po can la bkur stir byed pa'i bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa snga ma des brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ stong gi char yang / bye ba'i char yang / bye ba brgya'i char yang / bye ba stong gi char yang / bye ba brgya stong gi char yang / bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi char yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /grangs su yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ char yang / bgrang bar yang / dper yang / dpes bstan par bya ba yang / rten du yang/ rgyur yang ma bzod do/ /zhes rnam smin dkar por 'dzag par gsungs shing / sngar thos bsam gyi gra bzang bas rgyud 'dul lung sher phyogs dkon brtsegs sangasargyas rma ga chad sogs kyi rgyun cung zad dar na'ang mdo mangs rnams dkon par brten dge ba'i bshes gnyen gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas kyis steng pa lo rtswa ba rgya gar du chos 'tshol du btang bas paṇ+ḍi ta pu byoshrī la mdo sna sum brgya dang nyer dgu'i lung gsan/ sa gsum gyi mgon po 'phags pa rin po ches stag ston shes rab 'od zer la bka' gnang ba bzhin smri ti dzñā nasgru nas brgyud pa shangs pa grags seng la gsan/ de nas ring zhig lon pa na bag ston gzhen nu tshul khrims kyis brgyud pa mi gcig pa —/54

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mabazhi la gsan pas mdo mangs la bka' drin mchog tu che/ rim gyis lhag je phrar song ba thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' rnam rgyal gyi bka' drin las me ro gsos pa dus dbang gis 'jig rten gyi 'du 'dzi las gal chung chos su byas (127na)pa'i skyon gyis mdo 'dul sher phyogs kyi rgyun shin tu nyag phra ba'i tshe rgyal kun ngo bo gnas gsar ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mkhas grub chen po nyang ston blo mchog rdo rje lung rgyun khungs btsun pa 'tshol bar mngags te gsan pa dang rgyud 'bum ngor dang 'dul lung gong dkar du gsan zin pa nas bka' 'gyur yongs su rdzogs pa chu 'brug gong dkar rdo rje gdan gyi chos grwa chen por gnang bas ding sang stod smad kun tu khyab ste shākya seng ge'i bstan pa rin po che'i srog gi zungs su gyur pa ni bka' drin zla med pa'o/ /de yang dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis 'di ga'i ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung dang rang gi sgrib sbyongs su dmigs te sku gsung thugs kyi rten bzhengs pa'i 'di phyi kun tu dge ba'i phan yon ni/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ gang gi rgyal ba'i sku ni rab 'bar zhing / khyad par 'phags pa'i gzugs dang sems 'dra ba/ /dzam klung gser ltar rab mdzes lta na sdug /mtshan gyi me tog rgyas pas mngan du gang / /mngon par shes pa thob cing dbang chen grags/ /byang chub spyod mchog dam pa zhi ba spyod/ /de ni nam yang longs spyod 'grib mi 'gyur/ /lhas kyang bsti stang bya zhing mchod par 'ong / /bstan pa 'dod pa'i longs spyod gzhan mi dga'/ /tshul (127ba khrims rnam dag rab mkhas tshangs par spyod/ /yi dam bcas nas nags dang nags 'dabs song / /mngon shes 'thob cing khyad par 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / shes rab khri pa las/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /ji skad smas pa de bzhin te/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo des tshes brgyad dang / tshes bcu bzhi dang / tshes bco lnga la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha rtan du byed pa dang / 'chad nga ra byed pa na bsod nams kyi phung po dpa gtu med/ grangasamed/ tshad med/ bsam gyis mi khyab/ gzhal du med pa mang po dag bskyed par 'gyur zhing de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha ton du byeng pa dang 'chad par byed pa na lha'i 'khor mdun du gnas —155

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gepar 'gyur ro/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rin po che yin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de la rin po che ni 'di yin te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni semasacan dmyal bar 'gro ba las yongs su thar par byed pa dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / mi dbul po dang / gnod sbyin dbul po dang / klu dbul po las yongs su thar bar byed pa yin no/ zhes dang / dam chos pad dkar las/ gang gis mchod rten rdo las byas pa dang / /gang (128na gis a ka ru dang tsan dan nam/ /gang gis thang shing mchod rten byas pa dang / /la lasashing ngam g.yin las byas pa dang / /sa dang so phag las ni brtsigs pa yi/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten dga' zhing byas pa dang / /de phyir sa rdul phung po dag las kyang / /mya ngam dgon pa gang du byas pa dang / /byisapa rtse mor de dang de dag tu/ /gang gis rgyal ba de phyir mchod rten dag /bye ma las ni phung po byas pa yang / /de rnams kyis kyang byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes rgya cher bsngags pa rig byed kyi gzhung ltar sgro btags pa ma yin par sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' nam yang slu ba med pa'i gnas so/ /rnam dag dad pa'i ri bong 'dzin 'od kyis/ /chos dkar phung po spungs pa kun+da'i tshal/ /ba 'ad pas thub bstan spyi dang btsong kha pa'i/ /ring lugs ge sar ze'u 'bru rgod par shog /rnam gsum sdosnod klog dang de don rnams/ /bsam pa'i bshes gnyen ma la yar skyes ljon/ /phyogs rnams kun tu 'phel zhing rab brtan las/ /'gro la phan bde'i dri bsung spro bar shog shwakya seng ge'i gsung ngag sde snod gsum/ /klog dang spong bar dbang bas blo ldan tshogs/ /bzang po'i skal par yongs sbyor 'phrin las rgyun/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can gzhi 'dir g.yo med shog /mthun pa'i (12shab〉ltan sbyor gzhan gyisaphan pa bsgrubs/ /'dri dang zhugadag g.yos mkhan sgo gsum gyis/ /las byed bcas pa'i tshe dpal bsod nams sogs/ /dkar cha'i zla ba lta bur 'phel bar shog /thog med srid 'khyams nas bzung da lta'i bar/ /bsags pa'i kun 'byung des bskyed sdug bsngal rnams/ /nyi ma'i 'od kyis dros pa'i ba mo bzhin/ /dmigs med stong pa'i dbyings su rgyas 'debs shog /'khor ba'i bde ba tsam la thob bya —156

sku gsung thugasarten gsar bzhengasadang ran po lo mardzo rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar chag (memā/'dzin dang dman lam ched du bsgrubasapa'i dge/e raṇ+ḍal snying por mi bzung bar//'gro kun byang chen thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo//rkang gnyis rnams kyi gtso bo rdzogasasangs rgyas//zhi ba 'dod chagasabral ba dam pa'i chos//tshogasamachog theg gsum dge 'dun byin rlabs kyis//smon pa'i re 'brasagrub par bdag rjesazungs//sgrib gnyisadagra lasarnam par rgyal ba'i lha//byang semasathosasgrog slob mar bcasapa'i 'khor//bden tshig brjod pa'i dbyangasasnyan me tog char//nyer phog 'jig rten khamasakun shis gyur cig/ces me pho 'brug gi lo dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan gyis rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog gtso bor gyur pa'i rten gsum bzhengs pa'i tshe che brjod smon lam dang bcas ba dgosatshul ltar za hor gyi ban+des sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa bha wan+tu/sdomasbyor mash+ka pa'itsān+ta lasazlum po/129na〉8mogabaskyitsokushaphyagaljizhirnamārganekayikasāyamārakopabhāglablosamābanārnyanairmakāyapodha//dip+lukālpamasahasrabud+dhamahṝhradalwatigastistonalwadikāru'idamadrushākumacuspyiyañtsahu:yasmogazhom gzhig dang bral rdo rje'i gdan la 'jam mnyen ku sha'i phung po bkram steng mi shigasaskyil mo krung gcig gis//srod la yid srubasasdebacasanyer bcomasagung la mnyam par bzhag pa'i thun mthar mchog gi sprul skur sangs rgyas pas//sgron me'i bskal bzang 'di la stong phrag 'dren pa rgyu skar dbusan snying stobs 'od zer 'bar bsakhyad zhugs pa//thugasarje'i nyi ma 'jig rten gsum gyi gung nasalegasa'achar zasagatsang sras kyis phun sum tshogs pa'i dge legs stsol//sgrib gsum 'ching rgya las grol mkhyen brtse nusaldan don gnyisagrub pa'i skye rgu'i mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas//'gro ba'i dug lnga'i nad kun nyer zhi lha mi'i bsod namasazhing gyur bden gnyisaldan pa dam pa'i chos//tshul bzhin thos 29bajasam sgom pa'i nor gyisarab phyug 'khor ba'i dbul sel rig grol gnyis ldan dge 'dun la//byang chen de srid pus mo'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas yan lag mchog gis btud de gusaphyag 'tshal//stobasabacu'i rtsal gsum yongs su rdzogasapas 'jigs pa med pa seng ge'i rgyud kyi nga ro las//kun rdzob don dam bden pa'i gnas lugs legasasnyan glur 'bab thub dbang 7

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)gsung rab chos phung che/ /srid zhi'i gdung ba can gzan ngar skad snyems pa rab 'phrog 'jig rten khams su khyab pa'i sgra/ /rnam 'dren mgur nas yan lag drug cu'i zla med zil dngar lus can kun gyi rna ba'i dpyid/ /'od srungs la sogs nyan thos tshogs kyis bka' rnams rim bsdus pusta gaḥ/ /'phags yul nor 'dzin lus phra'i mngal yangs gcig tu lci ba'i khur chen las/ /swā la'i ljongs 'dir thub gsung gzhen nu 'grul med zla bzhin nyer btsas pa/ /rgyal blon lo paṇa ma ma'i bka' drin a ho bsams gyin gzhal dka'i gnas/ /grangs med bskal par thugs bskyed sa bon rnams/ /tshogs gnyis drod gsher gyis bskrun chos gzugs sku'i/ /mtshan dpe'i dpag bsam ljon pa dar drag rtser/ /phan bde'i 'bras bzang smin pa'i cho ga mkhan/ /gzod ma nyid nas stug po bkod zhing gtsor/ /'tshang rgya khyod min sangs rgyas spyi yi srol/ /ma 'dris 'gro ched zas gtsang sras gzungs pa/ /'dul dka'i gdul byar gcig tu brtse 'di mtshar/ /dzaskru'i gser gyi lhun por nyin byed (130na)gos/ /'bum gyis dkris pas cha tsam sgrun min pa/ /mthong na mi mthun med pa mtshan dpe'i sku/ / dran pa'i mod la 'khor ba'i duḥ kha 'jig /bgrang yas skye rgu'i bsam par 'tsham pa'i don/ /mtha' klasaskad du 'tshar ba'i 'phrul po ches/ /chos nyid bden pa bstan pas sems can kun/ /grol ba'i sgyu thabs gzhan gyi spyod yul ci/ /ji lta'i mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang / /ji snyed gnas lugs phra rab rdul phran yang / /ma 'dres gzigs tshul bsam tshe mgon khyod las/ /ston pa g.yin 'tshol lha min gdon gyis btab/ /ring nas bya dka'i spyod pa mtha' klas pas/ /grangs med bskal par bsgrubs pa'i tshogs chen yang / /sems can rnams dang lhan cig longs spyod par/ /bzhed pa brtse ba'i zhagasapas mkha' gos bcings/ /ji srid brgal dka' 'khor klung ma bskams bar/ /thugs rje'i rdzings kyi 'jug pa ma chad pa'i/ /bka' drin gzhal ba'i bre ru stong gsum gyi/ /'jig rten 'di yang khab kyi mig bur zad/ /gsung rab 'dri klog lan dang to pa yi/ /bsod nams ri bo dngos su rgyu 'dra ba'i/ /slu med gtam gyis yid drangs mdza' na mo/ /snying la mi phyed 'khyud pa'i rtse dga' rgod/ /de phyir legs—/58

sku gsung thugasarten gsar bzhongasadang rin po che'i mchod rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar chag (mibyasadzasbu tri sha'i 'bras/ /gtan mdun gser gyi snye mar yongs gyur pa/ /byang chub chen po'i bar du mi 'dzad pa'i/ /rnam dag brjod pa'i ta'i ra 'di 'brol/ /zhesashisapa brjod pa/ phyag bya ba/ dngosapo nges par bstan pa gsum (130ba)gyi sgo nas tshigs su bcad pa sngon du btang ste skabs su gleng bar bya ba'ang / 'phags pa sdud pa las/ /'dzam bu'i gling 'dir chu klung ji snyed cig 'bab cing / /me tog 'brasaldan sman dang nagasatshal skyed byed pa/ /ma drosaganasapa'i klu dbang klu bdag brtan gnasate/ /de ni klu yi bdag po de yi mthudapal yin/ /rgyal ba'i nyan thosapa dag ji snyed chosaston dang / /'chad dang rig pa dag dang ldan par brjod pa dang / /mchog 'phags bde ba byed dang de yi 'bras thob pa /de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthu/ /zhes ma dros pa'i mtsho chen por gnas pa'i klu'i dbang po'i mthu la brten nasadzam bu'i gling gi chu klung rtsi shing nags tshal me tog 'bras bu sogs snod kyi yon tan 'phel ba ltar byang sems nyan rang skye 'phags rnams kyis dam pa'i chos ston pa dang de don nyams su bstar bas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde'i 'bras bu smin pa'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu la brten nas 'byung bar gsungs shing sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las kyang ma pham pas/ /de bzhin 'khor ba ji srid bar/ /las ni rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod/ /cesa'akhor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad pa'i 'jug bya sems can gyi khams la tshad bzung bar mi nus shing 'gro ba'i lasakyi mthus snod kyi 'jig rten grub pa'ang / mkhas pa'i gsung las/ ji ltar me long ngos la bzhin snang ltar/ /'jig rten zhesabya phyi na yod min kyang / /byisarnams (131na)ji ltar snang ba de tsam la/ /bden par zhen te so sor a thang chad/ /ji ltar rmi lam snang ba sna tshogasade/ /snang dang mi bden gnyisaka'i yin pa ltar/ /'khor 'das snang ba sna tshogs thamasacad kyang / /bden rdzun bral ba de ltar shes par gyis/ /zhes gsungs pa bzhin theg pa 'og ma dang phyi rol pa sogs 'jig rten gyi khams phyi na yod par 'dod pa don la gnas pa ma yin pa'i rgyu mtshan mdo sde pa dang sems tsam pa sogs kun gzhi rnam shes 'khrul rgyus bslad pa ma gtogs don la phyi rol tu ma grub —159

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20) wa wapar bzhed la/ spyod 'jug las/ lcags bsregs sa gzhi su yis byas/ /me tsho gos de dag gang lasabyung / /des na de dag thams cad ni/ /sdig sems yin par thub pas gsungs/ /zhes mi dge ba'i las bsags pa'i yid ngor ngan song gi gnas shar bar bstan pa'i shugs la dge ba'i las bsags pa'i ngor bde 'gro'i gnas dang longs spyod 'char bar bstan cing der ma zad pha rol tu phyin pa'i yang dag mtha'i skabs sangs rgyas kyi zhing du dag pa rab 'byams kyang rang rang gi tshogs kyis sgrub dgos par bshad pas ding sang blun po mkhas pa'i khur 'dzin pa mang po dag 'og min du 'tshang rgya zhes pa gnas bye brag par ngos bzung nas bla ma bsko bzhag ltar gnas ther zug cig tu 'gro ba lta bur smra ba ni log rtog gi sgrib pa kho nar zad cing / dri med 'od kyi 'jig rten khams ler/ 'jig rten kun rdzob tu mos pa sna tshogs pa'i sems can rnams kyi (131ba thas ma pa'i dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams la tshad sna tshogs gsungs shing / don dam pa'i bden pas 'jig rten gyi khams la tshad med de/ sems can gyi bsod nams dang sdig pa'i dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams la tshad sna chogs su snang ba yin zhes sems can gyi las snang sna tshogs pas 'jig rten gyi khams kyang 'di tsam mo zhes kha mtshon gcod par dka' mod/ 'on kyang dpal ldan zla bas 'jig rten gyi grags pa mi 'gog par gsungs pa bzhin mngon pa gong 'og /'jig rten gdags pa/ dran pa nyer bzhag /sangs rgyas phal po che/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ dus 'khor/ rnying ma'i mgon po bde rgyud sogs gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa nas lugs srol mi mthun pa mang du snang ba'i chos mngon pa ltar na gling bzhi ri rab tshangs gnas dang bcas pa phyi'i rgya mtsho'i phyi rol khor yug cig gis bskor/ 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor la thug pa/ mdzod las/ gling bzhi pa dang nyi zla dang / /ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong la ni/ /stong ni spyi phud yin par 'dod/ /de stong la ni stong gnyis pa/ /bar ma'i 'jig rten khams yin no/ /de stong la ni stong gsum pa/ /mnyam du 'jig cing 'byung ba yin/ /zhes 'jig rten gyi khams gcig tu ngos 'dzin la/ chu zheng de las 'das pa'i phyi rol tu 'jig rten khams de dang mtshungs—160

sku gsung thugasarten gsar 4khosadang rin po che'i mja rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar chag 6)pa stong gi bar du bgrangs pa rgya mtsho gcig gis brten khor yug gcig gis bskor ba stong spyi phud kyi 'jig rten gyi (132naloms/ de 'dra stong du tshang ba rgya mtsho gcig la brten khor yug gcig gisabaskor ba stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams/ de lta bu stong gi grangs tshang ba gangs chen mtsho'i rgya mtsho chen por brten khor yug gcig gis bskor ba stong gsum gyi 'jig rten gyi khams rnams chags 'jig dus gcig tu 'byung ba 'di ni mchog gi sprul sku'i zhing du 'dod la/ theg chen ltar na/ stong gsum gyi 'jig rten de bye ba phrag brgyar rab 'byamasamatshamasasbyor/ de bye ba phrag brgyar rab 'byams rgyud gcig /de bye ba phrag brgyar rab 'byamasargya mtsho'i bar ma'i rgyud gcig /de bye ba phrag brgyar gzhi dang snying po me tog gis brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams sprul sku gcig gi zhing yin pa chags 'jig gnas stong bzhi cig car du byed pa de'ang rnam snang gangs can mtsho'i ba spu'i khung bu re dang zhing gi rdul rer yang bye ba phrag brgyar gnas shing rnam snang gangs can mtsho de bdag cag gi ston pa longasaspyod rdzogs skur bzhengs pa yin la/ sngar bshad pa'i zhing khams gcig tu bsdoms pa de longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku re re'i zhing du gsungs tshul 'di yis nam mkha' ji srid khyab par gyur pa de snyed rgyal ba'i zhing dang sku'ang gnas so/ /rang re'i zhing 'di ni rnam snang gangs can mtsho'i phyag gi lhung bzed nas pad+ma'i sdong po nyer lnga yod pa'i bcu gsum pa'i steng na gnas pa dbus ma'i snying po me tog gis brgyan cing de lasadabusakyi (132bangab 'byams/ rab 'byams rgyud/ rab 'byams mtshams sbyor/ de dbus gling bzhi ri rab bye ba phrag brgyas brgyan pa ni mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams zhes ston pa thub pa'i dbang po sogs sangs rgyas stong 'byon sa yin/ 'gro ba rnams nyon mongasapa las mi mjed pa'i phyir zhing gi skyon gyi sgo nas smad la/ zhing 'di'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogasani lhag par yang bzod pa dang ldan pa'i yon tan la bsngags pasan 'jig rten gyi khams 'di mi mjed ces brjod pa'i nang tshan dzam bu'i gling zhesabya ba dza na skye ba la'o zhes pa'i byings bzhag /na'i a brjod don yin pasaphyis/ bu /rkyen du byin/ /la yan bzhin 'ang sogasakyisaka phyis/ pibyin pa/ mi zad —161—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shepas phyis pas/ de'i sde pa la sde pa'i mtha'os/ na mar bsgyur ba'i ri/ zhes pa lus can skye ba'i gnas zhes bya ba'am/ mtsho ma dros pa'i 'gram du nge tri sha'i 'bras bu dzom tsam pa mtshor lhung pa'i sgra la brten nas shing dang gling gnyis kar de ltar grags/ dpal ldan rgyud kyi 'jig rten khams ler/ gling nas zla ba 'od dkar can dang rab mchog ku sha dang ni mi'am ci dang khrung khrung dang / drag po yang ni longs spyod sa ste bdun par dzam+bha'i mi rnams gnas pa dag ni las kyi sa/ zhes las dang longs spyod kyi sa'i gling bdun ga la dzasbu'i gling du grags shing dus kyi 'bor lo'i ri rab rdo rje'i rnam pa'i rwa 'og na yod pa'i zla ba sogs kyi gling drug ni longs spyod kyi sa dang / ye shes le'ur/ phyi rol tu ni rgyu skar 'khor (133na〉du rnams te las kyi sa la sa bzhi la ni mi rnams so/ /zhes phyi rol gyi gling phran mtha' dag la las kyi sa pa ste 'dzam gling chen por bshad la/ chos mngon pa sogs su 'dzam bu gling zhes bye brag tu bstan pa lho gling 'di ni 'dzam gling chung ngu ste gling gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i rgyu mtshan bskal pa chags 'jig gi tshe'ang 'jig par mi nus pa rdo rje gdan/ mju ga ta dha ra zhes dbus 'gyur 'chang ba'i don/ tsan+d+ra par bṛ kho dha ra la sogs pa rnams so/ /zhes ma ga dhar byang chub shing la sku rgyab brten nas 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da lta'i bskal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas stong dang lnga la sogs pa byon dang 'byon 'gyur mtha' dag bdud rtsi brnyes shing mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul ston pa'i gnas yin cing der ma zad/ rgya cher rol pa las/ gnas der nga yis mchod sbyin stong phrag bye ba khrag khrig bzhi bcu byas/ /der ni sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig stong phrag drug cu de dag mchod/ /wa ra ṇa si dam pa de ni sngon gyi drang srong rnams kyi gnas/ zhes dang / ngas ni sngon chad sangs rgyas bye ba stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa gcig dran/ /de dag drang srong zhes bya nags mchog 'dir ni 'khor lo dam par rab tu bskor/ /zhes phug ral can nam 'khor mo 'jig ste bsgyur lugs gnyis su yod pa'i yul wa ra ṇa sir 'o skol gyi ston pas slob lam gyi skabs su mchod sbyin stong phrag bye ba khrag khrig bzhi bcu mdzad cing sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig stong phrag (133ba)drug cu mchod pa dang ston pa nyid kyis thugs kyi —/62

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (madran par sangs rgyas bye ba stong phrag dgu bcu rtsa gcig gis chos 'khor bskor ba'i gnas su gsungs/mdzod las/ de ni 'dzam gling pho gyur nyid/ /ces gling bzhi la dbang sgyur ba'i 'khor los sgyur rgyal yang thog mar 'dzam bu gling du 'byung zhing/ rgya cher rol pa las/ dge slong de ltar byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas dam pa na 'dug pa ni rnam par lta ba chen po bzhi la rnam par lta ste/ bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ dus la rnam par lta ba dang / gling la rnam par lta ba dang / /yul la rnam par lta ba dang / rigs la rnam par lta ba'o/ /dge slong dag byang chub sems dpa'i gling la rnam par lta zhe na/byang chub sems dpa' ni mtha' 'khob kyi gling du mi skye/ shar gyi lus 'phags por mi skye/ nub kyi ba lang spyod du mi skye/ byang gi sgra mi snyan du mi skye/ lho'i 'dzam bu gling nyid du skye'o/ /dge slong dag ci'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' yul la rnam par lta zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni mtha' 'khob kyi yul gang na mi rnams dbang po rtul zhing blun la lug ltar lkugs pa'i rang bzhin can legs par bstan pa'i don shes par bya ba'i skal pa med pa dag tu mi skye'i byang chub sems dpa' ni yul gyi dbus nyid du skye'o/ /zhes sangs rgyas rnams 'og min gyi gnas su byang chub mngon du mdzad nas thun mong ba'i gdul bya 'dul ched mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i rnam par ston pa'ang dzaskru'i gling nyid du skye ba 'dzin par bshad (134na༄nga de dang mtshungs par/ bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud kyi le'u gsum par/'dzam bu gling ni chen po yi/ /dum bu bstoganyis kyi ni dbus/ shar gyi yul na gnas lha mo/ /zhes dang bzhi par/ 'dzam bu gling ni chung ngu 'dir/ /bdag ni shākya'i rigs rjes 'gro /zhes rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen shākya'i rigs zas gtsang gi sras su 'khrungs par gsungs pa'i 'dzam gling chung ngu 'di nyid kyi dbus su dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas rdo rje gdan/ shar phyogs ca na'i rgyal khams na 'phags pa 'jal dpal gyi gnas ri bo rtse lnga/ lho phyogs dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi mchod rten na ye shes sems dpa' ma bsdus par rang bzhin 'du ba'i dkyil 'khor dang de'i lho phyogs rgya mtsho'i 'gram na spyan ras gzigs kyi gnas ri bo gru 'dzin/ nub phyogs na gsang sngags —163

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shekyi mdzod skyon rdo rje 'chang chen po'i pho brang rang byung gi gtsug lag khang / byang phyogs legs pa'i cha kun bsags pa rigs ldan gyi grong khyer sham+bha la/ de'i byang na rim bzhin gangs ldan dang spos ngad ldan/ de gnyis kyi bar na mtsho ma dros pa dzasbu'i shing dang bcas pa/ ma dros pa las gaṅgā sis pak+ṣu sri ta ste chu bo bzhi dal gyis 'bab pa/ sposang da ldan nas rim bzhin byang ngos su brag gser gyi bya skyibasadang shing swā la rab brtan/ de'i shar ngos su rdzing bu dal gyi 'bab pa sogs yon tan tshes mang ba mtha' dag brjod pa ga la nus/ de'ang 'jam dpal rtsa (134ba〉spyad las/ nga yi dus na lo brgya na/kha ba can du mtsho bri nas/ /swā la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bod kyi rgyal khams yang bar lung bstan pa'i yul 'di nyid dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i skabs shar du li kha ra'i shing tshang tshing can sogs kyi khongs las brgal cing dge slong ma'i sdom rgyun med par brten sa tshigs dang chos tshigs gnyis ga'i skabs su mtha' 'khob tu bshad na'ang dus dbang gis 'phags yul sogs sngar bstan pa dar ba rim gyis 'grib cing rgyal blon lo paṇa gyi drin las thub pa'i lugs ches cher 'phel bar brten khro phu lo tsā bas be+e ḍūrla'i tshong 'dus nas kha che paṇa chen la phul ba'i zhu yig tu/ ma ga dha sogs rig 'byung gnas kyang sdig to yi/ /dmag tshogs kyis bcoms skyon kha che bal yul yang / /log spyod kyis khengs ding sang bstan srog legs gnas ni/ /bod yul 'dir zad skyes chen byang phyogs zhabs bskyod zhu/ /zhes dang / jo bo chen po rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs 'od dpag med pa'i lha khang du byang chub kyi sems la thugs sbyong ba'i tshe spyan ras gzigs kyis zhal bstan nas/ skyes bu dam pa legasaso legs so/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mdzod gang yin pa de khyod kyisashes sam 'di nas byang phyogs na nga'i zhing khams yod/ khyod kyi yi dam jo mo sgrol ma yang de na semasacan gyi don mdzad cing bzhugs/ khyod kyi gdul bya mang po yang de na yod pas byang phyogs bod du song zhig /ces lung (135na)bstan pa sogs don gyi yul dbus dang khyad par med cing / bde mchog rtsa rgyud las/ bod kyi yul dang de bzhin du/ /ma la wa dang pu li sogs/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul yin no/ /—164

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (7zhes bod 'di srung 'khor gyi gnas brgyad kyi zla sgo dang kye rdor du gnas dang sa sbyar ba'i sa brgya gnyis par bshad/ mi chos nas gzhal kyang bzang bar ga rta gos pas/ bal yul kho khom klu'i pho brang gi rgyal po de wa lhas sras mo khri btsun la gsungs pa/ nga yi snying dang 'dra ba'i bu mo khyod/ /bod cesabya ba khyad par 'phags pa'i yul/ /ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyi mgul/ /bsil la mdzes pa lha gnas gzhal yas khang / /ngo mtshar med byung phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /chu bo bzhi 'bab rtsi shing nags kyis mdzes/ /'bru sna lnga ri 'khrungs na cen sna tsho gos khrung / /zhes rgya cher bsngags la/ mkhasapa la la bod kyi yul yang gzhan dag dang 'dra bar mi grong sogs chags pa las mtsho dang nags tshal mi'i 'gro ba sogs rim gyis 'byung ba mi 'thad pa'i phyogs gsung na'ang gong du drangs pa'i 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud kyis kyang shes nus shing spyir bod du ma zad 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rigs la/ rgyal rigs/rje rigs/ bram ze'i rigs dmangs rigs te phyi'i rigs bzhi/ rgya gar lha/ rgya nag klu/ hor lha ma yin/ bod spre'u dang brag srin ma ste bar gyi rigs bzhi/ se/ dmu/ ldong/ stong ste nang gi mi rigs kyi phyi ma bcu gnyis su bshad cing bu ston chos 'byung (135ba)du skya seng bu lnga dgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis dang 'thabs pa'i dus su rgyal po ru pa ti zhes pa dmag stong phrag gcig dang bcas pa bud med kyi chas su zhugs te ri kha ba can gyi khrod du bros pa las 'phel bar bshad na'ang / yongs su grags pa thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa spre'u dang brag srin mo gshos pa las rigs drug nas tshe 'phos pa'i sprel phrug drug byung zhing / de'ang ka khol mar bzhi brgyar 'phel ba tshan pa bzhir 'thabs pa dang mes posabar mtshams byas te zhing la tshan pa bzhin bgos gcig la gcig 'jigs shing tshan bzhin gyes/ drug tu phye na bod mi khri tho r+ṣa po bya ba de la dgra 'bru ldong lga dang nu bo dpa' rda ste drug tu bshad cing / rus chen bzhi las gyes pa ye sang dkar po gnam gyi 'ju thag can/ ye smon nag po khro chu'i pha bong 'dra ba/spyang khrig ye shes lha'i sgron me/ mon rdzun ga po khyi'i rnga ljang can dang bzhi byung pa las 'phel ba shas che/ tshal pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i hu lan deb ther du spre'u dang brag srin mo las mched pa ma sangs —165

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)spun dgu/ rgyal phran nyer lnga/ bstoganyis/ sil ma bzhi brgyasarim bzhin dbang byasapa lasaring zhig nasargyal ba'i 'phrin lasakyi 'jug pa dus la babasapa'i rigs gsum mgon po sogs 'phags chen dam pa rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i thog mar rgya gar rgyal po dmag brgya pa'i rigs las rje gnya' khri btsan po lha ri zhol po'i rtser byon pa bon gyi lugasal dmu thag lasababasazer/ yon tan can gyi mi (136nayo༅ gnyis kyis mthong ste gang nas 'ongs dris pas mkha' la mdzub mo ker bas lha las chad par go nas gnya' bar khri byas te spyan drangs 'bangs thams cad mgrin gcig par rgyal por mnga' gsol bsabod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal po'i thog ma yin/ de nas brtsis pa'i gnam gyi khri bdun/ bar gyi steng gnyis/ sa'i legs drug /lde brgyad kyi rjes su btsan lngar grags pa'i khri thog rje btsan rgyal rabs nyer bdun gyi bar chab srid sgrung dang lde'u bon gyis bskyangs/ nyer brgyad pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam sprul lha tho tho ri snyan shal pho brang yum bu bla mkhar gyi rtser bzhugs pa'i tshe nam mkha' nasadapang bkong phyag brgya pa/ tshin+ta ma ṇi'i rkosaphor gser gyi mchod rten/ mdo sdom ma tog gi snying po yi ge drug pa rnams babs te de nas mi rabs lnga na 'di'i don shes pa 'byung ngo zhes mkha' las sgra bsgrags te bstan pa rin po che'i dbu brnyengs/ de nas rgyal rabasabazhi pa gnam ri srong btsan gyi dusargya nas rtsisadang sman byung zhing byang nasatsha kha rnyed/ de'i sras phyag na pad+ma'i rnam par sprul pa srong btsan sgam po ni 'jam dpal rtsargyud las/ de bzhin gshegasapa'i bstan 'di la/ /rnam pa sna tshogasabya ba byed/ /byang gi phyogasal brten nasani/ de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lha ldan yul zhesabya ba yi/gangasacan ri yi nangaganasapa'i/ rgyal po mi yi lha zhesapa/ /li tsa bī rnamasarigasasu 'byung / /de yang sngagasakyi don sgrub ste/ /longs(13thaspyod tshedang ldan par 'gyur/ /rigapa longasaspyod ldan zhesabya/ /mi yi bdag posade yang grub/ lo ni brgyad cur rgyal srid bya/ /zhesadang / 'jig rten sgron ma zhesagragasadang / /lha mo gosadakar mo dang ni/ /dkar mo go mo gzhan phan brtson/ /zhes rgyal po 'di nyid kyi ring la thu mi sasto ṭasalo tsā bslabasanasargya yig lnga bcu tham pa bod yig sum cur gtan la phab ste yi ge'i —/66

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag khomasrol gtone/ rin po che rta ge gi gzungs/ sher phyin 'bum pa/ spyan ras gzigs gyi mdo rgyud nyer gcig pa sogs bsgyur/ rgya bal nas sgrol ma dang khro gnyer can gyi sprul bsong jo dang khri btsun gnyis btsun mor bsus pa'i rten skal du jo bo rnam gnyis dang byams pa chos 'khor sogs gdan drangs/ bod srin mo gan rgyal du bskyel ba lta bu'i sa gnad gnon phyir mtha' 'dul/ yang 'dul/ ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang bcu gnyis brtsegs/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas phrul snang dang ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang rten brten par bcas pa bzhengs/ bstan pa rin po che'i srog shing dam pa 'di nyid sri zhu mdzad pa po ches mang mod gtso bor gyur pa/ bka' chems ka khol mar/ dge slong byang sems shar phyogs sku zhabrungs pa'i/ /gsang sngags lasang zhing rnal 'byor chen po ni/ /snying po'i mtha' can skyes chen dam pa yis/ /zhal yang bsgyur zhing snyed bkur dam pa mdzad/ /ces thams cad mkhyen pa shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis longs sku ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs gyi bar du bzhugs pa dang (137na)mtshungs pa'i rten 'brel du rin po che'i dbu rgyan sgron/ mnyan yod mchod pa'i dus ston btsugs pa sogs bstan 'gro'i phan bde gyen nas gyen du 'phyur ba blo'i ra ba las yongs su brgal bar mdzad/ chos rgyal gyis las can la thugs rje chen po'i gdams pa bstan nas thos bsam byed pa dang / gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa chos bsgyur ba sogs kyi bstan pa'i srol gtod/ de nas rgyal rabs bzhi pa mes ag tshom gyis mes srong btsan gyi dus zangs kyi byang bu las grub pa'i lung bstan rnyed pa rang nyid du 'byul nas paṇ+ḍa ta sangs rgyas gsang ba dang sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis gdan ma 'drongs kyang pho nya bas theg pa chen po'i mdo sde lnga blor bzung ba glegs bam du bzhengs pa'i bzhugasaganas la ma sa gong sogs lha khang lnga bzhengs pas mtshon dkon cog gsum la gus par mdzad/'di'i sras 'jang tsha lha dbon la rgya nag nas btsun mo bsus kyang sras gshegs pas yab dang yong jo 'dus pa las sras 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa khri srong lde'u btsan sku bltams/ sngon gyi bag chags bzang po'i mthus bstan pa spel bar ba ched de mkhan po bo dhi satwa gdan drangs dge —167

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheb bcu dang khamasabaco brgyad las brtsams pa'i chos gsungs kyang thang lha sham po bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs lha srin gdug pa can rnams 'khrugs te mdzad du ma ster bar brten slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas spyan drangs/ sa gzhi btul nas o tan+ta pū ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs (137ba)pa'i lugs gsum mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhedas/ mkhan po zhi ba 'tshos sad mi mi bdun la sogs pa rab tu byung zhing dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ bod phrug rig pa rno ba rnams la lo tsā bslabs rgya bal nas paṇ+ḍi ta mang du gdan drangs te dam pa'i chos bsgyur zhing 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab pa'i rlangs khams pa go chas 'bum thugs la bzung nas bsgyur bas thugs 'gyur ma/ rje'i sku mtshal dang ra dkar gyi 'o ma bsres te bris pa'i dum pa bzhi la reg zig dmar po/dbu skra'i gzhob ra dkar gyi 'o ma dang sbyar nas bris pa'i reg zig sngon po dum pa bzhi par lcags thur brgyus pas lcagasathur ma ste gnyis po la bla 'gyur chung ba'ang zer/ sbasadang nyang gnyis kyis blangasapa'i rgya dpe'i steng nas 'tsho rdzas rnams 'bangs la bsdus te bsgyur bas dpya 'bum du grags/slar lo chen be+e ros rgya dpe dang bstun zhu chen mdzad par dum bu drug la bla 'gyur 'bring po/ 'brom bza' byang chub slan gyis sad mi mi bdun sogs dge 'dun sum brgya la bsnyen bkur ba'i tshe bam po re la shog dril re byas pa'i steng nas gdugs tshod thon pa dang tshar re sgrogs pa'i snod la brten nasasha sgro can/ gzhan yang 'dul lung / mdo sde'i skor mang du bsgyur/ rgyud dzirin po che nasasangasargyas mnyam sbyor dang gsang 'dus rtsa rgyud tsam ma gtogs phyis 'gyur du grags pa'i bla med kyi rigs bsgyur ba med cing dkar chag ldan dkar ma dang phang thang ma sogs su gsang sngags phyi'i rgyud (138na)rnams zhib mor bkod rjes/ gsang sngags nang gi rgyud rnams ni ches gnyan pasare zhig 'dir ma bkod/ ces pa'i shugs la nang gi rgyud sems phyogs/ mdo sgyu sgrub sde brgyad sogs snga 'gyur gyi rgyud phal cher 'gyur bar brten/ rgyal po 'di'i sras chung ba sad na legs mjing yon gyi srasaphyag na rdo rje'i rnam 'phrul ral pa can nam khri lde gtsug brtan du gragasapa ni/ sgra sbyor bam po gnyisapa las/—/68

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shāmirta'i lo la btsan po khri lde srong btsan pho brang skyi smad 'on cang rdo na bzhugs/ stod smad kyi dmag gsar rnying brje ba dang rkun chen btul/ gar log gi pho nyas phyag btsal blon chen po byang khri zur ram shagasadang / mang rje lta 'dod la so gos pas rgya las srid gcig mang po bcad de/ snga rta dang ba mar phal mo che phyag tu phul/ zhad blon chen po man chad so sor bya dka' btsal ba'i lan la nyi 'og gi mkhan bo ā tsar+ya dzi na mi tra so gos zhes pa ltar/ rgya gar nas su ren+d+ra bo dhi/ shī len+d+ra bo dhi/ dwa na shī la so gos pa lha ta mang po spyan drangs/ bod kyi mkhan po rat+na rak+ṣita/ dharma ta shī la/ lo tsā ba dzñā na sen sogs la sngon yab mesakyi dus lo paṇa rnams kyis chos bsgyur ba'i tshe bod kyi skad la ma grags pa ming du btags pa'i khrod nas chos kyi gzhung dang byā ka ra ṇa'i lugs dang mi mthun pa dang go dka' ba dag skad kyi ming gces so tshal nas kyang bsnan te theg pa che chung gi gzhung dang mthun par 'gyur bcos gyis shig ces bka' stsal pa ltar dbus kyi 'phan yul ka ba na mo cher yum rgyas pa la 'gyur (138ba)bcos nas dum pa bcu drug tu mdzad/ des mtshon pha mes kyi dus 'gyur ba'i gsung rab phal cher skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/ rnying rgyud rnams ni bka' shin tu gnyan pas snod ldan ma gtogs gnod min rnams kyis spyod yul du ma gyur/ rgyal po dar mas bstan pa bsnubs pas 'di yan la snga dar dang /de rjes bstan pa'i me ro blang bar phyi dar du grags shing phyi dar la'ang paṇ+ḍita lā ba dmar po/ 'e ti/jo bo a ti sha/ gha ya dha ra/ paṇa chen shākya shrī/ nags rin sogs paṇa grub tshad thub kyang kha yar byon cing gtso bor nyi zla lta bu'i lo chen rin cen bzang po dang 'byog mi rnam gnyis/ gzhan yang mal/ mar do/ mar 'gos/ rwa gnyan/ sa rngog shong dpang sogs nas snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa zhwa lu lo tsā ba rin cen chos skyong bzang po byon pa'i bar 'jig rten gyi mig gcig po rnams kyis bka' dang bstan wa ba dang bsgyur zin 'chos pas mtshon bstan pa rin po che rma med par srol btod pa'i phyag rjes kyi tshad ni nam mkha'i mthas kyang bzung bar mi nus la/ de yang bod yul du snga phyir 'gyur pa'i gsung rab phal mo che phyogs gcig tu bzhugs par bka' 'gyur rin po che zhes grags —169

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)pa lha sras mu tig btsan po'i dus ban+de dpal brtsegs sogs kyis phang thang ka ba med pa'i gtsug lag na bzhugs pa'i gsung rab rnams la bam grangs brtsis te dkar chag bkod pa bka' 'gyur phyogs gcig tu bsgrig pa'i thog ma yin/ ska cog gnyis (139na〉kyes stong thang ldan dkar na bzhugs pa'i gsung rab rnams bsgrigs par dkar chag ldan dkar ma/ bstan pa phyi dar la 'jam dgag pa shes rgya nas chas rkyen bskur bar brten mchims kyis bzhengs pa'i lung sdo bzhi/ mdo mang chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i thugs dam lha mi'i rgyan mchog /'dar phyar bas bzhengs pa'i chu mig tu bzhugs pa/gru spang rtsa'i thugs dam 'dzam gling rgyan/ mchims kyi gser gzhud ma/ zhwa lu gser khang du bzhugs pa sogs mdo sna ches mang ba bsdus te dbus pa blo gsal sangs rgyas 'bum/ lo tsā ba bsod nams 'od zer/ rgyang ro byang chub 'bum sogs mang po go bsdur nas dpal snar thang gi gtsug lag khang du bzhengs par bcom ldan ral gyis dkar chag nyi ma'i 'od zer mdzad/ ma phyi de nyid la slar yang bsnon ma dang bcas si tu thams cad mkhyen pa dge ba'i blo gros kyis bzhengs par tshal pa bka' 'gyur zhes grags/ thams cad mkhyen pa bus chos kyi 'byung gnas gsung rab rin po che'i mdzod du dpyad pa gsum gyis dag pa'i dkar chag bsgrigs par thems spang ma zer ba'i phyi mo rnams las stod smad du 'phel ba mang ngo / /de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa las/ ko shi ka de lta bas na de ltar rigs kyi bu'ang rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la mngon par dad de rtog cing mos la sems dang bas byang chub tu sems bskyed nas lhag pa'i bsam pas nyan pa dang 'dzin pa (139ba)dang 'chang ba dang klog pa dang kun chub par byed pa dang / rab tu 'don pa dang ston pa dang nye bar ston nga/ dang lung 'bogs pa dang kha ton du byed pa dang gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par ston pa dang 'di'i don rnam par 'grel ba dang / yid kyis rjes su rtog pa dang ji lta bur grub pa'i shes rab kyis 'dir yongs su dpyod par byed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi tshul rgyun chad par ma gyur cig /dam pa'i —170

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag tre'ichos nub par ma gyur cig /ces dang / de'i phan yon ni ko shi ka bsod nams mngon par 'du byed pa de la/ rin po che sna bdun gyi mchod rten de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi phung po can la bkur stir byas pa'i bsod nams mngon par 'du byas pa snga ma des brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro/ stong gi char yang / bye ba char yang / bye ba'i brgya'i char yang / bye ba stong gi char yang / bye ba brgya stonge gi char yang /bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi char yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /grangs su yang nye bar mi 'gro'o/ /char yang /bgrang bar yang / dper yang / dpes bstan par bya ba yang / rten du yang / rgyur yang mi bzod do/ /zhes 'chad nyan gyis gtan la 'bebs pas ni ches khyad par 'phags shing lung sde bzhi paṇ+ḍi ta shrī la mi tra la dbus pa blo gsal sangs rgyas 'bum gyis zhus pa chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa la phul ba las 'phel ba'i rgyun/ sher phyogs skor dper na yum rgyas pa'i lung rgyun kha che dharma shrī la ba reg lo tsā bas gsan pa/ dkon brtsegs rdo rje gdan pa la ba ri lo tsā bsags (140na jis mchims brtson seng la brgyud pa/ sangs rgyas phal po che rgya nag gi mkhan po gying ju la dbus pa blo gsal sangs rgyas 'bum 'gyas gsan nas lo mchog par gnang ba/ gsar ma rgyud 'bum ni bsdus rgyud rwa 'gro /brtag gnyis 'brog mi/ gsang 'dus mar 'gos sogs la brgyud pas mtshon te dar so che na'ang mdo sna tshogs pa'i lung khungs shin tu dkon pa dar rgyas su mdzad pa po gro lung pa dang 'phags pa rin po che gnyis yin cing gro lung pas steng pa lo tsā bar gser mang du bskur nas rgya gar du brdzangs pas rdo rje gdan pa chung ba'i slob ma shrī rnam gnyis la mdo sna sum brgya nyer dgu tsam gyi lung yod pa'i dzña na shrī las kyang pu rtsa shrī dag cing rgya che ba'i snyan pa la brten nas tshang bar zhus/ bod du byon nas so thams cad mkhyen pa sogs la gnang ste 'phel/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pas spyi la bu ba stag ston shes rab 'od zer la lung khungs dag pa zhig 'tshol ba'i bka' gnang ba ltar paṇ+ḍi ta : tis rong zom la gnang ba rim bzhin mnga' bdag nyang nas brgyud pa shangs pa grags seng la gsan/ des sa skya yang dgon blo chen sangs rgyas sras la gnang ba bar skabs su bstan pa'i srog 'thud pa po bag ston gzhen nu —171—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)tshul khrim kyis rong pa sher seng la dpyal nas brgyud pa gsan yang brgyud par hor khongs kyi dogs pa byung nas sa skya yang dgon pa kun dga' 'od zer la kha che paṇa chen nas brgyud pa gsan kyang paṇa chen la lho pas gsan ma gsan gyi the tshom (140bskong zad byung bas slar rtsad bcad pa nas sa skya blo chen par khungs gtsang ba yod par rtogs nas zhus/ steng pa lo tsā par lho pas gsan pa'i brgyud pa nges tig srang phag khur par yod ces zer ba ltar tshar gcig ste dril ba'i bzhi gsan/ de nas kyang bla ma bdun tsam gyi bar brgyud pa ma chad tsam yod pa/ bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan la thu btsun thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' rnam rgyal dpal bzang pos gsan te rgya cher spel na'ang rgyud 'bum dang 'dul lung tsam ma gtogs phal cher dgun gyi chu phran ltar je phrar gyur cing yod skad du smra ba phal cher yang thog mtha' bar gsum tsam dang 'ga' zhig ma thob bzhin du rdzun la skyabs su 'tshol ba'i tshe rdo rje 'chang gnas gsar ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdo mangs sher phyogs khungs btsun 'tshol bar khyab bdag khra tshang pa chen po mngags te 'bad pas gsan nas bka' 'gyur ro cog dga' ba'i lo gong dkar rdo rje gdan du spel ba'i mthu las 'dzin ma'i khyon kun dam pa'i chos kyi phongs pa dang bral ba ni zang zing gi 'du 'khod tsam la bstan pa bzung ba'i kha khyer mthon por byed pa rnams kyi cha tsam gyis bsgrun du mi nus pas blo ldan gyi tshogs rnams lag pad snying gar sbyor bar rigs so/ /de'ang sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis thogs med nas bsags pa'i sgrib spyong dang gnas skabs mchis brang la brten pa'i sdig lhung dam tshig gi nyams chags sel 'don dang (141na)skye ba kun tu nged rang dang mi 'bral ba'i smon lam 'grub byed du dmigs ā na la zhes pa me 'brug hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bcu gsum nas dbu btsugs te bzang ri lhun grub rab brtan gling du sku'i rten la snyigs ma'i dus su byin brlabs kyi gzi byin lhag par che ba sman bla bde bar gshegs pa brgyad kyis thog drangs/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems choge skyong sogs kyi sku bris 'bur bzhengs pa'i bsod —172

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhongs dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag slobanams ni/bde mchog sdom 'byung las sngags pa las ni dang po pas/gzugs brnyan la sogs bya ba ste//bris sku bsgrubs na myur ba ni//dngos grub rgya cher thob par 'gyur//zhes dang /spyan ras gzigasakyi mdo las/gang gis rgyal ba'i sku ni rab 'bar zhing /khyad par 'phags pa'i gzugs dang semasa'adrab//dzam klung gser ltar rab mdzes lta na sdug/mtshan gyi me tog rgyas pas ma' du gang //ma' par shes pa 'thob cing dbang r+ṣa grags//byang chub spyod mchog dam pa zhi ba spyod//de ni nam yang longs spyod 'grib mi 'gyur//lhas kyang bsti stang bya zhing mchod par 'ong //bstan pa 'dod pa'i longs spyod g.yin mi dka'//tshul khrims rnam dag rab mkhas tshangs par spyod//yi dam yos nasanags dang nags 'dabs song //mngon shes 'thob cing khyad par 'thob par 'gyur//zhes dang /dam chos pad dkar las/la las de bzhin rin cen sna bdun dang //la las de bzhin zangs dang 'khar ba las//bde bar 14ba tshe/gegs pa rnams kyi gzugs byas pa//de dag thams cad byang chub 'thob par 'gyur//ro nye dang ni lcags sam sa yang rung //bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi gzugasabyas te//lta na sdug pa 'jim pa'i las byed bcug/de dag thams cad byang chub 'thob par 'gyur//gang gis rtsig ngos gzugs kyi ri mo dag/bsod nams brgya mtshan yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku//bdag gis bris sam 'dri ru bcug kyang rung //de dag thams cad byang chub 'thob par 'gyur//zhes dang /'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/rkang gnyis dam pa ston pa yi//sku gzugs mchod rten dag kyang bya//sposadang dri dang byug pa yis//mchod bya bsnyen bkur bya ba dang //rnam pa sna tshogs gos mchog dang /gzhan yang nor bu'i gdub kor rgyan//rnam pa sna tsho gos bza' dang bca'//yang dag sbyar ba dbul bar bya//rnam pa sna tshogs phun sum tshogs//ci 'dod kha zas byas pa la//de bzhin sngags ni bzlasabyas dbul//sems can dge ba'i skye gnas 'gyur//dam pa'i 'gro ba'i skye gnas su//grong mchog dag tu skye bar 'gyur//mthar ni byang chub gzhol 'gyur zhing //phyis nas zhi bar yang dag 'gro/zhesagasungs/rgyal ba'i gsung bka' 'gyur ro cog bzhengs pa'i phan yon ni/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)pa brgyad stong pa las/ kun dga' bo de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par 'dod pa dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol phyin pa 'di la spyad (142na)par bya'o/ khres rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mnyan par bya/ gzung bar bya/ bklag par bya/ kun chub par bya/ rab tu gdon par bya/ bstan par bya/ nye bar bstan par bya/ lung 'bogs par bya/ kha rtan du bya/ bri bar bya/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis glegs bam chen po la yi ge gsal zhing rab tu gsal ba legs par bris te me tog dang bdug pa dang dri dang 'phreng ba dang / byug pa dang phye ma dang / na bza' dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang dril bu dang ba dan dang kho ra khor yug tu mar me'i 'phreng ba dang mchod pa rnam pa mang pos bkur ster bya/ bla mar bya/ brjed par bya/ mchod par bya/ ri mor bya/ bsnyen bkur bya ste/ kun dga' bo 'di ni nga'i rjes su bstan pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / 'phags pa sdud pa las/ la las gaṅgā'i klung gi ji snyed zhing rnams na/ /sems can ji snyed 'khod kun dgra bcom gyis btul bas/ /gang gis shes rab pha rol phyin yig 'di bris te/ /sems can mchog la glegs byin bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ zhes dang / shes rab khri pa las/rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /ji skad smras pa de bzhin te/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de tshes brgyad dang / tshes bcu bzhi dang / tshes bco lnga la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha ton du byed pa dang /'chad par byed pa na bsod nams kyi phung (142ba)po dpag tu med grangs med/ tshad med/ bsam gyis mi khyab/ gzhal du med pa mang po dag bskyed par 'gyur zhing de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha ton du byed pa dang 'chad par byed pa na lha'i 'khor mdun du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/rab 'byor 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rin po che yin pa'i phyir te/ rab 'byor de la rin po che ni 'di yin te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni sems can dmyal bar 'gro ba las yongs su thar bar byed pa dang / dud 'gro'i skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang mi dbul po dang —174

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag slo'iganod sbyin dbul po dang klu dbul po las yongs su thar bar byed pa yin no/ /zhes gsungs/rin cen dngul las chos sku'i rten bzhengs pa'i phan yon ni/ mchod rten bskor ba'i phan yon las/ mkhas pa gang gis sangs rgyas mcho ne rten la/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis 'jim gong gcig bor ba/ /dzasbu'i chu klung gser gyi pho brang 'bum/ /de ni de dang mtshungs pa yod ma yin/ /mkhas pa gang zhig sangs rgyas mchode rten la/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis me rtag sil ma spungs/ /dzasbu'i chu klung gser snod 'bum bzhag pa/ /de ni de dang mtshungs pa yod ma yin/ /mkhas pa gang zhig sangs rgyas ma chad rten la/ /dga' ba'i sems kyis me tog 'phreng ba thogs/ /nge chu klung gser khal bye ba gnyis/ /de ni de dang mtshungs pa yod ma yin/ /zhes dang / dam chos pad dkar las/ gang gis mchode rten rdo lasabyas pa dang / /gang gis a ka ru dang tsan dan nam/ /gang (143na gis thang shing mchod rten byas pa dang / /la las shing ngam gzhan las byas pa dang / /sa dang so phag las ni brtsigs pa yi/ /rgyal ba'i mchod rten dga' zhing byas pa dang / /de phyir sa rdul phung bo dag las kyang / /mya ngam dgon pa gang du byas pa dang / /byis pa rtsed mor de dang de dag tu/ /gang gis rgyal ba de phyir mchod rten dag /bye ma las ni phung po byas pa yang / /de rnams kyis kyang byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes dang / spyan ras gzigasakyi mdo las/ mchod rten skor ba byas na ni/ /skye ba thams cad kun tu yang / /dbang chen grags pa'i khyim bdag dang / /dpal dang gzi brjid ldan par 'gyur/ /bram ze swā le che 'dra dang / /tshul khrimasaldan zhing mang thos dang / /rgyal rigs su la che 'dra dang / khyug cing nor cher ldan par 'gyur/ /risabaskor rgya mtsho tshun chad kyi/ /sa kun la ni gang smon pa/ /gling bzhi dag ni dbang phyug bla/ /rgyal po chosadang ldan par 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar yin la/ de yang bzo bo do dam las byed sogs ni/ zhu chen mnga' ris gra tshang nas dka' bcu bsod nams yar 'phel/ dka' bcu blo bzang rab rgyas/ rab 'byamasab blo bzang chos grags/ rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ rab 'byams pa bzang po dpal grub/ rab 'byams pa rin cen rgyal mtshan/ yig mkhan e nas sto dkar ba dbon dpal 'bar/—173—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)dpon lha mgon dar rgyas/ sgrol ma tshe ring / byings gras bag gro/ tshe brtan/ 'jam dbyangs ba po shis/(143bskor rgyas bkra shis/ nor bu/ kun dga' nor bu/ bsam grub/ blo bzang kun dga'/ rgyas dkar/ dgra 'dul/ bu mo phag bar/ khyi phrug /bkra shis 'dzom pa/ bzhi dar/ rab brtan/ lha mgon rgyal po/ nam mkha' sri chod/ thub dbang / dgra 'dul/ chos dar/ 'jam dbyangs nor 'dzin/ dngos grub nor bu/ tshe rgyal/ skyon nor bu/ rgya mon nor bu/ bsam grub dgos pa/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis/ 'ba' lhug /bsam grub dar rgyas/ spen mo 'jam dbyangs/ dgos pa bkra shis/ lhun grub/nor bu bstan 'dzin/ gro nang 'jam dbyangs/ lnga 'dzom/ rgya mon bsod nams/ bsam grub ba po shis/a bar rgyal po/ skrun drug /bsam grub dgos pa/ tshe ring don grub/ bsam grub dgos skyes/ skya'o lnga 'dzom/ tshe ring dar rgyas/ bstan 'dzin/ tshe dbang dpal 'bar/ bstan 'dzin/ rgya mon rab 'phel/bsam grub nor bu/ 'dam chos 'dzom/ dbang rgyal/ nor bu don grub/ rgya mon bkra shis/ lnga 'dzom/bu mo bsam grub/ dgos pa bstan 'dzin/ tshe ring phun tshogs/ lha dbang tshe ring / rgya mon bstan 'dzin/nor bu dar rgyas/ tshe ring dpal 'byor/ lha mgon bsam grub/ bsod nams dar rgyas/ tshe ring bsam grub/ lha byin nor bu/ bsam grub dgos pa/ bsam grub lha rgyal/ rgya mon bsam grub/ blo bzang /'tshom grol nor bu/ tshe ring dpal 'byor/ dpon 'jam dbyangs/ rgya mon nor bu/ lha mgon (144na)rdo rje/ sgam po dar rgyas/ khyung phrug /bstan pa dar rgyas/ rgya mtsho nor bu/ phyon phyag rdor/ 'jam dbyangs 'tshom grol/ tshe brtan/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis/ bsam grub dgos 'dzom/ nor bu/ rta mgrin rdo rje/ bsod nams rab brtan/ nor 'phel/ sri chos dar rgyas/ bsam pa don grub/ bsod nams nor bu/ dgos pa tshe ring / chos mdzad/ rgya mon bkra shis/ bkra shis/ sum dga'/ bkra shis rab brtan/ bu mo bkra shis/ dgos dgos dar rgyas/ dpal 'byor bkra shis/ bsod nams bstan 'dzin/ rgyal po bsam grub/ dngos grub/ rgya mon don grub/ bag gro /bkra shis/ smer rgya mon/ rgya mon dar rgyas/ tshe ring bstan 'dzin/ rgya mon chos mdzad/ mgon po rdo rje/ lha mgon bstan 'dzin/—/76

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag slonacho me bkra shis/ shog sbyor ba e nas yon bdag phyon phyag rdor/ nor bu bkra shis/ dngos grub bkra shis/ bkra shis/ sum dga'/ nor bu bsam grub/ lnga 'dzom/ dgos pa don grub/ nor bu dar rgyas/dar rgyas/ shes rab bstan 'dzin/ bstan 'dzin rnam rgyal/ snye mo skyid 'jam/ dpal 'byor rnams/gos bzo ba bsod nams/ lha byin/ bsod nams don grub/ do dmachos lung pa rdo rje dang / don grub/lha bris dbu mdzad pho brang phun tshogs/ rnam rgyal tshing bkras/ byings gras pho brang 'dod yon/ rab brtan/ dar 'bag grags pa/ 'phrang 'go dkon cog /dol pa hor (144ba tha kris/ chad dkar khra ri/ 'jim bzo dbu mdzad bag dro/ byings gras skyon chos rgyal/ 'dzom phrug /lnga 'dzom/ btsun chung /dpal 'dzin/ a bar dar rgyas/ a bar 'dzom phrug /gong 'khod bris 'bur gnyis kyi do dam 'brel snga ba a tshogs/ mchod rten gyi sa 'dzin yan nor bu'i tog man gyi dpangs la rgyug mtho bdun dang tshone gsum/ sa 'dzin gyi zheng la rgyug mtho bzhi yod pa'i bzo bo/ bal po brdungs pa dha lam/ phul pa de wi tsan+d+ra/ phra ba kā na/ gong 'khod bal po'i do dam rtses dang shan grong pa bstan 'dzin phun tsho gos dang /rgyal grong dngos grub bstan 'dzin/ mchod rten dang glegs shing gi shing bzo ba tsher bseb dbang phyug /khang gnyer bsam grub/ hor phrug /rtses dang brtan brtan/ bstan 'dzin/ bzhugs khri'i shing bzo ba dpon pad+ma dang / pho brang bkra shis dar rgyas/ shing bzo byings kyi do dam gsum grong pa dgos rdor/bzo byings kyi dgos cha gra sgrig sogs kyi do dam la tshogs rgyal gling pa tshe 'dzin/ tsha ru ba rgya phur/khri smon pa rdo rje mgon po tshe ring / ja ma rdo rje brtan pa/ chang ma nor bu/ las byed phun tsho gis ba po shis/bkra shis bcas pas bgyis shing / sku gsung thugs rten bzhedas pa dang de la phyag dang skor ba mchod bstod sogs sri zhur bgyis pa'i phan yon mdo rgyud du ma nas lan cig ma yin par byung ba/ lung phran tshegs las/ zla ba skar ma'i tsho gos bcas sa la lhung yang srid/ /sa 'dir ri dang nags tshal mkha' la 'gro (145na〉nga srid/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i chu ni bskams par 'gyur srid kyi/ /drang srong chen po rdzun gsung 'gyur ba srid pa min/ /zhes yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis mi bden pa'i tshigs—177

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)gsung ba nam yang mi srid pas rnam dkar gyi dge ba'i 'bras bu ji skad bshad pa mtha' dag yon sbyor gyi sbyin pa'i bdag por ma zad 'di'i ched du lus ngag yid kyi ngal ba cung zad bsten pa rnams kyang gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde ba la spyod par gdon mi za zhing blo gros mi zad pa'i mdor tshig lhug tu yod pa bka' gdams pa zhig gis tshigs bcad du bsdebs par/ dge ba rgya mtsho'i nang gi chu thigs bzhin/ /rgya mtsho ma zad bar du de mi 'dzad/ /de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang / /byang chub ma thob bar du de mi 'dzad/ /ces pa'i don ltar bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs pa ni/ sems can bsam pa'i khyad par de snyed dang / /'tsham par thub pas legs gsungs lung rtogs cho me/ /nam mkha' rang gi ngo bo gtong min par/ /legs byas zhing du nub pa med par shog /gser mdog cod pan 'chang ba'i chos srid bstan/ /dzā rta'i dri ngad 'thul ba chu gter che'i/ /ska rags rab bcings kun bzod yangasapa'i khyon/ khyab pa'i grib mar 'bangs rnamasang la gsor shog /duḥkhas nyer mnar gnas ga snod bcud tshogs/ /lha mi'i rjes 'gro'i sim pa'i tshor ba yis/ /dkar min rgyu dang des bskyed gos bu la/ /deng nas nam yang longs su mi spyod shog /'dod gzugs gzugs med (145ba)mngon mtho'i rten rnyed kun/ /yang srid gzhan du nying mtshams mi sbyor bar/ skye 'dir thar pa'i them skas la 'dzegs te/ /bla med ye shes grong du 'jug par shog /khyad par bod dang chen po'i rgyal khams su/ /rtsod dus nyes brgya bsags pa'i smag gi rus/ /lhag bsam skya rengs ma yis rab drangs pa'i/ /bde legs rdzogasaldan snang bas mthar byed shog /blo can bsod nams bzang po'i mthu brtas pas/ /stobs 'byor phun sum tshogs pa sbyin pa'i bdag /ring po'i tshe dang mnga' thang longs spyod rnams/ /rnam thos bu yi mched slar 'gran nus shog /thog ma med nas deng bar bsags sdig dri/ /legs byas nyer bsgrub gaṅgāsarab bkrus te/ /mtho ris yon tan bdun tshang dal ba'i rten/ /chad med skye ba kun tu thob par shog /phra rgyas skyon gyi khung bur rtag nyal ba/ /smin khyod sto 'gro'i rlabs kyis babs pa'i dug /ches dkar chig dug sman gyis drung phyungs te/ /sim pa'i tshor ba rgyun du myong bar shog /chags nyams sel gyi lang —178

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (malong rnyog ma'i chu/ /slu med rten 'brel ke ta gas bsgrungs pas/ /yang srid brgyud mar dam pa'i mgon gyi gzugs/ /'char ba'i gzigs mo tshar du che bar shog /rtsa gsum 'khor lor me tog 'phog pa'i lhas/ /rjes bzung he ru gaḥdapal grong khyer du/ /smin grol lam gyi zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin/ /mngon 'gyur yid can mtha' dag 'dren par shog /mtshan dpe rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa chen por/ /bgrod min bar gyi yang srid mtha' dag tu/ /ngag dbang blo gsal skal bzang rgya mtsho dang / /'bral med brtse bas rjes su 'dzin par shog /de don nyer btab sa bon yongs smin par/ khas 'che ji bzhin 'grub par mchog gsum gyi/ /thugs rje (146na po pyid kyi drod gsher las bskrun pa'i/ /re 'bras yongs 'du'i ljon pa dar ba shog /sku gsung thugs rten bzheng ba 'di ched du/ /a mra'i tshig gu tsam gyi bdog pa dang / /gomathakhrig 'degs pas mtha' byas ngal bsten kun/ /bde 'gro rim brgyud nges legs myur thob shog /'dren pa sras dang slob mar bcas pa yi/ /thugs dam bskul tshig dbyar rnga snyan po'i sgras/ /byin rlabs mngal khur bzung nas byang chen bar/ /dga' ba'i sgro gzhog zlum por bsgyur bar shog /spyad kyang mi 'dzad dge tshogs yongs 'du'i 'bras/ /ma smad gtan bde'i ro brgya bda' ba'i bcud/ /rang ched kho nar mi bsgrub ma rgan 'gro'i/ /gzhal dka'i drin lan bsab pa'i rgyu ru bsngo/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma zhi khro rab mas gsang gsum 'khor lo'i chu 'dzin las/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma'i thogs med 'phrin las char rgyun gyis/ /'di dang gtan mdun phan bde'i lo 'bras rab smin khur gyis yongs dud pa'i/ /dga' ston mchog la rtag tu sbyor bar rtsa gsum lha yis bdag byin rlobs/ /nam yang slu med dkon cog rin cen thugs rje'i mthu dpung brjod pa don dang ldan pa'i dbyangs/ /len dang lhan cig lha dang rig 'dzin bden tshig grub rnams mgrin pa gcig tu rab bteg nas/ /su sti ka yi rgyud mangs sgra las nye bar drangs pa'i bkra shis glu ru blangs pa bzhin/ /bsamasapa'i rgyal mtshan rtse mor bkod pa'i yid bzhin nor bus 'dod pa'i re 'bras lhun grub shog /a na la zhes me pho 'brug gi lo sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyis —/79

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)rten 146ba tha zhengs pa'i tshe che brjod dang 'brel ba'i bsngo smon tshigs bcad dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes pho brang chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa sirnyi ra stu//sdeb sbyor mnya baPROBPROBPROB las metog phreng can/myun+ta kā ga mya rwaṣ+ṭha sku t+ta su lha/skyo ṅgā de ci ka pā da sprug tā/༷ t+nañtsasiḥbra bis sum/lu bya kai su ri tāk+ta ra ma le bu li ris med 'gro kun skyabs mdzad de yi gsung //legs 'dzin slob mar bcas zhabs gtsug tor rtser//bkod nas rin cen las grub snang ba ho gyis//dkar chag mdo tsam yi ge'i 'phreng bar spel//tshangs sras lha mos nyer stsal dngos grub tu//the tshom bral bas bran mo'i la du yis//skad cig gnas lnga rig bsgyur mos blo'i ngor//rgyal rnams nyer 'byon byin rlabs dngos po'i gshis//de phyir gdan gsum tshang ba'i rdo rje sems//bshes gnyen gzugs47na ) su nges pa'i 'dra 'bag la//gar dbang pad dkar 'dzin dang 'brom rje'i sku//med byung gzigs mor tshar du dngar nus gyur/ /'jon dmar klu mtsho grangs kyi nya ga la/ /rin cen gnyis pa tshes zhor longs pa yis//gzhal ba'i ti tsha dngul chu sku rgyu'i gser//brgyad kyi se bas lhag pa'i bcu gnyis zho//ma ༅ tse dar bco brgyad khar longs pa'i//man shel sol shing nyer mkho'i yo byad bsgrubs//grang gser se ba gsum dang bzo rig gi/zas yon zho 'khor bdun ldan sa le sbram//nas khal mkha' mig kha btags che chung brgyad//dkar sha khog zung phyed bcas zas sna'i rigs//longs su spyod bya'i bdog pa 'a lcangs blo dang //nyer bral snying stobs brtson pas ā na la //me 'brug bgrang byar dpal grong sngags rams pas//yon sbyar mkhas pa dha na zhes pa yi//rnam dpyod sor rtse'i 'phrul gyis rab bskrun par//nyi ma'i gnyen gyi 'phel gdung yid bzhin nor//a ti sha yi rnam sbyar dbu zhwa gdung //rgya dpe mi tra dzo zhi'i rdo'i sgom thag/'brom gyi lcang log dung thal bzhugs pa'i stan//rngog lo khu dbon na bza' dgon pa ba'i//sku reg po to'i na bza' de nyid dang //spyan mnga'i dbu skra sne zur mnabs pa'i gos//paṇa chen sgre pa sha bo sgang pa'i ༷dung //bya 'dul dbu lo las kyi rdo rje'i phyags//

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (7kun mkhyen btsong kha pa yi dbu skra zhwa/ /snam sbyar rdul gzan phyag nas sku'i snyes 'bol/ /rgyal tshab ba so smon lam dpal gsum gyi/ /dbu lo dge legs dpal ba'i sman gyi 'phreng / /gtsang pa bdun brgyud byin rten 'jam rgyam gdung / /dge 'dun grub gyi dbu skra bla gos zhu/ /'dar ston blo bzang gragasadang kun bzang pa/ /mdung ras gsum gyi dbu skra nor bzang pa'i/ /(147bsgor skyes gding ba gsang chab ril bur bcas/ /paṇa chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dbu skra zhwa/ shangs mtshal pur ras sngags rams gsang gnas chab/ /bsod grags na bza' de dang bstan dar ba'i/ /dbu skra bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zha thul ber/ /pur ras dbu lo gsang chab 'phreng thag phyags/ /sku rag dar dang na bza' sku gsum gyi/ /rigs 'dzin bla ma bsgrubs pa'i ril bur bcas/ /sgom sde'i bla gos de dang na kha ba'i/ /dbu lo blo bzang chos rgyan snam sbyar skra/ /yon to rgya mtsho'i dbu lo gsang chab zhwa/ /pur ras dkon cog chos 'phel slar skyes dang / /pha bong kha pa'i dbu skra phyag gi sen/ /me khyer rgyu skar gral bzhin skra mtshal zung / /yon sbyor 'dod ltar spel legs 'phreng bar bsgrigs/ /bla brgyud bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med dang / /pad gzungs mtha' rten ring bsrel rnam pa bzhi/ /gnod sbyin 'khor lor bcas pa'i gzungs 'bul rnams/ /lo de'i zla skar rgyal gyis nya ba yi/ /gang ba dang po'i gza' skar 'phrod dge'i dus/ /ngos kyi gtsor brtan gzungs 'bul lag len kun/ /'khrul med mkhas pa'i phyag len ltar bskrun nas/ /rgyal ba gnyis par dam ye dbyer med par/ /rab tu gnas te bkra shis me tog snyil/ /chos dkar 'bras bu 'di'i ched 'bad pa kun/ /tshe dpal dbang thang lung rtogs yon tan rnams/ /bla nas blar 'phel mtho ris lam brgyud nas/ /ring min rnam pa thams cad mkhyen thob shog /cesartses dang dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis nged rang gi 'dra 'bag bzhengs pa'i dkar chag dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa'ang sngags rams pa nyid do/ /(148na sko mang grwa sgo gi rdzas khro'i kha byang ro bsko dpal lon/ bkra shis sgo mang rnam phye'i 'dus sdel/ /sri zhus bskrun snod khams gsum 'byor pa kun/ /dzaḥ'i ltor lam gsum las 'bab ltar/ /legs 'khyil —/81—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shero brgya'i dpal 'dzin 'di ko mtsha//longs spyod srog gi zungs gyur gas ba'i snod//bdud rtsi'i bum par 'gran pa'i za ma tog/thos bsam sgo mang rnam bkra'i 'dus sde'i tshogs//dgyes dgur rol pa'i legs byas gzugs can bzhin//rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me sprul lor deb ther du bkod pa'i rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i dngos spyad kyi deb ther dpag bsam 'dod 'jo dang /tsho rig byed mtha' dag gi snying po bsdus pa'i glegs bam gyi che brjod smon lam gyi rim pa sogs/rnam par rgyal ba 'a phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i lugs gnyis dang tshol ba'i dngos spyad kyi deb ther dpag bsam 'dod lo/sdeb sbyor mkho phe brit+ta las sa gas gtso pa rgya mtsho/sa khrid yab pan lhan/ṇ+ḍa'i dre ṇa pā me〉sa dru mo do grakāmug pā rā p+ta burnya spri ye lhag la ka tsas48cha ni yigaḥhi tri ya ni yug kān+ta'i zhes du gi rmi rasaḥ/shis pa brjod 4sgo dang po/byams brtse'i sa bon sa gnyis drod gsher gyis smin chos gzugs yongs5 sa brtol dar drag 'dod pa'i re ba kun skong rdzogs sangs rgyas//dpal gyi mgur nas drug phy-i glu las bden pa gnyis kyis 'gro rnams theg gsum la sbyor thog mtha' bar dge dam pa'i chos kyi ro//48ba ma bi ta li ha lha mi pa bha lha bu zhen su ka pra mu grwa ya tsashā bkas lun+daḥpra/lhe ṣa'i bu khyu na la bha sa dekashā ra tri bu rin ru ra su rlas hi tu lha nu dz+wa lwakwa la la to r+sā baḥ/tshul bzhin legs myangs sa dang lam gyi mngon par rtogs pas smin cing rab grol rgyal ba'i sras po yi rang skye 'phags dge bdun te//byang chub bar du gto gyi skyabs gcig mchog gsum thugs rje rta bdun pa yis phan bde'i 'od 'bar dus kun phun tshogs dga' ston stsol// 8

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sa (mashis pa brjod pa'i sgo gnyis pa/gdul dka'i 'gro mang stobs ldan sa srungs nyon mongs chus myos log lam nyer 'phyan dge bcu'i pad tshal brdzi ba'i snar//bde gshegs yongs kyi dbang gi 'phrin lasa.ut+pal lcags kyu'i gzugs can btab pas bag yod ra bar legs 'jug pa//rked phra nu 'bur chu 'dzin mngon mtho dkyus ring spyan gyi zur mda' 'gos tshe brtan g.yo'i dngos kun snying 'bigs ma//rgyal rnams yum gcig 49na jigs byed lha khyod zhabs rdul gtsug bsten 'dod pa'i re 'bras char du bsnyil pa'i shis pa stsol//shi4brjod ye sgo gos 'o/mchod sbyin brgya pa'i yan lag bzhi dpung bde bar ngal gso'i mi 'jigasaster ba'i byams ldan yang //bzod dka' lus ga 'phrul gyis bcud bral don snying lkog mar 'byin la gtum drag brtse med can//brgya phrag nyi gos kyis klubs gser sbyangs lhun po zil gnon rnam mang thos sras phyag sor gyis//btsir ba'i ne'u le'i mgrin pa las skyugs mi zad nor bu'i gru char 'bebs pa'i dge legs stsol//mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje stong r+ṣa shes rab rang snang btsun mo'i e dbyings rnam dag gzhal yas cher//'pho med bde ba'i bcu drug cha gang kun+da'i lang tsho dar babasathabs mchog waṃ yig lha yi tshogs//yi la'i khu'i sgo dang po/rang las ga' na min 'khor la nges gsang nā da'i dbyangs su len pa khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' che//thun mong gdul byar 'tshams sprin gos can shākya seng zhabs 'khor los rab bkra gtsug tu bkod phyag 'tshal//phyag 4la shā sgo gnyis pa/'od/ mas stong 'bar mdzod spu'i zer las rgya gar paṇa grub 'dzam gling che ba'i rig sngags 'chang //'ja' lus 'pho ba chen po'i sku brnyes rigs brgya'i bdag po dpal ldan kun bzang he ru gaḥ/dus gsum rgyal ba yongs kyi spyi gzugs mtsho las skyes pa'i rdo rje zhes grags thod 'phreng rtsal//zhabs sen me tog byang r+ṣa de srid cod pan la 'ching yid srubs sde las rgyal byin rlobs// 8
