rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)149ba ) phyag la'i phe sgo gsum pa/ring bsags bod 'bangs legs byas phung po nor 'dzin lusaphra'i mngal khur chu gter che//rigs gsum sgyu 'phrul gangs can lha gcig mes dbon thugs bskyed ri bo bsgril ba las//'phags bod lo paṇa rim par byon sogs bgrangs yas mkhas grub bum bzang bdud rtsi'i gter//nyes brgya'i zug rngu drung chun bstan 'gro'i srog zungs gyur to cog kun phyag gi gnas//la'i zla'i sgo kha/phul byung mkhyen yangs mes po'i thod las skyes bu gsum gyi mtho ris chab/blo gros ltor 'khyil dpyad gsum dag pa'i gzegs ma phyir skyugs gaṅgā'i rgyun//rgyal bstan log rtog dri tshogs 'khrud la lha yig bzhun ma mi yi gzugs/shes byar srid kun gzigs pa'i dbang phyug rnam 'dren btsong kha pa la 'dud//phyag la'i shā sgo lnga pa/chu nang zla ltar rang bzhin med kyang mya ngam thang 'khyams 'gro//ma 'dris yongs la thub rnams rjes chags gzugs snang snying rje'i lha//phyag na pad dkar lus can bsod nams zhing du ngur smig gar//bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i pha mthar khyab des bdag rjes bzung //dngos po nges bstan gyi sgo dang po/rnam par grol rtse rgyal ba'i sa bon ched//gzhan phan bde 'byung legs lam bshad sgrub kyi//rigs 'dzin 'dus gling spyad byar 'os pa'i ca//rmugs 'dzin dbang po'i mdzod la gcig tu 'gran/dngos po nges gas gyi sgo ga7pa/snying med e rwa ro ma tsos zang zing nor//zhi khro rab 'byams dam can srung ma rnams/ /mchod pa'i rdzas bsgyur bsod nams nyer 50na / byas gzugs/ /snod du 'jig rten khams kun byed pos bskrun//dngos po nges tshan rgya sgo gsum pa/brtul zhugs spyod pa'i yan lag gar 'chams kyi//chas gzhug rgyan gos sna tshogs rol mo sogs//rgyud 'grel mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes rjes 'brangs las//snang shas za zi mkhan po'i mched zla min//'di phyi'i bde skyid ༷/ra yi ngad//gtong phod ma la ya rlung gis drangs

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shā'idri/ /don min gdung gzhil bsgrubs 'bras byang chub bar/ /mi 'dzad rang g.yin sgrib las grol ba'i rgya/ /dkon cog rnyed pa log 'tshor nyer sbyor zas/ /zangs bzhun khol mar 'thungs pa'i sa bon gyis/ /'gro mang mnar nus me tog mda' can gyi/ /cho ga rdzogs las phyir bzlog 'phrul gyi sgrogs/ /bag tsha sdum dum sreg byed 'dod chen mes/ /snying gi yol gor rku sems khol ba'i chab/ /bcil nus brjod pa rnam dag deb ther ngos/ /ming tshig yi ge'i dwangs bsil chu klung sbreng / /thabs mkhas gzhan snang 'drid nus 'dod pa'i lha/ /dngos don 'khrul bral mgrin blon mig gi mes/ /bsregs tshe khyab mjug gis kyang 'khyog po'i 'gros/ /ma nus sa chen 'degs pa'i brgyal brten/ /ngo srung mdzes tshig gtso bor ma bton pa/ /gsong por smras pa dgu tshigs gnam gyi thig /bskal par rdzogs min ring po'i ska rags kyi/ /ri mo mig gsum pas kyang dbyi nus su/ /long long khol ba'i snying gi khrag dron gyis/ /ma tshim srid gsum zla la rngams pa'i zhal/ /rab gdangs beg tse lcam dral dmar zlum spyan/ /(150ba)gzigs nas me la tshe mdzad la ma g.yel kye/ /ches phra'i ka car phyir bsnyigs yud tsam la/ /nyin lam bco brgyad bya rgod 'phur ba'i bzhul/ /myul ba'i bka' srung li byin ha ra che/ /yum blon kiṅka rar bcas mthu dpung bskyed/ /bstan 'gro'i rtsa lag rig grol gnyis ldan sde/ /'du rdzas rnam dkar las rgyun spel ba'i mkhar/ /lha srin lcags ri dus mtha' me lta bus/ /gshin rje'i 'dun sa snying las chung ngur mdzod/ /'jam mnyen shog bu'i kho ra khor yug nang / /a 'dus ka 'phreng ldan pa yi ge'i gzugs/brda dang bkod pa'i khyad par rnam bkra ba/ /'chi med bdag po'i skyed mos tshal rjes 'gro/ /dzā ti'i 'khri shing klung nas chug ter rlabs/ /mkha' la snyeg 'dra'i bar gyi nor 'dzin stor/ /phun tsho gos 'byor pa'i phud kun gcig bsdus pa/ /deb ther dpag bsam 'dod pa 'jo 'di spel/ /de'ang bdag nyid chen po 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍita sa/ mchod bstod 'dud pa'i bdag nyid can/ mas pa brjod sogasami 'gal te/ /thams cad du yang ston pa yi/ /che ba 'ba' zhig brjod phyir ro/ /zhes mchode bstod shisabarjod sogs tshig gi sbyor sde dang ming 'dogs kyi khyad par las don du bsngags yul gang yin pa —183

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gede'i che ba kho na brjod par gsungs pa/ slob dpon da khri'i zhabs kyis/ shis brjod phyag bya dngos po ni/ /nges par bstan pa'ang de yi sgo /zhes pa'i dgongs don dang mtshungs pa yin pas 'phags pod kyi mkhas grub rnams kyi rjes su (151na)zhugs te snyan ngag gi tshigs su bcad pas sngun bsus nas dngos don gleng bar bya ba ni snying rje pad+ma dkar po las gsungs pa ltar/ 'o na bskal pa 'di la bzang po zhes brjod pa ci zhe na/ 'jig rten 'di chus 'jig pa'i tshe mtsho nas gser gyi pad+ma stong byung bar gyur te/ de la lha rnams kyis brtags pas sangs rgyas stong 'byung ba'i ltas su shes te/ kye ma bskal pa 'di ni bzang po'o zhes brjod pas bskal pa bzang po zhes grags par 'gyur ro/ /zhes grags can gyi bskal pa 'di la sangs rgyas stong byon pa'i nang nas 'o skol gyi 'dren pa zas gtsang sras po 'og min gnas su mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas zin kyang / bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ 'dzam bu'i gling ni chung ngu 'dir/ /bdag ni shākya'i rigs rjes 'gro /zhes dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang mthun par 'dzam gling che chung gnyis las chung ba lho phyogs kyi 'dzam gling 'dir rigs phun sum tshogs pa shākya'i brgyud du bltams nas shin tu ngo mtshar ba'i gnas bcu'i lte ba maṅga dha rdo rje gdan du mchog gi sprul pa'i skur 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan pa'i 'phrin las kyi sgo 'phar yangs por phye nas lung rtogs kyi bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i nang tshan 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ nga yi dus nas lo brgya na/ kha ba can du mtsho bri nas/ /swā la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes mtsho bri ba'i shul du rim gyis mi'i 'gro ba chags pa'i lha gcig chos kyi rgyal po rnams dang snga phyir byon pa'i mkhas grub lo paṇa tshogs kyi bka' drin las bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa dar ba ni/ khrus khang (151ba〉sgo tsā ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sdes/ lar dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje dang / /rgyal sras pad dkar zhabs drin las/ /bod kyi yul khams 'di nyid kyang / /'phags yul dang skal ba mnyam pa snyam/ /zhes gsungasapa don la gnas shing bstan pa'i rtsa ba ni 'dul ba'i sde la rag lus pa'i dge 'dun de la yang nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang / theg chen gyi dge 'dun gnyis su byung ba'i snga ma gtso che ba'i dbang du btang ste/—186

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag yonasdom gsum las/ /nyan thos rnams kyi bla ma ni/ /bzang yang gang zag kho nar bas/ /zhes dge slong grangs bzhir ma longs pa la gang zag dang longs pa ni/ mdzod rang 'grel las/ so so thar pa'i sdom pa de yang dge 'dun nam/ gang ga las te/ dge slong dang / dge slong ma dang / dge slob ma'i sdom pa ni dge 'dun las so/ /gzhan rnams gang zag las so/ /ches/dam pa'i chos 'dul ba dang 'brel ba'i dge 'dun du byed dgos pa bstan pa gnas ma gnas kyang so thar gyi sdom pa yod med la rag lus par gsungs pas gtso che na'ang sdom gsum las/ pha rol phyin pa'i bla ma ni/ /bzang yang dge 'dun dkon cog yin/ /zhes sbyor mthong sgom gsum la gnas pa yin par gsungs pa de lta bu'i gang zag kyang mtha' ma bkag pas theg pa che chung gi 'dus tshogs rnams lung rtogs kyi yon tan phur sum tshogs pas phyug cing lha mi'i bsod nams kyi zhing dam par gyur pa'i phyir rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling 'di nyid du'ang rgya hor bod dang bod chen po sogs skye rgu mtha' klas pas 'di phyi'i bde 'bras kyi ched du sri (152na tshe nur bskrun pa'i bdog pa gzhi lam byes tshang mar dgos pa lugs gnyis dang 'brel ba'i dpya da dngos rnams don ma yin par chud 'dza' bar gyur na mdo nyi ma'i snying po las/ lhun po dang ni 'dra ba'i mi/ /blang ba byas te zos pa bla'i/ khyim par gyur pas dge 'dun gyi/ /longs spyad par ni mi bya'o/ /zhes dang / me lce 'bar ma lta bu yi/ /lcags kyi thu lum blangs pa bla'i/ /ra btu byung dang khyim pa yis/ /dbyig ni blang bar mi bya'o/ /zhes dge 'dun gyi rdzas la 'bags pa'i nyesadamigs ches mang du gsungs pas log 'tsho dang chom rkun gyi 'jig pa las skyob pa'i ched du sku gsung thugs rten/ sgrub mchod/ cho ga /bskang ba/ mdos gtor/ gar 'chams sogs la nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad/ mchod rdzas/ spyan gzigs/ gzhan yang lugs gnyis kyi skabs thob dang 'brel ba'i dngosapo'i rim pa brjed byang du bya bar/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ /rnal 'byor dag pa'i sems 'chang ba/ /de la gdug pa'i gza' skar dang / /bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad kyis/ /gnod par mi nus rtog med phyir/ /zhes de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la tshes grangs gza' skar sogs rtsi mi dgos kyang —187

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shekun rdzob kyi chosal/rdo rje'i tshig tu/ji ltar sabon de bzhin shing /khreng ji lta ba de bzhin 'bras//'jig rten kun la de mthong bas//'di ni rten cing 'brel 'byung ngo //zhes pa ltar gza' skar sogasarten 'brel 'grig pa la bltosadagosapa/'grel chen dri med 'od las/gza' tshesargyu skar sbyor ba dang byed pa nyid 152bdong dusaspyor dang //gdug pa'i gza' ste 'di rnams ni//bsod namasabyed pa rnamasal dge/zhes gsungasapa bzhin 'phagasapa'i skad du siṅga la zhesapa phyogasa'adir dmar ser can du bsgyur cing rgya nag gtsug lag gi gzhung lasating zi ste me sgrul gyi lo chu stod zla ba'i gnam gang lha'i bla ma rgyal sar byon ba'i dus dge bar deb ther dpag bsam 'dod 'jo 'dri ba'i dbu btsugs te bkod pa la/sprel zla'i tshesaḥ r+sā mor nye bar mkho ba'i deb ther 'dren byed bdud rtsi'i dpal ster/sdebasbyor mnyalapa'i bṛt+ta lasame yo 4nga ༅/kāralegodzaslabastatik+ṣa t+yatagrwasur grwahagar+ṇananikyisathi//rgyusaspo:dhāhasarashārtasagorjekhuskomāras rnyi rmatshwaṣ+ṭha patra/mi bzad rdo rje 'bar ba'i mtshon rnon po//gdengasartser lha min gdon tshogs mi rtag lam//'god mdzad sirdzu'i rgya mtshor 'dab brgya'i steng //gar bsgyur 'chi med grub pasabyin chen phob//153na7ga na pad+ma'i sgyu 'phrul khams gsum la//dbang phyug dkar mor rjes chags dmar 'od mdangs//srid zhi'i yid rtsa g.yo byed 'dod ba'i me'i//rtse mo tshangs pa'i yul sa las brgal sgar//ma dang mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshogasadapon du//rgyalakun rigasabadag rnga yab gling pa'i zhabs//legasa'abyin gar 'chamasango mtshar bkod pa'i deb//'dren byed bdud rtsi'i dpal ster deng 'dir 'god/khesabakra shisakyi tshigs4dbarjod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ji skad du/rin go mtshogling pad+ma'i sdong po las:rangabyung sprul pa'i sku ru brda yis 'ongs:gang zhig lasacan skyesabu dad pa can bdag la gdung ba'i semasakyis gsol 'debs na rgyu 'bras rten 'brel smon lam khyad par gyis :sangs rgyasagazhan pasabadag nyid thugasarje myur zhesasnyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i sems can thamasacad mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi sar bkri ba'i thugs bskyed mnga' na'ang khyad par bod dang bod chen po'i 88

sku gsung thugs rten gsar ba tshe ngas dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (ma'agro ba rnams rjes su 'dzin par thugs rje'i mthu lhag par myur ba zhal gyis 'ches shing der ma zad/rgyal po'i mnga' bskyed nor bu'i bang mdzod las/nga yi 153ba po sung gi gdul bya yis bod la bde skyed 'byung 'dod na:yar ngo tshes bcu nam shar tshe:phyon pad+ma'i sprul pa 'byung:zhes dang /chos rgyal rat+na gling pa'i gter byon chos bcu'i bskul byang las/nga nyid srin yul 'gro ba'i tshe bod kyi rgyal blon sngags slob la byung cog zla ba'i tshes bcu la:nga nyid 'byon pa'i dbu snyung bzhes pad+ma 'byung gnas gzhan mi bslu:the tshom spongs shig rjes 'jug rnams:zhes lhag par yar ngo'i tshes bcur dngos su 'byon par zhal gyis 'ches pa'i nang tshan sprel zla'i tshes bcu chen mo mnga' bdag gsung gi sprul pa gu ru rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug gi zab gter las byang le'u brgyad pa dang 'brel ba'i gar 'chams pho brang 'dzam gling rgyan gcig sne'u sdong rtser zi na rin po che kun bzang rtse ba bsod nams rgyal mas yab sras kyi phyag bzhes su bstar ba'i rjes su 'brangs pa'i zhal brnyan/phod ka/gar gos/brog zhu/rten khebs/rgyan drug/phyag mtshan/ging rnga/'phan gdugs sogs spyan gzigs kyi rim pa'i deb 'dren byed bdud rtsi'i dpal ster bkod pa la/rtsa deb dpag bsam 'dod 'jor ma tsos pa med spyad 'phel 'grib sna tshogs gnyer par rtsis sprad 154na〉'i deb dngas mtsho'i zla gzugs/ldeb sbyor mnya pa'i phri tsā las me rta go phreng ༅/rka shi sna rlu lha:ye na bstasumaṇ+ḍa lu/chogamatras tsā lha bha baḥ//da sbakār ma hā de ba kā ma sung lha bha be+e r+sha su gāṇa shas n+da sha tu//'bum phrag nyi ma zil gnon zhal gyi khyim//mthong ba'i mod la brtan g.yo'i dngos po kun//'dar mdzad lha wo ṭak+ki rā dza yis//srid zhi'i legs tshogis ma lus dbang du sdus//rgya bal bod hor tsi na'i rgyal khams sogs//skad rigasacha byad spyod tshul mtha' klas pa//bgrang yas yul gru'i spyad dngos 'di tsam zhes//gcig tu 'dzin pa byis pa'i blo gros bzhin//de phyir rin cen phyi nang gos ras rdzas//nyer mtshon tshong bos du mar bsgyur ba dang //longs su spyad pas 'phel 'grib sna tshogs deb//rab 'char dwangs mtsho'i zla gzugasa'adi na'o//zhes tshigs su bcad pa sngon du bto shā gnyer par rtsis sprod rgyu'i gser dngul rin po

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)che'i rigs/gos dar ja ras/thab gdan chas/go mtshon/ 154ba〉khru cha/rta drel/ru khag gi mtshon bdog pa sna tshogs mtha' dag gcig tu brtan mi chags par 'phel 'grib kyi deb dwangasamatsho'i zla gzugs bkod pa la/gzhigabyesaganyisakar 'phral dgosakyi rigasartsa deb dpag bsam 'dod 'jo las zur du phyung ste dkon gnyer rnamasal sprad pa'i deb murtag r+sāng ba/sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bṛt+ta lasamertag 4nga can/bidubasemalaskruh+phugaṅgan+tadwaridratasprutādher+hayaspu tatā//gāmadzemashudrwastadzam+bhaphywahitsatridh+watosaka lupa〉shekusamathu stobs ma la ya las legs 'ongs dris//dbul 'phongs gdung sel 'byor pa'i grib bsil bar//'gro rnams ngal gsor byed pa dzam la dmar/kham sa gsum mtha' dag rang gir dbang du mdzod//bsnyen sgrub dmigs pa'i rten gyi brisa'abur sku//mngon spyod lasal sbyor ba drag po'i chas//rtsa gsum thugasadam skong nusamachod pa'i dzos//'phral du spyad byar 'osarnamasazur phyung ba//spel legasamu tig 'phreng mdzesaltar brgyusadeb//mkha' 'gro lnga tshogasadagyesabaskyed tam bu ra//brjod pa rnam 155narkog tshig sbyor sbar mo'i rtses//bskul ba'i sgra dbyangs rna ba'i rgyan du dngar//zhes phun sum tshogs pa'i shis pa brjod de rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams byes su 'degs dus 'bras spangs sogs nye bar mkho zhing gzhis su'ang 'phral du spyod pa'i sku gsung thugs rten rgyun gtor/dus gtor glo bur du dgos pa'i mchod mas sogs ma deb chen mo dpag bsam 'dod 'jo nas zur du phyung ste dkon gnyer sbrel por rtsis sprod kyi deb mu tig 'phreng ba bkod pa la/bye bzhugasakyi nyer spyad rtsa deb dpag bsam 'dod 'jo nasazur du byung ba gnyer nga sbrel por sprad pa dang gsar byung rtsisathogatu4ra ñtsadebari jayonayam̐dakyilage'i/sdosar mtshala'ibṛt+talasasapo'ang tha/sāmatesdat+palādusalhagap+takot+nardzabar+shakame༅lha'ipaḥ//munar+sāb2shrīmatodzalha〈peshrabir+ghaṇ+ḍaropu༅yatsātu//snyan brjid 'grin rnga sgrog pa g.yu 'brug steng //gaṅgā'i yab gcig mdzes pa 'phrog pa'i gzugs//yid kyi gdung sel dpal ldan dzam bha las//rnam thosabu yi gan mdzod deng 'dir stsol//sras bcas rgyal ba zhi khro'i bris 90

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sha shā'ithang sku//dar zab lda ldi spel legs155brko bang po'i gzhu//phra mang dung dkar sbub sil spos phor dang //rten khebs go mtshon bza' btung g.yos 'dren snod//'phel 'grib rtsis su gdab 'os byesams rigs//'phral bde mdzod gnyer sna tsho gos ka ca'i deb//ma 'dres cha gang ri bong 'dzin pa yi//dkyil 'khor gnyis skyes dga' ston deng 'dir shar//zhes tshigs su bcad pas bsngun bdar te rtsa deb wo mo dpag bsam 'dod 'jo nas zur du phyung ba gtso bor ba 'a te grwa tshang byes su btegs bzhugs kyi 'phral dgos dang snyan dar sogs spyi 'bul gyi rim pa gsar byung rtsis khog nas brtan pa'i gzhis su bskur 'os dang 'phral bder bed spyod pa'i 'phel 'grib sna tshogs gnyer tshab sbrel por rtsis sprod kyi deb ri bong 'dzin pa'i dkyil wor bkod pa la/rtsa ba 'a mod pag ba smo 'dod sku'i zhu yog lag yon deng ther dbang gi rgyal po/sdos sbyor mnyam pho brit+ta las zlum po/lha ba yadi biṣ+ṭha ka rig ṇa korma ma la no ni stodhiswā ra mā ta pād+ma te rtsa kā ya pā yaswā tri lo kagan+ta snun na k+ṣaṇa:mān+tataji bcu ḍi khri ni kyi pa n+da di gsarba bis snas dge kha ya graban+ta ko ma'i nuṅgā ra/ /56na ) thabs shes zung 'jug tshogs gnyis rlabs 'phreng yol med byang lho snying po'i mtsho//ma dros las 'ongs sku bzhi'i chu bosa'ajig rten gsum gyi dri ma rnams//zhagi da par mi dal 'khor mtha' de srid chad med rtag 'bab 'phrin las rgyun//'gro kun la 'jug nyi ma'i gnyen zhabs gtsug tor rtser 'ching bdag rjes bzung //chen po hor sogs 'dzam gling ma lus par//btud bya bsod nams gzhin gyur 'phrin las kyis//rgya mtsho'i gos mtha' bcings mthong brgya byin kyang //zhabs pad 'dud la brel khyod bsngags pa'i yul//dpal mgrin sras po mi bsrun gnyis 'thung zhal//'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje 'phrul po ches//ye shesasnang ba mas klas tshogs kyi bdag/bi nu rā dzas mkho rgu'i 'byor pa stsol//gdul dka' nyi ma'i dngos grub dmar chung snying //za ba'i gtum drag srid gsum 'dar nus kyang /khro chags pad rag mdangasaldan rnam thos sras//gnod sbyin bang mdzod sgo 'phar deng 'dir phye//lha mi'i longs spyod yod do cog gi gter//phyur bur spungs pa ming don 'khrul /da du//brda sprod yig gzugs dkar 'jam shog

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebu'i ngos//yongs shar deb ther dbang rgyal deng 'dir dgod//ces pa'i shis pa brjod pa sngon du bto nas rtsa deb r+ṣa mo dpag bsam 'do 'jo'i bu yig gnyer pas lag 'dzin du byed rgyu'i deb ther dbang gi rgyal po bkod pa la/sdeng sbyor mkho pa'i brit+ta las zlum po/ 156ba〉lam+bha ta su kar+sha ka di gaṇa swā dha no bi du༄sla ṭika shukla dwar+shakasubak+ta tā su biṅgārā pa no ta la ji/ga bha mā sta tiṣ+ṭha/bidzaskrudi la ge mu khe ni mit+ta be+e ma bya de shu pañtsa mo da di btsakra ba ār+shasi ji ten gu:la/ring nas legs byas tshogis kyis bsgrubs pa'i rdul bral shel dkar me long ngos//ye shes rang gzugs 'gog med yongs shar 'og min zhing gtsor 'khor ba'i mtha'/ /rdzogs min bzhugs kyang 'dzam gling 'gro ngor mawo dpe'i snang bas ma' sum du//bstan te lnga bdo'i gling dang dpung gnyen don kun grub des dge legs stsole//g.yas 'khyil mdzod spu nas 'phros 'od kyi zer//yongs khyab 'jig rten snang ba'i dga' ston gyis//dus kyi mun pa mthar byed tshe mtha' yas 'chi med bum bzang gtsug tu bkod byin rlobs//ut+pal rgyud las drangs pa'i 'jam mnyen mdas//'khor 'das yid myos gtsug tor 'dud pa'i rtser//rkang sen zla ba tshes pa'i mchog sbyin mkhan//57narigs byed lha mos 'jig rten gsum dbang sdus//ga sgo'i klung rdul snyed kyi bgrang dka'i zhing //'gro 'dul sprul pa nam mkha'i mtha' bsnyeg ding //'bod grogs mgon gcig tshul dngom sgyu thabs can//pad+ma thod 'phreng zha khas pad spyi bos len//thub bstan ut+pal bzhad rtser legs bshad kyi//rnam dpyod ral gri 'od 'phros dpung mdzes brgyan//skye rgu'i mig ngor sgyur mdzad btsong kha pa//'jam dpal rdo rjer nges rnyed mgos phyag 'tshal//thog mtha' bar dge ched 'dun brtson pa'i 'bras//lhun grub bsod nams tsho gos 'a yon to gyi//phung pos nor 'dzin rngul ba'i chu gter bzhi//byang chub rgya mtshor babs der 'dud par spro//dang po'i mgon po gdul bya'i bsod nams zhing //'tshams sprin gos klubs rnam kun mchog ldan pa//e tsho zung 'jug dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i skur//bzhengs la dngos po yongs kyis skyabs su song //'khor 'daXchos kyi gnas lugs rlabs kyi 'phreng //ka dag

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mchu gter dbyings su ro gcig pas//rang rig kun bzang don gyi bla ma sa/ngo 'phrod rnam par grol mdzad rigs kyi bdag/theg chen skye 'phags slob mar bcas pa yi//sku gsung thugs rten spel pa'i legs byas tshogis//'dren byed yul gyi dngos mthong gzugs can du/gyur na nam mkha'i mtha' 'jal ngal ba btang //skye mang sdig mun brtsegs pa'i phung po'i nang //dge ba'i sgron me chung ngu btegs pa'i mod//sgrib byed mngon sum lta zhog bag la zha//gar song 'phags157ba lnga'i spyan gyis gzigs nus ci//nyes brgya'i gar+sā po mtho ris chu gos rtser//blo brtson tog gis rab mdzesam dag dri//bkrus par gnasang na sbyin skyes dogs bral zhing //nges legs mig mi 'dzum gyi dga' ston dpyid//bsod nams byas tshogs gdang bu sbrel pa'i skas//ma rmad thar pa'i ba gam sgor btsugs par//'dzegs nas dgyes dgur spyod pa gtan gyi 'dun//sgrub pa'i zlos gar de la su zhig bshung //dkar nag yongs btab sa bon ma 'dres par//legs smin tshul la dpyod pa'i mig yangs pos//nyer 'bad dge tshogs dzasbu'i ljon shing 'bras//byang chub mchog mtshor gser du bsgyur de spro//blo gsal dpal ldan skal pa bzang po'i mthu//stobs kyi kho lag yangs por lhag bsam gyis//rang gzhan don ched rnam smin ches dkar zas//'tshang rgya'i bar du myong tshor ro bas mngar//ring bsrel bzhi yis phyur bur spungs pa rten//thub gsung 'gyur ro cog gi pu sta daḥ/dkon cog rin cen spel legs ga sdo la'i//dkar chag mu tig 'khri shing 'dod pa 'jo//de'ang mkhasa'ajug las//bstan bcos rtsom pa'i dam pa yis//ston pa la ni mchod brjod bya//bstan pa spel phyir dag pa'i tshig/'di la 'thad pa bzang po mthong //zhes gsungs pa ltar sngon rabs dam pa'i rnam par thar pa'i rjes su 'brangs te phun sum tshogs pa'i mchod bstod 'dud tshig sngon du btang nas skabs su gleng bar bya ba ni/rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen pos/res 'ga' rgyal 15ni7 dmigs pa'i dad pa dang //skabs 'gar shing rta chen po'i sku drin dran//gzhan tshe mkhas pa'i bshes la gus pa dang //nyam chung 'gro la snying nas brtse ba dang //bstan pa rin cen ring du gnas 'dod pa//'di dag 9

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she—phan tshun 'gran cing 'phel bar 'gyur/ /zhesathub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bya dka' ba brgya phrag du ma'i spyod pa rlabs chen pos grangs med pa'i bskal pa mang po sems can rnams kyi don du tshogs bsags shing byang chub mchog gi bdud rtsi brnyes nas thabs la mkhas pa'i mdzad pa du masayid can rnamasa'adren par mdzad pa la rgyu mtshan shesanasadad pa/ bskal pa 'di'i rnam 'dren bzhi pa shākya seng ges 'khor lo rim pa gsum sogs mdo rgyud kyi chos tshul mtha' klas pa gsungs na'ang rjes 'brangs rnams kyis ma rtogs pa dang log rtog gis 'dam du chud par 'brul med kyi shing rta'i srol legs par phye ba klu sgrub dang thogs med gnyis kyi sku drin rjes su dran pa'am/ shing rta chen po'i srol bzung nas grub mtha' rnam bzhi'i chos tshul rgyas par mdzad pa'i paṇa grub dang ljongs 'dir skad gnyis smra ba'i 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu sogs klog pa thos bsam dang spong ba bsam gtan la gcig tu bzhol ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la dad pa chen pos gus pa/ bde bar 'dod kyang ma rig pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal gyi rgyu la longs spyod pa'i nyam thag gi skyes bu'i tshogs pha mar shes nas snying brtseb/ 'phagasapa sdud pa las/ 'dzam (158ba〉sdu'i gling 'dir chu klung ji snyed cig 'bab cing / /me tog 'bras ldan sman dang nags tshal skyed byed pa/ /ma dros gnas pa'i klu dbang klu bdag rten gnasate/ /de ni klu yi bdag po de yi mthu dpal yin/ /rgyal ba'i nyan thosapa dag ji snyed chosaston dang / /'chad dang rig pa dag dang ldan par brjod pa dang / /mchog 'phagasabade ba skyed dang de yi 'bras thob pa/ /de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthu/ /zhesapa'i don bzhin gong du smos pa rnams kyi 'byung gnas/ bstan 'gro'i dge legs thams cad kyi rtsa ba thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che yun ring du gnas na ci ma rung snyam pa rnams thugs rgyud la phan tshun 'gran pa bzhin du 'gyur tshul gsungs pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa ni phan pa dang bde ba 'byung ba'i sgo dam pa yin pa de'ang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo'i yul yongs su spyod par/ yul dbusanasalho phyogasasu dar bar 'gyur ro/ /lho phyogasanasabyang phyogasasu dar bar 'gyur ro/ /byang phyogasanasabyang phyogs—194

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shāmisu dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i byang phyogs zhes pa'i byang phyogs ni thugs rje chen po dang sgrol ma'i sprul pa spre'u dang brag srin mo 'dus pa las 'gro ba 'phel te rus chen bzhi'am drug tu mched par thugs rje chen po'i bka' 'bum sogs nas byung zhing / khyad par 'phags bstod kyi 'grel pa'i khungs bu ston chos 'byung du drangs par/ skya seng bu lnga dang dgra ngan dpung tsho gos yan lag bcu gnyis 'thab pa'i tshe rgyal po rū pa ti (159na slo45 dmag stong phrag gcig dang bcas bud med kyi chas su zhugs te ri gangs can gyi dbus su bros pa las mched pa dang / bde mchog rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud las/ /bod yul du ni lhan skyes te/ /zhi zhid gsal ba'i gzugs can la/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan lag na thogs/ /brag gi khyim la brten te gnas/ /rang byung gi ni skye gnas can/ /zhes yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ya gyal du bgrangs pa sogs bshad tshul sna tshogs kyang don du bod yin pa mthun la/lha gcig jo bo a ti sha rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs na 'od dpag med kyi lha khang zhig yod pa'i nang du byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i thugs dam la bzhugs pas jo bo spyan ras gzigs kyi zhal mngon sum du bstan pa'i zhal nas/ /skyes bu dam pa legs so legs so dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mdzod gang yin pa de khyod kyis shes sam 'di nas byang phyogs na nga'i zhing khams yod/ khyod kyi yi dam jo mo sgrol ma yang de na sems can gyi don mdzad cing bzhugs/ khyod kyi gdul bya mang po yang de na yod pas byang phyogs bod du song zhes bod 'di thugs rje chen po rang gi zhing khams mchog tu lung bstan cing sgrol mas kyang / sa gzhi dang skye 'gro'i rgyud byin gyis brlab par tha mal gyi tshul bzung nas rgyun brtan par bzhugs pa'i phyir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa rgyun mi chad pa'i dbang gis rje gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung rgyal rabs nyer (159ba)bdun gyi bar dngos su dam pa'i chos kyi ming tsam mi grags kyang thabs kyi sgo nas legs pa'i lam la bkris shing chab srid sgrung lde'u bon gsum gyis bskyangs/ lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi dus dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyengs/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga pa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i dus srol btod/—/95

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shede nas rgyal rabs bzhi song nas rje khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus dam pa'i chos rgyas par mdzad/ dbon khri lde gtsug brtan gyis skad gsar bcad kyi gtan la 'bebs pa sogs bstan pa snga dar dang bar skabs su 'phel 'grib byung ba 'dul ba'i bstan pa mdo smad phyogs nas me ro gsos shing 'e ti dzña na shrī dang jo bo wo po a ti sha sogs paṇa grub du ma dang / sprul pa'i skyes mchog rin cen bzang po dang sgra sgyur chen po shākya ye shes sogs skad gnyis smra ba rnams dang / de dag gi rjes su zhugs pa'i mkhas btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug nam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bus gnam gyis sa bkab pa bzhin gyur te thub pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa deng sang gi bar du chad pa med par bzhugs pa ni lus can kun gyi bsod nams kyi zhing dam pa yin la/ de yang spyod 'jug las/ ji ltar mtshan mo mun nag sprin sum na/ /glog 'gyu skad cig rab snang ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas mthu yis brgya lam na/ /'jig rten bsod nams blo gros thang 'ga' byung / /de ltar dge ba nyam chung nyid la brtag /sdig pa stobs chen shin tu mi bzad pa/ /zhes sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ni sgron bskal du glog 'byug pa tsam dang sangs rgyas(160na〉ye 'byon pa'i mun bskal mtha' klas par bstan pa dang mi 'jal zhing dge bcu'i las lam tshul bzhin lag tu bstar rgyu yod pa ni ches skal pa bzang la/ /de bsgrub pa'ang rang nyid gcig bu'i ched du bya ba dman par gol bas blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis blang bya ma yin cing de las ldog ste gzhan don spyod pa ni/ slob springs las/ bder gshegs lam bstan 'gro ba 'dren par mas gyur cing / /sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa/ /lam de lha dang klu yis rnyed min lha min dang / /mkha' lding rig 'dzin mi'am ci dang lto 'phyes min/ /zhes bde bar bshegs pa'i theg pa chen po'i lam la brten nas 'gro ba thar par 'dren par byed pa'i khur khyer bar nus pa'i rten gyi gtso po'ang dal 'byor tshang ba 'di nyid yin cing / /de nyid las/ tshen tu rnyed bla'i mkham 'ga' lta phyugs kyang rang nyid za/ /shin tu sgom pas gdungs pa'ang chu zhig rnyed na dga' mgur 'thung / /'di na skyes bu gzhan don byed par brtson pa gang yin pa/ /de 'di'i brjid bag yin te de bde skyes bu'i rtsal de 'phags/ /nyi ma —196

sku gsung thugs rten gsar ba nangs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag slonarlabs chen rta zhon rgyu ba snang byed gang yin dang / khur la mi rtsag sa yis 'jig rten 'degs pa gang yin de/ /rang don 'ga' med chen po rnams kyi rang bzhin de 'dra ste/ /de dag 'jig rten phan dang bde ba'i ro la gcig tu gzhol/ /zhes rang gi zas skom 'tshol ba sogs phan thabs lhur len pa dud 'gro la'ang 'byung ba lta bu ma yin par 'di snang gis pha (160ba〉pas thog drangs mkha' mnyam gyi skye rgu rnams kyi don du bsgrub pa nyi mas mun pa bsal ba dang sa chen pos 'jig rten 'degs pa dang chosamatshungs pas gzhan don bsgrubs pa'i zhan la rang don shugs la 'byung ba/ byang chub lam rim las/de'i phyir rang g.yin gyi legs pa thams cad kyi 'byung gnas rgud pa thams cad sel ba'i sman/ mkhas pa'i skye bo kun gyis bgrod pa'i lam chen po mthong thos dran reg gis kyang 'gro ba kun gyi gsos su gyur pa/ gzhan don du zhugs pas rang don ma tshang ba med par zhan la 'grub pa'i thabs mkhas chen po dang ldan pa'i theg chen la 'jug tu yod pa ni kye ma'o bdag gis rnyed ba legs par rnyed do snyam du bsams la skyes bu'i rtsal ci yod kyis theg pa mchog 'dir 'jug par bya'o/ /zhes 'phags chen dam pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa'i rjes su zhugs te 'bad pas bzhengs pa'i yul yang / sngon gyi yig tshang las/ dbus phyogs tsam dud 'khyer lugs ni/ /'bri gung bod 'brog gnyis po la/ /sum stong drug brgya sum cu yod/ /tshal pa sum stong bdun brgya yin/ /phag mo gru pa nyis stong dang / /bzhi brgya sum cu rtsa brgyad do/ /zhes pa'i khungs kyang / de phyir sa skya'i dpon chen ni/ /zam gru gung ming dban hu yi/ /ming thob shākya bzang po de'i/ /deb ther shog dril can bzhir yin/ /khri skor de bas dbus gtsang gi /'ja' mo 'dzin lugs de ltar yin/ /zhes dbus gtsang khri skor bcu gsum le lag dang bcasaso sor dbye ba'i char gtogs shing gnam gyis bskos (161na)pa'i drung chen rin po che tā'i si tus gzhis chen bcu gsum btab pa'i nang tshan zangs ri lhun grub rab brtan du sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis 'phags pa'i yul du a na la zhes pa phyogs 'dir mer 'bod cing rgya nag gi yul khams su sing zhing zhes pa ljongs 'dir me pho 'byug gi lor sku gsung thugs rten bzhengs pa dang dmar ser —197

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)can zhes pa me sbrul rten bzhengs rnams kyi dkar chag bkod pa la rdzong gsar tshoms chen gyi byang rgyud ngos kyi cha'i dbus su bdag cag gi ston pas lan cig ma yin par ches cher bsngags shing / mtha' yas pa'i bskal pa'i sngon rol nas sdug bsngal gsum gyis mnar ba'i lus can rnams sa dang lam la zhugs par ma bltos par rnam par dag pa'i smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar ba'i mthus srid pa 'dzin par nus pa'i dag pa'i gnas mngon par 'du mdzad pa nub phyogs bde ldan zhing gi bkod pa dang snyigs ma'i 'gro 'dren thugs bskyed kyi dam bca' phul du byung ba mgon po 'od dpag med sras kyi thu bo snying rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs dang bdud dpung zil gyis gnon pa mthu chen thob sogs mig gi bdud rtsir gyur pa'i steng gi cha'i dbus su/ 'jam dpal rdo rje ngur smig 'dzin pa'i zlos gar rgyal ba gnyis pa shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa/ de'i mdun smad kyi char nged rang gi 'dra 'bag /g.yas su snang ba mtha' yas ye ( ma'i zlos gar/ lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan mar me mdzad/g.yon du skye ba nyi shu rtsa lngar (161ba 'jam dpal dbyangs mi'i srid pa gzung zhing sku tshe phyi ma mngon dga'i zhing du bde gshegs dri ma med par mngon sangs rgyas pa sa paṇ+ḍita kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ de nas rim gyis cung zad dma' bar jo bo chen por sgrol mas slob ma'i mchog tu lung bstan pa bka' gdams kyi chu 'go 'byom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam sprul dge ba'i bshes gnyen gsang phu ba legs pa'i shes rab/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa/ dbyangs can ba 'ad pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ mkhyen brtse nus ldan bsod nams rgya mtsho/ bde chen shug kyi rgyal po yon tan rgya mtsho/ bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa'i g.yas g.yon gyi gling gi char/ yangs pa can gyi rol mo'i sgra can gyi shing ljon pa'i drung na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya'i rgyal pos thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i chos gsungs pa'i tshe 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyis lnga brgya'i tha ma la gang thos pa tsam gyis bla na med pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur pa dang bsam pa thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sngon gyi smon lam —198

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mar jos khang bzang gi dkar chag 9yikhyad par rgyas pa zhu bar mdzad pa'i dgos pa bstan pa'i mthar gyur pa na/ gsung rab spyi dang gzungs sngags mthu chung bar 'gro ba bshad kyang / mdo 'di nyid ches cher bdo ba'i 'gro la ched du bsngagasapas nus pa cher 'gro ba smon lam gyi khyad par yin zhing sangs rgyas rnams ris su ma chad pa'i sems can la rjes su chags(162na)par mtshungs kyang / zhu lan nor bu'i 'phreng bar/ sprul pa'i cho ge rgyal dpal ldan mar me mdzad bzang po ma dag pa'i gdul bya la dus drug tu gzigs shing bzhugs pa'i tshe snyigs ma'i mgon po rgyal ba bdun dang rang gi ston pa shākya thub pa/ zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rnam 'dren gzhan las mthu dpung lhag par che zhing bde gshegs bdun gyi mchod pa'i phan yon kyang / ser sna/ tshul 'chal/ nga rgyal/ phrag dog /phra ma las sbyor ngan pa byas pa'i rnam smin myong ba dag mtshan thos pa dang dran pas sdug bsngal las grol ba/ las kyi sgrib pa dag cing bdud sdig can gyis mi brdzi ba bu nor tshe dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs shing 'khor los sgyur rgyal du skye ba sogs phan yon mtha' klas pa'i mdo'i cho ga las byung ba'i zhing bkod gtso 'khor gyi lha tshogs nga gsum/ steng gi char brgyud pa'i bla ma rin po che'i 'phreng ba ltar tshar du dngar ba/ nub phyogs nas rim pa bzhin yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis yul yangs pa can du sku tshe byin gyis brlabs pa'i rnam rgyal mchod rten sku rgyu rin cen gnyis pa dngul dkar dang / khri sogs gser zangs las grub pa bum nang du sku dang / seng khri rgyal chen bzhi 'phrul ma rin po che'i rgyan sogs bzo bkod phun sum tsho gos pa/ yum chen mo sher phyin ma/ mnyam med jo bo rje a ti sha /rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa/ 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag /thugs rje chen po sems nyid ngal gso/ gangs can lha gcig chos kyi rgyal po (162ba tshorgong btsan sgam po/ 'jam dpal rdo rje tshangs pa lha'i me rta go /'phagasamachog snying rje'i gter chen 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa/ thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ hor bod skye rgu'i rnam 'dren bsod nams rgya mtsho/ yon tan rgya mtsho'i 'byung gnas bde chen chos rgyal/ de 'phros dang nub rgyud kyi —199

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shestod char 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag par du btab pa bcus lhag sum stong dang smad char sgrol dkar gyi sku mang ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa/ mdo sde gser 'od dam pa/ pad+ma bka'i thang yig /bka' thang sde lnga/ mnyam med jo bo yab sras kyi gsang chos bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che cha lag dang bcas pa/ bdud rtsi'i snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud bzhi/ de'i cha lag bco brgyad/ nged rang gis brtsams chos par du 'khod pa rnams/ shar phyogs su snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa bu ston rin cen grub kyis mdzad pa'i dkar chag sor gnas la mtshal pa bka' 'gyur gyi rnying rgyud po ti gsum bsnan pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog skya pod gsar bzhengs la che brjod dkar chag smon lam dang bcas pa logs su gsal/ mchod rdzas sa rgyan gnam rgyan 'phan me dam/ mchod skong / ting sogs mchode pa'i bye brag mtha' klas pa/ gzhan yang skyon phug tu dpal o ḍi ya na'i slob dpon chen po za hor ma'i chos sku yum chen mo'i rnam par sprul pa ma gcig lab kyi sgron (163na sgo'i gnas khang dmar mchod khang du dpal mar me mdzad/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa/ 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag /rdzong gi klu sdings su slob dpon chen po'i sku rgya gar lugs/ gzims khang 'og a lags dgos dgos kyi phyi rten du skyon chen po gtso 'khor gsum/ sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi rnam par sprul pa dang 'brel ba'i 'brungs rabs gra tshar zhal thang bcu bdun la tshang ba'i lha mgron sogs phyug pa rnams/ dmar ser can zhes pa me sgrul gyi lo rong lnga rgyal mtshan gyis nged rang ring 'tsho'i rten 'byung la dmigs nas mi tshad tsam bzhengs te zangs ri khang dmar du bzhugs na legs pa'i lung bstan ltar skyon yab yum gsum/ gu ru mtshan brgyad dang bcas pa/ de steng skyid grong thod pa 'bar/ pha thos smyon bsam grub/ ma gcig lang kyi sgron ma/ phyag na rdo rje rnams/ g.yin yang thub dbang / gnas brtan bcu drug /dge bsnyen dharma/ rgyal chen bzhi/ ha shang gu ru mtshan brgyad chung gra gcig /jo bo chen po a ti sha gsum/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa gsum/ 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag che chung drug /bris sku cho 'phrul mchod pa'i zhal thang bco lnga rnams las/ 'bur sku dang —200

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga (mamachod rten gyi gzungs bzhugs la/ring bsrel rnam pa bzhi las/sku gdung gi ring bsrel/sku bal gyi ring bsrel/chos sku'i ring bsrel rnams las/bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i ring bsrel rtse lha sgang gi nang rten dang chos dbang gi gter 163ba ) byon sogs las byon pa/gdung dang sku bal so sor phye ba las/gang zag de ga'i byin rlabs rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdo mes pa brjod bdebs/bstan lha'i skor la rdo rje gdan gyi byang chub ljon shing /rang sangs rgyas kyi gdung rdo'i khams su byin gyis brlabs pa/dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pa'i snam sbyar/dpal ldan sa ra ha) reg 'jam sprul gyi pags pa'i sgom thag/paṇa chen nā ro ta pa'i rus rgyan/mnga' bdag mi tri pa'i rdo rgyus sgom thag/dge slong ma dpal mos bsgrubs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i bum chu ril bu//'jig rten mkha' 'gros rgya gar phyag na la gnang ba'i rdo rgyus sgom thag/bal po'i rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i ba so'i dbu rgyan/chosargyal srong btsan sgam po'i zhabs phyags/rgya mo bza' yong jo'i phyag bzo'i sangs rgyas btags sku//'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu lo chen rin bzang gi dbu skra/lho brag mar pa chos kyi blo gros kyi gsol zhal la rje mi las kyang bzhes pa'i thun mong gi bzhes can/rje btsun mi la'i sgom thag/mkhas grub khyung po dang rmog bcog pa rin cen brtson 'grus kyi gdung thal/bstan pa'i rtsa lag kha che'i paṇ+ḍita chen po shākya shrī'i sku chos/dbu zhwa/lhung bzed kyi shubs/gsil byed kyi bar shing byang chub ljon pa las grub pa/rtsod dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che'i zhabs phyags/sems dpa' chen po thogs med bzang po dpal ba'i na bza'/gzhubs chos lung tshogs pa'i rten 'dam/gnyags dbon bsod nams164na tha zang po'i dbu skra/ mkhan chen rgyal ba phyag na'i dam rdzas/ 'jam dbyangs dkon cog bzang po'i dbu lo/yab rje rdo rje 'chang kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sgom thag/tsa ri dang chosa'akhor rgyal gyi bla mtsho'i ril bu rnams/bka' gdams rin po che dang mnyam med zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i byin rten la/lnga brgya pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu jo bo rje a ti sha'i bla gos/dbu zhwa/gdung nag/rgya dpe/bshes gnyes chen po po to ba 0rin cen gsal gyi bla gos/spyan snga rin po che tshul

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)khrims 'bar gyi dbu skra/ mchims nam mkha' grags kyi ber zlam/ mkhan chen las kyi rdo rje'i phyag mdzub/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dbu lo/ bla gos/ dbu zhwa/ rdul gzan/ dga' ldan khri pa 'jam dbyangs gtsang pa bdun brgyud kyi dbu skra phyag sen rnamasaphyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i ril bu/ rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa dar ma rin cen gyi dbu skra/rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i zhabasang ra/ ba so sho chas rgyal mtshan gyi dbu skra/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa'i dbu paṇa/ paṇa chen byams pa gling pa bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba'i na bza'/'jam dbyangs smon lam legs dpal blo gros kyi shangs phyis/ 'dar ston blo bzang grags pa'i gdung rus/ dus zhabs chen po mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/ bzhugs gding / thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i sku rags/ paṇa (64bskosko bsod nams grags pa rnam dpyod mchog gi sde'i dbu lo/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbu skra/ zhwa thul/ pur ras/ stan dmar/chab mdo rje drung rin po che bstan pa rgya mtsho'i na bza'/ thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/ gsang chab/ phyag 'phreng/ pur ras/ rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa dpal 'byor lhun grub kyi dbu skra/dbu klad/ gdung rus/ nged rang nas chu byi bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi sgrub chen gyis thog drangs gra tshang la dbang mang du phul ba dang gzhan yang snga phyir dbang bskur tshe chog sogs bgyis pa'i bum chu dang tshe chang ril bu/ sgrub gtor/ zur kun mkhyen chen por tshe bdag gi dbang zhus skabs kyi dpung skud dang bcas pa/ dwags po grwa tshang nas ma ṇi dung phyur bsgrubs pa'i ril bu/ dga' ldan gsang sngags gling pas byang gter thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i myong grol ril bu rnams/ /rje btsun sa skya pa rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i byin rten skor la grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba dpal ldan brla pa'i rus rgyan/ de'i bdud rtsi ril bu/ zung 'jug sku brnyes spyo ston chos 'bar gyi na bza'/ bla ma gnam kha'u pa dar ma rgyal mtshan tsha ba bzhes skabs mgon po 'kha bzhi dngos su gzigs pas phyag nas shor ba'i bzhes can/ 'khon dkon cog rgyal po'i na bza'/ de dang rje sa skya pa thun slong gi —2()2

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mare phrug gi na bza'/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po'i gar gos/ rus rgyan/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo'i gar gos/ rje btsun (165na)rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi phyag 'phrong me 'bar ma/ gar gos/ ber zlam/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'i 'phan rtse/ 'jam dbyangs sa skya paṇa chen gyi na bza'/ chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che'i na bza'/ rdo rgyus pang khebs/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi bla gos dang tsar mo/ sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba'i sku ber/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i pur ras/ da lam bsgrubs pa 'di myangs na skye ba gsum na mkha' spyod grub par mkha' 'gros lung bstan thengs gsum byung ba ltar bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu/ rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi mas bsgrubs pa'i tshe zan/ sa le thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam dpal rdo rje'i na bza'/ rdo rje 'amang tshar pa chos rje'i dbu lo/ gdung rus/ sku rag /thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi gdung rus/ des byang gter thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i skye bdun ril bu/ na bza'/ des 'basgrubs pa 'a skye bdun ril bu/ rin po che bod mkhar pa mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan gyi dbu skra/ mkhan rin po che gzhen nu blo gros kyis bsgrubs pa'i rtag gtor/ tshar chen dang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse yab sras kyis bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu/kun mkhyen klu sgrub rgya mtsho dang sngags 'chang dgon gsar ba bsod nams chos 'phel gyi gdung rus/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi gdung rus/ na bza'/ bdag chen 'jam dbyangs bsod namasadabang po'i (165ba'i bu lo/ rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi bla gos/ sa skya khri chen a mi ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i sa zhu/ sku sham/ des bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu/ rigs kun khyab bdag mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan gyi gdung rus/ bsgrub pa gnang ba'i tshe zan/ 'khon rigs gong ma sogs dang sngags gsar ma mang po'i dam rdzas phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i rta brgya mdzo brgya ri ba'i ril bu rin spungs pa'i nang rten gras rnams/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i byin rten skor la/ slob dpon chen po'i —203

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)na bzas mtshon thog mar 'dri 'os na'ang / gter kha so so nas byung ba'i na bza' shog ser sogs mang ba'i gter ston gyi rjes su 'brangs pa brjod bde bar mthong ste bkod pa la/mnyam med jo bo chen po a ti shas bsnams phebs pa'i za hor rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi gdung rus/ be+e ro tsa na'i rgya dpe/ bsam yas par khang gi rgya dpe/ gter kha gang yin ma nges pa'i shog ser khungs btsun/ phyon chen po'i dbu skra /nyang ta thā ga ta'i gdung rus/ mnga' bdag sku'i sprul pa nyang ral pa can gyi gter byon bde 'dus shog ser/ mnga' bdag gsung gi sprul pa gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi sku sha /gter byon gyi khrus lung ma ṇi ma'i khrus dar/ shog ser/ des bsgrubs pa'i chos sman/ sras pad+ma dbang chen gyi sku sha /bla ma bya nag chen po rin cen 'od kyis drang srong bsgrubs pa'i skra /mthu chen (166na〉kangs pa shāka 'bum gyis sgrub pa mdzad pa'i phyag phreng / slar rgyal ba g.yung ston pas kyang mdzad pa dang ring bsrel/ rog snye mdo thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbu skra dang zhabs phyags/yab rje skyon gling pa'i gter byon khros nag shog ser/ de'i shog ser slob dpon gyi phyag rjes ma/ kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po klong chen rab 'byams pa'i phyag 'phreng / sprul sku sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter byon skyon yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar/ gter ston rin cen gling pa'i sku sha /gter ston dri med lhun po'i dbu zhwa de'i gter byon/ mkhan po bo dhi sa twa/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod 'phreng / chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan/ mkha' gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal gsum gyi shangs mtshal sku rgyur bsres pa'i 'bum dmar/ rigs 'dzin rgod kyi ldem phru'i gter ma'i rnam snang rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi dbu ral/ cho ge rgyal rat+na gling pa'i gdung rus/ sku rag /gter byon slob dpon chen po'i zab ber gter ston kun skyong gling pa'i gdung rus/ grub thob thang stong rgyal pos bsgrubs pa'i tshe ril/ sle bem/ gter ston pad+ma gling pa'i sku sha ril bu/ gter byon gyi shog ser/ slob dpon chen po'i zab ber/ des bsgrubs pa'i skye bdun ril bu/ se ston mgon po bzang po'i dbu klad/ /se ston rin cen rgyal mtshan gyi dbu ral/ sku sham/ mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che'i gdung rus/ rigs 'dzin chen po legs ldan rdo rje'i dbu skra/—204

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag 6)gdung rus/ na bza'/ skye bdun/ dam rdzas kyi phabs(166ba〉tha gung pa chos rgyal rin cen phun tsho gos kyi sku sha ril bu/ phyag 'phreng / mnyam med nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi gdung rus/ sku phod/ 'phrong po gter ston shes rab 'od zer gyi dam rdzas ril bu/ 'bri gung zhabs drung chosargyal phun tshogs kyis bde 'dus sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i chos sman/ chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi dbu ral/ bsam yas ār+ya pa gling nas gdan drangs pa'i myong grol pad+ma rā ga /bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i bum chu ril bu/ chos sman/ snang gsal ba rigs 'dzin kun dga' tshe mchog gi dbu zhwa/ bkra bzang pa se ston pad+ma dbang chen gyi dbu ral/ byang pa rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i dbu skra/ na bza'/ zhabs phyags/ 'bri gung pa rigs 'dzin chen po chos kyi grags pa'i dbu skra/ bder 'dus kyi sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i chos sman/ 'phyong rgyas zhabs drung hor ngag dbang bsod nams grags pa'i gdung rus/ rlung chen gzhen nu don grub kyi na bza'/ yol mo sprul pa'i sku bstan 'dzin nor bu'i dbu ral/ gdung rus/ gsung sprul tshul khrims rdo rjes bsgrubs pa'i skye bdun dang chos sman/ kong po rdzogs chen pa lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med kyis bsgrubs pa'i 'gro don las sbyor lnga pa/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi dbu skra/ chab ser ril bu/gdung rus/ phyag 'phreng thag pa/ des bsgrubs pa'i 'gro don las sbyor lnga pa dang / tshes bco lngar phyag gis dril ba 'phel ba'i (167na skom rdzas khyad mtshar/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa blo mchog rdo rje'i dbu skra/ des bsgrubs pa'i gsang rdzogs kyi chos sman dang / tshe dpag med bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i tshe ril/dar rgyas chos sdings pa rigs 'dzin 'phrin las lhun grub kyis shel brag tu bsgrubs pa'i chos sman/chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa'i gter byon a tham ma/ skyon chen po'i sku rag /gter ston rang nyid kyi dbu skra/ rigs 'dzin thugs tig gi sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i tshe ril/ bdud rtsi chos sman/ rdo rje brag rigs 'dzin sprul pa'i skus gsang rdzogs sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i chos sman/ tshe dpag med bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang / sku gsum rigs 'dus kyi tshe ril/ thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol la brten pa'i —205

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)skye bdun ril bu/ dpal ri sprul sku ngag dbang pad+ma 'phrin las kyi 'chi med sku gsum 'dus pa dang /rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i ril bu rnams/ dwags po bka' brgyud kyi byin rten skor la/ te lo nā ro sogs rgya bod kyi paṇa grub du ma'i steng du bka' brgyud kyi bla ma rnams bsnan pa'i bka' brgyud spyi'i rten 'dus rin spungs pa'i nang rten nas brgyud pa/ sgam po zla 'od gzhon nu'i zhabs phyags/ dpal phag mo gru pa'i dbu skra/ ber zlam/ sgom zhwa/ zhab 'gro ba'i mgon po g.yu brag pa'i na bza'/ 'bab rong pa dar ma chos kyi dbang phyug gi chibs yag /stag lung thang pa'i na bza'/rgyal ba thog sdugs pa chen po'i thog gtum pa'i na bza'/ rgod tshang pa mgon po rdo rje'i dbu skra/ grub chen (167ba po rma pa shi'i dbu lo/ kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rje'i gdung rus/ spyan lnga lha gzigs ras pa'i gdung / zhwa dmar ba bzhi pa spyan snga chos kyi grags pa'i shangs mtshal te gong gsal so so'i cha shas re rten rnams la tshang bar bzhugs shing khyad par nged rang gis yun ring du longs spyod pa'i snam sbyar tshang ma 'dra 'bag nang du bcug /chos sku'i ring bsrel la sngags gsar rnying mang po'i bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan gzungs/ rig pa chen mo/ gsang sngags gsar rnying gi rgyud sde nas byung ba'i pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis su med pa ste bla med kyi skor/ srog shing brten pa/ rnal 'byor rgyud/ gzungs chen sde lnga gtso bor bton pa'i bya spyod/ mdo gzungs/ chos skyong / nor lha/ brtan bzhugs/ shis brjod rnams par 'debs pa nas 'bul ba'i bar 'khrul pa med pa'i phyag len gyis phyur bur gtams pa/ 'phags bal rgya nag bod yul sogs kyi gnas chen gyi sa sna rdo sna mang du spungs pa/ gtso bo rnams la gnod sbyin 'khor lo dpa' bo gcig grub kyi dgongs don sor ba rtag tshul bzhin bsgrubs par zas nor longs spyod kyi phung po 'byor ba'i rten 'brel du spel te rten bzhengs snga ma rnams la dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas rdo rje slob dpon byas gra pa bcu skor gyis dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor zhal phye ste bcu gnyis la sta gon dang bcu gsum la dngos gzhi'i sgo nas rab tu gnas pa legs par bsgrubs/ de yang / lung gzhi las/ /mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems dad pas/ /sangs rgyas mchod —206

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (marten (16ni' ni gom 'dor na/ /dza'i chu bo'i gser gyi srang tshad ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min/ /zhes dang / /gang zhig rab dang sems kyis sangs rgyas kyi/ /mchod rten la ni 'jim gong 'jog byed na/ /dza'i chu bo'i gser gyi srang tshad ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min/ /zhesabade bar gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la sogs pa rten gyi zhig gsos dang de dag gi ched gom pa 'dor ba tsam gyi bsod nams gyi tshad kyang mtha' klas na gsar du bskrun pa'i phan yon gyi tshad gzung bar dka' la/ de bzhin du/ 'phags pa brgyad stong pa las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mnyan par bya gzung bar bya bcang bar bya bklag par bya kun chub par bya rab tu gdon par bya bstan par bya nye bar bstan par bya lung 'bogs par bya kha gtan du bya bri bar bya/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi brlabs kyis glegs bam chen po la yi ge gsal nyid rab tu gsal ba legs par bris te me tog dang bdug pa dang dri dang 'phreng ba dang byug pa dang phye ma dang na bza' dang gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang dril bu dang ba dan dang kho ra khor yug du mar me'i 'phreng ba dang mchod pa rnam pa mang pos bkur stir bya bla mar bya brjed par bya mchod par bya ri mor bya bsnyen bkur bya ste/ kun dga' bo 'di ni nga'i rjes su bstan par bya'o/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ mdo (168ba〉sdo'adi la su dga' ba/ /de dag chos rnams thams cad la/ /the tshom dang ni rnam nur med/ /de dag mya ngan 'das dang nye/ /bya rgod phung por de bzhin gshegs/ /dpa' bo chen po de yis mthong / /thams cad sangs rgyas lung bstan te/ /rgyal ba byams pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas byams pa mthong nas/ /bzod pa bzang po 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab la 'dri klog sri zhur bgyis pa'i phan yon gzugs su grub na nam mkha'i mthongs su'ang shong bar dka' zhing / 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo las/ blo gros rnam par dag pa byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa la yang dag par zhugs pa gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten mthong nas dad pa bskyed de/ bus mo —207

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)gnyis rka'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas phyag 'tshal zhing phyag byed de/ de bzhin gegs pa skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis sku legs par brgyan pa ci 'dra bar bdag gi lus kyang de 'dra bar gyur cig ces mos pa bskyed na/ blo gros rnam par dag pa/ bsod nams kyi phung po de'i mtha' brjod par mi nus te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /bsod namasakyi phung po de ni rgyal po nyid dam/ brgya byin nyid dam/ tshangs pa nyid dam/ rang sangs rgyas nyid dam/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi theg pa bla na med pas kyang zad par bya bar mi nus so/ /zhes de bzhin (169na〉lta shegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can du gyur pa'i mchod rten bzheng ba dang bkur stir bgyis pas gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'khor 'das kyi yon tan phung po ni gang gis kyang mtshungs zlar mi rung ba sogs rgya cher bsngags pa'i tshul la blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis sgo gsum gyi 'bad pa chen pos nan tan bsgrub pa ni phan pa dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas bla na med pa'o/ a ho 'gro ched bskal mang bya dka' spyod/ /brtson pas byang chub mchog gi bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /thugs gsang za ma tog 'khyil rgyal drin mtha'/ /'phrog byed mkha' lding zhen myul ma rnyed ngal/ /thub rnams gang mdzad skye rgur rtsi sman gyi/ /ljon shing phang phung 'dab ma'i grib bsil la/ /mtha' dag 'jig rten ngal gsos dbang po lngar/ /sim pa'i tshor myong sngon bsags legs byas mthu/ /dkon cog zhing sar sri zhu sa bon cha/ /phra yang bsngo smon gsher gyis skyed bsrings sdong / /yal ga thar pa'i lam snyeg dpag bsam 'bras/ /'ganyas pa lha dang thun mong spyad bya min/ /bzang po'i bag chags sprin la rnam dpyod mig /nyer blta legs byas 'khyil ba dbyar rnga'i sgras/ /blang dor mngal khur mdun ma gru bzhi'i sar/ /bde skyid sgro gshog zlum por zlos gar sgyur/ /theg gsum skye 'phags kun gyis cher bsags tshogs/ /so nam (169ba)rtag 'grus zhing la cha mnyam par/ /bkram pa'i rnam dkar dge tshogs snye ma las/ /brgyags phye byang chen de srid mi 'dzad shog /dus min mtshun du 'khrid pa 'chi bdag gdon/ /dmar ba'i mig ras btsa' bzhin ring po'i tshe/ /pha mthar phyin pa'i byed po gar dbang lha'i/ /bum bzang bdud —208

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (martsi srog gi zungs gyur shog /nag po'i las dang des bskyed zug rngu'i nad/ /rtsub tsher 'byung ba'i sman pa be+e ḍūrla'i/ /'od ldan rnam 'dren thugs rjes 'du ba rnams/ /ma zhabrugs snyoms pa'i tshor ba rtag myong shog /yang srid mang por gtong ba'i bu lon tshogs/ /chud mi 'dza' ba dbang thang ne'u le'i mgrin/ /nyer skyugs 'byor ba'i phung po mthor brtsegs pa/ /ngal gsos bu yi gan mdzod spun zlar shog /dar drag btsan po'i las shugs rkang pa'i rdul/ /gtsug tu 'god la 'jig rten che rgu yis/ /rgyags pa'i bsnyems btang pus mo'i lha nga sar/ /btsugs nas lag pad snying gar zum par shog /skye bar skyabs mgon bshes gzugs yid smon mtshar/ /'char gegs dug bcil 'dod don sman gyi ror/ /rab bsgyur bden pa'i tshig gi chu lha'i bu'i/ /dkyil 'khor mchog gsum mthu yis gsal bar shog /chosadakar phung po 'di ko bsgrubs pa ched/ /gom gcig bor bas mtha' brten las byed dang / /(170na)bdog pa gtong rnams deng nas yang srid kun/ /bde skyid dpal 'bar rnam mkhyen myur thob shog /gting mtha' mi dpogs 'khor ba'i klong du zo chun 'byud mo ltar 'phyan pa'i/ /yang srid brgyud mar btungs pa'i nu zho rgya mtsho'i tshad brgal byin pa'i ma/ /dngos dang des skyed sdug bsngal bsgrub brtson yid can tshogs rnams gtan gyi bde/ /mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i rgyu ru bsags pa'i dge tshogs ma lus bsngo/ /mig gi bdud rtsir mthong ba'i mod la rnam par grol ba'i sa la yongs sbyor rdzogs sangasargyas/ /sgra 'dzin dbang por thos pa tsam gyis srid zhi'i nyes brgya mtha' dag gzhil mdzad dam pa'i chos/ /dad dang gtong bas ri mor bgyis na rlabs chen tshogs gnyis dbyar ltar mtsho spel dge 'dun gyis/ /'jig rten gsum du bkra shis dga' ston char gyi rgyun babs phan bde'i myu gu dar bar shog /ces sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis sku gsung thugs rten snga phyir bzhengs pa'i dkar chag legs byas 'dod 'jo 'di ni rgyu sbyor ba po nyid kyis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi ban+de 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis dmar ser can zhes pa me sgrul chu stod zla ba'i shes rab kyi cha'i gnam gang gi rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i 'grub sbyor gyi nyin pho brang dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni —209

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya ma gsung 'bum/ (20) wa warigs 'dzin gyi btsun pa 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa sarba dwa:bhawastu/(170ba)(sdeb sbyor slawo pa'iXt+ta las zlum po/)5di tā hi mi tra dwa yag lha khri zhin rtsi ta su mi gha ni la ka tsā kas ro storabharnya dharma〉sa sa ñdza ro da ru dra/ā gam :mā rdo tar dra tā ra ma k+ṣa ris mā ya ya dwa ti kalpa pañtsa mo dkal kān ṣa su tsakrashākyarwa dza//gzod ma nyid nas byams brtse'i snying po thugs bskyed sprin sngon 'khrigs pa las//bya dka'i phyin drug spyod pa'i char gyis chos gzugs snye ma dar drag pas//'gro kun 'khor 'khyams phongs las sgrol ba'i mi g.yo'i dam bca' gang du song //de phyir cher snyigs lnga bde'i dus 'dir thugs rje'i dpung bskyed zas gtsang sras//dgra gnyen bar ma kun la cha snyoms par//lhag bsam ga bur rdul dkar bkram pa'i ngad//sdug bsngal tsha gdung bcil de khyod kho na'i/khyad par ma yin rnam 'dren yongs kyi srol//'on te gcig tu gdul dka' lcags kyi khams//snying stobs rtsi yis nges legs gser sbyangs su//bsgyur la pad dkar lta bur lha rnams kyis//bsngags pa'i bden gtam 'di lagang gis bsnyene//chu (171na tha ljid ldan sprin dbus dbyar rnga'i sgras//mdongs mtha' sgro gzhog zlum por gar byed na//bskal bzang 'dren pa bzhi pa'i rnam thar la//mi dad blo de lha min gdon gyis btab//zla bzhin dkyus ring mig gi zur mda' can/ /'jam mnyen nu 'bur gangs ri'i dpal 'dzin pa/ /rked phra sor mo'i gdub sil 'brol ba'i sgras/ /'od ldan yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog las ci/ /ring nas sbom por skyed bsrings stong po la//yal ga phang phung g.yo ba'i lo 'dab dbus//ro bda'i 'bras bu smin pa'i dpag bsam ljon//spyod pa'i mig mi 'dzum la lhag par smon//sngo 'jam dge ba'i byu chun po'i steng //skyil krung gcig gis mngon par byang chub ste/ /rtsod ldan 'gro 'dren tshul la chu skyes rnams/ /dga' ba'i 'dzum gyis phyogs der dgod pa bzhin//brgya pa'i bgrang byar 'khor lo rnam gsum gyi//'jigs bral seng ge'i nga ro'i sgra bsgrags tshe//lus med ce spyang dus min skad 'byin pa'i/snying de lkog mar bros kyang dum bur gas//rtsibs brgyad rab tu bkra ba zhabs kyi mthil//gtsug tu bkod pa'i ri mo byang chub bar//mngon sum gsal 'di dbyi bar 2draX po yis//bskal brgyar dka' thub blangs kyang

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (7cung zad ngal/ /pus mo'i lha nga sar btsugs lag pa zung / /snying gar sbyar te mgo bos phyag 'tshal na/ /srid zhi'i phun tsho gis dpal gyis 'jig rten gsum/ khyab pa'i dge legs deng 'dir stsal du gsol/ /zhes shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gis sngun bsus nas/(171ba/ro skol gyi ston pa grangs med pa'i bskal pa du ma nas sgrib gsum gyi 'ching rgya las rnam par grol te ma lus par spangs pa/ /chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis sngon du gyur nas yon tan mtha' dag la byang chub par mdzad pa'i mnyam med bu ram shing pas 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing du bla na med pa'i ye shes brnyes nas/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi gzugs sku mthar thug pa la g.yo ba med na'ang/ rgyud bla mar/ chos kyi sku las ma g.yos kyang / /sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tsho gis kyis/ /skye ba mngon par skye ba dang / /dga' ldan nas ni 'pho ba dang / /lhums su 'jug dang bltams pa dang / /bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang / /btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol pa dang / /nges 'byung dka' ba spyad pa dang / /byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang / /bdud sde bcoms dang rdzogs par ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /mya ngan 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/ /srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes gsungs pas thun mong ba'i sems can rnams kyi ched du dga' ldan gyi gnas su lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar por bstan pas rang gi cod pan mi pham mgon po'i dbu la bcings te/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ 'dzam bu gling ni chen po yi/ /dum bu bcu gnyis kyi ni dbus/ /zhes dang / 'dzam bu gling ni chung ngu 'dir/ /bdag ni shākya'i rigasarjes 'gro /zhes pa ltar rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i rigs su srid pa bzung ste ma ga dha rdo rje gdan gyi spor mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i rnam par (172na)rol pas 'dus pa rnam pa gsum la chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum du bskor zhing / gdul bya dbang po yang rab tu gyur pa rnams la nges gsang rdo rje theg pa'i smin grol gyi gdams pa rgya cher stsal ba sogs sdosnod gsum dang rgyud sdo bzhi'i gsung rab mtha' dag /ji skad du/ gang zhig don ldan chos dang nyer 'brel zhing / khams gsum kun nas nyon mongs spong byed la/ /zhi ba'i phan yon ston par mdzad pa gang / /de dag drang srong gsung yin ldog pa gzhan/ /—211—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shezhes dngos dang brgyud pa'i sgo nas gdul bya'i rgyud kyi nyen mongs pa sel ba dang zhi ba mya ngan las 'das pa'i go 'phang thob pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo dang yan lag gi tshul du gsungs pa sha stag yin la/ de yang 'dul mngon du gling gsum gyi skyes pa dang bud med rnams la so sor thar pa'i sdom pa skye bar bshad pas dam pa'i chos kyi snod yin kyang gtso bor/ rnam bzhag rim pa las/ shar gyi lus 'phags dang /nub kyi ba lang spyod dang / byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi mi rnams la longs spyod chen po dang ldan te/ de lta mod kyi blun cing rmongs pas mi spyod cing mi 'byed do/ /'dzam bu gling pa 'di ni las kyi sa pa yin te/ sogasanas/ 'on kyang 'go smos pas go ba dang / dbang po rno zhing bsgrin pa ste/ des na byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'dzam bu gling gi skye bo'i gnas kyi dbus su 'khrungs shing chos ston par 'gyur ro/ /zhes rgyal ba'i bstan pa la thos bsam sgom gsum gtso bo dar ba ni 'dzam bu gling yin la/ 'dzam gling yang /dpal (172bskon rgyud kyi 'jig rten khams ler/ gling nas zla ba 'od dkar can dang rab mchog ku sha dang ni mi'am ci dang khrung khrung dang / /drag po yang ni longs spyod sa steng bdun par 'dzam bu'i mi rnams gnas pa dag ni las kyi sa/ /zhes ri rab kyi ra'i 'og gi gling drug longs spyod kyi sa dang / bdun pa sa dum bu bcu gnyis la las kyi sa pa 'dzam gling chen por gsungs pa dang phyogs mthun par/bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs las bshad na'ang / mngon pa gong 'og gis mtsho ni pa'i gsung rab mang por lho phyogs kyi gling 'di la 'dzam bu gling du bshad pa'i thub pa'i bstan pa dar rgyas su gyur pa'i gling yang 'di nyid du ngos 'dzin cing / gling de la/ dus 'khor du/ 'phags yul bod li rgya nag dang / /kol sha dang gangs can che/ /zhes yul chen po drug tu bshad pa'i nang tshan/ 'du thab lung las/ mnyan yod gnas bcas tsam pa ka /wa ra ṇa gi yangs pa can/ /rgyal po'i khab dang drug po ste/ /'di dag grong khyer chen por grags/ /zhes grong khyer chen po drug gis mtsho ni pa'i 'phags yul ni/shar du li kha ra'i shing tshang ching can/ lhor chu klung 'dam bu can/ nub tu bram ze'i grong /ba dang nye ba'i ka ba/ byang du u shi ri'i ri'i sa mtshams dang 'khor rnam pa bzhi'i sdom rgyun sogs/ sa tshigs dang —212

sku gsung thugs rten gsar ba tshe ngas dang rin po che'i mchod jo khang bzang gi dkar chag rtogechos tshigs gnyis ka'i sgo nas yul dbus su grags par bka' bsdu rim pa gsum dang / shing rta chen po gnyis sogs paṇa grub mtha' klas pas bka' rnams 'chad nyan gyis gtan la phab cing /de'i dgongs 'grel gyi (173na tha stan bcos mang du mdzad nas bstan pa rin po che nyin mo ltar gyur pa las ri kha ba can gyi khrod du ji ltar dar ba'i tshul ni/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ nga yi dus nas lo brgya na/ kha ba can du mtsho bri nas/ /swā la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes bod yul 'di mtshosagang ba rim gyis bri nas nags dang mi'i 'gro ba 'byung bar bshad cing / de yang thugs rje chen po'i bka' 'bum sogs su spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol mas byin gyis brlabs pa'i spre'u dang brag srin mo 'dus pa las gdong dmar sha zan gyi phrug gu drug byung ba nas rim gyis 'phel ba rus chen bzhi'am mi'u gdung drug byung tshul dang / lo rgyus la lar rgyal po rū pa ti dpung bcas g.yul 'pham ste bud med kyi chas su zhugs nas ri kha ba can gyi khrod du 'ongs pa las mi'i 'gro ba 'phel bar bshad/ mkhas pa'i dbang po stag tshang pa sogs ni rgya gar gyis mtshon pa'i yul khams gzhan ltar bod yul du'ang thog ma nas lhan cig par bcud chags par bzhed pa sogs rnam grangs mtha' yas kyang / don du pur rgyal gyi rgyal khams 'di'i 'bangs kyi rje bo rgyal phran sil ma bcu drug sogs mang dag byung ba'i mthar phyag na pad+ma'i sprul pa gnya' khri btsan po mang pos bkur te rgyal por mnga' gsol ba nas bzung rgyal rabs nyer bdun gyi bar du rgyal srid sgrung dang bon gyis bskyangs shing / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo'i yul yongs su spyod par/ yul dbus nas lho phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro/ lho phyogs nas byang phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro/ /(173ba)byang phyogs nas byang phyogs su dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dam pa'i chos rgya gar nas rim gyis byang phyogs kha ba can du dar bar lung bstan pa ltar lha tho tho ri snyan shal gyi dus dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyengs/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga pa rje srong btsan sgam po'i dus dam chos kyi srol bstod/ de nas gdung rabs lnga pa lha sras khri srong lde'u btsan gyisamakhan slob gnyis dang / mkhas pa'i dbang po ka mā la shrī la sogs paṇa grub du ma spyan drangs shing /—213

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)lo paṇa la bsnyen bkur nas 'dul lung sher phyogs mdo sde sna tshogs kyi skor mang dag bsgyur zhing theg pa chen po gsang sngags ni bka' gnyan pas lkog chosasu mdzad par grags/ de nas dbon khri lde gtsug brtan gyis mes kyi dus bsgyur ba'i chos rnams skad gsar bcad kyi gtan la 'bebs pa'i bdag rkyen mdzad/ bstan pa phyi dar la yang sgruti dzña na shrī/ jo bo chen po mar me mdzad/ paṇa chen gha ya dha ra/ skasmi ra pa'i sdom brtson bsod snyomasapa chen po sogasapaṇa grub du ma dang / lo chen rin cen bzang po/ 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyis mtshon pa'i skad gnyis smra ba rgyu skar gyi 'phreng ba ltar spel legs su byon pa rnams kyis mdo rgyud kyi bka' dang dgongs 'grel zhus chen dang bsgyur bcos kyis bstan pa rin po cher byi dor mdzad pas/ khrus khang lo tsā ba'i gsung las/lar dusagasum rgyal ba'i thugs rje dang / /rgyal sras pad dkar zhabs drin las/ /bod kyi yul khams 'di nyid kyang / /'phags (174na)thul dang skal ba mnyam pa snyam/ /che'i/mtha' 'khob kyi rgyal khams 'di nyid du sngon rgya gar du bstan pa dar ba dang mtshungs pa'i bka' drin ni 'dzam gling gser gyisabakang kyang gzhal bar ga la nus/ bod 'dir 'gyur ro cog gi thub pa'i gsung rab kyi tshogs rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams nas nye bar bzung dam pa'i chos la rgyu mtshan shes nas dad pa thob pa'i rab tu byung ba dang khyim gyi bdag po 'byor ldan rnams kyis sgyu ma'i nor la snying po len pa'i ched du yi ger 'bri ba dang klog pa sogasargya cher dar ba yang / shesarab khri pa las/ rab 'byor de de bzhin no/ /ji skad smras pa de bzhin de/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de tshesabargyad dang / tshesabacu bzhi dang / bco lnga la shesarab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha rtan du byed pa dang / 'chad par byed pa na bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med/ grangs med/ tshad med/ bsam gyis mi khyab/ gzhal du med pa mang po dag bskyed par 'gyur zhing de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha rtan du byed pa dang / 'chad par byed na lha'i 'khor mdun du gnas par 'gyur ro/ /zhes dang / brgud stong pa las/ ko shi ka de lta bas na/ de ltar rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la mngon par —2/4—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag khomadad de rtogs shing mos la sems dang bas byang chub du sems bskyed nas lhag pa'i bsam pas nyan pa dang / 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub bar byed pa dang / rab tu 'don pa dang / ston pa dang / nye bar ston (174ba)pa dang / lung nod pa dang / kha ton du byed pa dang / gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par ston pa dang / zhes pa ltar lung nod pa gtso bor gsungs na'ang /mdo mangs kyi lung rgyun ches dkon pa chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen gro lung pa chen po sogs bstan pa rin po che gces par 'dzin pa'i dam pa du mas brtson pa chen po'i mthu las dkar cha'i zla ba ltar 'phel zhing / der ma zad 'dul lung sher phyogs rgyu dang bcasapa'ang bag ston gzhen tshul dang / bka' 'gyur ba shākya rgyal mtshan/ gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa kun mkhyen kun dga' rnam rgyal sogs bstan 'dzin du mas srol legs par bzung yang / dus kyi bskal pas 'jig rten gyi 'du bkod dang / brgya bshig stong 'gugs kyis mtshon pa'i rang don lhur len la bstan 'gro'i don du sgro 'dogs pa'i chu shing lta bu'i skye bos nor 'dzin dpal mo'i lto ba yongs su gtams te gal chung cho gel byas pas sngon dus dam pa rnams kyis dka' ba brgya phrag spyad pa'i mdzad pa rnams kyang bya lam rjes med du 'gro bar nye ba'i tshe/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi rigazugs gas dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag gnas gsar mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i 'phrin las kyi cha shas las dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i rgyal khams kun tu 'chad nyan gyis khyab par gzur gnas rnams dad pa'i dbyar mtsho ches cher 'phel bar snang mod/ gangs ri sngon por mthong ba'i log shes can dag sngon bsags las nyon gyi bag chags (175na)ga po'i mthu brtas pa la mtha' ma bkag pas/ legs bshad rin po che las/ las shugs sa bdas pa na/ /blo can log pa'i lam ngan 'gro /mu stegs byed kyi ston pa mchog /dbang phyug smyon pa'i brtul zhugasa'adzin/ /zhes pa'i don dang mtshungs par mngon/ skabs don/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brgyad stong pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis brlabs kyis glegs bam chen po la yi ge gsal zhing —215

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)rab tu gsal ba legs par bris te/ me tog dang / bdug pa dang / dri dang / 'phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza'/ gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / dril bu dang / ba dan dang / kho ra khor yug tu mar me'i 'phreng ba dang / mchod pa rnam pa mang pos bkur stir bya/ bla mar bya/ brjed par bya/mchod par bya/ ri mor bya/ bsnyen bkur bar bya ste/ kun dga' bo 'di ni nga'i rjes su bstan pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin 'di las thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /zhes shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i glegs bam yi ger bris te mchod pa byas par bsod nams gzhal du med pa 'byung bas mtshon te rgyal ba'i gsung rab mtha' dag la ri mor byas pa'i 'bras bu shes par nus shing / sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang ba gsum gyi mdzad pa'i nang nas/thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa chen pos/ mdzad pa kun las gsung gi ni/ /mdzad pa mchog yin de yang ni/ /(175ba tsher di nyid yin phyir mkhas pa yis/ /'di las sangs rgyas rjes dran byos/ /zhes gsung zhi mdzad pa gtso bor bshad pa'ang / tsho mes las/ thub rnams sdig pa chu yis mi bkru zhing / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gis mi sel la/ /nyid kyi rtogs pa gzhan la spo min te/ /chos nyid bden pa bstan pas grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes sems can gyi rgyud la bgos pa'i las nyon rnams dri ma chus bkru ba dang / tsher ma cha dpyad kyis dbyung ba lta bu ma yin par ma zad thugs rgyud kyi spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i yon tan rnams dngos po'i gtong len bzhin gzhan rgyud la spo nus pa min yang bden pa gnyis kyi rnam bzhag bka' stsal pa la brten nas grol par 'gyur bas na/ dpal ldan zla bas/ tha snyad bden pa thabs su gyur pa dang / /do dam bden pa thabs byung gyur pa yi/ /de gnyis rnam dbye gang gis mi shes pa/ /de ni rnam rtog log pa'i lam ngan zhugs/ /zhes pa'i shugs la/ de gnyis rnam dbye gang gis legs shes pa/ /de ni phyin ci ma log lam bzang zhugs/ /zhes yang ba ltar bden pa gnyis kyi khyad par tshul bzhin du shes pa la brten nas 'khor ba las grol bas thub pas gdul bya dbang rtul gyi rigs la bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos 'khor dang / de kho na nyid dang phyin drug gi spyod pa sngon —216

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhongs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shā'igoms kyi bag chags sad pa'i rigs la bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chos 'khor bstan nas/ de gnyis sgras zin la 'gal ba de spong gi lan 'khor lo (176na〉 ma'i dus bka' stsal bas rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i tshul 'di ma rtogs na thar pa thob par mi nus pas/ 'jug pa las/ slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyi lam las ni/ /phyi rol gyur la zhi ba'i thabs med do/ /de nyid kun rdzob don dam bden lasanyams/ /de las nyams pas thar pa thob yod min/ /zhes gzhus phyi mo'i dbu ma pa 'phags pa yab sras kyi bzhed pa'i dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa rtogs pa gal che na'ang / de tsam gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa thob par mi nus pas bsam pa byang chub tu sems bskyed/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa ston pa sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa la bslab pa'i thabs shes zung du 'brel dgos pa'i phyir/ma pham pas/ theg mchog la mos sa bon shes rab ni/ /sangs rgyas chos bskyed ma dang bsam gtan gyi/ /bde ba'i mngal gnas snying rje'i ma ma can/ /gang yin de dag thub pa'i rjes skyes sras/ /zhes byung ba ltar sde snod gsum gyi brjod bya'i snying po 'di wo yin na'ang/ drang nges kyi bka' thams cad kyi nang nas la la byang chub thob pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo dang / 'ga' zhig de'i yan lag ste mtha' dag mi 'gal bar sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs gdams par shar dgos pas/ ji skad du/ /bstan pa thams cad 'gal med rtogs pa dang / /gsung rab ma lus gdams par shar ba dang / /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bde blag rnyed pa dang / /nyes spyod chen po'i g.yang sa las kyang bsrung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur (17ba kho cog la 'bri klog kha ton mchod par byas pa ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bya ba byas par 'gyur zhing / sangs rgyas ni/ rigs pa'i dbang phyug gis/ tsan+dan ste'ur mtshudas pa la/ /chags bral zhes su brjod pa yin/ /zhes g.yas nas tsan+dan gyis byugs pa dang / g.yon nas ste'u 'phyar te brdeg par brtsams pa gnyis la chags sdang gi rtog pa mi mnga' bas 'dis nga la bya ba byas so dgongs pa'i chags pa med kyang thugs rje r+ṣa po'i 'jug pa dus las mi yol ba chos nyid de/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu bems po la legs nyes kyi rtog dpyod med kyang gsol ba btab pas re 'bras grub —217

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shepa'i phyir na/ sangs rgyas rma ga chad las/ ji ltar nor bu rin cen bsam pa kun bsten pa/ /gang rnams ci 'dod de la de dag thams cad 'byin/ /de ni bsod nams gang gis byas pa des mthong ste/ /rin cen dam pa de la rnam rtog gang yang med/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas bde gshegs sku mchog bsam pa kun skong ba/ /mthong nas smon lam su 'debs de dag bsam pa 'grub/ /snying ring dma' ba'i sems ldan 'gro bas thub mi mthong / /bde gshegs rnam rtog mi mnga' ser sna mi mnga' 'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yul khyad par can la brten nas tshogs bsags pa'i phan yon ni/ /thub pas bdud bcoms nas mngon par sangs rgyas ma thag tu/ /bsod nams rnam smin bde de sdug bsngal thams cad sel/ /bsod nams (177na tshe ldan pa'i mi yi bsam pa rnams kyang 'grub/ /bdud bcoms nas ni byang chub bar du reg par 'gyur/ /mya ngan las 'das zhi ba bsil ba'i dngos po thob/ khes dang / rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing las/ /rab rtsub mya ngam du gsal 'khor ba'i lam ni shin tu gdung ba 'dir/ /rtag par rjes su gdung ldan sdig pa sdig pa bor zhig skye bo dag /rtag tu bsod nams mdzod cig bsod nams brten pa rnam dag gi /bsod nams bdud rtsis bran pa'i bsod nams grib bsil shing gi sa gzhi bsil/ /zhes gsungs rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa las 'byung bar dgongs te/'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā bas/ sngon kyang 'di bzhin byas rnams bde/ /da lta na yang bde bar mthong / /gtan tshigs bzang po 'di yis ni/ /ma 'ongs dus su'ang phun tshogs 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar sa skyong blo bzang sbyin pas khur bzhes nas khams stod sho pa mdo lhun grub mi 'gyur rab brtan du thub gsung glegs bam brgya phrag tu brgyal ba bzhengs pa'i do dam 'jun pa cha dkar ba gnyis kyis byas pa'i legs byas kyi 'bras bu nam yang bslu ba med pa ni/ mdo las/ 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i dpag bsam ljon pa de/ /bsod nams yin pas lha yi yul du smin/ zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa bzhin no/ /legs ldan dbyid kyi bu mo bzhin dngom tshe/ /dbyar skyes gzhen nu'i brtan pa 'phrog pa (177bskor/ /rgyu 'bras mi bslur nges pa tshul gsum po/ /tshang ba'i gtan tshigs 'di ko gang gis 'gog /kun la —218

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mchags snang bral ba btang snyoms gzhin/byams brtse'i brlan gyis sems bskyed snga tha la//'jam mnyen bdud snying rtsub des ris med kyi//mgon du zhal 'tshe'i dam bca' gang du thal//slo bur zug rngu skyed byed ro nus sman//zhu rjes nad brgya bkru ba'i chog bzhin//gcig tu chu srin rgyal mtshan sder bcas la//rjes chags byang chen la sbyor 'phrul po che//'dir snang zhing sar mi mngon sa bon tshogs//bsngo smon gsher drod kyis bskyes myu gu'i rtser//bde skyid gos bu dud la skye ba kun//spyod pa'i skal pa bzang por 'gyur bar shog/yangs pa'i 'jig rten nya phyis khog pa mā/zhwa ser chos srid phyur spungs mu thi laḥ//lus can yongs kyi srid mtshor rgyan 'phreng du//bskal pa'i dar gyi srad bur rtag brgyu shog/khrimasaganyis gser gyi gnya' shing mnga' 'bangs kyi//phrag par rab lci nor 'dzin skyong ba'i rje/sku tshe dbang thang dar drag grib bsil du//'gro rnams bde ba'i ngal gsor longs spyod shog/thub gsung 'di bskrun byed por rtags kun gyis//nyer mtshon nam mkha'i ska rags ring pos kyang //'ching bar nusamin mar gyur yin no cog/byang chen thob rgyur dge ba'i tshigs rnams bsngo//zhes smon lam che brjod dang bcas pa 'di ni sa skyong blo bzang sbyin pa'i gsung gis bskul ba la brten nas za hor gyi ban+de tshangs sras bko pa'i rdo rjes dmar ser can gyi lo glu dbyangs kyi zla ba'i dbyangs o 'char ba'i tshes la rgyal khab dmar po rir sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni 'phyong rgyas bsam mthong ngag rig phun tshogs dbang pos bgyis pa dza yas//ldeb sbyor mnyam pa'i brit+ta las me rtag g.yo ba'i 'khri shing /kā pa ga bas re na tan su ra pra se:yaḥbh+yoPROBhādi ba na ya ya de khā sto ( t+ta duḥd rgya lu〉shī bha ga ba nu ta re ya rdo karmār+shakā tsā gro ba dzñā yu(tre par tig mā lo kan sdoḥyasmo/thugs rje'i zla gzugs 'gro rgyud dang mtshor bra phab ji bzhin mngon sum du//'char la brtse chen dkyus ring spyan zur mkha' mtha' brgal des yol med pas//lus can sna tshogs mos ngor rjes 'jug gang 'dul 'phrin las dkyil 'khor cha//'phel 'grib dang bral mchog gsum gzi yis 'jig rten kun snang dga' ston stsol//sgrib gsum zug rngu'i 'a/nga rgya bkrol ba'i zhar//bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i gdung

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogesel sman gyi blar//srid zhi yongs kyi skyabs song btud pa'i gtsug/zhabs rdul 'khor lo'i ri mo thakhrig tu gsal//las nyon gyis bskyed mi mnyam 'du 'khrug nad//gzhil la tshangs pa mgrin sngon 'khor lo'i lag/lha dang phyi nang drang srong tshe'i rig byed//'dzin rnams bkra 174skos me tog char du snyil//nyi bu'i mche phrag phyogs pa'i phyugs srog kyang //ldog par rig na dal rten ring 'tsho ba//brtson pa'i bsod nams gru rdzings la brten nas//thar pa'i rin cen gling du bgrod min su//ma byas mi 'phrad gang bsags chud mi 'dzad//tshad ma'i bka' dang dpang gyur gzhung lugs bzhin//rnam smin ches dkar 'bras bu'i ro myong ba'i//bden gtam rlung bskur ma yin su zhig bsnyen//chung ngu'i blo gros rmig pa'i khung bu sa/phra mo'i yon to nyal 'gros khengs min pa//mkhyen dpyod rab rgyas zla ba'i ma ma'i 'jing //gtsug lag bye ba'i chu gnyer mi dog yangs//lto 'gror ma gi ta bzhin phyogs lhung snying //ma rungs yang po'i gdon gyis ma btab pa'i//gzur gnas blo yi legs bshad bang mdzod kyi//yid bzhin gtam gyis phyur bur spungs 'di long /de yang 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu mkhas pa'i dbang po dpang lo tsā bas/rgyal ba'i sras kyi shes bya thams cad la//bslab par gsungs phyir ji snyed mkhyen pa yi//ye shes rgyu ru 'gyur bas shes ldan rnams//byang chub don gnyer bsam pas 'dir blang rigs/zhes dang /khrus khang lo tsā ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sdes/de phyir kun mkhyen lam don gnyer ba yis//phyogs lhung med pa'i yid kyis thos pa btsal//zhes thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'dasas rgyal ba'i sras po rnams kyis mi bslab pa'i gnas ni gang yang med cing dgos pa'ang rang gzhan gyi don gnyis sgrub pa la bla na med pa'i byang chub mngon du byed 179na rko gos shing chos thams cad thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa ni la la rgyu'i gtso bo dang /'ga' zhig yan lag tu 'gyur ba'i phyir blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis dang du blang bya yin la/de'ang shes bya ji lta ji snyed kyi gnas mtha' dag gzigs pa ni 'phags chen dam pa rnams kyi spyod yul yin la/rang cag tshur mthong gi skye bo rnamasakyis ji tsam rtogs pa rig pa'i gnas chen bco ba/da sogs ngos 'dzin gyi khyad par rgya che chung rnam

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shāmigrangs mtha' yas kyang snying por dril na ma pham pas mdo sde rgyan du gsungs pa dang mas par/'jam mgon sa
