skya paṇ+ḍita sa/gangs ri'i khrod kyi blo gsal kun 'dus kyang //rig pa'i gnas lnga kun la blos mi lcogs//mkha' la rgyu skar bye ba'i 'od 'khrigs kyang //tsha zer byed po'i 'phrin las 'grub par dka'//'on kyang las kyi 'phro 'du mi bzad pas//snyigs ma'i dus 'dir gangs ri'i khrod du skyes//'on kyang sngon gyi bag chags mthu pas/shes bya phal cher 'bad pa chung ngus shes//zhes dang /sabazang ma ti paṇa chen gyis/kun mkhyen thob par 'dod rnams kyis//rig pa'i gnas lnga shes bya ste//zhes gsungs pa'i gnas lnga po ni/ rin spungs sa spyod dbang po ngag dbang 'jig rten dbang phyug gragasapa'i rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sa paṇa gyi rnam thar sa rgya bcu gnyis mar/sgra dang 3 ma'i rig pa gtum posalta ngan ma lus shes bya'i dbyings su bsad//bzo dang gsob rjes su 'dzin pa'i phan pa mngon sum 179ba ) nyid du yang dag rgyu//chos kyi dra ba sdom pa'i nang gi de nyid smra ba kun gyi rgyal po che//lnga rig mkhas dang grub pa'i 'khor lo dus gsum sgyur ba rnams la dang bas bstod//ces log smra tshar gcod pa sgra dang tshad ma/gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa bzo dang gso ba/rang nyid kun shes par bya ba nang rig pa ste/rig gnas lngar bshad pa'i nang tshan gso ba rig pa ni/mkhas mchog dpa' bos/tshe ni ring bar 'dod pa yis//chos dang nor dang bde ba sgrub//tshe yi rig byed lung skad pa//sgo tu gus par bya bar gyis/zhes dang /rig gnas kun shes las/'gro kun lus nad sna tshogs kyis gzir phyir//gsod bya da don du miganyer srid mtha' tsam de phyir rig gnas gnyi di nyid ni don gnyer // sa pa 'a nyad // rjes su 'dzin pa'i mchog tu grub//ces thog ma med pa nas nyon mongs pa dug lngas gzir cing nag po'i las ches cher brtsegs pa'i 'bras bu 'du ba rnam bzhi 'khrugs pa'i nad bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi la mjug don yongs gtad las/nad la bzhi brgya rtsabazhin grags pa la//brgya dang rtsa gcig ltar snang gol gya nad//ma bcos rang gar bzhag pas 'tsho ba yod//'on kyang yos na myur du bde ba ster//dper na 'gyel bub lag nas 'then pa 'dra//dang 2po sngon tshul che bar byung gyur kyang //ma bcos rang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shegar lam nas bzlog pa yod//dper na mkha' la sprin 'thibs char 'bab pa//glo bur sangs nas than par 'gyur ba 'dra//brgya dang rtsa gcig kun brtags gdon yin 180na ) pas//de ma bcos par sman dpyad len mi 'dod//gdon bcos sman med gyur kyang 'tsho ba yod//dper na dpung pa g.yar ba'i bsdun bu 'dra//brgya dang rtsa gcig yongs grub tshe yi nad//ma btsos cha la bcos na 'tshob yod//de yang dang po bar dang tha ma gsum//tsha ba'i sngon tshul lam nas mi zlog pa//gnyen po grogs kyisalen du mi ster phyir//stobs chung grogs med gsar dus mi zlog med//bar du nad rgyas gnyen pos cho mes pa dka'//dper na shwa yi gdong du rags brtsigs pa//zhan la khyer yang zhan la mnan pa yis//chu shugs zad nas rags kyis thub par snang //de bzhin nad rgyas gnyen po 'thabs pa yis mi choms 'dra yang bstud na nus pa thob//grang rgyas ba gar+sā pos choms dka' ste//go mas bcasapa'i tshong pa dpung bcas 'dra//brgya dang rtsa gcig gzhan dbang sngon gyi las//bcos kyang mi thub 'chi ba'i nad yin pas//de yang bsdu na srog bcod nad dgur 'dus//tsha ba la la bzlas dang ma bzlasaganyis//dper na me long thab tu bcug pa 'dra//ma zhu chus sleb zhu nas des mi zlog/grang ba gting nas 'khar dang mi 'khar gnyis//dper na sdum bu dang ni sdong rgan 'dra//dang po tshos bla gnyis pa tshos mi 'gyur//rlung nad srog rten chad dang ma chad gnyis//dper na skon pa nang gi bya dang 'dra//ma shor zin la shor na zin thabs med//zungs zad nad la de srog gnas pa ste//nad bcom gyur na srog kyang 'jig pa'i phyir//dper na rmang gis ma thub rtsig 80ba pa 'dra//rnam par 'tshe ba gdon gyis bla khyer ba//'tsho ba 'dra yang nges par 'chi ba ste//dper na rgyu ma phug pa'i mi dang 'dra//'tsho ba'i tshe las bsod nams gsum zad pa//nad grol rtsa shor 'byung ba 'gag pa'i phyir//dper na nam gzhug chad pa'i char pa 'dra//gshed du babs pa tsha grang gnyis 'doms pas//gcig bcos gcig skye gnyen po kun mi len//dper na thag chod mi la gros 'debs 'dra//sbyor ba mtshudas pa rgyu rkyen gnyis po log/gang bcos grogs kyi thog tu bab pa ste//dugazin mi la btsan dug blud pa 'dra//gnad du babs

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag khu'ipa srog gnas bcom pa ste/ /srog rtsa chad pa bcos thabs ci la rnyed/ /gros kha btsan po dgra la shor ba 'dra/ /drang srong chen po the tshom skye mi rung / /gso byas ma byas mnyam por bya mi rigs/ /'tsho 'chi kun la sman yod ma yin te/ /kun tu sman med ces smra de ma yin/ /me steng chu slug mi gsod ga la srid/ /de yang sman na sod pa na tu dka'/ /rtsam pas ltogs pa mi sel ga la srid/ /chu yis skom pa mi sel ga la srid/ /gag lhog gso ba med par su bder 'gyur/ /chu 'gags sman dpyad med par ci la thon/ /gnyen po med par dug za su yis nus/ /mchog sogs nus pa lung las grags ba'i na sel/ /de phyir gso ba the tshom bcas ma bya/ /zhes ma bcos kyang 'tsho ba/ gdon bcos pas 'tsho ba/ bcos na 'tsho la ma bcos na mi 'tsho ba/ /bcos kyang mi 'tsho ba ste mu bzhin gsungs pa'i sman dpyad sogs (181na)kyis 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa las grol bar byed pa'i tshul 'dis skye rgu kun la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa rlabs po ches gzhan phan gyi thabs rgyal ba'i sras kyi spyod pa'i yan lag tu nges par 'gyur ba shes ldan rnams kyis gcig tu gzhol ba'i gnas yin la/ de'ang lha las dar ba ni/ ji skad du/ snyan tshig mchod sbyin srid srungs dang / /nges brjod rig byed bzhi zhes bya/ /bslab dang brda sprod sdeb sbyor dang / /de bzhi skar rtsis thos pa dang / /rtog pa dang ni yan lag go /dran pa dang ni chos dang bcas/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar yan lag drug /nye ba'i yan lag gnyas dang bcas pa kun kyang mes po'i 'kha bzhi las byung ba'i rgyu mtshan/ gang phyir tshangs pa yi ni zhal/ /dbus ma nas ni tshe'i rig byed/ /snyan tshig nges brjod mchod sbyin rnams/ /zhal gzhan nas ni gsung ba mdzad/ /ces pas shes nus shing rig byed de'ang sus kyang ma byas pas rtag pa/ bya rtsol rgyas ma bslad par rang byung / thams cad brjod du rung bas tshad ma yin pa zhig tu ngos 'dzin la/ kun shes las/ sgra gcan 'khor los tshangs pa'i dpyal ba snang / /de yi rkyen gyis tshe yi rig byed dran/ /skye rgu'i bdag la bshad cing de yis kyang / /tha skar bu gnyis brgya byin la sogs pa/ /zhes pa'i don ltar/ slob dpon shes rab go chas mdzad pa'i lha las phul byung gi 'grel par/ de yang 'di skad thos te tshangs pas bskos pa'i phyogs gcig na lha gnas/—223

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya ma gsung 'bum/ (2she wa phyogs gcig na ni lha ma yin rnams 'dug (181bskos/ ri bo man+da ra'i steng nas ni khyab 'jug gisabazung / klu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyis srub thag byas/ 'og nas ni rus sbal gyi rgyab kyis brten te 'o ma can gyi rgya mtsho chen po bsrubs par 'gyur to/ /de nas shin tu 'jigs su rung ba'i dug gi skyes bu nag po brtsegs pa zhes bya ba zhig byung bar 'gyur pa dang / de khyab 'jug gis mid par gyur ba na dran pa gtor te sa la 'gyel nas cang mi smra bar gnas pa dang / lha chen pos de las drangs te mgrin par bzhag par gyur to/ /des de'i mgrin pa sngon por gyur to/ /de nas zla ba tshes pa byung na lha chen posablangs te mgo la bzhag go /de nas dpal mo zhes bya ba byung ste/ des rang nyid sa khyab 'jug blangs nas 'dus so/ /de'i 'og tu rta mgrin ring dang / shing yongs 'du sa brtol la sogs pa byung ste/ de dag ni brgya byin la sogs pa lha gzhan rnams kyis ci rigs par khyer ro/ /de nas bud med shin tu yid du 'ong ba zhig byung ba dang de la khyed su yin zhes dris pa na nga ni chang zhes bya ste 'thungs na myos pa dang /brgyal ba dang dregs pa la sogs pa'i rnam par 'gyur ba 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pa dang /lha ma yin rnams 'jigs nas ma 'thungs pa na lha ma yin zhes bya bar 'gyur/ lha rnams kyi 'thungasapas ni lha zhes bya bar gyur te/ de nas de'i 'og tu bdud rtsi byung ba na snod chen po brgyad gang ba lha ma yin rnams kyis khyer bar gyur pa las lha rnams shin tu yid mug nas khyab 'jug gis shin tu yid (182na)du 'ong zhing gzugs bzang ba'i bud med kyi gzugs su bsgyur te song zhing brgya byin gyis kyang mi snang ba'i gzugs kyi nam mkha' la 'dug go /de'i tshe lha ma yin rnams kyis 'di ni kho bo cag gi bud med yin no snyam nas bdud rtsi'i srung mar bzhag ste rang nyid rnams khrus la song ngo / /de'ang chos kyi bstan bcos las/ ma bkrus dri ma sbyong gyur bas/ khrus ma byas par zas mi za/ /zhes smos pa'i don gyis de dag khrus la song ngo / /skabs der khyab 'jug dang brgya byin gyis bdud rtsi ba nus nas brgya byin gyi khang par khyer ro/ /de rnams khrus byas nas slar log pa dang / bdud rtsi ma mthong nas de 'tshol ba la brtson pa na lha rnams kyis khyer ro/ zhes thos nas lha rnams steng du 'gro ba na bden no snyam mo/ /de'i —224

sku gsung thugs rten gsar ba tshe ngas dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mtshe lha rnams bdud rtsi la longs spyod pa'i phyir 'dus pa na sgra gcan zin lha'i cha lugs su bsgyur te der zhugs pas/ bdud rtsi'i skal ba thob pa dang de nyi mas mthong ste khyab 'jug la sbran nas 'di ni sgra gcan zin no zhes smras pa dang / de'i 'khor los mgo bcad par gyur la/ 'on kyang bdud rtsi la longs spyad cing lhags pa'i mgo bo ni deng sang na'ang gsal la/ lus lhag ma ni shi bar gyur to/ /de nas sgra gcan zin dang nyi ma zhe 'gras par gyur pas gang gis nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'gebs shing sgrib par byed pa yin no/ /zhes gtam du grags so/ /zhes pa ltar bskal ba rdzogs ldan gyi mjug tu khams kyi zas rag pa zas pa la brten nas ma zhu ba sogs nad byung ba'i dus der gnas ri (182ba)rab kyi rtse mor 'chi med gyi bdud rtsi lha ma yin sgra gcan zin gyis rku thabs kyis btungs par khyab 'jug gi lag na zho 'thung gi rus pa las bi shwa ga mes bzos pa'i nyi ma bdar ba'i 'khor lo yong ba de 'phangs pas sgra gcan gyi mgrin pa bcad kyang bdud rtsi'i mthus ma shi bar phyir 'phangs pasatshangs pa'i dbral ba'am mkhur tshos la rma byung ba'i zug rngu drag po mi bzod pas ring zhig brgyal ba bsos/ dran pa rnyed nas phan thabs bsam pas sngon sangs rgyas shig la sman gyi rgyud thos pas rkyen byas/ rma nang nas tshe'i rig byed kyi thog ma oṃ a tha zhes bya ba thon pa la brten nas tshe'i rig byed sogs rig byed bzhi yan lag dang bcas pa byung ba/ zla zer las/ yi ge oṃ dang a tha'i sgra/ /gnyis po 'di dag sngon tshangs pa'i/ /mkhur tshos brtol nas byung ba ste/ /des na 'di dag ba po shis yin/ /zhes bshad cing / bklag pa'i tshe yang nges brjod kyi rig byed kyi oṃ/ snyan ngag gi u/ srid srung gi e/mchod sbyin gyi ā ste/ de bzhi po'i tshad du 'don dgos par bzhed/ a bsrung ba la ste skyod pa la'o zhesapa'i byings bzhag /ba'i srog gi a brjod don/ ma ni nu 'os ma ni nu byin/ in rjes 'brel/ a ba ti'i mtha' dbyi'os/ ma'i srog dang na dbyi tsha ba dag gi lnga pa la sha tā ṭā 'os/ bra/ ā ṭa sa shi bi i bi ma bi dz+wa ri twa ra rnams kyi dngos u paṅgā'i a'ang riṭa/ a yig las ṭa'i 'phel ba 'os/ ṭa gnyisaphyis/ tā mtshungs 'dra/ nā mi mtha'i byings dang sogs kyi yon tan/ ma da ror byas pas oṃ (183na)—225

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she'agrub pas srung ba'i don la 'jug /rdo rje rtse mo las/ oṃ ni ci zhig yin par bshad/ /mchog dang nor gter dpal dang g.yang / /skal bzang rnam pa dang ldan zhing / /dam bca' pa dang bkra shis don/ /nor bu 'dzin pa'i snying po yin/ /zhes bkra shis pa sogs don mang po la 'jug par gsungs/ thar pa lo tsā bas bsgyur ba'i nyi ma'i mdor/ lha'i bu nyi mas bcom ldan 'das rjes su dran pa yid la byas te/ de'i dus su tshigs su bcad pa 'di gsol to/ /sangs rgyas dpa' bo de la 'dud/ /thams cad myur du sgrol bar gyis/ /bdag 'di'i kha ru bcug pas na/ /bdag ni khyed la skyabs su mchi/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i bu nyi ma'i ched du lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan 'dzin la tshigs su bcad pa bka' stsal pa/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten la brtse ba/ /dgra bcom de bzhin gshegs pa la/ /nyi ma skyabs su song bsan/ /sgra gcan 'dzin gyis nyi ma thong / /gang zhig mun pa snang bas gsal bar byed/ /rnam snang drag po'i gzi brjid dkyil 'khor can/ /nam mkha'i nyi ma sgra gcan sgrib ma byed/ /nyi ma 'di ni sgra gcan gyis thong zhig /ces dang / zla ba'i mdor yang zhu ba zhu lan 'di dang dbyibs 'dra ba yod pa sgra gcan gyis bdud rtsi brkus pa zla bas bya btang ba'i 'khon 'dzin gyis bco lnga'i dus zin pa'i 'jigs skyob de bzhin gshegs par zhus par bshad cing / gnam stong du nyi ma sgrib pa'am gtso bor zla bar yin rung lhan cig tu gnas pa'i (183ba)dbang las yin pa lo rgyus la lar byung ba thun mong ba'i gdul bya'i snang ngor tsam ste don nyi zla khams kyi dwangs ma'i rnam par sgra gcan bar srid kyi tshul du sbyor zhing / go la'i rgyu lam du chu shel dang me shel gyi dkyil 'khor shin tu dwangs pa'i steng du gdong mjug nor bu be+e ḍūrla 'a mdangs can steng nas phog pa'i grib ma las gnod pa byas pa'i tha snyad med cing ( tī sgra gcan dang ro rkyang nyi zla byas nas phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi sbyor tshul dang po'i sangs rgyas gsungs/ der ma zad sman pa la snga ba tshangs pa/ sman la snga ba chu skol/ nad pa la snga ba shed bu/ nad la snga ba ma la ju ba thong zhes grags/ mes pos skye rgu'i bdag po zhes pa tshangs pa gnyis pa zhig la bstan/des tha skar gyi bu gnyis zhes pa sngon gyi rgyal po skya seng gi bu lngar grags pa'i 'thab brtan chos kyi bu/—226

sku gsung thugs rten gsar tshongs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga (ma'ajigs sde rlud gi bu/srid sgrub dbang po'i bu/ris med lhar bcas gnyis te lnga'i nang nas tha ma gnyis tha skar gyi bu yin pa la bshad/de gnyis kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la bstan pa las rgya cher 'phel lo//lha yul du ma zad 'gro ba mi la dar rgyas su gyur pa bskal pa bzang po 'di la mtshon na sangs rgyas 'khor ba 'jig gi bstan pa la sangs rgyas kyi bka' stsal pa dang gzhan dag gis bshad pa sogs med pa'i mtha' ma bkag kyang ding sang 'di'o zhes gsal bar brjod pa'i skabs ma 'tshal zhing /kun shes las/thub pa'i dbang pos rgya gar lho phyogs su//tshangs pas zhus ngor tshe yi rig byed kyi//sman rgyud 'bum phrag gsungs pa mkhas la grags//184na gi 'an yang rgyud sdebazhi dang dus 'khor lo//sman gzhi'i lung dang gser 'od sogs su'ang gsungs//zhes pa ltar/'o skol gyi ston pa shākya seng ges 'khor lo dang po'i dus su dge slong nad pas ni sman pa la dris te bya'o//zhes pa lta bu'i 'phros la brten nas 'dul ba lung gi dum bu gsum par sman dang mas btang ba'i dpyad la sogs pa nyung ngu tsam zhig bshad cing gtso bor smos pa ni/bcom ldan 'das mgon med zas sbyin gyi tso dga' ra ba na bzhugs pa' tshe dge slong rnams ston da'i bro nad kyi skya bo seng seng por gyur pa'i tshe sman so sor bsten par gsungs kyang dus su ma gtogs de las yol bar mi bsten pas skya bor gyur pa la/kun dga' bo de lta bas na rjes su gnang ste/dge slong rnams kyi sman rnam pa bzhi po dus su rung ba dang /thun tshod du rung ba dang /sa bdun pa dang /ji srid 'tsho bar du yong ba so sor bsten par bya'o//de la dus su bco ba ni lde gu dang /'bras ho dang zan dron dang /sha dang /snum khur ro/thun tshod du rung ba ni gas ba rnam pa brgyad po shing tog tso ༅ gas ba dang /chu shing gi gos bu'i gas ba dang /rgya shug gi gas ba dang /a shwa tso btung ba dang /u dum wā ra'i gas ba dang /sa ru sha ga'i bco ba dang /rgun 'bru'i gas ba dang /lā go'i btung ba'o//zhag bdun pa ni mar dkar dang /til mar dang /bus gyi dbu ba dang /sbrang rtsi dang /sha kha ra'o//'tsho ba'i bar du lang ba ni rtsa ba'i 184bskyon dang /sdong po'i sman dang /rdo ༷'i sman dang /me kho gi sman dang /sti'i sman

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedang / thang chu'i sman lnga dang / thal ba lnga dang / lan tsha lnga dang / bska ba lnga'o/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa byin gyis brlab tshul dang bcas te bka' stsal/ 'khor lo bar pa'i dus su lha chen po tshangs pa la gcer mthong rig pa'i rgyud chen po le'u sum stong lnga brgya pa'am gso dpyad 'bum par grags pa gsungs shing / la lar kun dga' bo dang be ta'i yul du shā ri'i bu la stsal zer ba snang / 'khor lo tha ma'i dus su tshong dpon gyi bu chu 'bebs la mdo sde gser 'od dam pa bka' stsal pa la/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum 'gyur pa'i 'bring por/ zla gsum dbyar te zla gsum ston du shes/ /zhes sogs blo ka dgu dang / rgya nag 'gyur du de bzhin gshegs pa khye'u chu 'bebs su zhakhrungs pa'i tshe rang gi yab las byung ba rnams bskyar ba'i tshul gyi gsungs pa dang / mdo sde myang 'das su grong khyer zhig na rgyal po dang sman pa gnyis ka shes rab 'chal ba 'o ma kho na sman du bzung bas skye bo mang po'i srog 'phrog pa na yul gzhan nas sman pa tshe'i rig byed yan lag la mkhas pa zhig gis thabs kyi sgo nas sman pa de bskrad pa dper mdzad nas chos bstan/ des mtsho ni nas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las/ 'das pa'i dus su sngon byung ba'i/ /bde chen bskal pa dang po sa /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag dang der/ /lhag pa yi ni lha gcig zhu/ grub pa lha min mi ma yin/ /lha tsho gos kyis kyang mthong nas skrag /sangs rgyas (185na)thams cad 'dus pa yi/ /bdag ni myur du bskul bar byed/ /byang chub sems gyur lha chen po/ / bdud rnams kun nas zil mnan byas/ /thams cad de yis rmonges par byed/ /dngul chu zhes ni bshad pa yin/ /zhes dngul chu sogs bcud len gyi sbyor ba dang / g.yin yang gsog ldang zhi gsum rags pa tsam gsungs/ dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi bsdus pa'i rgyud du/ lus 'di la ni khams kyi tshogasarnams mtha' dag ro drug zos shing 'thungs pa las/ /zhes sogs lus chags tshul dang / rlung 'joms lan tsha skyur ba dag tu rab tu 'gyur te mngar dang bska ba dang ni mkhris pa'i dgra /bad kun 'jomasapas kha ba kun dang de bzhin tsha ba dag kyang sman rnams sam ni khu ba'am/ /bad gan 'joms pa ra yi 'o ma tsha ba gsum bcas dag ni ma he'i 'o ma mkhris pa'i dgra/ /rlung 'joms dag kyang lnga mo'i 'o ma —228

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (marnam gsum nad 'phrog pa yi 'o ma dang ni de bzhin mar/ /dzā ti bskol ba'i chu ni bro bas kha nad zhi bar byed de so yi zug rngu nyid kyang ngo / /til mar dngos po'i chus bskol tsha ba gsum dang lan tsha dag gis rna ba yi ni nad dag 'joms/ /mar dang 'o ma bskol bar gyur pa klu dang dmar po dag gis rtag tu sna yi nad dag 'joms/ /ka rko ṭi dang laṅga li dang in+d+ra bong bu'i chur bcas byugs pas gos kyi 'phreng ba 'phrog /ces sogs phyi nang gi sman bsten tshul sna tshogs yum dkar mor brten nas rdo rje'i tsher ma gzhil srung / 'chi ltas/ rin cen sbyor ba/ (185ba)bla gnas kyi 'pho tshul sogs kyang 'dod pa'i bstan bcos/ ro brjod pa'i gzhung / srid srung sogs rig byed rnams dang sgo bstun nas gsungasapas shes nus shing / kun shes las/ lha yi drang srong rnams la brgyud nas ni/ /zhes phyi nang gi ston pa g.yin dag gis bshad pa brgya byin la skya seng gi bu ltar pha lha'i drang srong rgyun shes sogs bu bdun/ma ma'i bud med la brten nas rgyun shes kyi bu sogs kyis rgyud la 'jug pa'i 'grel pa rgya che ba re brtsams/ de dag gi slob ma drang srong lug nag sogs dang sha le ho tra rnams kyis kyang gso ba rig pa'i gzhung ji snyed cig mdzad pa rdo 'jog gi sman pa rgyun shes kyi bu'i bar du byung bar grags/ sman gyi grong khyer lta na sdug tu don kun grub pas ston pa sman gyi bla'i rnam par bstan te bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag rgyud bka' stsal pa'i mjug don yongs gtad du/ bde gshegs rnams kyis sprul pas 'gro don du/ /rgya gar yul du sman gyi sbyor ba gsungs/ /rgya nag yul du me btsa' rtsa sbyongs gsungs/ /dol po'i yul du gtar kha gtso bor bstan/ /bod kyi yul du rtsa chu'i brtag pa bstan/ /lha yi 'khor lagasodapyad 'bum pa gsungs/ /drang srong 'khor la tsa ra ka sdebargyad/ /mu stegasa'akhor la dbang phyug nag po'i rgyud/ /nang pa'i 'khor la rigs gsum mgon po'i skor/ /gsodapyad rgyud 'dir thams cad 'dus par bstan/ /'dir ma 'dus pa'i gso dpyad gzhan med de/ /'phags pa'i thugs rje phyogs ris med mod kyang / /(186na skong zag mos pa'i mthong snang so sor shar/ /dper na mkha' la zla ba gcig shar na/ /chu yi skyogs rer zla ba re re bzhin/ /gcig tu gsungs kyang —229

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)so sos du mar go /zhes gong du smos pa'i phyi nang drang srong gi tshe'i rig byed kyi gzhung gi rtsa ba kun ston pa nyid kyi gang la gang 'dul gyi skur sprul nas phal cher bstan pas sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshad rang cag so skye rnams kyis gzhal bar mi nus shing brjod pa'i gnas ma yin la/ de'ang kun shes las/ ston pa bzhugs dus rgyal po pad+ma yi/ /snying po che kha/bya'i yul ljongasardo 'jog tu/ /mi yi drang srong rgyun shes bu las ni/ /gzugs can snying po'i zur bu tha chung po/ /'tsho byed gzhen nus gsos zhes cher grags pa/ /sman pa'i rgyal por lan mang dbang bskur zhing / /thub pa snyun gso'i sman pa'i rgyal po byung / /de las brgyud pa gsal ba ma mthong yang / /zhes pa ltar rgyal po gzugs can snying po dang tshong dpon gyi chung ma 'dus pa las byung ba'i bu rang gi phu bo gzhon nu 'jigs med kyis gsos pas gzhen nus gsos zhes bya ba lang tsho la bab par nye ba na gos dkar can mang du mthong ba las su yin dris pas/ yab na re 'di rnams nad kyi gdung ba sel ba'i sman pa zhes bya ba sha stag yin no zhes zer ba thos pas sngon gyi bag chags nyid kyis bdag kyang 'di rnams kyis rjes su bslab par bgyi'o/ /zhes zhug pas gnang ste sman bslab par brtsams so/ /de'i tshe rgyun shes(186ba)kyi bu'i rjes su slob par 'dod nas rdo 'jog gi rgyal po pad+ma'i snying po la yab kyi yi ge dang bcas te phyin/ der slob dpon gyis nyung shas tsam las ma bstan kyang khyad par dang bcas te lobs/ dus gzhan zhig na slob dpon gyis 'tsho byed khrid nas nad pa zhig la sman bslabs nas log pa la 'tsho byed kyi bsam pas sman de mi 'phrod par mthong nas slar nad pa'i rtsar song ste slob dpon na re sman snga ma de ma za bar phyi ma 'di dang 'di lta bu zo zhig ces gsungs so/ /zhes thabs mkhas kyis bzlog go /ji tsam na slob dpon gyis dris pas gsos zer/ da dung sman 'di nyid thong zhig byas pas snga phyi gang yin zer/ kho bos gnyis ni ma bstan byas pas/ snga ma ni dngos su dang / phyi ma ni 'tsho byed las sgo zer bas/ slob dpon gyis bsams pa/ bdag gis nyes te 'tsho byed ni mkhas pa'o snyam nas 'tsho byed la dga' ba skyes te shas cher 'tsho byed nyid 'khrid par byed do/ /slob ma gzhan rnams na re mkhan po ni 'tsho 230

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag yonabyed kho na la spro bas ston gyi bdag cag rnams ni ma yin no/ /zhes zer ro/ de la mkhan pos 'tsho byed ni shes rab che ba yin te/ ngas gang bstan pa de las rnam par 'byed nus kyi khyod rnams kyis ma yin no/ /de ltar mkhan pos gang las mkhyen 'o na mngon sum du bya'o/ /zhes smras nas/ khyed cag rnamasalhan cig tu tshong 'dus su song la sman 'di dang 'di 'dra ba'i rin thang khyod dang khyod lta bu re res dris la shog cig ces bsgos nas btang ste slar 'khor nas dris pas gzhan rnams kyi gang smos pa'i sman sna re'i rin thang ma gtogs (187nasgo shes/ 'tsho byed kyis sman sna thams cad kyi rin thang 'chad rgyu byung ngo / /yang song la thang shing gi ri nas sman ma yin pa long zhig byas nas 'khor ba'i tshe/ ga 'an rnamasakyis sman ma yin pa mang po khyer byung la/ 'tsho byed kyis sman ma yin pa ma rnyed nas des 'on kyang 'dam bu mda' rgyu'i rtsa ba dang rdo'i dum bu zhig khyer nas song ba'i lam du phyugs rdzi mos zho'i bum pa dang phrum tshud khyer nas mkhan po'i drung du 'gro ba las mig shin tu na ba mthong nas des de la mdun de nyid na yod pa'i sman zhig bstan pa las bsos nas dga' ste zho bum khyod sgoms shig /des phrum tshud blangs te zho'i bum pa de nyid la gtad nas phyin pa las bal glang gi rjes shig 'dug pa grogasarnams brtag pa'i ched du dris pa/ 'di gang gi rjes yin/ gzhan rnams na re glang po che'i rjes so/ /de ni ma yin te/ 'di ni bal glang mo'i rjes so/ /de yang mig g.yas pa zhan ba/ de ring kho nar glang po'i phrug gu skye ba/ de la zhen pa'am bud med yin pa/ mig g.yas zhan ba/ de ring nyid du bu pho btsa' bar gyur ba zhig go /zhes smras nas slob dpon gyi drung du sleb pa na bram ze'i khye'u rnams kyis sman ma yin par bstan pa dang / mkhan pos 'di thams cad kyang sman yin te/ 'di la ming 'di zhes bya ba dang nad 'di dang 'di la phan no zhes re re nas smras so/ /'tsho byed kyis thams cad sman lags te sman ma yin pa ci yang ma mchos so/ /'on kyang 'di gsum khur ro/ /'dis ci bya/ de na re/ sdig pas:na (187ba lnga la mda' rgyu'i rtsa ba'i dud pas bdugs nas phrum tshud bslan pas phan zhing rdo'i dum bu ni ston ka zho'i bum pa chags par 'gyur ro/ /zhes smras pa las mkhan po 'dzum byung ba na gzhan rnams kyi bsam pa —231—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)mkhan po 'tsho byed la ma mnyes so snyam nas smras pa/ mkhan po 'di gcig pur bas dgongs sam/lam du glang po che'i rjes la rigs pa ma yin pa 'di ltar smras so/ /zhes lo rgyus bskyar bas/ 'tsho byed bden nam bden lags so/ /de ji ltar shes/ des mkhan po bdag rgyal po'i rigs las chen por gyur pa lags ci ste mi shes/ glang po che'i rjes ni zlum mo/ bal glang mo'i rjes ni mchur ring ngo/ mig g.yas zhar ba ni g.yon phyogs su rtsa zos pa las shes so/ /sbrum ma ni lag pa bas rkang rjes gting ring ba las/ de ring kho nar skye ba ni gcin bi'u snabs can las/ phrug gu phor skye ba ni rkang pa g.yas pa'i rjes gting ring ba las/ de la bud med zhen pa ni babs nas chu btang ba'i rjes/ de'i yang mig g.yas pa zhan ba ni g.yon phyogs su me tog 'thus pa las/ de sbrum ma ni rting pa'i rjes lhag par dod pa las/ de ring kho nar btsa' ba ni gcin ljin ldin can las shes te/ thugs mches na de nyid du dri bar mdzod cig /ces smras pa ltar dris pas ji lta bar mthong nas mkhan pos gzhan rnams la smras pa thos sam/ 'tsho byed ni 'di 'dra ba'i shes rab can yin no/ /zhes smras te thod pa dbye ba'i dpyad ma gtogs thams cad bslabs (188na〉sgo/ /ji tsam na mi zhig klad nad kyis thebs nas mkhan po la zhus pas/ de ring dong dang lci ba sta gon gyis shig par bya'o/ /de thos nas 'tsho byed kyis nad pa'i khang par gab nas gnas pa'i tshe/ mkhan pos thod pa phye nas srin bu len par brtsams pa'i tshe 'tsho byed thon nas thabs bstan pas mgu ste/ kho bo ni 'dis 'tsho ba yin na khyed gzhan du song zhig smras pas/ phyag byas te rgyal po pad+ma'i snying po'i gan du phyin nas 'gro bar brtsams pa na kho bo dang mi mthun pa mtha' khob skya seng thul la song zhig /des khas blangs nas yan lag bzhi'i dpung gis phab gte'u bzung / dpya' phul bas bya dga' chen po gnang ba thams cad mkhan po la phul nas rim gyis grong khyer bzang byed du phyin no/ /der dbyar gnas nas khrung po thams cad kyi skad shes pa'i bstan bcos bslabs nas chas pa na/ shing khur ba'i mi rus pa dang pags pa'i lhag ma can kun nas 'dzag pa zhig mthong nas rgyu mtshan dris pas/ shing khur 'dis byung ste gzhan kho bo mi shes zer ba la/ shing brtag —232

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bsgongs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shā'ipa'i rig pas 'byung po thams cad dang bar byed pa'i nor bu 'dug par mthong nas/ khur po tshongs shig rin ji tsam/ ga r+ṣa pa ṇi lnga brgya'o/ /des de sprad nas nor bu de blangs so/ /de'i yon tan ni khyim na rdzas ci yod mar me bteg pa bzhin nad ne'i mdun du bzhag pa tsam gyis nad ji lta ba shes pa zhig pas/ rim gyis yul u dum wā rar phyin pas bre mgo la bsnun pa zhig mthong nas dris(188ba)pasaklad pa g.ya' zer/ der nor bu la brten nas brtags pas klad pa la srin bu mthong nas sngar gyi dpyad byas pas sos te da r+ṣa pa ṇa lnga brgya thob pa'ang mkhan po la bskur ro/ /de nas yul ro he ta dar phyin pas khyim bdag zhig la skyed tshal ngo mtshar can zhig yod pa la lhag par chags nas shi ba de nyid du mi ma yin du skyes pas der gnas pa mang du bsad pa las tshal de spangs so/ /ji tsam na dmu chus na nas sman pas spangs pa zhig tshal der 'chi bar phyin pa dang / 'tsho byed kyang nub mo de nyid du bsdad pa las/ de'i tshe mi ma yin des nad pa de bsdigs pa na nad bdag de byung ste 'di bdag gisasngar nas bzung na khyod kyis ci la sdig /khyod la ra spu'i du bas ni ma bdugs/ de bdugs na khyod dpag tshad bcu gnyis su sa dgos par mi 'gyur ram zer bas/ des khyod la'ang la phug gi sa bon mar phyungs pa'i dar ba dang sbyar te 'ga' yang ma sbyin/ des ni khyod dum bu dum bur 'dzag par mi 'gyur ram/ zhes gleng ba thams cad 'tsho byed kyis rtogs nas nang par khyim bdag gi bu dang nad pa gnyis ka la thabs de so sor byas pas ji lta ba bzhin byung nas da r+ṣa pa ṇa lnga brgya lnga brgya byung ba'ang mkhan po la bskur ro/ /de nas yul bcom brlag tu phyin nas shing drung zhig na ngal gsob las/ gyad gcig gis gcig brdabs nas nang khrol 'khrugs te shi'o/ /zhes phyir khur byung ba na/ shing de'i rtse na bya rgod mo phrug gu dang bcas pa dag na re/ sha dgos/ ga la yod/ gyad kyi ro'o/ /'di 'tsho byed kyis 'tsho'i/ /(189na)ji ltar phye mas reg na'o/ /zhes zer ba rtogs nas nor bus bltas te gci'u sa phyi ma nang khrol la reg pas sos te da r+ṣa pa ṇa lnga brgya rnyed pa'am mkhan po la bskur ro/ /yang de nyid du khyim bdag gcig chung ma shin tu mdzes pa la chags bzhin du shi ba mngal gyi srin bur skyes nas skyes pa —233

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesus spyad kyang 'chi bar byed do/ /de na sus kyang reg par ma nus pa la 'tsho byed la bstan pas/ sgron mor phyungs nas mo mtshan gyi sgor sha'i dum bu bzhag pa las srin bu sha la chags nas 'ongs pa dor bas sos so/ /des kyang ga r+ṣa pa ṇa lnga brgya byung ba de yang mkhan po la bskur ro/ /de nas rim gyis chu bo ya mun nar phyin pa dang / mi ro'i rting pa la nyas 'then pas mig 'byed 'dzum byed pa mthong nas rtsa phra thams cad brtags te rim pas yangs pa can du phyin no/ /der rgyad gcig gis gcig gi gdong la thal mo bsnun pas mig don pa la rting pa'i rtsa nas drangs pas tshud do/ /des kar+ṣa pa ṇa lnga brgya byung ba thu bo 'jigs med kyi ma a mra skyong ma la byin no/ /yang der mi zhig gi rna bar srin bu zhugs nas phrug gu bdun brgya tsam gnas pas nyen pa la bsams pa/ sngar ni mkhan pos bstan pa ltar byas/ da ni rang gis bsams la bya'o snyam nas lo ma'i spyil por ras sngon pos g.yogs/ de'i 'og tu rnga bzhag nas sa yang dro bar byas te mi de sa la bkal/sa rnams chus chag chag btab ste rnga brdungs pas srin bu rnams kyi dbyar zhu'o snyam nas phyir thon pa la rna'i (189bsor sha'i dum bu bzhag pas de nang du song nas thams cad pos te za ba'i tshe dor bas sos shing ga r+ṣa pa ṇa lnga brgya rnyed pa'ang a ma skyong ma la byin no/ /de nas rim pas rgyal po'i khab tu phyin pa na ma skyes dgras sus kyang ma phrad par sgo gzhan nas zhugs/ dus gzhan zhig na skye bo mang pos bskor nas sems g.yengs shing song ba'i tshe/ bram ze mig na ba zhig gis sman zhus pa la zhe sun nas thal ba thob byas pa ltar btab pas de sos so/ /phyis de dang mi gzhan zhig phrad pa las gar 'gro dris pas 'tsho byed la sman zhur 'gro zer/ des 'di'i sman ni thal ba'o zhes sngar bzhin btab pas long / de tsam na yab rgyal po'i spyi por phol mig byung ba la sman pa rnams bsags nas dpyad gyis shig par bsgos pas/ lha lags sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed yod bzhin du bdag cag rnams kyis rngo mi thogs par zhus pas/ 'tsho byed bkug nas dpyad byos shig /dam zhig bca' na bya'o/ /bdag nyid kyis khrus bgyid na'o/ /de bzhin gyis shig byas des skyu ru ra bkur —234

sku gsung thugs rten gsar tshongs dang rin po che'i mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (7cing sman rdzas btab nas de dang bsres pa'i chu bum pa lnga brgya blug nas smin pa'i tshe spu gris reg pa tsam gyis ma tshor bar brtol/ de nas 'tsho ba'i rdzas btab cing de dang bsres pa'i chu bum pa lnga brgya blug pas sos te skra yang mnyam par gyur to/ khrus de byas ma thag dpyad gyis shig /re zhig bgos gsol zhig /de nas dpyad kyang gyis shig /lha bgyis zin lags so/ /de yid ma ches nas lag pas skul bsam shes/ me long (190na〉pa bltas pas kyang ma mthong / btsun mo la dris pas kyang ma shesanas ngo mtshar skyes te blon po rnams la 'tsho byed sman pa'i rgyal por dbang bskur zhig /thal ba btab pas long ba des smras pa/ lha sras la byams pas sam mkhas pas dbang bskur/ mkhas pas zhe na kho bo'i mig long bas so zhes pa la/ 'tsho byed kyis khyod mig gis kyang ma mthong ngo / /des med kyang khyod kyis bstan pa ltar g.yin gyis so/ /de'i khams kyang g.yin la khyod kyi khams kyang gzhan yin pasaslad nas 'di lta bu zhig gyis zhes bstan pa ltar byas pas sos nas smras pa/ lha 'di ni lhag par mkhas pas dbang bskur du gsol/ de nas glang po che la bskyon te dpal gyi 'byor pa chen po nas sman pa'i rgyal po r+ṣa por dbang bskur ro/ /yang rgyal po'i khab na sman pa phal gyis spangs pa'i skran nad pa zhig yod pa des 'tsho byed dpyad mdzad du gsol/ des sman 'di ni rnyed dka'o byas pas 'dis kyang spangs so snyam nas dur khrod du song ba dang de na ro bsregs pa'i me 'bar ba'i nang na ni'u le dang srog chags go dha tsas 'thabs pa lhungs pa'i sha zos te/ dur khrod kyi 'od pa'i chu ngas nas gnag lhas kyi ko dra'i chang dang mar phyung ba'i zho 'thungs pas skran rdol te zhabru skyugs byung nas sos so/ re zhig na btsun mo lus 'phags ma de gos can gyi 'doms su phol mig byung ba la/ rgyal pos ma g.yar ma'i dpyad byos zhig /des zan sla mo'i khar 'dug tu (190ba〉ga la khur shog de mthong nas smin pa'i sman btab ste zan la btsag bu btsugs nas sngar bzhin sdod du bcug pas brdol te bska ba'i chus bkrus nas 'tsho sman btab pas sos so/ /rgyal pos de la dpyad byas sam/ lha byas so/ /gcir mor ma bltas sam/ ma bltas te rgyu —235

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)mtshan bshad pas mgu nas yang dbang bskur zhig /skran nad pas sngar bzhin smras pas/ 'tsho byed kyis ngas dpyad nas ma byas sman rnyed dka'o byas rnyed dka' ba gang yin/ 'tsho byed kyis mar ngo'i tshes bcu bzhi la mi ser skya shi ba'i ro dur khrod du bsregs pa la sogs sngar bzhin smras pas shin tu legs te de bzhin bgyis so zhes mgu nas lha de bzhin rngo thog gi dbang bskur du gsol/ slar yang sngar bzhin no/ /gang gi tshe ma skyes dgra lhas byin gyis bskul nas pha bsad pa'i rjes su skran nad kyis thibs so/ /sman pa kun bsags kyang de rnams kyis rngo ma thogs nas 'tsho byed kyis/ gzhen nu 'char byed bzang po'i sha gsol na'o/ /des khyod rgyal srid 'dod dam/ 'di min pa'i dpyad med do/ /rang las 'phangs pa med pas khas blangs so/ /de'i tshe bu sbas nas mi sha gzhan bcos nas byin pas za bar brtsams pa'i tshe 'phrogs nas klad la brgyab ste/ sngar pha bsad de bu sha za ba'i glen pa zhes smad pas mi bzod pa skyes pas rdol te 'khru skyugs kyi sgo nas sos shing bu gtad pas ches dga' bas dbang gsum pa bskur ro/ /de'i tshe kho bo dang mnyam pa li 'tsho thabs pa med snyam pa'i (191na〉ngas pa skyes nas/ lus kyi dpyad byed pa'i mchog ni kho bo yin la/ sems kyi dpyad byed pa'i mchog ni sangs rgyas yin snyam ste sangs rgyas kya spyan sngar song ngo / /de ci tsam yi yang bden pa ma mthong / rgyu de mkhyen nas ri'i rgyal po gangs can la song las sman ci 'dod pa long zhig /'jigs so zhes pa la lag na rdo rje dang snyam du song la long zhig /des de blangs nas drung du slebs pa'i tshe/ 'tsho byed 'di ci yin gsungs pa la phal cher shes kyang g.yin mang rab kyi ming tsam yang ma shes pa la/ sangs rgyas kyis ming dang phan yon sogs gsungs pas bcom ldan 'das kyis sman dpyad kyang mkhyen lags sam/ zhes zhus pas bka' stsal pa/ 'tsho byed sman pa zug rngu 'byin pa yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa ni rgyal po la 'os pa/ rgyal po la mkho ba rgyal po'i yan lag gi grangs su 'gro'o/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ de la sman bzug rngu 'byin pa la mkhasapa yin/ nad kun nas slong ba la mkhas pa yin/ nad byung ba spangs pa la mkhas pa yin/ spang ba phyis —236

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag 9mimi 'byung ba la mkhas pa yin te/ nad la mkhas pa ci lta bu zhe na/ de la sman pa zug rngu 'byin pas nad shes shing / nad 'di ni 'di lta bu dang 'di lta bu yin no zhes de ltar nad la mkhas pa yin no/ /nad kun nas slong ba la mkhas pa ci lta bu zhe na/ de la sman pa zug rngu 'byin pas nad shes shing 'di ni rlung gis kun nas bslang ba'am/ mkhras pas kun nas(191ba bslang ba'am/ bad gan gyis kun nas bslang ba'am/ bdag las gyur pa'am/ gzhan las gyur pa'am/ 'dus pa las gyur pa'o/ /zhes de ltar nad kun nas slong ba la mkhas pa yin no/ /nad byung ba spong ba la mkhas pa ci lta bu zhe na/ de la sman pa zug rngu 'byin pa nad shes shing nad 'di ni mig sman nam/ bku mnye'am/ ( nam/bkru sman nam/ snar slug pa'am/ du bas bdug pa'am/ nan rtsi'i las kyis spong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes de ltar byung ba spong ba la mkhas pa yin no/ /nad spangs pa phyis mi 'byung ba la mkhas pa ci lta bu zhe na/ de la sman pa zug rngu 'byin pa nad shes shing nad 'di ni 'phrod pa'i chog 'di lta bu dang 'di lta bu dag byas te spangs na phyis mi 'byung ngo / /zhes de ltar nad spangs pas phyis mi 'byung ba la mkhas pa yin no/ /de ltar na sman pa zug rngu 'byin pa yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa rgyal po la 'os pa yin no/ /rgyal po la mkho ba yin/ rgyal po'i yan lag gi grangs su 'gro ba yin no/ /de bzhin du de bzhin gshegasapa dgra bcom pa yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yan lag bzhi dang ldan pa'am sman pa zug rngu 'byin pa bla na med pa zhes bya'o/ /'tsho byed bzhi gang zhe na/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni/ 'di ni sdug bsngal 'phags pa'i bden pa'o/ /'di ni sdug bsngal kun 'byung ba'o/ /'di ni sdug bsngal 'gog pa'o/ /'di ni sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam 'phags pa'i (192na tha den pa'o// zhes yang dag par ji lta ba bzhin rab tu mkhyen to/ /'tsho byed sman pa zug rngu 'byin pas ni skye ba'i rtsa ba can gyi sdug bsngal rnams spong ba'i sman mi shes so/ /rga ba dang na ba dang 'chi ba dang mya ngan dang smre sngags 'don pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang yid mi bde ba 'khrugs pa'i rtsa ba can gyi sdug bsngal rnams spong ba'i sman mi shes so / /'tsho byed de bzhin gshegs pa ni skye ba'i rtsa ba can —237—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shegyi sdug bsngal rnams spong ba'i sman mkhyen no/ /rga ba nas ga byugs pa rtsa ba can gyi bar gyi sdug bsngal rnams spong ba'i sman mkhyen no/ /de bsan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni sman pa zug rngu 'byin pa bla na med pa zhes bya ba'o/ /zhes pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs bstan pa las 'tsho byed ga 'a na nus bskyed/ chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral bskyes so/ /de nas 'tsho byed gzhen nu bskyes kyis chos mthong ba dang thos pa dang / chos kyi gting slebasapa dang / som nyi dang the tshom las brgal ba dang / gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa dang / gzhan gyis mi bkri ba dang / ston pas bstan pa'i chos rnams la mi 'jigs pa thob nas stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der thal mo sbyar ba btud de 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bdag ni 'phags so/ /mngon par 'phags so/ /bcom ldan 'das dang chos dang dge slong gi dge 'dun la (192ba tshe skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ deng slan chad ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog dang bsdos te skyabs su mchi lags so zhes gsol to/ /de'i tshe ri'i rgyal po gangs can rtag tu kha bas g.yogs shing lhag pa che bas bcom ldan 'das grang nad kyi bsnyun gyis thebs pa dang / 'tsho byed kyis bsam pa/ dper na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po la byed pa bzhin bcom ldan 'das kyi rim gro bdag nyid kho nas bya'o snyam mo/ /de nas me to ge snga khyu la sum cu rtsa gnyis bkru sman gyi rdzas dang sbyar nas phul te 'di rnams shangs kyi mnam du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis mnams pa las thengs sum cu rtsa gnyis khrus par gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la ci dgar legs par 'khrus lags sam / bka' stsal pa/ 'tsho byed/ skyon gang dag g.yos la ma 'khrus pa dag kyang yod/ 'khrus la ma g.yos pa'ang yod/ zhakhrus la g.yos pa'ang yod/ ma 'khrus ma g.yos pa dag kyang yod do/ /gsol ba de lta na/ bu ram dang a ru ra gsol la 'khru ba'i rim pa yang mdzod cig /des de bzhin mdzad pas snyun dngas par gyur to/ /'tsho byed kyi kun tu spyod pa ni rgyal po'am blon po'am gang su'i dpyad byas kyang rung ste/ des de la grong ngam mchog sbyin par byed pa yin no/ /de nas yul —238

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag rtoge'aphags rgyal gyi rgyal po mu khyud mtha' yas kyi bu rab snang zhes bya ba dbang po lnga dang nye dbang lnga dang mchog lnga la sogs pa phun sum tshogs kyang nad du gnyid med cing (193na sgor la sdang la chang la dga' ba zhig pas/ de la sman pa rnams kyis rdzas khyad par sna tshogs pa mar dang sbyar te blud par brtsams pa'i tshe mi mthung zhing / mar gyi ming tsam smos pa de'i mgo bo gcod par byed par gtum po rab snang zhes bya bar grags so/ /de gnyid med pas thams cad kyi re mos su mel tshe bgyid dgos pa la/ spos tshong gi khyi'u zhig la bab pas bsad dogs nas sa 'dzin pa zhig brngan nas tshab la btang / de mkhas pa zhig pas/ 'ug pa khrung khrung muñdza dang / /nag po sreg pa bum pa dang / /lan tsha phye dang shi ba dang / /dong thags rdza ma sdig pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bsdoms dang mthun pa'i sgrung gis rgyal po dga' bar byed do/ /mjug tu de ltar khyod kyis thams cad shes na nga gnyid med pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin/mi 'jigs pa stsol na'o/ /sbyin no/ /sdig pa las skyes pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis so/ /gang las shes/ mngon sum du bya'o zhes smras nas/ sa dong du ba lang gi lci ba skam pos bkang ba'i steng du rgyal po bzhag ma thag gnyid la song ngo / sad nas de ltar yin pa shes kyang yum la dris pas mi 'jigs par stsol zhig /de ltar bgyi'o gsungs shing / khyod kyi yab btsun mo'i 'khor kyang chen po dang ldan pas/ bdag zla mtshan dang ldan pa'i dus su khrus byed pa'i tshe sdig pa zhig mthong ba la blo skyes pa la de pho zhig pas 'dod pa spyad pas khyod skyes so/ /rgyal pos bsam pa/ sa 'dzin pa de mkhas pa zhig pas des gzhan la smra 'ong / mi 'jigs pa byin pas bsad (193ba)du mi rung yang gzhan du dbyung ngo snyam nam pa ṇa lnga brgya byin te bskrad do/ /de nas nad de gzhi cher gyur pa la sman pa rnams bsags nas dpyad gyis shig par bsgos kyang / de rnams na re/ nged cag rnams kyi rngo ma thogs kyi/ rgyal po'i khab na gzugs can snying po'i bu sman pa'i rgyal po 'tsho byed gzhon nus gsos zhes bya ba yod kyi des rngo thogs so/ /des yi ge springs te 'tsho byed 'gro bar brtsams pa na/ bang chen pa la na lugs dris te chang gi dri ro kha dog yod pa'i mar sbyar te khur nas phyin no/ /lam gyi yul ka na ku rdzar sman pa'i khye'u zhig yod pa de —239

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedang mnyam du song ngo / /sleb pa na bkur sti yang dag pas nang du bos nas dpyad gyis shig zer to/ /de la 'bros sa goms su 'jug pa'i ched du sman dkon pa 'tshol ba ltar byas nas/ nyin zhag gcig la dpag tshad brgyad cur bgrod pa'i glang mo bzang ldan la zhen te snga phyi ci rigs pa'i tshul gyi sleb par byas nas mthar sman pa'i khyi'u la brda byas nas khrus mdzod cig /gdugs tshodi gso le zhig /bdag gis 'khur ba'i skyems bzhes shig ces byas nas bros so/ /de 'thung ma thag gnyid du song nas nam phyed na sad pa'i tshe mar gyi sgreg pa byung nas mi dga' bas gsod par brtsams pa na bros par shes nas/ 'phar ma pa kha zhes pa nyin zhag gcig la dpag tshad nyi shu chod pa de nyin zhag gcig la dpag ra brgya chod pa'i glang po che la bskyon nas khrid shog bsgos so/ /zin la khad pa na glang mo'i chu btang ba'i dris cung zad thogs so/ /de nas (194/ ru ra'i tshal zhig tu zin nas khrid par brtsams pa na/ kha ci rings re zhig skyur ru ra zo zhig /lha'i gsung gis ci byin kyang ma za zer bas so/ /de ltar na phyed phyed za bo byas nas sen mo 'khru sman gyis bkang bas bcad nas byin pas shin tu 'khrus nas ri 'or zhig tu bzhag ste/ 'di rnams rgyal po'i mchog gsum yin pas rim gro 'di dang 'di lta bu gyis la phul zhig /gzhan du khyod rnams phung bar 'gyur ro byas nas rgyal po'i khab tu song ngo / kha de mdze can zhig pas sos nas logs pa'i tshe rgyal po'ang nad de las grol nas dris pas/ bros so/ /ma legs/ lha zin na ci bgyi gsod do/ /ci nged rang gnyis ka sos par byas pa ma yin nam/ 'o na ci bya/ bya dga' ster mod/ legs te de bzhin bgyi'o zhes byas nas nor mang po springs pa na/ 'tsho byed kyis kho bo la nor yod kyi/ sman pa'i khye'u la gnang ba'i rigs so/ /des sman pa'i khye'u la bya dga' chen po byin zhing / 'tsho byed la'ang brgya stong ri ba'i ras yug po che byin no/ /de'ang bcom ldan 'dasal phul nas chos gos gsum mdzad do/ /'tsho byed gzhen nus gsos kyi slob ma ni dngos bstan yin min la the tshom gyi gzhir snang yang deng sang yongs grags la ngos 'dzin pa ltar/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa nga 'das nas/ /lo ni bzhi brgya lon pa na/ /dge slong klu zhes de 'bod —240

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhongs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (ma'abyung //bstan pa la ni dad cing phan//rab tu dga' ba'i sa thob pa//lo ni drug brgya dag tu 'tsho//rig pa rma bya chen mo ni//194ba thad ga nyid chen po des kyang 'grub//bstan bcos sna tsho gos don dang ni//dngos po med pa'i don de rig/gang tshe lus de bor ba na/bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur//de ni mthar gyi sangs rgyas nyid//nges pa kho na yang dag thob ces lung bstan pa ltar sangs rgyas gnyisapa dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub spyir ji lta ji snyed kyi shes bya'i gnas kun la mkhas par ma zad tshe'i rig byed kyang mthar phyin pas gso rig gi bstan bcos sbyor ba brgya pa/'tsho ba'i mdo tshigs su bcad pa/ rtsa a ba'i chog /sman rin po che'i rim pa/ dngul chu'i sbyor ba rin cen 'phreng ba rnamasamadzad/dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi slob ma ni/kun shes las/lam 'di'i shing rta'i srol 'byed shes rab can//pha ma'i bran mdzad pha khol ma khol dang //de gnyisang ga bcag lha chen bsgrubasapa yis//pha gol ma gol zhes kyang mtshan du grags//phyi rol rig byed mkhas pa'i mthar son pas//mngal skyes sus kyang ma thub rig smra'i mchog/rdzus skyes 'phags pa lhas btul ston pa dang //bstan la dad pa'i mchog gyur snyan ngag pa//phyi mo'i dbu ma par nges dpa' bo yi//phyi nang gzhung lugs zla med du ma brtsams/khyad par yan lag brgyad pa chen po sogs//sman dpyad mkhas pa dga' byed bzhi tsam mdzad//de yi nang nas yan lag brgyad pa yi//snying po bsdus pa zhes bya 'di mdzad nas/zhes pa ltar/bdud rtsi bum pa/pha khol ma khol/pha gol ma gol/dpal 195na skosko dge ba/rta dbyangs/dga' byed/ma lta tsitā/a shwa ka/thub rgyal nag po zhes par grags shing nang par zhugasanas dkone cog 'bangs/rab 'byor skyangs/bha li lha/mar me mdzad/ngo bo gnyis med pa/bkod ma'adzin/btsun pa dpa' bo/dgra las rnam rgyal/rdo rje'i mtshon cha/lha gsum pa/bha ba bha/gzhan laphan pa'i dbyangs te mtshan nyi shu rtsa gnyis su grags pa'i mkhas mchog dpa' bo ni/'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/nyams dga' grong khyer rgyal po'i khab//'od ma'i tshal gyi sa steng du//slob ma'i tsho gos dang lhan cig tu//ji ltar bde bar nga bzhugs tshe//de/ ni bya rog gcig yod pas//nga la sems ni dad

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)byas nas/ /lus zig nas ni mtho ris song / /lha rnams las ni shi 'phos nas/ /mi yi nang du skyes nasakyang / /nga yi bstan la rab tu byung / /yon tan ldan zhing tshul khrims ldan/ /mang du thos shing chos kyang smra/ /ma khol zhes bya'i brtul zhugs can/ /de ni de tshe 'byung bar gyur/ /nga la ji bzhin bstod pa'i mchod/ /rnam pa sna tsho gos de dag gis/ /legs par dpyad la rab byed pa'o/ /blo ldan de ni mthar gyis kyang / /thams cad mkhyen pa byang chub thob/ /ces pa'i don bzhin/ thog mar phyi rol pa'i grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i mthar son pa rjes su nang pa'i bstan pa la zhugs te slob dpon 'phags pa yab sras kyi sras kyi thu bo/ gzhung phyi mo'i dbu ma pa/ phyi nang gi (195ba〉ngeg pa'i gnas mtha' dag la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhas pa chen po 'dis las 'bras la skur pa btab pa'i sdig bshags su yan lag brgyad pa chen po/ yan lag brgyad pa la 'jug pa/ yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa/yan lag brgyad pa bsdus pa ste bzhi/ ngag gi sdig bshags la skyes rabs/ yid kyi sgrib pa sbyang phyir rtsa lhung / gzhan yang rig pa'i gnas lnga gar bstan bcos mang du mdzad cing de'i nang nas yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa rtsom pa'i dus su/ sa gsum dge legs 'gyur ba yi/ /dge ba'i ltas ni sna tshogs 'byung / /zhes gsungs pa ltar sa 'og klu'i yul du 'od sna tshogs kyi khug sna sprin du chags pa/ de la bdud rtsi'i char 'bab pa/ shing rnams las dus min du 'bras bu smin pa gsum/ sa bla lha'i yul du ba dan dang rgyal mtshan g.yo ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros te phyogs kun khyab pa/ me tog gi char pa 'bab pa gsum/ sa steng mi'i yul du sa g.yo ba/ ut+pa la'i char 'bab pa/ dug gi me tog rnyings pa / gser gdugs rang bzhin gyis 'khor ba/ dung rnams rang skad 'byin pa/ shing gi bcad mtshams nas 'o ma dang sbrang rtsi 'bab pa/ lus 'phags kyi rgyal po nor 'dzin dmus long la mig byung ba/ yul dbus 'gyur 'chang gi yams nad chad pa/ mu stegs kyi mkhan po ra la pa tra nga rgyal chag nas sto ba sa la sbyar ba/ rdza rnga las rig sngags kyi sgra 'byung ba/ dkon cog gi rten rnams mdangs dang ldan pa/nang pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta rnams kyis shis pa (196na tharjod pa ste bcu gnyis dang bcas pa/ de ltar sa gsum —242

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhongs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag khu'idu rtsom pa'i rnam 'phrul bco brgyad gsal bar gyur cing rig pa'i dbang phyug gis/ rgyal po me rtag kun tu rgyas pa'i dris lan du/ tsan+d+ra go mi brjod pa rnam par dag /snyan ngag dpa' bo las byung sdeb sbyor mkhas/ /zhes bstan bcos rtsom pa la phul du byung bar bsngags/ kun shes las/ kha che zla dga' la bshad de yis kyang / /zla zer zhes bya'i rgya cher 'grel pa mdzad/ khres byung ba ltar/ de'i slob ma kha che zla ba mngon dga' yin par gso rig chos 'byung du ma dang brgyud 'debs gsan yig mang por byung la/ sgra sbyor nges par/ chags la mngon par dga' ba'i bu/ /zla ba mngon dga' zhes bya bas/ /zhesadang / zla zer du/ bdag gi mes bor gyur pa ni/ /dpal chen dge ba zhes grags yin/ /de ni da lta'ang sa gsum na/ /grags pa dri med sgrag par byed/ /de sras chags pa mngon par dga'/ /de'i bu zla ba mngon dga' bdag /slob dpon blo gros chen po ni/ khyud shes don ldan ming btags la/ /don dam zhes bya sman pa'i mchog /kha che'i yul du skyes pa yin/ /zhes dpal chen dge ba slob dpon dpa' bo dang / de'i sras chags pa mngon dga'/ /de'i sras kha che zla mngon yin kyang dus bsgrigs na yab kyi zhabs la ma thug pa'i nyes pa mi 'jug cing yang na mes dbon gyi bar du chags pa mngon dga' dgos pa brgyud yig tu ma chad pa'i nges pa mi snang zhing mes kyi yan lag (196ba tha rgyad pa chen po/ de la 'jug pa/ bsdus pa rnams dang / tsa ra ka 'bum gsogs gso rig gi gtsug lag mtha' klas par brten cing / rang nyid kyis rnam par dpyod pa'i rig lam nas drangs te snying po bsdus pa rgyas par 'grel bar tshig don zla zer/ de'i sman ming zur du bkod par tshig don sgra sbyor nges pa sogs mdzad de 'phags yul gyi rig byed 'dzin pa rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu lta bur gyur/ 'phags yul ma zad gangs ris bskor pa'i ljongs 'dir yang mnga' bdag chos skyong ba khri srong lde btsan gyi sku ring la mtha' bzhi'i sman pa rnams bkug nas gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs rgyas par spel zhing khyad par kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba mngon dga' dang skad gnyis smra ba'i dbang po lo chen be+e ro tsa na gnyis kyis bsgyur te gtan la phab/ dus der gso ba rig pa'i gzhung gzhan mang zhing dar che bas ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i —243

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gedon du yon mchod rnams bka' bgros te bsam yas bar khang gi ka gzhu la gter du sbas/ skyon chen po pad+ma thod 'phreng gis zhung blon rdo rje bdud 'dul la chos skyong dang gnod sbyin shing bya can la gter gyi srung mar bka' bskos/ de nas mi lo brgya dang lnga bcur nye ba na dge bshes gra pa mngon shes kyis gter nas spyan drangs/ des rog gi ban+de dkon cog skyabs la chig brgyud kyi tshul du gnang / des g.yu thog pa chen po yon tan mgon po la gsungs pa nas rgya cher 'phel bar grags/mkhas pa dang mi mkhas pa mang dag bod mar 'dod pa'i lung rigs phyogs re tsam (197na tshe pa brten nas bsgrub pa'i 'dod pa gtsor brtan la mtha' gcig tu nges bzung dka' yang / kun shes las/ de nas legs brgyud lo chen skyes bu mchog /rin cen bzang pos bsgyur bshad gtan la phab/ /mkhasapa du mar spel nas bod yul du/ /rgya cher spel las bod kyi shing rta che/ /g.yu thog sogs kyis rgyud bzhin grags pa spel/ /zhes byung ba/ 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu stag tshang lo chen 'di lung rigasakyi dpyad pa shin tu bzod cing des mdzad pa'i sman dpyad spyi'i rnam bzhag phyogs gcig tu bsdusapa'i gzhung mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog dang lag len gces bsdus reg pas nad sel zhes bya ba mkhasarlom g.yin las khyad zhugs pa'i legs bshad cig snang bas rgol bar ga la spobs/ de lta na'ang phyogs 'di ga'i rang skad gtsor brtan la bla ma gsang 'dus sogs gu ru zhi drag gi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor slob dpon chen po nyid rigs kyi bdag po'i rnam par bzhengs nas gsungs pa dang / bka' gdams thig le bcu drug jo bo yab sras kyi ye shes sgyu dra'i rol gar las shar na'ang don gyi brgyud pa rdo rje 'chang nas rim par byung ba ltar rje g.yu thog pa rigs 'dus sman pa'i bdag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bzhengs nas snying thig gi chos skor rnams gsungs shing sprul pa'i grong khyer chen por sman pa'i rgyal po'i rnam pas rgyud gsungs par khas blangs kyang don rgyud gong ma rnams 'byung bar gor ma chag cing rje btsun g.yu thog pa sman pa'i rgyal por gting (197bskos nges pa rnyed pa'i gang zag tshor don la khyad par med par sems so/ /de ltar bur rgyal gyi yul khams 'dir 'jig rten mig gcig —244—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar ba tshe ngas dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (7pu lo chen rin cen bzang pos bsgyur ba yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa dang sngon chos rgyal gyi dus mtha' bzhi'i sman pas gtan la phab pa rnams dpe dang ming tsam du lus na'ang bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud du grags pa rtsa bshad man ngag phyi ma ste rgyud bzhi/ cha lag bco brgyad/ gzhan yang brang ti/ byang pa rigs ldan chen po/ zur mkhar ba khu dbon sogs mkhas pa mang pos mdzad pa'i 'grel bshad/ man ngag gces so 'tshal phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i be'u bum/ bdud rtsi'i bum pa sogs gter kha sna tshogs pa'i man ngag rnams kyang gal chung chos su byed pa'i dus kyi bskal pas nam mjug sdud ga'i chu phran ltar je phrar gyur pa'i dus 'dir gsar byung gi gtsug lag grog mkhar dang sbrang ma'i sbrang rtsi lta bu la rnam pa gcig tu dgos pa med pa 'dra zhig mchis kyang / legs bshad rin po che'i gter las/ /rig pa nang par 'chi yang bslab/ /tshe 'dir mkhas par ma gyur kyang / /skye ba phyi mar bcol ba yi/ /nor la rang nyid len pa 'dra/ /yon tan ldan na skye bo kun/ /ma bsdus par yang de nyid 'du/ /dri ldan me tog rgyang ring yang / /bung ba sprin gyi tshogs bzhin 'khor/ /mkhas pa yon tan kun bslab pa/ /mthar phyin gcig gis 'jig rten gsal/ /blo ngan (198na/nas pa mang na yang / khu1 skar bzhin du gsal mi nus/ /mkhas pa yon tan dpag med kyang / /gzhan gyi yon tan chung ngu len/ /de ltar rgyun du spyad pa yis/ /myur du thams cad mkhyen par 'gro/ /zhes pa ltar rig pa'i gnas rnams la thos bsam bgyis pas 'di phyi kun tu rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen por 'gyur ba'i phyir na dus ༅ skye bo'i ngang tshul la skyid ma lug par sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar gyis yid drangs par ma zad/ mkhas pa'i dbang po dpang lo chen pos/ ding sang bstan pa nyams dma' bas/ /'di 'dra li tshul la mthun 'jug dang/ /'jug pa shin tu dkon mod kyi/ shes na mkhas pa'i go 'phang thob/ /gang zhig mkhas par bya 'dod kyi/ /gang zhig mkhas par byed 'dod na/ /'di dang 'di 'dra tshul mi slob/ /de dag blo ni bem po'am ci/ /zhes pa ltar/ la la dag rang nyid blo gros rmongs pa'i sgrib g.yogs su nang rig pa la thos bsam byar yod bzhin du tha snyad kyi rig pa rnams la —245

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shedagos pa med pa skad du zog rdzu'u ga pa spros pa ltar 'gyid na'ang / ji skad du/ /sman pas zas su sgro btags nas/ /sman gyis nad chen gsob ltar/ /'jig rten lugs kyi rjesangs nas/ /bdag gisadam pa'i tshul 'ji bshad/ /ces pa ltar/ phyi nang mthun mong ba'i gtsug lag rnams kyang rang nyid gnas skabs su mkhas par gyur pa tsam du ma zad thabs snying rje chen po dang shes rab stong pa nyid kyis rtsis zin na bla na med pa'i byang chub mngon du byas (198bskos de'i grib bsil du sems can thams cad mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi lam la ci dgar longs spyod pas na/ ji skad du/ de nyid gzigs pa dngar dang rab tu rgyas pa'i 'khri shing kun dga'i dpyid/ /ya mtshan yal ga stong gis dres pa'i yon tan skal pa bzang po'i mtha'/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis spong ba min pa'i gnas la byang chub grib bsil ba/ /rigs tshogos kha ba'i 'dzum ldan gaṅgā'i dpal mo spro ba'i rgyun 'dzin snying gi dpal/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /de yang sngar smos pa'i phyi nang drang srong gi tshe'i rig byed rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang nasamang dag yul dbus 'gyur 'chang du gtsug lag gnyis pa shes pa'i mkhas mang la brten nas dar rgyas su yod pa'i sman dpyad la mkhas pa kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir du ma zhig 'ongs tshod du 'dug rung paṇ+ḍita :ti phan tshun skad kyi brda ma 'phrod pas rta nag tu lug rdzi mdzad pa'i lo rgyus ltar ci yin cha ma 'tshal bar rang yul du phyir ldog ste gzhan phan gyi 'phrin las ma byung ba dang / la las tshe'i rig byed shes pa'i rna thos tsam go yang bod kyi gso rig pas choge shes nas/ legs bshad rin po cher/ tsan+dan gser las rin che ba/ /blun pos sol bar byas la stos/ /zhes pa ltar shes bzhin khyad gsod kyis dor ba'am mchis rung rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing 'brug gi lor shākya mu zhe'i pho brang chen po'i mdun phyogs rgya gar ba'i mi rigs du ma tshogs khrod du sman pa mkhas pa zhig yod dam zer ba'i gtam thos pas rkyen byas 'dar pa lo chen dri mal byed du bcug pa 'phags yul (199na)nub phyogs ma ho ra'i sa'i char bram ze gtsang ma'i rigs su skyes pa si rgya si go da ra ra khyo nga ste khyim spangs sa spyod ces bya bas rgya gar dbus/ shar nub lho byang / ni pā la dang bcas pa chu bzhin myul nas—246

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (moslob dpon go ta ma bha:/ ut+ta ma gi ri/ u kā ra bha:sogs gus pas bsten pa'i mkhas pa chen por rtogs te 'dar pa paṇa chen gyis lo tsā bgyis dar mo sman rams pa bslab tu bcug par gso rig gi lag len ngo mtshar ba du ma byung rung phyogs 'di mi rnyed pa'i sman gyi rigs 'tshol bar rgya bal phyogs su phyir bteg bal po yam bu'i rgyal blon la rogs dan dgos tshul gyi sde pa'i khung rgya'i mtshams sbyor song ba la brten sman gyi rigs rnam grangs shin tu mang ba bcas me mo sprul lo'i dbyar 'byor ba'i rgya bal gyi slob dpon mkhas pa rnams kyi zhal gyi bdud rtsi las 'ongs pa'i tshe'i rig byed kyi man ngag gnad kyi snying po bsdus pa 'di nyid/ mi chos gnad 'phreng las/ sngon dus bod 'di srin po'i rgyal khams 'dra/ /ding sang dus su rgya gar 'phags yul 'dra/ /bsams kyin lo tsā bod la bka' drin che/ /zhes dang / sa paṇ+ḍi tas/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i gzhung lugs bla na med/ /zhu mchan sgyur byed mchan bu'i gnas thob pa/ /skad gnyis smra mkhas lo tsā de dag ni/ /de dag bdag cag rnams kyi mig bzhin gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ pā ṇi byā ka ra ṇa sogs sgra mdo chen po bzhi la blo gros kyi lang tsho mchog tu rgyas pa se (199ba〉dkar rigs kyi thig le 'dar pa lo tsā ngag dbang phun tshogs lhun grub kyis zhu chen dang gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs la slob dpon mkhas pa bcu phrag tsam bsten nas sbyangs pa'i yar stod dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags kyis 'bad pa chen pos gtan la phab pa'i pu sta ka 'di nyid kyi thog mar nad kyi mtshan nyid bstan pa/ rtsa'i sgo nas ngos bzung ste gtan la 'bebs pa/dngul chu bco bkru/ gser/ zha nye dkar nag /ti tsha/ zangs/ lcags rnams 'dul lugs dang / de dag la brten pa'i sbyor ba/ rlung mkhris bad kun/ nad glo bur ba rnams so sor gtong rgyu'i thad/ zla ba'i dus dang sbyar nas sbyongs gto me lugs/ mu sa yi/ rims 'phrog lcags kyu/ go yu'i bcud len gyis mtshon spyi 'joms dang sgos sman sogs shin tu gces pa'i sbyor sde dang kha bsgyur bsdoms pa sum brgya lhag bcas/ 'khor lo dang sngags la brten pa bcu phrag lnga brgal ba/ me btsa'i skor ga rko ṭa'i bcud len la brten pa'i tshe nyi zla dang mnyam zhing lus rdo rje ltar brten pa rnams kyi phyag len —247

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)man ngag mtha' dag nyams 'og tu chud pa'i thos bsam gyi mthu la brten nas 'gro ba mang po bzod dka' zug rngu'i 'phrang las rnam par grol te bde zhing skyid pa'i dpal la sbyor bar gdon mi za'o//chu gter slar yang ma bsrubs sngon med pa'i//rig byed bdud rtsi'i bum pa thob pa'i tshe mes pos dran pa'i gso dpyad dbyar skyes kyi//rnga bsangs de la mos pa cung zad lhod//te se'i mdangasaltar rab dkar lhag pa'i yid//200na/rtsas can tshogs la rjes chags kun+da'i tshal//'dzum pa'i cho ga gtong min sems bskyed kyi//bsil sbyin mkhan po'i cha shas nye bar gang //phyogs brgyar gzegs ma 'thor ba mañdzu ra'i//ngad pa tsha gdung gcil la mtshar 'dzin pa//yongs grub brgya dang rtsa gcig bro nad gnyen//sman gyi dpag bsam 'khri shing 'di sus bskrun//ris su ma chad 'gro la 'jigs bral ba'i//sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs rgyal kyi sras//rlabs chen spyod la 'a lcag rnams sa rgyas zhes//grags can bgrod dka'i sa de mi ring snyam//bzod min tshor ba drag po'i nad gdon dang //de rgyu sgrib gnyis lus pa med bcas pa//'joms pa'i sman pa che mchog rdzogs sangs rgyas//'grub pa'i skal ba bzang por bdag gyur shog/tsan+dan 'byug dang ste'u sa rdeg pa la//snyoms par zhal 'ches thugasarje snyigs dus 'dir//bskul na 'jig rten gsum gyi duḥkha rnams//mkhyen brtse nus pas pha mtha' mdzad du gsol//'gro mang srogazungs bcu da len bdud rtsi'i gter//myangs pa 'a 'bras bu nam mkhasagazhal dka' ba'i//dge tsho gos ma lus mtha' bral sems can kun//bla med byang chub thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo//zhes tshe'i rig byed mtha' dag gi snying po bsdus pa'i glegs bam gyi che brjod smon lam gyi rim pa 'di ni za hor gyi ban+de sgos sras bas pa'i rdo rjes dmar ser can gyi lo khrums kyi zla ba'i dkar cha'i rgyal ba dang po'i tshes la rgyal khab chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa dza ( /wo bran grong smad pa' gzhas ka mtsho smad khang gsar dang smon grong gnyas200bkyi bogs shas kyi deb ther 'go brjod hrū li 'dod wo/sdos sbyor mnya0pa' prat+ta las mkhasha tshoX ༷/mañdza mā spru t+palā du bya ho sgo kā nu pā ka rngul rgespyi kāsne

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag khu'inabaḥ so mi re ko tsā su mārga1te ti skye kuṭ+wā:bha ghā lha shu go(phyiraḥ /'jam mnyen āt+pal lcags kyus 'jig rten gsum/ /nyer bkug phun tsho gis 'dod dgu 'jo ba'i 'bras/ /lhun po'i spo dang mnyam pa'i phyur bu sa /ches cher spungs shig bcom ldan rig byed lha/ /gser sbyangs ri bo ltar brjid dzam bha la'i/ /phyag gi ni'u les rab skyugs yid bzhin gter/ /nor rgyun sgeg mo'i snye ma las 'ongs pa'i/ /bgrang yas 'bru yis dbyig 'dzin lci bar mdzod/ /tshangs ris srid gsum mgon gyur dri za'i rgyal/ /rgyas pa'i las kun bsgrubs pa 'bar ba rtsal/ /'jig rten kun gyi mkho dgu'i dpal 'byor rnams/ /rang gir dbang du byed par mthu dpung bskyed/ /bsam don lhun grub bkra shis g.yang chags khang / /bre 'bor 'jal (201na tha ston na'i rtse 'jo la/ /kun dga' khong na rgod pa gsar pa'i mgron/ /'chi med yul gyi 'byor bar co 'dri zhing / /gang la mnga' sgyur sa yi drug cha'i khral/ /rje 'bangs so sor drang po'i thig 'debs pa/ /'gyur med yi ge'i 'phreng bar yongs spel ba/ /deb ther me long gdong gi rnam thar bzhin/ /zhes shis pa brjod pas sngun bsus te dmar ser can zhes pa me sbrul gyi lo stod lung mtsho smad khang gsar dang smon grong gi bogs deb gsar sgrigs bkod pa la/(ldeb sbyor mas pa'i brit+ta las me smo phreng ༅/lon hā ra rat+na〉si〉ཿmā na tri/sten na so dzasbu rā pa〉taḥ shā tagu〉su bā ste ṇa nyiXbi sgru'i ṭa be+e shā mā ṇi/tibha r+ṣa dha tu/yid 'phrog rin cen las grub gzhal med khang / /gsum brtsegs lte bar 'dzam bu'i gser zhun ri/ /brgya phrag nyi ma'i gos kyis rab klubs pa/ /rnam mang thos sras 'byor ba'i gru char phob/ khyod 'khor dpal ldan gnod sbyin chen po brgyad/ /(201ba) cang shes rta chog zhon rnams srid gsum yongs/ /myur te rin cen gzhong par srid zhi'i dngos/ /rab bsdus phyur bur gtams la rings pa bzhin/ /'dod 'jo'i ba dang mi zad gter gyi bum/ /dpag bsam ljon shing dbang gi rgyal po ltar/ /mkho dgu'i longs spyod rmugs 'dzin bang mdzod sgo/ /brgya phrag 'byed nus dngos grub lde mig sbyin/ /ci bsam don gyi re 'bras ma lus pa/ /'bad brtson med 'grub bde skyid khang gsar du/ /rnam mang 'bru rigs phun sum tshogs pa'i dpya/ /nyer sdud bla nas blar mthor nyer —249

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)brtsegs 'gro//dkar 'jam shing gi ma ma'i yol go sa/nor bu g.yas 'khyil ming tshig yi ge'i gzugs//rnam dag brjod pa'i deb ther rdzing bu'i ngogs//don bzang ngang mo'i mgrin las dbyangasasnyan sgrogs//zhes shis pa brjod de mtsho smad bsam grub khang gsar dang smon grong gi shas deb me mo sprul lo gsar du sgrigs pa la/sdeb skyor mkho pa'i brit+ta las me bya myos pa/ñdzashrī hi sha ta sprul pra sri tā bro tā ṅgātri rgyu ma hi lta su hi/be+e gu t+pan+d+rayod sha tsakraXti bi sba dzñā zhes twa snye btab bha ga rā sha/202na 'jam dpal rdo rje rigs brgya'i khyab bdag tu//rab bzhengs dus dgra'i dbang po ma he'i zhal//bgragasum 'khor lo'i snang bas 'phrul po cher//ye shes sems dpa' dngos su gzhu grubs ba'i na//phyogs 'dir rgya bod mkhas grub ba ched pa'i srol//skar tshogs dbus na chu shel dbang po ltar//rā chen lo tswa'i dgongs don ma 'khrul ba//gzur gnas dpyod ldan yid kyi gdung sel dpyid//mgon de'i phra rags bskyed rim ting nge 'dzin//rtse gcig thugasadam rten gyi bris sku dngos//mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud ji bzhin gtan tshigs 'dis//'byog bshad som nyi'i dra ba ci yang gcod//de phyir rwa lugs 'jigs mdzad rdo rje la//nges par mkhas shing grub brnyes tshar chen zhes//yab sras smin grol brgyud pa'i gdams pa cher//dbang rnon chos rjes 'brangs nga nas gcag tu dad//'di sgrub ched du ngal ba bsten pa kun//bgrang yas skye bar zur phud lnga ldan de//snying gi pad+ma ra bzhugs nas srid dang zhi'i//'dod pa'i re ba ma lus skong bar shog/ces rwa r+ṣa lo tsā ba rdo rje grags kyi thugs dam rten bris thang shin tu hrul ba zhig lag tu son pa rwa khrid mkha' 'gro snyan brgyud kyi dgongs pa dang mthun pa'i phan tshun gcig gis gcig la gtan tshigs yang dag tu 'gyur bar mthong nas/rwa lugs rna ma par dag pa 'di'o zhes sa dge zhal gsum gyi 'dren byed du gzigs mor 'bul ba'i ched dmar ser can gyi lor zur gyi sngags 'chang 'phrin las rnam rgyal dang 202bslob ma bstan pa tshul khrims gnyis bris shus byed bcug pa'i tshe rgyab yig tu za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'aXm dbyangs grags pa'o//

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mnges gsang theg pa'i ma dros mtsho chen las/ /sman grol gdams pa bshad dka'i chu bo bzhi/ /rin cen lta bu'i gdul bya zla 'phel nang / /'bab 'di skal bzang gdengs can rnams kyi dpyid/ bgrang yas rgyud sde'i rtser son 'dus pa'i gzhung / /snying po rim pa lngar dril yongs rdzogs lam/ /snyigs dusatshe thung gcig la mi slob pa'i/ /zung 'jug khang par bgrod byed man shel skas/ /mtha' gnyis 'khyog 'gror 'phyan min dbu ma sa /srid sgrub nyag phran ltar drang 'phags pa mchog zhang rta chen po'i bzhed srol 'dzin pa la/ /nā ro ta pa paṇa grub 'khor re/ /'jig rten mig gcig chos kyi blo gros kyi/ /zla med slob ma'i mchog gyur rngog ston nas/ /mtha' yas yon tan rgya mtsho chen po'i bar/ /snyan nasasnyan brgyud 'chi gsos bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mtshan gsung zer gyis/ /kun mkhyen bu ston sgra 'dzin ༄ la kha/ /phye las zab don dmar khrid za ma tog /tshe gcig thar 'dod yongs kyi gces pa'i mdzod/ /phra rags bskyed rim tshul la nges rnyed de/ /dben gsum sgyu lus 'od gsal zung 'jug gi /kha sbyor bdun ldan sar bgrod lam po che/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi gshegs pa'i bshul/ /mar lo'i rjes 'jug yin zhes zhal 'ches (203na skos/ /rgyud rgyal snying po'i gnad gsang ma thos par/ /chad ltar gnas lugs phyag rgya'i sgro 'dogs kyis/ /smig rgyus phal cher skoms pa'i gri ru 'chi/ /yid bzhin nor las ches dkon za ma tog /mkhas rlom mang dag ri mo'i mar me ltar/ /gyur tshe tshar pa chos rje'i gsung rgyun la/ /kun mkhyen mkhyen brtses kha 'byed lde mig mdzad/ khres bya'i mtha' 'jal lo chen byang rtse dang / /rgyal ba mchog grub 'jam dkar la sogasapa'i/ /sgyud yig so sor byung las zur brgyan na/ /gangs kyi ri bor zla 'od shar rjes 'gro/ /rtsa bshad rim lnga'i gzhung dang spyod bsdus sogs/ /bka' dang bstan bcos lung gi khungs sbyar bar/ /'byul med rigs pa sprad pa'i rgyas bshad na/ /gser sbyangs rgyan la rin can phra tshom 'dra/ /blo gros nor 'dzin sto bar brjod byed tshig /mang spel ri gling mtsho yis mdzes byed mod/ /byang gling bkra shis rgyal mtshan gsung rab kyis/ /dang po'i las can (r+sād par gcig tu sman/ /so so'i rtags rnams —251—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shenyams myong tshad ma bzhis//rang gi rgyud la yid ches rnyed min par//ting 'dzin ngang du sgo gsum nyer gzhol ba//brgyud ldan bla ma'i phyag len gtso bor bzhed//'on te snga bdo'i dbang gis sngon byon pa//dam pa'i rnam thar 'phyongs par sgrub dka' yang //ma gzugs dmigs rkang sgo sor nan tan gyis//thun du bcad de bstar ba lugs 'di'i srol//bklags lung tsam gyis 'khrid kyi go bcod cing //sbyor ba skyabs sems bor ba'i nyams khrid mkhan//203bsgo bsgoms myong 'bras smra ba'i stong bshad sogs//'phyon ma'i gar gyis gangs can sman ljongs khengs//dal 'byor rten bzang thob kyang 'di 'dra'i chos//sgra 'dzin bu gar ma gyur mtha' klas na//thos bsam sgom par byed pa bskal mang nas//bsags pa'i bsod nams las rnyed da gdod 'khums//yang yang 'jal dka' thabs rgyud yongs kyi rtse//zab zab snying gi thig ler 'chang ba'i chos//gsal gsal rjen par ston pa'i bla ma la//dung dung dad pa dbyar gyi mtsho ltar 'phel//rgyal kun bgrod lam gcig gyur gnad kyi mdud//rgyal ba gnyis pa klu sgrub kyis bkral gzhung //rgyal ba'i rnam sprul bu ston rin cen grub//rgyal tshab tshar chen yab sras drin las dar//rdo rje la4 nas mas sa bral bla ma'i bar//bar ma ho du byon pa'i nor bu'i 'phreng //'phreng mdzes zhal lung srad bur brgyud 'di 'dra//'dra bcos rgyas bkab mkhan gyi spyod yul min//'dir 'bad legs byas sa bon dar drag pa//rab smin myugu bskyed du bsrings pa'i rtser//zung 'jug sku bzhi'i gos bu g.yur za ba//brgya phrag ljags dkyil skye bar ro myong shog/rgya bod mkhas grub thugs dam snying po'i mthil//rim lnga'i nyams len zab mo dmar khrid du//'chad nyan nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa'i rgyun//ma nub de srid dar zhing rgyas par shog/rgyal kun ngo bo mkhan ḍā/ zha lu pa//tshe dbang lhun grub rab tu brtan par shog/ring lugs 'di 'dzin tsho gis rnams rdo rje'i khrir//mi 'gyur 24na༄sa 'khor bskor ba'i rgyu ru bsngo//dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi ngo bo thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i rim lnga'i dmar khrid yid bzhin nor bu'i za ma tog la kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyi kha 'byed

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag khomakyi lde mig gnang ba'i mdzad byang 'phrod lus pa rtsoms shig ces rigs kun bdag po zha lu pa chen po bka' stsal pa ltar phyogs 'di la bag chags kyi mthu cung zad brtas pa za hor gyi ban+de 'jam dbyangasadaga' ba'i bshes gnyen kyis dmar ser can gyi lor sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs grags pa sna(/ /lhaḥyig bzhu mi blugs yi gzugs can du/ /nyer shar mkhyen pa'i srang la shes bya'i khyon/ /gzhal kyang dog min rje btsun btsong kha pa/ /'jam dpal rdo rje dngos las gzhan na ci/ /gang gi gsung rab cha la nyes pa'i dri/ /gaṅgā'i klung rdul tsam yang rnam mkhyen gyis/ /ma rnyed de tshe tshangs pa rgan po sogs/ /'jig rten byed po phal cher gnyid du g.yur/ /'khrul pa'i lhad bral legs bshad sa le sbram/ kho nar nges kyang dzasbu chu bo'i gser/ /ji bzhin rim pa lnga yi gnad gsang kun/ /gsal byed sgron mes 'jig rten gsum mun sel/ /'dzam gling g.yas su bzhag pa nor bu'i dpya/ /phung por spungs pa btsal yang rnyed dka' ba/ /rnam dag brjod pa'i rgyud las nyer drangs gang / /don bzang pi wang sgra dbyangs rna ba'i rgyan/ /ris 'bral kun la chos kyi sbyin pa'i sgo/ /phye bas (204bsgo tha' drug tshul bzhi'i dka' gnad kyi/ /dbul phongs sdug bsngal rnyed yul dmigs med du/ /'tshol 'dod 'byog po'i blo de da ga re/ /bsod nams byas 'dis nges pa lnga ldan skur/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas min bar der mgon khyod kyi/ /legs bshad ro brgya myong ba'i blo gros kyi/ /'bum phrag zad mi shes pa'i skal bzang shog /'di sgrub ched du sgo gsum 'bad pa rnams/ /blo bzang grags snyan 'bar ba'i bstan pa la/ /yang srid kun tu zhugs nas gnas skabs dang / /gtan mdun 'grub pa'i bden tshig 'brasasmin shog /ces rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim gyi gnad don 'grel pa la 'gran pa'i zla thams cad dang bral ba rim lnga gsal ba'i sgron me chos sbyin mi 'dzad pa'i par 'di gsar brko'i 'dun pa yod steng dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bskul ma'i mtshams sbyar ba dang bcas dmar ser can gyi lo dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du brkos pa'i zhu chen —253—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20) dang do dam gnyis ka byed mi yar 'brog pa dge slong blo gros brtan pa/ rtse skor ba dge slong blo gsal mkhas pa/ bkra shis gling pa dge slong smra ba'i dbang phyug gsum dang / yig mkhan blo bzang dam chos/blo bzang nyi ma dga' ldan bstan 'dzin/ kun dga' rnam rgyal/ rkos mkhan dbu mdzad dgos slebs/dbu chung rgyal bkra shis/ byings gras rab brtan/ tshangs 'phel/ gzhung rdor/ nam mkha' rab brtan/rgyal mtshan/ grags pa/ nor bu (205na/lha skyabs/ a gces/ sum 'phel/ rab rgyas/ dpal khang dpal 'bar/ sgrol ba dbang rgyal/ yar 'phel/ tshe ring dpal 'byor/ 'om sbug dpal 'bar/dpung sogs/ gsum pa/ brag sna dbang rgyal/ rdo rje dbang rgyal/ kun dga' tshe brtan/ nor bu tshe brtan/ tshangs skyid/ dkar po/ phun tshogs/ tshe ring dar rgyas/ kun dga' tshul khrims/ 'jam dbyangs rgya mtsho/ snying po/ tshe dbang dpal ldan/ tshangs pa/ 'byor rgyas/ tshangs chen zam rgyal/ rdo rje ba po shis/ rgya mtsho/ kun dga' tshe dbang / shing bzo ba a dkar/ dbu lha 'dri mi ba 'ad pa kun dga' mtha' yas rnams kyis ched du bsgrubs pa'i dkar chag 'di ni za hor gyi rigs las shākya'i btsun pa 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas brgyas pa sarba dza — /gdul bya'i dwangs mtsho me rten dang brten pa'i zla/ shar kyang mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i ri bong can/ /thugs rje'i 'od kyi phan bde'i ku mu da/ /bzhad pas 'gro ba kun sgrol pad dkar 'chang / skyon rnog chos mdzad lnga 'dus pa'i gter/ /snying po'i yang zhun 'phags mchog dkyil 'khor che/ /mthong thos dran reg srid zhi'i rgya mtsho las/ /sgrol ba'i gru chen sngon med legs pa'i lam/ /'dis mtsho ni ngesagasang 'dus sde'i nyer spyad rdzas/ /ston mtshan zla 'dra'i lhag bsam gyis drangs te/ /sgo gsum 'bad pa'i bsod nams gaṅgā'i rgyun/ /yang srid lam brgyud (205ba)byang chub mtshor 'bab shog /ces pa 'di'ang me 'brug dang me sbrul gnyis kyi lor sngags rams pa blo bzang kun dga'/ sngags rams pa blo bzang chos ldan/ lha sa ba ngag dbang dkon cog gsum gyis rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs —254

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shāmibashad gling pa'i dkon gnyer gyi las thog byas skabs spyi rdzas kyi 'jog la thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol gyi dkyil thang mtha' 'jag zhal khebs can/ 'jam dpal tshe bdag rtsa ba'i lha drug gi tsaka li/ bum pa'i mgul chings rgya gos gser ma dkar dmar ljang gsum brtsegs pa gcig /hor gosabum gdan ma gzhi dmar mthongs 'bor lo zur bzhir sna tshogs rdo rje/ mthar rdo rje gsang lam yod pa gcig /yang rgyu gong mtshungs mthongs 'khor lo me tog zlum 'khor dang bkra shis rtags brgyad yod pa gsum/ hor gos tā si me tog ris legs pa'i mchod khebs gcig /dngul gyi pad sder bcu tham pa/ tshogs 'khor bzheng ba'i ljang ser gyi pad sder che nges gnyis dang me tog gi phor pa khebs bcas bzhi/ spron skyogs gcig /ling ro gtor mar 'bul snod kyi thod pa zangs kyi nang sha can gsum/lcags kyi mar lcugs 'then chas cha gcig /ting shag rnams kyi shubs mtshal rtsi gser ris ljang ser gyi par bkab mdzo sna a lung rgyab bzung ba dkri lcags bzung gdan dang bcas pa sum cu so gcig /spos mdong gzhi nag tshon khrag ser shog shing lo 'brug ris ljang ser gyi shan bsdams bzhi dang (206na)rgyab lag bzung ba dkri lcags sgo lcags lde bcas khur thag bzung ba a lung dang bcas pa gsum 'byar cha gcig /chog gra'i dus rdo rje slob dpon gyi nyer spyad rnams 'jog stegs kyi cha sgrom mtshal rtsi gser shog gi pad+ma nor bu rdo rje sgo khyem mtha' 'ja' sogs yod cing yod byad rnams 'jug snod zhan la yong rtsis kyi sgo la ljang ser gyi mdzo sna dkri lcags sgo lcags lde bcas yod pa cha gnyis/ sgam tshon rtsi khra gser shog gi zur dgag pa tra nor gzheng mtha' 'byed sogs yod par lcags shan rgyab lag mdzo sna dkri lcags sgo lcags lde bcas re 'byar ba lcags gdan dang bcas pa che ba cha bzhi/gtor ma rdzi snod ga zlokhe sgor che legs gcig /skyi sgam dmar po lcags shan rgyab lag mdzo sna dkri lcags dang bcas pa gcig /bse ṭo ra mtshal rtsi gser shog dang ldan pa cha gnyis/ dril dmangs gtong dus kyi stod shing khrol mtshal rtsi tshon khra lcags shan ma cha gnyis/ an dar rnams 'jog pa'i khri sgom che ba gcig/ zhun mar 'jug snod sgam lcog gzugs gcig /gdan khri ring ba cha gnyis/ tshe dpag med 255

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shedangs ma bcud 'dren gyi bum gdan pad+ma 'dabs brgyad dang bcas pa'i rgyu song la dge skos thengs zin rnams tshogis thog nas yas bsu mas skyel gyi gong dngul thog tu phab par srang nyis brgya lnga bcu nga gcig zho bdun skar phyed gsum byung 'dug pa 'jog dpangs mtho nges byas pa'i dus dkyil thang rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi bzhes sbyar pa'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o//rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa rta lor deb ther du bkod pa'i mtsho smad bsam grub khang gsar dang smon grong gnyis kyi gzhis ga'i khang tho dang chos rgyal gter bdag gling pas o rgyan smin grol gling du sku gsung thugs rten legs bskrun gyi dkar chag sogs/206ba〉tsho smad bsam grub khang gsar dang smon grong gnyis kyi gzhis ka'i khang tho/ri klung kyi rtsa shing bdag thob lag 'debs kyi zhing dang /son 'gro ma ser bsdad grong khra sogs gto 'bebs kyi de bzer mu tig gi 'khri shing /sdeb spyor mnyam pa'i brit+ta las me r+sā phreng can/de wa mā na bya lha te rma ṇa shun+ta su ka lube riḥdur n+ta sna dha lhas/gre wa su rja pā46sko kyakarwa be+e shra ba rje shu k+ṣa tar+sā la tsa/ lha mi'i 'byor pa ma lus yid bzhin gyis/ /nor bu'i phung po gzugs can mdzod ga cho dza gang //legs skyug mgrin pa btsir nas 'dzin mdzad pa'i//gnod sbyin dbang phyug ngal gsos po des skyongs//ci bsam don rnams 'grub par byed pa'i khang //mes pos gsar du bskrun pa mthong ba'i mod//gzhan yang rab smon dga' bde 'byung gnas grong //waṃ med bdag po'i tshal gyi spun zla bzhin/bgrang bya'i 'phreng bar g.yur za snye ma la//yongs207nas na 'bru sna'i phung po cher dud pa'i//phun tsho gos 'dod dgu g.yang du legs 'khyil tshe//ma rmos lo tog khengs pa phyogs kyis dogs//ci tsam bre 'bor bcal kyang 'dzad med kyi//bdog pa phyur bur nyer spungs 'dzam gling 'dir/ khong min snod gzhan 'tshol la 'khor lo/ lag /mkha' lding zhen nas phyogs bral myul ba

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shāmibazhin/ /mthor brtsegs ba gam yul grong 'bangs kyi grangs/ /gshin po'i sa zhing bskyed byed sa bon tshad/ /ri klungs rkang 'thung 'phreng dang ljang sngon rtsa/ /the tshom mun sel nyi ma'i gzi byin 'bar/ /bzang gos rgyab ldan ras dkar shog bu'i ngos/ brda dag gzugs mdzes yi ge'i g.yas su 'khyil/ /brjod don sgra dbyangs rna ba'i gsos 'jebs pa/ /skye ba lnga pa'i dung dkar 'di na snyan/ /ā li kwa li gsang sngags 'phrul po che/ /'jig rten gsum gyi dngos kun lcags kyu yis/ /deb ther nya phyis khog par mu thi la/ khyur bur skrungs shig lha chen 'dod pa'i rgyal/ /zhes shis pa brjod pa'i tshig sngon du btang ste rgya nag po'i yul grur u 'ur 'bod pa 'byung ba sum ldan sa pho rta'i hor zla dang po'i yar tshes dge bar mtsho smad bsam grub khang gsar dang smon grong gnyis kyi gzhis ka'i khang tho/ ri klungs kyi rtsa shing bdag thob lag 'debs kyi zhing dang son 'gro mi ser bsdad grong gi sgo khra sogs gtan 'bebs kyi deb zer mu tig 'khri shing bkod pa la/bla med ye shes rigs kyi dar dkar khams/ /(207bstabs gnyis tshon gyis dam pa'i skyes bu mā /bsgyur nus tsam la mos blo'i mtsho rdzing nang / /rgyal dang de sras zla bar sgro btags gzhi/ /ngag dbang lha mo'i blo gros skal thob pas/ /nyer mkhas bag yod kyis btsun bzang po'i sems/ pad rtsa'i rjes 'gro rdo rje'i rnal 'byor ma/ /rgya mtsho'i rlabs bzhin yol med gtsor byas te/ /nges par 'phags chen du ma'i snang brnyan 'phreng / /bla ma yi dam chos srung nor lha'i rigs/ /spel legs mgron thabs tshul du rab bkod tshe/ /sgyu ma'i khengs dang dregs pa bag la zha/ /dge 'bras 'jig rten yongs bde thub bstan dar/ /de 'dzin skyes bu zhabs brtan 'dus tshogs 'phel/ /bzo sogs las byed rigs su gtogos pa kun/ /'di phyi'i bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog /bsam grub rgyal po mngon par mtho ba'i rten/ /rim bgrod mi 'jigs bzhi ldan myur thob cing / khul mchis brgyud bcasalha mi'i bde skyid la/ /rab spyod byang chen grong du nyer 'jug shog /'khor ba'i mtha' brgal spyan gyi dkyus/ /ring pos bsam grub rgyal po la/ /gzigs nas gru 'dzin pho brang du/ /drongs shig 'jig —257

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sherten dbang phyug kye/ /bslu med dkon cog gsum gyi 'bangs/ /bde ldan zhing gi mgon po yis/ /bsam 'grub rgyal po spyon yul/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i gnas su khrid/ /drang por srong ba'i btsan po'i khrims/ /dge bcur gangs can 'gro 'god par/ /sgam po'i blo ldan mi'i dbang gis/ /bsam 'grub rgyal po'i rjes su bzung / /tshangs pa
