(208na sko yi me tog dpal/ /mnga' bdag khri srong lde btsan gyis/ /'jam dpal rdo rje'i sa chen por/ /bsam 'grub rgyal po nye bar sbyor/ /ga smi ra yi grub thob kyi/ /'bor los sgyur ba dgon pa bas/ /rgyal kun thugs kyi rdo rje yi/ /ngo bor bsam 'grub rgyal po sgyur/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba ma lus pa'i/ /'byung gnas 'brom ston chen po yis/ /bsam 'grub rgyal po tshe rabs kun/ /rlabs chen spyod pa mchog la sbyor/ /'khon rigs 'jam mgon sa skya pas/ khams 'dus gsum gyi 'phrang gegs las/ /bsam 'grub rgyal po nyer bsgral te/ /zung 'jug go 'phang thob byin rlobs/ /zhang ston brtson 'grus grags pa yi/ /sprul sgyur sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul gyis/ /bsam 'grub rgyal po srid lam du/ /dub las bde ba'i ngal gsor mdzod/ /mnga' bdag thugs rje'i nyi ma yi/ /'od zer bkye bas 'khor ba'i mun/ /bsal te bsam 'grub rgyal po gang / /snang ba longs sku'i zhing du drongs/ /dge 'bum sprul pa'i 'tsho byed kyi/ /dam chos rtsi sman ljon pa yis/ /bsam 'grub rgyal po dug lnga'i nad/ /mnar las drung nas 'byin par mdzod/ /bgrang yas theg gsum dge 'dun gyi/ /dbang phyug mkhas dang grub pa yis/ /bsam 'grub rgyal po skye ba kun/ /legs pa'i lam la rtag 'god mdzod/ /rab dkar dge la 'dun pa'i thugs/ /rgya mtsho lta bur gting zab pas/ /bsam 'grub rgyal po yang srid kun/ /rnam dag bstan par 'jug byin rlobs/ /lus can mtha' (208bkres bsod na mas tshogos/ /dbyar gyi rgya mtsho ltar 'phel bas/ /bsam 'grub rgyal po sa bcu yi/ /them skas gong nas gong 'dzeg shog /zag med bde ba chen po'i dpal/ /chos kyi rgyal po mthu stobs bdag /bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa ma lus las/ /bsam 'grub rgyal po skyab tu gsol/ /lhas byang gling pa'i ma gnyis cho go dang / jus yags/ blo bzang lhun grub/ dung skyong bkra shis spun khyo shug rnams kyi rgya bod —258

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khog dang rin po che'i mchod rdza khang bzang gi dkar chag 9yikyi rgyal blon paṇa grub la 'dod lha sna tshogs kyis bskor ba'i bris thang gra tshar bzhengs pa'i gtso bo smig rgyu chur sgro btags kyis nged rang gi 'dra 'bag bris pa'i ri mo pa dbu mdzad lhun po/ /bsod nams rgyal po/ dge bsnyen rgyal po/ mang bskur rgyal po/ snye mo ga me/ dan 'bag rin cen rdo rje/ rta mgrin/dgos bsam/ a lkug /lha byin bdud btsan/ 'phrin las/ lam rnyed/ gong sham pa dbu mdzad skyon/nor bu yar 'gro/ gro lhug rnams kyi ming tho sa bon dang bcas rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa dza ( /༷ wā ra'i rdul brtsegs lha be+e ga khams/ /zhun ma'i dngas cha 'jo sgeg mtshan dpe'i gzugs/ /zur phud lnga pa mi yi rol gar mkhan / khres bya kun gzigs blo bzang grags pa la/ /bla ma yi dam chos srung tshogs rnams kyis/ /legs bskor lha lam ngos su dbang gzhu ltar/ /rab bkra smon 'dun lhun grub rgya mtsho yis/ /mi phyed dad pa'i rten du yongs bzhengs 'bras/ /dge tsho gos gaṅgā'i yab gcig rtse mo nas/ /chad (209na thad 'bab pa'i bde skyid lhung lhung sgra/ /snyan po byang chen bar gyi rna rgyan can/ /sku bzhi'i chu gter klong du rogacig shog khres pa 'di'ang spun bdun pa lhun grub rgya mtshos rab zhengasabris thang gi rgyab yig dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'o/ /tshangs pa'i yul sa man gyi 'byor pa kun/ /gcig tu 'khyil ba'i rba rlabs srid pa'i rtser/ /rab phyur rin cen sna tsho gos yongs 'dus snod/ /nor 'dzin lto ba dog por 'geng byed 'di/ /mchog dman kun gyi bsod nams bye ba'i gter/ /bgrang yas sgo 'phar phye nas lus can rnams/ /'di dang gtan mdun 'grub par 'dus pa'i sde'i/ /phul byung thugs rje'i byin rlabs de med byung / /sa rta spyi sos dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi tshogs khro gsar du blug pa'i kha byang bsod nams zla ba'i 'khri shing 'di nyid za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pas brgyas pa sirnyi ra stu/phun tsho gos ro brgya bda' ba'i bcud bzang ngad/ /nam yang zad pa'i mtha' dang bral 'bab pas/ /—259

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)sa gsum phung po sto bar dog min pa/ /ngo mtshar bkod pas khyad 'phags yol go 'di/ /gangs can dang po'i 'bras spungs chos kyi sder/ /thos dang bsam pa'i phyir 'dus sdom brtson rnams/ /ngo mos med longs su spyad bas yon sbyor tshogs/ /chos dkar rdul bral ston zla ltar gyur cig /sa rta spyi sos dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi tsho gis khro gsar du blug pa'i (209ba)kha byang bsod nams sgo brgya yongs khe 'di nyid za hor gyi bzhes bkod pa'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags ram pas bgyis pa sirnyi ra stu/ /gser sbyangs rtsibs brgyad 'khor lo'i lte ba mā /skye ba lnga pa'i bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil/ khrug dkar g.yu yi phra tsho mos bkod legs can/ /dpyod ldan yongs kyi 'dren byed gzigs mor mtshar/ /rgya ljangs bzo yi rig byed 'phrul po che'i/ /sa zla sna tshogs gzugs ngos rin po che/ /mtha' klas pir gyis bris pa'i shel tshon bzhin/ khyad 'phags mdzes byed rgyan du legs spud 'bras/ /chos srid zung 'jug stobs kyi 'khor lo yi/ /dbang phyug dam pa'i dpal la mnga' 'byor zhing / /byed por rtogasakun rdzu snyul rkang par brten/ /skal brgyar 'gro rnams thar par 'dren gyur cig zhes sa skyong blo bzang sbyin pas khur bzhes/ do dam pa dbu ma bsod nams dbang rgyal/ gting skyes tshe dbang lhun po/ bal po tshe ring/ shākya mu ni/ bha gi shing / ka ṇa dza ti/ de'u dza ti/ gos bzo dbu mdzad mtshan ldan rnams kyis byas te shākya mu ni'i mgul rgyan gsar bzhengs/ rnying pa'i so bran gyi tshe kha byang du za hor gyi bzhes sbyar pa'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pas bgyis pa mo ga laḥ ( / /ma a thā/ ris med 'gro ba'i srog song bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /bas kyi nying khu rgyud bzhi'i za ma rta go /yongs 'khyil dka' gnad 'grel la legs bshad tshogs/ /'tshol de grags(210na)pa don ldan zur mkhar ba/ /rtsa bshad phyi ma'i sa go dang po yan/ /gangs can gso rig 'dzin kun snying dbus su/ /gces nor chos sbyin mdzad pa med pa'i bar/ /nam mkha'i mdzod sgo dbye ba'i do zla brel/ /rdul bral ston slar 'gran pa'i lhag bsam can/ /yar stod dar mo blo bzang chos grags kyis/ /bskul pa'i zhus chen rnam gling paṇ+ḍi ta/ /gtsug lag bye bar mig dkyus ring des so/ /skye bar dug lnga'i mal du 'byar —260

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shāmiba'i 'bras/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i bro nad gnyid po cher/ /g.yur rnams 'bod pa'i gso rig skya rengs mas/ /phan bde nyi ma'i snang ba rtag 'dren shog /lha dang drang srong phyi nang rig byed rnams/ /rgyas bshad snying por dril kun thos bsam gyis/ /chol kha gsum gyi yangs pa'i sa chen bor/ /yongs khyab 'gro ba'i gnyen du 'gyur bar shog /ces lus can kun la rigs su ma chad pa'i spyi nor chen po rgyud bzhir grags pa'i rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud yongs rdzogs dang / phyi ma'i rgyud kyi rtsa mdo yan gyi rnam bshad zur mkhar ba legs bshad 'tshol gyis mdzad pa'i mes po'i zhal lung dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du par du bskos pa'i tshe za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa sirnyi ra stu/oṃ swā sti pra dza saḥ 'gro 'dren sems kyi rtsa ba rab brtan par/ /rlabs chen sdong po'i yal 'dabs rgyas pa'i rtser/ /sku bzhi'i ro brgya (210ba thad 'a ba'i 'bras bzang can/ /'dren mchog yongs 'du'i dbang pos shis pa stsol/ /rnam gsum 'khor lo'i gzugs brnyan mgon khyod bstan/ /dri bral me long ngos 'char dge ba'i bshes/ /'jam zhing ches dul legs bshad dbyangs bdun rtsal/ /rab rdzogasasnyan pa'i grags pa nyer 'bar ba/ /'dir snang srid 'brul rol gar bkrag po che/ /phyi ma'i nying mtshams dmar 'od sprin rum phag /nyal tshe bslab gsum yon tan bla nas blar/ /'phel phyir nye bar gnas pas mang bsgrubs las/ /sa zla mkha' mtsho'i grangs su rab longs zho/ /nyer lngas lhag pa'i dngul dkar nyis brgya'i srang / /mes bsgyur 'byung ba'i nya gar legs sbrel zangs/ /muk+ta ka dang drug dkar drug dmar g.yu/ /byu ru sbur len man shel gyis mtsho ni pa/ /sna tshogs rin cen phra tshom kun gsal ngos/ /dbang po'i gzhu ris lta bur rnam bkra bar/ /yongs grub bkra shis sgo mang mchod rten la/ /thub dbang mchog zung gnas brtan bcu drug dang / /dharma ta la ha shang rgyal chen bzhi/ /sangs rgyasakun 'dus rje btsun btsong kha pa/ /'jam dbyangs grags pa'i snang brnyan legs 'phul bar/ /yungs 'bru lta bu'i rnam 'dren ring bsrel gsum/ /srong btsun phul byung blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs/ /'jam —261—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)dpal rgya mtsho dbyangs can bzhad pa'i sde/ /mtha' yas bsod nams mchog gi rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag blo bzang chos rgyal mtshan/ /dam chos rnam rgyal rta tshag sprul sku dang / /rje drung sku (211na ji dge bdun dbang phyug sogs/ /du ma'i sku bal sku gdung ches mang ba/ khyad par yongs 'dzin nyid kyi snam sbyar tshems/ /phyag 'phreng mgul du bcangs pa'i srung bar bcas/ /rgya bod mkhas dang grub pa'i tsho gis rnams kyi/ /dam rdzas mtha' klas gcig tu legs bsdebs pa/ /'phags pa gsum dang paṇa grub 'jig rten mig /ris su ma chad thub pa'i ring lugs la/ /bzang po'i phyag gi ri mo bkra mang dang / /myong bas rnam grol bdud rtsi chos kyi sman/ /skye 'dun bram ze'i sha ril bsgrubs shing 'phel/ /dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i rgyud kyi dgongs don bzhin/ /bdud rtsi ril bu rten 'dam dpe bral ma/ /sa skya'i 'jam mgon las brgyud byin rten rgyun/ /dge zhal dwags shangs zhi byed la sogs pa'i/ /rten 'dam bsdus pa'i ril bu bgrangs su yas/ /rwa sgreng shug pa'i rgyur grub srog shing ngos/ /bri bya'i gzungs sngags mthong ba'i brgyud ltar bris/ /bla ma'i mtshan sngags gsang 'dus gshed skor rigs/ /bde dgyes dus 'khor gyis mtsho ni bla na med/ /yo ga bya spyod khyad par gzungs chen lnga/ /mdo las byung ba'i gzungs sngags ji snyed pa/ /chos sku'i ring bsrel tshogs kyis phyur bur gtams/ /thub dbang rje btsun blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /tshe dpag med dang rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs/ /bla ma rgyal ba srasabacas sku'i snang bas/ /'khor lo bar pa'i yang snying brgyad stong pa/ /mdo sngags gnyis kyi las rim pad spungs btsos/ /sku gsung thugs rten rigs mang ji snyed bskrun/ /(211brdzing khrir cho so skyong srung ma nor lha'i sngags/ /gnod sbyin pho dgu mo dgu 'khor lo sbyar/ /tog nas rmang bar so so'i gnas rnams su/ /gzhug bya go rim zhabrul ba dang bral bar/ /tshas dang dri bzang rin cen 'bru sna ja/ /gang la 'os pa'i bdog pa phyur bur spungs/ /lag tu nyer bstar ri khrod dga' ldan pa'i/ /slob dpon blo bzang rnam par rgyal ba dang / /gnyug mar gnas pa 'dus pa'i tsho gis rnams kyis/ /bcu gsum lha yi 'khor lo la brten nas/ /kyi dus pho nyar yongs grags sa pho rta/ /nag zla'i rgyal dang gang ba gsum pa'i —262

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mnyin//dam tshig sems dpar ye shes dngos bcug ste//rab tu gnas pa'i me tog char du bsnyil//tshul 'di'i ched du sgo gsum ngal ba'i khur//dad dang brtson pas phrag par nyer len pa//bla ma'i mched po blo bzang mkhas mchogo ces//bcu phrag dka' gnas 'dzin pa gang des so//lhag bsem gaṅgā'i yab gcig las babs pa'i//mkhrod dge ba skal ldan shing rta'i klung //'gro rnams byang chen rgyu tshogs chu gter dang //dbyer med gyur te 'dzad bral 'phel bar shog/yon sbyor bzo bo tshig gi mtha' brten pa'i//phan par sgrub bcas 'di snang bde skyid rgyas//yang srid kun tu mtho ris lam rgyud nas//rnam mkhyen mchog gi grong du 'jug par shog/ces chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam po yab yum gsum gyis rigs gsum mgon po bsgrubs nas yi dam lha'i lung bstan ltar bod srin mo gan rgyal du bsnyel ba 'dra ba'i 22na lo'i me btsa' rnams btab ste phan bde'i 'byung gnas ra sa 'phrul snang gtsug lag khang bzheng bar mdzad pa'i gnas kyi thog ma pha bong kha byang chub shing gi gdan sa pa chos rje 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i phyi rten du dka' bcu pa blo bzang mkhas mchog gis khur blangs nas bkra shis sgo mangs kyi mchod rten rgyug mtho brgyad pa bzhengs pa'i tshe dkar chag dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas 'gyis pa sirnyi ra stu/sdeb sbyor mnya pa'i brit+ta las zlum po/8ga9brag dzi/ṭa tā rdo kā ṇ+ḍakwa na nā 'ardza dra tsā:muk+ta kā tir:mi〉mā smro be+e tsār+sās mya go mu kha twa/tshogs gnyis phung po yongs spungs drod kyis chos smin gser gyi sgong sbubs rgya//mngon par grol las 'khor 'das spyi mes tshad med bzhi ldan zhal sgo nas/22ba ) lha bsharnya gu bh+ya ga lha yurga ta kuṇ+ḍa na kā ma mo tsa sen yadzuḥni yun hi ru pa rgyu shā tanan+da lnga shi yasmosrid zhi'i dge legs snying por phyur ba chos nor 'dod dang thar pa'i sde//matso sbyin lo ḍi yā na'i mkhan po dga' ba brgya pas shis pa stsol//swā sti ka yi sgrar drangs rab snyan glu//mig mi 'dzum rnams mgrin mtshor rtag len dang //lhan cig mkha' la gom ba/da man+da ra'i//char 'bebs phun sum tshogs pa'i

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)rnga chen rdungs/ /chu skyesa'adab ma'i reg byasabaskrun min pa/ /'jam mnyen yid kyi brtan 'phrog marga dpe'i sku/ /'dod lha'i snying la rtsub pa'i tsher rnon can/ /rdzogs sangs rgyasazhabasardul dmar 'gro gtsug bsten/ /thog mtha' bar dge'i tshangs dbyangasadzam bu'i 'bras/ /'gro rgyud dbang po dang 'tsham mtshor lhungs mod/ /(213na)phan bde'i gser gyi snye ma 'dzad med mdzod/ /rnam byang bar du spyad bya dam pa'i chos/ /de don nyams bstar blo gros gom pa yis/ /mthon por bteg nasasalam bzhul ring por/ /ring bgrod gzhan dag der khrid dge 'dun zhes/ /mchog gsum gtan gyi skyabs song phyag bya'i gnas/ /kun khyab kun tu bzang po'i mkha' dbyings nas/ /rdor semasachu lha'i bu yi 'od snang gis/ /sgrib gnyisadug gzhil rig 'dzin rnams kyi thugs/ /dngasamatshor theg mchog gza' skar ri mo bkra/ khyad par rgyal kun spyi gzugasapad+ma 'byung / /bi mā mi tra'i zhal lung phab rtsi yi/ /langasapa'i bka' gter chang myos rig pa 'dzin/ /zab don rgyang glu len pasaljongs 'di khengs/ /rma galhags so zur gnubasasogs he ru gaḥ gosadakar lcang lo'i zol gyi mi gzugasacan/ /skal bzang gdul bya mngon sum sangs rgyas par/ khrid 'dis rnam 'dren lhag po gzhan na med/ /ma dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung mngar po'i gter/ /sgo 'byed gong 'og gling pa bcu gcig sogs/ /brgya phrag bod 'bangasabade skyid srog zungs su/ /nyer song nor bu'i 4nga ba 'dzad med ring / /bye brag lo go be+e ro tsa na yi/ /yang srid rak+ṣa rdo rje kun skyong mtshan/ /'dzin sogs skyes rabasamang brgyud chos kyi rgyal/ /gter bdag gling par gragasa'abar dbyangasade snyan/ /gang de'i zab gter lung bzhin a+yon rje'i/ /smin grol rgyud bshad 'dzin pa rig sngags 'chang / /'du ba'i (213bskornyo la yi bkod pa'i dpyid/ /'dzam gling mdzes byed rgyan gyi rtse mor son/ /zhes shisabarjod phyag bya dngos po nges bstan gyi sgo nas tshigs su bcad pasasngun bsus te skabs don gleng par bya ba ni/ /ji skad du/ /'gro ba'i bla ma 'jig rten la/ /bu gcig bzhin du gzigasapa lags/ /ji ltar chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa yang / /ring nasalo tog 'phel ba ltar/ /dam pa'i thugasarjesami 'dor bas/ /bdag cag mgon dang bcasapa lags/ /zhesa'agro ba —264—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mamatha' dag gi ma 'dris pa'i skyabs dang mgon dang dpung gnyen rnam 'dren yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sras dang slob mar bcas pa rnams kun la gzigs pa lhur mdzad pa sprin gyi phung po lasababs pa'i char gyi lo tog 'phel ba dang dper gsungs pa bzhin/ skye rgu mtha' dag gi phan pa dang bde ba ma lus pa bstan pa rin po che bsod nams kyi zhing du byas pa la brten nas 'byung bsan/ mdo las/ bsod nams rnam smin bde ster sdug bsngal thams cad sel/ /bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yi bsam pa rnams kyang 'grub/ /bdud bcoms nas ni byang chub myur du reg par 'gyur/ /mya ngan lasa'adas zhi ba bsil ba'i dngos po thob/ /ces srid pa dang zhi ba'i yon tan thams cad legs byas kyi mthu kho na las 'byung zhing / de 'phel ba'ang rgyal ba'i bstan pa la rag lus pa'i phyir sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa'i dus sgron me'i bskal ba dang / ma byung ba'i tshe mun pa'i bskal par bshad cing / sgron bskal gyi nang nas(214na tha skal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas stong ngam stong dang lnga sogs bshad tshul mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig byung yang / bzhi pa 'o skol gyi ston pa kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa yin par mthun zhing / de'i mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i dbye ba mkhas grub rnams kyi bzhed srol mang yang skabasa'adir gleng bar 'os pa rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po/ mdo sde thams cad kyi za ma rtag /theg pa kun gyi rtse rgyal/ gsang chen rnying mar grags pa'i lugs la mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo ye shes 'tsho rgyal gyis/ phyi rgyud dag pa sprul skus bstan pa 'dzin/ nang rgyud dag pa longs skus bstan pa 'dzin/ /gsang rgyud dag pa chos skus bstan pa 'dzin/ /ces pa ltar/ sprul pa'i sku shākya thub pas gsungs pa'i theg pa gsum ni/nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ byang sems kyi theg pa/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rdo rje sems dpa' gsungs pa la/ kṛ ya/ u pa/ yo ga gsum ste gsang sngags phyi'i theg pa/ snang(sku kun tu bzang pos gsungs pa la/bskyes pa ma hā yo ga /lung a nu yo ga /rdzogs pa chen po a ti yo ga ste gsang sngags nang gi theg pa bla na med pa dang bcas pas theg pa rim pa dgur 'chad cing / yang phyi'i rgyud sdodang / nang gi rgyud sde gnyisalas/ phyi rgyud kṛ ya'am bya rgyud rnams ston pa shākya thub pa nyid kyis gsungs/ u pa'am spyod rgyud dang —265

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)yo ga ste rnal 'byor gyi rgyud rnams ni rnam par snang mdzad kyis gsungs/ nang bla med kyi rgyud rnams ni rdo rje 'chang chen (214ba)pos chos 'byung yangs pa'i zhing khams su gsungs par bshad/ des na sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dang 'jig rten gyi khams kyang bsam gyis mi khyab/ 'khor ba'i sems can dang nyon mongs pa yang bsam gyis mi khyab/ de dag thams cad 'dul ba'i gnyen por byon pa'i sprul pa'i sku yang bsam gyisami khyab/ grangasamed brjod du med pa sprul zhing / chosardzogasapa chen po'i klong dgu/ bam po nyi khri chig stong / le'u 'bum phrag lnga la sogs pa'i sgo mtha' yas pa dag dang / rdzogs pa chen po'i dgongs 'dus rtsa ba'i rgyud drug la sogs pa bya rtsol las 'das pa'i chos theg pa'i rtse mo'i yang rtse mu med pa dag /ston pasazhal nasam gsungasapar/ /'khor gyi rtog dpyod blo la snang / /zhesagatso 'khor tha dad pa ma yin pa de'i phyir/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor chu nang du gsal ba'am me long la bzhin rasashar ba lta bu'i dgongasapa la dusa'ada' ba ṣ+ka do/ /de yang nub phyogasaskyon dang / rgya gar gyi yul dbusashar/ lho nub/ nai pa la sogasasu rdo rje theg pa'i chosargya cher dar na'ang gsang sngagasagasar rnying du tshig la btagasapa med kyang / don gyi cha la mdo rgyud semasagasum/ bka' brgyad spyi bye brag /theg pa rim pa dgur dbye tshul sogs brjod bya'i sgo nas thob cing de dag las phyogs 'dir dam pa'i chosadar ba'i thog mar mi'i 'gro ba chags tshul la/ mkhas pa'i dbang po stag tshang lo tsā ba sogs bod kyang rgya bal sogs yul gru gzhan dang 'dra bar thog ma nas mi'i (215na)'gro ba chags par bzhed pa rig pa bcug na 'thad par mngon mod/ 'on kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi 'khor los bsgyur pa 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud le'u so drug pa'i bdag nyid can las/ nga yi dus nas lo brgya na/kha ba can du mtsho bri nas/ /sā la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes thog mar mtshosagang ba rim gyis bri nas shug pa la sogs pa'i nags chags pas sā la'i ljongs su grags/ yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i ya rgyal du byed pa bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las/ bod yul du ni lhan skyesate/ /zhi zhing gsal ba'i gzugasacan ma/ /chu srin rgyal mtshan lag na thogs/ /brag gi khyim la brten te gnas/ /rang —266—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mabyung gi ni skye gnas can/ /zhes gsal bar yang bstan/ slob dpon shes rab go chas/ skya seng bu lnga dang / dgra ngan dpung tshogs yan lag bcu gnyis 'thabs pa'i tshe/ rgyal po rū pa ti zhes dmag stong phrag gcig dang bcas bud med kyi chas su zhugs te ri gangs can gyi dbus su bros pa las mched par bshad cing / yongs su grags pa spyir 'dzam bu gling pa'i mi rigs la bar nang gsum las/ rgyal rigs/ rje rigs/ bram ze'i rigs/ dmangs rigs te phyi rigs bzhi/ rgya gar lha/ rgya nag klu/ hor lha ma yin/ bod spre'u ste bar gyi rigs bzhi zhes byung ba'i thugs rje chen po dang sgrol mas byin gyisabarlabs pa'i spri'u dang brag srin mo 'dus pa las 'gro ba rigs drug nas tshe 'phos pa'i gdong dmar sha zan gyi phrug gu mdog (215brko byibs bya spyod sogs mi 'dra ba drug byung zhing/ de dag las mang du 'phel bar zas dkon pa'i tshe spre'u byang chub sems dpas ri bo po ta lar 'phags pa la zhus pa'i 'bru sna mang po stsal ba rnams bto nas ston thog byung ba'i tshe/ zo dang byas pas zo dang gong po rir grags/ jo bo chen po dpal mar me mdzad kyis 'phrul snang ka gzhu nas spyan drangs pa'i bka' chems ka khol mar/ sbrel phrug spun bzhi rgyal po de tshan pa bzhir 'thabs pa dang mes pos bar mtshams byas te zhing la cha bzhin bgos/ gcig la gcig 'jigs nas tshan bzhin chad pas sa dang / rmu dang / sdong dang / stong ste nang mi'u rigs bzhi dang bcu gnyis po rigs kyi phyi mor grags/ la lar mi'u gdung drug zer ba ngos 'dzin mi 'dra ba 'ga' zhig snang ba spyan snga rin po che bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i yig tshang du/ dga' sdong 'bru gsum dgra dang bzhi/ nu bo dpa' mda' gnyis te drug tu bzung zhing / si tu thams cad mkhyen pas deb dmar du/ ma sangs sbun dgu/ rgyal phran nyi shu rtsa lnga/ bcu gnyis/ sil ma bzhi bstos ma gyis dbang byas par bshad pa ltar rgyal phran sil ma sna chogs byung yang spyi la dbang sgyur ba zhig ma byung na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'phel ba'ang ches dka' ba'i phyir rigs gsum mgon po/ sgrib pa rnam sel/ kun bzang sogs 'phags chen dam pa'i rnam 'phrul gyi rgyal po byon zhing /glegs bam rin po che'i lha'i rgyal po'i le'ur/ da hril te dril na/ sngon (216na)gyi rgyal blon byang chub —267

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)sems dpa' de dag gas gsum mgon po'i sprul par grags te/ ral pa can la sogs pa gcig gnyis 'jam dpal rigs/ gzhan phyag rdor yin gyi/ phal cher ni mgon po spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas nyid yin la/ mkhan rgyud byang chub sems dpa' de rnams ni nga kho na nyid yin gyi gzhan du ma sems shig gsungs nas spyan hur mdzad ces pa ltar/ bod kyi lha btsan po rim byon rnams 'phags pa phyag na pad+mo'i sprul pa kho nar gsungs mod/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rnam par sprul pa ni mtha' klas pas gcig tu gtan tshigs kyis bsgrub par dka'/ 'on te rgyal ba'i 'phrin las kyi sgo 'phar 'jug pa'i rten 'brel du bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal po'i thog mar rgya gar gyi rgyal po dmag brgya pa'i sras mig mas 'gebs g.yu'i smin ma dang dung so 'khor ma lag pa'i mthil du 'khor lo'i ri mo yod pa'i mi las 'das pa zhig btsas pa/ lha 'dre'i sprul pa lta bur dogs nas sprugs pa lha ri gyang tho'i rtser byon nas gzigs pa na yar klungs yul gyi dge mtshan phun sum tsho gos pa dang / sham po'i gangs ri dpyad bzang bar mkhyen cing / lha ri rol po'i steng nas lha skasabargyud btsan thang sgo bzhir byon pas phyugs skyong ba sogs 'ga' zhig gis mthong ste dris pa na gnam la mdzub mo ker bas lhar ngos bzung nas gnya' bar khri byas gdan drangs pas gnya' khri (216ba)btsan por grags/ bon rnams dmu thag las brgyud nas 'ongs zer/ gang ltar bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal po'i thog ma yin/ de nas rgyal rabs nyer bdun 'das pa na lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan pho brang yum bu bla sgang na bzhugs pa'i tshe/ dpang sgong phyag rgya pa/ gser gyi mchod rten/ mdo sde za ma tog gi snying po yi ge drug pa/ tshin+ta ma ṇi'i rkos phor rnams pho brang gi yang thog tu babs pa na dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes/ gang yin mi shes kyang bzang por go ste/ gnyan po gsang bar btags nas mchode pa rgya cher mdzad pas rgyal po slar yang gzhen sha can du gyur nas lo bzhi bcu 'phar bas kun dril lo brgya nyi shu thub/ de yang / rgyal po dza'i khang steng du glegs bam gyi char babs tshe mdo za ma tog rlung gis khyer nas yum bu bla snang bi rtser babs pas bod du chos dar ba'i rten 'brel 'grig zer/ de nas rgyal 268

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhongs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag 9yirabs lnga na/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud chen las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan 'di la/ /rnam pa sna tsho gis bya ba byed/ /byang gi phyogs la brten nas ni/ /de yi tshe na 'byung bar gyur/ /lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ /gangs can ri yi nang gnas pa'i/ /rgyal po mi yi lha zhes pa/ /li tsa gyi rnams rigs su 'byung / /de yang sngags kyi don sgrub ste/ /longs spyod tshe dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rig pa longs spyod ldan zhes bya/ /mi yi bdag pos de yang grub/ /lo ni brgyad cur rgyal srid byed/ ces dang / 'jig rten sgron ma zhesagrags dang / /lha mo gos dkar (217na〉〈 dang ni/ dkar mo chen mo gzhan phan brtson/ /zhes pa'i don bzhin chos skyong ba'i rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos chos blon thon mi sam bho ṭa rgya gar du brdzangasate bod du yi ge med pa la 'bri klog gi srol btod glegs bam rin por cher/ rje dkon cog 'bangs ni bod du 'gro /bod glo bur rgyal po chos la spyod/ /bod mtha' 'khob yul rnams 'dul bar byed/ nga rgya nag yul nas der drangs te/ /mi kho la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang / /nga 'jig rten sgron ma zag med la/ /mi kho bo'i bas mo byed do skad/ /rgya nag po'i mchod gnas bod du 'dren/ /bod yul gyi dbusasu byed do skad/ /ces 'o skol gyi ston pa dgung lo brgyad pa dang bcu gnyis pa'i sku sgo sangs rgyasadangos kyi zhal bkyin gdan 'dren pa'i ched 'jig rten mthun 'jug gi tshul du khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa bal mo bza' khri btsun dang / sgrol ma'i rnam sprul rgya mo bza' ong jo zhes mtsho nang gi pad+ma ra gragasapa gnyis khab tu bsus/ 'phrul snang gi gtsugs lag khang brtsig par mi ma yin gyis 'tshe ba la brten skyid gshod nyang bran pha bong kha pho brang ma rur grags par rgyal po yab yum gsum sku mtshams mdzad nas yi dam gyi lha bsgrubs pas 'grub ste/ lung bstan ltar bod srin mo gan rkyal tu bsnyel ba'i me tsa rnams su mtha' 'dul yang 'dul/ ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang rnams brtsigs shing / sa dgra ngan pa rnams bcos/ 'phrul snang ra mo che'i rten brten par bcas pa rnams bzhengs/ ka (217bsgo blol mar chos rgyal 'di'i ring la/ rgya gar nas slob dpon ku sar dang / bram ze sha ka ra bal po'i dpon slob dpon shī la ma lha rgya nag gi slob dpon hwa shang ma hā ya na la sogs pa spyan drangs nas sde snod gsum 269

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)dang / rgyud kyi cha lag mang rab sgyur zhing bstan pa'i srol btod/ dngos su 'chad nyan ma byung yang rgyal po rang gis skal ldan mang por lkog cho ge su thugs rje chen po zhi khro'i gdams pa phog ste nyams su blangs shing / sad mi mi bdun rab tu ma byung phan nyang bran pha bong khar thugs rje chen po'i rnal 'byor spyod pa'i ral pa can brgya phrag tsam rgyun du byung bar bshad/ dus der gsungs pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdo mes pa gter kha gsum du byas pa/ grub thob dngos grub/ mnga' bdag nyang / shāka 'od gsum gyis gter nas gdan drangs pa'i deng sang ma ṇi bka' 'bum zhes grags che ba 'di yang gsang sngags rnying ma'i zab chos su gtogs pa kho na yin/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga na rje btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan ni mes srong btsan gyis/ da ste gdung rabs lnga na nga'i dbon sras rgyal po lde zhes bya ba'i ring la dam pa'i chos 'byung ba'i lung bstan zangs kyi byang bu la bris nas de'i phyag sbal du bcug pa'i don thog tu babs te dam pa'i chos dar bar mdzad pa'i thugs bsam bskyed nas za hor gyi mkhan po shan+ta rak+ṣi ta spyan drangs/ 'ga' zhig la yan lag brgyad pa'i khrims phabs/ dge ba bcu dang khams bco brgyad dang mthun pa'i chos gsungs par bod kyi lha srin gdug pa can rnams khros te (218na)thang lhas dmar po rir thog phab/ kham pos yar klungs phan thang chu la bskur/ /bstan ma bcu gnyis kyis mi nad phyugs nad btang bas bon blon sogs mang pos chos byas pas lan zhes sgro skur byas/mkhan pos btsad po la kho bos rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pa la sbyangs/ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan yang lha srin rnams mi thul bar 'dug pas 'dzam bu gling na che ba'i rig sngags grub pa skyon gyi slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas bya ba gdan drangs na bzhed pa 'grub pa lkog tu lung bstan pa mnal lam du byung ba ltar mdzad nas/ pho nya mngags pa bzhin slob dpon chen pos lha 'dre thams cad dam la btags nas zung mkhar mdar btsad po dang mjal/ brag dmar mgrin bzang du bzhugs/ skabs shig dusakyi dga' ston chen po zhig la rje'i dbu skra 'byu bar brtsams pa'i tshe mkhan chen zhi ba 'tshos ri rab gyi byang ngos na chu mig rtag tu snang ba bya ba yod pa nas chu blangs na sku tshe rigs brgyud 'phel zhing mnga' —270

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (7thang che bas/ len pa'i rngo sus thogs gsungs par/ blon po rnams kyis slob dpon sngags mkhan gyis nus sam zhes gsol ba ltar zhal gyis bzhes nas dar dkar gyis kha bcad pa'i gser gyi bum pa mkha' la bskyur bas je mthor song nas mi snang ba las/ re zhig na nyi logs su dkrong gi byung ba pho nya bar gnang ba mdog skya nyog ge ba 'dug pa mon gyi spyo chur dogs te pho bas don med chen po byas skad/ slob dpon chen pos rdo phral gyis bar snang (2147mas nas sbrang kham pa'i rnga ma/ gru gu'i rgyal po'i mdzod nas yum gyim shing ong jo'i bse'i me long bltas pas mngon shes 'char ba wa ra ṇa si'i mchod rten nas sangs rgyas kyis 'phel gdung mang po skad gcig la blangs te rgyal po la gtad pa sogs dpag dka'i mdzad pa brjod kyis mi lang / bsam yas mchod rten dkar po na ring bsrel mang du bzhugs pa yang 'di yin par mngon/ blon po khyung tshe stag tse'i blor brag dmar mgrin bzang mer bsregs na sngags mkhan 'di gsod thub snyam pa shar ba/ lan cig slob dpon gyis khyod 'di ltar bsams gsungs par kha skyengs te sngags mkhan 'dis ci yang shes par 'dug zer/ chos la shin tu brnag pa sbas gdong gzigs bya ba blon chen du gyur na chos la bar du gcod par mkhyen nas yug gcig dgongs pa la bzhugs pa na kho'i lus nas khrag zags te gum pa sogs slob dpon gyi mthu stobs la bdud blon rnams bag dog pa'i tshe/ lan cig btsad po la slob dpon chen pos/ khyod kyis yul 'di bzang por bya dgos sa sa shod kyi bye ma tshal dang ne'u sing du bsgyur/ gra dol dang stag la shar nub dang yul po che tshun gyi chab med pa rnams su 'byung ba/ 'tsho thabs su gram pa kun zhing sar bsgyur/ rnam thos sras la nor blangs nas 'dzam bu gling gi dkor nor yod do cog gi 'byung khungs bod du yod par bya/ gtsang po 'di las che ba zhig kho bos rgya gar du sbubs su bcug pas 'di yang sbubs su 'jug /(219na)rgya hor sogs mtha'i rgyal po mtha' dag dbang du 'du ba sogs byed pa'i bka' stsal pas nyams sad ched mdzad par gsol ba na/ dkyil 'khor bzhedas nas snga dro zhig dgongs pa mdzad pas brag dmar gyi skam sa zhig tu chu chen por brdol bar ming klu rdzing du btags/ da —271—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)dung mdzad dgos zhus pas/ brag dmar 'tsho mo mgul sngar bye mar yod pa la ne'u gsing du sngo phyams kyi song / de'i phyi dro brag gla ba'i gdong du nags chen po skad cig la byung ba la ming gla ba'i tshal du btags/yang de'i sang snga dro dgongs pa mdzad pa/ sngar zung mkhar la phu chu med pa la phu chu chen po nar gyis byung /da zhing sa gang du bya gsung / stag la shar gyi yul rked du chu byung nas mdze pho zhig gis brgal bas mdze pho rab tu grags/ de'i yul gyi phu zhig tu gtsang chu sbubs la drangs pa'i brag 'og cig tu thon/ slob dpon gyi dgongs pa la blon po ga pas bar du bcad pas chu ma byung yang / da lta brag 'og gi chu de gtsang po'i mdog gang byung der yong ba zhig yod/ de la brten nas yul gyi ming la chu sbubs gzhung du grags/ yul po che ni lung pa chung bas chu 'bad med du byung / de ltar dgongs pa gang bstad 'bad med du 'grub par shes nas blon po rnams kyis mdun sa chung bar gros byas nas zhing dar na yar klungasakyis cho go /yul 'di bzang por btang nas rgya gar du gtod 'dod pa yin te 'ong zhes so gos bsnyad mang du bshas/ don du sdig blon rnams spyod pa ga pa'i (219bsko nong gis slob dpon byu po'i rdzu'aphrul dang mngon shes ma bzod pas/ da bya ba'i 'phros rnams bshol la sngags mkhan 'di rang yul du btang ba 'thad par blon po dbang che ba phal cher kha mthun te btsad po la rgyu mtshan zhus pas rje thugs ma bde bar slob dpon la lkog tu gser phye bre gang phul nas lo rgyus rnams gsol bas/ bye ma dang rdo la phyag reg pa rnams gser du song ba bstan te kho bo la gser gyi dgos pa med chos dar ba'i ched du 'ongs pa yin te/ bzang sems byur gyi sna 'dren yin/ /snying rje rgas pa zhe sdang rgyu/ /rje yi kha lo blon gyis bsgyur/ /bod kyi 'dre blon gdug pa che/ /sems can las ga spyod pa la/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi nus pa'ang brdugs/ /zhes lon par ba ched de/ /man ngag lta 'phreng sogs zab chos mang po rgyal blon la gsungs/ ma 'ongs pa mkhyen nas bstan pa bsrung ba'i drag sngags mang po skal ldan rnams la gnang zhing / /chos sman rtsis sogs gter gyis sa steng bkang / lha 'dre dam bzhag dang sbyin sreg lan gsum 'grub na rgyal po sku tshe dang chab srid 'phel rgyur gsum pa ma 'grub pa bod spyi'i bsod nams —272

sku gsung thugasarten gsar bakhosadang rin po che'i mgo rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar chag (mel ma dbang skad/ blon po rnamasakyi 'dod pa ltar zla ba drug gam zla ba bco brgyad/ lo gsum mam lo drug gang rung las ma bzhugs pas bsam yas kyi rab gnas kyang mdzad long med par gung thang la thog nas gshegs pa'i dus zhabs skyel bar lha 'dre skyar 'dul gsum pa ma 'grub pa thugs la gcags shing chos (220nasnokhor zhig kyang byon nasa'ongs te/ der zhabrul pa chen po zhig kyang 'ong /chos la rked nyag bag re 'ong / klu de yang rgyal po la phugasazhe brnag par 'dug /rgyal brgyud kyang sil bur 'gro gsung ba sogs kyi lo rgyus byung ba las yun ring ma bzhugs pa'i skor myang 'das rgya gar 'gyur las/ res 'ga' ni semasacan rnamasakyis de bzhin gshegs pa grongs so snyam du yang dag par shesamod kyi/ de gzhin gshegs pa ni dusathamasacad du rtag pa dang / brtan pa dang / ther zug pa yin te/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar ston pa ni sangs rgyas rnams kyis chos nyid do/ /'dzam bu gling la lar ni skye bar ston pa ste/ sems can rnamasakyisaskyes so snyam du yang dag par shes so/ /nga ni bskal pa bye ba phrag grangs med pa nas bya ba byasazin mod kyi der yang go 'phang thams cad kyi don thob pa'i mthar thug par bstan te 'di ni 'jig rten dang mthun par bya ba tsam du zad do/ /'dzam bu'i gling la lar ni ngasatshul khrims 'chal ba pham pa byung ba lta bur bstan te/ sems can rnams kyis kye ma pham pa byung ba'o snyam du yang dag par shes mod kyi nga ni sngon chad g.yel bar gyur pa med do/ 'dzam bu gling la lar ni ngas bdag nyid de bzhin gshegs pa la ngan sems kyi khrag phyung ba dang / dgra bcom pa gsod pa dang/ pha ma gsod pa dang / bdag nyid dge 'dun gyi dbyen byed par bstan te sems can rnams kyis kye ma sems can 'di mtshams med pa lnga'i las byed pa (220ba)yin no snyam du yang dag par shesamod kyi/ nga yang de lta bu'i lasabyed pa ma yin la/ lha dang bcasapa'i 'jig rten na yang susakyang dge 'dun 'byed mi nusaso/ /zhesapa ltar/ de bzhin gshegs pa la yang mthong tshul sna tshogasashing / mdzangasablun du mnyan yod kyi cho 'phrul nyin bco lngar bshad kyang / 'dul lung sogs theg dman gyi lugs la tshes brgyad kyi mdzad pa lta bu las ma byung bas mtshon pa bzhin —273—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebod 'bangasalasam dag pa'i snang ngor de ltar mabyung ba'i mtha' ci bkag /ngesadon du/ nyon cig pad 'byung bka' la lha 'dre nyonaḥ 'jig rten khams na mtshungs med sprul pa'i sku: mngal kyis ma gosamatsho skyesardo rje yin lus la gang gisami tshugasa'achi med thob 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'jigs su rung : dmu rgod semasacan tshe thung g.yeng ba che: khri srong lde'u btsan lha khang bzhengasapa 'di rgyal mtshan rtse la nor bu 'phyar ba 'dra: bod du dam chosabastan pa tshugasapa na lha 'dre su ma mgu yang rag ma lus: mgron por rgya gar paṇa chen 'bod pa 'di: mun pa'i dkyil du sgron me khyer ba 'dra bod du bde skyid dam chosadar ba na: lha 'dre yul bud song yang rag ma lus: de bas yon bzhes sa gzhi gnang ba byin: rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan bsam pa 'grub: lha khang brtsigasashing lha 'dre lasal 'du:sngags 'chang pad+ma 'byung gnas bka' ma bcag: ces sogasagasungs shing nam mkha' la rdo rje'i 'grosamadzad pa'i grib ma la (221na)zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi rmang khrid/ otan+ta pu ri'i btsug lag khang la dpe byas nyin mo mi dang mtshan mo mi ma yin gyis brtsigs nas bzhengs pa'i bsam yas kyi lha khang jo mo'i gling gsum dang bcas pa ring por mi 'thogs par 'byongasapas/ bka' thang las/ bcu gsum lon nasayab kyisabor ba'i buḥ gdong dmar bod kyi rgyal po yusami cheḥ bco lnga lon nasargyal srid dmag jag bzungaḥ las thabasabya phyir blon por gdam ga bskur: bcu bdun lon nas chos kyi bsam pa skyes: sto dpyad byas pas mkhan chen gdan 'drongs zer: bsod nams ma chung mkhan chen bod du khugs: sa 'dul mdzad pasabagegs kyisabasgrub ma ster slob dpon spyan 'drongs 'grub cesalung bstan byung : las 'phro mi zhan slob dpon bod du byon:bsam yas brtsigs pa mi 'dra skyes pa 'dra: sku drin yod do btsad pos brjod ma zad cesagasungs pa ltar la/ rab tu gnas pa'i tshe ltasango mtshar ba mtha' klas/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tshos/ thams cad yod smra'i dge slong bcu gnyis kyi kha skong dang bcas sad mi mi bdun sogs rab tu byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs nas bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa'i gzhi btsugs/ paṇa chen bi mā la 274

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhongs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag 9mimi tras thog drangs rgya gar mkhas pa mang po dang / lo chen be+e ro tsa nas mtshon skad gnyis smra ba mtha' dag bsags te theg pa gong 'og gi chos (221bskoms bsgyur ba'i bshad nyan gyis gtan la phab/slob dpon chen pos/ rje 'bangs nyer lngas gtsos snod ldan mang por bla rdzogs thugs gsum/ bka' brgyad spyi bye brag sogs theg dgu'i chos kyi smin grol la bkod de mdo sngags kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su mdzad pa nas bzung glang dar mas bstan pa ma bsnubs pa yan chod kyi bshad sgrub mtha' dag gi sngags phyogs ni gsang sngags rnying ma dang /mdo lugs kyang bstan pa snga dar gyi khongs su bsdu zhing / phyi 'gyur las snga 'gyur phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad nas khyad par 'phags tshul lo tsā ba chen po rong zom chos bzang gi gsung las/ gsang sngags rnying ma la khyad par du 'phags pa'i che ba lnga ldan yod par gsungs te/ dang po spyan 'dren yon bdag gi che ba ni/ rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul pa mnga' bdag mes dbon rnam gsum gyi skabs su spyan drangs pa yin la/ yon bdag de rnams kyi smon lam dad pa'i mthu shugs kyis bod du gtsug lag khang bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa sogs dang / rab tu byung ba'i sde so so dang / lha srin sde brgyad sogs dam la btags pas chos dar ba skye 'gror bde skyid byung ba rnying ma'i bka' drin yin no/ /gnyis pa sgyur byed lo tsā ba'i che ba ni/ sngon spa gor be ro tsa na/ 'khon klu'i dbang po srung / gtsang legs grub/ ska cog zhang gsum/ de dus kyi lo tsā ba stong rtsa brgyad sogs/ de skabs su sgyur ba'i chos rnying ma yin (222na)pas bsam yas na bsgyur ba'i rgya dpe'i tshogs dang sgyur zin bod yig tu phab yod pa'i tsho gnyis su bzhugs yod pa bsgyur zin pa la gzigs pas sngon gyi lo stos bsgyur bar thugs yid ches shing / sngon gyi bka' 'gyur dkar chag mchims phu ma dang / ldan dkar ma dang /'phang thang mar gzigs pas kyang yid ches skye bar 'gyur ro/ /paṇ+ḍita'i khyad par gyi che ba ni/ paṇ+ḍita pad+ma 'byung gnas/ shalha gar+bha/ bi mā la mi tra/ sangs rgyas—275

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)gsang ba/ tsan+d+ra kirti/ paṇ+ḍi dha nā ta la 'di rnams sku dngos kyis bod la phebs rnying ma'i chos lugs dar rgyas su mdzad pa ni yongs la grags shing / paṇ+ḍi ta de tsho rig pa 'dzin pa'i sa la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sha stag gis rgya gar nas spyan drangs pa'i chos rnying ma/ bla rdzogs thugs gsum yongs rdzogs dang bcas pa bod du phebs pa yin no/ /dbang dang chos zhu ba'i rten nam yon me tog gi khyad par gyi che ba ni/ sngon gser phye bre la 'jal/gser sha ba'i rlid bu bkang nas phul/ gser rta khal dang drel khal phul nas zhus pa'i chos rnying ma yin/ da lta mchan khung nas gser zho re re gnyis gnyis nyug nyug byas nas zhus pa dang mi 'dra'o/ /brjod bya chos kyi khyad par gyi che ba ni/ theg pa rim pa dgu dang / sgrub chen bka' brgyad/ mdo sgyu sems gsum dang / sems sde la/ sems sde/ klong sde/ man ngag gi sde/ rdzogs chen a ro/ rdzogs chen rdo rje zam pa/ rdzogs chen klong sde/ man ngag gi chos skor la/ bi (222bsgo la'i snying thig /rdzogs chen 'od gsal sgron ma drug skor/ sa skya gong ma'i thugs dam nyams bzhes yang phur rdzogs rim/ rdzogs chen a ti sogs rdzogs pa wo po'i rnam grangs shin tu mang bar yod pa rnams ni brjod bya chos kyi khyad par gyi che ba yin no/ /gzhan yang brjod bya chos kyi che ba ni/ spyir bskal pa la yang dusabazhi yod/ khyad par sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la yang dus bzhi yod pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rdzogs ldan gyi skabs kyi/ sngon sangs rgyas bstan pa gra ma nyams/ lhad ma zhugs pa'i dus su/ sprul pa'i lo tsā ba be+e ro tsa na sogs kyis gtan la phab dī/ shes bya dngos po'i 'dug tshul sgra ji bzhin par bshad/ der rtogs byed thabs du ma dang zab mos brgyan pa'i chos dang / mchog dang thun mong bzhi dngos grub thams cad bde blag 'byung nges pa/ chos bka' so so'i bla ma brgyud pa'i lo rgyus la ltos shig yid ches par 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ni gzur gnas kyis brtags na shin tu mang bar byung / glang dar gyis bstan pa la bar lhad cung zad bcug kyang dpal skyon chen pos lha 'dre btul zhing sa gzhi byin gyis brlabs pas bstan pa phyi dar dang / gsar mar grags pa'i bshad sgrub kyang ci —276

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mdagar spyad chog pa'i bka' drin mtha' klas shing / thub pa'i lugs 'dzin 'phags yul dang skal pa mnyam pa dgongs te khrus khang lo tsā ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sdes/ lar dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje dang / /rgyal sras pad dkar zhabs drin (223na7sa/ /bod kyi yul khams 'di nyid kyang / /'phagasayul dang skal pa mnyam pa snyam/ /zhes gsungs pas shes nus/ sngon gyi mkhas pa lo chen rin bzang gis rgyud don sgra ji bzhin du bzung ba'i nor pa gsal ba/ pho brang zhi ba 'od/ tsa mi chag lo sogs kyis gsar rnying 'dres mar dpyad pa/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas dang / dpal 'dzin gnyis kyis/rang gi slob dpon dang mthun pa'i zhe nad kyis sdang bar smra ba/ mkhas grub chen po dge legs dpal bzang dang / paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan gyis mtshon chos kyi spyan ldan dang / dme pa mi bskyod rdo rje sogs mkhas rlom mang pos 'byam yig rnying pa rnams la gzhogs zur pa'i ri bong cal sgrog gi skur 'debs la brten 'gro ba mang po chos spong gi sgrib pa la sbyor bar snang mod/ snga 'gyur log chos yin na de bzhin gshegs pa ni shes bya gang la yang chags thogs mi mnga' bas/bod yul 'di tsam khyab pa'i bstan sel la 'dra min bshan 'byed kyi tshul du lung ston dgos pa bka' 'gyur ro cog gi mgo mjug gang du yang mi gsal/ rgya gar du dge slong lha chen pos log bstan btsugs pa ring por mi thogs par nub nas ma 'phel/ lo chen rin bzang gis sangs rgyas skar rgyal btul bzhin mthu ldan grub thob rnams kyis so zur gnubs gsum sogs 'dul dgos rgyu la/ zur pas 'gos lhas btsas tshur 'dul grabs byung ba dgongs dgos shing /sdom gsum du/ bka' gter (223ba khrims cad dmigs med du 'gro ba'i dgag pa mdzad yod yang / gsang sngags rnying ma 'ga' zhig las/ gru gsum dbang phyug chen po'i snying / /de yi sha dang khrag gis brgyan/ /mtheb sgyu mgo bo'i thod pas bskor/ /chang sogs bdud rtsis de bkang nas/ /he ru ka la mchod ces zer/ /gsang sngags gsar ma gru gsum gyi/ /gtor ma gzhung nas bshad pa med/ /ces dang / la la theg pa rim dgu la/ /lta ba tha dad yod ces zer/ /zhes dogs slong tsam las blo —277—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)ka gsum la longs pa'i tshig 'bru gnon rgyu med cing gsar ma'i gtor ma la gru gsum med par zhal gyis bzhes tshe/ sa dge dwags shangs kyi chos skyong gi gtor ma'i rnam gzhag thams cad dmigs pa med pa'i dbyings su rgyas 'debs pa las 'os ci 'chi/ be'u bum rnams kyang rdul dang mun pa'i khrod du gzim nas bzhugs pa tshul de la dgongs pa 'dra'o/ /de nas chos rje sa skya pa chen po bzhugs pa yan ho du/ /chos log spyod pa nyung zhes thos/ /zhes pa sa byu gyi yab 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po bla ོ 'byog mi'i dngos slob dang / bla chen tshos bka' dam par 'gos ma rangs pa'i sel byung ba ma gtogs/thog mar rje 'brog la thugs pas 'gos dang sa chen gyi bar du mi rabs kyis chod pa'i rgyun ha cang ring ba ni ma song / lo r+ṣa rin bzang gis dus la ma babs par sbyor sgrol sgra ji bzhi pa 'gog pa chos dang chos ma yin pa rnam par 'byed pa'i bstan bcos mdzad (224na)pa skyon pa rin chen dpal gyis yab mes byang chub rgyal mtshan mched/ ar tsho ban+de bco brgyad kyis phur bzhi la brgyangs nas mkha' 'gro mchod pa'i rdzas su gsod zer bas mtshon/ brlang spyod sna tshogs byung ba bkag pa las rnying ma'i rgyud 'grel la dmigs su phug pa mthong zhing / zhi ba 'od/ lhas btsas/ tsa mi/ chag lo'i springs yig rngog gi gze ma sogs su sngags gsar rnying mang por dri bcas dang / khyad par gha ya dha ra'i gser chosasogs rgol pa po nyid rnam dag tu bzhed pa du ma bsun dgrang ba thugs blor ma shong / dpal 'dzin gyi der mjug tu gsar ma thor bu 'dug par do ma gal zhing / rnying ma gtso bor bkag par brten 'byams yig zangs mar bris mod/ 'di la bden kha ster ba dang / rgyud gsar snying rgyud dang mthun par sbyar ba'i bstan bcos rnam dag tu 'chad na/ rgyud dang bstan bcos kyi ming gi khyad par ma gtogs don gyi cha la dri bcas su ga la 'gyur/ sdom gsum du/ 'byams yig gi khungs drangs pa dri ma can gsar rnying gang la yod kyang nad thog gi sman las gcig la dkar ba dang cig shos la nag pa'i tha snyad ma byung / gzhan yang gsang sngags gsar rnying la/ /bod kyis sbyar ba'i rgyud sde mang / /zhes rdzus rgyud gnyis ka la byung ba bstan pa las dmigs bsal med cing / 'grel pa la lar/ ngos bzung ba dag sa—278

sku gsung thugs rten gsar spu khos dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga 9yilo'i dgongs bzhed yin pa'i gtan tshigs dka'o/ /sa skya pa chen po'i rjes su byung ba ni/ phyi nas phag mo'i byin rlabs(224brkong / /zhes sogs gsar ma rang gi thog tu 'bab pas kun slong skyon can gyi 'byog bshad la yid brtan ga la rung / phur pa rtsa dum gyi rgyud/ shangs sreg shing nas rnyed par 'jam dbyangs sa los 'gyur mdzad/ bcom ldan ral gyis/ gsang snying sgrub pa rgyan gyis me rtag brtsom pa mdzad/ dbus pa blogs la gyis bka' bstan 'gyur gnyis ka'i dkar chag dang khyad par du rgyud 'bum rtsa ba sgyu 'phrul sde brgyad dang /mdo dgongs 'dus/ rngam glog kun 'dus/ kun byed rgyal po rgyud snga phyi gsum dang bcas pa sogs la 'gyur byang dang bcas te bzhengs nas/ dkar chag gi mtshan la dri ma med pa zhes 'dogasapar mdzad/ kun mkhyen bus/ rang wo kyi mes po la rdzogs pa r+ṣa po sgos sde'i skor dang / mdo sgyu 'phrul la sogs pa bka' gter mang po gsan nas bsnyen sgrub mdzad cing / gsung las/ kho bo'i bla ma thar pa lo tsā ba nyi ma rgyal mtshan dang / rig ral la sogs bla ma gong mas ba la yul dang bsam yasasogs nas rgya dpe rnyed pa'i rgyud legs zhes gsungs/ kun mkhyen 'phags 'od yon tan rgya mtshos/rdzogs chen la thugs dam mthil du mdzad nas rnam thar las༄ba mo lta ba/ nyams len sgom pa/ rgya chen spyod pa/ 'bras bu rdzogs chen rgyal thabs spyi lugs/ snyan brgyud kyi 'phreng bsal ba rdzogs chen gsang skor sogs brgyud pa sdebazhi'i skor rnams gsan nas thugs nyams su bzhes/ kun mkhyen rang byung rdo rjer/ shar sgam po gangs rir bi māl mdzod spur thim pa'i dag (225na skong shar ba'i rkyen gyis rdzogs chen gyi don thugs su chud/ 'on kyang brgyud pa zam ma chad pa dgos par dgongs te bla ma snying tig gis gtsos pa rigs 'dzin ku ma rā dzar gsan/ slob dpon pad+ma'i snying tig cig kyang yod thang dgongs par lha sar phebs skabs shig gter ston tshul rdor gyis mkha' 'gro snying tig spyan drangs pa'i shog ser phul ba chos bdag yin kyang rten 'brel cung zad ma 'grigs pas slar rgyal sras legs ldan la rdzogs par gsan/ zab mo nang don gyi rtsa dbu ma chos lnga ldan ngos 'dzin pa'i skabs—279

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesu/ sngags rnying ma'i gzhung las snying gar dngas ma lnga kyi 'dus sems zhes pa yang 'di kho na ste/ sha'i dngas ma rtsa dbu ma/ khrag gi dngas ma a thung / rus pa'i dngas ma e snya/ rlung gi dngas ma srog rlung /dngas ma'i dngas ma ni kun gzhi'i sems so/ /zhes dang / rtsa 'khor rnams la bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs rnams kyang sbyor bar mdzad/ rtsa gsum dril sgrub tu grags pa'i dag snang gi chos la phyon rin po che'i mtshan sngags yod par mi bskyod rdo rjes a spyo sa sogs kyi sngags bsgyur nas bzo bcos kyang mdzad par/ gar lugs rnams dril sgrub gsar ma zer/ rje rol pa'i rdo rje/ g.yung ston gyi zhal slob yin pas rgya nag tu rgyud gsang snying dang / g.yung 'grel gnyis khro bar du blug nas stong phrag tsam btab skad/ a ro ye shes 'byung gnas kyi slob ma/ cog ro zangs dkar mdzod phur/ des pa darngog legs(225ba)pa'i shes rab /des dge slong chos kyis shes rab/ po to ba rin cen gsal/ de'i slob ma gra pa brag dkar ba sogs ches mang bas rdzogs chen snyan brgyud la thos bsam sgom gsum mdzad/ jo bo chen po a ti shas bsam yas su rgya dpe'i dkor mdzod cig kha phye nas gzigs pas/ sngar gsan gzigs med pa'i rgyud shin tu mang bar gzigs te/ ngas 'dzam gling na grags pa'i rgyud rnams su ma zad mkha' 'gro mas bstan pa kho na yang mtha' yas par mthong ste/ de kun la yang rgyud 'di rnams mi gda'/ phal cher slob dpon pad+mas rdzu zhabrul gyis srin po'i yul nas blangs pa yin mchi/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags 'di la mtha' mngon rgyu yod yod mi 'dra zhes sngags la mkhas pa'i thugs rgyal der chag /snye thang du jo bo la bod ston rnams kyis dang po bod du brtsams pa'i bstan bcos 'ga' zhig gzigs phul bas/ gzhan ma la mnyes tshor ma mdzad/ a ro ye shes 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i theg chen rnal 'byor bya ba'i bstan bcos la shin tu mnyes nas/ dag cha che/ las 'bras gib/ don zab la rgya che ba 'dug gsung / ma gcig lab sgron gyis kyang rdzogs chen la thugs dam mdzad pas/gsung las/ phyag chen blo las 'das par rig /rdzogs chen ye dag chen por rig /ces dang / sras kyis yum la bstod par/ ma rtag chad gnyis kyi mtha' la mi 'jigs pa'o/ /bka' rdzogs pa chen po'i —280

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sa yonasgo ru zhugs/ /theg dman lta log zil gyis gnon/ /chos (226na sko ba'i phu thag chod pa'i ma/ /zhes bstod/ rje btsun mi las/ rong ston dang lha dga' yan chad du/ /spyir drin can gyi bla ma bcu tsam bzhugs/ khyad par lha rje gnubs chung la/ /drag sngags gza' gdong dmar nag zhus/ /zhes thog ma'i 'jug sgo sngags rnying ma yin shis rdzogs chen la thugs dam mdzad pas/ mgur las/ rdzogs pa chen pos mdun nas gzer/ /phyag rgya chen pos rgyab nas gzer/ kha nas gdams ngag khrag tu skyug /ces sogs dang / des mdzad pa'i bde mchog snyan brgyud kyi phyag rgya chen po ye shes gsal byed du/sems gsal stong phyag rgya chen po 'di la/ phyag rgya chen po rtog bral zer/ /rdzogs pa chen pos chos nyid zer/ /phar phyin pa ni stong nyid zer/ /zhes gsung / yang dgon pa thugs kyi rdo rje thugs dam gyi zhe phugs gtod sa rdzogs chen yin pa/ gsung mgur las/ chos thams cad ni thams cad du bden mod kyang / rdzogs chen zhes pa'i sgra bo che/ /sprang go ba'i len phyogs kyang de la bgyis/ /cig car gyi rtogasapa'ang de la 'khrungs/ /zhes dang / gnas lugs nyams su len pa'i phyag rgya chen po dang gcig /lam khyer rkyen la byed pa'i pha rol phyin pa dang gnyis/ /snang rkyen lam du blangs pa'i sdug bsngal zhi byed dang gsum/ /mthar thugazad par skyel pa'i rdzogs pa chen po dang bzhi/ /'di bzhi rnal 'byor bdag gi dam chos (226ba〉sprugs pas/ /chos ga' na gang la yang 'gram chu mi ldang ba lags so/ /zhes gsungs/ma gcig zha mar rtsa rlung gi gegs thu bo byung bar pha dam pas gegs sel mdzad pas lo gcig gi bar bsnyun sangs yang slar khams 'dus par dam pa la zhus pas/ mdo rgyud 'dra ltos/ rgyal khams 'dra bskor gsungs/ der mtshams byas mdo rgyud du ma bltas pas phan rgyu ma byung / rgyal khams la byon pas rong gi khu lung mda'i chu kha na gnubs pa'i gra pa ban chung kha cig /e ma'o ngo mtshar med kyi chos/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyis gsung / /skye ba med las thams cad skyes/ /skye ba nyid na skye ba med/ /ces sgyu 'phrul gyi e ma tshar lnga ma'i dbyangs then pas thugs thog tu 'gyur ba chen po zhig byung bas phan/ snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa ye bzang rtse pas/ gsang sngags rnying ma zhes grags pa'i —281—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)phyogs la lhag par mos pa thob cing / chos spong ba'i sgrib pas ma sbags tsam mo/ /zhes gsung ba rang nyid legs so 'dod pa rnams kyi yid la bcar ba'i gnas so/ /slob dpon chen po dang bi mā la mi tra/be+e ro tsa na/ gnyags sgo na ku mā ra/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes sogs rgya bod kyi mkhas grub mang pos bsgyur bshad gtan la dbab pa'i sems med bco brgyad/ mdo dgongs 'dus/ sgyu 'phrul sde brgyad/bka' brgyad khro mkhar rdzong phrang sogs rnying ma bka' ma'i rgyud bshad man ngag bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnubs yon tan rgya mtsho/(227na〉so ye shes dbang phyug sogs nas rim par lha rje zur che chung la bka' babs pas so zur gnubs gsum sngags pa'i rgyal po zhes 'gran zla dang bral bas mtshon/rnying ma bka' ma'i bstan 'dzin nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltar 'grang yas par ma zad snyigs ma lnga mdo'i dus kyi 'gro ba sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba rnams skyob pa'i phyir du zab gter mtha' yas pa sbas shing spyan drangs pa rnams la/ blun po blo chung dang / 'byung po'i gdon gyis yid bsrubs pa'i mkhas rlomasamang pos gter zhes bya ba rdzun yin zer ba dang / la lar dpe har sogs bod kyi 'byung po mthu bo che rnams dang bal po pad 'byung bya ba zhig gros byas nas sbas pas 'don rgyu yod kyang chos de nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu mdze/ snying rlung / smyo 'bog sags 'byung ngo zhes smra ba/ shog ser nyung zad tsam zhig yin na rdzun ma bzo thub pa'i dbang du byas kyang / bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi shog ser rgyal po'i bla dpe po ti dgu nyang gis spyan drangs nas smra bo lcog tu bzhugs pa'i steng nas mnga' bdag kun dga' lhun grub kyis mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po cher lung gsan/ skyon gling pas shel brag nas bka' 'dusachos kyi rgya mtsho po ti brgya skor spyan drangs pa'i tshang ma 'bebs ma thub par shog ser steng nas dbang lung mdzad pa sogs rnam grangs ches mang ba de tsam gyi gtos che ba'i shog ser gsang thabs su mi gcig gis ji ltar 'dri nus/ chos dbang rin po che brag rta mgrin (227bsgo gul dang chos rgyal rat+na gling pas gnam skas kyi brag gshags nas khrom gter bzhes pa gter byung gnyis su gsal zhing /de dang mtshungs pa gter ston gzhan dag gis kyang mdzad/ pad+ma gling pas me 'bar mtsho la mchongs nas —282

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mgater sgrom spyan drangs pa sogs rtsod med yongs grags yin/ mdze dang spyo 'bog re gnyis la mtha' ci bkag /gter ston gter slob phal mo che la ma byung / byung ba tsam la ngan par 'dzin na gsar ma ba'i bla ma mang po'i rnam thar du de rigs snang / gter rnying mar ma zad gsar ma phyogs la yang yod pa chu klung rol pa'i mdo las kyang / nga yi bstan pa cho se kyi gzhud / /thugs nas thugs kyi gter du sbas/ /yang na sa yi snying por bya/ /zhes dang / dpal bde mchog nyung ngu las/ rgyud dang rgyud kyi rgyal po gang / /phyag na rdo rje khyod nyid kyis/ /gter nas gter du phyung ste stsal/ /zhes gsungs/ jo bo chen po dpal ldan a ti shas bka' chems ka bkol ma dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos dang shā ri'i bus 'gog pa ri'i chu mtshams su sbas pa rgyal ba btsong kha ba chen pos spyan drangs/ pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyis chos zab mo zhi byed kyi chu klung rol pa'i mdo rgyud rnams dang / chu klung chen po'i gsang rgyud dang / mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang rgyud la sogs pa rnams/ dur khrod dpal gyi rgyu skar rol pa na mkha' 'gro ma'i gsang mdzod sgo nyis rim bcad pa'i nang na lcags kyi sgrom bu dgu gling nas gter nas bston nas yi ger btab par bzhed cing / da lta bod du yang zhi byed kyi (228na7do rgyud phal che ba rnams lho brag ban pa na gter du sbas nas yod par zhi byed pa chen po rnams gsung zhing yi ge 'khod/ rje btsun ras chung pa rdo rje grags kyis/ nā ro paṇa chen gyi ro snyoms skor drug lho brag mkhar chur brag rgan mo 'dzum shor 'dra ba'i nang na gnubs nam mkha'i snying po'i zhabs rjes kyi byang shar mtshams su sbas/ phyis gtsang pa rgya ras kyis gter nas brta zhe nas dar rgyas su mdzad cing / ti pu pa'i zhal nas/ rgya gar 'o ma'i rgya mtsho nas/ /ga dmasang ga mar gyi yang zhun 'di/ khri/da sde rnams la gab nas yod/ /paṇa chen rnams kyi long gtam tshul/ /grub thob rnams kyi khong snying tshul/ /ri khrod 'grim pa'i go cha yin/ /ku swā li pa'i sman sbyor yin/ /paṇa chen nā ro ma gtogos pa/ /paṇ+ḍita dang ku su li/ /gzhan la gdams pa 'di 'dra med/ /snod ldan khyod la bstan pa yin/ /gdams ngag bshad la dus tshod dgos/ /da lta bstan pa'i dus min pas/ khro bo'i cha byad 'dra ba'i brag /mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas shig tu/ /mkha' 'gro lha 'dre thams —283

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shecad la/ /gtad gnyer gyis la gter du sbos/ /mi rabs gsum gyi 'og rol du/ /snod ldan gang zag len du 'ong / /de yi lag tu gtad cig gyis/ /smon lam thob la sbos shig gsungs/ /zhes dang / slob dpon chen pos/ pu tra skor bsam yas su sbas pa/ phyis jo bo a ti sha mjal bar lha btsun byang chub 'od phebs skabs/ bla ma mkha' 'gros lung (228ba tha stan la brten gter nas bzhes pas pu tra ka bkol mar grags pa lo chen rin bzang gis kha che dharma pa lar zhus pa'i bka' ma dang zhus dag pher/lho brag mar pas chos drug sras mkhar gyi rgyang la sbas pa/ phyis chos dbang rin po ches gdan drangs pa cho ge drug sras mkhar ma zer/ phyag rgya chen po'i sems 'khrid/ /dgas po lha rjes dgas lha'i nye shogasasu gter du sbas nas/ dung mtsho ras pas gter nas brta zhe pas mtshon pa rnams kyang ma dag par khas len dgos par 'gyur ro/ /de yang rigs 'dzin chen po rat+na gling pas gnam skas brag nas spyan drangs pa'i zhal gdangs gsal ba'i sgron me las/ mnga' bdag khri srong gi gdung brgyud drug bdun tsam na yar song dus/ bod thams cad lo tsā bar grags te mi phyed rgya gar dang thags bran/ thams cad rang rang gi che ba ni 'dod/chags sdang dang 'gran sems ni rlung ltar 'tshi/ rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍita gser 'dod rnams kyang bod na gang dar ba'i chos la 'dod bcos 'chos/ /de yang rgya gar gyi sde snod gsum la sogs pa sngags mtshan nyid yongs su grags pa rnams ni da lta bsgyur zin/ rgyud dang man ngag ma grags pa rnams ni can mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod rnams na yod de/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug grub thob min pas mi thob/ de dus pod rnams kyis skyon yul du ni mi brtol/ dbus 'gyur rdo rje'i gdan mthil du ni yug re las tsha bas mi tshugs/ rgya gar shar phyogasabal yul kha che rnams la chu ltar rgyug /lo stor grags pa rnams (229na〉rang che mkhas pas gcig skyon gcig la 'gel/ sngar 'gyur zin pa rnams la rgyud khungs dang bcos chung re byas nasanga'i 'gyur bzang zer/ da lta'i sprul pa'i lo paṇa rnams mi bzang na/ ma 'ongs bod phrug so so skye bo byis pa rnams—284

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (7mi mkhas gsung / der bod phrug lo tsā bar grags pa rnams ru khrol nas man ngag cung zad bcos chung dang / gab sbas dang / 'dra man mang po 'chos/ rgya gar gyi khungs dang / brgyud pa gang legs nas 'gran/bod rnams gsar ngas ni che/ rgyu mtshan ni ma rig par/ rang rang gi lo tsā ba'i kha 'dzin chos srid dang phyogs dregs byed/ lo tsā ba kha cig sngar ma grags pa'i chos ni ma rnyed/ der sngags la sgra bcos byed/'gyur la rang bcos byed/ lha dpa' bo gcig pa la yum 'chos/ zhal phyag mang po la lhan skyes 'chos/lhan skyes la zhal mang phyag mang 'chos/ sku mdog la rigs lnga mang po byed/ /dkyil 'khor la 'dod bzhed kyis dkrug /mngon na gzhan dang mi 'dra ba zhig la gtso bor 'don/ mkhas pa de 'dra'i rigs mang po 'ong zhes pa ltar/ bstan pa phyi dar la lo paṇa mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa bstan pa'i srog 'thud pa mang du byung na'ang paṇ+ḍita gser 'dod dang / lo tsā ba mkhas 'dod mang pos rgyud lung man ngag rnams dkrugs te gzhan dang mi 'dra ba gtso bor ston pas rdo rje 'chang nas bzung ste brgyud pa'i bka' chad bas byin rlabs kyi ngad yal te grub thob mi 'byung bas lhad med kyi chos zab (229ba)gter mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can rnams kyis dngos grub brnyes pa'i rgyu mtshan bod kyi slob dpon shes chung gis/ ma dag pa la dag par 'dod/ ma yin pa la yin zer/ byar rgyu ma rnyed pa'i brjod bya/rang che 'dod pa'i lo tsā ba mang po ma 'ongs pa na khyu 'brel ba 'byung ste/ ma nges pa'i sgra dang bsgyur bcos mang po 'byung bas/ rang rang gi 'dod phyogs nas spu gzings pas/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang bsgyur dka'/de 'dra'i dus su kha 'dzin dang phyogs cha ma byed pad+ma nga'i rjes su 'jug pa rnams nga'i gter yig sel med kho na ltar nyams su long / rang dregs can rnams ci dgar smrar chug /chos gang zab kyi sgrub rtags bsal nas 'ong / zhes gsungs pas/ bka' ma rnams tsho me dus kyi 'o ma ltar lhad zhugs te 'chal ba'i dus su las 'phro sad pa'i skal ldan rnams gter chos kyis rang gzhan gnyis ga'i don chen 'grub par dgongs te rgyud lung man ngag gi bcud thams cad sgrom bur rgyas btab nas bod yul gyis ri brag mtsho gsum/ gtsug lag khang sogs su sbas pa'i dgos ched/ ji skad du/ shin tu zab pa'i mthar —283

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)thug snying po rnams:spyir yang bod rnams gsar ngas che ba dang :snyigs ma'i 'gro ba lhag par snying rje bas mtha' dbus thams cad gter gyis bkang nas bzhag:las can bu dang phrad pa'i smon lam btab:ma 'ongs dus su rtog ge tha snyad mkhan sgom chen la sogs phyogs dang rigs dred can rang che 'byin cing gter la rtsod 230na sko yang :snying ma'i chos byed phal gcig gter gyis 'dren zab la kha tshar mi bsgribs mtha' rgyas shing : gdams pa sna res gang zag grol bar nges: de bas las sad skal ldan sbyangs pa can:'chi ba dran na gter chos nyams su long :tshe gcig thar lam thob pa rjes 'dun rnams:zhes gsungs pa ltar snyigs ma'i dus kyi 'gro ba spyi dang /bye brag skor gsum/ru bzhi/sgang drug ste bod yul gyi skye rgu rnams kyi phan bde'i rtsa lag au ṇ+ḍi ya na'i ā tsarla rgan po'i zab chos la rag lus pa'i gter kha rnams zhal 'byed pa po thang yig tu/sangs rgyas bla ma nas bzung /bde chen gling pa'i bar gyi gter ston ches mang ba dus rtags dang bcas lung bstan yang shog ser nas 'bebs skabs chad pa bzhin yin nam gsal bar mi snang ba/khri srong rnam sprul chos rgyal byang pa dpal bkra shis stobs rgyal gyis/ rang nyid kyi gter chos ji ltar gsan pa'i gter byon rnams phyogs gcig tu sgrigs pa gter ston brgya rtsa'i gsol 'debs su sngon byon phal cher tshang zhing /de yang /mnga' skyong khri lde srin sbar gnas sogs nas//zab gter sgo 'byed don du bstan pa'i bdag/nyang rigs sku bltams ral pa'i cod pan can//gong ma nyi ma 'od zer la gsol ba 'debs//de 'og zhing 'dir dpang ston grub pa'i sras//bod yul gter gcig gnam skas khar chu sogs//bco brgyad sgo h+phu dgu ru chos dbang zhes//'brel tshad 230bdon ldan chen po lagaso lo ba 'debs//zhes gong 'og gnyis ni nyi zla ltar grags pa'i gter ston gyi rgyal po yin la/chos rgyal dbang po'i zhes myong grol pad+ma rā ga dang lhan cig tu bsam yas a rlu pa lo'i gling nas gdan drangs pa'i rang gter las/da lta'i mgo nag spyi yi rgyal po khyod:smon lam dag pa'i skye ba rnam lngas 'don :zhes pa'i sku sprul nyang nyi ma 'od zer/gsung sprul gu ru chos kyi dbaX /ga/thugs sprul rigs 'dzin yongs 'dus kya phyi

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (7sgrub yon tan gter mdzod las/ 'di nas tshe lo lnga bcu kha ral dusaḥ nga yi thugs rjes sprul pa'i rigs 'dzin niḥ pad+ma rgyal po ye shes rol ba rtsalaḥ phyi ltar rab byung sngags pa'i cha lugs canaḥ nang ltar sems bskyed bstan pa'i bya bar brtson gsang ba gnyis med rdzogs chen don dang ldan: chosargyal yab sras 'tsho rgyal smon lam gyis: sprul pa'i gzugs gyis ma 'gags spyod pa skyong : de 'dra'i gang zag nub kyi phyogs nas 'ongs zhes mnga' ris paṇa chen pad+ma dbang rgyal rdo rje/ yon tan gyi sprul pa byang bdag rigs 'dzin nyid kyi rang gter du/ dam rdzas de dang phrad pa'i skyes bu de skye ba du mar zab gter la spyod pa'i sku yi gzi brjid mtshan rtags bcu gsum ldan: bden pa'i ngag 'grub sgra dbyangs tshangs pa'i gsung : thugs kyi byin rlabs dgongs pa'i gting dpag dka' bdag dang rgyal po'i yon tan sprul pa ste zhes chos rgyal bkra shis stobs rgyal dang / 'phrin las kyi sprul pa ni/(231na)slad nas dus babs su 'byung 'gyur yin zhing / gzhan yang rigs 'dzin rgod ldem/ tshe brtan rgyal mtshan/ mung bo byang chub gling pa dpal rgyal mtshan/ gling pa bcu gcig /dri med gsum sogs rgya cher byon pa'i nang nas/ rdo rje chos/ 'phags pa kun dga' bo/ rgyal po dza/ slob dpon shan+ti gar+bha/ thu mi sa sto ṭa/ lo chen be+e ro tsa na sogs rim gyis byon pa'i dbang phyug 'bar ni/ thang yig las/ ta'i tus brtsigs pa'i rtsig pa sdug pa 'ong : jing dang rgya rnams grog ma'i tshang bshig 'dra:jo mo gling gsum sbas pa'i gter kha 'di: mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags der bstan nas byung : gter ston grwa pa mngon shes bya ba 'byung : sa steng gnas gzhi brgya dang rtsa brgyad 'gengs gra mda' 'di la gtsug lag khang zhig 'byung : rgyal pos bzhengs pa'i lha khang bdag po byed ces rgyud bzhi sogs sman dpyad kyi skor mang po dang chos skyong zhad blon gyis las tshogs/ gong 'og sogs gter kha du ma'i kha byang brtan zhing gra thang gis gtsos gnas gzhi brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzheng bas mtshon bshes gnyen zhig la 'phrin las che/ 'di'i rnam sprul/ thang yig tu/ skyon nga nyid gnyal smad lha rjer sprul: dwagasasgam snying po'i don sgom khyub ṇi ga 'byung : mchims phu kho mthing sbas pa'i gter kha 'di mi bzhag 'don —287

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)pa'i rtags der bsnyen nas byung : ra shag gter ston mdos la mkhas pa 'byung : zhes ma mo sgang shar sogs mdos gtso bor gyur pa'i (231ba)zab gter stag sgro gang thon/ de'i skye ba rdo rje gling pa ni/rang gter tu/ ma 'ongs lnga bcu kha ral tshe: bsam yas 'di yi lho nub mtshams lung pa dor ma brgyangs 'dra'i nang : gra zhes bya ba'i phu mda' phu rigs ldan sngags 'chang bya khyi lo: chu khams pad+ma rdo rje gling : phyon nga rang dngos gcig 'byung : skal ldan de dang 'di phrad shog ces pa ltar gnam lcags brag /spa gro stag tshang / sgrags yang rdzong / bsam yas mchims phu sogs gnas mang po nas/rdzogs pa chen po lta ba slong yangs / gu ru zhi drag /bka' brgyad/ bon rdzogs chen gser gyi yang zhun/bla ma rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ chos skyong rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ dpa' bo rgyal ba rgya mtsho/gter bdag rgya pa ba rgya mtsho/ bstan ma rgyal ba rgya mtsho sogs gter cho me shin tu rgya che/ 'di'i sku skyesakun skyong gling pa ni/ rang gter las/ be+e ro khyod kyi sprul pa ni chu khams bya'am khyi lo pa yab med yum bral sngags 'chang rigs phyon ming 'dzin shes rab can: ma nges spyod pas 'gro ba 'dul gnas med rlung bzhin kun tu rgyu mon bal rtse lnga phyogs su 'da' thugs gter dgongs gter mang zhig 'byed ces zab phu me tshor nas rdor sems snying thig /phyon chen po'i zangs sku/ bsam yas mchod rten dkar po nas bram ze dri med bshes gnyen gyi dbu thod sogs chos dang dam rdzas shin tu mang / 'phyong rgyas rtser me shor ba'i dus zangs skus me thub (232na〉nga cung zad gnas yar byung ba'ang mi'i rma rjes ltar sos pa'i ya mtshan che/ rdo rje gling pa'i gter kha rnams yang gter gyi tshul du bka' babs par grags/ 'di'i sku skye thang yig tu/ nyang smad nyi ma mdo ru rdzong zhig 'byung : dmag dpon brgyad dang bcu drug phya lung 'tshog: g.yas ru gtsang 'gram sbas pa'i gter kha 'di mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags der bstan nas byu pa skyon mdo sngags gling pa zhes bya 'byung : zhes pa sprul sku mchog ldan mgon po yin na'ang / kun skyong gling pa'i dus bdud mo zhig gi rkyen gyis lung bstan ngan pa zhig bzang por bsgyur bas rten 'brel phrags nas gter 'don rgyu ma byung / 'on kyang mnga' ris gung thang —288

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shāmirgyal po'i ti shir skur/ slob dpon chen pos rab tu gnas pa'i rta mgrin gyi sku 'jon dmar las grub pa lho brag lung gsum las dga' bar grags pa de phul/ hor dmag bzlog pa'i phyir du pho brang sne'u sdong rtse nas bkur sti mdzad pa sogs 'phrin las rgya che/ dam pa de dag gi sku'i skye ba rim par brgyud de/ thang yig las/ ce'i/log khrims ral dam nyams lung pa gang : lha mi'i gnas su gtam ngan gragasapas khyab: sha lug stag sgor sbas pa'i gter kha 'di mi bzhag 'don pa'i rtags der bstan nas byung :skyon gter bdag gling pa zhes bya 'byung : zhes deng sang gi 'gro ba'i spyod tshul dang dus rtags mthun par ches cher snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i skye rgu rnams mi bzad pa'i duḥkha las nye (232ba thar bskyabs te phan bde'i dbugs ring por 'byin par mdzad pa'i chos kyi rgyal po gter bdag gling pa'am pad+ma gar dbang 'gyur med rdo rje rtsal du grags pa de ni rang gter gab rgya can las/ be+e ro khyod ni skye mtha'i byang sems te khyod kyi 'di gong skye ba 'das pa ni: smra bsam brjod 'das ye shes snying po'i don :sems can sa rgyas mnyam nyid khyab brdal yang : khams gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren pa rdo rje chos: shākya'i nye gnas ā nan+ta zhes dang : rgyal po dza dang shan+ti gar+bha dang : bod 'dir sa sto ṭa sogs dag pa yi: skye ba de tsam snang gi ma dag pa'i skye tshul brjod du lang ba'i gnas ma yin: de ltar dag pa'i skye ba de dag gi 'gro la snying rje chen po'i thugs bskyed pas be+e ro khyod du skye ba blangs pa yin khyod kyang shrī sidha ye shes mdo pad+ma bdag sogs gtsug gi bla mar bsten gdams pa'i gnad rnams phu thag dpyad byas nas chos sku'i rang zhal mngon sum rtogs gyur pas las lo ma dag skye ba len mi srid 'on kyang sems bskyed smon lam bzang po yis mtshams sbyar mtha' yas 'gro ba'i dpal nyid du dbang phyug 'bar dang rak+ṣa rdo rje gling : kun skyong gling dang mdo sngags gling pa sogs pad+ma bdag gi zab gter bdag po dang : gzhan yang theg pa che chung sna tsho gos la: de dang mthun pa'i ngo mtshar skye ba'i grangs:bcu phrag gcig dang gsum tsam 'das pa'i mthar sum cu kha ral snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus bsam yas(233na〉( nub gra zhes g.yo ru'i sar: lung pa byang lta dor ma brkyang 'dra'i tshigs srin mo 'dzeg —289—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)'dra'i dge bsnyen sngags zhol du: burnya dzñā na'i sprul pa tshe ming pha shel dkar 'tsho sgron sprul pa dbyangs ming mas bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor sngags kyi brtul zhugs can me khams khyi yi lo pa pad+ma'i ming :gzugs byad ha cang mi ring mi thung ba mdangs snum rin chen rigs kyi rtags 'chang ba pad+ma nga la mos pa lhag par byed: bco brgyad lo la gter kha dang po 'byed: ces pa'i don bzhin/ sngar lha sras mu rug btsan pos blon po zhang rgya tsha lha snang gi bu bkum pa'i stong la gra dol gzhung gsum sprad pa'i yul gru de dag blon po'i brgyud pas bzung ba brgyud kyi mtha' rdzogs pa'i mag par nyang rin po che'i chos bdag mkha' 'gro'i bka' babs can mthing ma ba gnyos zhig chen po'i gdung 'dzin zhig byon pa'i mi rabs du ma'i mthar sngags bon sbrags ma tshe dbang don grub kyi sras sprul sku mdo sngags bstan 'dzin gyis bsam yas nas brtsis pa'i lho nub gra nang dge ba'i gling zhes bya ba'i dar rgyas chos sding gi gnas su 'od gsal lha gnyos kyi gdung sngags rnying ma'i grub brnyes rim par byon pa'i brgyud las phyags phabs pa'i sras/ mnyam med lha btsun chen po'i rigs 'dzin srog sgrub kyi lung bstan du dran pa nam mkha' dang / gter gsar du gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyi sprul par bshad pa/ dam pa de dag ngo bo gcig la ldog pa tha dad pas zla ba gcig (233ba〉pa rdzing bu mang por gzugs brnyan 'char ba bzhin yab rigs 'dzin chen po 'phrin las lhun grub dang yum shel dkar bza' 'tsho sgron gyi sprul pa lha 'dzin dbyangs can sgrol ma'i sras su rigs 'dzin chen po 'di me pho khyi'i lo la sku bltams pa'i ngo mtshar gyi mdzad pa gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag gleng bar bya ba dus su ma babs pas re shig btang snyoms su bzhag /gdul bya thun mong ba dang go mtshudas pa'i rol rtsed dang / yig klog /thos bsam gyi tshul rnams tshegs chung ngus thugs su chud cing / khyad par yab rigs 'dzin chen po/zur thams cad mkhyen pa/ rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba chen po/ dpal sa skya ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ mkhan chen chos kyi rgyal po zha lu ba rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ rigs 'dzin sgrub pa'i sku mchog pad+ma 'phrin las/ gsung —290

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (7sprul tshul khrims rdo rje/ mkhas grub khra tshang ba chen po blo mchog rdo rje/ se ston thugs mchog 'od 'bar/ zur ngag dbang phun tshogs/ rje bon lung pa gar dbang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras sprul sku/ sngags 'chang chen po mnga' ris pa dkon cog lhun grub/ 'od mchog sprul sku sogs dam pa du ma yongs 'dzin du bsten nas sngags gsar rnying gi dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gtams shing nged rang nas kyang sngags gsar rnying gi chos bka' rgya mi chung ba phul/(234na)lha sngags ye shes kyi rnal 'byor mthar phyin pas mkhyen brtse nus pa'i thugs kyi klong rang brdol du gyur/ gong smos kyi bla ma drug tsam ma gtogs gzhan rnams dang / gangs can gyi lha gcig dpal phag mo gru pa yab sras/ sgam 'brug sprul sku gnyis sogs bla chen/ mkhan po/ spyan lnga/ slob dpon/ lung dang rigs pa smra ba'i bshes gnyen/ rnal 'byor spyod pa ku swa li la sogs chos kyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i mchog dman mang pos dam pa'i chos kyi sgo skal nye bar nos shing / dpal ldan sa skya pa dang 'bri gung sprul pa'i sku sogs mang pos tshul de lta bu bzhed pa'i snyan gsan lan cig ma yin par gsol/ gnam dang sa'i dbang phyug blo bzang mthu stobs dang blo bzang sbyin pa/ 'od gsal lha rigs 'dzin pa sa skyong rgya ri ba/ yar 'byog khri dpon sogs dpon chen/ dpon skya/ mdun na 'don/rdzong gnyer sna bor gtogs pa sogs mchog dman mtha' dag gi gus pas btud cing / skabs don gyi gtso bo dgung lo bco brgyad du slebs pa chu mo yos kyi lo la brag dmar g.ya' ma lung nas rigs 'dzin thugs thig gi skor/ nyer gnyis pa me mo lug gi lor yar klungs shel brag nas 'jam dpal gshin rje dregs pa 'joms byed/ so gcig pa me 'brug la gnam lcags brag nas rdzogs chen dang drag dmar gyi skor sogs spyan drangs shing / /slar yang 'dren par 'gyur ba sogs 'khor lo gsum gyi mdzad pa'i cha shas las rang gter du/ /khyad par g.yu ru gtsang ma'i sar: (234ba) 'di nyid 'chad cing sgrub pa'i sde: tshom bu gcig tu 'dus pa dag: brtson pas bsgrubs nas 'grub gyur cing :ma 'ongs bstan pa cher 'phel te: bod kyi bde skyid gong du spel: zhes pa'i don ltar/ zab gter 'di —291—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)nyid la thos bsam sgom gsum bya ba'i rigs 'dzin 'dus gra zhig dga' ldan phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos srid zung du 'jug pa'i stobs kyi 'khor lo bla nas blar 'phags pa chab srid gdugs dkar po gcig gi grib bsil la pur rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams thams cad rdzogs ldan gyi dga' ston la spyod pa dang / rigs 'dzin chen po nyid mthong thos dran reg gi skye rgu mtha' dag rnam byang gi go 'phang la 'god pa'i dgos pa du ma'i ched du 'dzugs par bzhed pa'i gnas mal gyi gzhi dang / lha 'bangs dang / tshon/ gser shog /'bru/ sha mang gis mtshone pa'i nyer spyad nged rang dang sdopa snga phyi nas rim par phul nyid / dkar phyogs la dga' ba'i gzhi bdag rnams kyis sa rdo chu sogs sbyar bas mtshon ris bral 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa'i 'byor pa lhun gyis 'grub par brten/ spel pa'i yul dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyis 'khor lo'i bsdus pa'i rgyud las/ gling ni zla ba 'od dkar can dang rab mchog ku sha dang ni mi'am spyi dang khrung khrung dang / drag po yang ni longs spyod sa ste bdun par 'dzam bu'i mi rnams gnas pa dag ni las kyi sa/ zhes ri rab rdo rje'i rnam pa can gyi rwa 'og tu chud par longs spyod kyi sa dang / gling bzhi gling phran brgyad ni las kyi sa ste 'dzam gling chen po/ (235na)de'i nang tshan lho gling 'di 'dzam gling chung ngur bshad pa'i dbus su sa gzhi la gyen du 'bur dod dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad kyis mtho ba zur gsum me'i khams su yod pas/ bsdus rgyud las/ shar du rlung ni shin tu zlum por 'gyur te mi yi bdag po lho ru me ni gru gsum mo/ /zhes pa'i lte ba ma ga dha dus gsum gyi bder sa/shegs thams cad mchog gi sprul skur sangs rgyas shing rgya ba'i gnas/shar du 'phags pa 'jam dbal gyis rtsis kyi gtsug lag brgyad khri bzhi stong bstan pa'i gnas ri bo rtse lnga/lhor 'jig rten dbang phyug gi gnas po ta la/ nub na gsang sngags thams cad kyi 'byung nas skyon dhu ma tha la'i gtsug lag khang / byang na ka lwa pa rigs ldan gyi grong khyer sogs yul grong/ chu brag ljon shing sogs ngo mtshar ba'i dge mtshan du mas gtams pa'i byang phyogs na lha mo dri ma med pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ nga mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam —292—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar spu khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shā'ipa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes kha ba can gyi ljongs 'di rin spungs sa spyod dbang pos sa pan gyi rnam thar sa rga bcu gnyis mar/ nor 'dzin ma 'di'i rgyan du srid pa yis/ /byin pa'i gangs ri dpal gyi do shal can/ /sto bar chos kyi rgyal srid bla na med/ sa skyar grags pa'i ri mo phyogs su ring / /zhesapa'i tshig rkang bzhi pa paṇa chen smon gro pa rig gnas rgya mtsho'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pas don thog tu bsgyur ba/ gling rnams kun gyi gtsug tor 'di yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa (235bskor gling shing tu mang bar bshad kyang / gling dang yul ljongs rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa gtsug tor lta bu bod yul 'di ri mtho ba/ sa gtsang ba/ bsil la mdzes pa lha gnas gzhal yas khang dang 'dra ba/ phyogs bzhin chu bo chen po bzhi 'bab pa/ mi dpa' zhing rta mgyogs pa/ gangs ri'i rgyud kyi ra ba/ rin po che'i 'byung khungs/ rtsi mchog dri zhim la bcud che ba/ 'bru'i rnam pa mang zhing bzang ba/ rigs gsum mgon po'i rgyal khams/ bskos pa'i rgyal po sde bzhis kyang 'gran zla med pa'i bod yul 'di sngon chos skyong ba'i rgyal po mes dbon gyi dus spu rangs/ mang yul/ zangs dkar gsum skor gcig /li dang / gru sha/sbal sde gsum skor gcig /zhang zhung khri te stod smad gsum skor gcig ste/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ mdo khams la smad khams btags pa khams gcig /mdo smad la g.yar mo thang btags pa khams gcig /btsong kha la gyi thang btags pa khams gcig ste smad mdo khams sgang gsum/ dbusan dbu ru dang / g.yo ru gnyis/ gtsang na g.yas ru dang / ru lag gnyis te bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi las g.yo ru'i cha/ tshe ring gnam gyi she mong gi stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba jing gir hor gyi lung gis dpal sa skya par chol ka gsum gnang ba'i dbus gtsang khri skor bcu gsum du phye ba las tshal pa khri skor du gtogs pa/ gra phun tshogs dge ba'i gling gi gra phyi zhes bya ba'i lte ba sngon slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas (236na〉kye zhabs kyis bcags shing glu mes tshul khrims shes rab slob rgyun dang bcas pa'i gnas kyi shul/ rgyud sdodang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rnams las ji ltar bshad pa'i gnas kyi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su tshang ba'i gzhi der 'og min skyon smin grol gling nges pa don —293

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)gyi dga' ba'i tshal chen por grags pa'i 'dus sde'i gas la 'phags yul du ā na lar grags pa rgya nag gtsug lag pa me 'brug tu 'bod pa'i zla ba dang po'o nyer dgu gza' pa sangs dang / skar ma mon gru 'phrod pa'i nyin rigs 'dzin r+ṣa po nyid 'khor lo'i mgon por bzhengs te dpal chen rdo rje phur bu 'phrin las drag po'i dkyil 'khor du grub pa'i/ lo phyi ma gnyis su rim par bskrun pa'i brten pa lha la dri gtsang khang du ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ nyan thos mchog zung / byang sems nye ba'i sras brgyad/ sgo srung rta mgrin dang phyag rdor rnams 'bur du bzhugs shing / ri mor dus gsum sangs rgyas/ sangs rgyas rabs bdun/ sman bla dang 'od dpag med/ sgo 'gram na tshangs pa dang brgya byin/ 'du khang gi g.yas na lha khang bzhal yas khang na 'bur du sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rigs drug pa kun bzang /rnam snang / mi bskyod/ rin 'byung / snang (236ba)mtha'/ don grub rnams 'bur du bzhugs shing / ri mor g.yas ngos la sgo 'byed phyag rdor nas bzung /a ti'i dkyil 'khor bar gyi mdo dbang gi dkyil 'khor gtso bo phal cher bris pa la bka' ma rags pa tshang ba/ g.yon la bka' brgyad spyi bka'/ sgos dka'/ tshe bdag /rta mgrin/ yang gsang / gter ma'i yi dam rags bsdus rnams/ 'du khang gi g.yon ngos mgon khang dpal chen lha khang gi gtso bor dpal chen che mchog dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ ma ning / sngags srung ma/ gza'/rnam sras/ dur khrod ma mo/ 'dod khams dbang phyug /gter gsar mgon po rnams dang / ri mor chos skyong / de rnams kyi 'khor tshang ma dang / sdod pon sum cu/ phur srung bcu gnyis sogs kyi gtor tshogs rten rdzas tshang ma/ de'i sbug gsang ba'i mgon khang na bstan srid rin po che'i srog mkhar gyi rten bcas pa'i chos skyong de rnams kyi bla rdo rten gtor dang bcas yod pa dam 'byar ma/ gtsang khang gi thog 'og min chos dbyings lha khang gi rten gtsor slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas/ dngul dkar —294

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shāmilas grub pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i mchod rten brgyad/ bka' gter brgyud pa'i bla ma rags bsdus brgyad tsam po dza/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ sgeg pa rdo rje/ rma rin cen mchog /seng gdong g.yon gyi gtso bo slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas/ g.yas su mkhan po zhi ba 'tsho/ g.yon du paṇa chen bzung bya shing rta mo'i bar 'khrungs rabs so bzhi pa/ lto'i skya la bcom ldan 'das kyi sku tshe 'di'i mdzad pa bcu gnyisadang / slob dpon chen po'i rnam thar sis rgya mtsho ma rgyas tsam sogs shing rtsa dang bcas pa bsgrubasapa'i rdo shing gi bzo bo/ lha bzo ba sogs la rgyun gyi bza' btung thog mtha' bar gyi ston mo dang mtshar kha yon gyi dngos po bcas pas mnyes par mdzad (237bcung / bar gcod
