por mtho bas 'gro byin lhos//sngon goms 'a mongs stug pho khung bu sa/d+ku snyigs rtag nyal 'khyil ba rlangs spyod lce//gnyis skyong srog mthar byed pa bde gshegs bdun//'dab bzang dbang po'i thugs rjes nyer bzung kye//kun khyab mdzod spu'i 'od zer mas rnon pos//gshin rje'i zhags pa bcad nas bdud rtsi'i sman//srog zungs bcud len rtse 24bskog 'a khog rgod pa//tshe mtha' yas zhal 'grum pas 'gro 'di gsus//li khri'i rdul dmar brtsegs pa gar gyi dbang /ye pre ma'i rnam par tshil po che//kun rtog shes zhi khyad par dbyi ba'i mas//'od dpag med spyan mkha' mnyam 'gror gzigs shig/skad cig tsam yang mtha' klas lus can tshogs//yal yol bto snyoms mi mnga' dam bca'i gzungs//rdo ba'i ri mo ma pham mgon zhal gyis//'chesade mig gsum pas kyang ci zhig dbyi/gnas ༅ gdung me'i tsha reg 'bar ba'i dpal//thugs rje nya rgyas ga bur gzegs ma'i rdul//snying la sim pas bde ster bcom ldan 'das//mi 'khrugs rnam par 'dren pas 'gro dbugs phyungs//gzod ma nyid nas kun khyab kun bzang 'og min zhing gtsor rdo rje 'chang //gcig pu las ni du ma'i gar gyis zhi dang khro bo'i rol gar mkhan//'dzam gling che ba'i brtul tsos grub dbang rgya gar paṇa wo thod phreng rtsal//gangs can skye rgu'i bsod nams mgron spyod dngos grub yid bzhi char du bsnyil//mda' yi sder bcad dus me'i grangs khams sgrib mas rdul bral stong r+ṣa yi ge lnga bos waṃ yig dang //ro yig rnam par dbyi ba'i sde wo cha phra'i dri bral thig le stong pa yi ge drug 'dus a//zung 'jug mchog tu 'a/ra med mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje stong gzugs

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shedaga' mar rjes chags mtshams sprin mdangs//dman ngor bla gos gsar pa'i 'od gzis 'dul 'dzin yongs kyi gtsug tor rtser 'dzegs btsong kha pa 242nal 'dud//tsho gos kyis bsgrubs pa dag pa'i zhing gtsor rang rig dpal ldan rdo rje sems//mngon 'gyur skal pa gnyis 'dzin gyis phra 'khor lkoms dam par sgro btags kyang //ngag dbang lha mos blo gros skal bzang rgya chen la sbyar mgrin pa'i mtshor//legs bshad skad snyan sgrog la spobs mtho 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen rgyal//gangs can phan bde'i nyer 'tshor srong btsan rjes//yongs bzhedas g.yu ru khra phrug gas lar//gsar bskrun snang brnyan ngo mtshar dam tshig par/ /ye shes sems dpa' rab 'bar bzhu blugs 'khyil/ /dge legs yongs 'du sa brtol yal 'dab rtser//phan bde'i lo 'bras yongs dud rten brten pa//bsod nams mgron du slar yang nyer bos pa'i//deb gter dbyangs bdun rna ba'i sos su 'dzin//de yang mdo sde bskal bzang las//de bzhin gshegs pa dus mkhyen rgyal po ni//snyan ngag mkhan tshe bde gshegs tsa mchog la//tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod nas kyang //byang chub tu ni dang por sems bskyed do//zhes pa ltar legs byas kyi phung po bla nas blar spel ba'i ched du snyan tshig gi lam nas drangs pa'i bstod bsngags sngon du 'gro bas skabs su gleng bar bya ba ni//'o skol gyi ston pa thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can nyon mongs dang shes bya'i sgrib pa mtha' dag spangs pa/bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tsho gis ma lus pa yongs su rdzogs pa gang de/mgon po ma pham 242bapas/thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten mkhyen//'jig rten kun la gzigs nas ni//chos kyi sku lasam g.yos par//sprul pa'i rang bzhin sna tshogs kyis//skye ba mjo zhe /ra skye ba dang //dga' ldan gnas nas 'pho ba dang //lhums su zhugs dang bltams pa dang //bzo yi gnas la mkhas pa dang //btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rol pa dang /nges 'byung dka' ba spyad pa dang //byang chub snying por gshegs pa dang //bdud sde bcom dang rdzogs pa ni/ /byang chub chos kyi 'khor lo dang / /mya ga 'das par gshegs mdzad rnams/ /yongs su ma dag zhing rnams su/0/srid pa ji srid gnas par ston/ /zhes gzod ma

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod jos khang bzang gi dkar chag shāminyid nas 'og min gyi gnas su nges pa lnga dang ldan pa'i gzugs sku mthar thugs pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyang / de las zhing khams gaṅgā'i rdul gyi grangs las 'das par sprul pa'i skur bstan pa las bye brag dga' ldan gyi lha'i tshogs kyi ston par dam pa rtag dkar po bzhugs pa'i tshe phyogs bcu'i yos rgyas kyi mthus sil snyan gyi sgra las/ bsod nams rgya chen tsho gis mang dran rtogs shing / /blo gros mtha' yas shes rab 'od mdzad pa/ /pha das med stobasamanga' sgyu rtsal rgya che ba/ /mar me mdzad kyi lung bstan dgongs par mdzod/ /ces bskul ba'i rkyen gyis skye srid 'dzin pa'i gling / rgya che rol pa las/ dge slong de ltar byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas dam pa na 'dug pa ni/ rnam par blta ba chen po bzhi la rnam par blta ste (243na tha zhi gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ dus la rnam par blta ba dang / /gling la rnam par blta ba dang/ /yul la rnam par blta ba dang/ rigs la rnam par blta ba'o/ /dge slong dag byang chub sems dpa' gling la rnam par blta zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni mtha' 'khob kyi gling du mi skye/ shar gyi lus 'phags por mi skye/ nub kyi ba lang spyod du mi skye/ byang gi sgra mi snyan du mi skye/ lho'i 'dzam bu'i gling nyid du skye'o/ /dge slong dag ci'i phyir/ /byang chub sems dpa' yul la rnam par blta zhe na byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /mtha' 'khob kyi yul gang na mi rnams dbang po brtul zhing blun pa/ /lug ltar lkugs pa'i rang bzhin can/ legs par bstan pa dang / nyes par bstan pa'i don shes par bya ba'i skal ba med pa dag tu mi skye'i byang chub sems dpa' ni yul gyi dbus nyid du skye'o/ /zhes pa'i 'dzam bu'i gling gi nang tshan/ yul grong khyer ser skya/ rigs rgyal po/ rus bu ram shing pa/ cho 'brang bud med kyi skyon dang bral ba sgyu ma lha mdzes/ /dus snyigs ma ste gzigs pa lnga la gzigs nas ma pham pa'i dbu la rin po che'i cod pan bcings te/ grogs po dag /khyed rnams la mi pham pas chos ston par 'gyur gyi bag yod par spyod cig /kho bo ni 'dzam bu'i gling du gdul bya 'dul —303

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)ba'i dusal bab ste/ mu stegasakyi lta ba ngan pa tshar bcad nasayang dag pa'i lta ba la ci nasakyang 'god dgos pa'i phyir/ zhesagasungasapa'i don yang rgya che rol pa las/ seng ge gcig gis gcan (243ba)gzan tshogasarnams du ma rnam par sgrag /rdo rje gcig gisabrag gi rtse mo du ma rnam par 'jig /brgya byin gcig gis lha min tshogasarnams du ma rnam par 'joms/ /nyi ma gcig gis mun pa'i tshogs rnamasadu ma rnam par sel/ /chosakyi dung gisamu stegasangan pa'i lta ba gzhom byasanas/ /yang dag lta ba'i tshogasarnamasakun nasarab tu rgyasapar byed/ khesa'abyung la/ dam pa dang po'i sangasargyasabasdus pa'i rgyud las/ 'di rnamasasgrol ba'i slad du srasadang bcasapa rgyal ba'i bdag po lasakyi sar ni rab zhugs te/ mngal ni rab tu bzung ba mdzad cing mchog gi thugs rje dag gi byang chub bskyed pa mdzad nas ni/ nyon mongs dang ni bdud rnams bcom nasas yis steng gi gnasasu chos kyi 'khor lo rab bskor to/ /sprul pa sgyu ma mdzad nas slar yang bcon ldan 'das ni dag pa'i sku can de nyid kho na'o/ /zhes pa ltar glang po che thal gar mche ba drug ldan gyi rnam par sa mo lug gi lo dbyar 'bring chu stod zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i mtshan gyi char yum gso sbyong la gnas pa'i dus glo g.yasapa nas lhums su zhugs tsan dan gyi khang bu brtsegs par byis pa zla drug lon pa'i tshad tsam pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan cing na bza' dang bcas pa skyil mo krung gis bzhugs te tshangs pas phul ba'i zil dngar bzhes pas sku lus brtas par mdzad de zla ba bcu rdzogs pa lcags pho spre'u'i lo sa ga zla ba'i tshes bdun res bza' spen pa zla skar rgyal la babs pa'i tshe yum gyi glo g.yas pa nasabaltams pa na/ lha rnams (244na)kyis rin po che sna lnga'i me tog tshogs kyis gtong )tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyisaka shi pa'i ras kyis blangs/ /dga' bo dang nye dga' bo gnyisakyis khrusagasol ba dang / 'di ni nga'i skye ba tha ma ste/ skye ba dang / rga ba dang / na ba dang / 'chi ba mthar dbyung ngo / /zhesaso/ de'i tshe rin po che'i char dang phyogs kun 'od zer gyis gang ba skye 'gro rnams sdug bsngal dang bral zhing dga' bdes khyab pas gzhen nu don kun grub pa/ shwakya gtum po'i tshogs rnams 'disathub pa bzhin du gyur pa dang /—304—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bsngos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag 6yirang nyid thub pa bzhin zhi bar gnas pas shākya thub pa/ shākya rnams kyi lha gnod sbyin shākya 'phel sogs 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyis 'di'i zhabs la phyag byas pas lha'i yang lha zhes pa rnams su btags/ri bo gangs can drang srong nag po'i mngon shes kyis rig nas ser skya'i grong du gshegs te/ btsas gyur gzhen nu yi ni mtshan ltas la/ /sum sto rtsa gnyis mtshan gyis brgyan pa mthong / /'di ni gnyis su 'gyur gyis gzhan du min/ khyim na gnas na 'khor los sgyur rgyal lam/ /khyim nas khyim med rab tu byung gyur na/ /'jig rten 'dir ni mngon rdzogs byang chub 'gyur/ /zhes rtsod dus 'bor ༷ ba mi 'byung ba'i phyir sangs rgyas su lung bstan/ dgung lo drug pa la gser gzheng du 'bras chen bzhes pa ma mas bkag kyang ma thub pas snod de glang po che lnga brgyar btags te 'phrog par brtsams pa mdzub mos de dag tshur drangs pas 'di'i mdzub mos glang po stong thub (244ba༄sa glang chen stong thub tu grags/ yi ge rtsis phongs sogs sgyu rtsal drug cu rtsa bzhi la tshegs med par byang zhing g.yin gyis 'gran zla dang bral bas/ lhas sbyin gyis ni glang po'i dbang po bsad/ /dga' bo yis ni goms pa bdun du khyer/ /byang chub sems dpa'i zhabs kyis bar snang la/ /rdo ba bzhin du phyi rol bar snang 'phangs/ /zhes rlom sems can mang po'i khengs pa rmeg med par bcoms/ gzhan gyis 'phya ba spangs pa sogasa'ajig rten gyi chos dang sgo bstun te sa 'tsho ma/ grags 'dzin ma/ ri dgas skye ma sogs btsun mor bzhes pa'i sa 'tsho ma bud med brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gtso mor dbang bskur nas rang lo nyer dgu'i bar khab tu bzhugs/ de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs kyis sil snyan gyi sgra las/ 'chi med mya ngan med pa sangs rgyas te/ /sgom pas nyam thag bdud rtsis tshim byas shing / khyod kyi sngon smras tshig mchog dran byas te/ /grong khyer dam pa 'di nas myur du phyungs/ /zhes lung bstan dang mthun par grong khyer gyi sgo bzhir rga ba na ba 'chi ba/ yid du 'ong ba'i dge slong rnams rim par gzigs pas rkyen dang / da ni zhag bdun nas rab tu ma byung na 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur ba mtshan mkhan rnams kyis lung bstan pa thos pas yab la rab tu byung bar gsol yang ma gnang bar shākya rnams —305

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)kyis me la tshe byas pa na nya'i nub mo grags 'dzin ma'i mngal du sras sgra gcan 'dzin bskrun/ /brgya byin (245na)gyi mthus srung mkhan rnams gnyid sdug po la g.yur du bcug ste/ stobs dang brtson 'grus 'phags pa myur du bzhengs/ /sdug bsngal nyen pa'i sems can sgrol ba dang / /bla med byang chub mngon du bya ba'i phyir/ /da ni mngon par 'byung ba'i dus la bab/ /ces bskul nas chibs kyi rmig pa lha'i bu bzhis bteg nas rdzu 'phrul kyis mkha' la 'phags te mchod rten rnam dag gi drung du rang lo nyer dgu pa sa pho byi ba'i lor grogs gzhan la ma bltos par rang nyid kyis dbu skra bcad/ brgya byin gyis gos ngur smig phul ba bzhes nas rang byung gi sgo nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ de nyid du ring 'phur la ci yang med pa dang / gaṅgā'i pha rol tu ma ga dhar lhag spyod la srid rtse'i sems dag mngon du mdzad pas dge sbyong go ta mar mtshan thogs/ de nas dka' thub kyi gnas su gdung ba lnga'i sbyor bas bzhugs pas drang srong rnams kyis dge sbyong chen por mtshan gsol/ chu bo ni rañdza na'i 'gram du thog mar til/ rgya shug gos rnams 'bru re gsol/ dbugs rgyu ba bcad de lo drug gi bar du mkha' khyab kyi ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag nas bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa mthar phyin kyang zas rags pa med pas sku lus skems pa dang shi ba lta bu yab rgyal po sogs kyis gzigs pas mya ngan du gyur pa'i tshe/ nyi zla skar tsho gos sa la lhung mi srid/ /so so skye bo yin yang nga mi 'chi/ /de phyir 'di la mya ngan khyod ma byed/ /ring por mi thogs byang chub sangs rgyas mthong / /(245bkrokhi gsungs nas dbugs dbyung / de yang gsang sngags ltar na rang lo so lnga par phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas nam mkha' gang ba byon nas se gol gtogos te/ bsam gtan 'di ni rnam dag min/ /mthar thug thob byed kyang 'di min/ khyod kyis 'od gsal dmigs bya ste/ /nam mkha'i ngos lta mchog yin no/ /zhes dbyangs gcig gis gsungs pas/ting nge 'dzin de btang nas bzhengs te rnam smin gyi lus der bzhag nas ye shes kyi lus 'og min du mngon byang lngas sangs rgyas te/ ri rab kyi rtse mor rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs par bzhed/ slar rnam smin gyi lus la zhugs/ grong pa'i bu mo legs skyes mas ba stong gi 'o ma lan bcu drug tu nying khur —306

sku gsung thug rten gsar sakhosadang rin po che'i mchod rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar chag 9yibyas nasaphul ba bsten pa'i mod la sku mtshan dpe'i snang ba mngon par bkra zhing 'od zer 'dom gang ba 'phro bar gyur/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyisabla na med pa'i byang chub mngon du byed pa/ saphal pa rnamasakyisabasten par mi bzod par dgongs nas ma dh+ya ga ta dha ra la tsan+d+ra par bṛ kho da ra la sogasapa rnamasaso zhesapa'i bsdu ba byasapasam ga dha zhesadabus 'gyur 'chang du grags pa gang du gnas pa'i phyogasakyang dus 'khor dang bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho sogs su 'dzam gling che chung gnyis su bshad pa'i chung ba 'di ri rab kyi lho phyogs kyi ngos be+e ḍūr+ya sngon po'i 'og khyim 'khor losasgyur ba'i rgyal khamasakyi snying po rtse mo rdo rje gdan byang chub kyi snying po can shing dzasbu tri sha'i grib bsil dang ldan pa klu'i rgyal bo ma dros(246na)pa'i mtsho 'gram gling gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa chos mngon pa ltar na shing rta'i dbyibasadang la lar sog pa'i dbyibs/ dusakyi 'khor lor gru gsum du gnasapa'i lte ba rdo rje gdan/ de'i phyogasami 'gyur ba'i gzer chen shar phyogasargya nag gi rgyal khamasan 'phags pa 'jamadapa'adabyangasakyisartsisakyi sgo slobargyad khribazhi stongagasungasapa'i gnasari bo rtselnga/ lho phyogasan gnyisamed dusa'akhor rtsa rgyud gsungasapa'i dpal ldan 'brasaspungasakyi mchod rten na ye shesasems dpa' ma bsdusapar bzhugasaba'i sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dang rgya mtsho'i gling na rtse mor phyag na bad+mo'i pho brang po ta la/ rtsa bar 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bzhugs gnas yod ba/ nub phyogasan rgyud thamasacad kyi gsang mdzod mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'dus pa'i skyon rdo rje 'chang chen po'i pho brang he ru ka rang byung gi gtsug lag khang zhes bya ba rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi gnas/ byang phyogasan gsang chen rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi smin grol rnamasachosargyal rigs ldan rim par byon te chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i gnas ka lā pa'i grong khyer/gzhan yang kye rdor bde mchog saṃ bhu ṭi sogasanas yul nyer bzhi dang dur khrod brgyad sogs gnas sum cu rtsa gnyisagling chung ngu 'dir yod par bshad/ chosamangon pa las/ rdo rje gdan nasari brgyud dgu 'dasab na gangasari dpal dang ldan ba/ de'i (246ba)pha rol na ri sposangad ldan/ de gnyisakyi —307—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shebar na yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mtsho ma dros pa/ de'i shar brag glang po che'i kha 'dra ba nas gaṅgā sa dngul gyi bye ma/ de bzhin du lhor brag khyu mchog gi kha nas sis sa be+e ḍūrla'i bye ma/ nub phyogs brag rta'i kha 'dra ba nas pa k+ṣus shel gyi bye ma/ byang phyogs su brag seng ge'i kha 'dra ba nas snyi tus gser gyi bye ma drangs te bzhi gar chu phran lnga brgya dang bcas ma dros pa la g.yas skor lan bdun byas nas shar la sogs pa'i phyogs bzhi'i rgya mtshor 'bab der shing pa tri shar 'bras bu dmar po dzo ma tsam pa chur lhung ba'i sgrar dzam zhes pa'i sgras gling gi ming yang der thogs shing / klu'i rgyal po rnams lhar sprul nasa'abras bu myong ba'i lhag rnams ma dros pa'i chu'i nus pas gser du 'gyur bar rwa chu bo'i gser du grags/ sposang da ldan gyi byang phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu 'das par brag ser gyi bya skyibs can lha ma yin gyi ngos zhes brag g.yog brgya stong dang bcas pa/ de'i byang dpag tshad nyi shu bgrod pa na shing swā la'i rgyal po rab brtan 'dom bzhi bcu thur du zug pa/ brgyad bcu gyen du 'phags pa/ stong phran rim pa bdun kyis bskor ba/ de'i shar du dpag tshad nyi shu na rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab par rdzing g.yog brgyad stong dang bcas/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chus gang ba'i nang na pad+ma'i 'dab ma ba lang gi ko ba/sdong bu gshol mda'/ me tog shing rta'i phang lo ltar yod pa la ro sbrang rtsi dang 'dra ba/ brgya byin gyi glang po che rab brtan (247na〉grong g.yog brgyad stong dang bcas dgun zla bzhi brag gser gyi bya skyibs/dpyid zla bzhi su la'i rgyal po/ ston zla bzhi rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab par rgyu/ rma bya chen mo sogs nasabashad pa'i yul 'khor lnga brgya dang ljongs chen po bcu drug dang / yul phran stong dang / 'dul ba nas 'byung ba'i 'phags yul gyi grong khyer chen po drug dang gzhan yang mi rigs mi gcig pa sum brgya drug cu/ skad rigs mi gcig pa bdun brgya nyi shu sogs kyang ma bkag pa nyid las yod pa ngo mtshar ba'i zhing gi gtso bo rdo rje gdan du rto 'tsho me gi khye'u bkra shis las blangs pa'i rtswa'i rtse mo rnams nang du bstan pa'i steng zhal zhal shar du phyogs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung bcas nas sku lus drang por bsrangs/ mnyam bzhag mdzad nas stan 'dir bdag gis lus 'di skams kyang rung / /rus pa pags pa sha rnams zhig —308

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (makyang rung / /bskal mang rnyed dka'i byang chub ma thob bar/ /stan 'di las ni lus bskyod mi bya'o/ /zhesadam bcas nas rjes 'jug gi gdul bya rnams kyis 'bras bu khyad par can mngon du byed pa la/ bar chad sna tshogs yang zhing de dag gis mi tshugs par lam mthar phyin par byed dgos par shes pa'i phyir du smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas 'od zer bkye ste/ bdud kyi gzhal med khang la sogs pa'i phyogs kun snang bar mdzad pas de dag gis rang gi 'khor mi sdug pa dpag tu med pa dang bcas lag cha sna tshogs kyis brdeg pa me tog gi char du gyur pas drag pos gnod par mi nus pa shes nas bud (247bsgod rnams mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur kyis 'drid pa de dag rgan mor byin gyis brlabs pas bslu bar ma nus/ bdud sdig can gyis khyod kyi bsod nams 'di tsam gyis thar pa thob par ga la 'gyur smras pas lan du/ khyod kyi gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin gcig gis 'dod pa'i dbang phyug tu gyur na kho bos de 'dra ba grangs med pa byas pas ci'i phyir mi 'gyur gsungs par/ kho bo'i mchod sbyin gyi dbang por khyod yod mod/ khyod kyi de la su yod smras pa na byang chub sems dpas phyags la bsnun te/ sa 'di 'gro ba kun gyi gnas yin te/ khyu dang mi rgyu mnyam zhing nye 'khon med/ /'di ni bdag gi dpang ste bdag rdzun med/ /'di la khyod kyis bdag gi dpang byos shig /ces gsungs pas sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos pa'i gseb nas sa'i lha mo brtan ma gser gyi mdog can lus phyed phyung nas thal mo sbyar te skyes bu chen po de de bzhin no/ khyod kyis ji skad smras pa bzhin te/ 'di ni bdag la mngon sum mo/ /'on kyang bcom ldan nyid/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi dpang du gyur pa lags so/ /zhes mi snang bar gyur/ nyi ma nub ba na gshin rje gshed kyi skur bstan nas sdig can ma he la zhen pa brdzis te btul nas kha mthun/ zil gnon/ khro 'dus/ dgra nag gshed dmar sogs kyi rgyud gsungs pa gshed skor gyi chos 'byung rnams su gsal/ nam gyi cha stod la bsam gtan bzhi dang gung la mngon shes lnga skyed/ gsang sngags ltar na sngar nam (248na)mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa'i rdo rje'i rnal 'byor thugs nyams su bstar bas dgung lo so lnga pa shing rta sa ga zla ba'i tshes —309

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)bco lnga'i skya rengs 'char ba'i tshe zla ba la dus me zhugs pa dang mngon par rdzogs par mtshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan/de'i tshe grags 'dzin mar bltams pa'i sras la sgra gcan 'dzin du grags shing bdud rtsi zas kyi bur kun dga' bo 'khrungs/sa g.yos/'jig rten snang bar byas/bdud rnams phyogs kun tu byer te zhag bdun du phrad par ma gyur/de nas shing tā la bdun tsam du 'phags te/lam gyi rgyud ni ho/zag pa zad do zhes go du brjod pas lha rnams kyis me tog gtor te mchod/sangs rgyas kyi mthus kun tu bzang pos sangs rgyas phal po che'i chos kyi rnam grangs bshad/zhag bdun phrag dang po la sprul pa'i sku me'i khams la zhugs nas byang chub kyi shing drung du skyil krung ma bshig par bzhugs/mngon par byang tso pa'i sku ni 'dod lha'i gnas su byon te phyogs bcu'i rgyal sras 'dus nas cho me bstobasten/bdun phrag gnyis pa la dbang sgyur gyi gnas su rdo rje snying pos sa bcu pa dang /ston pasarnam snang mngon byang gi rgyud gsungs/sprul pa'i skus ni stong gsum zhabs kyis bcags/'di ltar gsang sngags la bshad mod theg pa thun mong pa ltar na byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs pa la lha rnams kyi mchod cing bstod pa/gnyis pa la stong gsum ring du 'chag ces byung / 244bsum pa la byang chub kyi snying por spyan mi 'dzum par gzigs/ bzhi pa la ri gling mtha' dag zhabs kyis bcags/ lnga pa la klu btang bzung gi gnas su bzhugs/drug pa la shing n+ya gro dhar skyong gi drung du bzhugs/bdun pa la shing sgrol rgyu'i tshal du bzhugs te tshong pa ga gon dang bzang pos sbrang rtsi'i 'dag gu phul ba rgyal chen bzhis phul ba'i lhung bzed du bzhes te/lha yi bkra shis don grub cing //phyogasarnams bkra shis byed pa des/khyod kyi don rnams grub gyur cig thams cad myur du mthun par shog/ces shis pa brjod//a mong ba'i snang ngor//zab bzhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas//bdud rtsi lta bu'i chos shig kho bos rnyed//su la bstan kyang go bar ma nus pas//mi smra nags kyi tshal du gnas par bya//zhes te thugs las chung ngur chos mi gsung ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs par/tshangs pa dang brgya byin 'jig rten gyi gtso bo yin pas de dag gis gsol ba btab nas chos gsungs na/gdul 0

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sa 6)bya rnams chos la ches cher 'jug pa'i dgos pa khyad par can gzigs nas/'od bkye bas stong gsum gyi bdag po tshangs pa gtsug phud can gyis shes nas grogs tshangs pa 'bum phrag drug cu rtsa brgyad dang bcas 'ongs te gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong phul nas gsol ba btab pas cang mi gsung ba'i tshul gyis zhal gyis bzhes ba tsam las chos kyi 'khor lo ma bskor bas brgya byin sbran te des gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dpag tshad lnga 249na tsher byu pa phul nas gsol ba btab pa sogs kyis rkyen byas yul wa ra ṇa sir drang srong lhung ribs dgas kyi nags su sangs rgyas nas zhag zhe dgu 'das pa chu stod zla ba'i tshes bzhi la 'khor lnga sde bzang po la dge slong dag 'di ni bden pa bzhi ste sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung dang /'gog pa dang lam mo//zhes sogs dang /sdug bsngal ni yongs su shes par bya'o//kun 'byung ni spang bar bya'o zhes so gos dang /sdug bsngal ni yongs su shes so//kun 'byung spang ngo //zhes so gos chos 'khor dang po bskor ro//gnas bya rgod phung po'i rir 'khor stong nyis brgya lnga gsam lnga stong gi dge slong dang /dge slong ma dang /dge bsnyen pha ma dang /byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig brgya stong la yum sras bcu bdun sogs bar pa mas ṣ+ka med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ri ma la ya dang yangs pa can sogs su theg pa mtha' dag la yang dag par zhugs pa'i byang sems la bka' dang bo dang bar pa'i sgras zin la dngos su 'gal ba ltar snang ba rnams rtsod pa spangs te tha mar legs pa rnam par phye ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/dgung lo gya gcig bzhes pa lcags thig nag pa zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la dpal ldan sa spungs su dus kyi 'khor lo rtsa ba'i rgyud stong phrag bcu gnyisapa phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa zla ba bzang po so gos la bska/de nas zla gcig tu nye ba na/grong khyer rtsacan gyi swā la zung gi tshal du kun dga' bos bshams pa'i 249bsko zims khri la mnal ba'i tshul mdzad pa las bzhengs te tā la bdun tsam du nam mkha' la 'phags nas khyed rnams nga'i sku gser btso ma lta bu la ltos shig/nga ni mya ga las 'da' 'o//sangs rgyas mthong ba ni rnyed par dka' ba yin no//zhes gsungs nas na bza' bsal te sku gsal bar bstan nas khri la gzims te dge slong rnams

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gel 'du shes bcu ston pa'i mdo gsungs/ nga ni rtag tu zhi ba'i snang ba la gnas pas mya ngan las 'dasapa chen po zhes bka' stsal nas sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i mtshan phyed la mya ngan las 'da' tshul bstan yang don dam par gser 'od las/ sangs rgyas mya ༅ yongs mi 'da'/ /cho me kyang nub par mi 'gyur zhing / /sems can rnams ni 'dul ba'i phyir/ /mya ngan 'das pa ston par mdzad/ khres khrung la/ de'i tshe gyad rnams kyis dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi sa gang ba'i mchod pas mchod cing lcags sgrom du bzhugs pa gyad kyis btegs bzhin par mkha' la 'phags te rto can gyi grong khyer la lan bdun bskor nas dbu rgyan btags pa'i mchod rten gyi drung du spos gyi shing brtsegs pa'i steng du bzhugs shing / thugs ka nas ye shes kyi me zhag bdun sbar ba'i mthar mche ba gnyis brgya byin dang laṅka'i bdag pos gdan drangs/ tshems mche ba 'og ma gnyis ma gtags gzhan thams cad yungs thi lta bu'i ring bsrel du gyur pa bse sgrom khal phyed tsam 'gro ba brgyad du gtams nas rtswa can gyi gzhi mdor mar pa na rten (250na)gyi ོ du g.yul bsham par nye ba'i tshe 'od srungs 'a po dang bram ze bre mnyam gyis cha brgyad du bgos te/ rtsa can gyi rgyad/ sdig can gyi gyad/ rgyal rigs bu lu ka /sirnya gling gi rgyal po kro tu/ khyab 'jug gling gi bram ze/ ser skya'i shākya/ yangs pa can gyi li tsa bī/rgyal po ma skyes dgra rnams la byin pas so so'i yul du mchod rten brtsigs te sku gdung gi mchod rten brgyad du grags so/ /tshems gnyis ni tshig 'dzin dang / la ba'i rgyal po la byin/ de yang rtog ge 'bar ba las/ theg pa chen po sangs rgyas kyi gsungs pa yin te/ rtsa ba'i bsdub byed pa po kun tu bzang po dang 'jam dpal dang / gsang ba'i bdag po dang / byams pa la sogs pa rnams kyis bsdus pa'i phyir ro/ /zhes pa ltar phyag na rdo rje sangs rgyas stong gi bka' bsdub por gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo dang phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud las bshad/ de'i rjes su rgyal po'i khab kyi lha'i phyogs bi ma la swa bhā wa zhes pa'i ri la rgyal sras 'bum phrag bcu 'dus te/ 'jam dpal gyis mngon pa/ byams pas 'dul ba/ kun tu bzang pos mdo sdebasdus pa theg pa chen po'i lugs yin cing / thun —312

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga shā'imong ba ltar na dus de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyi lo dbyar gnas len par phyogasapa/ gnas rgyal po'i khab tu 'od srungs nye bar 'khor gyis gtsos dgra bcom pa bzhi brgya dgu bcu rtsa dgu rgyun du zhugs pa'i kun dga' bo dang bcas theg dman gyi sde (250ba〉(da gsum bka' rnam dag ma yin pa'i log rtog sel ba'i ched du bsdu bar gang zag gcig ma tshang ba kun dga' bo 'od srungs chen pos bka'i chad pa phab pa'i rkyen gyis dgra bcom ba'i 'bras bu 'thob pa yin cing / snam sbyar lnga brgya bting de kun dga' bo gsol ba dang gnyis kyi las kyis bskos pa bzhugs te/ mgo bor gling bzhi bar du 'brel dang mtshams sbyor/ mthar 'khor 'dus tshul dang rjes su yi rang bcug nasamado sde'i sde snod rgyal bas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin du sgro skur med pa thugs la tshar gcig gsungasapa ni/ kun dga' bos mdo sde'i sde snod bsdus pa'i don no/ /de nas nye bar 'khor bskos nas sngar ji lta ba bzhin du 'dul ba'i sde snod bsdus/ de nasa'od srungs bskos pa med par rang 'dzegs te mgo bor gleng gzhi/ bar du 'brel dang mtshams sbyor mthar 'khor 'dus tshul dang / rjes su yi rang bcug nas/ mngon pa'i sde snod rnams rgyal bas ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin sgro skur med par thugs la tshar gcig gsungs pa ni/ 'od srungs kyis ma rga pa'i dzisnod bsdus pa'i don no/ /sangs rgyas gshegs nas lo brgya dang bcu song ba na gnas yangasapa can du dgra bcom pa grags pa la sogs pa bdun brgyas dge slong lha chen po can gyi/ mi rung ba'i gzhi bcu sogs 'dul ba'i lag len dri bcas rnams sun dbyung ba'i ched du dge 'dun rnams kyis sdosnod gsum zhal 'don dang / bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong mdzad nas bka' gnyis (251na)ba bsdus/ston pa gshegs nas lo bzhi brgya 'das pa na/ yul mnyan yod du byang chub sems dpa' lnga brgya/dgra bcom pa lnga brgya/ so so skye bo'i paṇ+ḍita khri drug stong ste khri bdun stong gis bdud sdig can gi sprul pa dge slong bzang pos chos log bstan pa de'i slob ma rnams kyis dar bar byas pa'i rkyen gyis sde pa bco brgyad phan tshun bstan pa yin min rtsod pa sun phyung ste sde pa bco brgyad yang dag pa'i bstan par 313

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogebacug pa'i dgos pa/mi brjed pa'i gzungs ma thob pa rnams kyi don du glegs bam ye ger bris pa bka' bsdugasum pa yin la/theg pa che chud gi bka' rgyal sras nyan thos rnams kyis legs par bsdusapa dag dar rgyas su mdzad pa'o//mjam dpal rtsa rgyud las/de bzhin gshegs pa nga 'das nas/lo ni bzhi brgya len pa na/dge slong klu zhes de 'bod 'byung //bstan pa la ni dad cing phan//4tu dga' ba'i sa thob pa//lo ni drug brgya dag tu 'tsho//rig pa rma bya wo mo ni//bdag ṣ+ka r+ṣa po des kyang 'grub//bska bcos sna tsho gos don dang ni//dngos po med pa'i don de rig/gang tshe lus de bor ba na//bdeb ༅ du skye bar 'gyur//de ni mthar gyis sangs rgyas//nye ba kho nar yang dag 'thob//ces sangs rgyas gnyis pa dpal mgon 'phags pa klu grub kyis dngos bstan stong nyid kyi rim pa gtso bor gyur pa'i thub gsung kyi dgongs pa legs par bkral zhing de nyid las/thogs med 251bces bya'i dge slong ni//bstan bcos de ni don la mkhas//mdo sde nges don drang ba'i don/r+sām pa mang po ra btu 'byed//'jig rten rig pa ston bdag nyid//gzhung phyed ngang tshul mā du 'gyur//de yis rig pa grub pa ni//sa la'i pho nya mo zhes brjod//de yi sngags kyi mthu yis ni//blo ni bzang po skye bar 'gyur//bstan pa yun ring gnas bya'i phyir//mdo yi de nyid don sdud byed//lo ni brgya dang lnga bcur 'tsho//de lus zhig nas lha yul 'gro//'khor ba rnams su 'khor ba na//yun ring byed pa rjesamyong nas//bdag nyid wo po mthar bgyis de//byang tso thob par 'gyur ba yin//ces 'phags pa thogs med kyis sbas don mngon rtogs kyi rim pa gtso bor bkral te shing rta chen po rnam gnyis zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa'i srol legs par 'dzin pa rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen pos/shing rta chen po'i srol ni legs bzung nas//'dzam gling blo gsal bye ba'i mig 'byed pa//'phags pa lha dang dpa' bo sangs rgyas bskyangs//legs ldan 'byed dang zla ba grags pa'i zhabs//dbyig gnyen zhabs dang de sras yon tan 'od/shwakya 'od dang phyogs kyi glang po dang //chos kyi gragasapa'i zhabs sogs 'dzam gling rgyan//thub bstan mi nub rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i mchog /ces 'dzam

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga 9yigling mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan drug dang mchog gnyis rjes 'brangs dang bcas pas grub mtha' smra ba rnam bzhi'i ring lugs 'phags pa'i yul grur nyin mo ltar gsal bar mdzad cing / 'jam (252na)dpal rtsa rgyud las/ yi ge dha zhes sdome brtson nyid/ /lho yi phyogs su rnam par bsgrags/ /pha rol rgol ba bzlog nas kyang / /de bzhin sdom brtson sngags kyang grub/ /ces shrī nā lan+da'i mkhan po dpal ldan chos skyong bdag med rdo rje btsun mo la brten nas grub mtha' bstogs te phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub brnyes shing lho phyogs su mu stegs pa mtha' dag brtul zhugs kyis tshar bcad pa grub pa'i 'khor lo sgyur ba bi rū pas mtshon grub chen brgyad cu rtsa bzhi sogs kyis skal ldan mtha' dag smin grol gyi lam la bkod de rgyal ba'i ring lugs bla nas blar 'phel ba'i rgyun bzang po las 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud du/ nga yi dus na lo brgya na/ kha ba can du mtsho bri nas/ swā la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes mtsho skams pa'i shul du mi'i 'gro ba chagasapar bshad pa lha las phul byung gi bstod par/ skya seng bu lnga dang dgra ngan dpung tsho gos bcu gnyisayibs pa dus su rgyal po ru pa ti zhes ba dmag stong phrag gcig dang bcas pa bud med kyi chas su zhugs te/ ri gangs can gyi gseb tu bros pa las 'phel ba yin par bshad/thugs rje chen po'i bka' 'bum dang bka' chems ka 'khol ma sogs su bod 'di thugs rje chen po dang sgrol ma'i 'dul zhing yin pas de gnyis kyi sprul pa spre'u dang brag srin mo 'dus pa lasami'i 'gro ba 'phel te se sdong rmu stong ste rus chen bzhi dang / drug tu byed na bod mi khri tho chen po bya ba de la dgra 'bru sdong lga dang (252ba'i bo dpa' mnga' ste mi'u gdung drug mtshal ba'i hu lan deb gter du spre'u dang brag srin mo las mched pa ma sangs spun dgu/ rgyal phran nyi shu rtsa lnga/ bgraganyis/ silam bzhi bskyes rim gyis dbang byas par bshad cing rgyal phran sil ma mang du byung ba'i mthar bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal po ni kha cig ko sa la'i rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi sras lnga tshigs yin zer kha cig gzugs can snying po'i sras chung ba stobs chung gi sras lnga tshigs yin zer/ kha cig bod dang bdud —315

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gernams gnod sbyin gyi rgyal phran bcu gnyis kyis mnar ba'i dus su bod sa la'i rgyal po 'char byed kyi bu mig mas 'gebs/ sor mo dra bas 'brel ba mtshan ldan zhig byung bsag par dogs nas gaṅgā la bskyur ba zhing pas rnyed de gsos nas cher skyes pa na sngar gyi gtam bshad pa'i yid skyo ste gangs ri'i khrod du bros pa na rim gyis lha ri yol ba'i khar byon pa de gnya' khri btsan po yin zer/ /don du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spel pa'i slad du rigs gsum mgon po dang kun tu bzang po sogs 'phags chen dam pas byin gyis brlabs bas rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa bdun gyi mthar lha tho tho ri gnyen btsan gyis pho brang yom bu bla mkhar du bzhugs pa'i tshe dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes/ de nasargyal rabs bzhi song nas 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan 'di la/ /rnam pa sna tsho gos bya ba byed/ /byang gi phyogs la brten nas ni/ /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ /gangs can ri yi nang gnas (253na)pa'i/ /rgyal po mi yi lha zhes pa/ /byu bī rnams rigs su 'byung / /de yang sngags kyi don sgrub ste/ /longs spyod tshe dang ldan par 'gyur/ /rig pa longs spyod ldan zhes bya/ /mi yi bdag po de yang 'grub/ ces dang / bka' gdam glems bam du/ 'di nas skye ba gzhan rgyas ma chod par/ /bod khams mgon med yul du thugs rjes song / /bod ni rgyal po dag la tshad mar 'dzin/ /mi dbang mdzod la bod khams bde bar skyongs/ /zhes pa ltar mi rje srong gtsan sgam po ni yab gnam ri srong btsan dang yum 'bri bza' thod dkar ma'i sras su me mo glang gi lo la pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling du sku bltams/ phyag zhabs 'khor los mtshan cing dbu skra mthon mthing du yod pa'i mi las 'das pa zhig byon/ nar son ༷ rtsal gyi gnas kun la byang zhing thugs dkyel che bas blon po rnams kyi 'o cag gi rje 'di ni yon tan mtha' yas shing thugs shin tu sgam par gyur pas na mtshan yang srong btsan sgam por btags/ dgung lo bcu gsum pa la rgyal sar mnga' gsol/yab mes kyi srol rgyun spel ba'i slad du dmar po ri'i pho brang btab nas bzhugs/ chos dge ba bcu'i —316

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shāmikhrims spel bar yi ge dgos par dgongs te thon mi a nu'i bu mtshan thams cad mkhyen pa zha lu lo tsā bas/ gangs can khrod pa'i bla ma mchog /sa ṭa zhes grags pa yi/ zhes bod yang dag pa dang / paṇa chen byams pa gling pas/ kun tu bzang po'i rtsa ba brgyad pa sogs(253ba)rgya cher spel dang de yi rjes 'jug pa/ /gnas brgyad su ban+ta sogs sngon byung ba/ /mkhas dang sgyur byed yongs kyi smra ba'i gzhi/ /zhes sa lha gdang / skyogs ston smin drug lo tsā bas 'khrungs yul gyi sa de 'bur du yod pasasa'abo ra yin par 'chad pa gang ltar de nyid yi ge bslab par rgya gar du rgyal pos mngags pa bzhin bram ze li byin la yi ge dang / paṇ+ḍita lha rig pa'i seng ge la sgra sogs rig pa mang du sbyangs te bod du byon/rgyal por rgyu mtshan rnams gsol bas blon po rig pa'i gnas rnams la mkhas par gyur kyang yi ge rnams bod kyi skad la mkho ba zhig ma byung bas rgyal blon gnyis kyis skyid shod nyang bran pho brang ma rur sku mtshams bcad nas rgya yig lnga bsto tham pa bod yig sum cur gtan la phab/ rgyal po'i smin mtshamasanas sprul pa'i dge slong ā ka ra ma ti shī las rgya gar gyi yul nas jo bo bcu gcig zhal dang lo ke shwa ra ste rang byon gyi sku gnyis yi dam gyi lhar gdan drangs nas pho brang gi rtser bzhugs su gsol nas rgyal po'i dogs sel gyi gros mtha' dag yi dam gyi lha la 'dri/ /jo shāka gnyis sogs bod yul bsod nams kyi zhing du 'dren ba sogs dgos pa du ma'i ched du khro gnyer can gyi sprul pa bal mo bza' khri btsun dang rgya mo bza' kong jo btsun mor bsu ba'i thabs mkhas kyi 'phrul chen po mdzad/ /jo bo rnam gnyis kyi pho brang 'phrul snang dang ra mo che'i gtsug lag khang brtsigs par nag phyogs kyi 'dre srin gdugs pa can (254na gyis brtsig tu ma ster bar rgyal po yab yum gsum gyis pho brang ma rur sgrub pa mdzad bas rig gsum mgon po zhal gzigs shing dbugs dbyung ba ltar bod srin mo gan rgyal du bskyel bar sa'i me btsa' lta bu'i gtsug lag khang bcu gnyis sngon la rtsig dgos par dgongs nas/ srin mo'i dpung pa g.yas na dbu ru na ka tshal mi 'gyur ba'i lha khang dang / de'i lag tu gseng shang 'gir rta'i lha khang / g.yon g.yu ru na khra 'brug bkra shis byams snyoms kyi lha khang dang lag —317

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo sang rgya mtsho gsung 'bum/ (0)tsan thang gi lha khang /rkang pa g.yas na gtsang 'gram byang chub dge gnas kyi lha khang dang lag dge drung gi lha khang /g.yon na grom pa rgyang dri med rnam dag gi lha khang dang lag 'bre'i lha khang ste mtha' 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi/des kyang ma non dogs nas gru mo g.yas shar stag gi mgo steng na kong po bu chu'i lha khang /g.yon lhor 'brug gi ze steng na lho brag mkho mthing gter gyi lha khang /bus mo g.yasanub phyogs bya dmar sgal steng na 'tshal rigs shes rab sgron ma'i lha khang /g.yon byang rus sbal dbral steng na bra dun rtse'i lha khang ste yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag khang bzhi/des kyang ma non na/lag mthil g.yas la tshangs pa rlung gnon gyi lha khang /g.yon la khams su klong thang sgrol ma/rkang mthilagayas na mang yul byams sprin dge rgyas lha khang /g.yon na pa gro skye chu'i lha khang ste ru gnon pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhi la sogs pa/dri gtsang khang bcu gnyis lag dang bcas pa 254ba tha rtsigs pa'i nang nas 'od gsal lha rigs gtsang ma las 'ongs pa ma sangs la khye'u mtshan ltas dang ldan pa de nyid rje sha khri btsun pos gzigs nas//dges pa rnam par dkar bas bdag gir bgyis pa sger dpal legasa'od nas brtsams te phyi sger nang sger grub thob kyi sger dang gsum las/mi rabs nyer lnga pa na nang sger lha rigs gtsang mar ral pa 'dzin zhes pa/gru gu'i yul du ded dpon mngags te g.yu rdzing bdun blangs pa'i bod rnams kyi rgyan du spa ba'i phyag rjes che/phyag na pad+ma'i gzugs can srong btsan sgam po'i bka'i nang blon wo por gyur te/nag po klu'i cho 'phrul khra'i lus can mgo bo lnga pa 'brug gi skad 'byin pa/rigs sngags kyis brtul ba don gyi go ba ming du chags pa/sa'i me btsa' la snga ba g.yo ru khra thig gi lha khang sgo drug ka ba drug/khyams kyi na char snga phyi/nge'i shar phyogs su byams pa mi 'gyur ba'i lha khang /thugs dam bkra shis 'od 'bar mchod rten mgo lnga sogs rten dang brten par bcas pa 'gro ba'i phyag mchod kyi yul du bzhengs ba'i gtsug lag khang 'di nyid mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa lha ldan zan g.yang gnyis dang phyogs mtshungs pa'i phyir thang yig las/bsam yas mchims phu yar klungs shel gyi brag ci/mer pa zla ba phug gi gnas 'di gsum bsam

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shā'iyas khra 'brug ra sa'i gtsug lag dang : zung du 'brel ba'i gnas chen sgrub pa'i gnas (255na)zhing mchog dam pa kun la'ang de las med 'di gsum gnas la mchog mthun gang bsgrub pa sgrub ba byas na mi 'grub gang yang med gnas 'brel tsam yang rigs 'dzin gral la tshud: phung po bor nas mkha' spyod gnas su 'gro zhes gsungs pa'i skyon he ru ka rang byung gi gtsug lag khang yar klungs shel gyi brag phug dang gos kyi gong pa lta bur zung du 'brel zhing chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che dang gnam gyi lha gong ma rgyal bo se chen gan gnyis mchod yon nyi zla zung du 'brel ba'i dusayig tshang las/ mnga' ris man nas zha lu yan/ /mgon me gling zhes pas brtsis/ de man 'bri gung yan gyi sa/ /su thugs skyid bdag gis brtsis/ /de phying sa skya'i dpon chen ni/ /zam glu gun mi dbon hu yi/ /ming thob shākya bzang po de'i/ /deb zer shog dril can bzhin yin/ khri skor de pas dbus gtsang gi /'ja' mo 'dzin lugs 'di ltar snang / /zhes khri skor bcu gsum du phye ba'i dpal phag mo gru pa'i khri 'og tu gtoges ba 'di nyid du 'phags yul ba kū la du ti zhes pa sa pho rta'i lo rgyal dar gong pa mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyi bod 'bangs kyi bde thabs dang sgos kyi pha dgos dgos/ ma skyid skyid/ skrun mgon po rab brtan/ khyi skyag /ngag dbang skal ldan/ tsha bo ngag dbang bstan 'dzin sogasanye du rnams kyi 'di phyi'i legs tshogs spel ba'i ched du bde bar gshegs pa brgyad/ /tshe mtha' (255badzes pa longs sprul gyi cha byad can gnyis/ bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa/ rgyal ba ma pham pa sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po shar btsong kha ba blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag dang bcas pa/ zhan byung khe gsum du bzhugs rgyu'i o rgyan rin po che/ rje btsun btsong kha pa/ 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag /dge bshes gra pa'i gter byon gyi dzam dmar srog sgrub rnams bzhengs pa'i rgyur/ byang chub shing gi 'bras bu/ tsan dan dkar dmar/ dbus 'gyur ma ga dha dang byang pu la ha ri'i gnas rdo/ rdo rje gdan gyi khrus rdzing gi me tog /dur khrod bsil ba tshal gyi rdo/ chu bo gaṅgā'i rde'u bye ma chu gsum/ a su ra'i sa/ rdo rje gdan gyi sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi —319

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)bzhugs khri'i sa/ tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i cha shas/ grong khyer rtomachog /gnyan yod/ mchod rten rnam dag gsum gyi sa sna/ rgya gar gnas chen mang po'i me rtag sna tsho gos dang lga ser/ mkha' 'gro ma su kha sedhis rgya gar nas 'bras kyi snyi ma blangs te gnyos chen la phul ba/ gnyos chen gyi dngos grub bam ro gsum pa de'u yang dag rin cen spungs par byung ba/ rgya gar gyi / ra/ a pha ra/ bra tra ko shi/pa la k+ṣa /a shwa t+tha/ u rdu wā ra/ ni pa'i shing / me rta ge dmar po sna tshogs/ srin bal gyi 'bru/ pi spa la/a mra/ ghan+ta lu la/ mun+ta/ dur ba/ bi lu rgya gar grub thob rnams kyi byin rlabs ril bu rnams/ (256na)yang le shod kyi sa sna rdo sna/ dzā ti/ sis ra/ me tog /mkha' 'gro ka sha gling gi rdo/ sbas yul 'bras mo ljongs kyi sa sna rdo sna shing sna chu sna/ rdzogs chen pa kun bzang rnam rgyal gyi 'chi med tshe chu'i ril bu/chos rgyal dus kyi sa bzhis gtsos lha sa ra mo che/ po ta la/ yer pa/ khra 'brug rnams kyi sa sna rdo sna/bsam yas kyis mchod rten dkar po/ sngon po/ dmar po gsum gyis gtsos pa'i sa sna chu sna/ chos 'khor rgyal gyi bla mtsho rnams kyi chu dang sa sna/ tsā ri yang rdzong phag mo'i bha ga nas byung ba'i sis ra/gnyos 'gar chos gsum gyis phag mo sal thim par gzigs pa'i sis ra/ bka' brgyud/ phyag rdor/gtum po/ sgrol ljangs/ zhing skyong rnams kyi bla mtsho'i rde'u sa sna dang chu/ mdo khams stod smad kyi gnasachen rnams kyi sa sna/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga'i me tog sna tshogs/ sa sna/ rtswa rigs mi gcig pa mang po so gos der ma gtogos pa'i 'dzam bu gling gi gnas chen du ma'i sa sna rdo sna/ byin rten sna tshogs/ rin po che/ sman sna/ dar zab/ 'bru sna/ ja sna tsho gos 'jim pa la bsres pa'i khu bar jo bo shākya mu ni/ rang byon lnga ldan/ byams pa chos 'khor sogs 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha brgyad/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i sku phyag nas mas thog drangs steng 'og bar gsum gyi rten brten pa yongs su rdzogs pa/ jo bo mi bskyod rdo rje sogs rgyas btab ra mo (256bsko'i lha khang gi rten gsar rnying / 'phags pa lo ke shwa ra/ thub pa sta zur ma/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal gyi phyag bzo'i slob dpon chen po'i sku bsod namasadapal 'bar/ grags pa rtsa ris ma bkra shis do kha ma 'jam dpal gshen rje gdung drug sogs pho —320

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod jos khang bzang gi dkar chag 9'ibrang po ta la'i mchod khang gi sku brnyan dngos su sku khrus gsol 'os pa rnams dang mi 'os pa rnams la me long la sku brnyan 'char du bcug pa'i khrus chus sbran nas gtsug lag gnyis pa shes pa'i mig yangs e pa sprul sku dbu mdzad bag dro/ a bar dpal 'dzin/ btsun chung / blo bzang bstan skyong / o rgyan/'dzom drug /a bar dkar rgyal/ nor bu tshe ring rnams la rnyed bkur gla yon so gos gya nom pa dang bcas chos sde chen po dpal ldan gos spungs kyi lha dbang gling du ston gyi zla ba legs par bzhengs grub pa la pho brang dmar po rir nged rang gis rab gnas rta thog ma dang me tog brgya rtsa brgyad du gtor/ gzungs bzhugs kyi skor chos sku'i ring bsrel la mdo rgyud kyi bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan sngags/rig pa chen mo/ gsang ba bos pa la so gos pa pha rgyud/ 'khor lo sdome pa la so gos pa ma rgyud/ dgyesamadzad rdo rje la sogs pa gnyis med rgyud/ srog shing brtan pa/ de nyid bsdus pa la sogs pa rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnam snang mngon byang la so gos pa stod rgyud/ gzungs wo sde lnga la so gos pa bya rgyud/ sher (257na)phyogs sogs las byung ba'i mdo gzungs/ bkra shis pa'i tshigs bcad/ mgon chen sdebazhi sogasachos srung / nor lha'i gzhings rnams/ yungs tsā lta bu'i ring bsrel la rten gtsor sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi ring bsrel gcig dang shākya thub pa'i gnyis/ gzhan rnams la re re/ rten gtsor bye ma a krong las grub pa'i pad+ma gu ru'i sku byin can/ sku gdung sku bal sna tshogs la/ bstan pa spyir sangs rgyasaglang po'i gdung gi cha shas/ rgya mo bza'i phyag bzo sangs rgyas btags sku'i nyag ma/ rang sangs rgyasakyi gdung rdo'i khams su byin gyis brlabs pa'i cha shas/ dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pa'i gdung dang snam sbyar gyi cha shas/ dpal ldan sa ra ha'i reg 'jam sprul gyi pags pa'i sgom thag gi cha shas/ bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi rus rgyan gyi cha shas/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa zhi ba 'tsho'i phyag mdzub kyi cha shas/ mkhas pa /ma la shi la'i gdung gi cha shas/ bal po'i rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i gdung dang ba so'i sku rgyan gyi cha shas/ grub chen nag po spyod pa'i rus rgyan gyi cha shas/ bsam yas su lo paṇa rnams kyisachos bsgyur pa'i khri'i dum bu grub chen ti lo pa'i bzhugs gdan gyi cha shas/ paṇa chen na ro ta pa'i rwa'i —321—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shesnyan rgyan/ bzhugs gdan/ sgom thag rus rgyan/ phyag 'khar rnams kyi cha shas dang / mkha' 'gro ma ni gu'i dbu skra dang mtshems kyi cha shas/ mnga' (257ba)bdag mi tri pa'i rdo rgyus sgom thag dang kha ṭ+wāṃ gi shing gi dum bu/ kha che dgon pa ba'i gdung gi cha shas/ grub thob mi tra dzo zhi'i rdo rgyus sgom thag dang 'jig rten gyi mkha' 'gros rgya gar phyag na la gnang ba'i rdo rgyus sgom thag /bal po a su'i rdo rgyus sgom thag rnams kyi dum bu/ paṇ+ḍita dwa na shi la'i dbu skra/ paṇa chen shrī pu t+na'i tshems kyi cha shas/ paṇ+ḍita 'bum phrag gsum pa'i dbu skra /kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī'i gdung rus/ dbu lo/ snam sbyar/ na bza'/'khar bsil gyi shing / zhabs sgrog /gsol lhung gi shubs rnams kyi cha shas/ grub chen dza ba ri pa'i nywa gdub gaṇ+ḍa mi rta yol mo sprul sku bstan 'dzin nor bus yun rings bcangs pa'i cha shas/ paṇa chen nags kyi rin chen gyi dbu zhwa'i tshal bu/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i zhabs phyags/ phyag phreng / de'i dus kyi sprul pa'i stag gi pags pa/ rgya mo bza' kong jo'i me long rnams kyi dum bu/ mnga' bdag khri ral gyi gdung rus/ lo chen rin cen bzang po'i phyag sen dang dbu skra/ sgra bsgyur mar pa lo tswa'i dbu lo/ ber seng ge mjing bsnol/ de dang mi la thog mar mjal dus chang lhan du bzhes pa'i gsol zhal/sras dar ma mdo sde'i gdung rnams kyi cha shas/ rje mi la bzhad pa rdo rje'i dbu lo/ ras gos dang / dgung lo bzhi bcu nas brgyad cu'i bar bcangs pa'i sgom thag gi tshal bu/ /ras chung rdo rje (255)gragasapa'i gdung rus/ mkhas grub khyung po du gu pa'i gdung thal/ rten 'dam phabs rgyun/ zheng zheng gi sku 'dra'i na bza' tshal bu/ mnyam med rin po che brtson 'grus kyi gdung thal/ skyer sgang pa chos kyi seng ge'i gdung dang na bza'i dum bu/ mnyam med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyi dbu lo/ rgyal ba ri khrod pa'i gdung rus/ yab chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sgom thag gi cha shas paṇa chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i yum gyi gdung rus/ chos rgyal rab brtan kun bzang 'phags pa'i mgul srung thag pa'i tshal bu rnams/gsang sngags rnying ma'i skor la/ slob dpon dga' rab rdo rje'i dbu lo/ slob dpon shrī sidha'i dbu skra/dpal skyon chen pos tsha med tshe'i rigs 'dzin bsgrubs dus kyi ril bu 'ja' tshon ma/ phyag phreng gi —322

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (7cha shas/ skyon yab yum gyi byang sems dang sha lnga bdud rdzi lnga bsres pa'i phabs rgyun/ paṇa chen be ma la mi tra'i shangs mtshal/ sku rag dang na bza'i dum bu/ za hor rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi gdung rus/bram ze skye ba bdun pa'i sha dang / dung rna can gyi sku mchin gyi dum bu/ mkha' 'gro ye shes 'tsho rgyal gyi phyag bzo'i seng ge'i tshal bu/ lo chen be ro tsa na'i gdung rus/ na bza' dang rgya dpe'i cha shas/ chosargyal khri srong lde btsan gyi gdung dang dbu skra/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dang myang ta thā (258ba)ga ta'i gdung rus/ lha lung dpal rdor gyi sku phod kyi tshal bu/ zur shākya 'byung gi chos sman/ mthu chen gangs pa shāg 'bum dang g.yung ston pa thun mong gi phyag phreng gi cha shas/ g.yung gi ring bsrel/ /thog byams pa bkra shis bde legs kyi slob ma byang 'bum gyi gdung rus/ pa thu khrul bu chos sman/ a mi bya nag chen po'i ber chos skyong khra ba'i dum bu/ snye mdo rog thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbu zhwa'i tshal bu/ so shākya dpal ba'i gdur rus/ phyag phreng dang ber gyi cha shas/ chu shur brag ston pa so legs ldan rdo rje'i sku sha dang sku rus/ mnga' bdag myang nyi ma 'od zer gyi dbu lo/ khros nag shog ser/ myang gi rig ma sangs rgyas skyid dang ye shes mkha' 'gro'i gdung / myang bdud 'dul gyi sku sha /bka' brgyud mkha' klong yangs pa'i na bza'/ gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi sku sha/ shangs mtshal/ chos sman/ skye bdun/gsang rdzogs kyi shog ser gyi tshal bu/ pad+ma gu ru'i sku rgyu'i bye ma a krong / sras pad+ma dbang chen gyi sku sha dang sku phod kyi dum bu/ yar klungs sprul sku shākya 'od kyi gdung rus/ sman lung chos ldan pa'i chos sman/khyab bdag khra tshang pa blo mchog rdo rje'i dbu skra dang chos sman/ brag sna phyogs kyi chos sman/ chos rje ngag dbang thub bstan gyis chu bo rir bsgrubs pa' tshe ril/ rigs 'dzin chen po rgod ldem gyis bdun/se ston mgon po bzang (259na)po'i dbu klad/ rtse ston rin cen rgyal mtshan gyi sku sha /sku rus/ dbu ral/ dbu zhwa dang sku sham gyi dum bu/ ldong ston chos skyong bsod nams kyi sku sha /mes ston rdo rje dpal bzang gi dbu ral dang phyag phreng gi cha shas/ thugs sras nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi dbu ral/ nub dgon pa byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi gdung rus/ sku phod/ snam sbyar gyi dum bu/ bkra bzang pa pad+ma dbang —323—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)chen gyi dbu ral/grub thob thang stong rgyal po'i dbu skra/sle bem/phyag phreng gi cha shas/tshe ril/ngag dbang nyi zla bzang po'i gdung rus/sprul sku skyon gling pa'i gdung rus dang khros nag shog ser gyi tshal bu/gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa'i gdung rus/dbu zhwa'i dum bu/dbu lo/dam rdzas rol r+ṣa/chos sman/tshe ril/de'i gter byon spyon rin po che'i phyag phreng gi cha shas/dkar wo kun dga' gragasakyi sku sha/gter chen rdo rje gling pa'i sku sha/sku tshil/na bza' dang /shog ser gyi tshal bu/chos rgyal rat+na gling pa'i ba khung rus/sku sha/dbu skra/dam rdzas rol pa chen po/a tham ma/rat+na'i sras grags pa rin cen gyi sku sha/gdung brgyud ngag dbang nor bu'i sku sha/yug klungs pa nor bu dbang rgyal gyi dbu skra/ 'phyong rgyas zhabs drungs ngag dbang bsod nams grags pa'i dbu thod kyi dum bu dang dbu lo/gter ston pad+ma gling pa'i bur ras kyi dum bu dang chos sman 259bsgo tham ma/skye bdun/de'i gter ma'i spyon rin po che'i sku chos gser gyi bkro can gyi cha shas/sprul sku mchog ldan mgon po'i sku sha/sprul sku sna tsho gis rang grol gyi chos sman/gsung sprul gyi skye bdun/gter ston bsam gtan gling pa'i 5sha/gter ston shes rab me 'bar gyi sku sha/mtsho sna gter ston mgon po rin cen gyi sku sha/lte las 'gro gling pa'i sku sha/kun mkhyen klong chen rab stims pa'i sku rag dang phyag phreng gi tshal bu/mnga' risapaṇa wo rin bo che'i gdung dang sku chos dang shog ser kyi tshal bu/mnga' ris rigs 'dzin r+pā po'i gdung /dbu skra/dam rdzas/chos sman/dbu zhu'i dum bu/skye bdun ril bu/'bri gung chos rgyal rin chen phun tsho gos kyi sku sha'i tshal bu/dbu skra/cho ge sman phyag phreng dang snam sbyar gyi cha shas/'bri gung zhabs drung chos rgyal phun tshogs kyi gdung rus dang tshems kyi dum bu/'bri gung zhabs drung chos kyi grags pa'i tshems kyi cha shas/gdung rus/chos sman/'bri gung sprul sku da rka rna cog 'phrin las kyisa'abasgrubs pa 'a chos sman dpal ri sprul sku ngag dbang pad+ma'i chos sman dang 'chi med sku gsum 'dus pa'i ril bu/chos rgyal byang pa bkra shis stobs rgyal gyi dbu ral bka' brgyad gsang rdzogs kyi sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i chos sman dang bum chu ril bu/daX zhwa/tshe bdag gi sgrub gtor/rigs 'dzin ngag

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga (mgi dbang po'i dbu skra dang 'gro don las sbyor lnga pa'i ril bu/ yol mo sprul sku bstan (260na 'dzin nor bu'i gdung / dbu ral/ na bza'i dum bu/ skye bdun/ rdo rje brag sprul pa'i sku pad+ma 'phrin las kyi bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i tshe ril/ 'chi med sku gsum 'dus pa'i ril bu/ skye bdun/ chos sman/ zur thams cad mkhyen pa chos dbyings rang grol gyi sku sha /sku rus/ bde 'dus kyi sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i chos sman/ 'gro don las sbyor lnga pa/ kong po gter ston 'ja' tshwa snying po'i gdung / thugs dang na bza'i cha shas/ rdzogs chen pa lha btsun nam mkha' 'jigs med kyi gdung dang chos sman/ snying ri ba rgyal sras bde ba bzang po'i dbu ral/ dar rgyas chos sdings pa rje 'phrin las lhun grub kyis shel brag tu bsgrubs pa'i chos sman/ chos rgyal gter bdag gling pa'i sku mtshal/ dbu lo/ a tham ma/chos sman/ tshe ril/ de'i gter ma'i skyon chen po'i na bza'i cha shas rnams/ dka' gdams dang dge lugs kyi skor la/ mnyam med jo bo chen po a ti sha'i gdung / dbu zhwa/ phrag phreng / phyag rtsa'i rten 'dam/ sag 'gril rgya dpe rnams kyi cha shas/ 'byom ston pa rgyal ba'i sting gnas kyi tshems/ gdung /dbu zhwa/ dbu skra/ bzhugs gdan rnams kyi dum bu/ rngog lo khu dbon gyi na bza'i tshal bu/ khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gi gdung / po to ba rin cen gsal gyi thugs/ gdung / dbu lo/ sku chos/rnam sbyar rnams kyi dum bu/ bshes gnyen spyan snga ba'i dbu (260bskyo/ sne'u zur pa ye shes 'bar gyi dbu skra/ rngog blo ldan shes rab kyi dpe khri'i thag pa'i dum bu/ khams lung pa'i phyag bshes gnyen sgre ba'i gdung / sha ra ba'i sku mtshal/ se spyil bu ba'i snam sbyar gyi cha shas/ ka ma ba'i na bza'i tshal bu/ snar thang dpal ldan gro'i phyag phreng dang rten 'dam/ mchims nam mkha' grags kyi gdung / bcom ldan ral gri'i gdung / bya 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i gdung dang dbu skra/ sbas ti dgra bcom pa'i dbu lo/ lho brag mkhan chen phyag rdor ba'i dbu skra/ phyag mdzub dang / zha khas phyags kyi dum bu/ rgyal ba gnyis pa btsong kha ba chen po'i sku mtshal/ dbu lo/ gsang chab/ tshems dang dbu zhwa/ sku rag /na bza'/ zhabasaphyags rnams kyi cha shas/ rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen pa'i dbu lo/ /mkhas grub dge legs dpal —325

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebazang gi gdung /ba so chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi dbu skra/'jam dbyangs smon lam dpal ba'i dbu skra/'jam dbyangs gtsang pa bdun brgyud kyi dbu lo phyag sen sogs bsres ba'i rten 'dam/paṇa chen byams pa gling pa'i na bza'i dum bu/thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa'i tshems/dbu zhwa sku chos gsum gyi tshal bu/sems dpa' kun bzang pa'i dbu skra/'dar ston blo bzang grags pa'i gdung /mdung ras pa'i dbu skra/mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho'i dbu lo dang bzhugs 'ding gi dum bu/'jam dbyangs legs pa chos 'byor gyi snam sbyar gyi cha shas/thams cad 261nasgo khyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i ring bsrel/chab ser/dbu lo/sku 'tshal/sku rag gi tshal bu/paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa'i gdung /dbu lo/na bza'i dum bu/sngags rams pa dge 'dun bkra shis kyi gdung /bde ba can pa dge legs dpal bzang gi gdung /thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sku sha/dbu klad/zhwa thul dang sku chos/pur ras/sku rag/zha khas chags/stan dmar rnams kyi cha shas/sgom sdo shar pa nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/rje drung rin po che bstan pa rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/paṇa chen rin po che blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/snam sbyar na 'a za'i dum bu/rten 'dus/thams cad mkhyen pa yon to rgya mtsho'i gdung rus/shangs mtshal/dbu skra/gsang chab/sku chos dang dbu zhwa/sku g.yogs/pur ras bzhi'i tshal pa/'jam dbyangs dkon cog chos 'phel gyi dbu lo/rten 'dus/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa'i dbu lo/sku gdung /dbu klad/tshems dang thugs zhabs sen/dbu zhwa rnams kyi dum bu/'di ga'i sgra dang rung thun gyi gos rngul bzan sbubs dang gzhan rnams kyi cha shas/chu pho byi lo po ta lar gsang rdzogs/grub chen sogs dbang mang du byas skabs sa kyi tshe ril/tshe chang /bum chu/gtor ma/sa rta rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pas bod khams bde thabs su lha sar phur sgrub dus kyi tshe 261ba jil/bum chu/chos 'khor rgyal bsam ṇi dung phyur btang ba'i ril bu/chos 'khor rgyal dang dgas gra tshang pas ma ṇi dung phyur gyi sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i ril bu dga' ldan gsang sngags gling pas thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun grol gyi sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i 'gro don las

sku gsung thugasarten gsar 4khosadang rin po ༅ mgo rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar ga yo'isbyor lnga pa'i ril bu rnams/sa skya ba'i skor la/ grub pa'i 'khor bsgyur bi rū pa'i rus rgyan dang sgom dbyug gi cha shas/ bdud rtsi ril bu/ 'brog mi lo chen shākya ye shesakyi gdung / ba ri lo tsā ba rin cen grags kyi na bza'i dum bu/bla ma 'ad ston chosa'abar gyi na bza'i tshal pa/ gnam kha'u pa dar ma rgyal mtshan gyi gdung / mgon po dngos su gzigasapa'i dusaphyag nasashor ba'i bzhes can dang rusargyan gyi dum bu/ 'khon dkon cog rgyal po'i dbu lo dang na bza'i tshal pa/ de dang sa chen thun mong gi na bza' re phrug ma'i cha shas/rje btsun brtse chen snying po'i zhabasakyi gdung / gar gosadang rusargyan gyi tshal pa/ slob dpon bsod namasartsemo'i dbu lodangagaragosakyi dum bu/ rje btsun gragasapa rgyal mtshan gyigadung / shangasamatshal/dbu skra/ gar gosadang na bza'/ sku ber/ thod phreng me 'bar ma/ bzhugs gdan rnams gyi cha shas/bdud rtsi ril bu/ 'jam dbyangasasaskya lo tsāba'i dbu skra/ gdung / snam sbyar dang rusargyan gyi tshal pa/chos kyi rgyal po 'phagasapa'i gdung / thugs/ na bza'/ phyag phreng gsum gyi tshal pa/ 'gro (262na)mgon phyag na'i gdung / rgyal ba brag phug pa bsod namasadapal gyi bdud rtsi ril bu/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gdung / gdung tsha/ snam sbyar/ gzungs thag /na bza' gsum gyi cha shas/ sngagasa'achang gzungasakyi dpal ba'i sku phod kyi dum bu/ theg chen chosarje'i dbu skra dang pur ras kyi tshal pa/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po'i gdung / kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyalagyi tshemasadang / snam sbyar gyi cha shas/ mnyam med ye shesadapal ldan bzangapo'i dbulo/ kun mkhyen g.yag pa'i gdung / rong ston shesabya kun rig gi sku chosakyi dum bu/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi dbu lo/ na bza' dang pur rasakyi cha shas/ musachen semasadapa' chen po dkon cog rgyal mtshan gyi rten 'dus/ bdag chen gragasapa blo grosakyi gdung rus/ salo 'jam dpalardo rje'i dbu skra dang na bza'i tshal pa/ bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug gi pur rasakyi dum bu/ ngor chen dkon cog lhun grub kyi dbu lo dang sku rag gi tshal bu/ rje kun dga' grol mchog gi tshemasakyi dum bu dang dbu skra/ rtse gdong —327

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)khri chen kun dga' bsod nams kyi bdud rtsi ril bu/sa skya khri chen kun dga' bsod nams kyi bdud rtsi ril bu/des rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi gdung thal phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa bdag chen rdo rje 'chang bar dang khong rang yan gyi byin rten rnams phyogs gcig tu sdoms pa rten 'dam dpe 262babral ma'i steng du gnas chen gyi sa rdo bsres pa/rin chen sgang pa sgos kyi snyan brgyud 'dzin pa yab 'jam dbyangs chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi gdung rus/gcin bdag chen rgya dkar shes rab rgya mtshan gyi gdung rus/bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi gdung rus dang /myangs pasaskye ba gsum na mkha' spyod 'grub par lung bstan byung ba'i bdud rtsi ril bu/rje btsun rdo ring ba kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i gdung rus/pur tshwa dang /tshe bum gyi cha shas/ rje sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa'i gdung rus/tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po'i gdung rus dang tshems khrag/chab ser/zhabs sen/shangs mtshal/pur tshwa/thugs dam rtag gtor rnams kyi cha shas/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi shangs mtshal/chos sman/de dang gzhon blo dbang rab gsum gyis gcig tu bsrel ba'i bdud rtsi ril bu/rin po che bod mkhar ba mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan gyi dbu lo/yol mkhan chen gzhen nu blo gros kyi tshems kyi cha shas/thams cad mkhyen pa klu sgrub rgya mtsho'i dbu thod kyi dum bu/sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel gyi gdung rus/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi gdung rus/na bza'i tshal bu/skye bdun/bdud rtsi ril bu/mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi bdud rtsi ril bu/rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur ba chen po'i gdung rus/dbu lo/snam sbyar gyi dum bu/skye bdun/tshe ril/po ta lar rgyu dbang 263na skonang ba'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon/khyab bdag zha lu pa chen po'i dbu skra/bkra shis chos sde bas rnam rgyal stong mchod kyi sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i bum chu ril bu rnams/dgas brgyud pa'i skor la/sgam po zla 'od gzhen nu'i gdung rus/dbu skra dang na bza'/phyag phreng /zhabs phyags/chibs sga rnams kyi cha shas/dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'bab rom pa'i shang mtshal dang chibs sga'i yag gi dum bu/dpal phag mo gru pa'i gdung rus/daX //sku ber dang /na bza'i tshal bu/'jag spyil

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga shāmigyi sa/ bdud rtsi ril bu sku 'bum brag gi sku byi bas zos pa'i sku sha /spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas kyi gser gtor bdud rtsir song pa'i cha shas/ rgyal ba thog jugs pas thog btums pa'i na bza'i dum bu/ spyan snga tshes bzhi pa'i phyag phreng gi cha shas/ spyan snga lha gzigs ras pa'i gdung rus dang na bza'i tshal bu/ 'bri gung skyob pa 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi gdung rus/ 'bri gung spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po'i dbu skra/ stag lung thang pa'i na gza'i dum bu/ stag lung ngag dbang grags pa'i gdung rus/ yang dgon pa thugs kyi rdo rje'i gdung rus/ rgyal ba g.ya' bzang pa chos smon lam gyi gdung rus/ gsal stong sho ra'i phyag tsha'i cha shas/ rje dbu se'i gdung rus/ dbu thod dang na gza'i dum bu/ ga me pa shi'i thugs kyi cha shas dang dbu lo/ mthong ba don ldan gyi gdung rus/ shangs mtshal/ dbu lo/ dbu thod kyi cha shas(263bsgoms dang / gzhan yang srog shing la 'dri bar 'os pa'i gzungs dang gnod sbyin zhal sbyar gyi 'khor lo/ yid srubs sdodang bcas pa bsrung zhing bzlog pa'i tsakra rnams la so sor thob pa'i sgos chos kyi sbyang khrus rab gnas sgrub pa sogs dang bcas 'phyugs med du legs par bstar zhing mchod rdzas su thog rnams khebs pa'i gos sna tsho gis las grub pa'i gnam rgyan gnyis/ phan nyer gnyisagong bcas/ khro chung gnyis/ li ting bdun tshar/ sbub chol/ rten so sor snam sbyar sogs kyi na bza'/ rten gtsor dar sna bdun dang gzhan rnams la lnga re nyin star mchod pa me tog dang bdug sposal nas ting re/ nyin mas khyongs pa'i mchod me sdong rkang re dang / lha bsgos bcas thon rtsis mchode thebs su tshos grong nas zhing sna mo shag 'og ma/ mdongs dkar nas rgya mi zhing gi shar lho na byang zhing kher ba bcu gnyis 'di lo ston steng nas sbyor 'jags bgyis pa la/ gnas brtan 'jam dbyangs grags pas rdo rje slob dpon byas pa'i gra tshang gyi grwa pa grangs bcad kyis 'phrin las phur pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas dam tshig pa la ye shes pa bcug nas brtan bzhugs shis pa brjod pa'i me tog gi char chen po legs par phab cing / de dang phyogs mthun par ri bo chos gling du bka' 'gyur gser chos/ gan ji ra/ gsang 'dus sgrub mchod kyi rigs lnga/ dar dpyangs/ rten khebs rnams 'bul sbyor —329

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya ma༅ gsung 'bum/ (she legasabar bgyis pa'i phan yon kyang gsal rgyal gyis264na zhusapa'i mdo las/su dag bde bar gshegasapa'i gzugasabyed pa//de yi lusani dri ma med pa dang //pad+ma'i snying po lta bur 'jam zhing yang /nad dang mya ngan sdugabasngala'ajigasalasathar//su dag 'jig rten mgon po'i gzugasabyed pa//bran du mi skye mngag gzhug skye mi 'gyur//dbul por mi 'gyur rigasadamar mi skye zhing //dbang po rnams kyang nyams par yong mi 'gyur/zhesadang /dam chos pad dkar las/la las de bzhin rin cen gzugasabyasapa//sum bcu rtsa gnyisamatshan dang ldan pa'i gzugs//gang gis de phyir byasapa de dag kyang//de dag thamasacad byang chub thob par 'gyur//la las der ni rin cen sna bdun dang //la las de bzhin zangs dang 'khar ba las//bde bar gshegasapa rnams kyi gzugs byas pa//de dag thamasacad byang chub thob par 'gyur//zhes de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs bzhengs pa'i legs byasakyi phung po mtha' yas par gsungs shing /sku gzugasade dag bsod nams kyi zhing du byas nasasri zhur bskrun pa'i rnam smin deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar du dkar por 'dzag pa'ang /spyan ras gzigs kyi theg pa chen po'i mdo las/'dren pa'i sku gzugasarab tu mdzesabyasan//dbang ldan dbang phyug nyid kyi lhar 'gyur te//mi dman dga' ba'i sems kyis sangasargyasamachod//rgyal ba mchog gi bstan la dad par 'gyur//tshangasapa'i 'jigarten dbang thob 264ba〉ngasapar 'gyur//yid 'ongasashin tu mdzesapa'i sposangad can//dzasbu klung gser 'od byed dga' 'gyur ba'i//gzhal med khang mchog lta sdug thosapar 'gyur//de ni ded dpon stobs bcur ldan pa'o//semasacan snying po mtshungasa'adra med pa 'thos//kha dog mtha' yasa'ajig rten kun na gsal//gser steng rin chen be+eḍūr+ya dang mtshungs//su zhig dga' ba'i yid kyis me tog blangs//dad skyes 'jig rten mgon la char du gtor//de ni mi yi 'jig rten bsod namasaldan//rgyal srid gnasanas0

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shā'irgyal ba mchog bkur 'gyur//mya ngan tha ba bskams shing drir ldan lus//yan lag legs gnas mtshungs med thob par 'gyur///zhes sogs phan yon rgya cher gsungs pas yid drangs te/dad pa ma skyes pa rnams bskyed cing bskyed pa gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i yon tan mtha' klas pa 'byung ba ni dkon cog ta la'i gzungasalas/ dad pa sngon 'gro ma ltar bskyed pa ste/ /yon tan thams cad bsrung zhing 'phel bar byed/ /dogs pa sel zhing chu bo rnams las sgrol//dad pa bde legs grong khyer mtshon byed yin//dad pa rnyog pa med cing sems dwangs byed//nga rgyal spong zhing gus pa'i rtsa ba yin//dad pa nor dang gter dang rkang pa'i mchog /lag pa bzhin du dge sdud rtsa ba yin/ /zhes 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa yin no//e ma rgyal dang de sras 265na slob mar bcas/ /snang brnyan spel mchod bsod nams gzugs can du/grub na snod du 'jig rten gnyis pa zhig/bskrun par mes po 'og 'gyu'i rtog par 'byams//mchod sdong ring bsrel can gyi snying po'i ched//'jim gong 'jog dang gom gcig bgrod pa yi//legs byas blo las 'das na yongs rdzogs mtha'//gzhal la kun mkhyen spyan dkyus des kyang thungs//bslu med bden gtam tshangs dbyangs bung ba'i glu//mchu sgros āt+pal 'dzum dbus nyer blangasadon/deng nas byang chen de srid myong ba la//yid kyi khye'u chung rtse dga' khong nas rgod//rgyal ba'i 'phrin las ga pur thang chu'i rgyun//'dzag pas srid zhi'i tsha gdung zug rngu'i nad//nyer phyungs sgo gsum sim pa'i tshor ba la//'gro sbyor thub bstan bskal brgyar rtag 'phel shog/klog dang bsam gtan las kyis ri mo rtswa/byed pa'i yang das/ lam ston bshes gnyen rnams//yid srubs log smon 'ching rgya yongs dbral nas//don yod 'tsho ba g.yung drung gzhir smin shog/lung rtogs mya ngan med ljon 'dab ma'i grib/ /'jig rten spyi dang khyad par gangs ljongs kyi/ /skye rgu mtha' dag dge bcu rdzogs ldan du//spyod pa'i skal bzang mgron du deng bsur shog/gser mdog

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)zhwa 'od snang ba bkrag po che/ /yangs pa'i nor 'dzin kun gsal chosasrid kyi/ /khrimasaganyisartsibasastong 'khor rjes brtan g.yo'i chos/ /rjes 'brang gnam (265ba)gyi she mong dar drag shog /sku gzugs bsgrub la rgyu sbyor las byed char/ /gtogs rnams 'di snang sdug bsngal kun zhi zhing / /mngon mtho'i yang srid bde ba rim myong ngos/ /bla med ye shes myur du thob par shog /ched dmigasadage tshogs nor bu ke ta gas/ /lha rje dgos dgos la sogs lnga pa'i grong / /zhugs rgyud dug gsum rnyog ma rab bgrungs klung / /sems mtshor zla gzugs bgrang yas 'char bar shog /bsod namasayongs byas drang srong ā ga stas/ /mchod dpon ngag dbang shesarab ma spun tsho'i/ /nad gdon gnod 'tshe'i dug dbyungasa'adi phyi'i bde/ /yan lag brgyad ldan ro nusadar drag shog /bkra shisabyamasasnyomasarten dang brten pa yi/ /ye shes sems dpa' brgya phrag nyi ma'i gzi/ /gangasacan 'chi med lam du nyer 'bar ba'i/ /phan bde'i 'od kyis 'jig rten kun khyab shog /gaṅga'i rdulabarnyed lusasprul gtsug tu mchog gsum zhabs bkod mgos phyag 'tshal/ /mchod sprin mi 'dzad sgo brgya rab phye thog med nas bsags sdig ltung bshags/ /bdag gzhan legs byas kun la yi rang chos 'khor rgyun mi chad skor bskul/ /bskal brgyar mya ngan mi 'dar gsol 'debasadage 'brasabyang chub thob rgyur bsngo/ /bya dga'i rlabs chen spyod pas tshogs gnyis yongs bsags bden pa'i dpang por lha mo brtan ma sa las 'thon/ /phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs 'dus pas mgrin gcig bdud rtsi (266na)rnyed slad dbang bskur legasaso'i bsngags brjod dbyangasasnyan 'brol/ /dpal gyi mgur nas lung rtogs chos phung semasacan kun gyi snying la 'jug pa gtan gyi skyabs gcig pu/ /tshul bzhin bsgrub pa dge 'dun rnams kyis thog ma bar dang tha mar dge ba'i bkra shis char du bsnyil/ zhes mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyis khra 'brug bkra shis byams snyoms kyi gtsug lag khang du gangs can sā la'i sman ljongs kyi skye rgu rnams bde skyid la spyod pa'i rten 'brel dang /rang nyid pha ma nye dur bcas pa byang chub snying po'i bar du bde bar spyod pa'i lhag bsam rdul —332—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bldengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mabral gyi ston zla ltar dkar bas gong smos kyi rten bzhengs rnams bgyis pa'i dkar chag cig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar deb ther phan bde'i dpag bsam 'dod 'jo zhes pa 'di ni za hor gyi rigs las shākya'i btsun pa 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen nam tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rjer 'bod pas stod 'grel ba'i lugs la kā la du ti kho pa dus kyi pho nyar grags shing /mang bkur 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i khab tu (ha mu nas phyogs 'dir dbang thang dang bstun pa sa pho rta'i lo 'o skol gyi ston pas bden bzhi'i chos 'khor skor ba dang /lhums su zhugs pa'i zla ba dmar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gsum pa res gza' ku mud gnyen dang zla skar rgyal la babs pa'i dus rdzogs ldan gyi rnam par thar pa bzhi'i sgo 'phar cig car du phye ba rgyal khab chen po po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag rig smra ba lcang gseb pa bstan 'dzin dbang pos bgyis pa sa spru sa she ya la: bha ( // 266bsdeb sbyor mnya pa'i dz+ra t+ta las zlum po/ādzñā tā kar sgo la sbu le 〉 diḥto:mān+ta mā sa mas tu na tshe dbazhi patratwa snu ri sha tsā ra kā gra/satwa sarba tsit+ta to me teṣ+ṭha kā ga mā ba bo dha rā sa ka su mot+pal tri ta ku shākya༄dwal du mā bi su sed yi hi//thams cad mkhyen par byed pa'i ye shes rtsa ba sbom por bskyed bsrings te//'khor mtha' rdzogs min chad med 'phrin las yal 'dab phang phung g.yo ba'i rtser//sems can yongs kyi snying la nyer sim lung rtogs ro bda'i 'bras dus pa/shwakya'i skye mchog yongs 'du sa brtol slar yang 'gro dbugs 'byin la spyon/'dom gang 'od las kun khyab gzin byin gyis//'jig rten gsum po snang bar byas pa'i mod//sdig 'bras brnag dka'i zug rngu smag gi rum//mig stong can des ma mthong da ga re//sis wā ra'i rdul mang brtsegs pa'i rtser//mthon mthing zur phud g.yo ba gzhen nu'i gzugs//dge sbyor rgan po'i khrims ldan btsong kha pas/mi mkhyen shes bya tshad med ma rnyed 267na jil//bi spa ltar dmar dbyangs can mchu yi sgros//'dzum las legs bshad pi wang rnar 'jebs pas//chos kun gzigs mtshan don mthun dge 'dun gyi//gtsug tor rtser 'dzegs rgya mtsho'i sde yis skyongs//ched du 'dus ma byas par lhun grub rkyen gyis rtogs min mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid can//don gnyis dang ldan

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she'agog pa'i bden pa mngon du gnyer mdzad rdzogs sangs rgyas zhes sgra bo che/ /kun rdzob brdar tshon snang brnyan dzasbu'i grib mar rgyas pa'i legs byas mched po deng gi dus/ /bden par lta ba'i bskal bzang 'di ko bgrang yas bskal par 'bad pas bsags pa deng smin bzhin/ /nyon mongs sra mkhregs sems can lcags khams bden pa gnyis ldan rtsi yis gser bsgyur bas/ khyud la thob bya mngon par rtogs pa tshogs sbyor mthong dang bsgoms pa mi slob lam/ /brjod byar yongs byed dpal gyi mgur nas nyer gsungs 'gro kun zhin sbyor lung gi chos/ /thub gsungs brgya phrag pusta gaḥ'aphreng 'jig rten gsum na snyan pa'i grags pa dkar/ /bag yod lcags kyos rgyud rengs glang dul thos dang bsam pa'i nor gyis phyug /lha mir bcas pa mchod sdong gcig pu skyabs dang dpung gnyen gling gyur pa/ /tshogs kyi gtso bo skye 'phags dge 'dun 'du gnas kun dga' ra ba yis/ /mgon med zas sbyin khengs pa bag zha zhi ba'i nags su yibs la bzhin/ /mchog gsum rten dang brten par bcas pa la ri mor bgyis pa'i rnam smin byang chen bar/ /pad+ma'i rtsa ba ltar (267brkokar ches 'dzag pa/ /thub dbang zhal bzhes ri mo gang gis bsu ba/ /g.yo ru 'phros lung 'dzin ma'i thig le sa /dge legs rab bkra dusakun shis pa'i gling / /bdeb chen po'i 'byung gnas gas la'i/ /dkar chags la chun po thod du ching / /zhes mkhas pa'i dbang po da lha'i gzhung dang rjes su 'brel ba'i tshigs su bcad pa sngon du btang ste gleng bar bya ba ni/ de yang yon tan rin po che sdud pa las/ /'jig rten don grub tshul la mthu med pa'i/ /theg pa gnyis po gtan du spang bya zhing / /thub rgyal theg pa snying rje bstan pa ni/ /rang don la gzhol gzhan don de dag 'jug /ces 'jig rten gyi khams su gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyi don bsgrub pa la lhag bsam dang snying stobs kyi mthu ches dman pas rang don lhur len pa nyan rang gi theg par 'jug pa ni lung las/ mod la gyi bus/ btsun pa sangs rgyas chos zab mo de lta bu ni bdag gi glo bar ma tshud do/ /gal te bdag gi glo bar chud par gyur na/ bdag gi lus ni til gyi bye ma lta bur bgyisakyang / bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sems las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba zhig na/—334

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khog dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shā'id ni shing tshig pa bzhin ci bgyid yang ma mchis so/ /zhes pa ltar shing tshig pa'i mgal dum bzhin sangasargyas kyi rgyud mi rung bas dbang rnon theg pa chen po'i rigs can rnams kyis spang bya dang de'i cig shos kyi blang bya yin pas/ mgon po zhi ba lhas/ byang chub sems bskyed gyur na ska cig gis/ /'khor ba'i btson rar bsdams(26ni lnga'i nyam thag rnams/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing / /'jig rten lha mir bcas pa'i phyag byar 'gyur/ /zhes ska cig ma dang po la 'khor ba'i btson rar gnas pa'i nyam thag pa rnams kyang ska cig ma gnyis pa la byang chub tu sems bskyed nas rgyal ba'i sras po lha mi thams cad kyis phyag byed pa'i gnas su gsungs pa'i theg pa chen po'i lam du zhugs nas sangs rgyas sgrub dgos pa 'phags pa sdud pa las/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir chu klung ji snyed cig 'bab cing / me rtag 'bras ldan sman dang nags tshal skyed byed pa/ /ma dros gnas pa'i klu dbang klu dag brten gnas te/ /de ni klu yi bdag po de yi mthu dpal yin/ /rgyal ba'i nyan thos pa dag ji snyed chos ston dang / /lar dang rig pa dag dang ldan par brjod pa dang / /mchog 'phags bde ba byed dang de yi 'bras thob pa/ /de dag kun kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skyes bu'i mthu/ /zhes klu'i bdag po ma dros pa gnas pa'i mtsho las chu klung mtha' klas pa 'bab cing / sman dang nags tshal me rtag sogs bskyed pa ltar/ 'khor rnams pa bzhi la sogs pa rjes su 'brangs pa rnams kyi dam pa'i chos rgya cher ston pa sogs kyi 'phrin las la brten nas lus can rnams phan pa dang bde ba la sbyor ba thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs rje la brten pa bcom ldan 'das la rag lus shing / rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang rgyu med dang mi mthun pa'i rgyu las byung ba ma yin par bskal bzang las/ nga ni sngon tshe dman par gyur pa'i tshe/ /de bzhin (264〉shegs pa shākya thub de la/ /'jam gang zhig ni dbul bar byas nas kyang/ /dang por byang chub chom ma gtu sems bskyed do/ /zhes sngon dzomakhan gyi khye'u snang byed du gyur pa'i tshe byang chub mchog tu thugs dang por bskyed/ de rjes gzhon nu brtson 'grus spyod du gyur pa'i tshe de bzhin bshegs pa 'od 'phro la sogs pa'i spyan sngar sems bskyed nas rab tu dga' —333—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheba'i samangon du mdzad/ tshong dpon shes rab bzang por sku 'byungs pa'i tshe sangasargyas dkon cog yan lag sogs la grangs med gnyis pa'i tshogs bsags te ring du song ba'i sa thob/lung las/ gang tshe mar me mdzad kyisang / /lung bstan gyur pa de yi tshe/ /sabargyad pa ni thob gyur te/ /dbang bcu dag kyang thob par gyur/ /zhes gzhen nu sprin du gyur pa'i tshe bde gshegs mar me mdzad sogasal grangasamed gsum pa'i tshogs bsags/ de nas grangs med pa'i bskal pa gcig gi ring goms pa'i tshogs kyis bsgrubs pas chos kyi sprin gyis mngon du mdzad nas mthar 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing du mngon par sbyor ba lnga'i sgo nas kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur sangs rgyas kyang / thun mong ba'i gdul bya'i don du dam pa rtag dkar po'i rnam par bstan pa gzigs pa rnam pa lnga'i sgo nas rgyal po zas gtsang ma dang lha mo sgyu 'phrul gyi sras su sa lug chu stod kyi nya ba'i che'igabaco lnga la lhums su zhugs/ lcagasasprel sag zla ba'i tshes(bdun la sku bltams/ sgyu rtsal gyi gnas kun la byang bas dregs ldan thamasacad (269na)kyi spobasapa phrogs/ 'jig rten dang sgo bstun ma 'ongs pa na mu stegs byed sogs gyis phya ba sdang bar sras bskrun pa'i ched du grags 'dzin la sogasabatsun mo mang po khab tu bzhes/ /de yang ji skad du/ sa bdag rtog pa po rnams blo gros 'khrul/ /rtsod pa'i dus su 'khor los sgyur mi 'byung / /bsod nams can gyi chos kyi mdzod 'di ni/ /nyes las rnam par grol te sangs rgyas 'gyur/ /zhes pa ltar grong khyer gyi phyi rol tu rga ba na ba 'chi ba dge slong zhi dul can gzigs pa'i rkyen gyis thugs 'byungs nas rgyal pos bskos pa'i mel tshe ba rnams kyis ma tshor bar rdzu'aphrul gyis mchod rten rnam dag drung du gshegs te ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan bzung / dka' ba lo drug gi bar du spyad mthar dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas shing rgya bar 'gyur ba'i gnasam gadha rdo rje'i gdan gyi spor ku sha'i stan 'jam po la rdo rje'i skyil krung bcas/ byang chub kyi shing la sku rgyab gtad de ye shes mchog ma brnyes kyi bar du mi g.yo ba'i dam bca' brtan po sa ga zla —336—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdza khang bzang gi dkar chag shāmiba'i tshes bco lnga'i srod la me tog mda' can ster bcas kyis ri bo pang du blangs te 'phen pa sogs mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char phab pa shin tu 'jam zhing mnyen pa'i me rtag tu bsgyur/ bdud mo rnamasabud med mdzes ma'i rnam 'gyur sna tshogs pa ston pa rgas shing khogs par byin gyis rlabs nas bdud btul/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ rnam dag sku lnga mchog tu gzugs bzang zhing / /ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra/ /grags pa 'jig (269ba lhan gsum na lhang nge ba/ /mgon po mchog brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bdud gyis bstod/ gung la mnyam par bzhag /tho rengs mchog gi sprul pa'i skur sangs rgyas pa yin zhing / /sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i mtshan gyi sgra bo che 'jig rten gsum du grags pa byi ba la glang chen ltar snyan ngag mkhan gyis bstod pa dang 'dod rgyal ma'i brda las btags pa ma yin par grags pa don dang mthun pa/ dpe la bstod pa las/ khyod sku mtshan gyis spras gyur pa/ /mdzes gyur mig gi bdud rtsi ni/ /sprin med ston gyi nam mkha' la/ /skar ma'i tshogs kyis spras pa 'dra/ /zhes mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa mthong na mi mthun pa med pa/ mthong ba dang reg pa sogs kyis rnam par grol ba sku'i yon tan lce brgyas bskal par brjod kyang zad mi nus pa/ bden pa po'i lung las/ ji ltar sems can kun gyis nges pa'i tshig /mang po dag gis dus gcig zhu zhus na/ /sems kyi skad cig gcig la thugs chud nas/ /gsung dbyangs gcig gis so sor lan yang 'debs/ /de lta bsan 'dren pa 'jig rten na/ /tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs gsung sgron mkhyen par mdzod/ /de ni lha mi'i sdug bsngal mthar 'byin pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor bar mdzod/ /ces yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa'i tshangs pa'i gsung dbyangs kyis legs par sbyar ba lha'i skad lta bu'i sgra las drangs pa'i chos bstan pa/ kun tu bzang po'i smon lam gyi rgyal po las/(270na sko yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad/ khrul bum dag dang mi yi skad rnams dang / /'gro ba kun gyi sgra rnams ji tsam par/ /thams cad skad du bdag gis chos bstan to/ /zhes 'gro ba so so'i skad rigs dang mthun par rigs can gsum gyi gdul bya'i mos blo dang 'tsham pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi rna —337

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 4bum/ (20)ba'i bcud du 'bab pasathosapasarnam par grolab sogasayonatan mtha' klas/ bsngagasa'osabasngagasabastod las/ khyod 'ba' zhig gi ye shes kyis/ shinas bya mtha' dag khyab lags kyi/ khyod las g.yin pa thamasacad kyi/ khresabya kho na lhag pa las/ /zhesaji lta ji snyed kyi shesabya'i gnasalugasamatha' dag sgrib pa dang bral bar mngon sum du gzigs pa rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis gang gi yon tan cha tsam dran pa'ang btang snyoms yal yol du ma lus par rjes su 'dzin pa ji skad du/gang la mos pa gtsor byed pa/ /de yi mdun na thub pa bzhugs/ /zhesadad pa'i a lung yod na thugs rje'i lcags kyus mi 'dzin pa'i lus can mi srid pa'i mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi sgo nas gdul bya rjes su 'dzin par mkhas pas ma 'dris pa'i mdza'
