bshes chen po zhes thugs kyi yon tan kun gsal gyi mthas kyang gzhal bar mi spyod/ brgya lnga bcu pa las/ /'gro ba 'di dag thamasacad ni/ khyad med yon to rnamasakyis bcings/ khyod ni 'gro ba'i nyon mongs dag /sgrol slad yun ring thugs rjes bsdams/ /dang por khyod la phyag bgyi'am/ /'on te gang gis 'khor (270bathar khyod/ /skyon mkhyen yun ringasade lta bur/ /bzhugs mdzad thugs rje che la bgyi/ /zhesagazhan la phan gdagasapa'i yon tan gyis 'gro ba rnams phar bcings pa ltar nyon mongs pas thog ma med pa nas gzir ba'i lus can rnams kyi sdug kun nye bar gzhil ba'i thugs rje chen po'i khur gyis bcings pa yongs rjes kyi brgyan te rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen pos/ khyod ni 'gro ba'i don gyi slad/ khung zad tsam yang mi ngal zhing / /'gro ba rnams kyang khyod kyi ni/ /yon tan brjod la ngal ma gyur/ /zhes pa dang mtshungs pa'i phyir thugasarje chen po'i yon to tshad ma'i srang la gzhal kyang rtogs par dka'/ brgya lnga bcu pa las/ khyod kyisanyon mongs gzhom par bshad/ /bdud kyi g.yo dag bstan par mdzad/ /'khor ba'i rang bzhin mi bzad brjod/ /'jigs pa med pa'i phyogs kyang bstan/ phan dgongs thugs rje can gyis gzigs/ /sems can rnams la bgyi 'tshal ba/ /gzhan go ci zhig mchis lags kyis/ /zhes sems can gyi don du 'gyur na ༅ 'gro'i gnas kyang mtho ris kyi dgal tshal bzhin spro ba chen pos dang du blangs te thabs —338—

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (7mkhas pa'i mdzad pa sna tshogs kyi sgo nas srid zhi'i duḥ kha las skye rgu rnams yongs su bskyabs te bde ba la sbyor ba'i 'phrin las ji srid 'khor ba ma stongs pa de srid du 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa rgyun mi chad mod/ 'phrin las la rnam grangs mtha' yas kyang gtso bo ni tshoms las/ thub rnams sdig pa chu yis mi 'khrud cing / /(271na 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gis mi sel la/ /nyid kyi rtog pa gzhan la spo min te/ /chos nyid bden pa bstan pas grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes chos kyis 'khor lo bskor ba nyid gtso bo yin cing / rnam bshad rig pa las/ chos ni shes bya lam dang ni/ /mya ngan 'das dang yid kyi yul/ /bsod nams tshe dang gsung rab dang / /'byung 'gyur nges dang chos lugs la'o/ /zhes rnams grangs bcur gsungs pa las/ skabs 'dir lam la chos zhes spyi ming sgos su btags pa 'dul ba lung gi sgra bshad ltar/ /dam pa ni mchog gam mi 'gyur bas na dam pa ste/ sa: ta'i skad du sa d+dha 'a zhes pa dam pa'i chos te ḍū dhi nya 'dzin pa la'o zhes pa'i byings las bsgrubs pas ngan 'gro las mi gtong bar 'dzin pas chos/ de bzhin gshegs pa la skyes bu dam pa'i 'du shes 'jog par bshad pas dam pa'i skyes bus gsungs pa'i chos te/ dam pa yang yin la sna chas kyang yin pas de ltar du btags/ de yang chosamangon pa las/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /zhes lung rtogs gnyis su gsungs pa'i gdul bya'i rgyud la thob par bya ba rtogs pa'i bstan pa yin kyang / /sngon du de brjod byar byed pa'i lung gi bstan pa la thos bsam bya dgos pa'i phyir 'o skol gyi ston pa sangs rgyas nas zhag zhe dgu pa na tshangs pa gtsug phud can gyi gser gyi 'khor lo dang/ /slar grogs su brgya byin sbran nas gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul te gsol ba (271ba)btab pa'i mthus wa ra ṇa sir bden pa bzhi la brten pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo/ bya rgod phung po'i rir bar pa mas nyid med pa'i chos 'khor/yangs pa can du legs par rnam par phye ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas rtswa mchog gi grong du dgung lo gya gcig pa lcags 'brug sag zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la chos kyi dbyings su mya ngan las 'das te 'gro ba rnams kyis bsod nams kyi zhing du gdung ring bsrel gyi snying po can cha brgyad du bgos nas mchod —339

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sherten brgyad du bzhugs so/ /de yang 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang lang gar gshegs pa sogs las lung bstan pa'i mgon po klu sgrub dang 'phags pa thogs med ces shing rta chen po rnam pa gnyis rjes 'brang dang bcas pas rgyal ba'i ring lugs 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas gsal bar mdzad/ zhi lhag zung 'brel dang bskyed rdzogs kyi ting nge 'dzin la brten nas zla bsnan zhabs dang bi rū pa sogs brgyad cu rtsa bzhis mtshon pa'i rnal 'byor spyod pa rnams kyis mchog thun gyi dngos grub brnyes nas bstan pa ches cher dar bar mdzad pa'i zhing khams kyang spyir mkhas pa'i gsung las/ /ji ltar me long ngos la bzhin snang ltar/ /'jig rten zhes bya phyi na yod min kyang / /byis rnams ji ltar snang ba de tsam las/ /bden par zhen te so sor a thang chad/ /ji ltar rmi lam snang ba sna tsho gos de/ /snang dang mi bden gnyis/yin pa ltar/ /'khor 'das snang ba sna tshogs thams cad kyang / /bden rdzun bral ba de ltar shes par (272na gyis/ /zhes pa ltar 'jig rten gyi khams phyi na yod par theg pa 'og ma dang mu stegs can gyi gzhud lugs na bshad pa'i 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi snang ngor shar ba dang sgo bstun gyi kun gzhi'i rnam shes zhabrul rgyus bslad pa las 'jig rten gyi khams sna tshogs su snang bar mdo sde pa dang sems tsam pa sogs 'chad/dri med 'od kyi 'jig rten khams ler/ 'jig rten kun rdzob tu mos pa sna tsho gis pa'i sems can rnams kyi bsam pa'i dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams la tshad sna tsho gos gsungs shing / don dam pa'i bden pas 'jig rten gyi khams la tshad med de/ sems can gyi bsod nams dang sdig pa'i dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams la tshad sna tsho gis su snang ba yin/ zhes mdo sems rnams dang mthun par sems can gyi las dang bsam pa'i mtha' gzhal bar dka' na'ang / mdo rgyud kyi bka' bstan bcos mang po 'jig rten gyi chags tshul mi mthun pa mang du gsungs shing / bye brag chos ma' par/ gling bzhi pa dang nyi zla dang / /ri shib dang ni 'dod lha dang / /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong la ni/ /stong ni spyi phud yin par 'dod/ /de stong la ni stong gnyis pa/ /bar ma'i 'jig rten khams yin no/ /de stong la ni stong gsum pa/ lda nyam —340

sku gsung thugs rten gsar ba tshe ngas dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shā'idu 'jig cing 'byung ba yin/ /zhes stong gsum mi mjed kyi 'jig rten bstan pa'i nang tshan dzasbu gling zhes bya ba 'jig rten khams ler/ /gling ni zla ba 'od dkar can dang rab mchog ku sha dang ni mi'am ci dang khrung (272bsgo grang dang / drag po yang ni longs spyod sa de bdun par dzaskru'i mi rnams gnas pa dag ni las kyi sa/ /zhes dus kyi 'khor lo'i ri rab rdo rje dbyibs can gyi rwa'i 'og tu longs spyod gyi gling drug dang / phyi rol gyi gling phran mtha' dag las kyi sa ste 'dzam gling chen por bshad pa dang mthun par mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i le'u gsum par/ dzasbu gling ni chen po yi/ /dum bu bcu gnyis kyi ni dbus/ shar gyi yul na gnas lha mo/ /zhes 'dzam gling che chung gi khyad par yod pa mngon pa gong 'og sogs las dzasbu gling zhes pa lho phyogs kyi gling 'di gar ngos 'dzin pa/ dza na skye ba la'o zhes pa'i byings bzhag /na'i a brjod don yin pas phyis/ bu kra rkyen du byin/ ka la yan bzhin 'ang sogs kyis ka phyis/ gi byin pa mi zad pa phyis pas de'i sde pa la sde pa'i mtha' 'os/ na mar bsgyur bas dzasbu/ zhes pa lus can skye ba'i gnas sam/ mtsho ma dros pa'i 'gram du sru tri sha'i gos bu rdza ma tsam pa mtshor lhung ba'i sgra la brten nas gling dang shing gnyis ka la ming du chags shing / gling gi dbyibs kyang spyir shing rta'i rnam par mngon pa las bshad mod/ gling 'di'i dbus su sa bzhi las gyen du 'bur dod dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad kyis mtho ba zur gsum me'i khams su yod pas bsdus rgyud las/ shar du rlung ni shin tu zlum por 'gyur te mi yi bdag po lho ru me ni grugasum mo/ zhes 'byung ba'i gling 'di/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor/ dzasbu'i gling ni chung ngu (273na 'dir/ /bdag ni shākya'i rigs rjes 'gro/ zhes bdag cag gi ston pas mchog gi sprul sku'i mdzad pa ston pa'i phyir mi'i srid pa 'dzin pa'ang 'dzam gling chung ngu 'di nyid yin pas/ rgya che rol pa las dge slong de ltar byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas dam pa na 'dug pa ni rnam par blta ba chen po bzhi la rnam par blta ste/ bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ dus la rnam par blta ba dang / /gling la rnam par blta ba dang / /yul la rnam par blta ba dang / /rigs la rnam par blta ba'o/ /dge slong dag byang chub sems dpa' gling la rnam par blta zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni mtha' 'khob —341—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2shekyi gling du mi skye/ shar gyi lus 'phags por mi skye/ nub kyi ba lang spyod du mi skye/ byang gi sgra mi snyan du mi skye/ lho'i 'dzam bu'i gling du skye'o/ /dge slong dag ci'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' yul la rnam par blta zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni mtha' khob kyi yul gang na mi rnams dbang po brtul zhing blun la lug ltar lkugs pa'i rang bzhin can legs par bstan pa dang nyes par bstan pa'i don shes par bya ba'i skal ba med pa dag tu mi skye'i byang chub sems dpa' ni yul gyi dbus nyid du skye'o/ /zhes dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gnas ma ga dha rdo rje'i gdan gling 'di'i lte bar byas pa'i phyogs rnams su lung las/ mnyan yod gnas bcas tsaskra ka /wa ra ṇa gi yangs pa can/ rgyal po'i khang dang drug po ste/ de dag grong khyer chen (273ba)por grags/ zhes pas mtshon te rgya gar shar nub lho byang gi yul rnams dang / de dag gi phyi rol tu shar nas 'jam dbyangs kyi gnas ri bo rtse lnga/ lhor spyan ras gzigs dang sgrol mi'i gnas ri bo po ta la/ nub tu ma dang mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin 'du ba oṃ ṇ+ḍiya na rdo rje theg pa'i chos kyi 'byung gnas/ byang du chos rgyal bdun dang rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lngas dpal dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgo nas grong khyer bye ba phrag dgu bcu rtsa drug gi 'gro ba rnams smin grol la bkod pa'i gnas dpal ldan sham+bha la sogs rnam grangs ches mang zhid / byang phyogs kha ba can gyi rgyal khams ni thog mar mtshos gang ba rim gyis bri nas swā la'i nags chags pa'i rjes su thugs rje chen pos sprul pa'i spre'u dang brag srin mo 'dus pa las mi'i 'gro ba 'phel bar se rmu sdong stong ste nang mi'u rigs bzhi'am drug tu dbye na bod mi khri tho chen po bya ba de la dbra 'bru sdong lha dang nu bo dpa' mda' ste bu drug tu bshad pa spyan lnga lha gzigs ras pa'i yig tshang du/ dga' sdong 'bru gsum dbra dang bzhi/ /nu bo dpa' mda' gnyis te drug tu gsungs/ chos khrung la lar skya seng bu lnga dang dgra ngan dpung tshogs bcu gnyis 'thabs pa'i dus su rgyal ba ri pa ti dpung bcas bud med kyi chas su byas nas ri kha ba can gyi khrod du 'ongs pa las 'phel ba sogs 'chad tshul rnam grangs mang ba don du kha bas bskor ba'i ljongs thams cad grong dang grong khyer gyis kun tu khyab pa tshal pa ta'i si —342

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bgengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag yon(274na) dge ba'i blo gros kyi hu lan deb ther du/ spre'u dang brag srin mo las mched pa ma sangasaskrun dgu/ rgyal phran nyi shu rtsa lnga/ bcu gnyis sil ma bzhi bcus rim gyis dbang byas par bshad pa las bod spyi la mnga' sgyur ba'i rgyal po med pas sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa'i skye rgu rnams dge ba bcu'i khrims la bkod nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar bya ba'i ched du rigs gsum gyi mgon po sogs rgyal po'i rnam par bstan nas 'dul zhing du gyur ba/ /jo bo chen po a ti sha rdo rje gdan gyi nub phyogs 'od dpag med pa'i lha khang byang chub sems la thugs byung ba'i tshe spyan ras gzigs kyis 'kho bstan nas/ skyes bu dam pa legs so legs so/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsang ba'i mdzod gang yin pa de khyod kyi shes sam 'di nas byang phyogs na nga'i zhing khams yod/ khyod kyis yi dam jo mo sgrol ma yang de na sems can gyi don mdzad cing bzhugs/ khyod kyi gdul bya mang po yang de na yod pas byang phyogs bod du song zhig khres pa'i dgongs pa mthun cing yul khams gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa'ang / bal bo'i rgyal po de ba lhas sras mo khri btsun la gsungs pa/ nga yi snying dang 'dra ba'i bu mo khyod/ /bod ces bya ba khyad par 'phags pa'i yul/ /ri mtho sa gtsang gangs ri gnyan gyi mgul/ /bsil la mdzes pa lha gnas gzhes yas khang / /ngo mtshar med byung phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /chu (274bston bzhi 'bab rtsi shing nags kyis mdzes/ /'bru sna lnga zhakhrungs rin cen sna tsho gos tshang / /zhes yon tan khyad par can dang ldan pa'i pur rgyal gyi rgyal khams spyi la dbang bsgyur pa'i rgyal po'i thog ma rje rgyal po gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung rgyal rabs nyer bdun gyi bar rgyal srid sgrung dang lde'u bon gsum gyis bskyangs/ de nas 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par sprul pa lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyis pho brang yom bu gla sgang du bzhugs pa'i tshe dpang stong phyag brgya pa/gser gyi mchod rten/ tshin+ta ma ṇi'i rkos phor sogs mkha' las babs par mtshan gnyan po gsang bar btags nas mchod de bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/ de nas gdung rabs lnga pa rje rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos bod srin mo gan rgyal du bskyel ba lta bu gnon byed du mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon gyi —343

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)gtsug lag khang brtsigs pa'i rjes su ra sa dang ra mo che'i ga smyo la bzhengs par jo shākya rnam gnyis kyis gtsos pa'i brten pa lha'i tsho gis bzhugs su gsol bar mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstab cing / rgyal po nyid kyis skal ba dang ldan pa mang por thugs rje chen po zhi khro'i gdams pa gnang ba sogs bstan pa'i srol gtod/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga pa mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyis mkhan po bo dhi satwa/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal/ paṇa wo bi mā la mi thos gtsos rgya gar nas paṇa grub mang po gdan drangs/ be+e ro tsa na (275na tshes gas bod phrug dbang po rno ba mang por lo tsā slob tu bcug /o tan pu ri'i gtsug lag khang la dpe blangs pa'i zan g.yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa phyag rjes su bstar/ chos bsgyur ba nyan bshad rab byung gi sde 'dzugs pas mtshon bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas su mdzad/ slob dpon mtsho skyes rdo rjes rje 'bangs dgu dang nyer lnga la sgrub pa chen po bka' brgyad spyi bye brag gi smin grol gyi gdams pa stsal/ so so grub pa'i mtshan ma khyad par can re bstan mdo sgyu sems phyogs sogs bka' ma'i skor so zur gnubs gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i sngags 'chang rnams las ches cher dar bas bka' ma dang / slob dpon chen pos ri brag mtsho gsum phal mo che byin gyis brlabs/ zab gter bgrang las yas pa sbas pa mnga' bdag nyang nyi ma 'od zer dang / gu ru rin po che chos kyi dbang phyug sogs lung bstan dus babs kyi gter ston ji snyed cig byon te spyan drangs pa'i sngags rnying mar grags pa'i bstan pa dar rgyas su gyur/ de nas mi rabs gnyis na sgra sbyor bam po gnyis pa las/ rta'i lo la btsan po khri lde srong btsan pho brang skyi smad 'on cang rdo na bzhugs/stod smad kyi dmag gsar rnying brje ba rkun chen btul/ gar log gi pho lhas phyag btsal/ blon chen po zhang khri zur ram shags dang / mang rje lta 'dod la sogs pas rgya las srid cig mang po bcad de/ snga rta dang ba mar phal mo che phyag tu phul/ zhang (275ba)blon chen po man chad so sor bya dga' stsal ba'i lan la nyi 'og gi mkhan po ā tsarla dzi na mi tra sogs zhes pa ltar rgya gar nas su ren+d+ra bo dhi/ shī len+d+ra bo dhi/ dwa na shī la sogs paṇ+ḍita mang po spyan drangs/ bod kyi mkhan po rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ dharma ta shī la/ lo tsā —344

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shāmib dzñā na se na la sogs la sngon yab mes kyi dus bsgyur ba'i bka' dang de'i dgongs 'grel rnams skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab ste dag par bcos pa sogs bstan pa rin po che bla nas blar 'phel ba yid srubs sde dang bcas pa'i snying gi zug rngur gyur te chos la mi dga' ba'i blon po rnams kyis thabs du ma'i 'phrul byas te rgyal po dgung lo sum cu rtsa drug pa la dkrongs/ gcen glang dar ma 'u dum btsan rgyal sar brtan te sku gsung thugs rten 'jig pa/ rab tu byung ba rnams rtags cha lugs dang dbral ba sogs bstan pa bsnubs te bod mun pa'i gling du gyur pa rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i 'jug pa dus las mi yol ba'i mthus bla chen po dgongs pa rab bsal gyis 'dul ba'i bstan pa mdo smad nas me ro gsos/ mnga' ris rgyal po lha btsun byang chub 'od kyi dka' ba du mas dpal jo bo chen po di bī ka ra gdan drangs/ bstan pa la log par rtog pa'i dri ma mtha' dag bsal nas lha chos bdun ldan bka' gdams rin po che'i sde tshugs/ lo tsā ba chen po rin cen bzang po/ lo chen 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ mar 'gos/ mar do/ ra gnyan sogs lo tsā ba mang pos(27na7da sdebazhi gtso bor gyur pa'i zhus chen dang 'gyur bcos/ rngog lo rjes 'bras dang bcas pas phar tshad kyis gtsos pa'i bka' pod mang po'i gad nyan gyi rgyun/ lha bla ma khu dbon gyi bka' drin las/ rgya gar nas pā la rnam pa gsum gyis stod 'dul bar grags pa'i sdom rgyun/ /smir pa'i paṇa chen bsod snyoms pa chen po shākya shrīs 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā ba dang byang rdor rnam gnyis sogs sdom pa gsum la bkod de paṇa chen sdom rgyun zhes bod kyi mkhas btsun phal cher thub bstan rin po cher 'jug pa'i sgo phye/ shong dbang nas snyigs dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa rin cen chos skyong bzang po brgyud par bcas pas ka tsan snyan ngag sdeb sbyor zlos gar gyi mtshon phyi tha snyad kyi rig pa'i srol gsar du phye zhing / mdo rgyud kyi ring lugs slar yang je rgyas su mdzad/ lo paṇa de dag gi bshad sgrub kyi rgyun 'jam mgon grub pa'i dpa' bo sa skya pa rjes 'brang gi slob mar bcas pa dang / shes bya thams cad gzigs pa kun mkhyen bu ston yab sras kyis gtan la phab nas rgya cher spel/ gzhan yang dwags shangs/ zhi byed snga phyi bar gsum —345

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)sogs nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i rjes su zhugs pa'i grub mtha' ris med kyi ring lugs dbyar mtsho ltar phyogs kun tu khyab par brten/ khro phu lo tsā ba be+eḍū rla'i tshong 'dus nas kha che paṇa chen la phul ba'i zhu yig tu/ ma ga dha sogs rigs 'byung gnas kyang sdig to yi/ /dmag tshogs kyis bcoms(276ba)skyon kha che bal yul kyang / /log spyod kyis khengs ding sang bstan srog legs gnas ni/ /bod yul 'dir zad skyes chen byang phyogs zhabs bskyod zhu/ zhes dang / khrus khang lo tsā ba bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sdes/ /lar dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje dang / /rgyal sras pad dkar zhabs drin las/ /bod kyi yul khams 'di nyid kyang / /'phags yul dang skal ba mnyam pa snyam/ che'i(gsung ba don la gnas shing / khyad par rgyal ba gnyis pa shar btsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal thog mar chos rje don grub rin chen pas yongs 'dzin dang bdag rkyen mdzad nas dbus gtsang gi phyogs su slob sbyongs la byon ris med pa'i yongs 'dzin bsten nas bka' pod rnams bslabs sbyangs mthar phyin/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nas rgyal mtshan/ thugs sras lo tsā ba rin cen rnam rgyal/ khyung po lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ gong gsum bde chen pa chos kyi dpal ba/ yo ga ba mgon bzang / re mda' ba gzhon nu blo gros sogs dam pa du ma la rgyud sdebazhi dbang khrid bshad bka' man ngag gi gnad la sgro 'dogs bcad/ khyad par dpal mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi bzhed pa'i dbu ma thal 'gyur ba'i lta ba thun mong ma yin pa dang / rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rdzogs rim rim pa lnga'i nang tshan sgyu lus kyi skor la bla ma dbu ma pas lo tsā mdzad nas mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs la dri ba mang du mdzad cing / bla ma 'jam dbyangs (277na〉kye byin rlabs thugs la zhugs nas dka' gnas de dag la sngon gyi mkhas pa rnams kyis ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa'i mdud pa thams cad rang sar bkrol nas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa dbyis phyin par rnyed de mkhas pa mgu ba bskyed pa'i legs bshad kyi bstan bcos mang du brtsams/ mdzad chen bzhing grags pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa mnyan yod du rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi cho 'phrul gyis ston pa drug rjes 'brang dang bcas pa btul ba'i dus ston —346

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mar jos khang bzang gi dkar chag 9yi'aphrul snang lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang du rgyun btsugs pas/ bka' 'tshems ka khol mar/ dge slong byang sems shar phyogs sku zhakhrungs pa'i/ /gsang sngags 'chang zhing rnal 'byor chen po ni/ /snying po'i mtha' can skyes chen dam pa yis/ /zhal yang bsgyur zhing bsnyen bkur dam pa mdzad/ /ces gser gyi lha shākya mu ni bod yul 'dir yun ring por bzhugs pa'i ched rin po che'i brog zhu sgron nas nges pa lnga ldan gyi gzugs sku dang pha das pa'i rten 'brel bsgrigs te zhal bsgyur ba'i mdzad pa'i bka' drin ni bod dang bod chen po'i skye rgu rnams kyi bsab pa'i go skabs dang bral/ gdan sa chen po dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling phyag dar nas btab/ sne'u rdzong phyi ba nam mkha' bzang po dang 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan la zhal ta gnang / dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos kyi sde chen po gzhi things par zhabs kyis bcags/ se rar phebs nas theg pa chen po'i gling 'byung ba'i (277ba)rten 'brel mdzad/ se 'bras dge gsum zhes nyi zla ltar grags pa las mched pa'i dngos dang yang slob kyi mnga' ris nas bzung rgya nag po'i bar gyi rgyal khams kun tu mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa zhes zhwa ser cod pan 'dzin pa'i 'phrin las sa chen po'i rdul gyi grangs las 'gong ba ltar khyab/ khyad par 'dul ba'i bstan pa rin po che snga rabs pa rnams la dar rgyas shin tu che yang lag len cha phra mo dag 'dul ba'i sde snod las 'byung ba yul dus kyi dbang gis 'phags yul dang mtshungs pa phyogs 'dir ma dar ba mkhas pa rnam gsum gyis gnam rtsibs steng du gtan la legs par phab cing / de don tshigs tsam du ma lus par phyag len du gdab par mdzad pas grub pa'i mthar rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol tu son pa thams cad mkhyen pa ye bzang rtse ba'i zhal snga nas kyis/ rje btsun de'i bka' drin las/ zhal ma mthong zhing phyogs ring na gnas pa'i rab tu byung ba dag kyang dras drubs ma dang gding lhung la sogs pa'i yo byad bsrel ba dang / phyi rol yang sdud ma spangs te zla gam gyon pa dang zhu'i kha dog kyang gser mdog tu byed pa'i 'di yin no/ /'di dag ni thun mong du snang ba'i che ba tsam zhig brjod pa ste/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo —347

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (sherjes mkhan chen las kyi rdo rje la bka' stsal pa'i yi ge las/nga lag na rdo rjes kyang ma ti bha dra gī rnyi gri'i yon tan gyi mtha' rtogs par mi nus so gsungs/tshad ma las ni 'di'i phyi ma dga' ldan du byang chub sems dpa' 'jam 278na8pal snying por 'gyur ro zhes bya ba dang /ma 'ongs pa na de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge'i nga ror 'gyur ro//zhes bya ba dag la yid 'khyog pa med cing shin tu mtho ba'i sal bzhugs pa zhig 'dir sems can gyi don la byon no zhes bya bar nges so//zhes dang /dus kyi dbang gis dge slong lhod pa yang ma rab byung ba na rje btsun dam pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis dang por skyor mo lung ba mkhan chen blo gsal ba la 'dul ba legs par bslabs/phyis dben pa'i gnas rnams su sgrub pa snying po mdzad pa na'ang 'dul ba'i kun tu spyod pa las ma 'das/phyis 'khor skyong ba'i tshe yang drung na 'khod pa thams cad 'dul ba nas ji skad bshad pa'i chos gos gsum gding ba dang lhung bzed la sogs pa mkho ba'i yo byad rnams 'dzin du bcug/jo bo chen po rje lha gcig gi man ngag la brten nas skyes bu gsum la blo sbyangs nas 'khor ba mtha' dag la yid 'byung ba'i blos sdom pa thams cad so so thar ba mtshan nyid pa la bkod de dag gi spyan stos la brten nas bod kyi khams 'dir 'dul ba'i bstan pa nyi ma shar ba lta bur gyur ba yin no zhes/deb ther sngon por bka' stsal ba ni khungs shin tu che ba yin no//rje bla ma'i 'phrin las kyi cha shas las chos rje don grub dpal bas yar klungs su ri bo chos gling dang /sto brag shar du bkra shis chos gling gnyis btab/yar klung 'phyong rgyas kyi ri bo dgon par bzhugs nas lam rim blo sbyong gsang 'dus278bsko sum la 'chad nyan mdzad/phyis su lung pa phu khang mtho bas 'phyongs dka' bar brten ri bo dgon sde pa 'phyos pas sbyin bdag mdzad nas bya 'dabs gzhis ka'i logs su spos pas bkra shis bde chen du grags/ri bo'i spor rgyal mtshan rtse'i gzims khang du thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos kyang mang du bzhugs nas bstan bcos kyi rtsom pa du ma mdzad/mgon khang du shangs mtshal ༷༷ dpal ldan dmag zor ma'i bris sku gnyan par

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdza khang bzang gi dkar chag khomabazhugs pa dang phyogs mtshungs pa bas sna'i rdzong dang yar klungs sa ba gru pa'i gzhis gar yang yod zer / de ltar dbu mdzad blo bzang yon to gyis rang nyid dang pha khyi skyag ma bkra shis dbang mo rnams kyi sgrib sbyongs dang dgon pa'i zhabs tog lhag bsam dang brtson pa'i mthu la brten nas shing mo yos kyi lor chos sde 'di nyid kyi dri gtsang khang / kun dga' ra ba rnams rgya che ba'i mkhar las dang bka' 'gyur rin po che gsar bzhengs kyi dbu btsugs pa sogs rim par bgyis pa'i dus kyi pho lha'i lo bris 'bur gyi rten rnams bzhengs par/ dri gtsang khang du dus gsum sangs rgyas mchogo zung / sgo srung rta mgrin dang phyag rdor/ 'du khang du rgyal ba btsong kha pa wo po'i sku/ gtsang khang steng du spyan rasagazigs/ rgyal po 'jig rten dbang phyug /lha'i rgyal po/ chos rgyal gnya' khri btsan po/ lha tho tho ri snyan shal/ rgyal po dad pa brtan pa/ rje dkon cog 'bangs/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po/ tshangs pa lha'i me tog (279na sgong 'a bdag khri lde srong btsan/ /rgyal po dge ba dpal/ kha che dgon pa ba/'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas/ rje btsun sa skya pa chen po/ zhang g.yu brag pa brtson 'grus grags/gter ston mnga' bdag nyi ma 'od zer/ lha rje dge ba 'bum/ bal po'i paṇ+ḍita pad+ma badz+ra/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa/ paṇa chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho/ /bde chen chos kyi rgyal po/ 'di ga'i 'dra 'bag rnams bsgrigs pa'i bla ma lha khang rnams kyi nang bzhugs la ring bsrel rnam pa bzhi las/ rgyud sdebazhi dang mdo las byung ba'i chos sku'i ring bsrel/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yungs wī lta bu'i ring bsrel/ sku gdung dang sku bal la/ thog mar bstan pa spyir/ sangasargyas kyi bsil byed kyi bar shing / de bzhin gshegs pa glang po'i gdung / rang sangs rgyas kyi gdung rdo'i khams su byin gyis rlabs pa/ dgra bcom pa nyi ma gung pa'i gdung / mkhan po bo dhi satwa dang ka mā la shī la'i gdung / rgyal po 'od zer go cha'i ba so'i sku rgyan/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i zhabs phyags/sprul pa'i stag pags/ mnga' bdag khri ral gyi gdung / bram ze dri med snang ba'i sku sha /bsam yas su lo paṇa gyis chos bsgyur ba'i bzhugs khri/ te lo pa'i bzhugs gdan/ grub chen nag po spyod pa dang ma —349—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti pu ba gsum gyi rus rgyan/ paṇa chen nā ro pa'i bum chu/ snyan rgyan/ bzhugs gdan/ (279ba〉skom thag /mkha' 'gro ma ni gu dang paṇa chen 'bum phrag gsum pa'i dbu skra/ mi tri pa'i kha stu ga'i shing / rgya gar phyag na'i rdo rgyus sgom thag /kha che dgon pa'i gdung rus/ dwa na lha la'i dbu skra/ mar mi thun mong gi gsol zhal/ lo chen rin bzang gi phyag sen/ pha dam pa'i zhabs phyags/ /mi la'i dbu skra ras gos sgom thag /mkhas grub khyung po dang rin cen brtson 'grus/ dbon ston skyer snang pa gsum gyi gdung rus/ mnyam med nam mkha'i rnal 'byor gyi dbu skra/ kha che paṇa chen gyi snam sbyar/gsol lhung gi shubs 'khyar sil/ paṇa chen nags rin gyi dbu zhwa/ yab chos rje kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sgom thag /skyon 'tsho ma'i dbu klad/ rgya dpe 'khrul med/ 'phags pa lo ke shara'i sku phyis pa'i dar rnams/ bka' gdams gsar snying gi skor la/ jo bo chen po a ti sha'i gdung dang rgya dpe/ 'brom ston pa'i tshems/ rngog lo khu dpon gyi na bza'/ khu ston gyi gdung rus/ po to ba'i dbu skra/ sne'u zur pa'i dbu skra/ mchims nam mkha' grags kyi gdung / snar thang pa'i rten 'dam/ spas ti dgra bcom ba'i snam sbyar/ lho brag phyag rdor pa'i phyag mdzub dang zhabs phyags/ rgyal ba btsong kha pa chen po'i sku mtshan/snam sbyar/ bla gos/ gsang chab/ na bza'/ dbu skra/ sku rag /zhabs phyags/ 'jam dbyangs gtsang pa bdun rgyud kyi dam rdzas sna tshogs bsdus pa/ ba so chos rgyan (280na)pa'i dbu skra/ rje smon lam dpal ba'i dbu zhwa/ paṇa chen byams pa gling pa'i na bza'/ mdung rtse ma'i gdung rus/ sems dpa' kun bzang pa'i dbu skra/ rtogs ldan 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i zhabasang ra/ paṇa chen dge 'dun grub pa'i tshems/ sku chos/ dbu zhwa/ sku mtshal/ mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/ 'jam dbyangs legs chos pa'i snam sbyar/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i dbu lo/ pur ras/ paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa dang rdo rje 'chang sngags rams pa bde ba can pa gsum gyi gdung rus/ rje bstan dar ba'i dam rdzas/ thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbu klad/ sku chos/ sku ber/ sku rag /zhwa thul/ pur ras/ stan dmar/ sgom sde nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi dbu skra/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi —350

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag shāmirgyal mtshan gyi dbu skra dang snam sbyar/ rten 'dus/ thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i shangs mtshal/dbu skra/gdung rus/dbu zhwa/sku chos/'jam dbyangs dkon cog chos 'phel gyi dbu skra/rdo rje 'chang pha bong kha pa'i dbu skra/dbu zhwa/snam sbyar/bdud rtsi ril bu/gdung rus/'di ga nas bsgrubs pa'i tshe chang dang bdud rtsi ril bu/bod khams bde thabs su grwa tshang gis lha sar phur sgrub gyi tshe chang dang bum chu ril bu/rgyal me tog thang pa dang thar pa gling pa yer pa gra tshang pha bong kha pa nye sdings pa lngas so sor sgrubs pa'i ma ni ril bu/dga' ldan gsang sngags280ba ) gling pa'i 'gro don las sbyor lnga pa rnams/rje btsun sa skya ba'i skor la/'byog mi lo chen gyi thugs/snang kha'u pa'i rus rgyan/ba ri lo tsā ba'i na bza'/rjes wo gyis gdung rus/slob dpon rin po che'i dbu lo dang gar gos/rje btsun grags pa'i na bza'/gdung rus/phyag phreng me 'bar ma/rje btsun sa paṇa gyi dbu skra/snam sbyar/rus rgyan/'phags pa rin po che'i na bza'/gdung rus//phyag phreng /rgyal ba brag phug pa'i dam rdzas/bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi gdung rus/sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba'i sku phod/theg chen chos kyi rgyal po'i dbu skra/ngor pa rdo rje 'chang gi dbu skra/kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa'i snam sbyar/bdag chen grags pa blo gros kyi bdud rtsi ril bu/sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i na bza'/bdag chen kun dga' legs pa'i rten 'dam/bdag chen bsod nams dbang po'i na bza'/rtse gdong khri chen kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub kyi sku chos/sa skya khri chen ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyi bdud rtsi ril bu/yab 'jam dbyangs chos rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang /bdag chen rgya dkar ba shes rab rgyal mtshan gnyis kyi gdung rus/bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gi bdud rtsi ril bu lung bstan ma/rje btsun rdo ring pa/sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po gsum gyi gdung rus/'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i shangs mtshal/rin po che bod mkhar ba mi tri don grub rgyal mtshan gyi gdung rus/yol mkhan chen gzhen nu blo gros kyis rtag gtor/ 28na ) rin po che rta ra ba'i gdung rus/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan dang khyab bdag bka' 'gyur ba mkhan chen zha

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2she lu ba gsum gyi dbu skra/ rtses dang bsam gtan gling gi dam rdzas/ lha sar bkra shis chos sdebs rnam rgyal stong mchod kyi bum chu ril bu rnams/gsang sngags rnying ma'i skor la/ dga' rab rdo rje dang lti sidha'i dbu skra/ skyon rin po che'i sbyin sreg gi rdo/ skyon yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar/ skyon gyi tshe ril 'ja' tshon ma/ bram ze skye ba bdun pa'i sku sha/ bsam yas bar khang gi rgya dpe/ bi mā la mi tā'i na bza'/ rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi gdung rus/ chos rgyal khri srong lde bas gyi dbu skra/ lo wo be+e ro'i gdung / ga lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs dang nyang ta thā ga ta'i gdung / zur shākya 'byung gi chos sman/ so shākya dpal ba'i gdung rus/ka thog pa pa3 khrus 'bum/ myang gi rig ma sangs rgyas skyid kyi gdung / gu ru chos dbang gi shangs mtshal/ sras pad+ma bde chen gyi sku phod/ skal ldan yar klungs sprul sku'i sku sha/ skyon gling pa dang gter ston sangs rgyas gling pa'i sku rus/ gter ston rdo rje gling pa'i sku sha /chos rgyal rat+na gling pa'i dbu skra/klong chen pa'i sku rag /gter ston dri med lhun po'i 'bum dmar/ gter ston pad+ma gling pa'i gter ma'i phyon rin po che'i sku chos/ thang stong rgyal po'i sle bem/ se ston mgon po bzang po'i dbu klad/ se ston rin cen rgyal mtshan gyi sku sha/ mes ston nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi dbu ral/ nub mgon pa byams pa chos kyi (281ba)rgyal mtshan gyi gdung rus/ mnga' ris paṇa chen rin po che'i shog ser/ mnga' ris legs ldan rdo rje'i dam rdzas dang chos sman/ 'bri gung zur pa'i sku sha ril bu dang phyag 'phreng / 'phrang 'go gter ston gyi na bza'/ dpal ri gra tshang gis bsgrubs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i ril bu/ 'bri gung sprul sku dkon cog 'phrin las bzang po'i chos sman/ rigs 'dzin ngag gi dbang po'i sku gzan/ yol mo sprul sku'i gdung rus/ rdo rje brag sprul sku'i chos sman/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang 'chi med sku gsum rigs 'dus kyi tshe ril/ 'gro don las sbyor lnga pa/ rje kun dga' tshe mchog gi dbu zhwa/ zur gzhen nu don grub kyi phyag 'phreng / zur thams cad mkhyen pa'i gdung rus/ khyab bdag khra tshang pa blo mchog rdo rje'i dbu lo dang skye bdun ril bu/ chos rje thub bstan pa'i tshe ril/ kong po rdzogs chen pa nam mkha' —352

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mgo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga yona'ags med kyi gdung rus/dar sdo mes chos rje 'phrin las lhun grub kyi chos sman/sprul sku gter bdag gling pa'i dbu lo dang chos sman/snying re ba bde ba bzang po'i dbu skra/tshe lam dpal ri ba'i tshe chu ril bu rnams/dwags brgyud pa'i skor la/sgam po zla 'od gzhon nu'i na bza'/dpal phag mo gru pa'i dbu skra dang /'bri gung spyan snga chos kyi rgyal po/gong dkar zhabs drung ngag dbang bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan bka' brgyud rnam par rgyal ba'i lha gsum gyi dbu skra/rje dbu se'i gdung /dme pa mthong ba don ldan gyi gdung rus te gong gsal rnams nas cha shas re rnams dang (282na lhan gtsor de dag gi steng du sangs rgyas 'od srungs kyi 'phel gdung khungs btsun/'o skol gyi ston pa'i 'phel gdung 'khrul med gsum/mkhas grub khyung po'i ring bsrel gnyis/rje 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang paṇa chen bzang po gragasapa'i ring bsrel re/g.yin ma lnga/bris sku la/shing byang ngos la jo bo yab sras kyi snang brnyan shangs 'tshal gyis bris par yab sras gnyis ga'i phyag nas brgya rtsa ma khu ston gyi dad rten du lha khang ke tsu nas stsal pa rim par brgyud de byung ba'i ngo mtshar can/jo bo a ti sha'i snang bas byin rlabs can/rgyal ba btsong kha pa'i sku brnyan nyid kyi phyag nas ma/kun mkhyen bsod nams rgya mtsho'i snang brnyan/rje yon tan rgya mtsho'i sku brnyan phyag zhabs kyi rjes yod pa/sems dpa' chen po dpal 'byor bzang po'i sku bas/'khor lo bde mchog lhan skyes kyi sku bas dang /rje 'jig rten mgon po rin cen dpal gyi phyag zhabs kyi rjes yod pa zhig po nyi ma seng ge'i thugs dam rten/yang jo bo a ti sha/rje btsun btsong kha pa/mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen pa gsum gyi snang brnyan re/bde mchog lha hi pa dang kun rig gi dkyil thang re/ 'jigs byed kyi snang bas/ mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i snang bas g.yas g.yon du rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i phyag zhabs kyi rjes yod pa rnams/'bur sku la/thub dbang gi sku li ma gnyis/gser sku gcig/sman sku gcig/paṇa chen : rta'i phyag tsha0khog/tsan dan dkar po las grub 282ba ) pa'i bcu gcig zhal gyi sku 'dra gcig/rdo nag las grub pa'i phyag rdor/byang chub ljon

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geshing las grub pa'i byams pa'i ldem sku gcig /'di ga nas 'jim pa byin rlabs dang rab gnas byas pa'i sman bla bde gshegs brgyad tshar bzhi/ gser zangs las grub pa'i gdung rten gcig /gsung rten gshin rje dgra nag gi rgyud tshar bzhi/ las thams cad grub par byed pa'i rgyud tshar gnyis/ 'jigs byed kyi rgyud rtog gsum tshar gnyis/ ga 'gro thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ rgyal rtse'i gzungs 'bum gzungs 'dus gser chos/ phal chen/ sa bcu pa'i mdo/ yab sras mjal ba'i mdo/ dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin pa'i mdo/ gser 'od/ mtshan 'bum/ gra lnga/ brgyad stong pa tshar gnyis/ 'bum gyi po ti gcig /khyad par 'phags bstod/ o rgyan gyi rnam thar/ rje rin po che'i gsang ba'i rnam thar/ chags lo'i gsan yig rnams/ zur chos dbyings rang grol dang 'di ga'i bla gos sbubs re/ 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan pa'i dbang bum rnams bzhugs so/ /ldebs bris kyi skor la/ gtsang khang sbug tshe dpag med kyi skus gang ba/ bka' 'gyur khang du yum chen mo'i sku brgya rtsa/ bla ma lha khang du sangs rgyas rabs bdun/ nye ba'i sras brgyad/ 'du khang gi byang skya gtsang khang gi sgo'i g.yas su ngos kyi 'dra 'bag dang zab mo lta brgyud/ g.yon du rgyal ba btsong kha pa la rgya chen spyod rgyud kyis bskor ba/ shar rgyud la 'dus pa lha so gnyis(283na tha de mchog lha re gnyis/ 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum/ jo bo lugs kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig /nub rgyud la sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi lha tshogs nga gsum/ /phung po gsum pa nas gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas sum cu so lnga/'phags pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug /lho rgyud la dpal myur mdzad mgon po gtso 'khor/ rnam sras rta bdag brgyad/ /las gshin yab yum/ dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug ma/ rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong /yang gha bza'/ rgyal chen bzhi/ srid pa 'khor lo/ phyogs skyong bco lnga/ gnas chung chos rgyal/ 'phyos lha sgam po/ grib btsan pa/ gnam g.yengs la bla ma lha khang gi 'bur sku rnams tshang ba sbyin bdag gi 'dod pa gra dmangs rnams kyis slar mnan pa/ 'od dpag med/ rgyal ba seng ge'i nga ro/ zangs dkar lo tsā ba/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa/ mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen rin po che blo —354

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khos dang rin po tsho yong rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga tre'ibazang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/zhal snga nas blo gros rin chen/mkhan blo bzang bstan 'phel/kun rig rnam par snang mdzad/rdo rje mi zhakhrugs pa/gtsug tor rnam rgyal/spyan ras gzigs rta mgrin zhabs brgyad pa/sgrol dkar/phyag na rdo rje/dzam la 'bru gzhen/dzam ser nag gnyis/ngag dbang bkra shis kyi 'dod pa'i skyon rin po d+ku gu ru mas pa brgyad kyis bskor ba rnams/shing rtsi dang yos pa'i rdo bzo dbu mdzad slob dpon kun bzang gis gtsos pa'i brgyad/shing bzo dbu mdzad chos skyong can bcu gcig lcags bzo ba dbu mdzad dge rgyas pa can drug/tshags pa dbu mdzad mgon po can bcu gcig/zhal mkhan po yongs grags pa can gnyis//dbu 283bsgo dzad skyon chos rgyal can 'jim bzo ba bco lnga/bris pa sman lugs rags kha a bar can bcu gcig/mkhyen lugs spus khyim tshe 'phel gnyis kyis gtsos bcu dgu/'go pa ngag dbang bkra shisang ga dbang bzang po/sa nag pa kun dga'/rgya dma' ba bsod nams dbang po dang khyi skyag/gzungs bzhugs dang rab gnas pa phan bde legs bshad gling nas dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pa sogs bcu gsum gyis bkra shis kyi me tog char du phab cing gegs med du grub bo//de yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan bzhag pa'i phan yon yang dag brjod pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs las/dge slong dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzugs brnyan byed pa'i gang zag sbyin pa po la phan yon 'di lnga yod de/lnga gang zhe na/gzhal med khang chen por gnas pa dang /bong steg bzang por grags pa dang /spro ba mang ba dang /tshe ring ba dang /grags pa dang ldan pa dang /bde ba mang ba ste/dge slong dag 'di ni de bzhin gshegasapa'i gzugs bas byed pa'i gang zag sbyin pa po'i phan yon dang po yin no//zhes sogs phan yon lnga rgyas par gsungs shing /mdor na dkon mchog gsum gyi pho brang brtsig pa/rten bzheng ba de dag la rnyed bkur stob pa sogs kyi yon tan mdo las/bsod nams rnam smin bde ster sdug bsngal thams cad sel//bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yi bsam pa rnams kyang 'grub//bdud bcoms nas ni byang chub myur du reg par 'gyur//mya ngan las 'das zhi ba sil ba'i dngos po thob//284na jis bka' stsal

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo 4nga rgya ma༅ gsung tsom/ (sheba'i rdo rje'i gsung nam yang slu ba med de/ting 'dzin rgyal po las/zla ba skar mar bcasapa gnasalhung zhing //ri dang grong du bcasapa'i sazhig la//nam mkha'i khamasani rnam pa gzhan gyur kyang /khyod ni mi bden pa yi tshig mi gsung//zhes rgyu dge ba bsags pa'i 'brasabu rnam smin dkar po 'dzag pa la som nyi dang bral ba'i yid la dga' bde'i ṣi nge 'dzin brtan po lhur bya'o//chosadakar snye ma dang bral sbun pa tsam//'phyar la 'brasa'adod byisapa'i sor mo yis//chu nang ri bong can gzugasa'adzin pa'i ched//dka' thub e raṇ+ḍayi snying po bzhin//dkon chog gsum la ri mor bya ba'i blos//mtha' klasamachod sbyin nyer spel bsod namasagazi//ma bzod gzhan 'phrul gnasakyi bdag po de//mya ga khang bur lusamed tshul du yib//rang nyid gcig pu'i ched min mkha' mnyam don//tshogasabasags musti ka yi char chen po//'dir ni gtogasaso cog rnamasaskye ba mā/'bab pa'i 'khri shing gnyisapar 'gyur bar shog/blo bzang gragasasnyan 'bar ba'i bstan pa dang //de 'dzin skyesabu sder bcasabla nasablar//'phel ba'i phung pos lha lam gas pa'i lto//mtha' klasabagrangasabya'i gu tshigasamasa'aching shog/me long gdongagirnam par thar pa'i khrims//drang por srong ba'i sadabang chab srid kun//bskal gzhan pha mtha'i rgya mtshor bsnyeg nus pa'i//sngon med dza hu'i bu mo deng 'grub shog/bkra shisakho lag rdzogasapa mig stong can//bshol med dga' mar brtse ba'i bde ba che//284brkog tu myong ba chosabazang 'dun samākhud mngagru blangasarna bar legasa'ajebasashog/dbyangasabadun mgrin par 'brol nasasrasabacasargyal//mchod sprin nam mkha' mdzod kyi rjesa'agro mkhan//dbu mdzad blo bzang yon tan 'di snang du//rdzogasaldan nyamasamyong byang chen myur thob shog/lusabaskyed khyi skyag bkrashisadabang mo zhes//drin lan gzhal bar dka' ba'i pha ma zung //myang 'dasade srid sim bstan 'bad med du//yongs rnyed gro bzhin skyesakyi spun zlar shog/bsod namasaldid kyi kun bzod rngul ba'i chu//'jig rten gsum gyi 'gram par 'dzag pa'i rgyur//skye 'phagasatshogasakyi dge dang lhan cigatu//bsngosapasagatan bde'i bzhin rasachesadakar shog/cesadabu mdzad blo bzang phun tshogs kyi 'bad pa chen posachos 6

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag yonasde bkra shis bde chen gyi mgon khang ka gnyis ma ma gtogs gtsug lag khang kun dga' ra ba dang bcas pa gsar bskrun/ /bris 'bur gyi rten bzhengs/ gnam rgyan/ 'phan/ ting sbug chol sogs mchod rdzas gsar sbyor dang bcas pa legs par grub skabs dkar chag dgos tshul ltar deb ther ut+pa la'i chun po 'di ni za hor gyi rigs las sdom brtson sde snod gsum pa 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen du 'bod pas rab byung bcu gcig pa'i nang tshan stod 'grel ba kā la dhu ti zhes dus kyi pho nyar grags pa sa pho rta'i lo nyin mor byed pa seng ge'i khyim du spyod pa'i phyogs snga ma rgyal ba dang po'i tshes la rgyal khab chen po po ta lar (285na〉sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag rig smra ba lcang gseb pa bstan 'dzin dbang pos bgyis pa ya thā sarba pra ṇi dha ni rā bho gsu shri ya pra la/rab byung bcu gcig pa'i sa lug lor deb ther du bkod pa'i sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur gsar du bzhengs pa'i dkar chag smon lam dang / sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho khri 'don skabs rten gtso khag la tham phud phul ba'i kha byang sogs/rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i rnga gnyer rnams la gser rnga che 'bring chung gsum rtsis sprad pa'i de ge ther gyi 'go brjod dmodagyes pa'i sgra dbyangs/ /) sdeb sbyor 47 pa'i brit+ta la me rta ge 'phreng can/ (re rma dh+wa to rmā hā shrī su ri rga rtso kā bhi pra yaṃ tso da tai dze ma dho r+ṣa bā rkaḥ/ /ga rdza pe ro tsa ka je raṃ dza bla ga rba dha du smo sa bhā bā gra ro t+pā dza gaḥ/chos kyi dbyings nas dpal chen lha tshogs rnams/ /thugs dam bskul ba'i brjid ldan rol mo'i sgra/ /g.yu 'brug mgrin dbyangs nyer 'khrol bsnyems 'phrog rnga/ /srid pa'i rtse mor sgrog pa mchod pa'i mchog /ljon shing zlum por 'khyil ba gzhi 'jam ngos/ /dbang gi mdangs ldan pad rā ga zhun ma'i —357

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)gzi//gser sbyangs ri mo'i 'od bkrag rab rgyas mthar//drag byed rlon pa'i g.yang gzhi nye bar bsdams//'chad gzung pad+ma'i 'dab ma kha sbyar ba'i/khung zhe gos stod 285bskyod rgya mdud rtsa ba dang //rked par chu skyes rab bzhad je phra'i snar//mi 'gyur rdo rje phyed pa'i mtshan mas mdzes bzo dbyibs gcig tu nyer mtshungs che chung dang //bar mas khyad par byas pa mtshams 'dzin grangs//gas grums skyon dang de bral rnam 'byed pa'i//deb ther legs nyes bzhin gsal me long ltar//a 'dus ka phreng ldan pa'i yi ge la//ming tshig brjod pa yongs su tshang ba'i gtam//mi bskyud yid kyis gsosasu rtsi sman gyi/ /med byung ljon pa'i dri bsung 'di na 'thul/ /zhes tshigs su bcad de phan bde legasabashad gling pa'i rnga gnyer rnams la gser rnga che 'bring chung gsum gyi rigs rnams rtsis sprad pa'i brjed byang deb ther du bkod pa la/'tshams sprin bla gos sbubs kyis ma sgrib ngo mtshar mtshan dpe nyer gsal ba/phyag mthil 'khor lo rnam par bkra rjes nam mkha'i mtha' snyeg lus can gtsug/nye ring med par gsal ba'i ri mo mig gsum pas kyang dbye nus skabs//yongs bral nyi ma'i gnyen gyi slar yang srid 'khyams 'gro dbugs dbyung la spyon/ /thub gsung mdo rgyud dka' ba'i gnad kyi mdud/ /rnam dpyod sor mos 'grol la skal bzang 'di'i//'dren pa stong gi lung rtogs gcig bsdus pa//btsong kha pa zhes snyan grags srid gsum 'bar/ /rgyal kun mkhyen dngos 'phrog pa'i chom rkun mar/ /mtha' klas 'khor 'das yon tan nya gang bar/khri4la dpung par 'dzum steng glegs ral can//bdag blo'i rmongs mun sel cig ngag gi lha//dkar 'jam lus phra smin ma'i nags klung 286na ) g.yo//mchu sgros rgod ma kha yis chags pa'i mtsho//skem byed dri za'i bu mos sor gdub sgra//'brol bzhin bdag yid gzhen nur 'khril sbyor mdzod//'chi med jamakhyen dpyod pad dkar ze'u 'bru las/legs sbyar sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyis snying myos pas//brda sprod gzhung brgya'i glu dbyangs len mkhas pa//'phags yul paṇa chen rnam thar yid kyi gsos//gangs can skad gnyis smra ༷'i nags klung dbus/khong dpang tsan dan ljon

sku gsung thugs rten gsar spu gos dang rin po che'i ma rdzo rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag (mapa'i ga bur dang //rmodzas mun bcil la 'dren mdzad thugs rje dpal//stag tshang lo tswa'i snyan pasabadag yid phyogs//chos skyong bzang po'i ma dros chu gter las//tha snyad rig pa'i klung chen phyogs bzhi sa/nyer babs mi shes dri bkrus rjes 'brangs drin//gzhal bar stong gsum gser gyis bkang des min//tsan+d+ra go mi lcang lo rin ོ gyi//do shal ring po'i gzugs gzhan yongs bsgyur nas//ljongs 'dir don gyi paṇa chen smon 'gro ba//brtan pa'i 'khor lo'i khengs pa da gdod phyogs//ngag dbang blo gter bum bzang lto ba sa/legs bshad rgya mtsho bskyed pa tshangs sras ma//mgrin bzhugasab 'ad pa'i rdo rje 'jam dbyangs lha//dga' ba'i bshes gnyen dus kun dge legs sne stsol//zhes pa 'di yang bya rigs gdung gi mngon mtho rnam gling paṇa chen dkon chog chos grags kyi slob ma ri bo chos gling pa ngag dbang chos grub rtses dang du legs sbyar gyi bshad pa byed pas rkyen byas//rig gnasapa spyi la phan phyir slob 286brko pon nyid kyis bskul ba ltar snyan dngags mkhan tshangs sras bshad pa'i rdo rjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs so//sdeb sbyor 47yo' brit+ta las me rtag phreng tso/nga lar chu: skye sha hra dra sma ha ste tsa pad+ma su swā la kya mā yi ya gaḥ/hā tu kā ho byu hai mā /shi kya su ba k+ṇi gag rkye spro hi dh+wa nub ༷ tra da bde ldan gnas nas gar dbang thugs rje'i zer//phyag na pad+ma'i mtha' wa ma'i 'phrul//ngo mtshar zhing gi bkod pa med byung ba//ka shi /dngos mkha' la 'ja' bzhin bkra//gos dkar nyer spungs chos sdomadzes pa'i rgyan//kun dga' ra ba'i yang rtse'i ldebs bris tshogos//pra phab lta bur gyis zhes mi yi bdag/blo bzang sbyin pa'i legs mdzad cha las bsgrun//sman thang ring lugs rjes zhugs pir thogs kyi//rnam dpyod sor mo'i 287na khol rtsed 'phrul po che/ /du mas sgyu ma'i khengs pa bag zha nas/ /rang gzugs mngon sum gsal bar ston nam snyam//ga sgo'i yab gcig bzhin du ches dkar ri//ston mtshan zla ba stong gisa'abyud pas kyang //'gran pa'i skabs bral dge legs ro bda'i zas//byang chub snying po'i bar du myong bar shog/ru bzhi bod kyi rgyal khams 'di nyid na/9/mes dbon rnam gsum bzhed sa yongs smin

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)te/ /rdzogs ldan dga' ston dngos la longs spyod pa'i/ /phun tshogs dpal gyis dus kun khyab par shog /ces sa skyong 'phrin las rgya mtshos kun dga' ra ba bskrun pa'i nyi 'od kyi 'khor yug tu ngo mtshar ba'i zhing bkod sna tshogs phyogs gcig tu bris pa las/ sa pho rta'i lo sa skyong blo bzang sbyin pas bris thang du 'god pa'i khur blangs tshe rag kha a bar dang chos mdzad bkra shis kyis dbu mdzad/ byings gras dkon chog /bsod nams rgyal po/ tshangs pa/ lags rta mgrin/ 'jam dbyangs don grub/dgos bsam/ chos rje brag logs pa/ byams pa mthar phyin/ rkos pa/ blo bzang / 'bag lhug/dbang phyug /chos skyong / grags pa/ bsod nams/ u rgyan/ dge bsnyen rgyal po/ 'phrin las/ dge bsnyen/ tshe ring bsam grub/ skya 'bal/ blo bzang / tshon mdangs gser ris kyi lag g.yor du mkhyen lugs dbu mdzad tshe 'phel/ /dbu chung byams pa rgyal mtshan/ /byings gras bsod nams mgon po/bkra shis tshe ring / do dam pa rag kha blo bzang rnams kyis byas (287ba〉〉 bzhengs pa'i gtso thang rgyab yig tu za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge slong 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa sirnyi ra stu/swa sti/ dad ldan rgyal ba don grub kyis gser zho phyed nyis brgya las grub pa'i maṇ+ḍal g.yu phra can chos lung tshogs par phul ba sa rta spyi tshogs nas ring 'tsho'i rten du bstar ba mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab kyi zhu phul gyis rkyen dang gtso bor sa skyong blo bzang sbyin pas lhag bsam dag pas drangs te sde pa nyid kyi sor tshad bcu drug cher bskyed/ /gsar snon gser zho nyis brgya dang phyed bco lnga/ g.yu phra rnying pa mi legs pa rnams bzhag pa'i bzhi brgya don bdun gyi steng du gsar snon chig brgya re gcig /rgya mu tig sran ma tsam chig brgya nga bdun/ byu ru rgya sran tsam chig brgya nyi shu rtsa bdun rnams bskrun pa'i do dam 'phan yul dbu ma pa dang gting skyes tshe dbang lhun po/ dzñā na mu ni/ rgyal po des rkyen las/ mu ni/ dzñā na tsā spro/ bra ma las/ dgos byed sprod mi a dar sbus srang nga gnyis so/ /kun bzang mchod sprin yongs 'dus maṇ+ḍal/ /phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i spyi rdzas su/ /sa skyong blo bzang sbyin pa'i rnam dpyod mthus/ /spel 'dis srid zhi'i legs tshogs dar bar shog /ces —360

sku gsung thug rten gsar 4khog dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag khu'ipa'ang za hor gyi brnyes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pas bgyis pa dza / / /nges gsang theg pa'i dge 'dun dkon cog gi /mchod rdzas ljon shing phur ma skol ba'i snod/ /rin chen sna lnga bzhu blugs rab 'khyil (28ni sgo sbo/ /phun tsho gos 'dod dgu'i gter gyur yol go 'di/ /rnam par rgyal ba phan bde'i legs lam gyi/ /'byung gnas bshad sgrub gling gi gnyer ba'i las/ /nyer 'dzin res son ngag dbang smon lam gyis/ /rnam dag bsam pas ched du yongs bskrun dges/ /bstan 'gro'i bde skyid yar ngo'i zla ba ltar/ /rab 'phel tshul 'dir lus ngag yid gsum pa/ /'bad rnamasasrid par lha mi'i dpal la spyod/ /ring min bla med byang chub 'thob par shog zhes tshogs khro 'dod dgu 'khyil ba'i rgyur zangs khal nyi shu dang bsha' dkar khal gcig nyag bco lnga song ba sa lug gnyer pa ngag dbang smon lam gyis khur blangs te/ bzo bo dbu mdzad dgos pa rdo rje/ sangs rgyas rdo rje/ dar po/skyon nor bu/ bsam grub nor bu/ dgos pa bkra shis rnams kyis bgyis nas bskrun pa'i kha byang dgosatshul ltar za hor gyi brjes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pas bgyis pa dza / /gnam gyi she mong dpung pa'i rgyal khab kyi/ khor yug grong khyer las 'ongs btung ba'i rtse/ /med byung ro brgya skol snod rin wo khro/ /ngag dbang smon lam 'bad pas nyer blugs mthus/ /bdud las rnam par rgyal bas gnas skabs dang / /mthar thug phan bde'i legs nor bshad sgrub kyis/ /nyer 'dren rig sngags 'amang ba'i gling chen po/ /sdebazhi'i dpal gyis ma ho par mtho bar shog /gangasacan nor 'dzin rab yangs sto ba sa /skyid pa'i sa(288ba)bon dar drag 'dzam bu'i ljon/ /kun tu dga' ba gser gyi snye ma la/ /longs spyod skal bzang bkra shis dpal 'bar shog /ces tshogos khro ro brgya'i dpal 'dzin gyi rgyur zangs khal nyi shu dang bsha' dkar khal gcig nyag bco lnga song ba sa lug gnyer pa ngag dbang smon lam gyis khur blangs te bzo pa dbu mdzad dgos pa rdo rje/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje/dar po/ skyon nor bu/ bsam 'grub nor bu/ dgos pa ba po shis rnams kyis bgyis nas bskrun pa'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi ban des sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pas bgyis pa o —361—

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)a thā/srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor ma lus pa/rab 'khyil rin chen sna tshogs 'dus pa'i khro//rkang 'thung phur ma'i re bcud pad rā ka mdangs//skyabs gnas dkon mchog rnam gsum mchod pa'i snod//nges gsang 'dus pa'i gling gi spyi rdzas su//ngag dbang smon lam 'bad pas bskrun pa'i mthus//deng nas bla med byang chub ma thob par//bde skyid tshor ba rtag tu myong bar shog/ces sa lug gnyer pa ngag dbang smon lam gyis khur blangs bzo bo dbu mdzad dgos pa rdo rje/ sangs rgyas rdo rje/ dar po/skyon nor bu//bsam grub nor bu//dgos pa bkra shis rnams kyis bgyis te//rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling pa'i tshogs khro srid zhi'i dpal 'byor 'khyil pa blug pa'i bzo rgyur zangs khal gcig dang bsha' 289na ji kar khal bzhi song ba'i kha byang dgos tshul ltar za hor gyi ban+desasbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni grong smad pa sangs rgyas kyis bgyis pa la smyi bha / /gtsang byed pad+ma'i sbubs su rgyal kun gyi//mkhyen brtse nus pa bzhu blugs 'khyil ba'i spu/rgyags//ngo ma' sprul sku'i zlos gar rdo rje lang //iṇ+ḍi ya na'i slob dpon khyod ṣ+ka bsngags//gcig las du ma'i cho 'phrul rol pa'i mtshan//rnam grangs brgyad par 'phags bod kun grags kyang //gaṅgā'i rlung rdul des kyang mtshon min pa//mkha' khyab mkha' yi rdo rje'i mtha' rnyed su//waṃ yig mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba che//nyer 'dren e dbyibs stong chen phyag rgya mar//legs shar 'tsho rgyal gnas gsum ḍā ki'i gtsor//nges la dbang rnon chos rjes gong bas dad//gsang chen gdams pa'i nying khu gnam skasanas//klu bdud sto ba'i zab gter thod 'phreng rtsal//dngos mjal lung ston byed nus gsang ba 'dus/'dren byed gsung sprul chos kyi dbang phyug rgyal//dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dga' ston yar tshes bcur//'phrin las byang bu dang 'brel gar 'tshams dbyangs/ /'dzam gling rgyan gcig pho brang sne sdong rtse'i/ /phyag bzhes snyan grags dbyar rnga'i rjes su 'gro//de'i tshul dpyad gsum yongs dag shing rta che//sngagasa'achang yongs kyi 'khor dro rgyal gtso//kun ༷zang rtse pa'i dgongs bzhed ma nyams 'dis//rnam

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag 6yidag rgyud srol byed pos 'dzin 25ba thaba'i na//de phyir sgo gsum gcig dril sbyangs 'bras rnams//bskyud par 'phangs te don bzang mu thi la//tshig sbyor dar gyi srad bur yong rgyus nas//gzur gnasablo ldan mgrin pa'i a du sbud//gyer sgom tshig dang ting 'dzin zung 'brel nas//bde gshegs zhi khro'i stang stabs rol pa'i gar//skyon mkha' 'gro'i gling du legs bsgyur ba//rtsa gsum dgyes bskyed kun bzang mchod sprin che//gang dran rnam 'gyur ya ma zung gi chas//'ja' tsho ni gur la byis pa'i sbar 'dzin bzhin//spyad na snying po med pa spre'u'i gar/khrom gseng bsgyur ba'i grangs su 'di mi 'dren//yar ngo'i dus kyi ma rdzo par bod 'bangs don//dngos 'byon zhal la tshes slob dpon pad+ma yang //sgrub wen rtsod bral gter ston chos dbang zhabs//brgyud par bcas pa'i ba ched srol mchog tu med//rgyal khab chen po'i 'dun sar tshes bcu'i khrigs//dpal ldan kun bzang rtse pa'i dag ther gyis//mig dang rna ba'i bdud rtsi rgya mtsho cher//ri bo bsgril la ma bltos 'di ko mtshar//nor skyong mjug spu bal dang chabs cig par/ /'chags pa'i mthong tshad lag bstar ras spyod mkhan/ /mang por mi ston rgya yis nyer btab ste//dpal mgon ma ning nag pos rak+ṣa n+tu //yid ches shing rtas dge tshogs dbang gi rgyal//drangs pas phyogs 'dir sgo gsum 'bad pa rnams//mtsho skyes rdo rjes deng nas tshe rabs 290na thun//rjes bzung 'di phyi'i mdun ma lhun grub shog/nye ring bral yang zangs mdog dpal ri nas//thugs rje'i gzigs pas bod yul mi gtong bar//zhal bzhes phan bde'i gser gyi snye ma la//rtag par longs su spyod pa'i bkra shis shog/de'ang sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad+ma thod 'phreng rtsal gyis yar ngo'i tshes bcu la dngos su 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dus chen la nyams su blang bya'i bla ma zhi drag gi las byang ches mang ba'i nang nas gsang 'dus bla ma sgrub pa dang 'brel ba las byang le'u brgyad mar sman lung chos ldan pas choge khrigs mdzad pa de nyid khungs btsun zhing //cho ga'i khrigasadang bstun khar 'chams dbyangs rol rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes dar rgyas che'ang sgar skor ba rnams kyis skyen khyad sogs khrom pa mgo skor sdi lhad che bar/pho brang chen po sne'u sdong rtser gong ma

rgyal dbang lnga pangag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shechen po tshes gnyis rin po che ngag gi dbang phyug gi dus phyag len gnang bar dpal zi na kun bzang rtse pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang /chosakyi dbang phyug sogasakyisarnam par dag pasagatan la phab pa'i rgyun ma nyams pa las rab byung bcu gcig pa'i lcags pho khyi'i lo dbu mdzad rin chen bzang po can la rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legasabashad gling gra tshogasakyi zhib tu sbyangs nas phyag len gyi rgyun btsugasaskabs/'chamasadapon dge slong blo bzang legasaldan/chosarje blo bzang pad+ma/sngagasaramasapa blo bzang skyes mchog/290bgram pa dge slong blo bzang ngag dbang bzhisamatshan brgyad kyi stang stabs la zhus legs par dag 'dug par bzo skyar ma dgos kyang slar don grub ces pa sa mo lug gi lo 'chams dpon gram pa ba dge slong blo bzang ngag dbang rta lam sgang pa ngag dbang skal bzang /lha sangag dbang dkon mchog/brag gdong sngagasaramasapa blo bzang tshe dbang /gong dkar pa blo bzang bsod namasalngasachos rje dkon gnyer dpon po rin chen bzang po slar yang gtugasapa'i 'chams dbyangs byings la dbu mdzad dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i zin brisasteng nasakyang zhus legasapar dag pa'i 'chamasayig ngo mtshar 'phrul snang dang /dbyangasayig mkhasapa'i mgul rgyan bris 'dug pa'i mgo mjug gi tshigs bcad dgos tshul byung ba ltar za hor gyi ban+des sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngagasarams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyisabagyis par sarba dwa gre ya bha wan+tu/dza ya paṇ+ḍita kho gruthur lung lamakyi /ma ga byin tshe tham phud 'bul tshig gi bskul ma byung bltar bkod pa'i 'phrin lasarabayangs/thun mtshamasari mo rab 'bar tham ga'i phud //'dzam gling rgyan gcig shākya mu ni yi//spyan sngar phul bsabasod namasagadh+wa'i rgyun//byang chen zla ba'i ma mar rtagasa'abab shog/ching gisaganam gyi brgyud 'dzin rgyal rigasakyi//mnga' 'bangs rgyu skar 'phreng mdzesabasnyeg pa'i 'gro//thar lam nyer 'khrid 'phrin lasashing rta yi/kha lo 'khor ba ji srid bsgyur nusashogakhamasagasum cha29na chosakyi rgyal po btsong kha pa'i//bstan pa yongasa'adu'i phang phung 'dab ma'i grib//bsil por yid can mtha' dag sim tshor la//ci dgar spyod pa'i byed por bdag byin rlobs//64

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhongs dang rin po che'i mchod jos khang bzang gi dkar chag yonasdeb sbyor mnya pa'i phrit+ta las zlum po/dzñā na tsā33khri mā la su ra khas mi mas twa tsa rgyu3s na su bhā lha kurba nanemahā mos:ti mi ṣa su bhā ba ma na ci lta brtanā nu ka spa/〉tsā dra ṇa pra su da hā yahi tas ba su rlang:hi6lo ka bhā ba shākyarwa dza/e ma kun mkhyen ye shes dngas mtsho me mkha' mnyam yid can zla ba'i gzugs//rang bzhin med kyang kun rdzob brdzun snang 'phrul po che des srid lam du//'phyan par brtse ldan thugs bskyed skya rengs dad pa'i rta ljang gis 'dren na//phan bde'i nyi 'od 'jig rten gsum khyab snang bar mdzod cig shākya'i rgyal//'khor lo'i ri mo rab 'bar zhabs kyi rdul//gtsug tu lhungs pa'i mod la thog mtha' bar//dge mtshan bye bas nor 'dzin dpal mo'i mngal//291brko pyid kyis rngul ba'i bkra shis dga' ston stsol//phun tsho gos g.yas su 'khyil ba mgrin pa'i dung //chos phung sgra snyan thos 'dzin mun mal nas//slong byed sngon med nor bu'i rna rgyan che//lha mi'i bsod nams mchod sdong phyag bya'i gnas//rnam gsum 'khor lo bka' bsdudage 'dun gyi//mdzad bzang phyag rjes pu sta ka 'phreng las//gangs ljongs rab bsgyur yig gzugs bde dag par/ /bde skyid srog gi zungs song legs byas 'bras/ /mthong thosadran reg don ldan tso gsung la//ri mor bgyis pa'i chos dkar phung po'i tshad//chu ga kho a mra'i tshig gus 'jal 'dra ba'i//dka' thub mes po des kyang ga la bzod//zang zing gtong phod ma dros sto ba sa/sde snod rgyud sde'i chu klung rnam pa bzhi//'dzin nus dge ba'i rgyun bzang thar pa'i grong //zla ba'i ma mar 'phab de su yis bzlog/snyan po gtam gyi rgyud mangs rna ba yi//bdud len phyogs 'dir 'gyur ro cog gi bka'//gsar bskrun deb ther yid la dad pa'i sos//'chi med skyed tshal gnyisapa deng 'dir spel/ /zhes shis brjod/phyag bya/ /dngos po nges bstan gsum gyi sgo nas tshigs su bcad pas sngun bsus nas 'o skol gyi ston pa sgrib gnyis ma lus par spangs pa/yon tan mtha' dag mngon du mdzad pa/sa gsum gyi sgron me gcig pu thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge bskal pa grangs med pa'i sngon rol nas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rlabs po che 292nabasags nas chos gzugs kyi sku gnyis mngon du ༷dzad de 'og min zhing gi gtso bor nges pa lnga dang

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2sheldan pa'i longs spyod rdzogs sku las g.yo ba med bzhin du mchog gi sprul pa'i skur 'tshang rgya tshul bstan pa/ snying rje pad+ma dkar po nas bskal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas stong dang lnga/ gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa sogs kyi mdo sder sangs rgyas stong du gsungs pa las/ de'ang sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir bskal pa chen po 'dzin pa zhes bya ba la gling bzhi pa 'di nyid du 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud la mig mi 'dzum la sogs pa'i sras stong / rgyal phran brgyad khri bzhi stong la sogs pa mnga' ba'i mdun na 'don gyi gtso bo bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul la srasabargyad cu/ slob ma bram ze stong dang bcas pa mnga' ba las/ de'i sras bram ze rgya mtsho'i snying po sangasargyas pa'i mtshan de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen snying po la rgyal pos zla ba gsum gyi bar dang / sras rgyal bu stong gis zla ba gsum gsum bsnyen bkur byas te lo nyis brgya lnga bcu dang zla ba gsum 'das pa na/ yab bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyis lo bdun du bsnyen bkur byas chos mnyan nas rmi lam brtagasapas rgyal po rtsibs kyi mu khyud stag la sogs pa gcan gzan gdug pa can gyi srog chags kyis gsod par gyur pa dang / blon po kha cig shing rta bde ba la zhon nas lam gol bar 'dong ba la sogs pa rmis te sangs rgyas la zhus pas/ rgyal po rgyal srid (292ba)la chags shing mi dge ba la spyad pasang na song dang 'khor bar lung bstan/ blon po de dag to rang du lung bstan/ gas mang po byang chub wo por 'gyur ro zhes lung bstan te/ /de nas bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi rgyal po chen po la/ /rgyal po chen po mir gyur pa'ang rnyed par dka'/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du 'byung ba'ang rnyed par dka'/ dam pa'i chos nyan pa'ang rnyed par dka'i bla na med pa'i byang chub thugs skyed cig ces bskul pas/ rgyal pos/ kho bo bla na med pa'i byang chub tu 'tshang rgya bar mi 'dod do/ /zhes rgyu mtshan dang bcas par smra zhing sems bskyed du ma 'dod pa la/ bram zes lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du bskul pas/ sangs rgyas pa'i sangasargyas kyi zhing bzang po byung na bskyed do/ /zhes khas blangs/ de nas de bzhin gshegs pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' klas pa bstan pas rgyal po'ang dad de lo bdun gyi bar du rang rang gi khang par sangs —366

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag 9yirgyas kyi zhing bzung ba'i ched du sems par byed cing / bram zes srog chags mang po dge ba rgya chen po la bkod/ mthar rgyal po sras 'khor rnams lhas bskul ba ltar sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar sems bskyed pas rgyal po bde ba can du sangs rgyas tshe dpag med/ bu thu bo mig mi 'dzum ni ston pa 'das pa'i 'og 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa dpal brtsegs kyi rgyal po/ pho bo 'das pa'i 'og tu gnyis pa mthu chen thob ni rab tu brtan pa yon tan nor bu brtsegs pa'i (293na)rgyal po/ gsum pa 'jam dpal ni sangs rgyas kyi nyid dag pa rdul bral yang dag brtsegs su sangs rgyas kun gzigs/ bzhi pa ni kun tu bzang po/ lnga pa ni sangs rgyas pad+ma dam pa/ drug pa ni dbang sgyur dbang phyug rgyal po/ bdun pa ni snang ba rdul bral spos mtho dbang phyug rgyal po/ brgyad pa ni ye shes rdo rje rnam par skrungs pa'i dbang phyug /de nas bar 'dir srog chags khri sangs rgyas su lung bstan nas/ dgu pa mi 'khrugs pa/ bcu pa gser gyi me tog /bcu gcig pa rgyal ba'i zla ba ste rgyal bu stong tshang bar lung bstan/ de nas rgyal phran brgyad khri bzhi stong dang srog chags dung phyur phrag dgu dang bye ba phrag gnyis/ rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi sras brgyad cu/ bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi slob ma bram ze stong phrag gcig /bram ze bye ba phrag gsum lung bstan pas rnam par gzigs/ gtsur tor can/ thams cad skyob kyi bar du gyur to/ /de nas bram ze rig byed slob pa stong gi gnyis pa skar ma skyong ni bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas dang po 'khor ba 'jig/gsum pa tam bu ra ni gser thub/ bzhi pa kun gyis bsrungs ni sangs rgyas 'od srungs/ lnga pa dri med 'od ni byams pa/ de bzhin du dgu brgya go dgu'i bar du lung bstan/ bram ze'i rig byed slob pa stong gi tha ma la zhing gzung gi sems bskyed cing / thub pa stong dang bzhi'i sku tshe dang mdzad 'phrin mtha' dag 'byung bar smon lam btab par rin (293ba༄na snying pos legs so dang bcas te sangs rgyas gsal mdzad du lung bstan/ de nas bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi thugs la rgyal po sogs man ngag gi sems bskyed cing zhing dag pa yang bzung zin pas da ni bdag gis sems bskyed par bya'o snyam du dgongs te zhing ma dag pa mi mjed kyi zhing sems can ma rungs pa mi dge ba bcu tshang —367

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (shebar spyod pa/mtshams med pa lnga byed pa shin tu gdul dka' ba rnams la thugs rjes lhag par gzigs nas smon lam chen po lnga brgya btab ste bden pa'i stobs brjod pas/sangs rgyas rin chen snying pos legs so gnang ste/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis brtson 'grus brtsams pa ni bzhi ste/sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma dag par smon pa dang /zhes pa la sogs pa dang /khyod ni pad+ma dkar po lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa'o//gzhan ni me tog lta bu'i byang chub sems pa'o//zhes sogs bsngags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa brjod de bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas bzhi pa shākya thub par lung bstan/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis skyes bskur/lha dang mi'i skye rgu thams cad kyis mchod pa'i bskal pa bzang po de'i sangs rgyas su gyur pa la/mdo sde bskal bzang du sangs rgyas re re'i yul dang rigs dang 'od dang yab dang sras dang rim gro pa dang shes rab can dang rgyas la can gyi mchog gnyis dang /'khor 'dus pa dang sku tshe 294na ) dang bstan pa gnas pa'i tshad dang /sku gdung ste mchog zung so sor bgrangs pa'i don bcu gsum bcu gsum gyis bstan cing /kha cig gi gdung smosate bcu bzhi'o//'khor 'dus pa'ang kha cig la re re dang kha cig la mang po dang /sku gdung la rgyas par 'gyur ba dang ril po gcig tu 'dug pa gnyis so//ston pa 'di la dper brjod na/mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po nga skye ba'i yul ni ser skya'i gnas zhes bya'o//rigs ni rgyal po'i rigs so//gdung ni go ta ma'o//'od ni 'dom gang ngo //yab ni zlas gtsang ma zhes bya'o//yum ni sgyu 'phrul zhes bya'o//srasani sgra gcan 'dzin zhes bya'o//rim gro pa ni kun dga' bo zhes bya'o/shes rab can rnams kyi mchog ni nye rgyal zhes bya'o//rgya 'phrul can rnams kyi mchog ni pang na skyes zhes bya'o//khrus pa dang po la ni dge slong stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'o/sku tshe'i tshad ni lo brgya'o//dam pa'i chos ni lo lnga brgya'i bar du gnas so//lo lnga brgya'i bar du ni dam pa'i chos ltar snang ngo //sku gdung ni rgyas par 'gyur ro/zhesagasungs pa ltar/gling 'dir mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul bstan pa'i nang nas gtso bor gyur pa/tshomasalas/thub rnams sdig pa chu yis mi 'khru zhing //'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gis mi sel la//nyid kyi 8

sku gsung thugasarten gsar bakho dang rin po za mar rdza khang 4nga gi dkar ga shā'irtogasapa gzhan la spo min te//chosanyid bden pa bstan pasagrol bar 'gyur//zhesa'agro ba'i rgyud kyi sdig pa'i dri ma chus 'khru ba 294bdang de'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal tsher ma phyag gis dbyung ba dang rang rgyud kyi rtogasapa gdul bya'i rgyud la gnasa'apho ba lta bu ma yin par khamasadang dbang por 'tsham pa'i chosabastan nas rnam par grol ba'i lam 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir/sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin lasamatha' dag skye rgu rnamasal sman yon du 'gyur ba sha stag yin kyang /thams cad mkhyen pa btsong kha pa chen pos//mdzad pa kun lasagasung gi ni//mdzad ba mchog yin de yang ni//'di nyid yin phyir mkhasapa yis//'di lasasangasargyasarjesadran byos//zhes gsung gi mdzad pa nyid mchog tu bsngags shing /de'ang yul wa ra ṇa sir drang srong lhung ba ri dwags kyi nagasasu lnga sdesogasagadul bya nyan thosakyi rigasacan la bka' dang po bden pa bzhi'i chosa'akhor bskor/gnas bya rgod phung po'i rir 'khor stong nyisabargya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun/dge slong ma dang /dge bsnyen ma dang /byang chub semasadapa' khrag khrig brgya stong la bar pa mtshan nyid med pa'i chosakyi 'khor lo bskor/gnasayangs pa can sogasasu byang chub semasadaba'i 'khor la tha ma legasapar rnam par phye ba'i chosakyi 'khor lo ste rim pa gsum du bskor bar yongs su gragasapa/ji skad du/zab zhi sprosabral 'od gsal 'dusam byas//bdud rtsi lta bu'i chosashig kho bos rnyed//su la bstan kyang go bar mi nusapas//mi smra nagasa'adab tshal du gnasapar bya//zhes295nazhag zhe dgu'i bar thugasalas chung ngu chos mi gsung ba lta bu thun mong gi snang ngo dang rjes su 'brel ba'i chos 'khor la thog mtha' bar gsum gyi rnam gzhag bstan pa las ngesapa'i don du bde bar gshegs pas chos mi gsung ba'i skabasani cung zad kyang med la/dam pa'i chosade'ang /shesarab sgron me'i rgya cher 'grel pa las/bstan pa zhes bya ba ni/lha dang mi bdud rtsi'i go 'phang thob par 'dod pa rnamasayongs su shes par bya ba dang spang bar bya ba dang mngon sum du bya ba dang bsgom par bya ba dag la phyin ci ma log par ston pa ste bcom ldan 'dasakyi gsung rab ces bya ba yin no//zhes bden pa bzhi'i tshul 69

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)phyin ci ma log par nyams su bstar na 'khor ba las rnam par grol ba'i zhi ba'i lam brnyes par 'gyur bas/ ji skad du/ dam pa'i chos ni thog mar dge ba/ bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ yongs su dag pa/ yongs su byang ba/yang dag par mthong ba/ nad med pa/ dus chad pa med pa/ nye bar btod pa/ 'di mthong ba la don yod pa/ mkhas pa rnams kyis so sor rang gis rig par bya ba/ bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba la legs par ston pa/ nges par 'byung ba/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'gro bar byed pa/ mi mthun pa med cing 'dus pa dang ldan pa/ brten pa yod pa/ rgyu ba bcad pa'o/ zhes (295ba)byung la/ thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis legs par gsungs pa'i bka' rnamasakyang ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i phyi lo gnas rgyal po'i khab tu kun dga' bo dgra bcom par gyur ma thag pa de 'od srungs chen pos bskos nas snam sbyar lnga brgya bting ba'i steng du bzhugs nas mdo sde'i sdosnod/ de bzhin du nye bar 'khor sa 'dul ba'i sde snod/ gzhan gyis bskos pa la ma bstosapar 'od srungs chen pos mgo pa'i sde snod de bka' bsdu dang po mdzad/ /ston pa mya ngan las 'dasanas lo brgya dang bcu song ba na yangs pa can du dgra bcom pa grags pa la sogs pa bdun brgyas mi rung ba'i gzhi bcu sun dbyung ba'i ched du dge 'dun rnams kyis sde snod gsum zhal 'don dang /bkra shis pa'i gso sbyong mdzad nas bka' gnyis pa bsdus/ bdud sdig can gyi sprul pa dge slong bzang pos chos log bstan pa'i rkyen gyis sde pa bco brgyad nang phan tshun gyi rtsod pa byung ba zhi nas yang dag par 'god pa'i slad du sangs rgyas gshegs nas lo bzhi brgya na/ yul mnyan yod du byang chub sems dpa' lnga brgya dang / dgra gcom pa lnga brgya/ so so'i skye bo'i paṇ+ḍita khri drug stong ste khri bdun stong gis mi brjed pa'i gzungs ma thob pa rnams kyi don du glegs bam yi ger bris pa sogs bka' bsdu gsum pa mdzad de/ 'phags pa'i yul du dar rgyas che bar bzhugs pa las/ yul phyogs gzhan du 'phel tshul ni/ lha mo dri (296na)ma med pa lung bstan pa'i mdo las/ nga yongs su mya ngan —370

sku gsung thug rten gsar bgengs dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag khomalas 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos dar bar 'gyur ro zhes pa'i don thog tu babs te/bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'dir kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa'i 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa dus las mi g.yol ba'i byed pa por bka' gdams glegs bam rin po che las/bod ni rgyal po dag la tshad maḥ 'dzin//mi dbang mdzod la bod khams bde bar skyongs//zhes pod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal po zhig la brten nas bstan 'gro'i bde skyid 'phel bar dgongs nas 'phags pa rigs gsum gyi mgon po'i ye shes sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rol gar las sprul pa'i chos rgyal rim par byon pa'i nang nas lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes pa tsam las chos bsgyur ba sogs ma byung /mnga' bdag srong btsan sgam po'i dus 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi sprul pa thu mi sam bho ṭas rgya gar nas brda sprod pa'i bstan bcos sogs la mkhas par sbyangs te bod du yi ge med pa la yi ge'i srol gto de/spyan ras gzigs kyi mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig dang /mdo sdod po zhe mchog sprin sogasachos sna 'ga' zhig bsgyur rje btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus bod kyi blo rno ba mang po la lo tsā bslabs/'phags yul nas paṇa grub du ma spyan drangs/rgyal ba'i gsung rab bsgyur ba dang bshad nyan gyis gtan la phab/dbon rgyal po khri lde gtsug 296ba ) brtan gyi dus/sgra sbyor bam po gnyis pa las/rta'i lo la bsdo po khri lde srong ba 'a pho brang skyi smad 'on cang rdo na bzhugs/stod smad kyi dmag gsar rnying rje ba dang rkun ོ gas/gar log pho lhas phyag 'tshal/blon wo po zhang khri zur ram shags dang /mar rje lha 'dod la sogs pas rgya las srid cig mang po bcad de/rnga rta dang ba mar phal mo che phyag tu phul/zhang blon chen po man chad so so'i bya dga' stsal ba'i lan la nyi 'og gi mkhan po ā tsar+ya dzi na mi tra sogs zhes pa ltar sngar yab mes rte ba'i gsung rab kyi brda rnying rnams skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab/bar skabs su bstan pa la 'phel 'grib cung zad byung yang skad gnyis smra ba rin chen bzang po dang lo chen 'byog mi gnyis nas bzung thams cad mkhyen pa zha lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po slob ma yang slob rjes 'brangs dang bcas pa'i bar gyi 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu rim

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2gepar byon pa rnams kyis gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa bsgyur zin 'chos pa dang gsar du bsgyur ba sogs bstan pa rin po che rnam par dag pa'i phyag rjes la brten/ thub pa'i gsung rab rnams phyogs gcig tu glegs bam la bsgrigs par bka' 'gyur ro cog ces mtshan gyi sgras kyang srid pa'i gdung ba mtha' dag rnam par bcil ba'i dkar chag bstan pa snga dar gyi dus ldan dkar ma dang phang thang mar grags pa dang / phyi dar la dpal snar thang du dbus pa blo gsal dang bcom (297na)ldan ral gri gnyis kyi bsgrigs pa/ mtshal pa si tu thams cad mkhyen pa dge ba'i blo gros kyi zhal bkod ma'i mtshal pa bka' 'gyur/ kun mkhyen bu ston lo tsā bas dag ther mdzad pa'i them spangs ma so gos lus can rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du bzhugs shing / de la tsho gis ji ltar gsog na/ dbusamatha' rnam 'byed las/ /yi ge 'dri mchod sbyin pa dang / /nyan dang klog dang 'dzin pa dang / /'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang / de sems pa dang bsgom pa ste/ /spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdag nyid kyi/ /bsod nams phung po gzhal du med/ zhes pa'i don tshan lnga tsam dang mthun par nyams su bstar dgos pa las/ /'phags pa'i yul du stod 'grel ba'i lugs la siṅgā ba zhes pa ljongs 'dir don grub tu bsgyur cing / gnam gyi lha 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i khab tu kyi yi zhes pa sa mo lug gi lor sde pa blo bzang mthu stobs kyis lhag bsam rnam dag gi sgo nas 'di ga'i ring 'tshor dmigs shing / sde pa dang dpon saganyis kyi shegs sel gyi rim gro dang sgrib sbyongs kyi ched du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog bris shog gdong dar glegs shing sku rags sogs dngos gtsang ba bsgrubs pa'i zhus dag pa mnga' ris gra tshang dge slong blo bzang yar 'phel/ rab 'byams pa dpal mgon/ rab stims pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/rab stims pa bstan 'dzin 'phrin las/ sto dkar ba o rgyan nor bu dang blo bzang (297ba)pad+ma/yig mkhan byings/ chos mdzad/ o rgyan phyag rdor/ sa sna khyi phrug /o rgyan bsam grub/ chos don grub/ chos 'phel/ tshe dbang dpal 'bar/ chos mdzad/ lha mgon/ o rgyan tshe dbang / spun drug /skya bo lnga 'dzom/ sum dar/ o rgyan dar rgyas/ dbang 'dzin/ brgya byin/ skya bo bsod nams nor bu/—372

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag 9'imakhas lung nor bu/ tshe ring dar rgyas/ mkhar sngon chos 'phel/ tshe ring don grub/ dgos pa bkra shis/dge bsnyen/ snar ma/ smin drug /dgos skyes/ lcags ri srid gcod/ don grub/ shong stong nor bu/lcang can ba po shis/ spel gcig rdo rje/ mthong chung bag gro/ chos skyong nyi ma/ khyi phrug /blo bzang bkrashis/ khyi phrug lha dar/ lha mo dar rgyas/ nam mkha' nor bu/ lcang can khyi khrug /chos mdzad/ lha mgon bsam grub/ a bar dgra bdul/ o rgyan dar rgyas/ bkra shis 'dzom pa/ dgos pa tshe ring chos mdzad/ 'jam dbyangs/ rgya mon chos 'phel/ chos dar/ 'jam dbyangs dgos pa/ dgra 'dul/sum dga'/ bsam grub bkra shis/ dbang grags/ lha mgon rdo rje/ tshe ring nor bu/ rta mgrin chosamadzad/ ngag dbang tshe brtan/ o rgyan tshe brtan/ blo bzang dpal ldan/ chos dbang rgyal mtshan/ lhas byin/ rgyal dkar/ dngos grub bkra shis/ nor bu bkra shis/ dpal dgos/ nor bu bkra shis/ tshe ring / nor 'phel/ bu mo bkra shis/ rgyal po bsam grub/ bkra shis rab brtan/ dngos grub/ chos 'dzoms/ dgos pa (29sha༄stan 'dzin/ 'jam dbyangs/ lha mgon/ rgyal po/ lha mgon rdo rje/lhas byin nor bu/ rab 'phel/ nor bu don grub/ rgya mon bkra shis/ bsam grub/ lha rgyal/ bsam grub dgos pa/ dbang rgyal/ bu mo bkra shis/ rgya mon nor bu/ sgam po dar rgyas/ 'dzom phrug /bstan 'dzin/ o rgyan nor 'phel/ rgya mon rab 'phel/ bu mo bsam grub/ 'jam dbyangs/ /bsam grub bkra shis/ rgyan mon bsod nams/ dngos grub nor bu/ rgya mtsho/ lha 'dzin/ 'jam dpal rdo rje/ rdo rje gzhen nu/ 'phrin las rab brtan/ o rgyan nor bu/ hor rgyal/ don grub/ bsam 'phel bsod nams nor bu/ bsod nams rab brtan/ rta mgrin rdo rje/ o rgyan phyag rdor/ dol sri thar/ bstan pa dar rgyas/ slob ma gnyis/ shog las pa o rgyan phyag rdor/ skyol sgo dar rgyas/ bu mo bkra shis/ shes rab bstan 'dzin/ cho se skyong bsam grub/ bsam grub dgos pa/ dngos grub bkra shis/ chos mdzad/bu mo bsam grub/ bsam pa don grub rnams dang / do dam chos lung pa rdo rje/ dog bde don grub/ lasabyed phun tshogs bkra shis/ dgos brtan/ o rgyan chos mtsho/ dar rgyas rnams/ gos bzo gra phyi nor —373

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (2geskyong / bsod nams don grub/ shing bzo tshe gseb dbang phyug /sngo bzo pad+ma rdo rje/ do dam bsam grub bde chen pa rgyal phur/ rgyun gyi las 'khur ba tsho gis rgyal gling pa tshe 'dzin/ khri smon pa rdo rje tshe ring /bkra shis dgon stod pa rgyal (298ba)phur/ chos tshan bzhugs byang sogs 'dri mi khang gsar 'og dngos grub/ lcags bzo tshe brtan rnams kyis bgyis pa'i bzo bo rnams bza' btung yon gyi 'dod pa rnam par 'jo ba'i bdog pa'i dngos por 'jungs pa med pa'i sgyu ma'i nor la snying por len pa ni blang dor gyi gnas la blo gros yangs pa'i ngang tshul te/ legs bshad rin po che las/ shes rab ldan pas nyes pa dag /sel bar nus kyi blun pos min/ /nam mkha' lding gis dug can sbrul/ bsad par nus kyi khā tas min/ /zhes shes rab kyi rtsal dang ldan na nyes pa thams cad thabs kyis sel bar nus pa dngos po'i gshis lugs yin pas/ ji skad du/ /chen po rnams la yon tan 'ga' /ma bslabasapar yang ngang gis 'jug /nor se'i 'phreng ldan chu chen bzhi/ /rgya mtshor 'bab pa su yis bzlog /ces pa'i don dang mtshungs shing / dpal 'byor rgya chen po dang ldan yang don ldan snying por byed pa ches dka' bas/ ji skad du/ shes rab med pa'i longs spyod kyang / /phal cher rang la phan pa nyung / 'dod 'jo'i ba yi 'o ma yang / /be'u sa 'thung ba brgya lam yin/ /blun po rnams kyis mkhas pa yang mchod par 'gyur ba'i nges pa med/ /nyi ma shin tu 'od gsal la/ /'byung po'i gdon rnams mi los sam/blon po longs spyod gsog rnams la/ /gnyen gyi bsam pa ga la yod/ /sdig sdug gtam ngan kho na yis/ /byi ba bzhin du bsags nas 'chi/ /(299na tshe tshes don log gam/ don med du zang zing gi bdog pa chud 'dza' bar byed pa mang zhing / tshul de las ldog pa ni ya rabs bzang po'i ngang tshul yin pas/ ji skad du/ dam pa srog la babs na yang / /rang bzhin bzang po ga la 'dor/ /sa le sbram ni bsregs bcad kyang / /de yi kha dog nyams mi 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don dang rjes su 'brel/ de'ang tshe 'dir rang rgyud la gos pa'i sdig pas cha tsam yang bsgrun par mi nus pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas/dang por nga zhes bdag la zhen gyur cing / /bdag gi 'di zhes dngos la chags skyes pas/ /zo chun 374

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mar rdzas khang bzang gi dkar sa (ma'aphyan ltar rang dbang med pa yi/ /'gro la snying rjer gyur gang de la 'dud/ /ces bdag tu 'dzin pa'i dbang gis sems can thams cad thog ma med pa nas zo chun gyi 'byud mo ltar 'khor ba 'dir 'khor zhing / dge dang mi dge'i lung ma bstan gyi las sna tshogs bsags pa'i nag po'i las rnams ma sbyangs na je 'phel du 'gyur bas stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags pa la blo ldan rnams 'bad pas bsgrub pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/ dam pa sdig pa chung yang spong / /dman rnams chen po'ang de lta min/ /zho la rdul phran 'byar ba sel/ /chang la phabs kyang lhag par 'debs/ /zhes 'byung zhing / mi dge ba'i las phra mo la'ang brnyas par mi rung ba'i 'dul ba lung las/ sdig pa chung ngu dag la yang / /mi gnod snyam du brnyas (299ba)mi bya/ /me 'dag chung ngu dag gis kyang / /rto phung ri tsam bsreg par byed/ zhes pa ltar rnam par nag pa'i gos bu 'phel ba dang smin pa'i tshul legs par ma bsams na/ zhi ba lhas/dge ba dag kyang ma byas shing / /sdig pa dag kyang nyer bsags na/ /bskal pa bye ba brgyar yang ni/ /bde 'gro'i sgra yang thos mi 'gyur/ /zhes nyes dmigs shin tu che zhing / /las 'bras mi bslu ba ni mdo las/ /lus can rnams kyi las rnams ni/ /bskal pa brgyar yang chud mi 'dza'/ /tsho gis shing dusal babs pa na/ /'bras bu nyid du smin par 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don bsams nas rnam smin nag po mi 'dzag pa zhig
