dgos pa'i phyir sman pa mkhas pas bkru sman gyis nad drungs nas dbyung ba bzhin sngon chad kyi las la dug khong du song ba lta bu'i 'gyod sems phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi byed pa'i sdom sems/ gnyen po rten gyi stobs mkhas mchog dbyig gnyen gyis/ gang la dad pa tsam rgyas kyang / /rnam smin ma nges chos bcoms te/ /mtho ris bde myong myang 'das thob/ /zhing mchog rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes dang / lha las phul byung las/ /snying nas dad dam ji ltar dga' ba dang / the tshom gyis sam gas gyi ngor yang rung / /'on kyang thub dbang zla ba der phyag bgyid/ /des ni lha mi'i bde ba phun tshogs 'thob/ ces yul khyad par can gyi yon to la yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po sngon du bto nas gnyen po kun tu spyod pa/ /(300na sko gsum 'bad pa chen pos rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnams glegs —375

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (0)bam du 'dri ba nyid mchog tu gyur cing //bsam pa'i khyad par ni srid pa'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang /srid pa las rnam par grol ba'i tshul gnyis las//snga ma ni sbyin sogs kyi dge ba rgya chen po bskrun pa tshe 'di'i chos brgyad kyi ched dang /phyi ma lha mi'i bde 'bras tsam don du gnyer ba/dper na nad kyisabatab pa sman dpyad sogs kyis re zhig bde'ang slar nad de mi ldog pa'i nges pa med pa bzhin dge ba'i mthus lha mi'i rten la bde ba myong yang sngon bsags kyi mi dge ba'i las la sos btab pa na ngan 'gror ltung bsag gyi bde bar mi drang ba'i phyir/lam sgron las/gang zhig thabs ni gang dag gis//'khor ba'i bde ba k+ṣe dag la//rang wo don du gnyer byed pa//skyes bu de ni tha mar bshad/khresaskyes bu chung ngu'i spyod tshul 'di gtso bor don du gnyer bya ma yin zhing /bsags pa'i dge ba'i 'brasabu wo ngu yi thos byang tso/ 'bring rang rgyal gyi byang tso/ wo po sangs rgyas kyi byang tso gsum po gang drang du sems bskyed na srid pa las rnam par grol ba/dper na skyes bu 'brum nad byang ba dang 'dra bas phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan gyi bde ba yin pas/de nyid las/khred pa'i bde la rgyab phyogs shing //sdig pa'i las las bzlog bdag nyid//gang zhig rang zhi tsam don gnyer//skyes bu de ni 'bring zhes bya//zhes gsungs pa 300bskyis bu 'bring gi lam gyi rim pa ni//rang nyid gcig pu zhi ba don du gnyer ba yin pas theg pa chen po'i rigs sad pa'i dbang po rnon po rnams kyis ched du bsgrub bya ma yin pa sdud pa las/gal te bskal pa bye bar dge ba'i las lam bcu//spyod kyang rang rgyal dgra bcom nyid la 'dod bskyed na//de tshe tshul khrims skyon byung tshul khrims nyams pa yin//sems bskyed de ni phas pham pas kyang shin tu lci//zhes pas gsal bar bstan la//gang don du gnyer ba spyod 'jug las//byang chub sems bskyed gyur nas skad cig gis//'khor ba'i bsdun rar bsdams pa'i nyam thag rnams//bde gshegs rnams kyi sras zhes brjod bya zhing //'jig rten lha mir bcas pa'i phyag byar 'gyur//zhes skad cig ma dang po la 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i 'gro ba zhig kyang semasabaskyed ma thag nas 'jig rten kun gyi mchod pa'i zhi/ /la ba'i sras su 'gyur zhing / rang gzhan gnyis

sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mar jo khang bzang gi dkar ga shā'iga'i don bde blag tu 'grub pa thob bya mthar thug rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur bas shes ldan rnams kyis gtso bor bsgrub pa'i gnas yin zhing /bsgrub tshul yang mgon po zhi ba lhas/'jig rten bde ba ji snyed pa//de kun gzhan bde 'dod las byung //'jig rten sdug bsngal ji snyed pa//de kun bdag bde 'dod las byung //mang du bshad lta ci dgos te//byis pa rang gi don byed dang //thub pa gzhan gyi don 301nasgo dzad pa//'di gnyis kyi ni khyad par ltos//zhes bdag gzhan mnyam par brje ba'i sems bzang po 'di nyid yin zhing //de bskyed pa'i rten kyang dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i rten 'di las lhag pa slob dpon tsan+d+ra go mis/gang zhig thob nas skye ba'i rgya mtsho mthar phyin cing //byang chub mchog gis sa bon dge ba'ang 'debs 'gyur ba//yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang yon tan lhag pa yi//mi nyid de ni su zhig 'bras bu med par byed//bde gshegs lam brten 'gro ba'i 'dren par mas tsā ra ba//sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa'i//lam de lha dang klu yis mi rnyed lha min dang //mkha' lding rigs 'dzin mi'am ci dang lto tsos min//zhes dang //zla ba sgron me'i mdo las/mchod pa tshad med rnam mang ji snyed pa//zhing ni bye ba khrag khrig gtams snyed du//skyes bu mchog la mchod pa de byas pas//byams pa'i sems la grangs dang char mi phod//ces gsungasapa'i don gyi snying po theg pa chen por sems bskyed pa'i phan yon mtha' klas pas de don tshul bzhin nyams su bstar ba po las lhag pa'i gang zag mchog tu gyur pa gzhan med pa'i phyir/lam sgron las//rang rgyud rtogs pa'i sdug bsngal gyis/ /gang zhig gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun/ /yang dag zad par kun nas 'dod/skyes bu de ni mchog yin no//zhes gsungs pas shes nus shing /zhi ba lhas//mi khom brgyad spangs khom pa 'di//dam chos sgron dang bcas pa las//301bskyos bu chen po'i spyod pa yis//tshe 'dir 'bras yod bya bar rigs//zhes dang //bzang bo dpal gyis zhus pa'i mdo las/gzugs sku mtshan rab rnams kyis spras pa dang //chos sku rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (pelas 'jig rten bde ba thams cad 'byung //'di las rgyal bas bsngags pa'i yon tan 'thob//'di ni zhing rnams sbyang ba'i mchog tu 'gyur//zhes gsungs//don gyi snying po blo gros mi zad pa'i mdo las tshig lhug par gsungs pa bka' gdams pa zhig gis tshigs bcad du bstengs par/ji ltar rgya mtsho che nang chu thigs lhung //rgya mtsho mjad bar du de mi 'dzad//de bzhin byang chub yongs bsngos dge ba yang //byang chub ma thob par du de mi 'dzad//ces dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' dag mchog gsum dam pa dpang por byas te rnam par dag pa'i smon lam dang bsngo bas mtshams sbyar na bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi mthar thug gi bar phan pa dang bde ba'i gos bu mi 'dzad pa la longs spyod par 'gyur ba/ji skad du//bsod nams rnam smin bde ste sdug bsngal thams cad sel//bsod nams ldan pa'i mi yi bsam pa thams cad 'grub//bdud bcom nas ni byang chub myur du reg par 'gyur//mya ngan 'das zhi ba bsil ba'i dngos po 'thob/zhes dang //bsod nams ldan pa 'dir bde phyi mar bde//skye ba bzang po thob pas302na ) phyi phyir bde//zhes rgya cher gsungs pa de don bzhin smon pa 'di lta ste//sdig dang sgrib rnyog rang rgyud chu klung la//nyer gos bsngo smon nor bu ke ta gas//bsgrungs par gto bde'i gzugs bas dngos44 bar//tso dbang sras dang slob mar bcas dgongs kyi//rgyal gsung pu sta ka 'phreng nya phyis khog/yangs por bsod nams nyer byas mu nyi ka/byang chen bar gyi skye bar 'bab pa'i char//'khri shing lus phra gnyis par 'gran bzod shog/khams dang dbang por 'tsham par dam pa'i chos//phung po mkha' ltar che bzung bral ba'i don//'gro kun rgyud la smin nas rnam grol lam//bder zhugs mi gnas myang 'das grong bgrod shog/ga song lta ci sgo gsum zug rngu'i tsher//snon po'i reg byas mes pa'i bde 'gro yang //ming mthar byas nas rdzogs ldan dga' ston cher//sems can mtha' dag longs su spyod par shog/gangs can ma la ya yi nags klung las//gtan bde'i bde skyid dri bsung dngar po mā/'thul ba'i legs byas rlud bzhen gom 'gros kyis//nges legs thang la dkyusathog gcod par shog/gser mdog zhwa yi cod pa/ 'amang ba'i bstan//li shi'i gur khang phub nas

sku gsung thug rten gsar bzhengs dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag 9)an+da snyil/zhun ma'i chu gter mtha' klas khyab pa'i khrims//mchog dman yongs kyi gnya' ba gnon par shog/ngag yis//thog med dus nas da lta'i bar bsags sdig/nag po'i ra ri 'byud pa legs bris chab//rnam dag bsngo smon lam gsum sar 'bab shog/skyed byed kun 'byung ri gzar nas babs chu//dge legs chu lon 'phrul gyis nyer bzlog pa//de myong gos bu'i sdug bsngal ming tsam yang //rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pas rnyed min shog/mtho ris yon tan bdun tshang dal 'byor rten//yang srid kun thob dge ba'i them skas min rgyal ba khyu mchog gi/mched zla'i ngang tshul 'dzin pa'i dpal thob shog/gsung rab 'dri klog mchod sogs sri zhu yi//'bras bu gang thob risasu ma chad pa'i//sems can mtha' dag kun mkhyen ye shes che//ring min mngon du 'gyur ba'i rgyu ru bsngo//zhes sa skyong blo bzang mthu stobs kyis bka' 'gyur yongs su rdzogs pa gsar du bzhengs pa'i dus bsku la ma byung ba ltar dkar chag dang 'brel ba'i bsngo smon mtshams 303na skyor dang bcasapa dad pa'i gsos sman zhes pa 'di ni snon gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rgyal ba gnyis ba'i tshes la za hor gyi ban+de 'jam dbyangs dga' ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rang byung 'phags pa'i gtsug lag khang po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa su sti si(bha ( //bal po bri la jug dpal 'khor chos sde'i sman bla'i lha tshogasaXzhengs pa'i deb gyi 'go brjod dgos tshul ltar bris pa sdug kun

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ (20)sto sto : la dang ra/ khyod mtshan thos pa'i mod la 'gro rgyud kyi/ /sdug kun nyer zhi'i mchod sbyin sgo 'phar brgya/ /'byed mdzad sman bla mched bdun mdo chog dbyangs/ /mgur nas len mkhas shākya seng ge bsngags/ dpal 'khor bde ba chen po'i ga rjo lar/ /stong phrag 'dus pas chog gos gsung rten/ /'a sdungs pa'i mdud 'grol bal po bi la mis/ /bzhengs pa'i bsod nams ri bo dngos brgyu bzhin/ /phyi rabs dpyod ldan rnams kyang ngang tshul 'di'i/ /rjes su zhugs par rigs zhes rnam dkar gyi/ /dge bskul deb gter lha yi rnga bo che/ /srid rtse'i bar du brdungs la rna ba lhogs/ /zhes mchode par brjod pa'i tshig gis sngun bsus te/ nyi ma'i gnyen gyi rgyud las gangs ljongs 'dir/ /rigs gsum sgyu dra'i gar mkhan mes dpon sogs/ /phul byung thugs bskyed smon lam lde mig gis/ /phan bde'i sgo 'byed chos rgyal rim byon rgyal/ /dmar ser dhīḥyig sa bon dar drag pas/ /'jam mgon lang tsho (303ba〉sgongs smin btsong kha pa'i/ /thugs rje nam mkha'i mkha' rnyed 'gro rgyud la/ /rab 'jug skal bzang bsod nams bye bas bsgrubs/ /chos srid 'od kyis 'jig rten gsum khyab pa'i/ /'phrin las shing rta sku tri sha yi/ /nyer mtshan 'dzin mar 'dren byed kha lo pa/ /tshangs sras bzhad pa'i rdo rje brtan gyur cig /tshe ring gnam gyi she mong dpung pa yis/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos 'jam dpal snying po'i bstan/ /rgya mtsho'i gos can khyon la gyen 'degs pa/ /lha mi'i dbang phyug g.yung drung ltar brtan shog /thog mtha' bar dge'i gtsug lag bye ba'i gzhud / /ma smad spobs mthor rab son khog yangs por/ /mgrin pa'i 'bor lo grol ba'i rgyud mang glu/ /snyan po thos 'dzin dpyid du len par spro/ /risamed 'gror chags rgyal kun thugs rje'i spyan/ /dkyus ring srid pa'i mtha' snyed rdzogs min kyang / /bskal bzang 'di la lhas lhag rnam 'dren stong / /'byon zhes lha rnams bstod bsngags me rtag 'thor/khyad par gdul dka' dus 'dir snying stobs go /btsan po yongs bzhes shākya seng ge yis/ /rim gsum 'khor lo bskor nas gdul bya'i tshogs/ /mthong thos dran dang reg pas grol bar mdzad/ /semasacan dbang por 'tsham pa'i chos kyi grangs/ /'dzin par dka' yang theg pa che chung gnyis/ /grub —380pha

sku gsung thugs rten gsar 4khos dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar ga (momatha' rnam bzhi'i srol 'dzin rgyan drug dang //mchog zung rjes 'brangs paṇa chen skar tshogs bzhin//nges gsang long dgongs don gzhir bzung nas/spros tshe snang srid thams cad mngon sum bzhin//mkhas la legs bshad chen po de mtshungs ston//blun 3yi khor grong tshig dmangs dbus 'chal ba'i ngag/mchog dman bar pa'i yid gso rtsi sman ljon//smra ba rnam dpyod ldan rnamasang nga tshul yin//bde go bya rigs rnam gling paṇ+ḍita sa//ring 'tsho'i bden brjod sngon song 'phros gtam gyi//rtsa tshig bskul ltar za hor baṇ+ḍi yis//bkod tshe 'jam dbyangs grags pas yi ger bris//sa lug sdopa sang rgyas rgya mtsho khri 'don gyi dus tham phud kyi kha byang blta srid be mor byed pa/gnam jo bo rin po che/sa'i dkyil 'khor bar gnas 'gro rnams kyis///nga len lung gi lag rtags rnam bkra ba/'i kya seng

rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i gsung 'bum/ rtogege'i spyan sngar phul ba'i dges//phun tshogs sde bzhi'i sgo 'phar 'byed nus shog/don jo bo 7cad rdo rje/kun grub pa'i bslu med dus rtsa ba gsum dmag zor ma dpal lha dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa rnams la phul ba'i zhal byang dpag ba4 'dod 'jo/mkha' 'gro rtsa ba gsum/rnam lnga'i byin rlabs 'phrul po ches//skor gsum ru bzhi sgang drug phrag pa na/khrims gnyis gser gyi gnya' shing rab lci'i rtags//ri mo nyin byed 'od 3san sgo tshan 'bar bar shog/mchog das ma/dman kun gyi gnya' bar lci ba'i lung //rtags mgo nor bu gsum pa'i ri mo'i rjes//'jig rten yongs kyi gtsug na mngon gsal bar//mdzod cig dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug gi/'bum da45lha/phrag zla bzhin 'od kyis srid pa gsum//gsal ba'i lag rtags ri mo mngon can//tshangs pa'i rgyal po'i rdzu 'phrul mthu bo ches//thogs med legs bsgrub dga' ston stsal du gsol//mtha' klas yid can kun gyi rgyud la nyer gos dug gsum tsha gdung nad//thugs rje ta'i ra yi zegs rlabs chen spyod pa'i rlung shugs kyis//tsho gos gnyisachu gter brgal bar sangs rgyas rnams//mnyam yang smon lam yid bzhin nor bu yis//cher snyigasadabul sel sman gyi bla ma rgyal/ /sprul zhing lta na sdug pa'i grong khyer du/ /rig pa'i ye shes yid las skyes gnyis kyis//dris lan tshul gyis byin gyisaXrlabs pa'i bka'//lha dang drang srong phyi 3skab

sku gsung thugasarten gsar bzhengasadang rin po che'i mgo rdzasakhang bzang gi dkar sa shāminang 'khor la bshad//bkrashisa.a tha'i yi ge mesapo yi//mkhur tshosanasabardol tshe sgrub rig byed sogs/khrog gigasob ring spelagatsugalag gi/brjod don mtha' dgargyud 'dir tshang bar 'dus//thub dbang spyan sngar 'tsho byed gzhen nusabasos//de slob nā gārdzun dpa' bo'i sde//zla ba mngon par dgas 'ongasadon//zab mo'i gter du gsang ba'i phyag rgyasabatab//sgo 'byed dbang phyug 'bar sogasarim byon mthar//rigs 'dus sman rgyal g.yu thog gu ṇa yis//cha lag dang bcas rnam bshad dmar khrid kyis//kun khyab skye rgu'i bdag po gnyisamang sprul//mtha' klasarig byed sbyangasapa tshangasapa'i bu//rgyu skar 'phreng tshogs dbus na nyi zla bzhin//chos rgyal byang pa mnyam nyid rdo rje'i drin//bod khamasa'agro bsabaskal brgyar gzhalanusaci//rtsabashad rtsamado'i dgongasa'agrel dngul dkar gyi//me long ltar gsal mesapo'i zhal lung 'phros//chu mdo man 'grel bdud rtsi dar mo ba//blo bzang chosagragasarig rtsal mtsho lasathon//snang la ma ngesa'abyul phra'i rnyog ma rnams//rnam gling paṇa chen ke ta gas bsgrungs pa'i//nyal 'gro 'chi gsos drang srong ā ga sdus//legs bsgyur nad sel yan lag brgyad ldan 306nad+ku//mdo rgyud lung khungs sgro gshog rab brgyas dgod//na yams mkha' mtha' spyod lajad min par//tshig don mngon gsal rgya khra phyag len gyi//phyugs med zan bcur shes ldan yid kyi gsos//thob dka'i mi lus rin chen 'du 'khrugs pa'i//zug rngu'i 'dam drisasbags pa drungs phyung ste/ /legs byas rgyal mtshan rtser bkod sim tshor gyi//phun tshogs 'dod dgu'i gru char 'bebasade spro//phra mo'i srog chagasa'atshe ba lhur blangs dges//bsgrubasa'abrasa'adi phyir rab myong khe dpogasal/ /gzhol na sangasargyasasgrub rten 'chi 'dag las/ /rgyal ba'ibasod namasasridagasum khongasami shong //chesaphra'i dkar nag gzugasabs mja sum du//ma 'asalang ba lha go nyi ma'i bu'i//pho nya'i sor mosago du.ā dar+ṣa//'dzin ma'i mngal khur de yang dgadodagatong //'dus 8

sbyin tsho rig byed//lha dang drang srong phyi nang lugs4na la//dar ba'i yang gan rgyud bzhi'i gzhung don sogs//las to phyag len phyogs bas rgyas par shog/gtsug lag 'dir sbyangs de 'bras rab bkrol bar//sman gyi bla ma drang srong brgyud 'dzin bcas//dgyes zhal lhug par bstan nas tshe rabs su//'bral med thugs rje chen pos dbugs dbyung shog/ma pham dbus su 'gyur tshal du mchog sprul gar//bsgyur sku gsung thugs rten gsar ba tshe pas dang rin po che'i mchod rdzas khang bzang gi dkar chag slonasrid kun tu dal 'byor lus thob cing / /brtson khrus go rgyan shes rab ral gri'i mtshon/ /thogs nas gso rig gtsug lag mtha' klas par/ /skye rgu'i bdag po'i rnam thar yongs 'dzin shog /zhi byed dpyid kyi nus pa 'phrul po ches/ /bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kyis gtses pa yi/ /mi bzad zug rngu dungs nas won nus par/ /lha rje gzhen nus bsos kyi mched por shog /'gro gzhan 'du ba 'khrugs pa'i gdung ba rnams/ /bsal bas las nyon rang rgyud la gos pa/ /legs par byang ste thar pa'i grong khyer du/ /zhugs nas gtan shu bde ba 'thob par shog /zhi ba'i lam la ma chags rgyal sras kyi/ /rlabs chen spyod pas shes sgrib t+tha mo yang / /nyer spangs mi mjed zhing mgon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /go 'phang mngon gyur don gnyis lhun grub shog /rnam 'dren be+e ḍūrla yi 'od po che/ /'jig rten byed po dga' ba brgya pa sogs/ /lha dang drang srong rigs 'dzin tshogs rnams kyis/ /bkra shis dpal 'bar khams gsum yongs khyab shog /lus can mtha' dag gi srog 'tsho'i rtsi sman (307ba〉dud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud chen po las rtsa bshad gnyis dang phyi rgyud rtsa mdo yan gyi gzhung don 'grel par mang thos mkhas pa'i dbang po zur mkhar blo gros rgyal pos mdzad pa'i chu mdo man lor lus pa yar stod dar mo sman rams pa blo bzang chos grags kyis gzhung gi tshig don rnams bkrol te lag len gyi thog tu phebs pa'i zhal lung gnyis pa dka' gnad rdo rje'i mdud 'grol gsar du bskrun par rnam sras gling pa bya rigs paṇa chen dkon mchog chos grags kyi zhus dag par byas pa'i pusta gaḥ dga' ldan phun tshogs gling du par brkos kyi tshe che brjod smon lam bkra shis dang bcas pa za hor gyi bzhes sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson 'jam dbyangs grags pas bgyis pa sarba kā le a tha mu da ya bha ( / /sa
